````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useState, useMemo } from "react";
import SlideoutPanel from "@organisms/SlideoutPanel/SlideoutPanel";
import BasicSlideoutFooter from "./BasicSlideoutFooter";
import { Modal } from "@organisms/Modal/Modal";
import type { BasicSlideoutFooterButtons } from "@components/shared/shapes/BasicSlideoutShapes";
import BodyHeaderPanel from "./BasicSlideoutBodyHeader/BodyHeaderPanel";
import type { BodyHeaderPanelProps } from "./BasicSlideoutBodyHeader/BodyHeaderPanel";
import AlertBar from "@atoms/AlertBar/AlertBar";
import type { AlertBarProps } from "@atoms/AlertBar/AlertBar";
import {
    StyledSlideoutWrapper,
    StyledSlideoutHeader,
    StyledTitleContainer,
    StyledHeaderActionContainer,
    StyledCloseIcon,
    StyledBodyWrapper
} from "./BasicSlideout.styles";

type ModalType = "confirmation" | "information" | "decorated" | "error" | "destructive";

type LocaleTexts = {
    UNSAVED_CHANGES_CONFIRMATION?: string;
    UNSAVED_CHANGES_PRIMARY_ACTION?: string;
    UNSAVED_CHANGES_SECONDARY_ACTION?: string;
    UNSAVED_CHANGES_TITLE?: string;
};

const DEFAULT_LOCALE_TEXTS = {
    UNSAVED_CHANGES_CONFIRMATION: "Are you sure you want to discard your unsaved changes?",
    UNSAVED_CHANGES_PRIMARY_ACTION: "Discard",
    UNSAVED_CHANGES_SECONDARY_ACTION: "Cancel",
    UNSAVED_CHANGES_TITLE: "Unsaved Changes"
};

export type BasicSlideoutProps = {
    alerts?: AlertBarProps[];
    bodyHeader?: BodyHeaderPanelProps["bodyHeader"];
    buttons?: BasicSlideoutFooterButtons | null;
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    closeOnKeyEscape?: boolean;
    "data-testid"?: string;
    hasBodyHeader?: boolean;
    hasUnsavedChanges?: boolean;
    headerAction?: React.ReactElement;
    isOpen?: boolean;
    localeTexts?: LocaleTexts;
    modalType?: ModalType;
    muiColumnsOverride?: number;
    onCloseClick?: () => void;
    onExited?: () => void;
    title?: React.ReactNode;
    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly?: number;
};

export const BasicSlideout = ({
    isOpen,
    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly,
    onCloseClick,
    onExited,
    buttons,
    title,
    muiColumnsOverride,
    hasUnsavedChanges,
    modalType = "confirmation",
    localeTexts = {},
    headerAction,
    children,
    closeOnKeyEscape = false,
    hasBodyHeader = false,
    bodyHeader = {} as BodyHeaderPanelProps["bodyHeader"],
    alerts,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: BasicSlideoutProps) => {
    const _localeTextOverwrites = { ...DEFAULT_LOCALE_TEXTS, ...localeTexts };

    const [showUnsavedChangesModal, setShowUnsavedChangesModal] = useState(false);

    const handleClose = useCallback(() => {
        if (hasUnsavedChanges) {
            setShowUnsavedChangesModal(true);
            return;
        }
        onCloseClick?.();
    }, [onCloseClick, hasUnsavedChanges]);

    const handleDiscard = useCallback(() => {
        setShowUnsavedChangesModal(false);
        onCloseClick?.();
    }, [onCloseClick]);

    const handleStay = useCallback(() => {
        setShowUnsavedChangesModal(false);
    }, []);

    const slideoutButtons = useMemo(() => {
        if (buttons === undefined || buttons === null) {
            return null;
        }

        const newButtons = { ...buttons };
        if (newButtons.cancel && !newButtons.cancel.onClick) {
            newButtons.cancel = { ...newButtons.cancel, onClick: handleClose };
        }
        return newButtons;
    }, [buttons, handleClose]);

    const unsavedModalButtons = useMemo(
        () => ({
            primary: {
                children: _localeTextOverwrites.UNSAVED_CHANGES_PRIMARY_ACTION,
                onClick: handleDiscard
            },
            secondary: {
                children: _localeTextOverwrites.UNSAVED_CHANGES_SECONDARY_ACTION,
                onClick: handleStay
            }
        }),
        [
            _localeTextOverwrites.UNSAVED_CHANGES_PRIMARY_ACTION,
            _localeTextOverwrites.UNSAVED_CHANGES_SECONDARY_ACTION,
            handleDiscard,
            handleStay
        ]
    );

    return (
        <SlideoutPanel
            zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly={zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly}
            isOpen={isOpen}
            onOutsideClick={handleClose}
            onExited={onExited}
            muiColumnsOverride={muiColumnsOverride}
            closeOnKeyEscape={closeOnKeyEscape}
            data-testid={dataTestId}
        >
            <StyledSlideoutWrapper muiColumnsOverride={muiColumnsOverride}>
                <StyledSlideoutHeader>
                    <StyledTitleContainer>
                        <StyledCloseIcon onClick={handleClose} data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-close-button`}>
                            <i className="fal fa-times" />
                        </StyledCloseIcon>
                        {title}
                    </StyledTitleContainer>
                    {headerAction && <StyledHeaderActionContainer>{headerAction}</StyledHeaderActionContainer>}
                </StyledSlideoutHeader>
                {alerts &&
                    alerts.map(({ children, ...props }, i) => (
                        <AlertBar key={i} {...props}>
                            {children}
                        </AlertBar>
                    ))}
                <StyledBodyWrapper muiColumnsOverride={muiColumnsOverride}>
                    {hasBodyHeader && bodyHeader != undefined && (
                        <BodyHeaderPanel bodyHeader={bodyHeader} data-testid={dataTestId}></BodyHeaderPanel>
                    )}
                    {children}
                </StyledBodyWrapper>
                {slideoutButtons !== null && <BasicSlideoutFooter buttons={slideoutButtons} data-testid={dataTestId} />}
            </StyledSlideoutWrapper>
            <Modal
                buttons={unsavedModalButtons}
                type={modalType}
                header={_localeTextOverwrites.UNSAVED_CHANGES_TITLE}
                showModal={showUnsavedChangesModal}
                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-unsaved-changes-modal`}
            >
                {_localeTextOverwrites.UNSAVED_CHANGES_CONFIRMATION}
            </Modal>
        </SlideoutPanel>
    );
};

export default BasicSlideout;
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import type { Row } from "react-table";
import Button from "@atoms/button/Button";
import type { ButtonProps } from "@atoms/button/Button";
import { StyledActionWrapper, StyledButtonsContainer } from "../DataTableStyles";

export type ActionItem = ButtonProps & {
    clearSelectionAfterClick?: boolean;
    hide?: boolean;
    icon?: React.ReactNode;
    onClick?: (
        rowId: string | number,
        toggleRowSelected: (value: boolean) => void,
        rowOriginal: unknown,
        refetchData?: () => void
    ) => void;
};

export type ActionListValue = ActionItem[] | { hide: true };

export type ActionCellProps = {
    "data-testid"?: string;
    refetchData?: () => void;
    row: Row;
    rowIndex: number;
    toggleRowSelected: (value: boolean) => void;
    value?: ActionListValue;
};

const ActionCell = ({
    value: actionList,
    toggleRowSelected,
    rowIndex,
    row,
    refetchData,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: ActionCellProps) => {
    const stopPropagation = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
    };

    const handleActionOnClick = useCallback(
        (action: ActionItem, rowId: string | number) => {
            action.onClick && action.onClick(rowId, toggleRowSelected, row.original, refetchData);

            action.clearSelectionAfterClick && toggleRowSelected(false);
        },
        [refetchData, row.original, toggleRowSelected]
    );

    const rowActionList = useMemo(() => {
        if (!actionList || (actionList as { hide?: boolean }).hide) {
            return;
        }

        return (actionList as ActionItem[]).map(action => {
            let onClick;
            if (action.onClick) {
                onClick = () => handleActionOnClick(action, row.id);
            }
            return {
                ...action,
                onClick: onClick
            };
        });
    }, [actionList, handleActionOnClick, row.id]);

    return (
        <StyledActionWrapper
            onClick={stopPropagation}
            data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-action-cell-row-${rowIndex}`}
        >
            <StyledButtonsContainer>
                {rowActionList &&
                    rowActionList.map((action, index) => {
                        if (!action.hide) {
                            return (
                                <Button
                                    {...action}
                                    key={action.id}
                                    type="borderless"
                                    isIconOnly
                                    onClick={action.onClick}
                                    disabled={action.disabled || false}
                                    data-testid={
                                        dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-action-cell-row-${rowIndex}-button-${index}`
                                    }
                                >
                                    {action.icon}
                                </Button>
                            );
                        }
                    })}
            </StyledButtonsContainer>
        </StyledActionWrapper>
    );
};

export default React.memo(ActionCell);
````

````typescript
import { useCallback } from "react";

export type UseInitialSelectedRowsParams = {
    hasSelections?: boolean;
    initialSelectionKey?: string;
    accessorKey: string;
};

const useInitialSelectedRows = ({ hasSelections, initialSelectionKey, accessorKey }: UseInitialSelectedRowsParams) =>
    useCallback(
        (data: unknown[], toggleRowSelected?: (id: string | number, value: boolean) => void) => {
            if (hasSelections && data.length && initialSelectionKey) {
                for (const item of data) {
                    if ((item as Record<string, unknown>)[initialSelectionKey]) {
                        const id = (item as Record<string, unknown>)[accessorKey];
                        toggleRowSelected?.(id as string | number, true);
                    }
                }
            }
        },
        [accessorKey, hasSelections, initialSelectionKey]
    );

export default useInitialSelectedRows;
````

````javascript
import React from "react";
import PropTypes from "prop-types";
import LazyLoadTableRow from "./LazyLoadTableRow";
import TableCell from "@atoms/TableCell/TableCell";
import { PrebuiltCell, containsPrebuilt, optimizedProps } from "../PrebuiltCells/PrebuiltCell";

const MemoRow = React.memo(LazyLoadTableRow);
const MemoCell = React.memo(TableCell);

const Rows = ({
    rows,
    prepareRow,
    lazyRows,
    accessorKey,
    dataTrackAction,
    hasSelections,
    getCellInfo,
    increaseRowsLoaded,
    hasAsyncData,
    refetchData,
    dataTestId,
    onRowClick,
    disableTrackPostfix
}) => {
    return rows.slice(0, lazyRows).map((row, index) => {
        prepareRow(row);
        const rowProps = row.getRowProps();
        const rowIndex = row.original[accessorKey];
        const dataTrackActionRow = row.original?.dataTrackAction || dataTrackAction;

        return (
            <MemoRow
                key={rowProps.key}
                id={rowProps.key}
                rowInfo={index}
                isSelected={row.isSelected}
                triggerLazyAdd={index % 99 === 0 && index !== 0 && increaseRowsLoaded}
                onClick={onRowClick}
                hasSelections={hasSelections}
                getCellInfo={getCellInfo}
                row={row}
                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-row-${index}`}
                dataTrackAction={disableTrackPostfix ? dataTrackActionRow : `${dataTrackActionRow}-row-${rowIndex}`}
            >
                {row.cells.map(cell => {
                    const cellProps = cell.getCellProps();
                    return (
                        <MemoCell
                            key={cellProps.key}
                            cellType={row.canExpand ? "subHeader" : "body"}
                            componentType="div"
                            dataType={cell.column.type}
                            cellWidth={cell.column.cellWidth}
                            minWidth={cell.column.minWidth}
                            maxWidth={cell.column.maxWidth}
                            cellColor="#0a1b36"
                            cellPadding="8px 16px !important;"
                        >
                            {containsPrebuilt(cell.column.type) ? (
                                <PrebuiltCell
                                    {...optimizedProps(cell.value, cell.column.type)}
                                    toggleRowSelected={hasSelections && row.toggleRowSelected}
                                    data-testid={dataTestId}
                                    dataTrackAction={cell.row?.original?.dataTrackAction || dataTrackAction}
                                    type={cell.column.type}
                                    rowIndex={rowIndex}
                                    row={row}
                                    hasAsyncData={hasAsyncData}
                                    refetchData={refetchData}
                                    onToggleCallback={cell.column?.onToggleCallback || undefined}
                                />
                            ) : (
                                cell.render("Cell")
                            )}
                        </MemoCell>
                    );
                })}
            </MemoRow>
        );
    });
};

Rows.propTypes = {
    rows: PropTypes.array.isRequired,
    prepareRow: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
    lazyRows: PropTypes.number.isRequired,
    accessorKey: PropTypes.string.isRequired,
    dataTrackAction: PropTypes.string,
    hasSelections: PropTypes.bool,
    getCellInfo: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
    increaseRowsLoaded: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
    hasAsyncData: PropTypes.bool,
    refetchData: PropTypes.func,
    dataTestId: PropTypes.string,
    onRowClick: PropTypes.func
};

export default Rows;
````

````typescript
import React, { createContext, useCallback, useContext, useMemo, useReducer } from "react";

const DataTableAsyncContext = createContext<DataTableAsyncContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

const SET_DATA = "SetData";
const SET_TOTAL_COUNT = "SetTotalCount";
const SET_LOADING = "SetLoading";
const SET_FILTERS = "SetFilters";
const SET_PAGE_INDEX = "SetPageIndex";
const SET_PAGE_SIZE = "SetPageSize";
const SET_SORT = "SetSort";
const SET_SORT_ORDER = "SetSortOrder";
const SET_API_ERROR = "SetApiError";
const REFETCH_TRIGGER = "RefetchTrigger";
const SET_TOTAL_FILTERED_COUNT = "SetTotalFilteredCount";
const SET_TOOLBAR_OPTIONS = "SET_TOOLBAR_OPTIONS";

type FilterState = {
    search: string;
    selected: Array<unknown>;
};

type ApiErrorState = {
    message?: string;
    code?: string | number;
} | null;

    refetchTrigger: number;
    totalFilteredCount: number;
};

type DataTableAsyncAction =
    | { type: typeof SET_DATA; payload: Array<unknown> }
    | { type: typeof SET_TOTAL_COUNT; payload: number }
    | { type: typeof SET_LOADING; payload: boolean }
    | { type: typeof SET_FILTERS; payload: FilterState }
    | { type: typeof SET_PAGE_INDEX; payload: number }
    | { type: typeof SET_PAGE_SIZE; payload: string }
    | { type: typeof SET_API_ERROR; payload: ApiErrorState }
    | { type: typeof SET_SORT; payload: string }

    | { type: typeof SET_TOTAL_FILTERED_COUNT; payload: number }

type DataTableAsyncContextValue = DataTableAsyncState & {

    dispatch: React.Dispatch<DataTableAsyncAction>;
};

export type DataTableAsyncContextProviderProps = {
    columns?: Array<unknown>;
    loading?: boolean;
    hasFilterGroup?: boolean;
    hasPagination?: boolean;
    errorMessages?: Record<string, unknown>;

    paginationProps?: Record<string, unknown>;
    filterGroupOptions?: Record<string, unknown>;
    dataTestId?: string;
    children: React.ReactNode;
};

const initialState = (
    columns?: Array<unknown>,
    loading?: boolean,
    hasFilterGroup?: boolean,
    hasPagination?: boolean,
    errorMessages?: Record<string, unknown>,
    defaultSortBy?: string,
    sortByDesc?: boolean,
    hasSelections?: boolean,
    toolbarOptions?: Record<string, unknown>,
    topOffset?: string,
    localTexts?: Record<string, unknown>,
    hiddenColumns?: Array<string>,
    initialSelectionKey?: string,
    rowActionList?: Array<unknown>,
    hasRowActions?: boolean,
    accessorKey?: string,
    dataTrackAction?: string,
    hasFixedLayout?: boolean,
    hasAsyncData?: boolean,
    onRowClick?: (row: unknown) => void,
    onSelectedRowChanged?: (selectedRows: Array<unknown>) => void,
    paginationProps?: Record<string, unknown>,
    filterGroupOptions?: Record<string, unknown>,
    dataTestId?: string
): DataTableAsyncState => {
    return {
        data: [],
        AllData: [],
        columns: columns || [],
        loading: loading || false,
        hasFilterGroup,
        hasPagination,
        errorMessages,
        defaultSortBy,
        sortByDesc,
        hasSelections,
        toolbarOptions,
        topOffset,
        localTexts,
        localeTexts: localTexts,
        hiddenColumns,
        initialSelectionKey,
        rowActionList,
        hasRowActions,
        accessorKey,
        dataTrackAction,
        hasFixedLayout,
        hasAsyncData,
        onRowClick,
        onSelectedRowChanged,
        paginationProps,
        filterGroupOptions,
        dataTestId,
        filters: { search: "", selected: [] },
        totalCount: 0,
        pageIndex: 0,
        pageSize: "10",
        serchTerm: "",
        searchTerm: "",
        sortBy: defaultSortBy || "",
        sortOrder: sortByDesc ? "desc" : "asc",
        defaultSortField: "",
        apiError: null,
        topBarHeight: 0,
        filterGroupHeight: 0,
        isOpen: false,
        refetchTrigger: 0,
        totalFilteredCount: 0
    };
};

export const reducer = (state: DataTableAsyncState, action: DataTableAsyncAction): DataTableAsyncState => {
    switch (action.type) {
        case SET_DATA:
            return { ...state, data: action.payload };
        case SET_TOTAL_COUNT:
            return { ...state, totalCount: action.payload };
        case SET_LOADING:
            return { ...state, loading: action.payload };
        case SET_FILTERS:
            return { ...state, filters: action.payload, pageIndex: 0 };
        case SET_PAGE_INDEX: {
            const pageIndex = Math.max(0, parseInt(String(action.payload), 10) - 1); // Ensure pageIndex is non-negative
            return { ...state, pageIndex };
        }
        case SET_PAGE_SIZE: {
            const pageSize = action.payload === "Show All" ? "All" : action.payload;
            return { ...state, pageSize };
        }
        case SET_API_ERROR:
            return { ...state, apiError: action.payload };
        case SET_SORT:
            return { ...state, sortBy: action.payload };
        case SET_SORT_ORDER:
            return { ...state, sortOrder: action.payload };
        case REFETCH_TRIGGER:
            return { ...state, refetchTrigger: state.refetchTrigger + 1 };
        case SET_TOTAL_FILTERED_COUNT:
            return { ...state, totalFilteredCount: action.payload };
        case SET_TOOLBAR_OPTIONS:
            return { ...state, toolbarOptions: action.payload };
        default:
            return state;
    }
};

export const DataTableAsyncContextProvider: React.FC<DataTableAsyncContextProviderProps> = ({
    columns,
    loading,
    hasFilterGroup,
    hasPagination,
    errorMessages,
    defaultSortBy,
    sortByDesc,
    hasSelections,
    toolbarOptions,
    topOffset,
    localeTexts: localTexts,
    hiddenColumns,
    initialSelectionKey,
    rowActionList,
    hasRowActions,
    accessorKey,
    dataTrackAction,
    hasFixedLayout,
    hasAsyncData,
    onRowClick,
    onSelectedRowChanged,
    paginationProps,
    filterGroupOptions,
    dataTestId,
    children
}) => {
    const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(
        reducer,
        initialState(
            columns,
            loading,
            hasFilterGroup,
            hasPagination,
            errorMessages,
            defaultSortBy,
            sortByDesc,
            hasSelections,
            toolbarOptions,
            topOffset,

            rowActionList,
            hasRowActions,
            accessorKey,
            dataTrackAction,
            hasFixedLayout,
            hasAsyncData,
            onRowClick,
            onSelectedRowChanged,
            paginationProps,
            filterGroupOptions,
            dataTestId
        )
    );

    const setData = useCallback(
        (data: Array<unknown>) => {
            dispatch({ type: SET_DATA, payload: data });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );
    const setTotalCount = useCallback(
        (totalCount: number) => {
            dispatch({ type: SET_TOTAL_COUNT, payload: totalCount });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );
    const setLoading = useCallback(
        (loading: boolean) => {
            dispatch({ type: SET_LOADING, payload: loading });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );
    const setFilters = useCallback(
        (filters: FilterState) => {
            dispatch({ type: SET_FILTERS, payload: filters });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );
    const setPageIndex = useCallback(
        (pageIndex: number) => {
            dispatch({ type: SET_PAGE_INDEX, payload: pageIndex });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );
    const setPageSize = useCallback(
        (pageSize: string) => {
            dispatch({ type: SET_PAGE_SIZE, payload: pageSize });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );
    const setApiError = useCallback(

    const setSortBy = useCallback(

        },
        [dispatch]
    );
    const setSortOrder = useCallback(
        (sortOrder: string) => {

        },
        [dispatch]
    );
    const setRefetchTrigger = useCallback(() => {
        dispatch({ type: REFETCH_TRIGGER });
    }, [dispatch]);

    const setTotalFilteredCount = useCallback(
        (totalCount: number) => {
            dispatch({ type: SET_TOTAL_FILTERED_COUNT, payload: totalCount });
        },

    );

    const setToolbarOptions = useCallback(
        (options: Record<string, unknown>) => {

        },
        [dispatch]
    );

    const value = useMemo(() => {
        return {
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import Switch from "@atoms/switch/Switch";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";

export type SwitchCellProps = {
    on?: boolean;
    onChange?: (event: React.SyntheticEvent, rowIndex: number) => void;
    disabled?: boolean;
    rowIndex: number;
    "data-testid"?: string;
    hide?: boolean;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
};

const SwitchCell = React.memo<SwitchCellProps>(
    ({ on, onChange, disabled, rowIndex, "data-testid": dataTestId, hide, dataTrackAction }) => {
        const _onChange = useCallback(
            (_isOn: boolean, e: React.SyntheticEvent) => {
                onChange && onChange(e, rowIndex);
            },
            [onChange, rowIndex]
        );

        const stopPropagation = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
        };

        if (hide) return null;

        return (
            <div style={{ position: "relative" }} onClick={stopPropagation}>
                <StyledSwitchCell>
                    <Switch
                        data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-switch-cell-${rowIndex}`}
                        on={on}
                        onChange={_onChange}
                        disabled={disabled}
                        isStandAlone
                        dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction && `${dataTrackAction}-switch-cell-${rowIndex}`}
                    />
                </StyledSwitchCell>
            </div>
        );
    }
);
export default SwitchCell;

const StyledSwitchCell = styled("div")`
    margin: 0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
`;
````

````typescript
import { useCallback } from "react";

export type UseDeleteRowReturn = (rowIndex: number) => void;

const useDeleteRow = (
    overwriteSelection: Record<string, boolean>,
    setOverwriteSelection: (selection: Record<string, boolean>) => void
): UseDeleteRowReturn =>
    useCallback(
        (id: number) => {
            const nextOverwriteSelection: Record<string, boolean> = {};
            delete overwriteSelection[id];

            Object.keys(overwriteSelection).forEach(key => {
                const numKey = parseInt(key);
                const numId = parseInt(String(id));
                const offset = numKey > numId ? 1 : 0;
                nextOverwriteSelection[String(numKey - offset)] = true;
            });

            setOverwriteSelection(nextOverwriteSelection);
        },
        [setOverwriteSelection, overwriteSelection]
    );

export default useDeleteRow;
````

````typescript
import React, { useMemo, type ReactNode } from "react";

export type ErrorMessages = {
    noItems?: ReactNode;
    notFound?: ReactNode;
};

export type EnrichedErrorMessages = {
    noItems: ReactNode;
    notFound: ReactNode;
};

const useEnrichedErrors = (errorMessages?: ErrorMessages) =>
    useMemo(() => {
        const defaultMessages: EnrichedErrorMessages = {
            noItems: "There are no items to display.",
            notFound: (
                <>
                    <span>No items found.</span>
                    <span>Try a different search or filter</span>
                </>
            )
        };

        if (typeof errorMessages === "object") {
            return {
                ...defaultMessages,
                ...errorMessages
            };
        }

        return defaultMessages;
    }, [errorMessages]);

export default useEnrichedErrors;
````

````typescript
import { useEffect } from "react";

export type UseLazyRowTriggerInViewParams = {
    triggerLazyAdd?: () => void;
    inView: boolean;
    setTrigger: (trigger: boolean) => void;
    trigger: boolean;
};

const useLazyRowTriggerInView = ({ triggerLazyAdd, inView, setTrigger, trigger }: UseLazyRowTriggerInViewParams) =>
    useEffect(() => {
        if (triggerLazyAdd && inView && !trigger) {
            triggerLazyAdd();
            setTrigger(true);
        }
    }, [triggerLazyAdd, inView, setTrigger, trigger]);

export { useLazyRowTriggerInView };
export default useLazyRowTriggerInView;
````

````typescript
import { useCallback } from "react";

export type UseSelectAllRowsTriggerParams = {
    overwriteSelection: Record<string, boolean>;
    setOverwriteSelection: (selection: Record<string, boolean>) => void;
    unselectableRows: number[];
    data: unknown[];
};

export type UseSelectAllRowsTriggerReturn = (value: boolean) => void;

const useSelectAllRowsTrigger = ({
    overwriteSelection,
    setOverwriteSelection,
    unselectableRows,
    data
}: UseSelectAllRowsTriggerParams): UseSelectAllRowsTriggerReturn =>
    useCallback(
        (value: boolean) => {
            if (!value) {
                setOverwriteSelection({});
                return;
            }

            const newOverwriteSelection: Record<string, boolean> = {};
            for (let i = 0; i < data.length; i++) {
                if (!unselectableRows.includes(i)) {
                    newOverwriteSelection[i] = true;
                }
            }
            setOverwriteSelection(newOverwriteSelection);
        },
        [data, overwriteSelection, setOverwriteSelection, unselectableRows]
    );

export default useSelectAllRowsTrigger;
````

````typescript
import React, { ReactElement } from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import TableToolbar from "@molecules/TableToolbar/TableToolbar";
import type { ButtonGroupConfig, BulkActionMenuItem } from "@molecules/TableToolbar/TableToolbar";

const MemoToolbar = React.memo(TableToolbar);

type LocaleTexts = {
    SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: string;
    BULK_ACTIONS: string;
    SELECTED: string;
};

type CustomToolbarFunction = (params: {
    toggleRowSelected: (id: string) => void;
    toggleAllRowsSelected: (value: boolean) => void;
    selectedRows: Record<string, unknown>;
}) => ReactElement;

type ToolbarOptions = {
    customToolbar?: CustomToolbarFunction;
    preFilterItemCount?: number;
    autoFocus?: boolean;
    buttons?: ButtonGroupConfig;
    tableType?: string;
    customButtons?: () => ReactElement;
    hasSearch?: boolean;
    defaultSearchVal?: string;
    bulkActionMenu?: BulkActionMenuItem[];
    leftComponents?: ReactElement;
    rightComponents?: ReactElement;
    hideToolbar?: boolean;
};

export type CustomizableToolbarProps = {
    topOffset: string;
    toolbarOptions?: ToolbarOptions;
    toggleRowSelected: (id: string) => void;
    triggerAllRowsSelect: (value: boolean) => void;
    overwriteSelection: Record<string, unknown>;
    preGlobalFilteredRows: unknown[];
    rows: unknown[];
    triggerGlobalFilterUpdate: (searchValue: string) => void;
    selectedRows: unknown;
    localeTexts?: Partial<LocaleTexts>;
    parentDataTestId?: string;
};

const CustomizableToolbar: React.FC<CustomizableToolbarProps> = ({
    topOffset,
    toolbarOptions,
    toggleRowSelected,
    triggerAllRowsSelect,
    overwriteSelection,
    preGlobalFilteredRows,
    rows,
    triggerGlobalFilterUpdate,
    selectedRows,
    localeTexts,
    parentDataTestId
}) => {
    return (
        <StickyToolbar $topOffset={topOffset}>
            {toolbarOptions?.customToolbar ? (
                toolbarOptions.customToolbar({
                    toggleRowSelected,
                    toggleAllRowsSelected: triggerAllRowsSelect,
                    selectedRows: overwriteSelection
                })
            ) : (
                <MemoToolbar
                    itemCount={rows.length}
                    preFilterItemCount={
                        toolbarOptions?.preFilterItemCount || preGlobalFilteredRows.length || rows.length
                    }
                    autoFocus={toolbarOptions?.autoFocus}
                    buttons={toolbarOptions?.buttons}
                    tableType={toolbarOptions?.tableType}
                    customButtons={toolbarOptions?.customButtons}
                    hasSearch={toolbarOptions?.hasSearch}
                    defaultSearchVal={toolbarOptions?.defaultSearchVal}
                    onSearchCallback={triggerGlobalFilterUpdate}
                    bulkActionMenu={toolbarOptions?.bulkActionMenu}
                    numSelectedRows={Object.keys(overwriteSelection).length}
                    toggleAllRowsSelected={triggerAllRowsSelect}
                    selectedRows={selectedRows}
                    localeTexts={localeTexts}
                    data-testid={`${parentDataTestId}_toolbar`}
                />
            )}
        </StickyToolbar>
    );
};

type StickyToolbarProps = {
    $topOffset: string;
};

const StickyToolbar = styled("div")<StickyToolbarProps>`
    position: sticky;
    top: ${props => props.$topOffset};
    z-index: 3;
    flex-grow: 1;
`;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import TableHead from "@atoms/TableHead/TableHead";
import TableRow from "@atoms/TableRow/TableRow";
import TableCell from "@atoms/TableCell/TableCell";
import type { HeaderGroup, ColumnInstance, UseSortByColumnProps } from "react-table";

const MemoHead = React.memo(TableHead);
const MemoRow = React.memo(TableRow);
const MemoCell = React.memo(TableCell);

type ExtendedColumnInstance = ColumnInstance<Record<string, unknown>> &
    Partial<UseSortByColumnProps<Record<string, unknown>>> & {
        cellWidth?: string;
        canSort?: boolean;
        onSorted?: () => void;
        type?: string;
    };

export type HeaderProps = {
    headerGroups: HeaderGroup<Record<string, unknown>>[];
    topOffset: string;
    hideToolbar: boolean;
};

const Header: React.FC<HeaderProps> = ({ headerGroups, topOffset, hideToolbar }) => {
    return (
        <MemoHead componentType="div">
            {headerGroups.map(headerGroup => {
                const headerGroupProps = headerGroup.getHeaderGroupProps();
                return (
                    <MemoRow {...headerGroupProps} componentType="div">
                        {headerGroup.headers.map(column => {
                            const extColumn = column as ExtendedColumnInstance;
                            const sortProps = extColumn.getSortByToggleProps?.();
                            const headerProps = extColumn.getHeaderProps(sortProps);
                            return (
                                <MemoCell
                                    cellType="header"
                                    componentType="div"
                                    dataType={extColumn.type}
                                    topOffset={`calc(${topOffset} + ${hideToolbar ? 0 : "64px"})`}
                                    cellWidth={extColumn.cellWidth}
                                    canSort={extColumn.canSort}
                                    isSorted={extColumn.isSorted}
                                    isSortedDesc={extColumn.isSortedDesc}
                                    onSorted={extColumn.onSorted}
                                    {...headerProps}
                                >
                                    {extColumn.render("Header")}
                                </MemoCell>
                            );
                        })}
                    </MemoRow>
                );
            })}
        </MemoHead>
    );
};

export default Header;
````

````typescript
import React, { useState, ReactNode } from "react";
import TableRow from "@atoms/TableRow/TableRow";
import TableSubHeader from "@atoms/TableSubHeader/TableSubHeader";
import useLazyLoadBlur, { CellInfo } from "../TableHooks/useLazyLoadBlur";
import useLazyRowTriggerInView from "../TableHooks/useLazyRowTriggerInView";
import { useInView } from "react-intersection-observer";
import useTypeCheckedOnClickRow from "../TableHooks/useTypeCheckedOnClickRow";

export type LazyLoadTableRowProps = {
    id: string | number;
    onClick?: (row?: unknown) => void;
    triggerLazyAdd?: () => void;
    isHeader?: boolean;
    isSelected?: boolean;
    hasSelections?: boolean;
    children: ReactNode;
    rowInfo?: unknown;
    getCellInfo: (rowInfo?: unknown) => CellInfo;
    row?: { canExpand?: boolean; [key: string]: unknown };
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const LazyLoadTableRow = ({
    id,
    onClick,
    triggerLazyAdd,
    isHeader,
    isSelected,
    hasSelections,
    children,
    rowInfo,
    getCellInfo,
    row,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: LazyLoadTableRowProps) => {
    const { ref, inView } = useInView({ threshold: 0 });
    const [trigger, setTrigger] = useState(false);
    const isSubHeader = !!row?.canExpand;

    const typeCheckedOnClick = useTypeCheckedOnClickRow({ onClick, row });
    useLazyRowTriggerInView({
        trigger,
        setTrigger,
        triggerLazyAdd,
        inView
    });
    const blur = useLazyLoadBlur({
        id,
        hasSelections,
        rowInfo,
        getCellInfo,
        isSubHeader
    });

    const rowChildren = isHeader || inView ? children : blur;
    const refWithHeaderUndefined = isHeader ? undefined : ref;

    return isSubHeader ? (
        <TableSubHeader ref={ref} componentType="div">
            {rowChildren}
        </TableSubHeader>
    ) : (
        <TableRow
            ref={refWithHeaderUndefined}
            isSelected={isSelected}
            onClick={typeCheckedOnClick}
            componentType="div"
            data-testid={dataTestId}
        >
            {rowChildren}
        </TableRow>
    );
};

export default LazyLoadTableRow;
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import { BaseCheckbox } from "@atoms/checkbox/Checkbox";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import type { Row, UseRowSelectRowProps } from "react-table";

const MemoCheckbox = React.memo(BaseCheckbox);

type ToggleAllRowsSelectedProps = {
    checked?: boolean;
    indeterminate?: boolean;
    onChange?: (...args: unknown[]) => void;
};

export type SelectionHeaderProps = {
    getToggleAllRowsSelectedProps: () => ToggleAllRowsSelectedProps;
    triggerAllRowsSelect: (value: boolean) => void;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

type ExtendedRow = Row<Record<string, unknown>> &
    Partial<UseRowSelectRowProps<Record<string, unknown>>> & {
        original?: {
            checkbox?: {
                hide?: boolean;
                disabled?: boolean;
            };
        };
    };

export type SelectionCellProps = {
    triggerRowSelect: (index: number, checked: boolean) => void;
    row: ExtendedRow;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

export const SelectionHeader: React.FC<SelectionHeaderProps> = ({
    getToggleAllRowsSelectedProps,
    triggerAllRowsSelect,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}) => {
    const allRowsSelectedProps = getToggleAllRowsSelectedProps();

    const _handleOnChange = useCallback(() => {
        if (allRowsSelectedProps.indeterminate) {
            triggerAllRowsSelect(false);
            return;
        }
        triggerAllRowsSelect(!allRowsSelectedProps.checked);
    }, [allRowsSelectedProps, triggerAllRowsSelect]);

    return (
        <CheckboxWrapper data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-select-header-wrap`}>
            <MemoCheckbox
                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-select-header-check`}
                checked={allRowsSelectedProps.checked}
                indeterminate={allRowsSelectedProps.indeterminate}
                onChange={_handleOnChange}
            />
        </CheckboxWrapper>
    );
};

export const SelectionCell: React.FC<SelectionCellProps> = ({ triggerRowSelect, row, "data-testid": dataTestId }) => {
    const rowSelectedProps = row.getToggleRowSelectedProps?.() || {};

    // trigger change for row to be selected
    const onChangeHandler = useCallback(
        (e: { checked: boolean }) => {
            triggerRowSelect(row.index, e.checked);
        },
        [triggerRowSelect, row]
    );

    // cancelling row click when checkbox is clicked
    const stopPropagation = useCallback((event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        event.stopPropagation();
    }, []);

    if (row.original?.checkbox?.hide) return null;

    return (
        <CheckboxWrapper
            data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-select-cell-wrap-${row.id}`}
            onClick={stopPropagation}
        >
            <MemoCheckbox
                inputProps={{ "aria-label": `Select row ${row.id}` }}
                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-select-cell-check-${row.id}`}
                checked={row.original?.checkbox?.disabled ? false : rowSelectedProps.checked}
                indeterminate={rowSelectedProps.indeterminate}
                onChange={onChangeHandler}
                disabled={row.original?.checkbox?.disabled}
            />
        </CheckboxWrapper>
    );
};

const CheckboxWrapper = styled("div")`
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    margin: -0.375rem;
`;
````

````typescript
import React, { useMemo, useContext, useEffect } from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import BasicSlideout from "@organisms/BasicSlideout/BasicSlideout";
import { WizardContextProvider, WizardContext } from "./WizardContext";
import WizardNavigationList from "./WizardNavigationList";
import { WizardStep } from "./WizardStep";
import type { WizardStep as WizardStepType } from "./WizardContext";
import type { BasicSlideoutFooterButtons } from "@components/shared/shapes/BasicSlideoutShapes";

type LocaleTexts = {
    BACK?: string;
    CANCEL?: string;
    NEXT?: string;
    SAVE?: string;
};

const DEFAULT_LOCALE_TEXTS = {
    BACK: "Back",
    CANCEL: "Cancel",
    NEXT: "Next",
    SAVE: "Save"
} as const;

export type WizardProps = {
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    "data-testid"?: string;
    isOpen?: boolean;
    localeTexts?: LocaleTexts;
    onClose?: () => void;
    onExited?: () => void;
    onSave?: () => void | Promise<void>;
    renderActiveOnly?: boolean;
    steps: WizardStepType[];
    title?: React.ReactNode;
    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly?: number;
};

type WizardSlideoutProps = {
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    "data-testid"?: string;
    isOpen?: boolean;
    localeTexts?: LocaleTexts;
    onClose?: () => void;
    onExited?: () => void;
    renderActiveOnly?: boolean;
    title?: React.ReactNode;
    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly?: number;
};

// THIS COMPONENT WILL BE DEPRECATED, PLEASE, USE MultistepWizard COMPONENT INSTEAD.
const Wizard = ({ steps, onSave, children, ...props }: WizardProps) => (
    <WizardContextProvider steps={steps} onSave={onSave}>
        <WizardSlideout {...props}>{children}</WizardSlideout>
    </WizardContextProvider>
);

const WizardSlideout = ({
    title,
    onClose,
    localeTexts,
    children,
    onExited,
    isOpen,
    renderActiveOnly,
    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: WizardSlideoutProps) => {
    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "development") {
        console.warn("ui-kit: Wizard component will be deprecated soon! Please, use MultistepWizard instead.");
    }

    const localeTextOverwrites = { ...DEFAULT_LOCALE_TEXTS, ...localeTexts };

    const {
        isFirstStep,
        isLastStep,
        goToNextStep,
        goToPreviousStep,
        steps,
        currentStepIndex,
        setCurrentStepIndex,
        isNextDisabled
    } = useContext(WizardContext) || {};

    useEffect(() => {
        // reset the wizard index on close
        if (!isOpen && currentStepIndex !== 0 && setCurrentStepIndex) {
            setCurrentStepIndex(0);
        }
    }, [isOpen, currentStepIndex, setCurrentStepIndex]);

    const buttons: BasicSlideoutFooterButtons = useMemo(
        () => ({
            cancel: {
                onClick: onClose,
                text: localeTextOverwrites.CANCEL,
                type: "border"
            },
            primary: {
                disabled: isNextDisabled,
                onClick: goToNextStep,
                text: isLastStep ? localeTextOverwrites.SAVE : localeTextOverwrites.NEXT
            },
            secondary: isFirstStep
                ? undefined
                : {
                      onClick: goToPreviousStep,
                      text: localeTextOverwrites.BACK,
                      type: "border"
                  }
        }),
        [
            isFirstStep,
            isLastStep,
            goToPreviousStep,
            goToNextStep,
            onClose,
            localeTextOverwrites.CANCEL,
            localeTextOverwrites.BACK,
            localeTextOverwrites.NEXT,
            localeTextOverwrites.SAVE,
            isNextDisabled
        ]
    );

    const wizardChildren = useMemo(
        () =>
            React.Children.toArray(children)
                .filter(c => c)
                .map((child, index) => {
                    if (!steps || !steps[index]) return null;
                    return (
                        <WizardStep key={steps[index].id} id={steps[index].id} renderActiveOnly={renderActiveOnly}>
                            {child}
                        </WizardStep>
                    );
                }),
        [children, steps, renderActiveOnly]
    );

    return (
        <BasicSlideout
            title={title}
            isOpen={isOpen}
            onCloseClick={onClose}
            buttons={buttons}
            onExited={onExited}
            zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly={zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly}
            data-testid={dataTestId}
        >
            <StyledWizardBody>
                {isOpen && (
                    <>
                        <WizardNavigationList />
                        {wizardChildren}
                    </>
                )}
            </StyledWizardBody>
        </BasicSlideout>
    );
};

const StyledWizardBody = styled("div")`
    display: flex;
    flex: 1;
    height: 100%;
`;

export default Wizard;
````

````typescript
import {
    DEFAULT_COLOR_ARRAY,
    DUAL_HEAT_COLOR_ARRAY,
    HEAT_COLOR_ARRAY,
    SECONDARY_COLOR_ARRAY
} from "./StyledComponents";

type ColorPaletteType = "default" | "secondary" | "dualHeat" | "heat" | undefined;

/**
 * Returns hex colors array used for charts.
 * If called without arguments, DEFAULT_COLOR_ARRAY is returned
 */
export const getChartsColorPalette = (type: ColorPaletteType): string[] => {
    let palette: string[];

    switch (type) {
        case "secondary":
            palette = SECONDARY_COLOR_ARRAY;
            break;
        case "dualHeat":
            palette = DUAL_HEAT_COLOR_ARRAY;
            break;
        case "heat":
            palette = HEAT_COLOR_ARRAY;
            break;
        default:
            palette = DEFAULT_COLOR_ARRAY;
            break;
    }

    return palette;
};
````

## File: src/components/shared/Recharts/RechartsHooks.tsx
````typescript
import { useReducer } from "react";

type RechartsState = {
    activeMap: Map<string | number, boolean>;
    stateData: Record<string, unknown>[];
    left: number | string;
    right: number | string;
    refAreaLeft?: number;
    refAreaRight?: number;
    bottom: number | string;
    top: number | string;
    hasNegativeValue: boolean;
};

type RechartsAction =
    | { type: "UpdateMap"; id: string | number; value: boolean }
    | {
          type: "UpdateZoom";
          value: {
              left: number | string;
              right: number | string;
              refAreaLeft?: number;
              refAreaRight?: number;
              bottom: number | string;
              top: number | string;
              stateData: Record<string, unknown>[];
          };
      }
    | { type: "UpdateRefAreaLeft"; value: number }
    | { type: "UpdateRefAreaRight"; value: number }
    | { type: "ResetRefArea" };

const rechartsReducer = (state: RechartsState, action: RechartsAction): RechartsState => {
    switch (action.type) {
        case "UpdateMap":
            return { ...state, activeMap: state.activeMap.set(action.id, action.value) };
        case "UpdateZoom":
            return {
                ...state,
                left: action.value?.left,
                right: action.value?.right,
                refAreaLeft: action.value?.refAreaLeft,
                refAreaRight: action.value?.refAreaRight,
                bottom: action.value?.bottom,
                top: action.value?.top,
                stateData: action.value?.stateData
            };
        case "UpdateRefAreaLeft":
            return { ...state, refAreaLeft: action.value };
        case "UpdateRefAreaRight":
            return { ...state, refAreaRight: action.value };
        case "ResetRefArea":
            return { ...state, refAreaLeft: undefined, refAreaRight: undefined };
        default:
            return state;
    }
};

/* istanbul ignore next */
const getYAxisDomain = (left: number, right: number, state: RechartsState): [number | string, number | string] => {
    const tempLeft = left > 0 ? left - 1 : 0;
    if (state?.stateData.length < right) return [state?.hasNegativeValue ? "dataMin" : 0, "dataMax"];
    const refData = state.stateData.slice(tempLeft, right);
    const keys = Object.keys(refData[0]).filter(key => key !== "name");
    let top = refData[0][keys[0]] as number;
    let bottom = refData[0][keys[0]] as number;
    refData.forEach(d => {
        keys.forEach(key => {
            if ((d[key] as number) > top) top = d[key] as number;
            if ((d[key] as number) < bottom) bottom = d[key] as number;
        });
    });
    if (bottom > 0) bottom = 0;
    else bottom = bottom + bottom / 10;
    return [bottom, top + top / 10];
};

const isClicked = (left: number | undefined, right: number | undefined): boolean => {
    return left === undefined || right === undefined || left === right;
};

const dispatchZoom = (state: RechartsState, dispatch: React.Dispatch<RechartsAction>) => {
    let tempLeft = state.refAreaLeft;
    let tempRight = state.refAreaRight;

    /* when user clicks without dragging */
    if (isClicked(tempLeft, tempRight)) {
        dispatch({
            type: "ResetRefArea"
        });
        return;
    }

    // At this point, tempLeft and tempRight are guaranteed to be numbers
    if ((tempLeft as number) > (tempRight as number)) {
        tempLeft = state.refAreaRight;
        tempRight = state.refAreaLeft;
    }

    const [bottom, top] = getYAxisDomain(tempLeft as number, tempRight as number, state);

    dispatch({
        type: "UpdateZoom",
        value: {
            left: tempLeft as number,
            right: tempRight as number,
            refAreaLeft: undefined,
            refAreaRight: undefined,
            bottom,
            top,
            stateData: state.stateData.slice()
        }
    });
};

const dispatchZoomOut = (dispatch: React.Dispatch<RechartsAction>, state: RechartsState) => {
    dispatch({
        type: "UpdateZoom",
        value: {
            left: "dataMin",
            right: "dataMax",
            refAreaLeft: undefined,
            refAreaRight: undefined,
            bottom: state.hasNegativeValue ? "dataMin" : 0,
            top: "dataMax",
            stateData: state.stateData.slice()
        }
    });
};

type UseRechartsHooksParams = {
    activeMap?: Map<string | number, boolean>;
    data?: Record<string, unknown>[];
    left?: number | string;
    right?: number | string;
    refAreaLeft?: number;
    refAreaRight?: number;
    hasNegativeValue?: boolean;
    bottom?: number | string;
    top?: number | string;
};

function useRechartsHooks({
    activeMap = new Map(),
    data: stateData = [],
    left = "dataMin",
    right = "dataMax",
    refAreaLeft,
    refAreaRight,
    hasNegativeValue = false,
    bottom = hasNegativeValue ? "dataMin" : 0,
    top = "dataMax"
}: UseRechartsHooksParams = {}) {
    const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(rechartsReducer, {
        activeMap,
        stateData,
        left,
        right,
        refAreaLeft,
        refAreaRight,
        bottom,
        top,
        hasNegativeValue
    });

    const zoom = () => dispatchZoom(state, dispatch);

    const zoomOut = () => dispatchZoomOut(dispatch, state);

    return { state, dispatch, zoom, zoomOut };
}

export default useRechartsHooks;
````

````typescript
import { useCallback, useState } from "react";

export const useBrush = ([start, end]: [start: number, end: number]) => {
    const [leftBrush, setLeftBrush] = useState(start);
    const [rightBrush, setRightBrush] = useState(end);

    /* istanbul ignore next */
    const handleBrushChange = useCallback((e: { startIndex?: number; endIndex?: number }) => {
        setLeftBrush(prev => (e?.startIndex !== undefined && e.startIndex !== prev ? e.startIndex : prev));
        setRightBrush(prev => (e?.endIndex !== undefined && e.endIndex !== prev ? e.endIndex : prev));
    }, []);

    return { leftBrush, rightBrush, handleBrushChange };
};
````

````typescript
import { useMemo } from "react";

type DataKey = {
    dataKey: string;
    displayName: string;
};

export const useLegendSegments = (dataKeys: DataKey[], palette: string[]) => {

            dataKeys.map((item, index) => ({
````

````typescript
import PropTypes from "prop-types";

export type ColumnShape = {
    /** Column Header in the Table/Datatable */
    Header?: unknown;
    /** The accessor name in the data for the column */
    accessor?: string;
    /** Data type for the column. ex. "text, badge, avatar, label" for the column */
    type?: string;
    /** Contains the data for the cell */
    Cell?: unknown;
    /** Width size for the column */
    width?: string | number;
    /** Set to true to make the column sortable */
    sortable?: boolean;
    /** Optional custom sort function
     * Signature: function(rowA: object, rowB: object, id: string, desc: bool) => void
     */
    sortCallback?: (rowA: Record<string, unknown>, rowB: Record<string, unknown>, id: string, desc: boolean) => void;
    /** Callback fired when the column has been sorted
     * Signature: function(desc: bool) => void
     */
    onSorted?: (desc: boolean) => void;
    /** Set to false to prevent column from being reordered/hidden in column reorder panel. Defaults to true. */
    reorderable?: boolean;
};

export type ColumnsShapeArray = ColumnShape[];

// PropTypes validator for backward compatibility with JS files
export const ColumnsShape = PropTypes.arrayOf(
    PropTypes.shape({
        Header: PropTypes.any,
        accessor: PropTypes.string,
        type: PropTypes.string,
        Cell: PropTypes.any,
        width: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.number]),
        sortable: PropTypes.bool,
        sortCallback: PropTypes.func,
        onSorted: PropTypes.func,
        reorderable: PropTypes.bool
    })
);
````

````typescript
import useCalculateResize, { UseCalculateResizeCallback } from "./useCalculateResize";
import React, { useRef, useState } from "react";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { observeMock, unobserveMock, disconnectMock } from "../mocks/mockResizeObserver";

(global.ResizeObserver as unknown) = jest.fn().mockImplementation(() => ({
    observe: observeMock,
    unobserve: unobserveMock,
    disconnect: disconnectMock,
    callback: jest.fn()
})) as jest.Mock;

type TestComponentProps = {
    callback: UseCalculateResizeCallback;
};

const TestComponent = ({ callback }: TestComponentProps) => {
    const ref = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
    const [height, setHeight] = useState(0);

    useCalculateResize(ref as React.RefObject<HTMLElement>, newHeight => {
        setHeight(newHeight);
        callback(newHeight);
    });

    return (
        <div ref={ref as React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>} style={{ height: "100px", width: "100px" }}>
            Height: {height}
        </div>
    );
};

describe("useCalculateResize", () => {
    afterEach(() => {
        jest.clearAllMocks();
    });

    it("should call calculateHeight and update height", () => {
        const callback = jest.fn();
        render(<TestComponent callback={callback} />);

        const div = screen.getByText(/Height:/);
        expect(div).toBeInTheDocument();

        // Trigger the ResizeObserver callback
        (global.ResizeObserver as jest.Mock).mock.calls[0][0]();

        expect(callback).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    });

    it("should call observe on ResizeObserver when component mounts", () => {
        render(<TestComponent callback={jest.fn()} />);
        expect(observeMock).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should call unobserve on ResizeObserver when component unmounts", () => {
        const { unmount } = render(<TestComponent callback={jest.fn()} />);
        unmount();
        expect(unobserveMock).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("calls calculateHeight on window resize event", () => {
        const callback = jest.fn();
        render(<TestComponent callback={callback} />);

        // Simulate a window resize event
        window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));

        // Verify callback was called again due to window resize
        expect(callback).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2); // initial call + window resize
    });
});
````

````typescript
export type DragDropHandlers = {

    onDragLeave: (event: React.DragEvent<HTMLElement>) => void;
    onDragOver: (event: React.DragEvent<HTMLElement>) => void;
    onDrop: (event: React.DragEvent<HTMLElement>) => void;
};

const useDragDropHandler = (): DragDropHandlers => {
    const [inDropzone, setInDropzone] = useState(false);

    const onDragEnter = useCallback(
        (event: React.DragEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            setInDropzone(true);
        },
        [setInDropzone]
    );

    const onDragLeave = useCallback(
        (event: React.DragEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            setInDropzone(false);
        },
        [setInDropzone]
    );

    const onDragOver = useCallback(
        (event: React.DragEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            event.dataTransfer.dropEffect = "move";
            setInDropzone(true);
        },
        [setInDropzone]
    );

    const onDrop = useCallback(
        (event: React.DragEvent<HTMLElement>) => {
            event.preventDefault();
            setInDropzone(false);
        },
        [setInDropzone]
    );

    return {
        onDragEnter,
        onDragLeave,
        onDragOver,
        onDrop,
        isDragEnter: inDropzone
    };
};

export default useDragDropHandler;
````

````typescript
    });
````

````typescript
import { useEffect } from "react";
import type React from "react";

export type UseOnClickOutsideOptions = {
    disablePortal?: boolean;
    isAutoClose?: boolean;
    popperRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLElement> | null;
    popupRef?: React.RefObject<HTMLElement> | null;
};

export type UseOnClickOutsideCallback = (event: MouseEvent | TouchEvent | KeyboardEvent) => void;

export function useOnClickOutside(
    ref: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>,
    callback?: UseOnClickOutsideCallback,
    closeOnKeyEscape = false,
    options?: UseOnClickOutsideOptions
) {
    const { isAutoClose = true, popperRef = null, popupRef = null, disablePortal = true } = options || {};
    useEffect(() => {
        const listener = (event: MouseEvent | TouchEvent | KeyboardEvent) => {
            const isClickInsideRef = ref.current?.contains(event.target as Node);
            const isClickInsidePopper = !disablePortal && popperRef?.current?.contains(event.target as Node);
            const isClickInsidePopup = popupRef?.current?.contains(event.target as Node);

            // Only prevent closing when isAutoClose is false ** inside the popper **, but clicking outside should always close it.
            if (isClickInsideRef || ((isClickInsidePopper || isClickInsidePopup) && !isAutoClose)) {
                return;
            }

            if (callback) {
                callback(event);
            }
        };
        document.addEventListener("mousedown", listener);
        document.addEventListener("touchstart", listener);
        if (closeOnKeyEscape) {
            document.addEventListener("keydown", listener);
        }

        return () => {
            document.removeEventListener("mousedown", listener);
            document.removeEventListener("touchstart", listener);
            if (closeOnKeyEscape) {
                document.removeEventListener("keydown", listener);
            }
        };
    }, [ref, callback, closeOnKeyEscape, popperRef, disablePortal, isAutoClose, popupRef]);
}

export default useOnClickOutside;
````

````typescript
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

const usePrevious = <T,>(value: T): T | undefined => {
    const ref = useRef<T | undefined>(undefined);

    useEffect(() => {
        ref.current = value;
    }, [value]);

    return ref.current;
};

export { usePrevious };
export default usePrevious;
````

## File: src/hooks/useSelectionReducer.tsx
````typescript
import { useReducer, useCallback, type Reducer } from "react";

// Action types
const TOGGLE_CHECKBOX_SELECTION = "TOGGLE_CHECKBOX_SELECTION";
const RESET_SELECTION = "RESET_SELECTION";

export type SelectionItem = {
    id: string;
    selection: {
        props: {
            checked: boolean;
        };
    };
    [key: string]: unknown;
};

export type SelectionState = {
    items: SelectionItem[] | undefined;
    selectedCheckedItems: Set<string>;
};

type ToggleCheckboxSelectionAction = {
    type: typeof TOGGLE_CHECKBOX_SELECTION;
    id: string;
};

type ResetSelectionAction = {
    type: typeof RESET_SELECTION;
    initialHiddenColumns?: string[];
};

type SelectionAction = ToggleCheckboxSelectionAction | ResetSelectionAction;

/**
 * Reducer for managing selection state
 */
export const selectionReducer: Reducer<SelectionState, SelectionAction> = (state, action) => {
    switch (action.type) {
        case TOGGLE_CHECKBOX_SELECTION: {
            const newSelectedCheckedItems = new Set(state.selectedCheckedItems);
            if (newSelectedCheckedItems.has(action.id)) {
                newSelectedCheckedItems.delete(action.id);
            } else {
                newSelectedCheckedItems.add(action.id);
            }

            const newItems = state.items?.map(item => {
                if (item.id === action.id) {
                    return {
                        ...item,
                        selection: {
                            ...item.selection,
                            props: { ...item.selection.props, checked: newSelectedCheckedItems.has(action.id) }
                        }
                    };
                }
                return item;
            });

            return {
                ...state,
                items: newItems,
                selectedCheckedItems: newSelectedCheckedItems
            };
        }
        case RESET_SELECTION: {
            const initialHiddenColumns = action.initialHiddenColumns || [];
            const newSelectedCheckedItems = new Set<string>();

            const newItems = state.items?.map(item => {
                const isVisible = !initialHiddenColumns.includes(item.id);
                if (isVisible) {
                    newSelectedCheckedItems.add(item.id);
                }
                return {
                    ...item,
                    selection: {
                        ...item.selection,
                        props: { ...item.selection.props, checked: isVisible }
                    }
                };
            });

            return {
                ...state,
                items: newItems,
                selectedCheckedItems: newSelectedCheckedItems
            };
        }
        default:
            return state;
    }
};

/**
 * Creates initial state for selection reducer
 */
const initialState = (items: SelectionItem[] | undefined): SelectionState => {
    const selectedCheckedItems = new Set<string>();
    if (items && Array.isArray(items)) {
        items.forEach(item => {
            if (item.selection?.props?.checked) {
                selectedCheckedItems.add(item.id);
            }
        });
    }
    return {
        items,
        selectedCheckedItems
    };
};

export type UseSelectionReducerParams = {
    items: SelectionItem[] | undefined;
};

export type UseSelectionReducerReturn = {
    state: SelectionState;
    toggleCheckboxSelection: (id: string) => void;
    resetSelection: (initialHiddenColumns?: string[]) => void;
};

/**
 * Hook for managing selection state with reducer
 */
const useSelectionReducer = ({ items }: UseSelectionReducerParams): UseSelectionReducerReturn => {
    const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(selectionReducer, initialState(items));

    const toggleCheckboxSelection = useCallback((id: string) => {
        dispatch({
            type: TOGGLE_CHECKBOX_SELECTION,
            id
        });
    }, []);

    const resetSelection = useCallback((initialHiddenColumns?: string[]) => {
        dispatch({
            type: RESET_SELECTION,
            initialHiddenColumns
        });
    }, []);

    return { state, toggleCheckboxSelection, resetSelection };
};

export default useSelectionReducer;
````

````typescript
import { useMemo } from "react";

type ValueAndUnit = {
    value: number;
    unit: string;
};

const extractValueAndUnit = (value: string | number | undefined): ValueAndUnit | null => {
    if (value === undefined) {
        return null;
    }

    const valueStr = typeof value === "number" ? `${value}` : value;
    const match = valueStr.match(/^(-?\d+(?:\.\d+)?)([a-z%]*)$/i);

    if (match) {
        return {
            value: parseFloat(match[1]),
            unit: match[2] || ""
        };
    }
    return null;
};

type UseStickyPositionParams = {
    hasTopBar?: boolean;
    hasFilterGroup?: boolean;
    topBarHeight?: number;
    filterGroupHeight?: number;
    topOffset?: string | number;
    isOpen?: boolean;
};

type UseStickyPositionReturn = {
    stickyTopHeader: number;
    stickyTopFilterGroup: number;
    stickyToolBar: number;
};

const useStickyPosition = ({
    hasTopBar = false,
    hasFilterGroup = false,
    topBarHeight = 0,
    filterGroupHeight = 0,
    topOffset,
    isOpen = false
}: UseStickyPositionParams): UseStickyPositionReturn => {
    const topOffsetParsed = extractValueAndUnit(topOffset);
    const toolBarHeight = useMemo(() => (isOpen ? 48 : 0), [isOpen]);

    const stickyTopHeader = useMemo(() => {
        let baseHeight = toolBarHeight + (topOffsetParsed?.value || 0);

        if (hasTopBar) {
            baseHeight += topBarHeight;
        }

        if (hasFilterGroup) {
            baseHeight += filterGroupHeight;
        }

        return baseHeight;
    }, [filterGroupHeight, hasFilterGroup, hasTopBar, toolBarHeight, topBarHeight, topOffsetParsed?.value]);

    const stickyToolBar = useMemo(() => {
        let baseHeight = topOffsetParsed?.value || 0;

        if (hasTopBar) {
            baseHeight += topBarHeight;
        }

        if (hasFilterGroup) {
            baseHeight += filterGroupHeight;
        }

        return baseHeight;
    }, [filterGroupHeight, hasFilterGroup, hasTopBar, topBarHeight, topOffsetParsed?.value]);

    const stickyTopFilterGroup = useMemo(() => {
        if (hasTopBar) {
            return topBarHeight + (topOffsetParsed?.value || 0);
        } else {
            return 0 + (topOffsetParsed?.value || 0);
        }
    }, [hasTopBar, topBarHeight, topOffsetParsed?.value]);

    return {
        stickyTopHeader,
        stickyTopFilterGroup,
        stickyToolBar
    };
};

export default useStickyPosition;
export type { UseStickyPositionParams, UseStickyPositionReturn };
````

````typescript
import { useState, useCallback } from "react";
import type { ToastType } from "../components/atoms/Toast/ToastConfig";

export type AddToastOptions = {
    actionLabel?: string;
    autoHideDuration?: number;
    description?: string;
    hasAction?: boolean;
    hasCloseButton?: boolean;
    hasDescription?: boolean;
    onActionClick?: () => void;
    title: string;
    type: ToastType;
};

export type Toast = AddToastOptions & {
    id: number;
    open: boolean;
};

export type ShowToastOptions = Omit<AddToastOptions, "type">;

/**
 * Hook for managing toast notifications
 */
const useToasts = () => {
    const [toasts, setToasts] = useState<Toast[]>([]);

    const addToast = useCallback(
        ({
            type,
            title,
            description,
            autoHideDuration = 5000,
            hasAction = false,
            actionLabel,
            onActionClick,
            hasCloseButton = true,
            hasDescription = true
        }: AddToastOptions) => {
            const id = Date.now() + Math.random();
            const toast: Toast = {
                id,
                type,
                title,
                description,
                autoHideDuration,
                hasAction,
                actionLabel,
                onActionClick,
                hasCloseButton,
                hasDescription,
                open: true
            };

            setToasts(prev => [...prev, toast]);
            return id;
        },
        []
    );

    const removeToast = useCallback((id: number) => {
        setToasts(prev => prev.filter(toast => toast.id !== id));
    }, []);

    const showSuccess = useCallback(
        ({ title, description, ...options }: ShowToastOptions) =>
            addToast({
                type: "success",
                title,
                description,
                ...options
            }),
        [addToast]
    );

    const showError = useCallback(
        ({ title, description, ...options }: ShowToastOptions) =>
            addToast({
                type: "error",
                title,
                description,
                ...options
            }),
        [addToast]
    );

    const showWarning = useCallback(
        ({ title, description, ...options }: ShowToastOptions) =>
            addToast({
                type: "warning",
                title,
                description,
                ...options
            }),
        [addToast]
    );

    const showInfo = useCallback(
        ({ title, description, ...options }: ShowToastOptions) =>
            addToast({
                type: "informational",
                title,
                description,
                ...options
            }),
        [addToast]
    );

    const clearAll = useCallback(() => {
        setToasts([]);
    }, []);

    return {
        toasts,
        showSuccess,
        showError,
        showWarning,
        showInfo,
        removeToast,
        clearAll
    };
};

export default useToasts;
````

````markdown
## **Overview**

This guide explains how to use implement fetchData for Production use

---

### 1. To connect DataTableAsync to your real API, you will need to implement a fetchData function that:

```
•   Accepts { filters, pageIndex, pageSize, sortBy, sortOrder }
•   Sends a request to the backend using the proper query param format
•   Returns a response shaped like { rows, totalCount, totalFilteredCount }
•   Handles errors safely
```

### 2. Example: Expected variables in the fetchData response

-   **success:** indicates if the request was successful
-   **rows:** the array of returned data items
-   **totalCount:** the total number of records in the dataset available (for filterGroup and Pagination UI controls)
-   **totalFilteredCount:** the total number of records after applying filters (for FilterGroup UI control)
-   **error:** the total number of records after applying filters (for FilterGroup UI control)

```jsx
// json - success
return {
    success: true,
    rows: [...],
    totalCount: 150,
    totalFilteredCount: 42
}
```

### 3. `error` (optional `string`)

A human-readable message returned by `fetchData` when the request fails.
This field is **only present when `success: false`**. It is used by `DataTableAsync` to display error messages in the UI and help developers or users understand what went wrong.

#### Use Cases

Network errors (e.g., failed fetch, server unreachable)
Business logic failures (e.g., "No users found", "Access denied")
Malformed or unexpected responses

#### Example

```js
// json - error
return {
    success: false,
    rows: [],
    totalCount: 0,
    totalFilteredCount: 0,
    error: {
        error.message,
        error.code
    }
}
```

### Note:

---

Keep error messages user-friendly and **avoid leaking internal debug details**. For example, prefer "No data found" over "Unhandled promise rejection".

---

<br />

### 4. Filters Object Structure

The filters object passed to fetchData should follow this structure:

-   **searchTerm:** is a plain string for global search.
-   **selectedFilters:** is an array of filter selections.
-   Each `filter` object uses:
    -   **id:** the unique id of the selected value (if applicable)
    -   **filterName:** the value to filter by
    -   **filterGroup:** the corresponding property name in the dataset

```jsx
filters: {
  searchTerm: '', // global search input
  selectedFilters: [
    {
      id: '123',             // ID of the selected data item (if needed)
      filterName: 'admin',   // value selected from the filter dropdown
      filterGroup: 'role'    // the property name in the data (e.g. "role")
    }
  ]
}
```

### 5. FetchData API Example

```jsx
// This should live in: /api/fetchUsers.js
// Example implementation of fetchData for DataTableAsync, calling a real API.
const fetchUsers = async ({ pageIndex, pageSize, filters, sortBy, sortOrder }) => {
    try {
        // 1. Build query parameters (convert camelCase to snake_case for API).
        const params = new URLSearchParams();
        // Pagination (backend expects 1-based page index)
        params.set("page", pageIndex + 1);
        params.set("page_size", pageSize);

        // Search
        if (filters.searchTerm) {
            params.set("q", filters.searchTerm);
        }

        // Selected filters
        // Each selectedFilter object contais "filterName" and "filterGroup"
        // filterName is the value to filter by
        // filterGroup is the property name in the data object
        // e.g., { filterName: "admin", filterGroup: "role" }
        filters.selectedFilters.forEach(({ filterName, filterGroup }) => {
            params.append(filterName, filterGroup);
        });

        // Sorting
        if (sortBy) {
            params.set("sort_by", sortBy);
            params.set("sort_order", sortOrder || "asc"); //default to ascending
        }

        // 2. Fetch data from the API with the query string.
        const response = await fetch(`/api/users?${params.toString()}`);

        // 3. Parse the JSON result.
        const result = await response.json();

        // 4. If the response is not success (status 4xx/5xx), throw an error with details.
        if (!response.success) {
            const errorBody = await res.json().catch(() => ({})); //This will throw if body is invalid JSON
            const message = "API Failed to fetch users";
            const errorCode = result.code || response.status;

            // Throw an Error with a custom message and code for upstream handling
            const error = new Error(message); // *Avoid leaking internal debug, use custom eror message
            error.code = errorCode;
            throw error;
        }

        // 5. On success, return data in the format expected by DataTableAsync.
        return {
            rows: result.users, // array of user records for the table rows
            totalCount: result.totalCount // total number of users available
            totalFilteredCount: result.totalFilteredCount // total numbers users after applying `filters\search`
        };
    } catch (error) {
        // 6. Handle network or parsing errors.
        console.error("[fetchUsers] API call failed:", error);
        // Re-throw the error so that the calling component can handle it (e.g., show an error message in the UI).
        throw error;
    }
};
```

### 6. DataTableAsync Implementation Example

```jsx
import { fetchUsers } from "@/api/fetchUsers";

<DataTableAsync fetchData={fetchUsers} columns={columns} />;
```

### 7. Bulk Action Callback Arguments

When you define a bulk action in `DataTableAsync`, the callback function receives the following arguments:

-   **`selectedRows`**:  
    An array of the currently selected row data objects. Use this to know which rows the bulk action should operate on.

-   **`toggleSelection`**:  
    A callback function to programmatically select or deselect rows.

    -   Call as `toggleSelection(rowId, true)` to select a row.
    -   Call as `toggleSelection(rowId, false)` to deselect a row.
    -   You can use this to clear or update selections after your bulk action completes.

-   **`refetchData`**:  
    A callback function that will re-run the `fetchData` API call and refresh the table data.
    Use this after performing a bulk action (like enabling, disabling, or deleting rows) to ensure the table displays the latest data from your source.

#### Example Usage

```jsx
// bulk actions
{
  id: "enableAll",
  text: "Enable All",
  onClick: async (selectedRows, toggleSelection, refetchData) => {
    // Perform your bulk enable logic here
    // Optionally clear selections
    selectedRows.forEach(row => toggleSelection(row.id, false));
    // Optionally refresh data after the action
    refetchData && refetchData();
  }
}
```

#### Example Usage with API call

```jsx
// bulk actions
{
  id: "enableAll",
  text: "Enable All",
  onClick: handleEnableAllSwitches
}

// Function to enable switches
const handleEnableAllSwitches = async (selectedRows, toggleSelection, refetchData) => {
    try {
        /**
         * In real scenario, you would call your API to enable switches
         *  // Example API call to enable all switches
         *   const response = await fetch("/api/items/enable-switches", {
         *      method: "PATCH",
         *      headers: {
         *          "Content-Type": "application/json"
         *      },
         *      body: JSON.stringify({ selectedRows })
         *    });
         *
         *   const result = await response.json();
         */

        // For demonstration, we are using the mock API
        // Call the API to enable all switches
        const result = await enableAllSwitches(selectedRows);

        if (result.success) {
            console.log("All switches enabled successfully");
            // Optionally refresh data after the action
            refetchData && refetchData();
        } else {
            console.error("Failed to enable all switches");
        }
    } catch (error) {
        console.error("Error enabling all switches:", error);
    }
};
```

### 8. Row Action Callback Arguments

When you define a row action in `DataTableAsync`, the callback function receives the following arguments:

-   **`rowId`**:  
    The unique identifier for the row. This is typically the value of the `accessorKey` (e.g., `"id"`). Use this to know which row the action is being performed on.

-   **`toggleRowSelected`**:  
    A callback function to programmatically select or deselect a row.

    -   Call as `toggleRowSelected(rowId, true)` to select the row.
    -   Call as `toggleRowSelected(rowId, false)` to deselect the row.

-   **`row`**:  
    The full data object for the row. This contains all the fields for that row, allowing you to access any property you need for your action.

-   **`refetchData`**:  
    A callback function that will re-run the `fetchData` API call and refresh the table data.  
    Use this after performing a bulk action (like enabling, disabling, or deleting rows) to ensure the table displays the latest data from your source.

#### Example Usage

```jsx
// row actions
{
  id: "edit",
  text: "Edit",
  onClick: (rowId, toggleRowSelected, row, refetchData) => {
    // Perform your edit logic here
    // Optionally select the row
    toggleRowSelected(rowId, true);
    // Optionally refresh data after editing
    refetchData && refetchData();
  }
}
```
````
