## File: src/storybook/TableHelp.stories.mdx
````markdown
import { Meta, Story, Canvas, Preview, Source } from "@storybook/blocks";

import Table from "@organisms/table/Table";

<Meta title="Helpful Docs/Table" component={Table} />

# Tips to making a performant Table

<br />

### Use useMemo!

First thing is first, we should always memoize our `data` and `columns` props with `useMemo`.
Also, if you use them, be sure to wrap your `toolbarOptions` and `errorMessages` prop objects in a `useMemo` as well.
This makes sure the array we pass into the `Table` component doesn't cause unnecessary rerenders.

```
const memoData = useMemo(() => {
  return props.data;
},[props.data]);

const memoColumns = useMemo(() => {
  return props.columns;
},[props.columns]);"/>

const memoErrorMessage = useMemo(() => {
  return {
    noItems: "I don't have any items for you",
    notFound: "These are not the items you are looking for."
  };
},[props.columns]);"/>
```

### Use useCallback!

If you are passing functions into table, be sure to wrap your functions inside a useCallback. The Table component side wraps
all callbacks passed in from props inside a `useEffect` and or `useCallback`, so if you don't, it will rerender things that rely
on those callback props.

```
const onRowClick = useCallback((index) => {
  //do stuff wtih the value
}, []);
```

### Use React.Memo!

If you have a custom Cell component for one of the columns, try to use `React.memo` on them. This will help out
on when you have potentially a huge list of rows. There are a few caveats! If you are trying to pass objects/arrays
into the component, you should write a custom comparator, or you could potentially have some unwanted results. Mind you,
this doesn't always need to be done, as React is pretty good at rerendering components, but if you run into performance
problems, this is a good step towards fixing those issue.<br/>
https://reactjs.org/docs/react-api.html#reactmemo

```
const customComparator = (prevProps, newProps) => {
  return prevProps.value === nextProps.value && prevProps.onChange === prevProps.onChange
};

const CustomCell = React.memo(({value, onChange}) => {
  const [isOn, setIsOn] = useState(value);
  useEffect(() => {
    setIsOn(value);
  },[value]);

  return (
    <Switch on={isOn} onChange={onChange} />
  );
}, customComparator);
```

### About that data prop...

Your data prop should only consist of that...data! If you are passing any type of components or functions, you should put a custom Cell
renderer in the column, and pass the relevant information you need to render said cell.

```
const columns = [
    {
        Header: "First Name",
        accessor: "firstName",
        type: "text"
    },
    {
        Header: "Last Name",
        accessor: "lastName",
        type: "text"
    },
    {
        Header: "Email",
        accessor: "email",
        type: "text"
    },
    {
        Header: "Labels",
        accessor: "labels",
        type: "labels",
        //custom cell renderer!
        Cell: LabelsComponent
    },
    {
        Header: "Last Updated",
        accessor: "lastUpdated",
        type: "date"
    },
    {
        Header: "Tags",
        accessor: "tags",
        type: "number"
    }
];

const LabelsComponent = React.memo(({ value }) => {
    const labelStyle = label => {
        let bgColor;
        switch (label) {
            case "Jedi":
                bgColor = "#B3ECF3";
                break;
            case "Pilot":
                bgColor = "#FFC7A8";
                break;
            case "General":
                bgColor = "#81DAB1";
                break;
            case "Princess":
                bgColor = "#E69EB7";
                break;
            case "Scoundrel":
                bgColor = "#FCD514";
                break;
            case "Sith":
                bgColor = "#ED7B85";
                break;
            default:
                bgColor = "#B3ECF3";
                break;
        }

        return {
            paddingRight: "8px",
            textAlign: "center",
            minWidth: "60px",
            width: "20%",
            borderRadius: "2px",
            backgroundColor: bgColor,
            fontSize: "14px",
            padding: "4px",
            marginRight: "8px"
        };
    };
    return (
        <div style={{ display: "flex", margin: "-10px 0px" }}>
            {Array.isArray(value) ? (
                value.map(label => (
                    <div key={"label-" + label} style={labelStyle(label)}>
                        {label}
                    </div>
                ))
            ) : (
                <div style={labelStyle(value)}>{value}</div>
            )}
        </div>
    );
}, labelsComparator);
```

# Helpful things that might be useful to you

## Prebuilt Cells

There are a few prebuilt custom cells that are baked into the Table component. These are:

-   Switch
-   Menu
-   Labels

## How do I consume these?

Simple! All you have to do is assign the appropriate `type` in your column. The `type` will automatically be read by
the component, and automatically use the appropriate prebuilt cell. Here is a list of information you'll need to know for
each prebuilt cell.

#### Switch Cell

In your column Array:<br/>

```
const columns = [
    //...
    {
        //Text of the header
        Header: "",
        //use the value of this in your data as the key to transfer your data to the cell
        accessor: "switch",
        //set type to status to use the prebuilt cell
        type: "status"
    }
    //...
];
```

In your data object:<br/>

```
// Accepts Object<bool, func> as data
const data = [
    //...
    {
        //...
        switch: {
            on: false,
            onChange: SomeOnChangeCallback
        },
        //...
    },
    //...
```

#### Menu Cell

In your column Array:<br/>

```
const columns = [
    //...
    {
        //Text of the header
        Header: "",
        //use the value of this in your data as the key to transfer your data to the cell
        accessor: "menu",
        //set type to status to use the prebuilt cell
        type: "menu"
    }
    //...
];
```

In your data object:<br/>

```
const data = [
    //...
    {
        //...
        menu: [
            {
                id: "1",
                onClick: SomeOnClickCallback,
                icon: <i className="fa fas something"/>,
                text: "text"
            },
            {

            }
        ],
        //...
    },
    //...
```

#### Labels Cell

In your column Array:<br/>

```
const columns = [
    //...
    {
        //Text of the header
        Header: "",
        //use the value of this in your data as the key to transfer your data to the cell
        accessor: "labels",
        //set type to status to use the prebuilt cell
        type: "labels"
    }
    //...
];
```

Note! LabelsCell is special, and needed to have a way to add a borderless button, so in order to do this, refer to the second code snippet.<br/>
In your data object (Reference the atoms/Labels component to see props more in depth.) :<br/>

```
//Notice that the labels k/v pair value is an array of objects.  This will render the circle labels
const data = [
    //...
    {
        //...
        labels: [{
            text: 'text'
            color: 1',
            isParentSized: false
            icon: () => <i className="fa fas something"/>
        }],
        //...
    },
    //...
```

```
//Notice that the labels k/v pair value is just an object, with a text and onClick for the button text and onClick callback
const handleButtonClick = (rowIndex) => {
    console.log(`row index clicked: ${rowIndex)`);
};

const data = [
    //...
    {
        //...
        labels: {
            text: 'text'
            onClick: handleButtonClick,
            disabled: false
        },
        //...
    },
    //...
```

#### Subheaders

You can create subsections in your table by setting `hasSubHeaders` to `true` and including a `subRows` array in your data object

```
const data = [
    //...
    {
        column1: "Section Name",
        subRows: [
            {
                column1: "Item 1a",
                column2: "Item 1b",
                //...
            },
            {
                column1: "Item 2a",
                column2: "Item 2b",
                //...
            }
            //...
        ]
        //...
    },
    //...
```

#### Hide Row Checkbox / Switch toggle / Menu

You can hide checkbox or disable checkbox by adding `checkbox: { hide: true, disabled: true }` attribute to the table data (no column accessor needed).
You can also hide specific row's switch toggle and menu by specifying the "hide" prop on the data

```

const columns = [
    //...
    {
        Header: "",
        accessor: "switch_toggle",
        type: "status"
    },
    {
        Header: "",
        accessor: "menu",
        type: "menu"
    }
    //...
];

const data = [
    //...
    {
        //...
        checkbox: {
            hide: true
        }
        switch_toggle: {
            hide: true
        },
        menu: {
            hide: true
        },
        //...
    },
    //...
```

## Sorting

By default none of the columns are sortable. To make it sortable just pass in the `sortable` to your column.

```
const columns = [
    //...
    {
        Header: "Last Updated",
        accessor: "lastUpdated",
        type: "date",
        sortable: true,
        sortCallback: (rowA, rowB, id) => {
            const dateA = new Date(rowA.values[id]);
            const dateB = new Date(rowB.values[id]);
            return dateA - dateB;
        },
        onSorted: (desc) => {
            // ...
        }
    }
];
```

Note there are two optional props you should be aware of:

### sortCallback

By default, columns are sorted using a basic alphanumeric sorting algorithm. If you need anything more specific, you should use the `sortCallback` prop.
It has the following signature:

`function(rowA: object, rowB: object, id: string, desc: bool) => void`<br />
**rowA:** row object from your `data` prop. <br />
**rowB:** row object from your `data` prop. <br />
**id:** accessor of the column being sorted<br />
**desc:** whether the column is being sorted in descending order<br />

This function should return a number > 0 if rowA is greater than rowB, or < 0 if rowB is greater.
Note the value `desc` is provided but you probally do not need this, as it will automatically flip the order when the column changes from ascending to descending.

When a column is sorted, this function is called for _each row_ in the list, so you probally don't want to put any side effects here.

### onSorted

If you need to fire a side effect when a column is sorted, you can use the onSorted prop. This is a callback with the following signature:

`function(desc: bool) => void`<br />
**desc:** whether the column is being sorted in descending order<br />

# What some of these props do?

### topOffset

This prop allows you to set the header offset of a full sized table. Set this to 0px, and the toolbar and header will stick
to the top of the screen. If there are other sticky things already, offset them to be below that height.
````

## File: src/storybook/WhenToUseUIKitComponents.stories.mdx
````markdown
import { Meta } from "@storybook/blocks";

<Meta title="Helpful Docs/When to use UI Kit Components" />

# When should you use UI Kit Components?

<br />

### For all net new projects

All net new projects should have designs based off of the design system, which means the UI Kit should be built to support those features.

### When the designs flow matches the UI Kit

Current, there are projects that live in legacy code, but also have adapted some of the new UI Kit design flows, or needs to be updated to handle new features. If this is your situation, use the UI Kit, as it will be less maintenance for the future.
But only use the UI Kit IF the designs match. If the designs don't match, contact your designer to see if the design is correct, or if they can change it to match the design system. Another place to ask would be the eng-ui-kit-support channel in slack.

### When not to use the UI Kit

If you have pre-ui-kit designs that are not and will not be updated to meet the design system, continue to use the existing code you have. We will not be retrofitting old designs and features unless it is a design pattern that will be kept. This is intentional,
as adapting all old features and designs will open up a box of all projects having different design patterns/styles. The intent is in the future for our app to be unified, and function the same way in all different features.

### Give me some type of flow chart!!

<br />

#### Yes, I should use the UI Kit

    - New project [Post UI-Kit Release]
    - When I am in a legacy project, but the designs match the UI Kit components (look and flow)
    - When I am in a project in which the designs are updated to reflect UI Kit components

#### No, I should not use the UI Kit

    - When I am in a legacy project, and the designs do not match the UI Kit
    - When I am in a project that does not have the same flow that my designs have [could be a "one off" for your project only]

### I want to use the UI Kit, but designs don't match... what do I do?

If you feel like using the UI Kit will solve your problems, but the designs don't match, the first thing to do is to contact your designer, and express your findings. Most of the time, the designer will probably adapt the design to match the design system or have
a discussion with the design team to include the component feature/flow/type/style in the design system. If your designer says the current design is the direction that project is going with, and there is an older component in utui that can be used, then you should
utilize that component. If the component does NOT exist in utui, then explain situation in the eng-ui-kit-support, and see if the component can be adapted into the design system.
````

## File: src/storybook/WizardAndMultistepWizardHelp.stories.mdx
````markdown
import { Meta, Story, Canvas, Preview, Source } from "@storybook/blocks";

<Meta title="Helpful Docs/Wizard And MultistepWizard" component="Wizard" />

# How to use Wizard/MultistepWizard

## !!! Wizard component will be deprecated soon! Please, use MultistepWizard instead.

<br />

### Getting Started

First, it may be helpful to read the documentation about SlideoutPanel. The Wizard component is built ontop on SlideoutPanel and inherits much of the same functionality for opening/closing.

In the simple example below, we have a button which triggers a state change on whether or not to open the wizard.
The we pass in an array of Wizard steps which contains the title of each step, and a unique id for each.

Then in our component, we pass in 2 children. Each of these corresponds to a different step in the wizard. When we step through the wizard, the component which is displayed in the body changes.

So, when we click the button to open the wizard, we should see a div with the text "step1". When we click Next, we should see "step2". Here we should see a Save button, which when clicked will close the wizard and log a message to the console.

```
import React, { useCallback } from 'react';
import { SlideoutPanel } from 'tealium-ui-kit';

const WIZARD_STEPS = [
    { id: 1, title: "Step 1" },
    { id: 2, title: "Step 2" },
];

const Example = args => {
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

    const toggleOpen = useCallback(() => {
        setIsOpen(true);
    }, [setIsOpen]);

    const toggleClose = useCallback(() => {
        setIsOpen(false);
    }, [setIsOpen]);

    const onSave = useCallback(() => {
        toggleClose();
        console.log("save clicked");
    }, [toggleClose]);

    return (
        <>
            <button onClick={toggleOpen}>click to open</button>
            <Wizard title="Wizard Title" steps={WIZARD_STEPS} isOpen={isOpen} onClose={toggleClose} onSave={onSave}>
                <div>step1</div>
                <div>step2</div>
            </Wizard>
        </>
    );
```

### Left Panel

The left panel shows the current progress of the Wizard. You control what is displayed here for each step through the `title` property within `steps` prop of the wizard.

You may optionally pass in a component as the `details` - whatever you set this to will be displayed below the title for the step within the left menu.

```
const WIZARD_STEPS = [
    { id: 1, title: "Step 1", details: <div>step details</div>},
    { id: 2, title: "Step 2" },
    { id: 2, title: "Step 3" },
]
```

### Validation

What if we want to perform validation (or some other action) on each step before navigating to the next?
This is where the hook `useWizardValidation` comes in. Within any wizard step, we can call this hook to set a validation callback.
This function must return true or false, indicating whether the step is valid and the wizard should continue.

**Make sure to wrap your validation functions in a `useCallback` - not doing so could lead to infinite rerenders!**

Lets look at the example below. This is set up similarily to the example above - we have a button when opens the wizard, and we pass in an onClose and onSave callback.
But, within each step of the wizard, we call `useWizardValidation(id, onValidation)`.
This tells the wizard to perform our validation, and to not continue to the next step when the validation fails. **Note the id you pass into this function must having a matching id within the `steps` prop of the Wizard**

```
const ValidationTemplate = args => {
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

    const toggleOpen = useCallback(() => {
        setIsOpen(true);
    }, [setIsOpen]);

    const toggleClose = useCallback(() => {
        setIsOpen(false);
    }, [setIsOpen]);

    const onSave = useCallback(() => {
        console.log(apiData);
        toggleClose();
    }, [apiData, toggleClose]);

    return (
        <>
            <button onClick={toggleOpen}>click to open</button>
            <Wizard title="Wizard Title" steps={WIZARD_STEPS} isOpen={isOpen} onClose={toggleClose} onSave={onSave}>
                <MyWizardStep id={1}>step 1:</MyWizardStep>
                <MyWizardStep id={2}>toggleClose={toggleClose}>step 2</MyWizardStep>
            </Wizard>
        </>
    );
};

const MyWizardStep = ({ id, children }) => {
    const [value, setValue] = useState("");
    const [hasError, setHasError] = useState(false);

    const onValidation = useCallback(() => {
        const newHasError = value === "";
        if (newHasError) {
            setHasError(newHasError);
        }
        return !newHasError;
    }, [value]);

    useWizardValidation(id, onValidation);

    return (
        <div style={{ margin: "1em" }}>
            <div>{children}</div>
            <Textbox
                type="text"
                value={value}
                onChange={setValue}
                error={hasError}
                errorHelperText="field is required"
            />
        </div>
    );
};
```

### Wizard vs MultistepWizard

Wizard is a previous version of design system component. Currently, MultistepWizard has the same functionality as Wizard but has up-to-date styling.
````

````typescript
describe("filterAccessibleAttributes", () => {
    it("should filter only allowed accessible attributes", () => {
        const input = {
            "aria-label": "label",
            "aria-labelledby": "lbl",
            "aria-describedby": "desc",
            "aria-controls": "ctrl",
            "aria-checked": true,
            "aria-expanded": false,
            "aria-haspopup": true,
            "aria-hidden": false,
            "aria-live": "polite",
            "aria-pressed": false,
            "aria-readonly": true,
            "aria-required": true,
            "aria-selected": false,
            "role": "rowgroup",
            "not-allowed": "nope",
            "data-test": "should-not-appear"
        };
        const result = filterAccessibleAttributes(input);
        expect(result).toEqual({
            "aria-label": "label",
            "aria-labelledby": "lbl",
            "aria-describedby": "desc",
            "aria-controls": "ctrl",
            "aria-checked": true,
            "aria-expanded": false,
            "aria-haspopup": true,
            "aria-hidden": false,
            "aria-live": "polite",
            "aria-pressed": false,
            "aria-readonly": true,
            "aria-required": true,
            "aria-selected": false,
            "role": "rowgroup"
        });
    });

    it("should return an empty object if no allowed attributes are present", () => {
        const input = { foo: "bar", baz: 123 };
        expect(filterAccessibleAttributes(input)).toEqual({});
    });

    it("should handle undefined or null input gracefully", () => {
        expect(filterAccessibleAttributes()).toEqual({});
        expect(filterAccessibleAttributes(null)).toEqual({});
    });
});
````

````typescript
import { AriaLabelValidation } from "./AriaLabelValidation";

describe("PropTypesAriaLabelValidation", () => {
    const componentName = "TestComponent";

    it("should return an error if neither aria-label nor aria-labelledby is provided", () => {
        const props = { testProp: {} };
        const result = AriaLabelValidation(props, "attrProps", componentName);

        expect(result).toBeInstanceOf(Error);
        if (result) {
            expect(result.message).toBe(
                `Invalid prop in <${componentName}>: Provide either "aria-label" or "aria-labelledby".`
            );
        }
    });

    it("should return an error if both aria-label and aria-labelledby are provided", () => {
        const props = { testProp: { "aria-label": "Label", "aria-labelledby": "LabelledBy" } };
        const result = AriaLabelValidation(props, "testProp", componentName);

        expect(result).toBeInstanceOf(Error);
        if (result) {
            expect(result.message).toBe(
                `Invalid prop in <${componentName}>: Provide only one of "aria-label" or "aria-labelledby", not both.`
            );
        }
    });

    it("should return null if only aria-label is provided", () => {
        const props = { testProp: { "aria-label": "Label" } };
        const result = AriaLabelValidation(props, "testProp", componentName);

        expect(result).toBeNull();
    });

    it("should return null if only aria-labelledby is provided", () => {
        const props = { testProp: { "aria-labelledby": "LabelledBy" } };
        const result = AriaLabelValidation(props, "testProp", componentName);

        expect(result).toBeNull();
    });

    it("should return error message if prop is missing but not required", () => {
        const props = { testProp2: null };
        const result = AriaLabelValidation(props, "testProp", componentName);

        expect(result).toBeInstanceOf(Error);
        if (result) {
            expect(result.message).toBe(
                `Invalid prop in <${componentName}>: Provide either "aria-label" or "aria-labelledby".`
            );
        }
    });
});
````

````typescript
import { addDays, subDays, isValid, isEqual, newDate, isDayDisabled, isSameDay, isOutOfBounds } from "./DateUtils";

/**
 * Date Utils tests
 * source: https://github.com/Hacker0x01/react-datepicker/blob/master/test/date_utils_test.js
 */

// ** Date Constructors **

describe("DateUtils", () => {
    describe("newDate", () => {
        it("should return null for invalid value passed", function () {
            expect(newDate("21123asd")).toEqual(null);
        });
    });
    describe("isDayDisabled", function () {
        it("should be enabled by default", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            expect(isDayDisabled(day)).toBeFalsy();
        });

        it("should be enabled if on the min date", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            expect(isDayDisabled(day, { minDate: day })).toBeFalsy();
        });

        it("should be disabled if before the min date", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            const minDate = addDays(day, 1);
            expect(isDayDisabled(day, { minDate })).toBeTruthy();
        });

        it("should be enabled if on the max date", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            expect(isDayDisabled(day, { maxDate: day })).toBeFalsy();
        });

        it("should be disabled if after the max date", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            const maxDate = subDays(day, 1);
            expect(isDayDisabled(day, { maxDate })).toBeTruthy();
        });

        it("should be disabled if in excluded dates", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            expect(isDayDisabled(day, { excludeDates: [day] })).toBeTruthy();
        });

        it("should be enabled if in included dates", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            expect(isDayDisabled(day, { includeDates: [day] })).toBeFalsy();
        });

        it("should be disabled if not in included dates", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            const includeDates = [addDays(day, 1)];
            expect(isDayDisabled(day, { includeDates })).toBeTruthy();
        });

        it("should be enabled if date filter returns true", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            const filterDate = (d: Date | null) => isEqual(d, day);
            expect(isDayDisabled(day, { filterDate })).toBeFalsy();
        });

        it("should be disabled if date filter returns false", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            const filterDate = (d: Date | null) => !isEqual(d, day);
            expect(isDayDisabled(day, { filterDate })).toBeTruthy();
        });

        it("should not allow date filter to modify input date", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            const dayClone = newDate(day);
            const filterDate = (d: Date | null) => {
                addDays(<Date>d, 1);
                return true;
            };
            isDayDisabled(day, { filterDate });
            expect(isEqual(day, dayClone)).toBeTruthy();
        });
    });
    describe("isValid", function () {
        it("should be true if valid date", () => {
            const minDate = <Date>newDate();
            const day = addDays(minDate, 1);
            expect(isValid(day, minDate)).toBeTruthy();
        });
        it("should be true if minDate is null", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            expect(isValid(day, null)).toBeTruthy();
        });
        it("should be false if valid date === minDate", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            expect(isValid(day, day)).toBeFalsy();
        });
    });
    describe("isSameDay", function () {
        it("should be true if same day", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            expect(isSameDay(day, day)).toBeTruthy();
        });

        it("should be false if not same day", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            const addDate = addDays(day, 1);
            expect(isSameDay(day, addDate)).toBeFalsy();
        });
    });
    describe("isEqual", function () {
        it("should be true if equal", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            expect(isEqual(day, day)).toBeTruthy();
        });

        it("should be false if not equal", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            const addDate = addDays(day, 1);
            expect(isEqual(day, addDate)).toBeFalsy();
        });
    });
    describe("isOutOfBounds", function () {
        it("should be within bounds if on the min date", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            expect(isOutOfBounds(day, { minDate: day })).toBeFalsy();
        });
        it("should be within bounds if on the min date", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            expect(isOutOfBounds(day)).toBeFalsy();
        });
        it("should be out of bounds if before the min date", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            const minDate = addDays(day, 1);
            expect(isOutOfBounds(day, { minDate })).toBeTruthy();
        });
        it("should be enabled if on the max date", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            expect(isOutOfBounds(day, { maxDate: day })).toBeFalsy();
        });

        it("should be disabled if after the max date", () => {
            const day = <Date>newDate();
            const maxDate = subDays(day, 1);
            expect(isOutOfBounds(day, { maxDate })).toBeTruthy();
        });
    });
});
````

````typescript
import { getColumnWeight, getCellMinWith, getCellMaxWidth, getCellWidth, dataTypes } from "./TableUtils";

describe("Table Utils Tests", () => {
    it("should return the correct column weights", () => {
        const totalWeight = Object.keys(dataTypes).reduce((acc, val) => {
            return acc + getColumnWeight(val);
        }, 0);

        const numdataTypes = Object.keys(dataTypes).length;
        // (n * (n+1))/2, but since we're starting at 0, n = n-1
        const actualSumWeight = ((numdataTypes - 1) * numdataTypes) / 2;
        expect(totalWeight).toEqual(actualSumWeight);
    });

        expect(weight).toEqual(Number.MAX_VALUE);
````

````typescript
export type DataType = {
    weight: number;
    minWidth: string;
    maxWidth: string;
    width?: string;
};

export type DataTypeName = keyof typeof dataTypes;

export const dataTypes = {
    drag: {
        weight: 0,
        minWidth: "15px",
        maxWidth: "15px"
    },
    bulk: {
        weight: 1,
        minWidth: "15px",

        maxWidth: "20%"
    },

        weight: 15,
        minWidth: "45px",
        maxWidth: "45px",
        width: "1%"
    },
    roles: {
        weight: 16,
        minWidth: "100px",
        maxWidth: "100%"
    },
    labels: {
        weight: 17,
        minWidth: "100px",
        maxWidth: "100%"
    },
    mappings: {
        weight: 18,
        minWidth: "120px",
        maxWidth: "120px"
    },
    uid: {
        weight: 19,
        minWidth: "50px",
        maxWidth: "20%"
    },
    order: {
        weight: 20,
        minWidth: "50px",
        maxWidth: "20%"
    },
    menu: {
        weight: 21,
        minWidth: "40px",
        maxWidth: "40px",
        width: "40px"
    }
} as const satisfies Record<string, DataType>;

export const getColumnWeight = (dataType: string): number => {
    if (dataType in dataTypes) {
        return dataTypes[dataType as DataTypeName].weight;
    }

    return Number.MAX_VALUE;
};

export const getCellMinWith = (dataType: string): string => {
    if (dataType in dataTypes) {
        return dataTypes[dataType as DataTypeName].minWidth;
    }

    return "32px";
};

export const getCellMaxWidth = (dataType: string): string => {
    if (dataType in dataTypes) {
        return dataTypes[dataType as DataTypeName].maxWidth;
    }

    return "100%";
};

export const getCellWidth = (dataType: string): string => {
    if (dataType in dataTypes) {
        const typeData = dataTypes[dataType as DataTypeName];
        return ("width" in typeData ? typeData.width : undefined) ?? "100%";
    }

    return "100%";
};
````

## File: AGENTS.md
````markdown
# Agent Instructions

This project uses **bd** (beads) for issue tracking. Run `bd onboard` to get started.

## Quick Reference

```bash
bd ready              # Find available work
bd show <id>          # View issue details
bd update <id> --status in_progress  # Claim work
bd close <id>         # Complete work
bd sync               # Sync with git
```

## Landing the Plane (Session Completion)

**When ending a work session**, you MUST complete ALL steps below. Work is NOT complete until `git push` succeeds.

**MANDATORY WORKFLOW:**

1. **File issues for remaining work** - Create issues for anything that needs follow-up
2. **Run quality gates** (if code changed) - Tests, linters, builds
3. **Update issue status** - Close finished work, update in-progress items
4. **PUSH TO REMOTE** - This is MANDATORY:
    ```bash
    git pull --rebase
    bd sync
    git push
    git status  # MUST show "up to date with origin"
    ```
5. **Clean up** - Clear stashes, prune remote branches
6. **Verify** - All changes committed AND pushed
7. **Hand off** - Provide context for next session

**CRITICAL RULES:**

-   Work is NOT complete until `git push` succeeds
-   NEVER stop before pushing - that leaves work stranded locally
-   NEVER say "ready to push when you are" - YOU must push
-   If push fails, resolve and retry until it succeeds
````

## File: check-ec2-access.sh
````bash
#!/bin/bash

INSTANCE_ID="i-064acb0a9d4d146ce"

echo "=== EC2 Instance Accessibility Diagnostic ==="
echo "Instance: $INSTANCE_ID"
echo

echo "1. Instance Details & Public IP:"
aws ec2 describe-instances --instance-ids $INSTANCE_ID \
  --query 'Reservations[0].Instances[0].{PublicIP:PublicIpAddress,PublicDNS:PublicDnsName,State:State.Name,SubnetId:SubnetId,VpcId:VpcId}' \
  --output table
echo

SUBNET_ID=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --instance-ids $INSTANCE_ID \
  --query 'Reservations[0].Instances[0].SubnetId' --output text)

echo "2. Security Groups & Rules:"
SG_IDS=$(aws ec2 describe-instances --instance-ids $INSTANCE_ID \
  --query 'Reservations[0].Instances[0].SecurityGroups[*].GroupId' --output text)

for SG_ID in $SG_IDS; do
  echo "  Security Group: $SG_ID"
  aws ec2 describe-security-groups --group-ids $SG_ID \
    --query 'SecurityGroups[0].{Name:GroupName,Inbound:IpPermissions}' \
    --output json
  echo
done

echo "3. Subnet Auto-Assign Public IP:"
aws ec2 describe-subnets --subnet-ids $SUBNET_ID \
  --query 'Subnets[0].{SubnetId:SubnetId,AutoAssignPublicIP:MapPublicIpOnLaunch}' \
  --output table
echo

echo "4. Route Table (check for 0.0.0.0/0 -> igw-xxx):"
aws ec2 describe-route-tables --filters "Name=association.subnet-id,Values=$SUBNET_ID" \
  --query 'RouteTables[0].Routes' \
  --output table
echo

echo "5. Network ACLs:"
aws ec2 describe-network-acls --filters "Name=association.subnet-id,Values=$SUBNET_ID" \
  --query 'NetworkAcls[0].{Inbound:Entries[?Egress==`false`],Outbound:Entries[?Egress==`true`]}' \
  --output json
echo

echo "=== Diagnosis Complete ==="
echo
echo "Check for:"
echo "  [ ] Instance has Public IP"
echo "  [ ] Security group allows inbound (port 22/80/443/etc)"
echo "  [ ] Route table has 0.0.0.0/0 -> igw-xxx"
echo "  [ ] Network ACL allows traffic (default = allow all)"
echo "  [ ] Subnet has auto-assign public IP enabled"
````

## File: Jenkinsfile
````
@Library('jenkins-pipeline-setup') _
// waiting for the argo pipeline to complete before transitioning to this
// properties([pipelineTriggers([githubPush()])])

String defaultBranch = 'main'
String awscli = 'awscli'
String nodejs = 'nodejs'
String cdntools = 'cdntools'
String slash = '/'
String webhooks = 'webhooks'
String pipelineShared = '/pipeline/shared'
String shared = 'shared'
String installCmd = './jenkins/install.sh'
String codeCoverageCmd = './jenkins/code_coverage.sh'
Map gitshaCmd = [returnStdout: true, script: 'git rev-parse HEAD']
Map defaultGitshaCmd = [returnStdout: true, script: "git rev-parse origin/${defaultBranch}"]

// CICD-related library of Jenkins pipeline parameters and steps. See jenkins-shared-lib repo.
library(
    identifier: 'jenkins-shared-lib@v8.1.16',
    retriever: modernSCM([
        $class: 'GitSCMSource',
        remote: 'https://github.com/Tealium/jenkins-shared-lib',
        credentialsId: 'github-cicd-bot-teal-token'
    ])
)

Map<Object,Object> podTemplate = [
  spec: [
    nodeSelector: [
        'instance_purpose': 'critical_workloads',
    ],
    containers: [
        podDef.containerDefaults().nodeContainer
        .withName(nodejs)
        .withImageTag('node:20')
        .withResources('1000m', '4Gi', '')
        .withVolumeMount(podDef.volumeMount(shared, pipelineShared, false)),
    ]
  ]
]


pipeline {
    agent {
        kubernetes {
            yaml podDef(podTemplate)
            retries 2
        }
    }

    options {
        ansiColor('xterm')
        buildDiscarder(logRotator(numToKeepStr: '15'))
        skipStagesAfterUnstable()
        timeout(time: 1, unit: 'HOURS')
        timestamps()
    }

    parameters {
        gitParameter(
            branchFilter: 'origin/(.*)',
            defaultValue: defaultBranch,
            selectedValue: 'NONE',
            name: 'AUTOMATION_GIT_BRANCH_OVERRIDE',
            sortMode: 'ASCENDING_SMART',
            type: 'PT_BRANCH',
            description: 'SET EXCLUSIVELY BY AUTOMATION. Git branch to deploy from github.com:Tealium/tealium-ui-kit.git.',
            quickFilterEnabled: true
        )
        booleanParam(
            name: 'ONLY_UPDATE_PIPELINE',
            defaultValue: false,
            description: 'Select this to only run the initial checkout to update the pipeline itself, typically only needed for testing Jenkinsfile changes.'
        )
        booleanParam(
            name: 'RUN_A11Y',
            defaultValue: false,
            description: 'Run Accessibility tests'
        )
    }

    environment {
        ARTIFACTORY_CREDENTIALS = credentials('artifactory-credentials-jenkins')
        AWS_CREDS_LOCATION = '/home/jenkins/agent/ops-access-creds.txt' // Used to store temporary creds to ops role
        GIT_CREDS = credentials('github-cicd-bot-teal-token')
        JFROG_CLI_OFFER_CONFIG = false
        REGION = "${env.REGION}"

        GIT_BRANCH = "${params.AUTOMATION_GIT_BRANCH_OVERRIDE.split(slash).last() ?: env.GIT_BRANCH.split(slash).last()}"
        // TODO: [SDLC-770] Follow Jenkins standard security practices and do not re-reference credentials in environment variables.
        GIT_USER = "$GIT_CREDS_USR"
        GIT_TOKEN = "$GIT_CREDS_PSW"
        GIT_EMAIL = 'github-cicd-bot@tealium.com'
        // semantic release env variables
        GH_TOKEN = "$GIT_CREDS_PSW"
        NPM_USERNAME = "$ARTIFACTORY_CREDENTIALS_USR"
        NPM_PASSWORD = "$ARTIFACTORY_CREDENTIALS_PSW"
        NPM_EMAIL = 'ops@tealium.com'

        TEMPLATES_DIR = "${env.WORKSPACE}/jenkins/templates"
        lcov_results_file="${JENKINS_SRC_DIR}/coverage/lcov.info"
    }

    stages {
        stage('Git Checkout') {
            when { expression { !(params.AUTOMATION_GIT_BRANCH_OVERRIDE in [defaultBranch, '']) } }
            steps {
                echo "Git Checkout into branch: ${params.AUTOMATION_GIT_BRANCH_OVERRIDE}"
                git(
                    url: 'git@github.com:Tealium/tealium-ui-kit.git',
                    credentialsId: 'github-cicd-bot-teal',
                    branch: params.AUTOMATION_GIT_BRANCH_OVERRIDE
                )
            }
        }

        stage('Update Pipeline') {
            when { expression { return params.ONLY_UPDATE_PIPELINE } }
            steps {
                buildName "#${env.BUILD_NUMBER}_Pipeline_Refresh"
                unstable 'Pipeline updated! Start a new build to use the new settings.'
            }
        }

        stage('Send Webhooks') {
            environment {
                SOURCE_VERSION = "${sh(gitshaCmd).trim()}"
            }
            steps {
                container(webhooks) {
                    sh """
                        printf ${env.SOURCE_VERSION} >/tmp/source_version.txt
                        python /code/webhooks.py --action=create --status=in_progress
                        python /code/jira_update_build_status.py --status="In Progress"
                    """
                }
            }
        }

        stage('Install Depedencies') {
            steps {
                container(nodejs) {

                    // This gets the chromatic project key from AWS Parameter Store
                    script { load('jenkins/chromatic.groovy') }

                    // Install NPM dependencies
                    sh 'npm ci'
                }
            }
        }

        stage('Test Linting') {
            steps {
                container(nodejs) {
                    sh 'npm run lint:check'
                    sh 'npm run styles:check'
                }
            }
        }

        stage('Prettier Check') {
            steps {
                container(nodejs) {
                    sh 'npm run prettier:check'
                }
            }
        }

        stage('Run Jest Tests') {
            steps {
                container(nodejs) {
                    sh 'npm run test'
                }
            }
        }

        stage('Run Test Accessibility') {
            when { expression { return params.RUN_A11Y } }
            
            steps {
                container(nodejs) {
                    sh './jenkins/test_storybook.sh'
                }
            }
        }

        stage('Codacy after build') {
            when { expression { env.ENVIRONMENT_TYPE != 'prod' } }
            steps {
                container(nodejs) {
                    script {
                        String gitsha = "${sh(gitshaCmd).trim()}"
                        codacyAnalysis.afterBuild([
                            codacyProjectName: 'tealium-ui-kit',
                            gitsha: gitsha
                        ])
                    }
                }
            }
        }

        stage('Run Build') {
            steps {
                container(nodejs) {
                    sh 'npm run build'
                }
            }
        }
        stage('Run Storybook Build') {
            // this does nothing for now but to distinguish the difference between jenkins vs local
            environment {
                CDN_DEPLOY_LOCATION = 'storybook'
            }
            steps {
                container(nodejs) {
                    sh 'npm run build-storybook'
                }
            }
        }
        stage('Promote') {
            environment {
                NPM_CONFIG_REGISTRY = 'https://tealium.jfrog.io/artifactory/api/npm/npm-local/'
            }
            when {
                expression { return "${sh(gitshaCmd).trim()}" == "${sh(defaultGitshaCmd).trim()}" }
            }
            steps {
                container(nodejs) {
                    sh 'npx semantic-release'
                }
            }
        }

        // This should only be run on features and fixes for main, allowing us to publish and verify components.
        stage('Chromatic Build') {
            environment {
                CHROMATIC_PROJECT_KEY = "${readJSON(file: 'chromatic_project_key.json').CHROMATIC_PROJECT_KEY}"
            }
            when {
                allOf {
                    expression { return GIT_BRANCH == "main" }
                    expression { changelog '.*^\\[fix|feat\\] .+$' }
                }
            }
            steps {
                container(nodejs) {   
                    sh 'npx chromatic --project-token=$CHROMATIC_PROJECT_KEY -d storybook-static --ci --exit-zero-on-changes'
                }
            }
        }

        // This is for when we force chromatic to build, it skips running the tests but publishes the changes.
        stage('Test Chromatic Build') {
            environment {
                CHROMATIC_PROJECT_KEY = "${readJSON(file: 'chromatic_project_key.json').CHROMATIC_PROJECT_KEY}"
            }
            when { 
                expression { return GIT_BRANCH != "main" }
            }
            steps {
                container(nodejs) {
                    sh 'npx chromatic --project-token=$CHROMATIC_PROJECT_KEY -d storybook-static --ci --exit-once-uploaded --exit-zero-on-changes --only-changed "!(main)"'
                }
            }
        }
    }

    post {
        success {
            container(webhooks) {
                sh '''
                    export SOURCE_VERSION=`cat /tmp/source_version.txt`
                    python /code/webhooks.py --action=finish --status=success
                    python /code/jira_update_build_status.py --status=Passed
                '''
            }
        }
        failure {
            container(webhooks) {
                sh '''
                    export SOURCE_VERSION=`cat /tmp/source_version.txt`
                    python /code/webhooks.py --action=finish --status=failure
                    python /code/jira_update_build_status.py --status=Failed
                '''
            }
        }
    }
}
````

````javascript
module.exports = {
    roots: ["src"],
    moduleFileExtensions: ["ts", "tsx", "js", "jsx"],
    testPathIgnorePatterns: ["node_modules/"],
    testEnvironment: "jsdom",
    transform: {
        "^.+\\.[tj]sx?$": "babel-jest"
    },
    setupFilesAfterEnv: ["<rootDir>/jest.setup.js"],
    collectCoverage: true,
    collectCoverageFrom: [
        "src/**/{!(*.stories),}.{js,jsx,ts,tsx}",
        "!src/mocks/**", // Ignore all files in the mocks folder
        "!src/**/*.d.ts" // Ignore TypeScript declaration files
    ],
    testMatch: ["**/*.test.(ts|tsx|js|jsx)"],
    moduleNameMapper: {
        // Mocks out all these file formats when tests are run.
        "\\.(jpg|ico|jpeg|png|gif|eot|otf|webp|svg|ttf|woff|woff2|mp4|webm|wav|mp3|m4a|aac|oga)$": "identity-obj-proxy",
        "\\.(css|less|scss|sass)$": "identity-obj-proxy",

        // New mappings to handle alias
        "^@src/(.*)$": "<rootDir>/src/$1",
        "^@components/(.*)$": "<rootDir>/src/components/$1",
        "^@atoms/(.*)$": "<rootDir>/src/components/atoms/$1",
        "^@molecules/(.*)$": "<rootDir>/src/components/molecules/$1",
        "^@organisms/(.*)$": "<rootDir>/src/components/organisms/$1",
        "^@css/(.*)$": "<rootDir>/src/css/$1",
        "^@hooks/(.*)$": "<rootDir>/src/hooks/$1",
        "^@utils/(.*)$": "<rootDir>/src/utils/$1",
        "^@theme/(.*)$": "<rootDir>/src/theme/$1"
    },
    coverageThreshold: {
        global: {
            branches: 100,
            functions: 100,
````

````bash
#!/bin/bash

FILE="/Users/adrianbrowning/Documents/repos/tealiumlabs/tealium-ui-kit/src/components/atoms/textArea/TextArea.js"

cat > "$FILE" << 'EOF'
import React, { useRef, useLayoutEffect } from "react";
import TextField from "@mui/material/TextField";
import PropTypes from "prop-types";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import FormFieldHelper from "@atoms/FormFieldHelper/FormFieldHelper";
import useUniqueId from "@hooks/useUniqueId";

const TextArea = ({
    id,
    disabled,
    autoComplete,
    // autoFocus,
    name,
    error,
    errorHelperText,
    helperText,
    isHighlighted,
    onChange,
    onFocus,
    onBlur,
    placeholder,
    value,
    height = "100%",
    width = "100%",
    maxLength,
    readOnly,
    resize = "none",
    "data-testid": dataTestId,
    dataTrackAction,
    inputProps
}) => {
    // Generate unique ID
    const uniqueId = useUniqueId();
    // Style string for input height
    const [innerHeightStyle, setinnerHeightStyle] = React.useState("");
    // Style string for input resize
    const resizeStyle = resize === "auto" || resize === "vertical" ? resize : "none";
    // Ref to provide access to container element dimensions
    const containerRef = useRef(null);
    // Padding set here so it can be subtracted from container height/width to get correct input size (any style unit works)
    const inputRootPadding = "8px";

    const handleOnChange = event => {
        if (onChange) {
            onChange(event.target.value);
        }
        resize === "auto" && autoResize(event.target);
    };

    // Use the generated ID if no id prop is provided
    const elementId = id || uniqueId;

    // Auto-resize the input based on its content
    const autoResize = element => {
        setinnerHeightStyle(`calc(${element.scrollHeight}px`);
    };

    /**
     * Produce style string for adjusted input height.
     * This is a workaround for correct sizing around MUI wrapper elements when resize is enabled.
     * Any style unit works (px, em, rem, %, ...etc) for height/width props.
     */
    useLayoutEffect(() => {
        const { height: innerHeight } = containerRef.current.getBoundingClientRect();
        const isResizeable = resize === "auto" || resize === "vertical";
        const baseHeight = !isResizeable ? height : `${innerHeight}px`;
        const padding = !baseHeight?.endsWith("%") ? ` - ${inputRootPadding} - ${inputRootPadding}` : "";
        setinnerHeightStyle(`calc(${baseHeight}${padding})`);
    }, [height, width, resize]);

    return (
        <>
            <StyledTextArea
                ref={containerRef}
                id={elementId}
                error={error}
                disabled={disabled}
                inputProps={{
                    ...inputProps,
                    "data-testid": dataTestId,
                    maxLength,
                    "data-track-action": dataTrackAction,
                    readOnly,
                    style: {
                        height: innerHeightStyle,
                        resize: resizeStyle
                    }
                }}
                multiline
                variant="outlined"
                placeholder={placeholder}
                onChange={handleOnChange}
                onFocus={onFocus}
                onBlur={onBlur}
                autoComplete={autoComplete}
                name={name}
                value={value}
                $isHighlighted={isHighlighted}
                $inputRootPadding={inputRootPadding}
                $height={height}
                $width={width}
                $resize={resize}
            />
            <FormFieldHelper
                errorHelperText={errorHelperText}
                helperText={helperText}
                error={error}
                data-testid={`${dataTestId}_helper`}
            />
        </>
    );
};

TextArea.propTypes = {
    /**
     * HTML id attribute for the textarea element
     */
    id: PropTypes.string,
    /**
     * Browser autocomplete behavior ("off", "on", "address", etc.)
     */
    autoComplete: PropTypes.string,
    /**
     * Auto-focus on mount (not recommended)
     * @deprecated Reduces usability and accessibility. Users can Tab to focus.
     */
    autoFocus: PropTypes.bool,
    /**
     * HTML name attribute for form submission
     */
    name: PropTypes.string,
    /**
     * Disables the textarea
     * @default false
     */
    disabled: PropTypes.bool,
    /**
     * Shows error state with red border
     * @default false
     */
    error: PropTypes.bool,
    /**
     * Error message displayed below textarea with error icon
     */
    errorHelperText: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.node]),
    /**
     * Helper text displayed below textarea
     */
    helperText: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.node]),
    /**
     * Textarea height (any CSS unit: px, em, rem, %)
     * @default "100%"
     */
    height: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.number]),
    /**
     * Highlights textarea with yellow background (#FFFEEB)
     * @default false
     */
    isHighlighted: PropTypes.bool,
    /**
     * Callback fired when value changes
     * Signature: function(value: string) => void
     */
    onChange: PropTypes.func,
    /**
     * Callback fired when textarea receives focus
     * Signature: function(event: object) => void
     */
    onFocus: PropTypes.func,
    /**
     * Callback fired when textarea loses focus
     * Signature: function(event: object) => void
     */
    onBlur: PropTypes.func,
    /**
     * Placeholder text shown when empty
     */
    placeholder: PropTypes.string,
    /**
     * Controlled component value
     */
    value: PropTypes.string,
    /**
     * Textarea width (any CSS unit: px, em, rem, %)
     * @default "100%"
     */
    width: PropTypes.oneOfType([PropTypes.string, PropTypes.number]),
    /**
     * Maximum character length
     */
    maxLength: PropTypes.number,
    /**
     * Resize behavior ("auto" grows/shrinks with content)
     * @default "none"
     */
    resize: PropTypes.oneOf(["none", "vertical", "auto"]),
    /**
     * Makes textarea read-only
     * @default false
     */
    readOnly: PropTypes.bool,
    /**
     * Test identifier for testing libraries
     */
    "data-testid": PropTypes.string,
    /**
     * Pendo tracking identifier
     */
    dataTrackAction: PropTypes.string,
    /**
     * Additional props passed to underlying input element
     * @default {}
     */
    inputProps: PropTypes.object
};

const StyledTextArea = styled(TextField, {
    shouldForwardProp: prop => !["$resize", "$height", "$width", "$isHighlighted", "$inputRootPadding"].includes(prop)
})\`width: \${props => props.$width};
height: \${props => (props.$resize === "auto" || props.$resize === "vertical" ? "" : props.$height)};
min-height: \${props => props.$height};
border-radius: 0;

& .MuiOutlinedInput-root.Mui-error {
    & fieldset {
        border: 1px solid #db5560 !important;
    }
}

& .MuiInputBase-root.Mui-disabled {
    background: #ededed;
    border-radius: 0;
    border-color: #ededed;

    & fieldset {
        border: \${props => (props.error ? "1px solid #DB5560 !important" : "1px solid #EDEDED !important")};
        border-radius: 0;
    }

    &:hover fieldset {
        border: \${props => (props.error ? "1px solid #DB5560 !important" : "1px solid #EDEDED !important")};
    }
}

& .MuiOutlinedInput-root {
    padding: \${props => props.$inputRootPadding} !important;
    border-radius: 4px;
    background: \${props => (props.$isHighlighted ? "#FFFEEB" : "#FFF")};
    height: \${props => (props.$resize === "auto" || props.$resize === "vertical" ? "" : props.$height)};

    &:hover {
        & .MuiOutlinedInput-notchedOutline {
            border: 1px solid #1362a2;
        }
    }
}

& .MuiOutlinedInput-root.Mui-focused {
    & .MuiOutlinedInput-notchedOutline {
        border: 1px solid #1362a2;
    }
}

& .MuiInputBase-input {
    font-family: proxima-nova, Proxima, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif !important;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1rem;
    overflow: visible !important;
    color: #697380;
    border-radius: 0 !important;
    box-shadow: none !important;
    border: none !important;
}
\`;

export default TextArea;
EOF
````

## File: src/components/atoms/AlertBar/AlertBar.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import Button from "@atoms/button/Button";
import { ALERT_BAR_TYPE } from "@atoms/AlertBar/AlertBarConstants";
import { filterAccessibleAttributes } from "@utils/accessibleAttrFilter";
import {
    AlertBarContainer,
    StyledAlertBarIcon,
    AlertBarTitle,
    AlertBarContent,
    AlertBarActionButtonContainer,
    StyledCloseIcon
} from "./AlertBar.styles";

type AlertBarType = (typeof ALERT_BAR_TYPE)[keyof typeof ALERT_BAR_TYPE];

export type AlertBarProps = {
    /**
     * Type of alert bar
     */
    type: AlertBarType;
    /**
     * Optional title
     */
    title?: string;
    /**
     * Boolean that is responsible for displaying of "Call to action" button
     */
    hasAction?: boolean;
    /**
     * String label to be displayed in "Call to action" button
     */
    actionButtonLabel?: string;
    /**
     * Callback that is called when "Call to action" button is clicked
     */
    onActionClick?: () => void;
    /**
     * Show/hide "Close" button to close alert
     */
    hasClose?: boolean;
    /**
     * Callback that is called when "Close" button is clicked
     */
    onCloseClick?: () => void;
    /**
     * Show rounded corners
     */
    isRounded?: boolean;
    /**
     * Main component's content to be displayed
     */
    children: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Used for testing
     */
    "data-testid"?: string;
    /**
     * Additional attributes for accessibility
     */
    attrProps?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

const AlertBar = (props: AlertBarProps) => {
    const {
        type,
        title,
        hasAction = false,
        actionButtonLabel,
        onActionClick,
        hasClose = false,
        onCloseClick,
        isRounded = false,
        children,
        "data-testid": dataTestId,
        attrProps = {}
    } = props;

    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(true);

    const handleClose = useCallback(() => {
        setIsOpen(false);
        onCloseClick && onCloseClick();
    }, [onCloseClick]);

    const allowedAttrProps = filterAccessibleAttributes(attrProps);

    //Determine appropriate role and aria-live based on type
    const getAccessibilityProps = () => {
        const baseProps = {
            role: type === "error" ? "alert" : "status",
            "aria-live": type === "error" ? ("assertive" as const) : ("polite" as const),
            ...allowedAttrProps
        };

        return baseProps;
    };

    return (
        isOpen && (
            <AlertBarContainer type={type} data-testid={dataTestId} isRounded={isRounded} {...getAccessibilityProps()}>
                <StyledAlertBarIcon
                    $type={type}
                    className="fas"
                    aria-hidden="true" //Icon is decorative
                    data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-alert-bar-icon`}
                />
                <AlertBarContent>
                    {title && <AlertBarTitle>{title}</AlertBarTitle>} {children}
                </AlertBarContent>
                {hasAction && actionButtonLabel && (
                    <AlertBarActionButtonContainer
                        data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-alert-bar-action-button-container`}
                    >
                        <Button
                            type="borderless"
                            small={true}
                            isMinWidthZero={true}
                            onClick={onActionClick}
                            aria-label={actionButtonLabel}
                            data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-alert-bar-action-button`}
                        >
                            {actionButtonLabel}
                        </Button>
                    </AlertBarActionButtonContainer>
                )}
                {hasClose && (
                    <StyledCloseIcon
                        onClick={handleClose}
                        data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-close-button`}
                        role="button"
                        tabIndex={0}
                        aria-label={`Close ${type} alert`}
                        onKeyDown={e => {
                            if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
                                e.preventDefault();
                                handleClose();
                            }
                        }}
                    >
                        <i className="fal fa-times" aria-hidden="true" />
                    </StyledCloseIcon>
                )}
            </AlertBarContainer>
        )
    );
};

export default AlertBar;
````

````typescript
import React, { forwardRef, ComponentPropsWithRef } from "react";
import {
    StyledAvatarWrapper,
    StyledImageAvatarWrapper,
    DefaultCircleAvatarWrapper,
    DefaultSquareAvatarWrapper
} from "./Avatar.styles";
import {
    SIZES,
    FONT_SIZES,
    getBackgroundColor,
    getColor,
    getBorderRadius,
    CIRCLE,
    SQUARE,
    MEDIUM,
    GRAY,
    AvatarShape,
    AvatarSize,
    AvatarColor
} from "./constants";
import { filterAccessibleAttributes } from "@utils/accessibleAttrFilter";

export type AvatarProps = Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<"div">, "role"> & {
    /**
     * Shape of avatar - "circle" (default) or "square"
     * square avatar will be used for non-persona related items (e.g. product area, 3rd-party company)
     * circle avatar will be used for persona related items (e.g. profile picture, profile icon)
     */
    shape?: AvatarShape;
    /**
     * Size of avatar: "small", "medium" (default) or "large"
     */
    size?: AvatarSize;
    /**
     * Image path to be used as avatar.
     */
    imageSource?: string;
    /**
     * Text to be used to describe image for screen readers, needed for accessibility. This should be filled out whenever an imageSource is provided.
     */
    imageAltText?: string;
    /**
     * Initials to be used as avatar: 2 character limit.
     */
    initials?: string;
    /**
     * Icon to be used as avatar
     */
    icon?: React.ReactElement;
    /**
     * Color of avatar, to only be used with icon or initials. Must be one of the predefined colors: gray (default), red, orange, yellow, green, sky, blue, purple, pink
     */
    color?: AvatarColor;
    /**
     * Accessibility label for avatar
     */
    "aria-label"?: string;
    /**
     * TestId for testing
     */
    "data-testid"?: string;
    /**
     * Additional attributes for accessibility
     * @deprecated Use native HTML attrs instead. Will be removed in v2.0.
     */
    attrProps?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

const Avatar = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, AvatarProps>(
    (
        {
            shape = CIRCLE,
            size = MEDIUM,
            imageSource,
            imageAltText,
            initials,
            icon,
            color = GRAY,
            "data-testid": dataTestId,
            attrProps = {},
            className,
            "aria-label": ariaLabelProp,
            ...nativeProps
        },
        ref
    ) => {
        const allowedAttrProps = filterAccessibleAttributes(attrProps);

        // Merge aria-label: attrProps takes precedence for backward compat
        const ariaLabel = (attrProps["aria-label"] as string | undefined) || ariaLabelProp;

        // Spread props in order: nativeProps, allowedAttrProps (for backward compat priority)
        const sharedProps = {
            ...nativeProps,
            ...allowedAttrProps,
            ref,
            className
        };

        if (!imageSource && !icon && !initials) {
            if (shape === SQUARE) {
                return (
                    <DefaultSquareAvatarWrapper
                        {...sharedProps}
                        data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-square`}
                        role="img"
                        aria-label={ariaLabel || "Default square avatar"}
                    >
                        <i className="fa-solid fa-building" aria-hidden="true" />
                    </DefaultSquareAvatarWrapper>
                );
            }

            return (
                <DefaultCircleAvatarWrapper
                    {...sharedProps}
                    data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-circle`}
                    role="img"
                    aria-label={ariaLabel || "Default circle avatar"}
                >
                    <i className="fas fa-building" aria-hidden="true" />
                </DefaultCircleAvatarWrapper>
            );
        }

        return imageSource ? (
            <StyledImageAvatarWrapper
                {...sharedProps}
                $size={SIZES[size]}
                $borderRadius={getBorderRadius({ size, shape })}
                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-image-avatar`}
                role="img"
                aria-label={ariaLabel || imageAltText}
            >
                <img
                    src={imageSource}
                    alt={imageAltText || "Avatar Image"}
                    aria-label={ariaLabel || imageAltText || "Avatar Image"}
                    aria-hidden={!imageAltText}
                />
            </StyledImageAvatarWrapper>
        ) : (
            <StyledAvatarWrapper
                {...sharedProps}
                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-${initials ? "initials" : "icon"}-avatar`}
                $color={getColor[color]}
                $backgroundColor={getBackgroundColor[color]}
                $size={SIZES[size]}
                $fontSize={FONT_SIZES[size]}
                $borderRadius={getBorderRadius({ size, shape })}
                role="img"
                aria-label={
                    ariaLabel ||
                    (initials
                        ? `Avatar with initials ${initials}`
                        : icon
                        ? "Avatar with icon"
                        : /* istanbul ignore next */ undefined)
                }
            >
                {initials ? initials?.slice(0, 2) : icon && React.cloneElement(icon, { "aria-hidden": "true" } as any)}
            </StyledAvatarWrapper>
        );
    }
);

Avatar.displayName = "Avatar";

export default Avatar;
````

````typescript
import React, { forwardRef, ComponentPropsWithRef } from "react";
import { BadgeContainer, Icon, Label } from "./Badge.styles";
import { BADGE_CONFIG, BADGE_TYPE } from "./BadgeConstants";

const formatTrackingString = (text: string): string => {
    return text.replace(/\s+/g, "").toLocaleLowerCase();
};

const generateTrackAction = (prefix: string, type: string, label: string, suffix?: string): string => {
    const parts = [prefix, "badge", suffix, type.toLocaleLowerCase(), formatTrackingString(label)].filter(Boolean);
    return parts.join("-");
};

export type BadgeProps = Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<"span">, "style"> & {
    /**
     * Type of badge
     */
    type: (typeof BADGE_TYPE)[keyof typeof BADGE_TYPE];
    /**
     * Deprecated - With new redesign, it is required to show icon with badge
     */
    iconIsDisplayed?: boolean;
    /**
     * Label to display
     */
    label: string;
    /**
     * Icon Component in \<i className="fa fa-* fa-***" /\> format
     */
    icon?: React.ReactElement;
    /**
     * Flag to show badge with low attention
     */
    hasLowAttention?: boolean;
    /**
     * Flag to show badge with link
     */
    hasLink?: boolean;
    /**
     * Link props
     */
    linkProps?: React.AnchorHTMLAttributes<HTMLAnchorElement>;
    /**
     * Data track action
     */
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    /**
     * TestId for testing
     */
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

export const Badge = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, BadgeProps>(
    (
        {
            type,
            label,
            icon,
            hasLowAttention = false,
            hasLink = false,
            linkProps,
            dataTrackAction,
            "data-testid": dataTestId,
            className,
            ...nativeProps
        },
        ref
    ) => {
        return (
            <BadgeContainer
                ref={ref}
                type={type}
                $hasLowAttention={hasLowAttention}
                aria-live="polite"
                aria-atomic="true"
                data-track-action={dataTrackAction && generateTrackAction(dataTrackAction, type, label)}
                data-testid={dataTestId}
                className={className}
                {...nativeProps}
            >
                {React.isValidElement(icon) ? (
                    <Icon $type={type} aria-hidden="true" data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-custom_icon`}>
                        {icon}
                    </Icon>
                ) : (
                    <Icon
                        className={`fas ${BADGE_CONFIG[type].iconClassName}`}
                        aria-hidden="true"
                        $type={type}
                        data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}_icon`}
                    />
                )}
                <Label data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-badge-label`}>
                    {hasLink && linkProps ? (
                        <a
                            {...linkProps}
                            aria-label={label}
                            role="link"
                            tabIndex={0}
                            data-track-action={
                                dataTrackAction && generateTrackAction(dataTrackAction, type, label, "link")
                            }
                            data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-badge-link`}
                        >
                            {label}
                        </a>
                    ) : (
                        <span>{label}</span>
                    )}
                </Label>
            </BadgeContainer>
        );
    }
);

Badge.displayName = "Badge";

export default Badge;
````

````typescript
import { colors } from "@theme/themeUtils";

export const BADGE_TYPE = {
    DRAFT: "draft",
    ERROR: "error",
    INFORMATIVE: "informative",
    IN_PROGRESS: "inprogress",
    NEUTRAL: "neutral",

    WARN: "warn"
} as const;

    [BADGE_TYPE.DRAFT]: {
        backgroundColor: colors.paper,
        iconClassName: "fa-spinner",

    },
    [BADGE_TYPE.ERROR]: {
        backgroundColor: colors.paper,
        iconClassName: "fa-exclamation-circle",
        iconColor: colors.error,
        textColor: colors.errorDark
    },
    [BADGE_TYPE.INFORMATIVE]: {
        backgroundColor: colors.paper,
        iconClassName: "fa-circle",
        iconColor: colors.primary,
        textColor: colors.primaryDark
    },
    [BADGE_TYPE.IN_PROGRESS]: {
        backgroundColor: colors.paper,
        iconClassName: "fa-adjust",
        iconColor: colors.primary,
        textColor: colors.primaryDark
    },
    [BADGE_TYPE.NEUTRAL]: {
        backgroundColor: colors.paper,
        iconClassName: "fa-circle",
        iconColor: colors.gray600,
        textColor: colors.gray800
    },
    [BADGE_TYPE.SUCCESS]: {
        backgroundColor: colors.paper,
        iconClassName: "fa-check-circle",
        iconColor: colors.success,
        textColor: colors.successDark
    },

    }
} as const;
````

````typescript
// ButtonStyles.js imports - not yet converted to TypeScript
import {
    ServerCTABase,
    ServerCTAHover,
    ServerCTAFocus,
    PrimaryBase,
    PrimaryHover,
    PrimaryFocus,
    PrimaryDisabled,
    PrimaryToggle,
    SecondaryBase,
    SecondaryDisabled,
    BorderBase,
    BorderlessIconOnlyButtonBase,
    BorderlessIconOnlyButtonActive,
    BorderlessIconOnlyButtonDisabled,
    BorderlessBase,
    BorderlessFocus,
    SegmentedBase,
    SegmentedHover,
    SegmentedToggle,
    SegmentedDisabled,
    ServerCTAToggle,
    ServerCTADisabled,
    DestructiveBase,
    DestructiveToggle,
    DestructiveHover,
    DestructiveDisabled,
    BorderlessIconOnlyButtonHover,
    BorderlessHover,
    BorderlessDisabled,
    BorderHover,
    BorderFocus,
    BorderlessToggle,
    SegmentedFocus
} from "./ButtonStyles";

type ButtonType =
    | "primary"
    | "secondary"
    | "border"
    | "borderless"
    | "serverCTA"
    | "segmented"
    | "destructive"
    | undefined;

type ButtonStyleOptions = {
    type?: ButtonType;
    isIconOnly?: boolean;
};

export const getButtonTypeBase = ({ type, isIconOnly }: ButtonStyleOptions) => {
    switch (type) {
        case "serverCTA":
            return ServerCTABase;
        case "primary":
            return PrimaryBase;
        case "secondary":
            return SecondaryBase;
        case "border":
            return BorderBase;
        case "segmented":
            return SegmentedBase;
        case "borderless":
            return isIconOnly ? BorderlessIconOnlyButtonBase : BorderlessBase;
        case "destructive":
            return DestructiveBase;
        default:
            return PrimaryBase;
    }
};

export const getButtonTypeHover = ({ type, isIconOnly }: ButtonStyleOptions) => {
    switch (type) {
        case "serverCTA":
            return ServerCTAHover;
        case "primary":
        case "secondary":
            return PrimaryHover;
        case "border":
            return BorderHover;
        case "segmented":
            return SegmentedHover;
        case "borderless":
            return isIconOnly ? BorderlessIconOnlyButtonHover : BorderlessHover;
        case "destructive":
            return DestructiveHover;
        default:
            return PrimaryHover;
    }
};

export const getButtonTypeFocus = ({ type, isIconOnly }: ButtonStyleOptions) => {
    switch (type) {
        case "serverCTA":
            return ServerCTAFocus;
        case "primary":
        case "secondary":
            return PrimaryFocus;
        case "border":
            return BorderFocus;
        case "borderless":
            return isIconOnly ? BorderlessIconOnlyButtonActive : BorderlessFocus;
        case "segmented":
            return SegmentedFocus;
        case "destructive":
            return DestructiveHover;
        default:
            return PrimaryFocus;
    }
};

export const getButtonTypeToggle = ({ type, isIconOnly }: ButtonStyleOptions) => {
    switch (type) {
        case "serverCTA":
            return ServerCTAToggle;
        case "primary":
        case "secondary":
        case "border":
            return PrimaryToggle;
        case "borderless":
            return isIconOnly ? BorderlessIconOnlyButtonActive : BorderlessToggle;
        case "segmented":
            return SegmentedToggle;
        case "destructive":
            return DestructiveToggle;
        default:
            return PrimaryToggle;
    }
};

export const getButtonTypeDisabled = ({ type, isIconOnly }: ButtonStyleOptions) => {
    switch (type) {
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import ContentGrid from "./ContentGrid";
import { render } from "@testing-library/react";

describe("ContentGrid Tests", () => {
    it("should render a content grid", () => {
        // assemble/act
        const { getByText } = render(
            <ContentGrid>
                <span>Some Content Here</span>
            </ContentGrid>
        );

        expect(getByText("Some Content Here")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should render multiple children", () => {
        const { getByText } = render(
            <ContentGrid>
                <span>Child 1</span>
                <span>Child 2</span>
            </ContentGrid>
        );
        expect(getByText("Child 1")).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(getByText("Child 2")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should apply columnSize and isZeroMinWidth props", () => {
        const { getByTestId } = render(
            <ContentGrid columnSize={6} isZeroMinWidth data-testid="grid-test">
                <span>Content</span>
            </ContentGrid>
        );
        const grid = getByTestId("grid-test");
        expect(grid).toHaveAttribute("data-testid", "grid-test");
    });

    it("should render with no children", () => {
        const { container } = render(<ContentGrid data-testid="empty-grid" />);
        expect(container.querySelector('[data-testid="empty-grid"]')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
});
````

````typescript
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react";
import FileCard from "./FileCard";

export default {
    title: "Atoms/FileCard",
    component: FileCard
} satisfies Meta<typeof FileCard>;

const Template = (args: ComponentProps<typeof FileCard>) => {
    return <FileCard {...args} />;
};

const FileNameOverflowTemplate = (args: ComponentProps<typeof FileCard>) => {
    return (
        <div style={{ width: "200px" }}>
            <FileCard {...args} />
        </div>
    );
};

export const Default: StoryObj<typeof FileCard> = {
    render: Template,
    args: {
        fileName: "test_file.txt"
    }
};

export const FileNameOverflow: StoryObj<typeof FileCard> = {
    render: FileNameOverflowTemplate,
    args: {
        fileName: "some_long_file_name.pdf"
    }
};

export const ErrorState: StoryObj<typeof FileCard> = {
    render: Template,
    args: {
        fileName: "error_file.exe",
        hasError: true
    }
};
````
