````typescript
import {
    localeSelector,
    getPlaceholderDate,
    getPlaceholderTime,
    getTimeMaskLocale,
    getDateMaskLocale,
    getLocaleTime,
    getLocaleDate
} from "./DatePickerHelper";

describe("DatePicker Helper function tests", () => {
    it("should return a date-fns locale object", () => {
        const enLocale = localeSelector("en-US");
        const deLocale = localeSelector("de-DE");
        const frLocale = localeSelector("fr-FR");
        const jaLocale = localeSelector("ja-JP");
        const defaultLocale = localeSelector("anything");

        expect(enLocale.code).toEqual("en-US");
        expect(deLocale.code).toEqual("de");
        expect(frLocale.code).toEqual("fr");
        expect(jaLocale.code).toEqual("ja");
        expect(defaultLocale.code).toEqual("en-US");
    });

    it("should get the correct placeholder date text", () => {
        const enPlaceholder = getPlaceholderDate("en-US");
        const dePlaceholder = getPlaceholderDate("de-DE");
        const frPlaceholder = getPlaceholderDate("fr-FR");
        const jaPlaceholder = getPlaceholderDate("ja-JP");
        const defaultPlaceholder = getPlaceholderDate("anything");

        expect(enPlaceholder).toEqual("MM/DD/YYYY");
        expect(dePlaceholder).toEqual("DD.MM.YYYY");
        expect(frPlaceholder).toEqual("DD/MM/YYYY");
        expect(jaPlaceholder).toEqual("YYYY/MM/DD");
        expect(defaultPlaceholder).toEqual("MM/DD/YYYY");
    });

    it("should get the correct placeholder time text", () => {
        const enPlaceholder = getPlaceholderTime("en-US");
        const dePlaceholder = getPlaceholderTime("de-DE");
        const frPlaceholder = getPlaceholderTime("fr-FR");
        const jaPlaceholder = getPlaceholderTime("ja-JP");
        const defaultPlaceholder = getPlaceholderTime("anything");

        expect(enPlaceholder).toEqual("12:00 AM");
        expect(dePlaceholder).toEqual("00:00");
        expect(frPlaceholder).toEqual("00:00");
        expect(jaPlaceholder).toEqual("00:00");
        expect(defaultPlaceholder).toEqual("12:00 AM");
    });

    it("should get the correct time mask regex function", () => {
        const enTimeMask = getTimeMaskLocale("en-US");
        const deTimeMask = getTimeMaskLocale("de-DE");
        const frTimeMask = getTimeMaskLocale("fr-FR");
        const jaTimeMask = getTimeMaskLocale("ja-JP");
        const defaultTimeMask = getTimeMaskLocale("anything");

        expect(enTimeMask("0")).toEqual([/[0]/, /[0-9]/, ":", /[0-5]/, /[0-9]/, " ", /^[apAP]/, /^[mM]/]);
        expect(enTimeMask("1")).toEqual([/[1]/, /[0-2]/, ":", /[0-5]/, /[0-9]/, " ", /^[apAP]/, /^[mM]/]);
        expect(deTimeMask("2")).toEqual([/[2]/, /[0-4]/, ":", /[0-5]/, /[0-9]/]);
        expect(deTimeMask("1")).toEqual([/[0-2]/, /[0-9]/, ":", /[0-5]/, /[0-9]/]);
        expect(frTimeMask).toEqual(deTimeMask);
        expect(frTimeMask).toEqual(jaTimeMask);
        expect(enTimeMask).toEqual(defaultTimeMask);
    });

    it("should get the correct date mask regex function", () => {
        const enDateMask = getDateMaskLocale("en-US");
        const deDateMask = getDateMaskLocale("de-DE");
        const frDateMask = getDateMaskLocale("fr-FR");
        const jaDateMask = getDateMaskLocale("ja-JP");
        const defaultDateMask = getDateMaskLocale("anything");

        expect(enDateMask("0")).toEqual([/[0-1]/, /[0-9]/, "/", /[0-3]/, /[0-9]/, "/", /\d/, /\d/, /\d/, /\d/]);
        expect(enDateMask("1")).toEqual([/[0-1]/, /[0-2]/, "/", /[0-3]/, /[0-9]/, "/", /\d/, /\d/, /\d/, /\d/]);
        expect(enDateMask("12/3")).toEqual([/[0-1]/, /[0-2]/, "/", /[0-3]/, /[0-1]/, "/", /\d/, /\d/, /\d/, /\d/]);

        expect(frDateMask("0")).toEqual([/[0-3]/, /[0-9]/, "/", /[0-1]/, /[0-9]/, "/", /\d/, /\d/, /\d/, /\d/]);
        expect(frDateMask("3")).toEqual([/[0-3]/, /[0-1]/, "/", /[0-1]/, /[0-9]/, "/", /\d/, /\d/, /\d/, /\d/]);
        expect(frDateMask("30/1")).toEqual([/[0-3]/, /[0-1]/, "/", /[0-1]/, /[0-2]/, "/", /\d/, /\d/, /\d/, /\d/]);

        expect(deDateMask("0")).toEqual([/[0-3]/, /[0-9]/, ".", /[0-1]/, /[0-9]/, ".", /\d/, /\d/, /\d/, /\d/]);
        expect(deDateMask("3")).toEqual([/[0-3]/, /[0-1]/, ".", /[0-1]/, /[0-9]/, ".", /\d/, /\d/, /\d/, /\d/]);
        expect(deDateMask("30.1")).toEqual([/[0-3]/, /[0-1]/, ".", /[0-1]/, /[0-2]/, ".", /\d/, /\d/, /\d/, /\d/]);

        expect(jaDateMask("2021/0")).toEqual([/\d/, /\d/, /\d/, /\d/, "/", /[0-1]/, /[0-9]/, "/", /[0-3]/, /[0-9]/]);
        expect(jaDateMask("2021/1")).toEqual([/\d/, /\d/, /\d/, /\d/, "/", /[0-1]/, /[0-2]/, "/", /[0-3]/, /[0-9]/]);
        expect(jaDateMask("2021/12/3")).toEqual([/\d/, /\d/, /\d/, /\d/, "/", /[0-1]/, /[0-2]/, "/", /[0-3]/, /[0-1]/]);

        expect(enDateMask).toEqual(defaultDateMask);
    });

    it("should get a time locale format", () => {
        const enLocale = getLocaleTime("en-US");
        const deLocale = getLocaleTime("de-DE");
        const frLocale = getLocaleTime("fr-FR");
        const jaLocale = getLocaleTime("ja-JP");
        const defaultLocale = getLocaleTime("default");

        expect(enLocale).toEqual("hh:mm a");
        expect(defaultLocale).toEqual(enLocale);
        expect(deLocale).toEqual("HH:mm");
        expect(frLocale).toEqual("HH:mm");
        expect(jaLocale).toEqual("HH:mm");
    });

    it("should get a date locale format", () => {
        const enLocale = getLocaleDate("en-US");

        expect(enLocale).toEqual("MM/dd/yyyy");
    });
});
````

````typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react";
import DateRangePicker, { type DateRangePickerProps } from "./DateRangePicker";

export default {
    title: "Molecules/DateRangePicker",
    component: DateRangePicker,
    argTypes: {}
} satisfies Meta<typeof DateRangePicker>;

type Story = StoryObj<typeof DateRangePicker>;

const Template = (args: DateRangePickerProps) => {
    const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState<Date | undefined>();
    const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState<Date | undefined>();
    const [hasTime, setHasTime] = useState(args.hasTime);
    const onChange = (dates: [Date | null, Date | null]) => {
        const [start, end] = dates;
        setStartDate(start || undefined);
        setEndDate(end || undefined);
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        if (args.hasTime || args.hasTime === false) {
            setHasTime(args.hasTime);
        }
    }, [args.hasTime]);

    return <DateRangePicker {...args} startDate={startDate} endDate={endDate} onChange={onChange} hasTime={hasTime} />;
};

const TemplateWidthWrap = (args: DateRangePickerProps) => {
    const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState<Date | undefined>();
    const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState<Date | undefined>();
    const [hasTime, setHasTime] = useState(args.hasTime);
    const onChange = (dates: [Date | null, Date | null]) => {
        const [start, end] = dates;
        setStartDate(start || undefined);
        setEndDate(end || undefined);
    };

    useEffect(() => {
        if (args.hasTime || args.hasTime === false) {
            setHasTime(args.hasTime);
        }
    }, [args.hasTime]);

    return (
        <div style={{ width: "50%" }}>
            <DateRangePicker {...args} startDate={startDate} endDate={endDate} onChange={onChange} hasTime={hasTime} />
            <span>Parent is width: 50%</span>
        </div>
    );
};

export const Default: Story = {
    render: Template,
    args: {
        locale: "en-US"
    }
};

export const WithWidthSize: Story = {
    render: TemplateWidthWrap,
    args: {
        locale: "en-US",
        textboxWidth: "100%"
    }
};

const TemplateDisabledDatesWrap = (args: DateRangePickerProps) => {
    const [startDate, setStartDate] = useState<Date | undefined>();
    const [endDate, setEndDate] = useState<Date | undefined>();
    const [hasTime, setHasTime] = useState(args.hasTime);

    const onChange = (dates: [Date | null, Date | null]) => {
        const [start, end] = dates;
        setStartDate(start || undefined);
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useState, useContext } from "react";
import Picker from "react-datepicker";
import "@molecules/DatePicker/BaseDatePickerStyle.css";
import { isDayDisabled, type DayDisabledOptions } from "@utils/DateUtils";
import { DateRangePickerContext, DateRangePickerContextProvider } from "./DateRangePickerContext";
import { localeSelector, type SupportedLocale } from "@molecules/DatePicker/DatePickerHelper";
import DateRangePickerTextbox from "./DateRangePickerTextbox";
import DateRangePickerCalendarRightPanel from "./DateRangePickerCalendarRightPanel";
import { PickerHeader, PickerDay } from "@molecules/DatePicker/DatePickerCalendarBlocks";
import { StyledDatePicker, CalendarWrapperTop, CalendarChildrenWrap } from "@molecules/DatePicker/DatePickerStyle";

export const DEFAULT_LOCALE_TEXTS = {
    INVALID_DATE: "Invalid date selection",
    INVALID_TIME: "Invalid time range",
    APPLY: "Apply",
    CLEAR: "Clear",
    START_DATE_TIME: "Start Date and Time",
    END_DATE_TIME: "End Date and Time",
    START_DATE: "Start Date",
    END_DATE: "End Date",
    SELECT_DATE: "Select a date",
    SELECT_DATE_TIME: "Select a date and time range"
} as const;

export type DateRangeLocaleTexts = Partial<typeof DEFAULT_LOCALE_TEXTS>;

export type DateRangePickerProps = {
    /** start date of range picker */
    startDate?: Date;
    /** end date of range picker */
    endDate?: Date;
    /** callback for when dates change on apply */
    onChange?: (dates: [Date | null, Date | null]) => void;
    /** locale type */
    locale?: SupportedLocale;
    /** does the picker have time included? */
    hasTime?: boolean;
    /** locale text overwrites for defaults */
    localeTexts?: DateRangeLocaleTexts;
    /** the initial textbox range width */
    textboxWidth?: string;
    /** used for double calendar view */
    isDouble?: boolean;
    /** Minimum date that the user can select */
    minDate?: Date;
    /** Maximum date that the user can select */
    maxDate?: Date;
    /** Dates to exclude/disable */
    excludeDates?: Date[];
    /** Dates to include/enable */
    includeDates?: Date[];
    /** Function to filter dates to include when disabling dates */
    filterDate?: (date: Date | null) => boolean;
    /** data track action */
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const DateRangePicker = ({
    startDate,
    endDate,
    onChange,
    locale,
    hasTime,
    localeTexts = {},
    textboxWidth,
    isDouble,
    minDate,
    maxDate,
    excludeDates,
    includeDates,
    filterDate,
    dataTrackAction,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: DateRangePickerProps) => {
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

    const _localeTextOverwrites = { ...DEFAULT_LOCALE_TEXTS, ...localeTexts };
    return (
        <DateRangePickerContextProvider
            startDate={startDate}
            endDate={endDate}
            locale={locale}
            hasTime={hasTime}
            minDate={minDate}
            maxDate={maxDate}
            dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction}
        >
            <StyledDatePicker $textboxWidth={textboxWidth} $hasTime={hasTime} $isOpen={isOpen}>
                <BaseDateRangePicker
                    data-testid={dataTestId}
                    initialStart={startDate}
                    initialEnd={endDate}
                    onChange={onChange}
                    locale={locale}
                    hasTime={hasTime}
                    isDouble={isDouble}
                    localeTexts={_localeTextOverwrites}
                    textboxWidth={textboxWidth}
                    minDate={minDate}
                    maxDate={maxDate}
                    excludeDates={excludeDates}
                    includeDates={includeDates}
                    filterDate={filterDate}
                    isOpen={isOpen}
                    setIsOpen={setIsOpen}
                />
            </StyledDatePicker>
        </DateRangePickerContextProvider>
    );
};

type BaseDateRangePickerProps = {
    initialStart?: Date;
    initialEnd?: Date;
    onChange?: (dates: [Date | null, Date | null]) => void;
    locale?: SupportedLocale;
    hasTime?: boolean;
    isDouble?: boolean;
    localeTexts: typeof DEFAULT_LOCALE_TEXTS;
    textboxWidth?: string;
    minDate?: Date;
    maxDate?: Date;
    excludeDates?: Date[];
    includeDates?: Date[];
    filterDate?: (date: Date | null) => boolean;
    isOpen: boolean;
    setIsOpen: (open: boolean) => void;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const BaseDateRangePicker = ({
    initialStart,
    initialEnd,
    onChange,
    localeTexts,
    textboxWidth,
    minDate,
    maxDate,
    excludeDates,
    includeDates,
    filterDate,
    isOpen,
    setIsOpen,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: BaseDateRangePickerProps) => {
    const { startDate, endDate, dispatch, hasTime, locale } = useContext(DateRangePickerContext);

    const onPickerChange = useCallback(
        (dates: Date | [Date | null, Date | null]) => {
            // When selectsRange is true, dates will be an array
            if (!Array.isArray(dates)) return;

            const [start, end] = dates;

            dispatch({ type: "UpdateStartDate", value: start });
            if (end) {
                dispatch({ type: "UpdateEndDate", value: end });
            } else {
                dispatch({ type: "UpdateEndDate", value: null });
            }
        },
        [dispatch]
    );

    //validated, now pass values back to onchange
    const onApply = useCallback(() => {
        if (typeof onChange === "function") {
            onChange([startDate, endDate]);
        }

        setIsOpen(false);
    }, [startDate, endDate, setIsOpen, onChange]);

    /* istanbul ignore next */
    // the onClickOutside for the library doesn't act the way that can be used for RTL
    // apply was not hit, reset to intiial date passed in
    const onClickOutside = useCallback(() => {
        setIsOpen(false);
        dispatch({ type: "UpdateStartDate", value: initialStart ?? null });
        dispatch({ type: "UpdateEndDate", value: initialEnd ?? null });
    }, [dispatch, setIsOpen, initialStart, initialEnd]);

    // need to inject onApply
    const CalendarContainer = useCallback(
        (props: { children: React.ReactNode; className?: string }) => {
            const { children, className } = props;
            return (
                <CalendarWrapper
                    data-testid={dataTestId}
                    className={className}
                    hasTime={hasTime}
                    onApply={onApply}
                    localeTexts={localeTexts}
                >
                    {children}
                </CalendarWrapper>
            );
        },
        [hasTime, dataTestId, onApply, localeTexts]
    );

    //need to inject locale
    const PickerHeaderWrapper = useCallback(
        (props: any) => <PickerHeader {...props} data-testid={dataTestId} locale={locale} />,
        [locale, dataTestId]
    );

    const PickerDayWrapper = useCallback(
        (day: number, date: Date) => (
            <PickerDay
                day={day}
                disabled={isDayDisabled(date, { minDate, maxDate, excludeDates, includeDates, filterDate })}
                data-testid={dataTestId}
            />
        ),
        [dataTestId, minDate, maxDate, excludeDates, includeDates, filterDate]
    );

    return (
        <Picker
            selectsRange
            selected={startDate}
            startDate={startDate}
            onChange={onPickerChange}
            endDate={endDate}
            showPopperArrow={false}
            locale={localeSelector(locale)}
            renderCustomHeader={PickerHeaderWrapper}
            renderDayContents={PickerDayWrapper}
            minDate={minDate}
            maxDate={maxDate}
            excludeDates={excludeDates}
            includeDates={includeDates}
            filterDate={filterDate}
            customInput={
                <DateRangePickerTextbox
                    width={textboxWidth}
                    initialStart={initialStart}
                    initialEnd={initialEnd}
                    setIsOpen={setIsOpen}
                    isOpen={isOpen}
                    localeTexts={localeTexts}
                    data-testid={dataTestId}
                />
            }
            shouldCloseOnSelect={false}
            open={isOpen}
            onClickOutside={onClickOutside}
            openToDate={startDate}
            calendarContainer={CalendarContainer}
        />
    );
};

type CalendarWrapperProps = {
    className?: string;
    children: React.ReactNode;
    hasTime?: boolean;
    onApply: () => void;
    localeTexts: typeof DEFAULT_LOCALE_TEXTS;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const CalendarWrapper = ({
    className,
    children,
    onApply,
    localeTexts,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: CalendarWrapperProps) => {
    return (
        <CalendarWrapperTop>
            <div className={className}>
                <CalendarChildrenWrap>{children}</CalendarChildrenWrap>
            </div>
            <DateRangePickerCalendarRightPanel data-testid={dataTestId} onApply={onApply} localeTexts={localeTexts} />
        </CalendarWrapperTop>
    );
};

export default DateRangePicker;
````

````typescript
import React, { useState, useContext } from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import Button from "@atoms/button/Button";
import { DateRangePickerContext } from "./DateRangePickerContext";
import DateRangePickerDateTimeBlock from "./DateRangePickerDateTimeBlock";
import { GRAY_100, RED_400, WHITE_200 } from "@css/constants";

type DateRangeLocaleTexts = {
    APPLY: string;
    CLEAR: string;
    END_DATE: string;
    END_DATE_TIME: string;
    INVALID_DATE: string;
    INVALID_TIME: string;
    SELECT_DATE: string;
    SELECT_DATE_TIME: string;
    START_DATE: string;
    START_DATE_TIME: string;
};

export type DateRangePickerCalendarRightPanelProps = {
    "data-testid"?: string;
    localeTexts: DateRangeLocaleTexts;
    onApply?: () => void;
};

const DateRangePickerCalendarRightPanel: React.FC<DateRangePickerCalendarRightPanelProps> = ({
    localeTexts,
    onApply,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}) => {
    const { startDate, endDate, hasTime, dispatch, minDate, maxDate, dataTrackAction } =
        useContext(DateRangePickerContext);
    const [isInvalidDate, setIsInvalidDate] = useState(false);
    const [isInvalidTime, setIsInvalidTime] = useState(false);

    const _handleOnApplyClick = () => {
        if (!startDate && !endDate) {
            // allow user to clear the values & apply
            onApply?.();
            return;
        }
        if (!startDate || !endDate) {
            setIsInvalidDate(true);
            return;
        }
        if (startDate.getTime() > endDate.getTime()) {
            if (
                hasTime &&
                startDate.getFullYear() === endDate.getFullYear() &&
                startDate.getMonth() === endDate.getMonth() &&
                startDate.getDate() === endDate.getDate()
            ) {
                // time ranges are invalid
                setIsInvalidTime(true);
                return;
            }

            // date ranges are invalid
            setIsInvalidDate(true);
            return;
        }
        if (minDate && startDate < minDate) {
            setIsInvalidDate(true);
            return;
        }
        if (maxDate && startDate > maxDate) {
            setIsInvalidDate(true);
            return;
        }
        if (maxDate && endDate > maxDate) {
            setIsInvalidDate(true);
            return;
        }
        // default to false/clear states
        setIsInvalidTime(false);
        setIsInvalidDate(false);
        onApply?.();
    };

    const _handleOnClearClick = () => {
        dispatch({ type: "UpdateStartDate", value: null });
        dispatch({ type: "UpdateEndDate", value: null });
    };

    return (
        <RangeStartEndWrapper>
            <DateRangePickerDateTimeBlock
                hasTime={hasTime}
                isInvalidDate={isInvalidDate}
                isInvalidTime={isInvalidTime}
                dateValue={startDate}
                localeTexts={localeTexts}
                data-testid={dataTestId}
            />
            <DateRangePickerDateTimeBlock
                isEnd
                hasTime={hasTime}
                isInvalidDate={isInvalidDate}
                isInvalidTime={isInvalidTime}
                dateValue={endDate}
                localeTexts={localeTexts}
                data-testid={dataTestId}
            />
            <ApplyErrorTopWrapper>
                <ErrorTopWrap>
                    {(isInvalidDate || isInvalidTime) && <i className="fas fa-exclamation-triangle" />}
                    <ErrorMessageWrap>
                        {isInvalidDate && localeTexts.INVALID_DATE}
                        {isInvalidTime && localeTexts.INVALID_TIME}
                    </ErrorMessageWrap>
                </ErrorTopWrap>
                <ButtonWrap>
                    <Button
                        data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-clear-btn`}
                        small
                        type="border"
                        onClick={_handleOnClearClick}
                        dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction && `${dataTrackAction}-clear-button`}
                    >
                        {localeTexts.CLEAR}
                    </Button>
                    <ApplyWrap>
                        <Button
                            data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-apply-btn`}
                            small
                            type="primary"
                            onClick={_handleOnApplyClick}
                            dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction && `${dataTrackAction}-apply-button`}
                        >
                            {localeTexts.APPLY}
                        </Button>
                    </ApplyWrap>
                </ButtonWrap>
            </ApplyErrorTopWrapper>
        </RangeStartEndWrapper>
    );
};

const ErrorMessageWrap = styled("span")`
    padding-left: 5px;
`;

const ButtonWrap = styled("div")`
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    padding-top: 4px;
`;

const ApplyWrap = styled("div")`
    padding-left: 10px;
`;

const ErrorTopWrap = styled("div")`
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: ${RED_400};
`;

const ApplyErrorTopWrapper = styled("div")`
    padding-top: 3px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
`;

const RangeStartEndWrapper = styled("div")`
    background-color: ${WHITE_200};
    font-family: proxima-nova, Proxima, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    border: 1px solid ${GRAY_100};
    box-sizing: content-box;
    padding: 12px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    min-width: 200px;
`;

export default DateRangePickerCalendarRightPanel;
````

````typescript
import React, { useEffect, useMemo, useReducer } from "react";
import { isValidDate } from "./DateRangePickerHelpers";

type DateRangePickerState = {
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    endDate: Date | null;
    hasTime: boolean;
    locale: string;
    maxDate: Date | null;
    minDate: Date | null;
    startDate: Date | null;
};

type UpdateStartDateAction = { type: "UpdateStartDate"; value: Date | null };
type UpdateEndDateAction = { type: "UpdateEndDate"; value: Date | null };
type UpdateLocaleAction = { type: "UpdateLocale"; value: string };
type UpdateHasTimeAction = { type: "UpdateHasTime"; value: boolean };

export type DateRangePickerAction =
    | UpdateStartDateAction
    | UpdateEndDateAction
    | UpdateLocaleAction
    | UpdateHasTimeAction;

export type DateRangePickerContextValue = DateRangePickerState & {
    dispatch: React.Dispatch<DateRangePickerAction>;
};

export const DateRangePickerContext = React.createContext<DateRangePickerContextValue | undefined>(
    undefined
) as React.Context<DateRangePickerContextValue>;

type InitialStateParams = {
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    endDate?: Date;
    hasTime?: boolean;
    locale?: string;
    maxDate?: Date;
    minDate?: Date;
    startDate?: Date;
};

const initialStateDateRange = ({
    startDate,
    endDate,
    locale,
    hasTime,
    minDate,
    maxDate,
    dataTrackAction
}: InitialStateParams): DateRangePickerState => {
    return {
        startDate: startDate ? startDate : null,
        endDate: endDate ? endDate : null,
        locale: locale ? locale : "en-US",
        hasTime: hasTime ? hasTime : false,
        minDate: isValidDate(minDate) ? (minDate as Date) : null,
        maxDate: isValidDate(maxDate) ? (maxDate as Date) : null,
        dataTrackAction
    };
};

const dateRangeReducer = (state: DateRangePickerState, action: DateRangePickerAction): DateRangePickerState => {
    switch (action.type) {
        case "UpdateStartDate":
            return { ...state, startDate: action.value };
        case "UpdateEndDate":
            return { ...state, endDate: action.value };
        case "UpdateLocale":
            return { ...state, locale: action.value };
        case "UpdateHasTime":
            return { ...state, hasTime: action.value };
        default:
            return state;
    }
};

export type DateRangePickerContextProviderProps = {
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    endDate?: Date;
    hasTime?: boolean;
    locale?: string;
    maxDate?: Date;
    minDate?: Date;
    startDate?: Date;
};

export const DateRangePickerContextProvider: React.FC<DateRangePickerContextProviderProps> = ({
    startDate,
    endDate,
    locale,
    hasTime,
    children,
    minDate,
    maxDate,
    dataTrackAction
}) => {
    const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(
        dateRangeReducer,
        initialStateDateRange({ startDate, endDate, locale, hasTime, minDate, maxDate, dataTrackAction })
    );

    useEffect(() => {
        dispatch({ type: "UpdateStartDate", value: startDate ?? null });
        dispatch({ type: "UpdateEndDate", value: endDate ?? null });
    }, [startDate, endDate]);

    useEffect(() => {
        dispatch({ type: "UpdateHasTime", value: hasTime ? hasTime : false });
    }, [hasTime]);

    useEffect(() => {
        dispatch({ type: "UpdateLocale", value: locale ? locale : "en-US" });
    }, [locale]);

    const values = useMemo(() => {
        return {
            startDate: state.startDate,
            endDate: state.endDate,
            locale: state.locale,
            hasTime: state.hasTime,
            minDate: state.minDate,
            maxDate: state.maxDate,
            dataTrackAction: state.dataTrackAction,
            dispatch
        };
    }, [state, dispatch]);

    return <DateRangePickerContext.Provider value={values}>{children}</DateRangePickerContext.Provider>;
};
````

## File: src/components/molecules/DateRangePicker/DateRangePickerHelpers.ts
````typescript
import { isValid } from "date-fns";

type DateRangeLocaleTexts = {
    END_DATE: string;
    END_DATE_TIME: string;
    START_DATE: string;
    START_DATE_TIME: string;
};

export const getDateRangePickerDateTimeBlockLabel = (
    hasTime: boolean,
    isEnd: boolean,
    localeTexts: DateRangeLocaleTexts
) =>
    hasTime
        ? isEnd
            ? localeTexts.END_DATE_TIME
            : localeTexts.START_DATE_TIME
        : isEnd
        ? localeTexts.END_DATE
        : localeTexts.START_DATE;

export const getChangeUpdateType = (isEnd: boolean) => (isEnd ? "UpdateEndDate" : "UpdateStartDate");

export const isValidDate = (date: unknown) => {
    if (!date) return false;
    return date instanceof Date && isValid(date);
};
````

````typescript
import React, { useState, useRef } from "react";
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react";
import useEventListener from "@hooks/useEventListener";
import Dropzone, { type DropzoneProps } from "./Dropzone";
import Button from "@atoms/button/Button";

export default {
    title: "Molecules/Dropzone",
    component: Dropzone,
    argTypes: {}
} satisfies Meta<typeof Dropzone>;

type Story = StoryObj<typeof Dropzone>;

const Template = (args: DropzoneProps) => {
    const [file, setFile] = useState<File | null>(null);

    return (
        <div style={{ textAlign: "center", width: "35%" }}>
            <Dropzone {...args} onFileChange={f => setFile(f as File)}>
                <p style={{ minHeight: "150px" }}>{file && file.name}</p>
            </Dropzone>
        </div>
    );
};

export const Default: Story = {
    render: Template,
    args: {}
};

export const WithFileClear: Story = {
    render: (args: DropzoneProps) => {
        const [currentFile, setCurrentFile] = useState<File | null>(null);
        const fileInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

        const getFiles = (event: Event) => {
            const target = event.target as HTMLInputElement;
            if (target.files && target.files[0]) {
                setCurrentFile(target.files[0]);
            }
        };

        useEventListener("change", getFiles);

        const handleChooseFileClick = () => {
            fileInputRef.current?.click();
        };

        const handleFileChange = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
            const file = event.target.files?.[0];
            if (file) {
                setCurrentFile(file);
            }
        };

        return (
            <div style={{ textAlign: "center", width: "35%" }}>
                <Dropzone {...args} onFileChange={f => setCurrentFile(f as File)}>
                    <div style={{ minHeight: "150px" }}>
                        {!currentFile ? (
                            <>
                                <h2>Upload a Sample File</h2>
                                <p>Drag & Drop a file here</p>
                                <p>or</p>
                                <Button
                                    type="borderless"
                                    onClick={handleChooseFileClick}
                                    attrProps={{ "aria-label": "Choose a file" }}
                                >
                                    Choose a file...
                                </Button>
                                <input
                                    ref={fileInputRef}
                                    type="file"
                                    style={{ display: "none" }}
                                    onChange={handleFileChange}
                                />
                            </>
                        ) : (
                            <>
                                <p>
                                    <b>Currently Selected File: </b>
                                    {currentFile && currentFile.name}
                                    <Button
                                        type="borderless"
                                        onClick={() => setCurrentFile(null)}
                                        attrProps={{ "aria-label": "Remove file" }}
                                    >
                                        Remove
                                    </Button>
                                </p>
                            </>
                        )}
                    </div>
                </Dropzone>
            </div>
        );
    }
};
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import useDragDropHandler from "@hooks/useDragDropHandler";
import { BASICS_WHITE, BLUE_400, BLUE_50, BLUE_700, GRAY_400 } from "@css/constants";

export type DropzoneProps = {
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    "data-testid"?: string;
    onFileChange?: (file: File | FileList) => void;
};

const Dropzone: React.FC<DropzoneProps> = ({ onFileChange = () => {}, children, "data-testid": dataTestId }) => {
    const dragDropHandlers = useDragDropHandler();

    const handleOnDrop = (event: React.DragEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        dragDropHandlers.onDrop(event);
        onFileChange(event.dataTransfer.files.length === 1 ? event.dataTransfer.files[0] : event.dataTransfer.files);
    };
    return (
        <DragAndDropDiv {...dragDropHandlers} onDrop={handleOnDrop} data-testid={dataTestId}>
            {children}
        </DragAndDropDiv>
    );
};

const DragAndDropDiv: React.ComponentType<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> = styled("div")`
    border: 1px dashed ${GRAY_400};
    padding: 2rem;
    background-color: ${BASICS_WHITE};
    border-radius: 0.5rem;

    &:hover {
        background-color: ${BLUE_50};
        border-color: ${BLUE_400};
        color: ${BLUE_700};
        cursor: pointer;
    }
` as any;

export default Dropzone;
````

## File: src/components/molecules/EmailInput/EmailInput.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useState, useCallback, useMemo, useEffect } from "react";
import TokenInput from "@molecules/TokenInput/TokenInput";

const EMAIL_REGEX = /^[^@]{1,64}@[^@.]+\.[^@]+$/i;

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
    return typeof value === "object" && value !== null && !Array.isArray(value);
}

type ErrorToken = {
    token: string;
    tooltip?: React.ReactNode;
};

export type EmailInputProps = {
    autoComplete?: string;
    "data-testid"?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    disableInput?: boolean;
    error?: boolean;
    errorHelperText?: string;
    errorTokens?: ErrorToken[];
    helperText?: string;
    id?: string;
    inputProps?: unknown;
    invalidEmailText?: string;
    maxEntries?: number;
    maxEntriesErrorText?: string;
    maxLength?: number;
    onChange?: (tokens: string[]) => void;
    onInputChange?: (value: string) => void;
    onValidation?: (invalidEmails: ErrorToken[]) => void;
    placeholder?: string;
    value?: string[];
    width?: string | number;
};

export const EmailInput = ({
    id,
    autoComplete,
    disabled,
    disableInput,
    error,
    errorHelperText,
    errorTokens = [],
    helperText,
    invalidEmailText,
    maxEntries,
    maxEntriesErrorText,
    maxLength,
    onChange,
    onInputChange,
    onValidation,
    placeholder,
    value = [],
    width,
    inputProps,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: EmailInputProps) => {
    const [inputValue, setInputValue] = useState("");

    const invalidEmails = useMemo(() => {
        const invalidEmails: ErrorToken[] = [];
        value.forEach(e => {
            if (!EMAIL_REGEX.test(e)) {
                invalidEmails.push({ token: e, tooltip: invalidEmailText });
            }
        });

        return [...invalidEmails, ...errorTokens.filter(e => value.includes(e.token))];
    }, [value, errorTokens, invalidEmailText]);

    useEffect(() => {
        onValidation && onValidation(invalidEmails);
    }, [invalidEmails, onValidation]);

    // allow comma, space or semicolon seperated emails to be entered
    const handleInputChange = useCallback(
        (inputValue: string) => {
            onInputChange && onInputChange(inputValue);
            const options = inputValue.split(/[\s;,]+/);

            if (options.length > 1) {
                // remove duplicates (case insensitive)
                const newEmails = options.map(e => e.trim()).filter(e => e);
                const uniqueEmails = Object.fromEntries([...value, ...newEmails].map(e => [e.toLowerCase(), e]));
                const newValue = Object.values(uniqueEmails);

                onChange && onChange(newValue);
            } else {
                setInputValue(inputValue);
            }
        },
        [onChange, onInputChange, value]
    );

    const hasError = invalidEmails.length > 0 || error;

    return (
        <TokenInput
            id={id}
            value={value}
            onChange={onChange}
            onInputChange={handleInputChange}
            placeholder={placeholder}
            width={width}
            error={hasError}
            errorHelperText={errorHelperText}
            errorTokens={invalidEmails}
            helperText={helperText}
            inputValue={inputValue}
            disabled={disabled}
            disableInput={disableInput}
            autoComplete={autoComplete}
            maxEntries={maxEntries}
            maxEntriesErrorText={maxEntriesErrorText}
            maxLength={maxLength}
            ignoreCase={true}
            inputProps={isRecord(inputProps) ? inputProps : undefined}
            data-testid={dataTestId}
        />
    );
};

export default EmailInput;
````

````typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react";
import { FileUploader, FileUploaderProps } from "./FileUploader";

export default {
    title: "Molecules/FileUploader",
    component: FileUploader
} satisfies Meta<typeof FileUploader>;

type Story = StoryObj<typeof FileUploader>;

const Template = (args: FileUploaderProps) => {
    return <FileUploader {...args} />;
};

type UploadedFileData = {
    fileName: string;
    error: string;
};

type FileError = {
    file: File;
    errors: Array<{ errorMessage: string }>;
};

const FunctionalTemplate = (args: FileUploaderProps) => {
    const [uploadResults, setUploadResults] = useState<UploadedFileData[]>([]);
    const [successes, setSuccesses] = useState<UploadedFileData[]>([]);
    const [errors, setErrors] = useState<UploadedFileData[]>([]);

    function onFileUpload(files: File | File[]) {
        if (files) {
            const file = Array.isArray(files) ? files : [files];
            const fileArr = file.map(file => {
                return { fileName: file.name, error: "" };
            });
            setSuccesses(fileArr);
        } else {
            setSuccesses([]);
        }
    }

    function onFileError(errors: FileError | FileError[]) {
        if (errors) {
            const err = Array.isArray(errors) ? errors : [errors];
            const fileArr = err.map(error => {
                const errorMsg = error.errors.reduce((prev: string, curr) => {
                    return prev ? ` ${curr.errorMessage}${prev}` : curr.errorMessage;
                }, "");
                return { fileName: error.file.name, error: errorMsg };
            });
            setErrors(fileArr);
        } else {
            setErrors([]);
        }
    }

    useEffect(() => {
        setUploadResults([...successes, ...errors]);
    }, [successes, errors]);

    function onFileRemove(result: string) {
        if (uploadResults.length) {
            setErrors(errors.filter(file => file.fileName !== result));
            setSuccesses(successes.filter(file => file.fileName !== result));
        }
    }

    return (
        <FileUploader
            {...args}
            onFileUpload={onFileUpload}
            onError={onFileError}
            onFileRemove={onFileRemove}
            uploadedFilesData={uploadResults}
        />
    );
};

const COMMON_ARGS: FileUploaderProps = {
    formFieldAccessoryProps: {
        title: "Upload file",
        isRequired: true
    },
    uploadHelperProps: {
        helperText: `File restrictions are set in the 'controls' section`
    },
    uploadButtonProps: {
        dataTrackAction: "some_product_tracking_string"
    }
};

export const Default: Story = {
    render: FunctionalTemplate,
    args: { ...COMMON_ARGS }
};

export const UploadedFile: Story = {
    render: Template,
    args: {
        ...COMMON_ARGS,
        uploadedFilesData: { fileName: "test_file.jpg" }
    }
};

export const UploadError: Story = {
    render: Template,
    args: {
        ...COMMON_ARGS,
        uploadHelperProps: {
            error: true,
            errorHelperText: "The file failed to upload. Check the file and try again."
        }
    }
};

export const FileError: Story = {
    render: Template,
    args: {
        ...COMMON_ARGS,
        uploadedFilesData: {
            fileName: "test_file.pdf",
            error: "The file has expired. Upload a different file and try again."
        }
    }
};

export const MultipleFiles: Story = {
    render: Template,
    args: {
        ...COMMON_ARGS,
        uploadedFilesData: [{ fileName: "test_file.pdf" }, { fileName: "file.jpg" }, { fileName: "document.png" }]
    }
};

export const Dropzone: Story = {
    render: FunctionalTemplate,
    args: {
        ...COMMON_ARGS,
        isDropzone: true
    }
};
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import FormFieldAccessory from "@atoms/FormFieldAccessory/FormFieldAccessory";
import FormFieldHelper from "@atoms/FormFieldHelper/FormFieldHelper";
import Button from "@atoms/button/Button";
import FileCard from "@atoms/FileCard/FileCard";
import Dropzone from "@molecules/dropzone/Dropzone";

// eslint-disable-next-line no-useless-escape
const mimeTypeRegexp = /^(application|audio|example|image|message|model|multipart|text|video)\/[a-z0-9\.\+\*-]+$/;
const extRegexp = /\.[a-zA-Z0-9]*$/;

type FileErrorCode = {
    code: number;
    errorMessage: string;
};

const FILE_ERRORS: Record<string, FileErrorCode> = {
    invalidType: { code: 1, errorMessage: "not a valid file type" },
    minFileSize: { code: 2, errorMessage: "does not meet minimum file size" },
    maxFileSize: { code: 3, errorMessage: "exceeds maximum file size" },
    maxFiles: { code: 4, errorMessage: "exceeds maximum file count" }
};

type FileDataWrapper = {
    file: File;
    errors: FileErrorCode[];
};

type UploadedFileData = {
    fileName: string;
    error?: string;
};

export type FileUploaderProps = {
    accept?: string;
    "data-testid"?: string;
    formFieldAccessoryProps?: Record<string, unknown>;
    isDropzone?: boolean;
    maxFileSize?: number;
    maxFiles?: number;
    minFileSize?: number;
    multiple?: boolean;
    onError?: (errors: FileDataWrapper | FileDataWrapper[]) => void;
    onFileRemove?: (fileName: string) => void;
    onFileUpload?: (files: File | File[]) => void;
    onUpload?: (files: File | File[]) => void;
    uploadButtonLabel?: string;
    uploadButtonProps?: {
        dataTrackAction?: string;
        disabled?: boolean;
        label?: string;
    };
    uploadHelperProps?: Record<string, unknown>;
    uploadedFilesData?: UploadedFileData | UploadedFileData[] | null;
};

export const FileUploader = ({
    formFieldAccessoryProps,
    accept,
    maxFileSize,
    minFileSize,
    multiple,
    maxFiles,
    uploadButtonLabel,
    uploadButtonProps,
    uploadHelperProps,
    uploadedFilesData = null,
    onUpload,
    onFileUpload,
    onFileRemove,
    onError,
    isDropzone,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: FileUploaderProps) => {
    const acceptArray = accept
        ?.trim()
        .split(",")
        .map(ext => ext.trim());

    const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);

    const openFilePicker = useCallback(() => {
        if (inputRef.current) {
            inputRef.current.value = "";
            inputRef.current.click();
        }
    }, []);

    function mimeTypeLeft(mime: string) {
        return mime.split("/")[0];
    }

    function mimeTypeRight(mime: string) {
        return mime.split("/")[1];
    }

    const verifyFiles = useCallback(
        (files: File[] | FileList) => {
            function isFileTypeAcceptable(file: File) {
                if (!acceptArray) {
                    return true;
                }
                const fileExtension = file.name.split(".").pop();
                //Correct File upload for Windows on Chrome.
                if (fileExtension === "csv" && file.type === "") {
                    const newFile = { ...file };
                    newFile.type = "text/csv";
                    file = newFile as File;
                }

                const result = acceptArray?.some(acceptType => {
                    if (file.type && acceptType.match(mimeTypeRegexp)) {
                        const typeLeft = mimeTypeLeft(file.type);
                        const typeRight = mimeTypeRight(file.type);
                        const acceptLeft = acceptType.split("/")[0];
                        const acceptRight = acceptType.split("/")[1];
                        if (acceptLeft === typeLeft && acceptRight === "*") {
                            return true;
                        }
                        if (acceptLeft === typeLeft && acceptRight === typeRight) {
                            return true;
                        }
                    } else if (fileExtension && acceptType.match(extRegexp)) {
                        const ext = acceptType.substr(1);
                        return fileExtension.toLowerCase() === ext.toLowerCase();
                    }
                    return false;
                });

                return result;
            }

            const processedFiles: File[] = [];
            const errorFiles: FileDataWrapper[] = [];
            for (let i = 0, n = files.length; i < n; i++) {
                const fileDataWrapper: FileDataWrapper = { file: files[i], errors: [] };
                if (maxFiles && processedFiles.length >= maxFiles) {
                    fileDataWrapper.errors.push(FILE_ERRORS.maxFiles);
                }
                if (!isFileTypeAcceptable(fileDataWrapper.file)) {
                    fileDataWrapper.errors.push(FILE_ERRORS.invalidType);
                }
                if (maxFileSize && Number(fileDataWrapper.file.size) / 1000 > maxFileSize) {
                    fileDataWrapper.errors.push(FILE_ERRORS.maxFileSize);
                }
                if (minFileSize && Number(fileDataWrapper.file.size) / 1000 < minFileSize) {
                    fileDataWrapper.errors.push(FILE_ERRORS.minFileSize);
                }
                if (fileDataWrapper.errors.length) {
                    errorFiles.push(fileDataWrapper);
                } else {
                    processedFiles.push(fileDataWrapper.file);
                }
            }
            if (errorFiles.length && onError) {
                if (multiple || !processedFiles.length) {
                    onError(multiple ? errorFiles : errorFiles[0]);
                }
            }
            return processedFiles;
        },
        [maxFiles, maxFileSize, minFileSize, onError, multiple, acceptArray]
    );

    const onFileInputChange = useCallback(
        (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement> | File | FileList) => {
            let files: FileList | File[] =
                (event as React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>).target?.files ||
                (event as FileList | File[] as FileList);
            if ((files as { length?: number }).length === undefined) {
                files = [files as unknown as File];
            }
            if (!files || files.length === 0) {
                return;
            }
            if (files.length > 0) {
                if (onFileUpload) {
                    const verifiedFiles = verifyFiles(files);
                    if (verifiedFiles.length) {
                        onFileUpload(multiple ? verifiedFiles : verifiedFiles[0]);
                    }
                } else if (onUpload) {
                    onUpload(multiple ? Array.from(files) : files[0]);
                    if (process.env.NODE_ENV === "development") {
                        console.warn("onUpload is deprecated. Please use onFileUpload instead.");
                    }
                }
            }
        },
        [onFileUpload, onUpload, multiple, verifyFiles]
    );

    let fileCardSectionElement: React.ReactNode = null;

    if (uploadedFilesData !== null) {
        if (Array.isArray(uploadedFilesData)) {
            if (uploadedFilesData.length > 0) {
                fileCardSectionElement = uploadedFilesData.map(({ fileName, error }) => (
                    <FileCardSection
                        key={fileName}
                        fileName={fileName}
                        error={error}
                        onFileRemove={onFileRemove}
                        data-testid={dataTestId}
                    />
                ));
            }
        } else {
            const { fileName, error } = uploadedFilesData;
            fileCardSectionElement = (
                <FileCardSection
                    fileName={fileName}
                    error={error}
                    onFileRemove={onFileRemove}
                    data-testid={dataTestId}
                />
            );
        }
    }

    return (
        <FormFieldAccessory {...(formFieldAccessoryProps as any)} data-testid={dataTestId}>
            <div>
                {isDropzone ? (
                    <StyledDropzoneContainer>
                        <StyledDropzone onClick={openFilePicker}>
                            <Dropzone onFileChange={onFileInputChange} data-testid={`${dataTestId}_file_dropzone`}>
                                Drag and drop here or click to upload
                            </Dropzone>
                        </StyledDropzone>
                    </StyledDropzoneContainer>
                ) : (
                    <Button {...uploadButtonProps} type="border" attrType="button" onClick={openFilePicker}>
                        <StyledUploadIcon aria-hidden={true} className="fas fa-upload" />{" "}
                        {(uploadButtonProps?.label || uploadButtonLabel) ?? "Upload file"}
                    </Button>
                )}
                <input
                    ref={inputRef}
                    type="file"
                    accept={acceptArray?.join(",")}
                    multiple={multiple}
                    hidden
                    onChange={onFileInputChange}
                    data-testid={`${dataTestId}_file_input`}
                />
            </div>
            <FormFieldHelper {...uploadHelperProps} data-testid={`${dataTestId}_helper`} />
            {fileCardSectionElement}
        </FormFieldAccessory>
    );
};

type FileCardSectionProps = {
    "data-testid"?: string;
    error?: string;
    fileName: string;
    onFileRemove?: (fileName: string) => void;
};

const FileCardSection = ({ fileName, error, onFileRemove, "data-testid": dataTestId }: FileCardSectionProps) => {
    return (
        <StyledFileCardContainer>
            <FileCard
                fileName={fileName}
                hasError={Boolean(error)}
                onRemove={onFileRemove}
                data-testid={`${dataTestId}_file_card`}
            />
            {error && <FormFieldHelper error errorHelperText={error} data-testid={`${dataTestId}_file_card_helper`} />}
        </StyledFileCardContainer>
    );
};

const StyledUploadIcon = styled("span")`
    margin-right: 0.5rem;
    font-size: 0.75rem;
`;

const StyledFileCardContainer = styled("div")`
    margin-top: 1rem;
`;

const StyledDropzoneContainer = styled("div")`
    text-align: center;
`;

const StyledDropzone = styled("div")`
    margin: auto;
    font-weight: bold;
`;

export default FileUploader;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { TRAILING_TYPE } from "../ListItemConstant";
import { type TrailingItem } from "../ListItemPanels/TrailingPanel";
import ActionBadge from "@components/molecules/Card/Actions/ActionBadge";
import ActionButtonGroup from "@components/molecules/Card/Actions/ActionButtonGroup";
import ActionIcons from "@components/molecules/Card/Actions/ActionIcons";
import ActionSwitch from "@components/molecules/Card/Actions/ActionSwitch";
import ActionText from "@components/molecules/Card/Actions/ActionText";
import ActionActionMenuButton from "@components/molecules/Card/Actions/ActionWithActionMenuButton";
import { BadgeProps } from "@atoms/Badge/Badge";
import { ButtonProps } from "@atoms/button/Button";
import { type ActionIconItem } from "@components/molecules/Card/Actions/ActionIcons";
import { SwitchProps } from "@atoms/switch/Switch";

export type TrailingComponentProps = {
    trailing: TrailingItem;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const TrailingComponent: React.FC<TrailingComponentProps> = ({ trailing, "data-testid": dataTestId }) => {
    const { props, type } = trailing;
    switch (type) {
        case TRAILING_TYPE.BADGE:
            return <ActionBadge action={props as BadgeProps} data-testid={dataTestId} />;
        case TRAILING_TYPE.BUTTON_GROUP:
            return <ActionButtonGroup actions={props as unknown as ButtonProps[]} data-testid={dataTestId} />;
        case TRAILING_TYPE.ICON_GROUP:
            return <ActionIcons actions={props as unknown as ActionIconItem[]} data-testid={dataTestId} />;
        case TRAILING_TYPE.SWITCH:
            return <ActionSwitch action={props as SwitchProps} data-testid={dataTestId} />;
        case TRAILING_TYPE.ACTION_MENU_BUTTON:
            return <ActionActionMenuButton action={props as Record<string, unknown>} data-testid={dataTestId} />;
        default:
            return (
                <ActionText
                    action={props as unknown as { text: string } & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>}
                    data-testid={dataTestId}
                />
            );
    }
};

export default TrailingComponent;
````

## File: src/components/molecules/MultiSelect/MultiSelect.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import useAutocomplete from "@mui/material/useAutocomplete";
import { createFilterOptions } from "@mui/material/Autocomplete";
import { MultiSelectWrapper, StyledMultiSelect, StyledPaper, StyledPopper } from "./MultiSelect.styles";
import { renderInput, renderOptionsList, SELECT_ALL } from "./renderComponents";
import ButtonGroupActions from "@components/shared/ButtonGroupActions";

export type SelectOption = {
    label: string;
    value: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    sectionTitle?: string;
};

type BuildAutocompletePropsParams = {
    options: SelectOption[];
    value: SelectOption[];
    handleOnChange: (event: React.SyntheticEvent, selectedOptions: SelectOption[]) => void;
    groupBy?: (option: SelectOption) => string;
    selectAllLabel: string;
    withCheckboxes: boolean;
    isOpen: boolean;
    showSelectAll: boolean;
};

export type MultiSelectProps = {
    options?: SelectOption[];
    value?: SelectOption[];
    placeholder?: string;
    error?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    isFullWidth?: boolean;
    withCheckboxes?: boolean;
    onChange?: (selectedOptions: SelectOption[]) => void;
    "data-testid"?: string;
    noOptionsText?: string;
    groupBy?: (option: SelectOption) => string;
    selectAllLabel?: string;
    _isInFilterGroup?: boolean;
    footerButtonGroup?: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    isOpen?: boolean;
    showSelectAll?: boolean;
    disabledPortal?: boolean;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    hasScrollbar?: boolean;
    ariaLabel?: string;
};

const buildAutocompleteProps = ({
    options,
    value,
    handleOnChange,
    groupBy,
    selectAllLabel,
    withCheckboxes,
    isOpen,
    showSelectAll
}: BuildAutocompletePropsParams) => {
    const defaultAutocompleteProps = {
        multiple: true,
        options,
        value,
        getOptionLabel: (option: SelectOption) => option.label,
        isOptionEqualToValue: (option: SelectOption, value: SelectOption) => option.value === value.value,
        getOptionDisabled: (option: SelectOption) => option?.disabled,
        onChange: handleOnChange,
        groupBy,
        filterSelectedOptions: true
    };

    const filter = createFilterOptions<SelectOption>();

    const checkboxAutocompleteProps = {
        disableCloseOnSelect: true,
        filterSelectedOptions: false,
        filterOptions: (
            options: SelectOption[],
            params: { inputValue: string; getOptionLabel: (option: SelectOption) => string }
        ) => {
            const filtered = filter(options, params);
            const allOptions = showSelectAll ? [{ label: selectAllLabel, value: SELECT_ALL }, ...filtered] : filtered;
            return filtered.length > 0 ? allOptions : [];
        }
    };
    const isWindowOpen = isOpen ? { open: true } : {};

    return withCheckboxes
        ? { ...defaultAutocompleteProps, ...checkboxAutocompleteProps, ...isWindowOpen }
        : { ...defaultAutocompleteProps, ...isWindowOpen };
};

const computePopperStyle = (_isInFilterGroup: boolean) => {
    return {
        zIndex: _isInFilterGroup ? "1022" : "1"
    };
};

const computePaperStyle = (isFullWidth: boolean, _isInFilterGroup: boolean, width: number | string) => {
    const defaultWidth = _isInFilterGroup ? "200px" : "320px";
    return {
        width: isFullWidth ? width || defaultWidth : defaultWidth
    };
};

const getPlaceholderText = (_isInFilterGroup: boolean, value: SelectOption[], placeholder: string) =>
    !_isInFilterGroup && value.length > 0 ? "" : placeholder;

const MultiSelect: React.FC<MultiSelectProps> = props => {
    const {
        options = [],
        value = [],
        placeholder = "Select Options...",
        error,
        disabled,
        isFullWidth = false,
        withCheckboxes = true,
        onChange,
        "data-testid": dataTestId,
        noOptionsText = "No options",
        groupBy,
        selectAllLabel = "Select all",
        _isInFilterGroup = false,
        footerButtonGroup = [],
        isOpen = false,
        showSelectAll = true,
        disabledPortal = true,
        dataTrackAction,
        hasScrollbar = false,
        ariaLabel = "Autocomplete or select multiple options"
    } = props;
    const [multiSelectWidth, setMultiSelectWidth] = useState<number | string>(0);

    const enabledOptions = options.filter(option => !option.disabled);
    const selectedEnabledOptions = value.filter(option => !option.disabled);
    const allSelected = enabledOptions.length > 0 && enabledOptions.length === selectedEnabledOptions.length;
    const hasFooterIcons = footerButtonGroup.length > 0;

    const handleSelectAll = useCallback(
        (isSelected: boolean) => {
            if (isSelected) {
                const disabledSelectedOptions = value.filter(option => option.disabled);
                const enabledOptionsToSelect = options.filter(option => !option.disabled);
                const newValue = [...disabledSelectedOptions, ...enabledOptionsToSelect];
                onChange?.(newValue);
            } else {
                const disabledSelectedOptions = value.filter(option => option.disabled);
                onChange?.(disabledSelectedOptions);
            }
        },
        [onChange, options, value]
    );

    const handleOnChange = useCallback(
        (event: React.SyntheticEvent, selectedOptions: SelectOption[]) => {
            if (selectedOptions.find(option => option.value === SELECT_ALL)) {
                handleSelectAll(!allSelected);
            } else {
                const disabledSelectedOptions = value.filter(option => option.disabled);
                const newValue = [...disabledSelectedOptions, ...selectedOptions.filter(option => !option.disabled)];
                onChange?.(newValue);
            }
        },
        [onChange, allSelected, handleSelectAll, value]
    );

    const autocompleteProps = buildAutocompleteProps({
        options,
        value,
        handleOnChange,
        groupBy,
        selectAllLabel,
        withCheckboxes,
        isOpen,
        showSelectAll
    });

    const {
        getRootProps,
        getInputProps,
        getTagProps,
        getListboxProps,
        getOptionProps,
        getClearProps,
        groupedOptions,
        getPopupIndicatorProps,
        setAnchorEl,
        anchorEl,
        popupOpen
    } = useAutocomplete(autocompleteProps as any);

    const { onMouseDown } = getListboxProps() as any;

    const placeholderText = useMemo(() => {
        return getPlaceholderText(_isInFilterGroup, value, placeholder);
    }, [_isInFilterGroup, placeholder, value]);

    const id = popupOpen ? "simple-popper" : undefined;

    const setRef = useCallback(
        (el: HTMLDivElement | null) => {
            (setAnchorEl as any)(el);
            if (el) {
                setMultiSelectWidth(isFullWidth ? el.offsetWidth : "320");
            }
        },
        [isFullWidth, setAnchorEl]
    );

    const inputId = useMemo(() => getInputProps().id, [getInputProps]);

    return (
        <MultiSelectWrapper _isInFilterGroup={_isInFilterGroup}>
            <StyledMultiSelect
                {...getRootProps()}
                aria-labelledby={inputId}
                data-testid={dataTestId}
                data-track-action={dataTrackAction}
            >
                <div ref={setRef}>
                    {renderInput({
                        getInputProps,
                        dataTestId,
                        placeholderText,
                        _isInFilterGroup,
                        value,
                        getTagProps,
                        disabled,
                        popupOpen,
                        getClearProps,
                        getPopupIndicatorProps,
                        error,
                        isFullWidth,
                        ariaLabel
                    })}
                </div>
            </StyledMultiSelect>
            <StyledPopper
                id={id}
                onMouseDown={onMouseDown}
                open={popupOpen}
                anchorEl={anchorEl}
                placement="bottom-start"
                className="MuiAutocomplete-popper"
                role="presentation"
                container={anchorEl}
                style={computePopperStyle(_isInFilterGroup)}
                disablePortal={disabledPortal}
                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-popper`}
            >
                <StyledPaper
                    style={computePaperStyle(isFullWidth, _isInFilterGroup, multiSelectWidth)}
                    $hasFooterIcons={hasFooterIcons}
                >
                    {renderOptionsList({
                        groupBy,
                        _isInFilterGroup,
                        allSelected,
                        dataTestId,
                        getOptionProps,
                        groupedOptions: groupedOptions as Parameters<typeof renderOptionsList>[0]["groupedOptions"],
                        noOptionsText,
                        withCheckboxes,
                        hasScrollbar
                    })}
                    {hasFooterIcons && (
                        <ButtonGroupActions
                            footerButtonGroup={footerButtonGroup}
                            data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-button-group`}
                        />
                    )}
                </StyledPaper>
            </StyledPopper>
        </MultiSelectWrapper>
    );
};

export default MultiSelect;
````

````typescript
    value: SelectOption[];

    getClearProps: () => React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>;
    getPopupIndicatorProps: () => React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>;
    disabled?: boolean;
    _isInFilterGroup?: boolean;
};

type RenderOptionParams = {
    allSelected: boolean;
    getOptionProps: (params: {
        option: SelectOption;
        index: number;
    }) => React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement> & { key: any };
    withCheckboxes: boolean;
    dataTestId?: string;
    _isInFilterGroup?: boolean;
};

type GroupedOption = {
    group?: string;
    options: SelectOption[];
    index: number;
};

type RenderOptionsListParams = {
    groupBy?: (option: SelectOption) => string;
    _isInFilterGroup?: boolean;
    allSelected: boolean;
    dataTestId?: string;
    getOptionProps: (params: {
        option: SelectOption;
        index: number;
    }) => React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLLIElement> & { key: any };
    groupedOptions: (SelectOption | GroupedOption)[];
    noOptionsText: string;
    withCheckboxes: boolean;
    hasScrollbar?: boolean;
};

type RenderInputParams = {
    getInputProps: () => React.InputHTMLAttributes<HTMLInputElement> & { ref: React.Ref<HTMLInputElement> };
    dataTestId?: string;
    placeholderText: string;
    _isInFilterGroup?: boolean;
    value: SelectOption[];
    getTagProps: AutocompleteGetTagProps;
    disabled?: boolean;
    popupOpen: boolean;
    getClearProps: () => React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>;
    getPopupIndicatorProps: () => React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>;
    error?: boolean;
    isFullWidth?: boolean;
    ariaLabel?: string;
};

const renderTags = ({ value, getTagProps, disabled: disabledInput, dataTestId }: RenderTagsParams) =>
    value.map(({ label, value, disabled }, index) => {
        return (
            <StyledChip
                {...getTagProps({ index })}
                key={value}
                disabled={disabled || disabledInput}
                variant="outlined"
                deleteIcon={<StyledIcon disabled={disabled} className="far fa-times" />}
                label={label}
                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-chip${disabledInput ? "-disabled" : ""}`}
            />
        );
    });

const _getCloseIconClasses = (disabled?: boolean) => `fas fa-times-circle ${disabled ? "disabled" : ""}`;

const _getChevronIconClasses = (popupOpen: boolean) => `fas fa-chevron-${popupOpen ? "up" : "down"}`;

function hasOnClick(
    obj: React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement>
): obj is React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & { onClick: (event: React.MouseEvent) => void } {
    return typeof obj.onClick === "function";
}

const renderEndAdornment = ({
    value,
    popupOpen,
    getClearProps,
    getPopupIndicatorProps,
    disabled,
    _isInFilterGroup
}: RenderEndAdornmentParams) => {
    const clearProps = getClearProps();
    const popupProps = getPopupIndicatorProps();
    const handleClear = hasOnClick(clearProps) ? clearProps.onClick : undefined;
    const togglePopup = hasOnClick(popupProps) ? popupProps.onClick : undefined;
    const isDisabled = value.some(option => option.disabled) || disabled;

    return (
        <StyledEndAdornment>
            <InputAdornment position="end">
                {!_isInFilterGroup && value.length > 0 ? (
                    <StyledCloseIcon
                        className={_getCloseIconClasses(isDisabled)}
                        onClick={!isDisabled ? handleClear : undefined}
                    />
                ) : null}
                <StyledIcon
                    disabled={disabled}
                    onClick={togglePopup}
                    className={_getChevronIconClasses(popupOpen)}
                    _isInFilterGroup={_isInFilterGroup}
                />
            </InputAdornment>
        </StyledEndAdornment>
    );
};

const renderOption = (
    option: SelectOption,
    index: number,
    { allSelected, getOptionProps, withCheckboxes, dataTestId, _isInFilterGroup, ...props }: RenderOptionParams
) => {
    const optionProps = getOptionProps({
        option,
        index
    });
    const selected = optionProps["aria-selected"] as boolean;
    const selectAllOption = option.value === SELECT_ALL;
    const selectAllProps = selectAllOption ? { checked: allSelected } : {};
    const optionId = optionProps.id as string;

    return (
        <>
            <StyledOption
                {...props}
                {...getOptionProps({
                    option,
                    index
                })}
                key={optionId}
                _isInFilterGroup={_isInFilterGroup}
                onClick={option?.disabled ? undefined : (optionProps.onClick as (event: React.MouseEvent) => void)}
            >
                {withCheckboxes && (
                    <BaseCheckbox
                        id={optionId}
                        inputProps={{ "aria-labelledby": `${optionId}` }}
                        checked={selected}
                        disabled={option?.disabled}
                        data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-checkbox-${index}`}
                        {...selectAllProps}
                    />
                )}
                {option.label}
            </StyledOption>
            {withCheckboxes && selectAllOption && <StyledLineSepartor />}
        </>
    );
};

const _renderGroupedOrNot = ({
    groupBy,
    _isInFilterGroup,
    allSelected,
    dataTestId,
    getOptionProps,
    groupedOptions,
    withCheckboxes
}: RenderOptionsListParams) => {
    return groupBy
        ? (groupedOptions as GroupedOption[]).map((option, i) => (
              <li key={option?.group ? option.group : i}>
                  {option.group && <StyledSubTitle>{option.group}</StyledSubTitle>}
                  <StyledList>
                      {option.options.map((item, index) => {
                          return (
                              <React.Fragment key={index}>
                                  {renderOption(item, index + option.index, {
                                      allSelected,
                                      getOptionProps,
                                      withCheckboxes,
                                      dataTestId,
                                      _isInFilterGroup
                                  })}
                              </React.Fragment>
                          );
                      })}
                  </StyledList>
              </li>
          ))
        : (groupedOptions as SelectOption[]).map((option, index) => {
              return (
                  <React.Fragment key={index}>
                      {renderOption(option, index, {
                          allSelected,
                          getOptionProps,
                          withCheckboxes,
                          dataTestId,
                          _isInFilterGroup
                      })}
                  </React.Fragment>
              );
          });
};

export const renderOptionsList = ({
    groupBy,
    _isInFilterGroup,
    allSelected,
    dataTestId,
    getOptionProps,
    groupedOptions,
    noOptionsText,
    withCheckboxes,
    hasScrollbar
}: RenderOptionsListParams) => (
    <StyledList $hasScrollbar={hasScrollbar}>
        {groupedOptions.length > 0 ? (
            _renderGroupedOrNot({
                groupBy,
                _isInFilterGroup,
                allSelected,
                dataTestId,
                getOptionProps,
                groupedOptions,
                noOptionsText,
                withCheckboxes,
                hasScrollbar
            })
        ) : (
            <li>
                <StyledText>{noOptionsText}</StyledText>
            </li>
        )}
    </StyledList>
);

export const renderInput = ({
    getInputProps,
    dataTestId,
    placeholderText,
    _isInFilterGroup,
    value,
    getTagProps,
    disabled,
    popupOpen,
    getClearProps,
    getPopupIndicatorProps,
    error,
    isFullWidth,
    ariaLabel
}: RenderInputParams) => (
    <StyledTextField
        inputProps={{
            ...getInputProps(),
            "data-testid": dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-input`,
            role: "textbox",
            "aria-label": ariaLabel
        }}
        placeholder={placeholderText}
        multiline
        //defaultOpen={true}
        variant="outlined"
        InputLabelProps={{ shrink: false }}
        InputProps={{
            startAdornment: _isInFilterGroup ? (
                ""
            ) : (
                <StyledStartAdornmentWrapper>
                    {renderTags({ value, getTagProps, disabled, dataTestId })}
                </StyledStartAdornmentWrapper>
            ),
            endAdornment: renderEndAdornment({
                value,
                popupOpen,
                getClearProps,
                getPopupIndicatorProps,
                disabled,
                _isInFilterGroup
            })
        }}
        error={error}
        disabled={disabled}
        fullWidth={isFullWidth}
        _isInFilterGroup={_isInFilterGroup}
    />
);
````

````typescript
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { ITEMS_PER_PAGE_MAP } from "./PaginationConstants";
import { generateRangeIndex } from "./PaginationUtils";
import type { SelectOption } from "./Pagination";

const getPerPageOptions = (totalItems: number): SelectOption[] => {
    const index = generateRangeIndex(totalItems);

    const itemsPerPageArr = ITEMS_PER_PAGE_MAP[index as keyof typeof ITEMS_PER_PAGE_MAP];
    return itemsPerPageArr.map(val => {
        return {
            label: val === Infinity ? "Show All" : val.toString(),
            value: val === Infinity ? "Show All" : val.toString()
        };
    });
};

type PaginationOptionsProps = {
    totalItems: number;
    itemsPerPageValue: string | number;
    customItemsPerPage?: SelectOption[];
};

type PaginationOptionsReturn = {
    itemsPerPageOptions: SelectOption[];
    pageNumberOptions: SelectOption[];
};

const PaginationOptions = ({
    totalItems,
    itemsPerPageValue,
    customItemsPerPage
}: PaginationOptionsProps): PaginationOptionsReturn => {
    const itemsPerPageOptions = useMemo(() => {
        return customItemsPerPage?.length ? customItemsPerPage : getPerPageOptions(totalItems);
    }, [customItemsPerPage, totalItems]);

    const pageNumberOptions = useMemo(() => {
        const itemsPerPageValueToInteger = parseInt(itemsPerPageValue.toString());
        if (Number.isInteger(itemsPerPageValueToInteger) && totalItems > 0) {
            const pageOptionsArr = Array.from(
                Array(Math.ceil(totalItems / itemsPerPageValueToInteger)).keys(),
                num => num + 1
            );
            const pageResult = pageOptionsArr.map(val => {
                return {
                    label: val.toString(),
                    value: val.toString()
                };
            });
            return pageResult;
        } else {
            return [{ label: "1", value: "1" }];
        }
    }, [itemsPerPageValue, totalItems]);

    return {
        itemsPerPageOptions,
        pageNumberOptions
    };
};

export { PaginationOptions };
export type { PaginationOptionsProps, PaginationOptionsReturn };
export default PaginationOptions;
````

````typescript
import { useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import { OPTIONS, DEFAULT_LOCALIZATIONS, ITEMS_PER_PAGE_MAP } from "./PaginationConstants";
import type { SelectOption } from "./Pagination";

export const generateRangeIndex = (totalItems: number): number | string => {
    return (
        Object.keys(ITEMS_PER_PAGE_MAP)
            .map(Number)
            .filter(key => !Number.isNaN(key))
            .sort((a, b) => a - b)
            .reverse()
            .find(key => totalItems >= key) || "default"
    );
};

export const getInitialItemsPerPage = (
    itemsPerPage: string | number,
    totalItems: number,
    customItemsPerPage: SelectOption[]
): string | number => {
    const itemsPerPageToString = typeof itemsPerPage === "string" ? itemsPerPage : itemsPerPage.toString();
    let finalValue: string | number;
    if (customItemsPerPage.length) {
        const customOption = customItemsPerPage.find(option => option.value === itemsPerPageToString);
        finalValue = customOption ? customOption.value : customItemsPerPage[0].value;
    } else {
        const rangeIndex = generateRangeIndex(totalItems);
        const itemsPerPageOptions = ITEMS_PER_PAGE_MAP[rangeIndex as keyof typeof ITEMS_PER_PAGE_MAP].map(
            (option: number) => option
        );
        if (itemsPerPageToString?.toLowerCase() === "all" && itemsPerPageOptions.includes(Infinity)) {
            return "Show All";
        }
        const itemsPerPageNumeric = itemsPerPageToString
            ? OPTIONS[itemsPerPageToString.toUpperCase() as keyof typeof OPTIONS]
            : parseInt(itemsPerPageToString, 10);
        finalValue = itemsPerPageOptions.includes(itemsPerPageNumeric) ? itemsPerPageNumeric : itemsPerPageOptions[0];
    }
    return finalValue;
};

export const getInititalPageSelection = (pageSelection?: number): number => {
    const pageSelectionNumeric = parseInt(pageSelection?.toString() || "1", 10);
    return !Number.isNaN(pageSelectionNumeric) ? pageSelectionNumeric : 1;
};

type PaginationUtilsProps = {
    localizations: Record<string, unknown>;
    pageSelection?: number;
};

type PaginationUtilsReturn = {
    selectedLocalizations: Record<string, string>;
    getPageSelectionReset: (options: SelectOption[]) => number;
};

const PaginationUtils = ({ localizations, pageSelection }: PaginationUtilsProps): PaginationUtilsReturn => {
    const selectedLocalizations = useMemo(() => {
        return Object.keys(localizations).length > 0
            ? (localizations as Record<string, string>)
            : DEFAULT_LOCALIZATIONS;
    }, [localizations]);

    const getPageSelectionReset = useCallback(
        (options: SelectOption[]) => {
            const initialPageSelection = getInititalPageSelection(pageSelection);
            const pageSelectionExists = options.some(r => r.value === initialPageSelection?.toString());
            return pageSelectionExists ? initialPageSelection : parseInt(options[0]?.value);
        },
        [pageSelection]
    );

    return {
        selectedLocalizations,
        getPageSelectionReset
    };
};

export default PaginationUtils;
````
