````typescript
import React, { useState, useRef, useEffect, useCallback, ReactElement, ComponentType, RefObject } from "react";
import { Popper, PopperPlacementType } from "@mui/material";
import { PopUpContainer, ButtonContainer, StyledCustomTrigger } from "./PopUp.styles";
import Button from "@atoms/button/Button";
import PopUpWindow from "./PopUpWindow";
import { POPUP_MODIFIERS } from "@utils/PopUp.constants";
import { filterAccessibleAttributes } from "@utils/accessibleAttrFilter";
import type { PopUpButton } from "./PopUpButtonShapes";

type ButtonType = "primary" | "secondary" | "border" | "borderless" | "serverCTA" | "segmented" | "destructive";

type PopUpSize = "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg";

type PopUpTextItem = {
    header?: string;
    body?: string;
};

type PopperModifier = {
    name: string;
    options?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

export type PopUpProps = {
    buttonType?: ButtonType;
    buttonText?: React.ReactNode;
    buttonIcon?: ComponentType;
    customTriggerElement?: React.ReactNode;
    popUpText?: PopUpTextItem[];
    placement?: PopperPlacementType;
    popUpStyles?: Record<string, unknown>;
    isSmall?: boolean;
    customPopUp?: (props: Record<string, unknown>) => ReactElement;
    emergencyZIndex?: number;
    hideCloseIcon?: boolean;
    footerButtonGroup?: PopUpButton[];
    popUpSize?: PopUpSize;
    enterDelay?: number;
    leaveDelay?: number;
    hasMouseOverInteraction?: boolean;
    popupModifiers?: PopperModifier[];
    disabledPortal?: boolean;
    parentRef?: React.Ref<HTMLDivElement>;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const PopUp: React.FC<PopUpProps> = ({
    buttonType = "primary",
    buttonText = "Click Me",
    buttonIcon: ButtonIcon,
    customTriggerElement,
    popUpText = [{}],
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars
    popUpStyles = {},
    isSmall,
    placement = "bottom-start",
    customPopUp,
    emergencyZIndex,
    hideCloseIcon = false,
    footerButtonGroup,
    popUpSize,
    enterDelay = 100,
    leaveDelay = 300,
    hasMouseOverInteraction = false,
    popupModifiers,
    disabledPortal = true,
    parentRef,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}) => {
    const anchorEl = useRef<HTMLDivElement | HTMLButtonElement>(null);
    const timeoutRef = useRef<number | undefined>(undefined);
    const [popupOpen, setPopupOpen] = useState(false);
    // Accessible attributes for trigger button
    const accessibleButtonAttrs = filterAccessibleAttributes({
        "aria-haspopup": "dialog",
        "aria-expanded": popupOpen,
        "aria-controls": popupOpen ? "transitions-popper" : undefined
    });

    // Move focus to popup window when it opens
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!popupOpen) return;

        const current =
            typeof parentRef === "object" && parentRef !== null && "current" in parentRef ? parentRef.current : null;

        if (current) {
            const focusElement = () => {
                if (current) current.focus();
            };
            focusElement();
            requestAnimationFrame(focusElement);
        }
    }, [popupOpen, parentRef]);

    // Restore focus to trigger button when popup closes
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!popupOpen && anchorEl.current) {
            anchorEl.current.focus();
        }
    }, [popupOpen]);

    // Add global Escape key listener when popup is open
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!popupOpen) return;
        function handleEscape(event: KeyboardEvent) {
            if (event.key === "Escape") {
                setPopupOpen(false);
            }
        }
        document.addEventListener("keydown", handleEscape);
        return () => {
            document.removeEventListener("keydown", handleEscape);
        };
    }, [popupOpen]);

    // Cleanup timeout on unmount
    useEffect(() => {
        return () => window.clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
    }, []);

    const popupSetTimeout = useCallback(
        (transitionTime: number, isOpen: boolean, isOnHandleClick = false) => {
            window.clearTimeout(timeoutRef.current);
            if (transitionTime > 0) {
                timeoutRef.current = window.setTimeout(() => {
                    if (isOnHandleClick) {
                        setPopupOpen(prev => !prev);
                    } else {
                        setPopupOpen(isOpen);
                    }
                }, transitionTime);
            } else {
                if (isOnHandleClick) {
                    setPopupOpen(prev => !prev);
                } else {
                    setPopupOpen(isOpen);
                }
            }
        },
        [setPopupOpen]
    );

    const handleClick = useCallback(() => {
        const transitionTime = popupOpen ? leaveDelay : enterDelay;
        popupSetTimeout(transitionTime, popupOpen, true);
    }, [enterDelay, leaveDelay, popupOpen, popupSetTimeout]);

    const onOutsideClick = useCallback(() => {
        popupSetTimeout(leaveDelay, false);
    }, [leaveDelay, popupSetTimeout]);

    const handlePopoverOpen = useCallback(() => {
        popupSetTimeout(enterDelay, true);
    }, [enterDelay, popupSetTimeout]);

    const handlePopoverClose = useCallback(() => {
        popupSetTimeout(leaveDelay, false);
    }, [leaveDelay, popupSetTimeout]);

    const id = popupOpen ? "transitions-popper" : undefined;

    // Escape key handler
    const handleKeyDown = useCallback(
        (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
            if ((e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") && !popupOpen) {
                e.preventDefault();
                popupSetTimeout(enterDelay, true);
            }
        },
        [popupOpen, enterDelay, popupSetTimeout]
    );

    // Typed button props for custom trigger
    const triggerButtonProps: React.ButtonHTMLAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & { "data-testid"?: string } = {
        onClick: handleClick,
        onKeyDown: handleKeyDown,
        "data-testid": `${dataTestId}-custom-trigger`,
        style: {
            background: "none",
            border: "none",
            padding: 0
        },
        ...filterAccessibleAttributes({
            "aria-haspopup": "dialog",
            "aria-expanded": popupOpen ? "true" : "false",
            "aria-controls": popupOpen ? "transitions-popper" : undefined
        })
    };

    return (
        <PopUpContainer
            {...(hasMouseOverInteraction ? { onMouseEnter: handlePopoverOpen, onMouseLeave: handlePopoverClose } : {})}
            ref={anchorEl as React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>}
            data-testid={dataTestId}
        >
            {customTriggerElement ? (
                React.isValidElement(customTriggerElement) ? (
                    <button ref={anchorEl as React.RefObject<HTMLButtonElement>} {...triggerButtonProps}>
                        {customTriggerElement}
                    </button>
                ) : (
                    /**
                     * Deprecated: This is should be deprecated it's better use React element as a trigger
                     * Keeping it for backward compatibility
                     */
                    <StyledCustomTrigger
                        data-testid={`${dataTestId}-custom-trigger`}
                        onClick={handleClick}
                        ref={anchorEl as React.RefObject<HTMLDivElement>}
                    >
                        {customTriggerElement}
                    </StyledCustomTrigger>
                )
            ) : (
                <Button
                    data-testid="pop-up-button"
                    type={buttonType}
                    small={isSmall}
                    onClick={handleClick}
                    attrProps={accessibleButtonAttrs}
                >
                    {ButtonIcon ? (
                        <ButtonContainer>
                            <ButtonIcon />
                            {buttonText}
                        </ButtonContainer>
                    ) : (
                        buttonText
                    )}
                </Button>
            )}
            <Popper
                id={id}
                modifiers={popupModifiers || (POPUP_MODIFIERS as any)}
                open={popupOpen}
                anchorEl={anchorEl.current}
                placement={placement}
                style={{ zIndex: emergencyZIndex }}
                disablePortal={disabledPortal}
                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-popup-popper`}
            >
                <PopUpWindow
                    ref={parentRef}
                    popUpText={popUpText}
                    onOutsideClick={onOutsideClick}
                    onCloseClick={handleClick}
                    CustomPopUpBody={customPopUp}
                    hideCloseIcon={hideCloseIcon}
                    footerButtonGroup={footerButtonGroup}
                    popUpSize={popUpSize?.toLowerCase() as PopUpSize}
                    data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-popup-window`}
                    onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
                    tabIndex={-1}
                />
            </Popper>
        </PopUpContainer>
    );
};

export default PopUp;
````

````typescript
import React, { forwardRef, useMemo, useRef, useEffect } from "react";
import useOnClickOutside from "@hooks/useOnClickOutside";
import {
    PopUpWrapper,
    PopUpContent,
    PopUpClose,
    StyledBlock,
    StyledBlockHeader,
    StyledBlockBody,
    StyledCloseIcon
} from "./PopUp.styles";
import { POPUP_FOOTER_HEIGHT, POPUP_HEIGHT, POPUP_WIDTH, PopUpSize } from "./PopUpConstants";
import ButtonGroupActions from "@components/shared/ButtonGroupActions";
import { filterAccessibleAttributes } from "@utils/accessibleAttrFilter";
import type { PopUpTextItem } from "@utils/PopUp.constants";
import type { PopUpButton } from "./PopUpButtonShapes";

type WindowSize = {
    height: number;
    width: number;
};

const getWindowBySize = (popUpSize: PopUpSize | undefined, hasFooterIcons: boolean): WindowSize => ({
    width: POPUP_WIDTH[popUpSize || "md"] || POPUP_WIDTH.default,
    height: getWindowMaxHeight(popUpSize, hasFooterIcons)
});

const getWindowMaxHeight = (popUpSize: PopUpSize | undefined, hasFooterIcons: boolean) => {
    const contentHeight = POPUP_HEIGHT[popUpSize || "md"] || POPUP_HEIGHT.default;
    const totalHeight = hasFooterIcons ? contentHeight - POPUP_FOOTER_HEIGHT : contentHeight;
    return totalHeight;
};

export type PopUpWindowProps = {
    popUpText?: PopUpTextItem[];
    onOutsideClick: (event?: React.SyntheticEvent | Event) => void;
    onCloseClick: () => void;
    CustomPopUpBody?: (props: Record<string, unknown>) => React.ReactElement;
    hideCloseIcon?: boolean;
    footerButtonGroup?: PopUpButton[];
    popUpSize?: PopUpSize;
    onKeyDown?: (event: React.KeyboardEvent) => void;
    tabIndex?: number;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const PopUpWindow = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, PopUpWindowProps>(
    (
        {
            popUpText,
            onOutsideClick,
            onCloseClick,
            CustomPopUpBody,
            hideCloseIcon,
            footerButtonGroup = [],
            popUpSize,
            "data-testid": dataTestId
        },
        ref
    ) => {
        const internalRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
        const popupRef = ref || internalRef;
        useOnClickOutside(popupRef as React.RefObject<HTMLElement>, onOutsideClick);

        // Auto-focus the popup when it mounts (only if no external ref is provided)
        useEffect(() => {
            if (!ref && "current" in popupRef && popupRef.current) {
                popupRef.current.focus();
            }
        }, [ref, popupRef]);
        const hasFooterIcons = useMemo(
            () => (footerButtonGroup?.length > 0 ? true : false),
            [footerButtonGroup.length]
        );
        const popUpWindowSize = useMemo(() => getWindowBySize(popUpSize, hasFooterIcons), [hasFooterIcons, popUpSize]);

        const popUpBody = popUpText
            ? popUpText.map((item, index) => (
                  <StyledBlock key={item.header ?? index}>
                      <StyledBlockHeader id={index === 0 && dataTestId ? `${dataTestId}-title` : undefined}>
                          {item.header}
                      </StyledBlockHeader>
                      <StyledBlockBody>{item.body}</StyledBlockBody>
                  </StyledBlock>
              ))
            : null;
````

````typescript
import React, { ReactNode } from "react";
import RadioButton from "@atoms/RadioButton/RadioButton";
import { filterAccessibleAttributes } from "@utils/accessibleAttrFilter";
import FormFieldAccessory from "@atoms/FormFieldAccessory/FormFieldAccessory";
import { FormFieldHelperProps } from "@atoms/FormFieldHelper/FormFieldHelper";
import {
    StyledFormControl,
    StyledFormControlLabel,
    StyledFormHelperText,
    StyledFormHelperTextWrapper,
    StyledRadioGroup
} from "./RadioGroup.styles";

type RadioButtonItem = {
    /**
     * ID that will be passed back in onChange
     */
    id: string;
    /**
     * Label of radio
     */
    label: string;
    /**
     * Disable radio option
     */
    disabled?: boolean;
    /**
     * Helper text displayed below the radio option
     */
    helperTextProps?: Partial<FormFieldHelperProps> & {
        children?: ReactNode;
    };
    /**
     * Used for pendo tracking
     */
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    /**
     * Additional accessible attributes
     */
    attrProps?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

export type RadioButtonGroupProps = {
    /**
     * Label of radio group
     */
    label?: string;
    /**
     * Optional tooltip or popup component
     */
    labelInfoIcon?: ReactNode;
    /**
     * NOTE: This property will be deprecated. Use "labelInfoIcon" instead
     */
    tooltip?: ReactNode;
    /**
     * Optional required field
     */
    isRequired?: boolean;
    /**
     * Callback that's trigger on change, passes back id
     */
    onChange?: (id: string) => void;
    /**
     * Group of radioButtons that build the radio group
     */
    radioButtons: RadioButtonItem[];
    /**
     * Radio to be selected
     */
    selectedValue: string;
    /**
     * Display radio buttons horizontally
     */
    isHorizontal?: boolean;
    /**
     * Used for testing
     */
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const RadioButtonGroup: React.FC<RadioButtonGroupProps> = ({
    label = "",
    tooltip,
    labelInfoIcon,
    isRequired,
    onChange,
    radioButtons,
    selectedValue,
    isHorizontal = false,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}) => {
    const handleChange = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
        onChange?.(event.target.value);
    };

    const radioButtonConfigs = radioButtons.map(radioVal => {
        const helperId = `helper-text-${radioVal.id}`;
        const filteredAttrProps = filterAccessibleAttributes({
            ...(radioVal.attrProps || {}),
            ...(radioVal.helperTextProps ? { "aria-describedby": helperId } : {})
        });
        return {
            key: `radio-${radioVal.id}`,
            value: radioVal.id,
            controlProps: {
                isStandAlone: false,
                dataTrackAction: radioVal.dataTrackAction,
                inputProps: filteredAttrProps
            },
            disabled: radioVal.disabled,
            label: radioVal.label,
            dataTestId: `${dataTestId}-radio-group-button-form-control-label`,
            helperTextProps: radioVal.helperTextProps,
            helperId
        };
    });

    return (
        <StyledFormControl data-testid={dataTestId} component="fieldset" variant="standard">
            <FormFieldAccessory
                title={label}
                tooltip={labelInfoIcon || tooltip}
                isRequired={isRequired}
                data-testid={`${dataTestId}-radio-group-form-field-accessory-label`}
            >
                <StyledRadioGroup
                    $isHorizontal={isHorizontal}
                    aria-label={label}
                    name={label}
                    value={selectedValue}
                    onChange={handleChange}
                    data-testid={`${dataTestId}-radio-buttons-group`}
                >
                    {radioButtonConfigs.map(config => (
                        <div key={config.key} style={{ lineHeight: "16px", padding: "0px" }}>
                            <StyledFormControlLabel
                                value={config.value}
                                control={<RadioButton {...config.controlProps} />}
                                disabled={config.disabled}
                                label={config.label}
                                data-testid={config.dataTestId}
                            />
                            {config.helperTextProps && (
                                <StyledFormHelperTextWrapper>
                                    <StyledFormHelperText
                                        helperText={
                                            config.helperTextProps.helperText ||
                                            (!config.helperTextProps.error
                                                ? (config.helperTextProps.children as
                                                      | string
                                                      | React.ReactElement
                                                      | undefined)
                                                : undefined)
                                        }
                                        error={config.helperTextProps.error}
                                        errorHelperText={
                                            config.helperTextProps.errorHelperText ||
                                            (config.helperTextProps.error
                                                ? (config.helperTextProps.children as
                                                      | string
                                                      | React.ReactElement
                                                      | undefined)
                                                : undefined)
                                        }
                                        maxLength={config.helperTextProps.maxLength}
                                        currentLength={config.helperTextProps.currentLength}
                                        maxLengthHelperText={config.helperTextProps.maxLengthHelperText}
                                        component={config.helperTextProps.component}
                                        attrProps={{ ...config.helperTextProps.attrProps, id: config.helperId }}
                                        data-testid="helper-text"

                </StyledRadioGroup>
            </FormFieldAccessory>
        </StyledFormControl>
````

````typescript
    const handleOptionDisabled = useCallback((option: SelectOption) => option?.disabled ?? false, []);

    useOnClickOutside(selectRef, closeSelect, isSelectOpen, popperRef, popupRef, disablePortal);

    useEffect(() => {
        const handleResize = () => {
            if (isSelectOpen && window.innerHeight < heightThreshold) {
                closeSelect();
            }
        };

        window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
        return () => {
            window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
        };
    }, [closeSelect, isSelectOpen]);

    return (
        <div ref={selectRef} style={style}>
            <StyledAutocomplete
                id={(id || allowedAttrProps?.id) as string | undefined}
                open={isSelectOpen}
                data-testid={dataTestId}
                style={style}
                options={_options}
                noOptionsText={noOptionsText}
                onChange={onSelectionChange}
                freeSolo={allowCustomInput}
                popupIcon={popupIcon}
                disableClearable
                PaperComponent={(props: any) => (
                    <CustomPaper
                        {...props}
                        hasFooterIcons={hasFooterIcons}
                        noOptionsText={noOptionsText}
                        showOptions={showOption(options, inputValue)}
                    />
                )}
                PopperComponent={(props: any) => <SelectPopper {...props} ref={selectRef} />}
                renderInput={renderInput}
                renderOption={renderOption}
                getOptionLabel={getOptionLabel}
                getOptionDisabled={handleOptionDisabled}
                value={selectValue}
                disabled={disabled}
                onBlur={handleOnBlur}
                inputValue={inputValue}
                onInputChange={handleOnInputChange}
                clearOnBlur={!allowCustomInput}
                blurOnSelect={_isInFilterGroup}
                autoHighlight={autoHighlight}
                groupBy={groupBy as any}
                selectOnFocus={!allowCustomInput}
                isOptionEqualToValue={handleOptionSelected}
                onOpen={openSelect}
                onClose={closeSelect}
                openOnFocus
                handleHomeEndKeys
                disableCloseOnSelect={disableCloseOnSelect}
                data-track-action={dataTrackAction}
            />
            <FormFieldHelper
                errorHelperText={errorHelperText}
                helperText={helperText}
                error={error}
                data-testid={`${dataTestId}_helper`}
            />
        </div>
    );
};

export default Select;
````

````typescript
import { useMemo } from "react";

const SM = 5,
    MD = 6,
    LG = 9;

export const LIST_HEIGHT_MAP = {
    sm: SM,
    md: MD,
    lg: LG,
    "default": MD
} as const;

export type ListHeightSize = keyof typeof LIST_HEIGHT_MAP;

export const SELECT_FOOTER_HEIGHT = 3.063; //49px

const getSizeByOptionLength = (optionsLength: number) => {
    if (optionsLength <= 6) {
        return 5;
    } else if (optionsLength <= 9) {
        return 6;
    } else {
        return 9;
    }
};

const getMaxHeightBySize = (listSize: string) => LIST_HEIGHT_MAP[listSize as ListHeightSize] || LIST_HEIGHT_MAP.default;

const calculatedMaxHeight = (
    itemsCount: number,
    itemHeight: number,
    hasFooterIcons: boolean,
    hasListHeightSize: boolean
) => {
    //40px per item +  20px for half last item height + 8px for padding
    const maxHeight = itemsCount * itemHeight + 1.75;
    if (itemsCount === 5 && !hasListHeightSize) {
        return "auto";
    }
    return maxHeight;
};

export const useDropdownMaxHeight = (
    listHeightSize: string | undefined,
    optionsLength: number,
    hasFooterIcons: boolean
) => {
    // 40px per item
    const itemHeight = 2.5;

    const hasListHeightSize = listHeightSize != undefined;

    const maxHeight = useMemo(() => {
        const itemsCount = hasListHeightSize
            ? getMaxHeightBySize(listHeightSize)
            : getSizeByOptionLength(optionsLength);

        return calculatedMaxHeight(itemsCount, itemHeight, hasFooterIcons, hasListHeightSize);
    }, [listHeightSize, hasFooterIcons, optionsLength, hasListHeightSize, itemHeight]);

    return maxHeight;
};
````

## File: src/components/molecules/Select/useEvaluateCustomInput.tsx
````typescript
import { useCallback } from "react";

export type SelectOption = {
    label: string;
    value: string | number;
    icon?: React.ReactNode;
    index?: number;
};

type InputValueWithIndex = {
    index: number;
    label?: string;
};

type UseEvaluateCustomInputParams = {
    forceCustomInputValue: boolean;
    options: SelectOption[];
    optionValueAsSelectValue: boolean;
};

type EvaluatedValue = {
    value: string | number | SelectOption;
    icon: React.ReactNode | Record<string, never>;
};

const formatReturnValue = (value: SelectOption | string, returnOnlyValue: boolean): EvaluatedValue => ({
    value: returnOnlyValue ? (value as SelectOption).value : value,
    icon: (value as SelectOption)?.icon || {}
});

export function useEvaluateCustomInput({
    forceCustomInputValue,
    options,
    optionValueAsSelectValue
}: UseEvaluateCustomInputParams) {
    const evaluateValue = useCallback(
        (inputValue: string | number | InputValueWithIndex, isCustomUserValue: boolean): EvaluatedValue => {
            // If the input was selected from the dropdown, skip evaluation
            if (!isCustomUserValue) {
                return formatReturnValue(options[(inputValue as InputValueWithIndex).index], optionValueAsSelectValue);
            }

            const inputStr = inputValue.toString().trim();

            // If input is empty and not zero, return empty string
            if (!inputStr && inputValue !== 0) {
                return formatReturnValue("", false);
            }

            // Check for existing option
            const existingOptionIndex = options.findIndex(opt => opt.label.toLowerCase() === inputStr.toLowerCase());
            const existingOption = options[existingOptionIndex];

            if (existingOption) {
                // Do not allow exact duplicates if forceCustomInputValue is enabled and value also matches
                if (!forceCustomInputValue || existingOption?.value === inputStr) {
                    return formatReturnValue(existingOption, optionValueAsSelectValue);
                }
            }

            // Allow new custom value
            return formatReturnValue({ label: inputStr, value: inputStr }, optionValueAsSelectValue);
        },
        [options, forceCustomInputValue, optionValueAsSelectValue]
    );

    return evaluateValue;
}

export default useEvaluateCustomInput;
````

````typescript
    const popperRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const popupRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

    useOnClickOutside(ref, callback, isActive, popperRef, withPopupRef ? popupRef : undefined);

    return (
        <div>
            <div ref={ref} data-testid="main-ref">
                Main
            </div>
            <div ref={popperRef} data-testid="popper-ref">
                Popper
            </div>
            {withPopupRef && (
                <div ref={popupRef} data-testid="popup-ref">
                    Popup
                </div>
            )}
            <div data-testid="outside">Outside</div>
        </div>
    );
};

        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const { getByTestId } = render(<TestComponent callback={callback} isActive={false} />);
        await user.pointer({ keys: "[MouseLeft]", target: getByTestId("outside") });
        expect(callback).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
````

## File: src/components/molecules/TableToolbar/TableToolbarHooks/useBulkActionsMenuList.tsx
````typescript
import { useMemo } from "react";
import type { ActionListItem } from "@atoms/ActionMenu/ActionMenu";
import type { BulkActionMenuItem } from "../TableToolbar";

type UseBulkActionsMenuListParams = {
    bulkActionMenu?: BulkActionMenuItem[];
    performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove: (fn: () => void) => void;
    onSelectedRemove: () => void;
    selectedRows: unknown;
};

const useBulkActionsMenuList = ({
    bulkActionMenu,
    performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove,
    onSelectedRemove,
    selectedRows
}: UseBulkActionsMenuListParams) =>
    useMemo(() => {
        if (!bulkActionMenu) return;
        return bulkActionMenu.map(action => {
            const { onClick, clearSelectionsAfterClick } = action;
            return {
                ...action,
                onClick:
                    onClick && clearSelectionsAfterClick
                        ? () => performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove(() => onClick(selectedRows, onSelectedRemove))
                        : onClick
                        ? () => onClick(selectedRows, onSelectedRemove)
                        : undefined
            };
        }) as ActionListItem[];
    }, [bulkActionMenu, performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove, selectedRows, onSelectedRemove]);

export default useBulkActionsMenuList;
````

## File: src/components/molecules/TableToolbar/TableToolbarHooks/useOnSelectedRemove.tsx
````typescript
import { useCallback } from "react";

export type UseOnSelectedRemoveParams = {
    toggleAllRowsSelected?: (value: boolean) => void;
};

export type UseOnSelectedRemoveReturn = {
    onSelectedRemove: () => void;
    performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove: (fn: () => void) => void;
};

const useOnSelectedRemove = ({ toggleAllRowsSelected }: UseOnSelectedRemoveParams): UseOnSelectedRemoveReturn => {
    const onSelectedRemove = useCallback(() => {
        toggleAllRowsSelected?.(false);
    }, [toggleAllRowsSelected]);

    const performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove = useCallback(
        (functionToPerform: () => void) => {
            functionToPerform();
            onSelectedRemove();
        },
        [onSelectedRemove]
    );
    return { onSelectedRemove, performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove };
};

export default useOnSelectedRemove;
````

````typescript
        expect(primaryBtn).toBeInTheDocument();

        expect(primaryBtn.getAttribute("role") || "button").toBe("button");
        expect(secondaryBtn.getAttribute("role") || "button").toBe("button");

        // Keyboard navigation: check both buttons are focusable via tab, but do not enforce order
        primaryBtn.blur();
        secondaryBtn.blur();
        let foundPrimary = false;
        let foundSecondary = false;
        // Tab through up to 10 elements, check if each button receives focus
        for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            await user.tab();
            if (document.activeElement === primaryBtn) foundPrimary = true;
            if (document.activeElement === secondaryBtn) foundSecondary = true;
            if (foundPrimary && foundSecondary) break;
        }
        expect(foundPrimary).toBe(true);
        expect(foundSecondary).toBe(true);
        // Click interaction
        fireEvent.click(primaryBtn);
        expect(primaryOnClick).toHaveBeenCalled();
        fireEvent.click(secondaryBtn);
        expect(secondaryOnClick).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import Tabs, { TabsProps } from "./Tabs";
import Tab from "@atoms/Tab/Tab";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react";

export default {
    title: "Molecules/Tabs",
    component: Tabs,
    argTypes: {}
} satisfies Meta<typeof Tabs>;

const StyledIcon = styled("i")`
    color: #007cc2;
`;

const Template = (args: TabsProps) => {
    const [tabIndex, setTabIndex] = React.useState("Tab0");
    const changeTab = function (e: React.SyntheticEvent, index: unknown) {
        setTabIndex(index as string);
    };
    return (
        <Tabs {...args} selectedTabValue={tabIndex} onChange={changeTab}>
            <Tab value="Tab0" icon={<StyledIcon className="fas fa-info-circle" />} data-testid={"tab0-test-id"} />
            <Tab value="Tab1" label="Tab" data-testid={"tab1-test-id"} />
            <Tab value="Tab2" label="Tab2" disabled data-testid={"tab2-test-id"} />
            <Tab
                value="Tab3"
                label="Tab3"
                icon={<StyledIcon className="fas fa-info-circle" />}
                data-testid={"tab3-test-id"}
            />
        </Tabs>
    );
};

export const Default: StoryObj<typeof Tabs> = {
    render: Template,
    args: {}
};

export const WithAccessibility: StoryObj<typeof Tabs> = {
    render: Template,
    args: {
        attrProps: {
            "aria-label": "Tabs with Aria Label"
        }
    }
};
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { filterAccessibleAttributes } from "../../../utils/accessibleAttrFilter";
import Button from "@atoms/button/Button";
import { getBackgroundColor, getBackgroundColorHover, getTextColor } from "./ToggleUtils";
import { ToggleWrapper, ButtonWrapper } from "./Toggle.styles";

export type ToggleSegment = {
    id: string | number;
    content: string | React.ReactElement;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    iconColor?: string;
};

export type ToggleProps = {
    isMulti?: boolean;
    isLegend?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    onClick: (segmentId: string | number) => void;
    segments: ToggleSegment[];
    selectedSegmentId?: string | number;
    selectedSegmentMap?: Map<string | number, boolean>;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

type SingleToggleProps = {
    onClick: (segmentId: string | number) => void;
    segments: ToggleSegment[];
    disabled?: boolean;
    selectedSegmentId?: string | number;
    isLegend?: boolean;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    dataTestId?: string;
};

type MultiToggleProps = {
    onClick: (segmentId: string | number) => void;
    segments: ToggleSegment[];
    disabled?: boolean;
    selectedSegmentMap?: Map<string | number, boolean>;
    isLegend?: boolean;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    isMulti?: boolean;
    dataTestId?: string;
};

type SegmentProps = {
    isSelected: boolean;
    isLegend?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    content: string | React.ReactElement;
    id: string | number;
    iconColor?: string;
    first?: boolean;
    last?: boolean;
    onClick: (segmentId: string | number) => void;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    isMulti?: boolean;
    hasMiddleSelected?: boolean;
    isOnlySelected?: boolean;
    hasLeftNextSelect?: boolean;
    hasRightNextSelect?: boolean;
    dataTestId?: string;
    tabIndex?: number;
};

const Toggle = ({
    isMulti,
    isLegend,
    onClick,
    segments,
    disabled,
    selectedSegmentId,
    selectedSegmentMap,
    dataTrackAction,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: ToggleProps) => {
    if (isMulti) {
        return (
            <MultiToggle
                onClick={onClick}
                segments={segments}
                disabled={disabled}
                selectedSegmentMap={selectedSegmentMap}
                dataTestId={dataTestId}
                isLegend={isLegend}
                isMulti={isMulti}
                dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction}
            />
        );
    } else {
        return (
            <SingleToggle
                onClick={onClick}
                segments={segments}
                disabled={disabled}
                selectedSegmentId={selectedSegmentId}
                dataTestId={dataTestId}
                isLegend={isLegend}
                dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction}
            />
        );
    }
};

const SingleToggle = ({
    onClick,
    segments,
    disabled,
    selectedSegmentId,
    isLegend,
    dataTrackAction,
    dataTestId
}: SingleToggleProps) => {
    const handleClick = (clickedId: string | number) => {
        onClick(clickedId);
    };

    // Calculate border-related properties on every render to ensure they update on clicks
    const selectedIndex = segments.findIndex(seg => seg.id === selectedSegmentId);
    const hasMiddleSelected = selectedIndex > 0 && selectedIndex < segments.length - 1;
    const isOnlySelected = segments.length === 1;

    return (
        <ToggleWrapper data-testid={dataTestId} role="group" aria-label="Toggle group">
            {segments.map((segment, index) => {
                const isSelected = selectedSegmentId === segment.id;
                const isFirst = index === 0;
                const isLast = index === segments.length - 1;

                // Calculate if adjacent segments are selected
                const hasLeftNextSelect = !isFirst && selectedSegmentId === segments[index - 1].id;
                const hasRightNextSelect = !isLast && selectedSegmentId === segments[index + 1].id;

                return (
                    <Segment
                        onClick={handleClick}
                        content={segment.content}
                        disabled={disabled}
                        key={segment.id}
                        id={segment.id}
                        isSelected={isSelected}
                        last={isLast}
                        first={isFirst}
                        isLegend={isLegend}
                        hasMiddleSelected={hasMiddleSelected}
                        isOnlySelected={isOnlySelected}
                        hasLeftNextSelect={hasLeftNextSelect}
                        hasRightNextSelect={hasRightNextSelect}
                        dataTrackAction={
                            segment?.dataTrackAction || (dataTrackAction && `${dataTrackAction}-${segment?.id}`)
                        }
                        dataTestId={`${dataTestId}_segment_${segment.id}${isSelected ? "_selected" : ""}`}
                        tabIndex={isSelected || (!selectedSegmentId && isFirst) ? 0 : -1}
                    />
                );
            })}
        </ToggleWrapper>
    );
};

const MultiToggle = ({
    onClick,
    segments,
    disabled,
    selectedSegmentMap,
    isLegend,
    dataTrackAction,
    isMulti,
    dataTestId
}: MultiToggleProps) => {
    const handleClick = (clickedId: string | number) => {
        onClick(clickedId);
    };

    // Calculate border-related properties on every render to ensure they update on clicks
    const hasMiddleSelected = segments.some(
        (seg, idx) => selectedSegmentMap?.get(seg.id) && idx > 0 && idx < segments.length - 1
    );

    // Calculate which segments are selected for better border logic
    const selectedSegments = segments.filter(seg => selectedSegmentMap?.get(seg.id));
    const isOnlySelected = selectedSegments.length === 1;

    return (
        <ToggleWrapper data-testid={dataTestId} role="group" aria-label="Toggle group">
            {segments.map((segment, index) => {
                const isSelected = selectedSegmentMap?.get(segment.id) || false;
                const isFirst = index === 0;
                const isLast = index === segments.length - 1;

                // Calculate if adjacent segments are selected
                const hasLeftNextSelect = !isFirst && selectedSegmentMap?.get(segments[index - 1].id);
                const hasRightNextSelect = !isLast && selectedSegmentMap?.get(segments[index + 1].id);

                return (
                    <Segment
                        onClick={handleClick}
                        content={segment.content}
                        disabled={disabled}
                        key={segment.id}
                        id={segment.id}
                        iconColor={segment.iconColor}
                        isSelected={isSelected}
                        last={isLast}
                        first={isFirst}
                        isLegend={isLegend}
                        isMulti={isMulti}
                        hasMiddleSelected={hasMiddleSelected}
                        isOnlySelected={isOnlySelected}
                        hasLeftNextSelect={hasLeftNextSelect}
                        hasRightNextSelect={hasRightNextSelect}
                        dataTrackAction={
                            segment?.dataTrackAction || (dataTrackAction && `${dataTrackAction}-${segment?.id}`)
                        }
                        dataTestId={`${dataTestId}_segment_${segment.id}${isSelected ? "_selected" : ""}`}
                        tabIndex={isSelected || (!selectedSegmentMap?.size && isFirst) ? 0 : -1}
                    />
                );
            })}
        </ToggleWrapper>
    );
};

// Remove React.forwardRef and make Segment a regular function component
const Segment = ({
    isSelected,
    isLegend,
    disabled,
    content,
    id,
    iconColor,
    first,
    last,
    onClick,
    dataTrackAction,
    isMulti,
    hasMiddleSelected,
    isOnlySelected,
    hasLeftNextSelect,
    hasRightNextSelect,
    dataTestId,
    tabIndex
}: SegmentProps) => {
    const handleClick = () => {
        onClick(id);
    };

    const backgroundColor = getBackgroundColor(isSelected, !!disabled, isMulti);
    const backgroundColorHover = getBackgroundColorHover(isMulti);
    const textColor = getTextColor(isSelected, !!disabled, isMulti);

    // Memoize accessible attributes
    const accessibleButtonAttrs = React.useMemo(
        () =>
            filterAccessibleAttributes({
                tabIndex: tabIndex,
                "aria-pressed": isSelected
            }),
        [tabIndex, isSelected]
    );

    const accessibleIconAttrs = React.useMemo(() => filterAccessibleAttributes({ "aria-hidden": true }), []);

    return (
        <ButtonWrapper
            $backgroundColor={backgroundColor}
            $backgroundColorHover={backgroundColorHover}
            $textColor={textColor}
            $disabled={disabled}
            $isSelected={isSelected}
            $isLegend={isLegend}
            $first={first}
            $last={last}
            $isMulti={isMulti}
            $hasMiddleSelected={hasMiddleSelected}
            $isOnlySelected={isOnlySelected}
            $hasLeftNextSelect={hasLeftNextSelect}
            $hasRightNextSelect={hasRightNextSelect}
        >
            <Button
                data-testid={dataTestId}
                type="segmented"
                disabled={disabled}
                onClick={handleClick}
                borderRadiusType={first ? "left" : last ? "right" : "none"}
                mediumSmall={isLegend}
                dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction}
                attrProps={accessibleButtonAttrs}
            >
                {iconColor ? (
                    <React.Fragment>
                        <span
                            className="fas fa-xs fa-circle"
                            style={{ color: iconColor, marginRight: "5px" }}
                            {...accessibleIconAttrs}
                        />
                        {content}
                    </React.Fragment>
                ) : (
                    content
                )}
            </Button>
        </ButtonWrapper>
    );
};

export default Toggle;
````

## File: src/components/molecules/toggle/ToggleUtils.ts
````typescript
import { BLUE_600, GRAY_300, BASICS_WHITE, PURPLE_25, BLUE_700, GRAY_850, PURPLE_700 } from "@css/constants";

type BorderStyleProps = {
    first?: boolean;
    hasLeftNextSelect?: boolean;
    hasMiddleSelected?: boolean;
    hasRightNextSelect?: boolean;
    isMulti?: boolean;
    isOnlySelected?: boolean;
    isSelected?: boolean;
    last?: boolean;
};

/**
 * Returns background color based on selection, disabled, and multi-select state.
 */
export const getBackgroundColor = (isSelected: boolean, disabled: boolean, isMulti?: boolean) => {
    if (isMulti) {
        if (disabled) {
            return isSelected ? GRAY_300 : "";
        }
        return isSelected ? PURPLE_25 : "";
    }
    if (disabled) {
        return isSelected ? GRAY_300 : "";
    }
    return isSelected ? BLUE_600 : "";
};

/**
 * Returns text color based on selection, disabled, and multi-select state.
 */
export const getTextColor = (isSelected: boolean, disabled: boolean, isMulti?: boolean) => {
    if (isMulti) {
        if (disabled) {
            return isSelected ? BASICS_WHITE : GRAY_300;
        }
        return GRAY_850;
    }
    if (disabled) {
        return isSelected ? BASICS_WHITE : GRAY_300;
    }
    return isSelected ? BASICS_WHITE : BLUE_700;
};

/**
 * Returns hover background color for multi-select.
 */
export const getBackgroundColorHover = (isMulti?: boolean) => {
    return isMulti ? PURPLE_25 : "";
};

/**
 * Returns left border style based on selection, disabled, and multi-select state.
 */
export const getLeftBorderStyle = (props: BorderStyleProps) => {
    if (props.isMulti && props.isSelected) {
        return props.first || props.last || props.isOnlySelected || !props.hasLeftNextSelect
            ? `${PURPLE_700}`
            : "transparent";
    }
    return props.last && props.hasMiddleSelected ? "transparent" : "";
};

/**
 * Returns right border style based on selection, disabled, and multi-select state.
 */
export const getRightBorderStyle = (props: BorderStyleProps) => {
    if (props.isMulti && props.isSelected) {
        if (props.first || props.last) {
            return `${PURPLE_700}`;
        }
        return props.last || props.isOnlySelected || !props.hasRightNextSelect ? `${PURPLE_700}` : "transparent";
    }
    return !props.last ? "transparent" : "";
};
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import Autocomplete from "@mui/material/Autocomplete";
import FormFieldHelper from "@atoms/FormFieldHelper/FormFieldHelper";
import Tooltip from "@atoms/Tooltip/Tooltip";
import { StyledChip, StyledTextField, StyledTokenInputWrap } from "./TokenInput.styles";

type ErrorToken = {
    token: string;
    tooltip?: React.ReactNode;
};

export type TokenInputProps = {
    id?: string;
    autoComplete?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    disableInput?: boolean;
    error?: boolean;
    errorHelperText?: string;
    errorTokens?: ErrorToken[];
    helperText?: string;
    inputValue?: string;
    isHighlighted?: boolean;
    ignoreCase?: boolean;
    maxEntries?: number;
    maxEntriesErrorText?: string;
    maxLength?: number;
    onChange?: (tokens: string[], lastToken: string) => void;
    onInputChange?: (value: string) => void;
    placeholder?: string;
    value?: string[];
    width?: string | number;
    inputProps?: Record<string, unknown>;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

// This is built using Autocomplete so that we can easily add a dropdown/typeahead later,
// but right now this is not in the design system so there is no way to enable it.
const OPTIONS: string[] = [];

const filterUnique = (tokens: string[], ignoreCase?: boolean): string[] => {
    const uTokens = tokens
        .map(value => (ignoreCase ? value.toLowerCase() : value))
        .reduce(
            (map, tokenValue, tokenIndex) => (map.get(tokenValue) ? map : map.set(tokenValue, tokens[tokenIndex])),
            new Map<string, string>()
        );

    return [...uTokens.values()];
};

type TokenProps = {
    option: string;
    error?: ErrorToken;
    tooltip?: React.ReactNode;
    className?: string;
    disabled?: boolean;
    "data-tag-index"?: number;
    tabIndex?: number;
    onDelete: (event: React.SyntheticEvent) => void;
};

const Token = ({ option, error, tooltip, ...props }: TokenProps) => {
    const chip = (
        <StyledChip
            {...props}
            label={option}
            $error={!!error}
            clickable={false}
            deleteIcon={<i className="far fa-times" />}
            // @ts-expect-error MUI v5 Chip component prop typing issue
            component="button"
        />
    );

    return (
        <>
            {tooltip ? (
                <Tooltip title={tooltip}>
                    <div>{chip}</div>
                </Tooltip>
            ) : (
                chip
            )}
        </>
    );
};

/**
 * TokenInput is a generic field for entering multiple values.
 * For an email specific version, see [EmailInput](?path=/docs/molecules-emailinput)
 */
const TokenInput = ({
    id,
    autoComplete,
    disabled,
    disableInput,
    error,
    errorHelperText,
    errorTokens = [],
    helperText,
    inputValue,
    isHighlighted,
    ignoreCase,
    maxEntries,
    maxEntriesErrorText,
    maxLength,
    onChange,
    onInputChange,
    placeholder,
    value = [],
    width = "100%",
    inputProps,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: TokenInputProps) => {
    const [internalInputValue, setInternalInputValue] = useState(inputValue || "");

    const handleOnChange = useCallback(
        (event: React.SyntheticEvent, newValue: string[], reason: string) => {
            // MUI v5 Autocomplete: handle token creation (selectOption or createOption)
            if ((reason === "selectOption" || reason === "createOption") && newValue && Array.isArray(newValue)) {
                const lastToken = newValue[newValue.length - 1];
                const trimmedToken = typeof lastToken === "string" ? lastToken.trim() : lastToken;
                // Ignore empty or whitespace-only tokens
                if (!trimmedToken) return;
                // Enforce maxEntries limit
                if (typeof maxEntries === "number" && newValue.length > maxEntries) return;
                const filteredValue = filterUnique(newValue, ignoreCase);
                onChange && onChange(filteredValue, trimmedToken);
            }
        },
        [onChange, ignoreCase, maxEntries]
    );

    const handleInputChange = useCallback(
        (event: React.SyntheticEvent, inputString: string) => {
            setInternalInputValue(inputString);
            onInputChange && onInputChange(inputString);
        },
        [onInputChange]
    );

    const handleBlur = useCallback(() => {
        // Use internal input value state instead of event.target.value for MUI v5
        const newToken = internalInputValue && internalInputValue.trim();
        if (newToken && newToken.length > 0) {
            // Enforce maxEntries limit
            if (typeof maxEntries === "number" && value.length >= maxEntries) return;
            const newValue = filterUnique([...value, newToken], ignoreCase);
            onChange && onChange(newValue, newToken);
            // Clear the input after adding token
            setInternalInputValue("");
        }
    }, [onChange, value, ignoreCase, maxEntries, internalInputValue]);

    const currentEntryCount = value && value.length;
    const isError = error || errorTokens.length > 0;
    const accessibleLabel = id ? undefined : (inputProps?.["aria-label"] as string) || "Input field";

    // Normalize width for CSS
    const normalizedWidth = typeof width === "number" ? `${width}px` : width || "100%";
    const wrapTestId = dataTestId ? `${dataTestId}-wrap` : undefined;

    return (
        <StyledTokenInputWrap $width={normalizedWidth} data-testid={wrapTestId}>
            <Autocomplete
                value={value}
                onChange={handleOnChange}
                options={OPTIONS}
                multiple
                freeSolo
                disableClearable
                disabled={disabled}
                renderTags={(value: string[], getTagProps) =>
                    value.map((option, index) => {
                        const error = errorTokens.find(e => e.token === option);
                        const tooltip = error && error.tooltip;
                        const { key, ...tagProps } = getTagProps({ index });

                        return <Token key={key} {...tagProps} option={option} error={error} tooltip={tooltip} />;
                    })
                }
                renderInput={params => (
                    <StyledTextField
                        {...params}
                        placeholder={placeholder}
                        variant="outlined"
                        error={isError}
                        autoComplete={autoComplete}
                        $isHighlighted={isHighlighted}
                        fullWidth={true}
                        data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-input`}
                        InputProps={{
                            ...params.InputProps
                        }}
                        inputProps={{
                            ...params.inputProps,
                            maxLength,
                            id: id || params.inputProps.id,
                            ...inputProps,
                            "aria-label": accessibleLabel,
                            readOnly: disableInput
                        }}
                    />
                )}
                inputValue={internalInputValue}
                onInputChange={handleInputChange}
                onBlur={handleBlur}
                data-testid={dataTestId}
            />
            <FormFieldHelper
                error={isError}
                errorHelperText={errorHelperText}
                helperText={helperText}
                maxLength={maxEntries}
                maxLengthHelperText={maxEntriesErrorText}
                currentLength={currentEntryCount}
                data-testid={`${dataTestId}_helper`}
            />
        </StyledTokenInputWrap>
    );
};

export default TokenInput;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import {
    AreaChart,
    Area,
    XAxis,
    YAxis,
    CartesianGrid,
    Tooltip,
    ResponsiveContainer,
    ReferenceArea,
    Brush,
    ReferenceLine
} from "recharts";
import { CustomTooltip as CustomToolTip } from "@components/shared/Recharts/CustomTooltip";
import type {
    DataKeys,
    AccessoryOptions,
    ContainerDimensions,
    LegendOptions,
    XAxisOptions,
    YAxisOptions,
    TooltipOptions,
    PopUpOptions
} from "@components/shared/Recharts/PropTypes";
import withAccessories from "@components/shared/Recharts/withAccessories";
import { useBrush } from "@components/shared/Recharts/useBrush";
import { getTickFormatter } from "@components/shared/Recharts/tickFormatters";

type RechartsState = {
    stateData: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    activeMap: Map<string | number, boolean>;
    left: string | number | undefined;
    right: string | number | undefined;
    refAreaLeft: string | number | undefined;
    refAreaRight: string | number | undefined;
    bottom: string | number | undefined;
    top: string | number | undefined;
    hasNegativeValue?: boolean;
};

type HocProps = {
    state: RechartsState;
    palette: string[];
    zoom: () => void;
    updateRefAreaLeft: (e?: { activeLabel?: string | number }) => void;
    updateRefAreaRight: (e?: { activeLabel?: string | number }) => void;
};

export type AreaGraphProps = {
    /** Array of data objects to be fed into Line Graph including the name of each point on the X axis
     * and each data key/value pair for the Y axis */
    data: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    /** Additional Data and parameter to feed into the line/lines of the line graph */
    dataKeys: DataKeys;
    /** data points for drawing a reference line */
    referenceLineArray?: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    /** Color palette selection for graphs */
    type?: "default" | "secondary" | "dualHeat" | "heat";
    /** Renders basic Rechart Line Graph */
    isSimple?: boolean;
    /** Renders basic Rechart Line Graph */
    dateFormat?: boolean;
    /** Header text */
    header?: string;
    /** Callback Function for the current range of brush
     * Signature: function(range: object) => void */
    currentRange?: (range: { startIndex: number; endIndex: number }) => void;
    /** Start index for brush from chart data array */
    brushStart?: number;
    /** End index for brush from chart data array */
    brushEnd?: number;
    /** Sub Header text */
    subHeader?: string;
    /** Y Axis Label */
    yAxisLabel?: string;
    /** X AxisLabel */
    xAxisLabel?: string;
    /** Options for Graph that extends abilities beyond that of standard Rechart Line Graph */
    accessoryOptions?: AccessoryOptions;
    /** Options for Custom LineGraph Container */
    containerDimensions?: ContainerDimensions;
    /** Additional options for legend */
    legendOptions?: LegendOptions;
    /** Additional options for xAxis */
    xAxisOptions?: XAxisOptions;
    /** Additional options for yAxis */
    yAxisOptions?: YAxisOptions;
    /** Additional options for tooltip */
    tooltipOptions?: TooltipOptions;
    /** Options for PopUp */
    popUpOptions?: PopUpOptions;
    /** Enables/Disables grid for chart background */
    enableGrid?: boolean;
    /** If any two categorical charts(LineChart, AreaChart, BarChart, ComposedChart) have the same syncId,
     * these two charts can sync the position tooltip, and the startIndex, endIndex of Brush. */
    syncId?: string;
    /** orientation of the line graph */
    layout?: "horizontal" | "vertical";
    /** width of container */
    width?: number;
    /** height of container */
    height?: number;
    /** margin of container */
    margin?: Record<string, unknown>;
    /** This array of colors will override internal one, which is based on 'type' prop */
    customPalette?: string[];
    /** Indicates if chart has negative values */
    hasNegativeValue?: boolean;
    summaryOptions?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

type AreaGraphWithHocProps = AreaGraphProps & { hocProps?: HocProps };

export type BaseAreaGraphProps = Omit<AreaGraphProps, "hocProps"> & {
    state: RechartsState;
    palette: string[];
    updateRefAreaLeft: (e?: { activeLabel?: string | number }) => void;
    updateRefAreaRight: (e?: { activeLabel?: string | number }) => void;
    zoom: () => void;
};

const AreaGraph: React.FC<AreaGraphWithHocProps> = ({ hocProps, ...props }) => {
    const { state, palette, zoom, updateRefAreaLeft, updateRefAreaRight } = hocProps!;

    return (
        <BaseAreaGraph
            state={state}
            palette={palette}
            updateRefAreaLeft={updateRefAreaLeft}
            updateRefAreaRight={updateRefAreaRight}
            zoom={zoom}
            {...props}
        />
    );
};

const inBounds = (ndx: number, arr: unknown[]): boolean => {
    return ndx >= 0 && ndx < arr.length;
};

export const BaseAreaGraph: React.FC<BaseAreaGraphProps> = props => {
    const {
        state,
        palette,
        dataKeys,
        referenceLineArray,
        dateFormat,
        xAxisOptions = {},
        yAxisOptions = {},
        tooltipOptions = {},
        accessoryOptions = {},
        syncId,
        layout,
        width,
        height,
        margin = {},
        enableGrid,
        updateRefAreaLeft,
        updateRefAreaRight,
        zoom,
        brushStart,
        brushEnd,
        currentRange
    } = props;

    const { stateData, activeMap, left, right, refAreaLeft, refAreaRight, bottom, top, hasNegativeValue } = state;
    const { isStacked, hasZoom, hasBrush, hideToolTip } = accessoryOptions;
    const xAxisKey = xAxisOptions.dataKey ?? "name";
    const inBoundsStart = inBounds(brushStart ?? 0, stateData) ? brushStart ?? 0 : 0;
    const inBoundsEnd = inBounds(brushEnd ?? stateData.length - 1, stateData)
        ? brushEnd ?? stateData.length - 1
        : stateData.length - 1;
    const { leftBrush, rightBrush, handleBrushChange } = useBrush([inBoundsStart, inBoundsEnd]);
    const tickFormatter = getTickFormatter(xAxisOptions, dateFormat);

    /* istanbul ignore next */
    const onBrushChange = (e: { startIndex?: number; endIndex?: number }) => {
        handleBrushChange(e);
        if (currentRange) {
            currentRange(e as { startIndex: number; endIndex: number });
        }
    };

    return (
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%" minWidth="50px" minHeight="50px">
            <AreaChart
                width={width}
                height={height}
                data={stateData}
                syncId={syncId}
                layout={layout}
                margin={margin as { top?: number; right?: number; bottom?: number; left?: number }}
                onMouseDown={e => {
                    /* istanbul ignore next */
                    if (hasZoom) updateRefAreaLeft(e as { activeLabel?: string | number });
                }}
                onMouseMove={
                    /* istanbul ignore next */ e => {
                        /* istanbul ignore next */
                        if (refAreaLeft !== undefined && hasZoom)
                            updateRefAreaRight(e as { activeLabel?: string | number });
                    }
                }
                onMouseUp={zoom}
            >
                {enableGrid && <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />}
                <XAxis
                    allowDataOverflow
                    dataKey="name"
                    domain={hasZoom ? ([left, right] as any) : (["auto", "auto"] as any)}
                    tickFormatter={tickFormatter}
                    {...xAxisOptions}
                />
                <YAxis
                    allowDataOverflow
                    domain={
                        /* istanbul ignore next */ hasZoom
                            ? ([bottom, top] as any)
                            : ([hasNegativeValue ? "dataMin" : 0, "auto"] as any)
                    }
                    type="number"
                    {...yAxisOptions}
                />
                {!hideToolTip && (
                    <Tooltip
                        content={(<CustomToolTip />) as any}
                        customToolTipStyles={tooltipOptions?.customToolTipStyles as any}
                        {...(tooltipOptions as any)}
                        {...(dateFormat ? { dateFormat: true } : {})}
                    />
                )}
                {dataKeys.map((dataKeyProps, index) => {
                    const dataKeyValue = dataKeyProps?.dataKey;
                    const mapKey = typeof dataKeyValue === "function" ? String(index) : dataKeyValue;
                    if (activeMap.get(mapKey)) {
                        return (
                            <Area
                                key={typeof dataKeyValue === "function" ? index : String(dataKeyValue ?? index)}
                                type={(dataKeyProps?.types as any) ?? "monotone"}
                                stroke={dataKeyProps?.stroke ?? palette[index]}
                                stackId={isStacked ? 1 : index}
                                fill={dataKeyProps?.stroke ?? palette[index]}
                                dot={dataKeyProps?.dot ?? false}
                                name={dataKeyProps?.name?.toString()}
                                dataKey={dataKeyValue as any}
                            />
                        );
                    }
                })}
                {referenceLineArray && (
                    <ReferenceLine stroke="#E36D5A" strokeDasharray="3 3" segment={referenceLineArray as never} />
                )}
                {hasZoom && refAreaLeft !== undefined && refAreaRight !== undefined ? (
                    <ReferenceArea x1={refAreaLeft} x2={refAreaRight} strokeOpacity={0.3} />
                ) : null}
                {hasBrush && (
                    <Brush
                        data={stateData}
                        startIndex={leftBrush}
                        endIndex={rightBrush}
                        onChange={onBrushChange}
                        tickFormatter={tickFormatter}
                        dataKey={typeof xAxisKey === "function" ? undefined : xAxisKey}
                    />
                )}
            </AreaChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
    );
};

export default withAccessories()(AreaGraph);
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import {
    BarChart as ReBarChart,
    Bar,
    XAxis,
    YAxis,
    CartesianGrid,
    Tooltip,
    ResponsiveContainer,
    ReferenceLine,
    Brush,
    Text
} from "recharts";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import { CustomTooltip as CustomToolTip } from "@components/shared/Recharts/CustomTooltip";
import type {
    DataKeys,
    AccessoryOptions,
    ContainerDimensions,
    XAxisOptions,
    YAxisOptions,
    TooltipOptions,
    PopUpOptions,
    SummaryOptions
} from "@components/shared/Recharts/PropTypes";
import withAccessories from "@components/shared/Recharts/withAccessories";
import { getTickFormatter } from "@components/shared/Recharts/tickFormatters";

const DEFAULT_DIMENSIONS = { width: "100%", height: "350px" };
const DEFAULT_TOOLTIP_STYLES = { height: "auto", width: "200px", padding: "16px" };

type RechartsState = {
    stateData: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    activeMap: Map<string | number, boolean>;
};

type HocProps = {
    state: RechartsState;
    palette: string[];
};

export type BarChartProps = {
    /** Array of data objects to be fed into the chart including the name of each point on the X axis
     * and each data key/value pair for the Y axis */
    data: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    /** Additional data and parameter to feed into the bars, legend, tooltip */
    dataKeys: DataKeys;
    /** Formats the XAxis values using local date string format */
    dateFormat?: boolean;
    /** Color palette selection for graphs */
    type?: "default" | "secondary" | "dualHeat" | "heat";
    /** Shows the charts yAxis reference line at 0 */
    showZeroLine?: boolean;
    /** Header text */
    header?: string;
    /** Sub Header text */
    subHeader?: string;
    /** Y AxisLabel */
    yAxisLabel?: string;
    /** X AxisLabel */
    xAxisLabel?: string;
    /** Options for Graph that extends abilities beyond that of standard chart */
    accessoryOptions?: AccessoryOptions;
    /** Options for Custom BarChart Container */
    containerDimensions?: ContainerDimensions;
    /** Additional options for xAxis */
    xAxisOptions?: XAxisOptions;
    /** Additional options for yAxis */
    yAxisOptions?: YAxisOptions;
    /** Additional options for tooltip */
    tooltipOptions?: TooltipOptions;
    /** Additional options for summary */
    summaryOptions?: SummaryOptions;
    /** Options for PopUp */
    popUpOptions?: PopUpOptions;
    /** Enables/Disables stacked behavior for the bars */
    stacked?: boolean;
    /** Enables/Disables grid for chart background */
    enableGrid?: boolean;
    /** If any two categorical charts(LineChart, AreaChart, BarChart, ComposedChart) have the same syncId,
     * these two charts can sync the position tooltip, and the startIndex, endIndex of Brush. */
    syncId?: string;
    /** width of container */
    width?: number;
    /** height of container */
    height?: number;
    /** margin of container */
    margin?: Record<string, unknown>;
    /** This array of colors will override internal one, which is based on 'type' prop */
    customPalette?: string[];
    hocProps?: HocProps;
};

type BaseBarChartProps = Omit<BarChartProps, "data" | "dataKeys" | "hocProps"> & {
    state: RechartsState;
    palette: string[];
    dataKeys: DataKeys;
};

type CustomTickProps = {
    tickFormatter?: (value: unknown, index: number) => unknown;
    payload?: { value: unknown };
    index?: number;
    [key: string]: unknown;
};

const BarChart: React.FC<BarChartProps> = ({ hocProps, ...props }) => {
    const { state, palette } = hocProps!;

    return <BaseBarChart state={state} palette={palette} {...props} />;
};

const StyledText = styled(Text)`
    & tspan {
        fill: #697380;
    }
`;

const CustomTick: React.FC<CustomTickProps> = ({ tickFormatter, ...props }) => {
    const value = tickFormatter ? tickFormatter(props.payload?.value, props.index ?? 0) : props.payload?.value;
    return <StyledText {...props}>{value as any}</StyledText>;
};

export const BaseBarChart: React.FC<BaseBarChartProps> = props => {
    const {
        state,
        palette,
        dataKeys,
        dateFormat,
        xAxisOptions = {},
        yAxisOptions = {},
        tooltipOptions = {},
        accessoryOptions = {},
        syncId,
        width,
        height,
        margin = {},
        enableGrid,
        stacked,
        showZeroLine
    } = props;

    const { stateData, activeMap } = state;
    const { hasBrush, hideToolTip } = accessoryOptions;
    const xAxisKey = xAxisOptions.dataKey ?? "name";
    const tickFormatter = getTickFormatter(xAxisOptions, dateFormat);

    return (
        <ResponsiveContainer width={width ?? "100%"} height={height ?? "100%"}>
            <ReBarChart data={stateData} syncId={syncId} margin={margin} stackOffset="sign">
                {enableGrid && <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="1 5" />}
                <XAxis
                    dataKey={xAxisKey}
                    tick={<CustomTick />}
                    tickLine={false}
                    stroke="#a2a8b0"
                    tickFormatter={tickFormatter}
                    {...(xAxisOptions as any)}
                />
                <YAxis tick={<CustomTick />} tickLine={false} stroke="#a2a8b0" {...yAxisOptions} />
                {!hideToolTip && (
                    <Tooltip
                        content={<CustomToolTip />}
                        customToolTipStyles={DEFAULT_TOOLTIP_STYLES}
                        {...(tooltipOptions as any)}
                    />
                )}
                {dataKeys.map((props, index) => {
                    const dataKeyValue = typeof props?.dataKey === "function" ? index : props?.dataKey;
                    if (activeMap.get(dataKeyValue)) {
                        return (
                            <Bar
                                {...(props as any)}
                                key={
                                    /* istanbul ignore next */ (typeof props?.dataKey === "function"
                                        ? index
                                        : props?.dataKey) ?? index
                                }
                                fill={props?.fill ?? palette[index]}
                                stackId={stacked ? "a" : undefined}
                                name={props?.displayName}
                            />
                        );
                    }
                })}
                {showZeroLine && <ReferenceLine y={0} stroke="#697380" />}
                {hasBrush && <Brush dataKey={xAxisKey} height={56} stroke="#828a94" tickFormatter={tickFormatter} />}
            </ReBarChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
    );
};

export default withAccessories({ hasSummary: true })(BarChart);
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useState } from "react";
import CollapsePanel from "@molecules/CollapsePanel/CollapsePanel";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";

export type CollapsePanelGroupProps = {
    /**
     * each direct child will be wrapped in a collapse panel
     */
    children: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * used for testing
     */
    "data-testid"?: string;
    /**
     * array of strings that tie into the header of the children
     * will be used in order that is passed in
     */
    headers: string[];
    /**
     * Callback that is called when a panel has changed
     * returns the active index
     */
    onPanelChange?: (activeIndex: number) => void;
};

const CollapsePanelGroup: React.FC<CollapsePanelGroupProps> = ({
    children,
    headers,
    onPanelChange,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}) => {
    const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
    const handleActive = useCallback(
        (clickedIndex: number) => {
            if (clickedIndex === headers.length - 1 && activeIndex === clickedIndex) {
                return;
            }
            if (clickedIndex === activeIndex) {
                setActiveIndex(clickedIndex + 1);
                if (onPanelChange) {
                    onPanelChange(clickedIndex + 1);
                }
            } else {
                setActiveIndex(clickedIndex);
                if (onPanelChange) {
                    onPanelChange(clickedIndex);
                }
            }
        },
        [activeIndex, setActiveIndex, headers, onPanelChange]
    );

    // there currently is some bug with babel-plugin-styled-components that breaks when doing a children.map
    // on transpiled files, this is temporary to fix that, but will need to investigate the bigger issue
    let _children;
    if (children && Array.isArray(children) && children.length) {
        _children = children.map((panel, index) => (
            <CollapsePanel
                key={headers[index] + "-panel"}
                isCollapsed={activeIndex !== index}
                isActive={activeIndex === index}
                header={headers[index]}
                onHeaderClick={() => handleActive(index)}
            >
                <PanelWrap>{panel}</PanelWrap>
            </CollapsePanel>
        ));
    }

    return <CollapsePanelGroupWrap data-testid={dataTestId}>{_children && _children}</CollapsePanelGroupWrap>;
};

const PanelWrap = styled("div")`
    height: 100%;
    width: 100%;
    margin-bottom: 16px;
`;

// todo: fix up styles to use style tokens
const CollapsePanelGroupWrap = styled("div")`
    font-family: proxima-nova, Proxima, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;

    > div:nth-child(n + 2) {
        margin-top: 16px;
    }
`;

export default CollapsePanelGroup;
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useRef } from "react";
import BasicSlideout from "@organisms/BasicSlideout/BasicSlideout";
import ColumnReorderPanel, { ColumnReorderPanelHandle } from "./ColumnReorderPanel";

type Column = {
    accessor?: string;
    [key: string]: unknown;
};

export type ColumnReorderSlideoutProps = {
    isOpen: boolean;
    onClose: () => void;
    columns: Column[];
    onReorder: (columns: Column[]) => void;
    hiddenColumns: string[];
    onVisibilityChange: (hiddenColumns: string[]) => void;
    initialColumns: Column[];
    initialHiddenColumns?: string[];
    "data-testid"?: string;
    onColumnOrderChange?: (columns: Column[]) => void;
    onHiddenColumnsChange?: (hiddenColumns: string[]) => void;
    totalManageableColumns?: number;
};

const ColumnReorderSlideout = ({
    isOpen,
    onClose,
    columns,
    onReorder,
    hiddenColumns,
    onVisibilityChange,
    initialColumns,
    initialHiddenColumns,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: ColumnReorderSlideoutProps) => {
    const columnReorderPanelRef = useRef<ColumnReorderPanelHandle>(null);

    const handleResetColumns = useCallback(() => {
        // Only reset the ColumnReorderPanel's local state
        // This allows the user to see the reset changes and decide whether to apply them
        if (columnReorderPanelRef.current) {
            columnReorderPanelRef.current.resetToInitial();
        }
    }, []);

    const handleApplyColumnChanges = useCallback(() => {
        // Trigger the apply changes from ColumnReorderPanel
        if (columnReorderPanelRef.current) {
            columnReorderPanelRef.current.handleApplyChanges();
        }
        // Close the slideout after applying changes
        onClose();
    }, [onClose]);

    return (
        <BasicSlideout
            isOpen={isOpen}
            onCloseClick={onClose}
            title="Manage Columns"
            muiColumnsOverride={3}
            data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-column-reorder-slideout`}
            buttons={{
                cancel: {
                    text: "Cancel",
                    type: "border",
                    "data-testid": dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-slideout-cancel-button`
                },
                secondary: {
                    text: "Reset",
                    type: "border",
                    "data-testid": dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-slideout-reset-button`,
                    onClick: handleResetColumns
                },
                primary: {
                    text: "Apply",
                    "data-testid": dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-slideout-apply-changes-button`,
                    onClick: handleApplyColumnChanges
                }
            }}
        >
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                ref={columnReorderPanelRef}
                columns={columns}
                onReorder={onReorder}
                hiddenColumns={hiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={onVisibilityChange}
                onDone={onClose}
                initialColumns={initialColumns}
                initialHiddenColumns={initialHiddenColumns}
                dataTestId={dataTestId}
            />
        </BasicSlideout>
    );
};

export default ColumnReorderSlideout;
````

````typescript
import {
    columnVisibilityReducer,
    initializeVisibleColumns,
    toggleColumnVisibility,
    resetColumnVisibility,
    type ColumnVisibilityState
} from "./columnVisibilityReducer";

describe("columnVisibilityReducer", () => {
    const initialState = {
        visibleColumns: new Set(["column1", "column2"]),
        numberOfNonDisplayColumns: 2
    };

    describe("TOGGLE_VISIBILITY action", () => {
        it("should remove column from visible columns when it exists (if path)", () => {
            const action = toggleColumnVisibility("column1");
            const result = columnVisibilityReducer(initialState, action);

            expect(result.visibleColumns.has("column1")).toBe(false);
            expect(result.visibleColumns.has("column2")).toBe(true);
            expect(result.visibleColumns.size).toBe(1);
            expect(result.numberOfNonDisplayColumns).toBe(2);
        });

        it("should add column to visible columns when it does not exist (else path)", () => {
            const action = toggleColumnVisibility("column3");
            const result = columnVisibilityReducer(initialState, action);

            expect(result.visibleColumns.has("column1")).toBe(true);
            expect(result.visibleColumns.has("column2")).toBe(true);
            expect(result.visibleColumns.has("column3")).toBe(true);
            expect(result.visibleColumns.size).toBe(3);
            expect(result.numberOfNonDisplayColumns).toBe(2);
        });
    });

    describe("INITIALIZE action", () => {
        it("should initialize visible columns and track non-display columns", () => {
            const columns = [
                { accessor: "column1" },
                { accessor: "column2" },
                { accessor: "selection" },
                { accessor: "switchStatus" },
                { accessor: "action" },
                { accessor: "menu" }
            ];
            const hiddenColumns = ["column2", "selection", "switchStatus", "action", "menu"];
            const action = initializeVisibleColumns(columns, hiddenColumns);
            const result = columnVisibilityReducer({} as ColumnVisibilityState, action);

            expect(result.visibleColumns.has("column1")).toBe(true);
            expect(result.visibleColumns.has("column2")).toBe(false);
            expect(result.visibleColumns.has("selection")).toBe(false);
            expect(result.visibleColumns.has("switchStatus")).toBe(false);
            expect(result.visibleColumns.has("action")).toBe(false);
            expect(result.visibleColumns.has("menu")).toBe(false);
            expect(result.numberOfNonDisplayColumns).toBe(4);
        });
    });

    describe("RESET action", () => {
        it("should reset to initial state", () => {
            const resetState = {
                visibleColumns: new Set(["resetColumn1"]),
                numberOfNonDisplayColumns: 1
            };
            const action = resetColumnVisibility(resetState);
            const result = columnVisibilityReducer(initialState, action);

            expect(result).toEqual(resetState);
        });
    });

    describe("default case", () => {
        it("should return current state for unknown action", () => {
            const unknownAction = { type: "UNKNOWN_ACTION" } as any;
            const result = columnVisibilityReducer(initialState, unknownAction);

            expect(result).toBe(initialState);
        });
    });
});
````
