## File: src/components/organisms/DataTable/DataTablePanels/columnVisibilityReducer.ts
````typescript
import { Reducer } from "react";

export type ColumnVisibilityState = {
    visibleColumns: Set<string>;
    numberOfNonDisplayColumns: number;
};

type InitializeAction = {
    type: "INITIALIZE";
    columns: Array<{ accessor?: string }>;
    hiddenColumns: string[];
};

type ToggleVisibilityAction = {
    type: "TOGGLE_VISIBILITY";
    columnAccessor: string;
};

type ResetAction = {
    type: "RESET";
    initialState: ColumnVisibilityState;
};

export type ColumnVisibilityAction = InitializeAction | ToggleVisibilityAction | ResetAction;

// Column visibility reducer
export const columnVisibilityReducer: Reducer<ColumnVisibilityState, ColumnVisibilityAction> = (state, action) => {
    switch (action.type) {
        case "INITIALIZE": {
            const initialVisibleColumns = new Set<string>();
            const nonDisplayColumns = new Set<string>();

            for (const col of action.columns) {
                // Track non-display columns (selection, switchStatus, action, menu)
                if (
                    col.accessor === "selection" ||
                    col.accessor === "switchStatus" ||
                    col.accessor === "action" ||
                    col.accessor === "menu"
                ) {
                    nonDisplayColumns.add(col.accessor);
                }

                // Add column to visible set if it's not in hiddenColumns
                // This includes manageable: false columns that user previously selected
                if (col.accessor && !action.hiddenColumns.includes(col.accessor)) {
                    initialVisibleColumns.add(col.accessor);
                }
            }

            return {
                visibleColumns: initialVisibleColumns,
                numberOfNonDisplayColumns: nonDisplayColumns.size
            };
        }
        case "TOGGLE_VISIBILITY": {
            const newVisibleColumns = new Set(state.visibleColumns);
            if (newVisibleColumns.has(action.columnAccessor)) {
                newVisibleColumns.delete(action.columnAccessor);
            } else {
                newVisibleColumns.add(action.columnAccessor);
            }
            return {
                ...state,
                visibleColumns: newVisibleColumns
            };
        }
        case "RESET": {
            return action.initialState;
        }
        default:
            return state;
    }
};

// Action creators
export const initializeVisibleColumns = (columns: Array<{ accessor?: string }>, hiddenColumns: string[]) => ({
    type: "INITIALIZE" as const,
    columns,
    hiddenColumns
});

export const toggleColumnVisibility = (columnAccessor: string) => ({
    type: "TOGGLE_VISIBILITY" as const,
    columnAccessor
});

export const resetColumnVisibility = (initialState: ColumnVisibilityState) => ({
    type: "RESET" as const,
    initialState
});
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { ErrorMessagesWrap } from "../DataTableStyles";
import ErrorMessages from "../TableModules/ErrorMessages";

export type ErrorPanelProps = {
    rowsLength: number;
    hasPagination?: boolean;
    pageLength: number;
    errorMessages?: {
        noData?: string;
        noFilteredData?: string;
    };
    hasFilterGroup?: boolean;
    filteredData?: unknown[];
    preGlobalFilteredRows?: unknown[];
    loading?: boolean;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const ErrorPanel = ({
    rowsLength,
    hasPagination,
    pageLength,
    errorMessages,
    hasFilterGroup,
    filteredData,
    preGlobalFilteredRows,
    loading,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: ErrorPanelProps) => {
    return (
        <>
            {!loading && (rowsLength === 0 || (hasPagination && pageLength === 0)) && (
                <ErrorMessagesWrap>
                    {!loading}
                    <ErrorMessages
                        errorMessages={errorMessages}
                        hasFilterGroup={hasFilterGroup}
                        filteredDataSize={filteredData?.length}
                        preGlobalFilteredRows={preGlobalFilteredRows}
                        data-testid={dataTestId}
                    ></ErrorMessages>
                </ErrorMessagesWrap>
            )}
        </>
    );
};

export default ErrorPanel;
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import { StyledPaginationWrapper } from "../DataTableStyles";
import Pagination from "@molecules/Pagination/Pagination";

export type PaginationPanelProps = {
    hasPagination?: boolean;
    totalItems: number;
    paginationProps?: {
        itemsPerPage?: string | number;
        customItemsPerPage?: Array<{ label: string; value: string | number }>;
        pageSelection?: number;
        localizations?: Record<string, string>;
        onPaginationChange?: (data: { pageIndex: number; pageSize: string | number }) => void;
    };
    setPageSize: (pageSize: number) => void;
    setPageSizeValue: (pageSize: number) => void;
    gotoPage: (pageIndex: number) => void;
    setPageIndexValue: (pageIndex: number) => void;
    "data-testid"?: string;
    hasAsyncData?: boolean;
};

const PaginationPanelComponent = ({
    hasPagination,
    totalItems,
    paginationProps,
    setPageSize,
    setPageSizeValue,
    gotoPage,
    setPageIndexValue,
    "data-testid": dataTestId,
    hasAsyncData
}: PaginationPanelProps) => {
    // Pagination callback function
    // This function returns the pageIndex(integer) and pageSize(integer)
    // These parameters will set the pageIndexValue and currPageSize props for the datatable component
    const onPageChange = useCallback(
        (data: { pageIndex: number; pageSize: string | number }) => {
            const pageIndex = parseInt(String(data.pageIndex)) - 1;
            const pageSize =
                data.pageSize === "Show All" || data.pageSize === "" ? totalItems : parseInt(String(data?.pageSize));
            if (pageSize > 0) {
                setPageSize(pageSize);
                setPageSizeValue(pageSize);
            }
            gotoPage(parseInt(String(pageIndex)));
            setPageIndexValue(pageIndex);
        },
        [gotoPage, setPageIndexValue, setPageSize, setPageSizeValue, totalItems]
    );
    return (
        <>
            {hasPagination && (
                <StyledPaginationWrapper
                    $displayBorders={totalItems > 0}
                    data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-datatable-pagination-wrapper`}
                >
                    <Pagination
                        totalItems={totalItems}
                        onPaginationChange={hasAsyncData ? paginationProps?.onPaginationChange : onPageChange}
                        itemsPerPage={paginationProps?.itemsPerPage}
                        customItemsPerPage={paginationProps?.customItemsPerPage as any}
                        pageSelection={paginationProps?.pageSelection}
                        localizations={paginationProps?.localizations}
                        data-testid={dataTestId}
                    />
                </StyledPaginationWrapper>
            )}
        </>
    );
};

// Export the component wrapped with React.memo
export default React.memo(PaginationPanelComponent);
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import CustomizableToolbar from "../TableModules/CutomizableToolbar";
import { Collapse } from "@mui/material";
import { StickyToolbar } from "../DataTableStyles";

export type ToolBarPanelProps = {
    toolbarOptions?: {
        hideToolbar?: boolean;
        [key: string]: unknown;
    };
    isOpen: boolean;
    toggleAllRowsSelected: (value?: boolean) => void;
    localeTexts?: Record<string, string>;
    selectedRows?: unknown[];
    stickyToolBar: number;
    hasTopBar?: boolean;
    hasFilterGroup?: boolean;
    refetchData?: () => void;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const ToolBarPanelComponent = ({
    toolbarOptions,
    isOpen,
    toggleAllRowsSelected,
    localeTexts,
    selectedRows,
    stickyToolBar,
    hasTopBar,
    hasFilterGroup,
    refetchData,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: ToolBarPanelProps) => {
    const hideToolbar = toolbarOptions?.hideToolbar;
    const hasTopRadiusBorders = !hasTopBar && !hasFilterGroup;
    return (
        <>
            {!hideToolbar && (
                <StickyToolbar $topOffset={`${stickyToolBar}px`} data-testid="sticky-toolbar">
                    <Collapse in={isOpen} mountOnEnter={true} unmountOnExit={true}>
                        <CustomizableToolbar
                            toolbarOptions={toolbarOptions}
                            triggerAllRowsSelect={toggleAllRowsSelected}
                            localeTexts={localeTexts}
                            selectedRows={selectedRows}
                            hasTopRadiusBorders={hasTopRadiusBorders}
                            refetchData={refetchData}
                            parentDataTestId={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-collapse-toolbar`}
                        />
                    </Collapse>
                </StickyToolbar>
            )}
        </>
    );
};

export default React.memo(ToolBarPanelComponent);
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import useLazyBody from "./useLazyBody";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import type { Row } from "react-table";

describe("useLazyBody hook test", () => {
    const createRows = (number: number): Row[] => {
        const rows: Row[] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < number; i++) {
            rows.push({
                cells: [
                    {
                        column: {
                            type: i % 2 ? "text" : "status",
                            cellWidth: "100px"
                        },
                        getCellProps: () => {
                            return {
                                key: i
                            };
                        },
                        render: () => {
                            return <div>Stuff</div>;
                        }
                    }
                ],
                getRowProps: () => {
                    return {
                        key: i
                    };
                }
            } as unknown as Row);
        }
        return rows;
    };

    type RandomComponentProps = {
        numberOfRows: number;
        prefilterAmount: number;
    };

    const RandomComponent = ({ numberOfRows, prefilterAmount }: RandomComponentProps) => {
        const rows = createRows(numberOfRows);

        const { getCellInfo, increaseRowsLoaded, lazyRows } = useLazyBody(rows, prefilterAmount);

        return (
            <div onClick={() => increaseRowsLoaded()} data-testid="test">
                <span>{getCellInfo(0).dataTypes[0]}</span>
                <span>{getCellInfo(0).cellWidths[0]}</span>
                <span>{lazyRows}</span>
            </div>
        );
    };

    it("should handle prefilteramount differs of rows", async () => {

        rerender(<RandomComponent numberOfRows={200} prefilterAmount={300} />);

        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("test"));

        expect(screen.getByText("100")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should get cell information ", () => {
        render(<RandomComponent numberOfRows={100} prefilterAmount={100} />);

        expect(screen.getByText("100")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should get number of rows needed to load", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        render(<RandomComponent numberOfRows={100} prefilterAmount={100} />);

        //clicks div to see if there is more rows to increase by
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("test"));

        expect(screen.getByText("100")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should increase the number of rows needed to load", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        render(<RandomComponent numberOfRows={200} prefilterAmount={200} />);

        //clicks div to see if there is more rows to increase by
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("test"));

        expect(screen.getByText("200")).toBeInTheDocument();

        //we are at the limit, it should still be 200
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("test"));

        expect(screen.getByText("200")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should increase the number of rows needed to load", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();

        //clicks div to see if there is more rows to increase by
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("test"));

        //clicks div to see if there is more rows to increase by

        expect(screen.getByText("300")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
});
````

## File: src/components/organisms/DataTable/TableHooks/useLazyLoadBlur.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useMemo, ReactElement } from "react";
import TableCell from "@atoms/TableCell/TableCell";

type UseLazyLoadBlurParams = {
    id: string | number;
    getCellInfo: (rowInfo?: unknown) => { dataTypes: string[]; cellWidths: string[] };
    rowInfo?: unknown;
    hasSelections: boolean;
    isSubHeader: boolean;
};

const useLazyLoadBlur = ({ id, getCellInfo, rowInfo, hasSelections, isSubHeader }: UseLazyLoadBlurParams) =>
    useMemo(() => {
        const childrenStuff: ReactElement[] = [];
        const cellInfo = getCellInfo(rowInfo);
        for (const [i] of cellInfo.dataTypes.entries()) {
            if (i === 0 && hasSelections) {
                childrenStuff.push(
                    <div style={{ padding: "8px", backgroundColor: "#fafafa" }} key={`lazy-load-cell-${id}-${i}`}></div>
                );
            } else {
                childrenStuff.push(
                    <TableCell
                        componentType="div"
                        key={`lazy-load-cell-${id}-${i}`}
                        cellType={isSubHeader ? "subHeader" : "body"}
                        cellWidth={cellInfo.cellWidths[i]}
                        dataType={cellInfo.dataTypes[i]}
                    >
                        <div style={{ padding: "10px 0px", width: "100%", backgroundColor: "#fafafa" }}></div>
                    </TableCell>
                );
            }
        }
        return childrenStuff;
    }, [id, hasSelections, rowInfo, getCellInfo, isSubHeader]);

export { useLazyLoadBlur };
export default useLazyLoadBlur;
````

````typescript
import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { Column } from "react-table";
import MenuCell from "../PrebuiltCells/MenuCell";
import ActionCell, { type ActionItem } from "../PrebuiltCells/ActionCell";

export type UsePrepareColumnsParams = {
    hasRowActions?: boolean;
    columns: Column<Record<string, unknown>>[];
    rowActionList?: ActionItem[];
    refetchData?: () => void;
    dataTestId?: string;
};

const usePrepareColumns = ({
    hasRowActions,
    columns,
    rowActionList,
    refetchData,
    dataTestId
}: UsePrepareColumnsParams) =>
    useMemo(() => {
        let actionColumns: Column<Record<string, unknown>>[] = [];
        // Check if rowActionList is not empty and hasRowActions is true
        // and columns is not empty
        if (hasRowActions && columns?.length && rowActionList?.length && rowActionList.length > 0) {
            if (rowActionList.length < 3) {
                actionColumns = [
                    {
                        //key: "rowActions",
                        id: "rowActions",
                        Header: "",
                        accessor: "action",
                        isBuildIn: true,
                        type: "action",
                        disableSortBy: true,
                        reorderable: false,
                        manageable: false, // Action columns are not manageable
                        cellWidth: "50px",
                        Cell: ({ row }: { row: any }) => (
                            <ActionCell
                                value={rowActionList}
                                toggleRowSelected={row.toggleRowSelected}
                                rowIndex={row.index}
                                row={row}
                                refetchData={refetchData}
                                data-testid={dataTestId}
                            />
                        )
                    } as Column<Record<string, unknown>>
                ];
            } else {
                actionColumns = [
                    {
                        //key: "menu",
                        id: "menu",
                        Header: "",
                        accessor: "menu",
                        type: "menu",
                        disableSortBy: true,
                        reorderable: false,
                        manageable: false, // Menu columns are not manageable
                        isBuildIn: true,
                        cellWidth: "50px",
                        Cell: ({ row }: { row: any }) => (
                            <MenuCell
                                value={rowActionList}
                                toggleRowSelected={row.toggleRowSelected}
                                rowIndex={row.index}
                                row={row}
                                refetchData={refetchData}
                                data-testid={dataTestId}
                            />
                        )
                    } as Column<Record<string, unknown>>
                ];
            }
            return [...columns, ...actionColumns];
        }
        return columns;
    }, [columns, dataTestId, hasRowActions, refetchData, rowActionList]);

export default usePrepareColumns;
````

## File: src/components/organisms/DataTable/TableHooks/useSortByAlphanumeric.tsx
````typescript
import { useCallback } from "react";
import { Row } from "react-table";

const sortByAlphanumeric = (
    rowA: Row<Record<string, unknown>>,
    rowB: Row<Record<string, unknown>>,
    id: string,
    desc?: boolean
) => {
    const valueA = (rowA.original as Record<string, unknown>)[id]?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? "";
    const valueB = (rowB.original as Record<string, unknown>)[id]?.toString().toLowerCase() ?? "";
    if (desc) {
        return valueA.localeCompare(valueB) > 0 ? -1 : 1;
    }
    return valueB.localeCompare(valueA) > 0 ? 1 : -1;
};

const useSortByAplhanumeric = () => {
    const sortByInsensitiveCase = useCallback(
        (rowA: Row<Record<string, unknown>>, rowB: Row<Record<string, unknown>>, id: string, desc?: boolean) =>
            sortByAlphanumeric(rowA, rowB, id, desc),
        []
    );

    return { sortByInsensitiveCase };
};

export default useSortByAplhanumeric;
````

````typescript
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { useColumnOrder, useGlobalFilter, usePagination, useRowSelect, useSortBy } from "react-table";

type UseTableUtilsParams = {
    defaultSortBy: string | undefined;
    sortByDesc: boolean;
};

const useTableUtils = ({ defaultSortBy, sortByDesc }: UseTableUtilsParams) => {
    const tableHooks = useMemo(() => {
        return [useGlobalFilter, useSortBy, usePagination, useRowSelect, useColumnOrder].filter(p => p);
    }, []);

    const sortBy = useMemo(() => {
        return defaultSortBy ? [{ id: defaultSortBy, desc: sortByDesc }] : [];
    }, [defaultSortBy, sortByDesc]);

    return {
        tableHooks,
        sortBy
    };
};

export { useTableUtils };
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { fireEvent, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import useTypeCheckedOnClickRow from "./useTypeCheckedOnClickRow";

describe("useTypeCheckedOnClickRow hook test,", () => {
    type TestRow = { hasBeenOnClicked: boolean };

    const row: TestRow = { hasBeenOnClicked: false };
    const presentOnClick = () => (row.hasBeenOnClicked = true);
    const absentOnClick = null;

    type WrapperComponentProps = {
        onClick: (() => void) | null;
    };

    const WrapperComponent = ({ onClick }: WrapperComponentProps) => {
        useTypeCheckedOnClickRow({
            row: row,
            onClick: onClick as (() => void) | undefined
        });

        return <button onClick={onClick ?? undefined}></button>;
    };

    it("should trigger the onClick function on the row if the onClick function is present", () => {
        row.hasBeenOnClicked = false;

        render(<WrapperComponent onClick={presentOnClick} />);
        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button"));

        expect(row.hasBeenOnClicked).toBeTruthy();
    });

    it("should do nothing if the onClick function is not present", () => {
        row.hasBeenOnClicked = false;

        render(<WrapperComponent onClick={absentOnClick} />);
        fireEvent.click(screen.getByRole("button"));

        expect(row.hasBeenOnClicked).toBeFalsy();
    });
});
````

````typescript
import { useCallback } from "react";

type UseTypeCheckedOnClickRowParams = {
    onClick: ((row: unknown) => void) | undefined;
    row: unknown;
};

const useTypeCheckedOnClickRow = ({ onClick, row }: UseTypeCheckedOnClickRowParams) => {
    const noopCallback = useCallback(() => {}, []);

    return useCallback(
        () => (typeof onClick === "function" ? onClick(row) : noopCallback()),
        [onClick, row, noopCallback]
    );
````

````typescript
import React, { ReactElement } from "react";
import ActionMenuButton from "@molecules/ActionMenuButton/ActionMenuButton";
import Button from "@atoms/button/Button";
import type { ActionListItem } from "@atoms/ActionMenu/ActionMenu";
import type { FooterButtonWithClose } from "@molecules/ActionMenuButton/useFooterButtonGroupWithWrappedOnClick";

export type BulkAction = ActionListItem & {
    onClick?: () => void;
    actionList?: BulkAction[];
    footerButtonGroup?: FooterButtonWithClose[];
    actionMenuProps?: {
        emptyActionMessage?: string;
    };
    isRightAligned?: boolean;
    disablePortal?: boolean;
    isAutoClose?: boolean;
    emergencyZIndex?: number;
};

const renderActionButton = (
    action: BulkAction,
    index: number,
    handleOnClick: (onClick?: () => void) => (() => void) | undefined,
    parentDataTestId?: string
): ReactElement => {
    const hasActionList = action.actionList && action.actionList.length > 0;
    const hasEmptyActionMessage =
        action.actionList && action.actionList.length === 0 && action.actionMenuProps?.emptyActionMessage !== undefined;

    if (hasActionList || hasEmptyActionMessage) {
        return (
            <ActionMenuButton
                {...action}
                key={`bulk-action-${index}`}
                type="primary"
                isRightAligned={action.isRightAligned}
                onClick={handleOnClick(action?.onClick)}
                actionList={action.actionList}
                footerButtonGroup={action.footerButtonGroup}
                hasCaretIcon={!!action.actionList}
                disablePortal={action?.disablePortal || false}
                isAutoClose={action?.isAutoClose || false}
                emergencyZIndex={action?.emergencyZIndex || 1500}
                data-testid={parentDataTestId && `${parentDataTestId}-bulk-action-${action.id}`}
            >
                <span>{action.text}</span>
            </ActionMenuButton>
        );
    }

    return (
        <Button
            key={`bulk-action-${index}`}
            type="primary"
            isMinWidthZero={true}
            onClick={handleOnClick(action?.onClick)}
            data-testid={parentDataTestId && `${parentDataTestId}-bulk-action-${action.id}-action-btn`}
        >
            <span>{action.text}</span>
        </Button>
    );
};

export default renderActionButton;
````

````typescript
import { useCallback } from "react";

export type UseOnSelectedRemoveProps = {
    toggleAllRowsSelected?: (value: boolean) => void;
};

export type UseOnSelectedRemoveReturn = {
    onSelectedRemove: () => void;
    performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove: (functionToPerform: () => void) => void;
};

const useOnSelectedRemove = ({ toggleAllRowsSelected }: UseOnSelectedRemoveProps): UseOnSelectedRemoveReturn => {
    const onSelectedRemove = useCallback(() => {
        toggleAllRowsSelected?.(false);
    }, [toggleAllRowsSelected]);

    const performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove = useCallback(
        (functionToPerform: () => void) => {
            functionToPerform();
            onSelectedRemove();
        },
        [onSelectedRemove]
    );
    return { onSelectedRemove, performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove };
};

export default useOnSelectedRemove;
````

## File: src/components/organisms/DataTable/TableModules/DataTableToolbar/TableToolbarHooks/useValidElement.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useMemo, ReactElement } from "react";
import ActionMenuButton from "@molecules/ActionMenuButton/ActionMenuButton";

export type UseValidElementProps = {
    customButtons?: (() => ReactElement) | ReactElement;
};

export type UseValidElementReturn = {
    customComponent: ReactElement | undefined;
};

const useValidElement = ({ customButtons }: UseValidElementProps): UseValidElementReturn => {
    const customComponent = useMemo(() => {
        // Handle functions that return components
        if (typeof customButtons === "function") {
            // Invoke the function to get the component
            const component = customButtons();
            if (React.isValidElement(component)) {
                const isActionMenuButton = component.type === ActionMenuButton;
                if (isActionMenuButton) {
                    return React.cloneElement(component, {
                        emergencyZIndex: 9999
                    } as any);
                }
                return component;
            }
            return component;
            // Handle direct React element
        } else if (React.isValidElement(customButtons)) {
            const isActionMenuButton = customButtons.type === ActionMenuButton;
            if (isActionMenuButton) {
                return React.cloneElement(customButtons, {
                    emergencyZIndex: 9999
                } as any);
            }
            return customButtons;
        }
        return customButtons;
    }, [customButtons]);
    return { customComponent };
};
export default useValidElement;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { TableInfoBar } from "./TableToolbarStyle";
import useOnSelectedRemove from "./TableToolbarHooks/useOnSelectedRemove";
import TableToolbarSelectedWrapper from "./TableToolbarSelectedWrapper";
import { DEFAULT_LOCALE_TEXTS } from "./TableToolbarConstants";
import useBulkActionsMenuList from "./TableToolbarHooks/useBulkActionsMenuList";
import type { LocaleTexts } from "./TableToolbarConstants";
import type { BulkAction } from "./TableToolbarHooks/renderActionButton";

type BulkActionMenuInput = Omit<BulkAction, "onClick"> & {
    onClick?: (selectedRows: unknown, onSelectedRemove: () => void, refetchData?: () => void) => void;
    clearSelectionsAfterClick?: boolean;
};

export type TableToolbarProps = {
    localeTexts?: Partial<LocaleTexts>;
    bulkActionMenu?: BulkActionMenuInput[];
    numSelectedRows?: number;
    toggleAllRowsSelected?: (value: boolean) => void;
    selectedRows?: unknown;
    hasTopRadiusBorders?: boolean;
    refetchData?: () => void;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const TableToolbar: React.FC<TableToolbarProps> = ({
    localeTexts,
    bulkActionMenu,
    numSelectedRows,
    toggleAllRowsSelected,
    selectedRows,
    hasTopRadiusBorders,
    refetchData,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}) => {
    const localeTextOverwrites: LocaleTexts = { ...DEFAULT_LOCALE_TEXTS, ...localeTexts };

    const { onSelectedRemove, performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove } = useOnSelectedRemove({
        toggleAllRowsSelected: toggleAllRowsSelected
    });

    const bulkActionsMenuList = useBulkActionsMenuList({
        bulkActionMenu: bulkActionMenu as any,
        onSelectedRemove: onSelectedRemove,
        performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove: performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove,
        selectedRows: selectedRows,
        refetchData: refetchData
    });

    return (
        <TableInfoBar $borderTopRadius={hasTopRadiusBorders ? "4px" : "0"} data-testid={dataTestId}>
            <TableToolbarSelectedWrapper
                parentDataTestId={dataTestId}
                bulkActionMenu={bulkActionMenu}
                bulkActionsMenuList={bulkActionsMenuList}
                onSelectedRemove={onSelectedRemove}
                localeTextOverwrites={localeTextOverwrites}
                numSelectedRows={numSelectedRows}
                selectedRows={selectedRows}
            />
        </TableInfoBar>
    );
};

export default TableToolbar;
````

````typescript
import Button from "@atoms/button/Button";
import { ButtonGroup } from "./TableToolbarStyle";
import React, { ReactElement } from "react";
import useValidElement from "./TableToolbarHooks/useValidElement";
import type { ButtonType } from "@atoms/button/Button";

export type ButtonConfig = {
    primaryText?: string;
    secondaryText?: string;
    primaryOnClick?: () => void;
    secondaryOnClick?: () => void;
    primaryButtonType?: ButtonType;
    secondaryButtonType?: ButtonType;
    primaryDataTestId?: string;
    secondaryDataTestId?: string;
};

export type TableToolbarButtonGroupProps = {
    buttons?: ButtonConfig;
    customButtons?: (() => ReactElement) | ReactElement;
    dataTestId?: string;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
};

const TableToolbarButtonGroup: React.FC<TableToolbarButtonGroupProps> = ({
    buttons,
    customButtons,
    dataTestId,
    dataTrackAction
}) => {
    const { customComponent } = useValidElement({ customButtons });
    if (customButtons)
        return (
            <ButtonGroup
                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-topbar-custom-button`}
                data-track-action={dataTrackAction && `${dataTrackAction}-custom-btn`}
            >
                {customComponent}
            </ButtonGroup>
        );
    return (
        <ButtonGroup data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-topbar-buttons`}>
            {buttons?.secondaryText && (
                <Button
                    data-testid={buttons.secondaryDataTestId}
                    onClick={buttons.secondaryOnClick}
                    type={buttons.secondaryButtonType ? buttons.secondaryButtonType : "secondary"}
                    dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction && `${dataTrackAction}-secondary-btn`}
                >
                    {buttons.secondaryText}
                </Button>
            )}
            {buttons?.primaryText && (
                <Button
                    data-testid={buttons.primaryDataTestId}
                    onClick={buttons.primaryOnClick}
                    type={buttons.primaryButtonType ? buttons.primaryButtonType : "primary"}
                    dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction && `${dataTrackAction}-primary-btn`}
                >
                    {buttons.primaryText}
                </Button>
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import useDataTableAsync from "./DataTableAsyncContext";
import DataTable from "@organisms/DataTable/DataTable";

type FetchDataParams = {
    filters: {
        search: string;
        selected: Array<unknown>;
    };
    pageIndex: number;
    pageSize: string;
    sortBy: string;
    sortOrder: string;
};

type FetchDataResponse = {
    success?: boolean;
    rows: Array<unknown>;
    totalCount: number;
    totalFilteredCount: number;
    code?: string | number;
    status?: string | number;
};

export type DataTableAsyncWrapperProps = {
    /**
     * Function to fetch data
     * Signature: function(params: object) => Promise<object>
     */
    fetchData: (params: FetchDataParams) => Promise<FetchDataResponse>;
    columns: Array<unknown>;
    hasFilterGroup?: boolean;
    hasPagination?: boolean;
    hasSelections?: boolean;
    disableLoading?: boolean;
    toolbarOptions?: Record<string, unknown>;
    hasColumnReorder?: boolean;
    hasScrollX?: boolean;
    minWidth?: string;
    maxHeight?: string;
};

type CustomError = Error & {
    code?: string | number;
};

const DataTableAsyncWrapper: React.FC<DataTableAsyncWrapperProps> = ({
    fetchData,
    columns,
    hasFilterGroup,
    hasPagination,
    hasSelections,
    disableLoading,
    toolbarOptions: externalToolbarOptions,
    hasColumnReorder,
    hasScrollX,
    minWidth,
    maxHeight
}) => {
    const {
        filters,
        pageIndex,
        pageSize,
        loading,
        errorMessages,
        sortBy,
        sortOrder,
        data,
        totalCount,
        searchTerm,
        setData,
        setLoading,
        setTotalCount,
        setPageIndex,
        setPageSize,
        setFilters,
        setApiError,
        apiError,
        setSortBy,
        setSortOrder,
        topOffset,
        dataTestId,
        accessorKey,
        dataTrackAction,
        hasFixedLayout,
        hasRowActions,
        hiddenColumns,
        initialSelectionKey,
        localeTexts,
        onRowClick,
        onSelectedRowChanged,
        paginationProps,
        filterGroupOptions,
        rowActionList,
        refetchTrigger,
        setRefetchTrigger,
        setTotalFilteredCount,
        totalFilteredCount,
        setToolbarOptions
    } = useDataTableAsync();
    const [hasAPIError, setHasAPIError] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        let isActive = true; // Flag to track if the component is mounted

        // Fetch data when the component mounts or when any of the dependencies change
        const fetchDataAsync = async () => {
            setLoading(true); // Set loading to true when the component mounts
            try {
                // This function should return a promise that resolves to the data
                const response = await fetchData({
                    filters,
                    pageIndex,
                    pageSize,
                    sortBy,
                    sortOrder
                });

                // If the response is not successful, set the API error state
                // Throw an Error with a custom message and code for upstream handling
                if ("success" in response && response.success === false) {
                    const error: CustomError = new Error("Failed to fetch data");
                    error.code = response.code || response.status;
                    throw error;
                }

                // Destructure the response to get the rows, totalCount, and totalFilteredCount
                const { rows, totalCount, totalFilteredCount } = response;

                // Check if the component is still mounted before setting state
                if (!isActive) return; // If the component is unmounted, do not set state

                setData(rows);
                setTotalFilteredCount(totalFilteredCount); // Set the initial total count
                setTotalCount(totalCount); // Set the total count to the length of rows if totalCount is not provided
                setHasAPIError(false); // Reset the API error state
                setApiError(null); // Clear any previous error messages
            } catch (error) {
                if (!isActive) return; // If the component is unmounted, do not set state

                const customError = error as CustomError;
                //console.error("Error fetching data:", error);
                setHasAPIError(true);
                setApiError({ message: customError.message, code: customError.code });
                setData([]);
                setTotalCount(0);
                setTotalFilteredCount(0); // Reset the initial total count
            } finally {
                if (isActive) {
                    setLoading(false); // Set loading to false when the data is fetched
                }
            }
        };

        // Call the fetchData function
        // This will be called when the component mounts and when any of the dependencies change
        fetchDataAsync();

        return () => {
            isActive = false; // Cleanup function to set isMounted to false
        };
    }, [
        fetchData,
        filters,
        pageIndex,
        pageSize,
        setLoading,
        setData,
        setTotalCount,
        searchTerm,
        setApiError,
        sortBy,
        sortOrder,
        errorMessages,
        refetchTrigger,
        setTotalFilteredCount
    ]);

    // Effect to sync external toolbar options with context
    useEffect(() => {
        if (externalToolbarOptions) {
            setToolbarOptions(externalToolbarOptions);
        }
    }, [externalToolbarOptions, setToolbarOptions]);

    // Memoize the data to prevent unnecessary re-renders
    const memoData = useMemo(() => data, [data]);

    // Memoize totalCount to avoid unnecessary recalculations
    const memoTotalCount = useMemo(() => totalCount, [totalCount]);

    const errorMessagesAsyncProps = useMemo(() => {
        return {
            ...errorMessages,
            apiError: hasAPIError
                ? {
                      code: `Error code: ${apiError?.code || "UNKNOWN"}`,
                      line1: `Failed to fetch data.`,
                      line2: apiError?.message
                  }
                : null
        } as any; // Extended errorMessages type for async with apiError property
    }, [errorMessages, hasAPIError, apiError]);

    const onFilterChangeAsync = useCallback(
        (filters: { search: string; selected: Array<unknown> }) => {
            setFilters(filters);
        },
        [setFilters]
    );

    const onPageChangeAsync = useCallback(
        (data: { pageIndex?: number; pageSize?: string }) => {
            if (data?.pageIndex !== undefined) {
                setPageIndex(data.pageIndex); // Preserve pageIndex
            }
            if (data?.pageSize !== undefined) {
                setPageSize(data.pageSize);
            }
        },
        [setPageIndex, setPageSize]
    );

    const memoFilterGroupOptions = useMemo(() => {
        return {
            ...filterGroupOptions,
            onFilterChange: onFilterChangeAsync
        } as any; // Spread preserves required fields from filterGroupOptions
    }, [filterGroupOptions, onFilterChangeAsync]);

    const memoPaginationProps = useMemo(() => {
        return {
            ...paginationProps,
            onPaginationChange: onPageChangeAsync
        };
    }, [paginationProps, onPageChangeAsync]);

    const memoToolbarOptions = useMemo(() => {
        if (!externalToolbarOptions?.bulkActionMenu) {
            return externalToolbarOptions;
        }

        // Pass through the toolbar options without modifying the handlers
        return {
            ...externalToolbarOptions
        };
    }, [externalToolbarOptions]);

    return (
        <>
            <DataTable
                data={memoData as Array<Record<string, unknown>>}
                accessorKey={accessorKey}
                columns={columns as Array<{ Header: string; accessor: string; type: string; cellWidth: string }>}
                dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction}
                defaultSortBy={sortBy}
                sortByDesc={sortOrder === "desc"}
                setSortBy={setSortBy}
                setSortOrder={setSortOrder}
                errorMessages={errorMessagesAsyncProps}
                filterGroupOptions={memoFilterGroupOptions}
                hasFilterGroup={hasFilterGroup}
                hasFixedLayout={hasFixedLayout}
                hasPagination={hasPagination}
                hasRowActions={hasRowActions}
                hasSelections={hasSelections}
                hiddenColumns={hiddenColumns}
                initialSelectionKey={initialSelectionKey}
                loading={loading}
                localeTexts={localeTexts}
                onRowClick={onRowClick}
                onSelectedRowChanged={onSelectedRowChanged}
                paginationProps={memoPaginationProps}
                rowActionList={rowActionList}
                toolbarOptions={memoToolbarOptions}
                topOffset={topOffset}
                totalCount={memoTotalCount}
                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-async`}
                hasAsyncData
                refetchData={setRefetchTrigger}
                totalFilteredCount={totalFilteredCount}
                disableLoading={disableLoading}
                hasColumnReorder={hasColumnReorder}
                hasScrollX={hasScrollX}
                minWidth={minWidth}
                maxHeight={maxHeight}
            />
        </>
    );
};

export default DataTableAsyncWrapper;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { PieChart, Pie, Cell, Tooltip } from "recharts";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import type {
    AccessoryOptions,
    ContainerDimensions,
    TooltipOptions,
    SummaryOptions
} from "@components/shared/Recharts/PropTypes";
import { GraphContainer } from "@components/shared/Recharts/StyledComponents";
import { getChartsColorPalette } from "@components/shared/Recharts/getChartsColorPalette";
import { ChartSummary } from "@components/shared/Recharts/ChartSummary";

const HORIZONTAL_ALIGN = {
    LEFT: "left",
    RIGHT: "right",
    CENTER: "center"
} as const;

const VERTICAL_ALIGN = {
    TOP: "top",
    BOTTOM: "bottom",
    MIDDLE: "middle"
} as const;

type HorizontalAlign = (typeof HORIZONTAL_ALIGN)[keyof typeof HORIZONTAL_ALIGN];
type VerticalAlign = (typeof VERTICAL_ALIGN)[keyof typeof VERTICAL_ALIGN];

const StyledPieChartWrapper = styled("div")`
    & .recharts-wrapper {
        height: 100% !important;
    }
    & .recharts-surface {
        height: 100% !important;
    }
`;

type GetCXParams = {
    width: number;
    height: number;
    align: HorizontalAlign;
    radius: number;
    margin: { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number };
};

const getCX = ({ width, height, align, radius, margin }: GetCXParams): number | undefined => {
    if (align !== HORIZONTAL_ALIGN.CENTER && width - margin.left - margin.right > height - margin.top - margin.bottom) {
        return align === HORIZONTAL_ALIGN.LEFT
            ? radius + margin.left
            : align === HORIZONTAL_ALIGN.RIGHT
            ? width - radius - margin.right
            : undefined;
    } else {
        return undefined;
    }
};

type GetCYParams = {
    width: number;
    height: number;
    align: VerticalAlign;
    radius: number;
    margin: { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number };
};

const getCY = ({ width, height, align, radius, margin }: GetCYParams): number | undefined => {
    if (align !== VERTICAL_ALIGN.MIDDLE && width - margin.left - margin.right < height - margin.top - margin.bottom) {
        return align === VERTICAL_ALIGN.TOP
            ? radius + margin.top
            : align === VERTICAL_ALIGN.BOTTOM
            ? height - radius - margin.bottom
            : undefined;
    } else {
        return undefined;
    }
};

export type DonutChartProps = {
    /** Dimensions for chart container */
    containerDimensions?: ContainerDimensions;
    /** Width of PieChart component (in pixels) */
    width: number;
    /** Height of PieChart component (in pixels) */
    height: number;
    /** Four margins of PieChart component (in pixels) */
    margin?: { top: number; right: number; bottom: number; left: number };
    /** Horizontal align of the chart (use when width is greater than height) */
    horizontalAlign?: HorizontalAlign;
    /** Vertical align of the chart (use when height is greater than width) */
    verticalAlign?: VerticalAlign;
    /** Array of data objects to be fed into the chart containing name and value for each sector */
    data: Array<Record<string, unknown>>;
    /** Color palette selection for graphs */
    type?: "default" | "secondary" | "dualHeat" | "heat";
    /** This array of colors will override internal one, which is based on 'type' prop */
    customPalette?: string[];
    /** The key of each sector's name */
    nameKey?: string;
    /** The key of each sector's value */
    valueKey?: string;
    /** Additional options for tooltip */
    tooltipOptions?: TooltipOptions;
    /** Additional options for summary */
    summaryOptions?: SummaryOptions;
    /** Options for accessories (hideTooltip prop in this case) */
    accessoryOptions?: AccessoryOptions;
    /** Animation flag (just for tests) */
    isAnimationActive?: boolean;
};

const DonutChart: React.FC<DonutChartProps> = ({
    containerDimensions = { width: "100%", height: "100%" },
    width,
    height,
    margin = { top: 0, right: 0, bottom: 0, left: 0 },
    horizontalAlign = HORIZONTAL_ALIGN.CENTER,
    verticalAlign = VERTICAL_ALIGN.MIDDLE,
    data = [],
    type,
    customPalette,
    nameKey = "name",
    valueKey = "value",
    tooltipOptions = {},
    accessoryOptions = {},
    summaryOptions = {},
    isAnimationActive
}) => {
    const { hideToolTip, hideSummary } = accessoryOptions;
    const palette = customPalette ?? getChartsColorPalette(type);
    const summaryData = data.map((item, index) => ({
        name: item[nameKey] as string,
        value: item[valueKey] as number,
        color: palette[index % palette.length]
    }));
    const outerRadius = Math.min(width - margin.left - margin.right, height - margin.top - margin.bottom) / 2;
    const innerRadius = outerRadius * 0.75;
    const cx = getCX({ width, height, align: horizontalAlign, radius: outerRadius, margin });
    const cy = getCY({ width, height, align: verticalAlign, radius: outerRadius, margin });

    return (
        <GraphContainer horizontal $dimensions={containerDimensions} data-testid="graph-container">
            <StyledPieChartWrapper>
                <PieChart width={width} height={height} margin={margin}>
                    <Pie
                        nameKey={nameKey}
                        dataKey={valueKey}
                        data={data}
                        cx={cx}
                        cy={cy}
                        innerRadius={innerRadius}
                        outerRadius={outerRadius}
                        paddingAngle={1}
                        startAngle={90}
                        endAngle={-270}
                        isAnimationActive={isAnimationActive}
                    >
                        {data.map((_, index) => (
                            <Cell key={`cell-${index}`} fill={palette[index % palette.length]} />
                        ))}
                    </Pie>
                    {!hideToolTip && <Tooltip {...(tooltipOptions as any)} />}
                </PieChart>
            </StyledPieChartWrapper>
            {!hideSummary && <ChartSummary vertical data={summaryData} options={summaryOptions} />}
        </GraphContainer>
    );
};

export default DonutChart;
````

````typescript
            description: "Fields to be excluded from search"
        }
    }

const listLabels = ["Rick", "Oscar", "Pilot"];

const generateLabels = () => {
    const returnVal: number[] = [];
    const maxLabelNum = Math.floor(Math.random() * 4);
    while (returnVal.length < maxLabelNum) {
        const label = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
        if (returnVal.indexOf(label) === -1) {
            returnVal.push(label);
        }
    }
    return returnVal.length === 0 ? [1] : returnVal;
};

const randomColors = (min = 1, max = 12) => {
    const difference = max - min;
    let rand = Math.random();
    rand = Math.floor(rand * difference);
    rand = rand + min;
    return rand;
};

const AddLabels = (data: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    data["labels"] = [];
    const randomLabels = generateLabels().sort((a, b) => a - b);
    data["labels"] = randomLabels.map(label => {
        const randomIcon = Math.floor(Math.random() * 2);
        return {
            text: listLabels[label],
            color: randomColors(),
            isParentSized: false,
            icon: randomIcon ? () => <i className="fas fa-lock" /> : null
        };
    });
    return data;
};
````

````typescript
import React, { useState, useCallback } from "react";
import Grid from "@mui/material/Grid";
import Textbox from "@atoms/textbox/Textbox";
import { StyledSearchBox } from "./FilterGroup.styles";
import useFilterGroup from "./FilterGroupContext";

type ClearButtonProps = {
    onClick: () => void;
};

const ClearButton: React.FC<ClearButtonProps> = ({ onClick }) => {
    return (
        <span
            style={{ display: "flex", cursor: "pointer", color: "red", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}
            role="button"
            tabIndex={0}
            onClick={onClick}
            onKeyDown={e => {
                if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
                    e.preventDefault();
                    onClick();
                }
            }}
        >
            <i aria-label={"Clear search"} data-testid="filtergroup-search-clear" className="fas fa-times-circle" />
        </span>
    );
};

type FilterGroupSearchProps = {
    onKeyUp?: (event: React.KeyboardEvent) => void;
    onSearch?: (value: string | null) => void;
};

const FilterGroupSearch: React.FC<FilterGroupSearchProps> = ({ onSearch, onKeyUp }) => {
    const [term, setTerm] = useState("");
    const { dataTrackAction } = useFilterGroup() || {};

    const onHandleSearch = useCallback(
        (value: string) => {
            setTerm(value);
            onSearch && onSearch(value);
        },
        [onSearch]
    );

    const onClearSearch = useCallback(() => {
        setTerm("");
        onSearch && onSearch(null);
    }, [onSearch]);

    return (
        <Grid
            container
            alignContent="flex-end"
            alignItems="flex-end"
            direction="row"
            justifyContent="flex-end"
            wrap="wrap"
            sx={{ width: "100%" }}
        >
            <div>
                <StyledSearchBox data-testid="filtergroup-search">
                    <Textbox
                        placeholder="Search..."
                        value={term}
                        onChange={onHandleSearch}
                        startAdornment={<i className="fas fa-search" />}
                        endAdornment={term ? <ClearButton onClick={onClearSearch} /> : null}
                        _isInFilterGroup
                        isFilterGroupSearch
                        ariaLabel={"Search"}
                        onKeyUp={onKeyUp}
                        dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction && `${dataTrackAction}-filter-group-search`}
                        data-testid="filtergroup-search-textbox"
                    />
                </StyledSearchBox>
            </div>
        </Grid>
    );
};

export default FilterGroupSearch;
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import ContentGrid from "@atoms/ContentGrid/ContentGrid";
import useFilterGroup from "./FilterGroupContext";
import { StyledTokenBox } from "./FilterGroup.styles";
import { renderTokens } from "./FilterGroupHelpers";

type Token = {
    filterGroup: string;
    getOptionsValues?: (value: unknown) => unknown;
    id: string;
    label: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    value: unknown;
};

type FilterGroupTokensProps = {
    onDelete?: (token: Token) => void;
};

const FilterGroupTokens: React.FC<FilterGroupTokensProps> = ({ onDelete }) => {
    const { tokens, hasSort } = useFilterGroup();

    const handleDelete = useCallback(
        (token: Token) => {
            onDelete && onDelete(token);
        },
        [onDelete]
    );
    return (
        <ContentGrid data-testid="filtergroup-tokens" columnSize={12}>
            {tokens.length > 0 && (
                <StyledTokenBox>
                    {hasSort &&
                        tokens
                            .filter(token => token.filterGroup.toLowerCase() === "sort by")
                            .map(token => renderTokens(token, handleDelete, "filtergroup-sort-chip"))}
                    {tokens
                        .filter(token => !(token.filterGroup.toLowerCase() === "sort by"))
                        .map(token => renderTokens(token, handleDelete, "filtergroup-filter-chip"))}
                </StyledTokenBox>
            )}
        </ContentGrid>
    );
};

export default FilterGroupTokens;
````

````typescript
    const searchByFilteredData = useSearchByFilterGroup(excludedFieldsOnSearch, maxSearchDepth);

    const applyFilters = useCallback(
        (arrayFilters: SelectedFilter[], searchValue: string | null) => {
            return getFilteredData(
                data,
                filterGroupTypes,
                arrayFilters,
                hasSort,
                searchValue,
                sortByFilteredData,
                searchByFilteredData
            );
        },
        [data, filterGroupTypes, hasSort, searchByFilteredData, sortByFilteredData]
    );

    const removeSelectedGroup = useCallback(
        (id: string, filterGroup: string, isMultiselect?: boolean) => {
            removeFilterByGroup(id, filterGroup);
            removeTokenByGroup(id, filterGroup);
            if (isMultiselect) {
                removeAllOptionByGroup(id, filterGroup);
            }
        },
        [removeAllOptionByGroup, removeFilterByGroup, removeTokenByGroup]
    );

    const addSelectedFilter = useCallback(
        (
            selectedItem: SelectedItem,
            id: string,
            filterGroup: string,
            placeholder: string | undefined,
            setValue: (value: unknown) => void,
            getOptionsValues: ((value: unknown) => unknown) | undefined,
            isMultiselect: boolean | undefined
        ) => {
            const filterName = selectedItem.value as string;
            addFilter(id, filterName, filterGroup);
            addFilterToken(
                selectedItem,
                id,
                filterGroup,
                placeholder,
                setValue,
                getOptionsValues,
                isMultiselect,
                addToken
            );
            if (isMultiselect) {
                addOptionByGroup(id, selectedItem.label, selectedItem.value, filterGroup);
            }
        },
        [addFilter, addOptionByGroup, addToken]
    );

    return {
        addSelectedFilter,
        applyFilters,
        maxFilterGroups,
        removeSelectedGroup
    };
};

export default FilterGroupUtils;
````

````typescript
import { useCallback } from "react";

const searchInFilteredData = (
    data: Record<string, unknown>[],
    searchTerm: string,
    excludedList: string[] | undefined,
    maxDepth: number | undefined
) => {
    if (!searchTerm) return data;

    const trimmedSearchTerm = searchTerm.trim().toLowerCase();
    const isDash = trimmedSearchTerm === "-" || trimmedSearchTerm === "–";
    const maxD = maxDepth || 5;
    const excluded = excludedList || [];

    const search = (item: unknown, currentPath = "", depth = 0): boolean => {
        if (depth > maxD) return false;

        if (Array.isArray(item)) {
            return item.some((subItem, index) => search(subItem, `${currentPath}[${index}]`, depth + 1));
        } else if (typeof item === "object" && item !== null) {
            return Object.entries(item).some(([key, value]) => {
                const path = currentPath ? `${currentPath}.${key}` : key;

                if (excluded.includes(path) || excluded.some(ex => path.startsWith(ex))) {
                    return false;
                }

                return search(value, path, depth + 1);
            });
        } else if (typeof item === "number" || typeof item === "boolean") {
            return item.toString().includes(trimmedSearchTerm);
        }

        if (isDash) {
            return (
                item === null ||
                item === undefined ||
                item === "–" ||
                item === "-" ||
                (typeof item === "string" && item.includes("-"))
            );
        }
        return typeof item === "string" && item.toLowerCase().includes(trimmedSearchTerm);
    };

    return data.filter(item => search(item));
};

const useSearchByFilterGroup = (excludedList: string[] | undefined, maxSearchDepth: number | undefined) =>
    useCallback(
        (searchValue: string, filteredData: Record<string, unknown>[]) => {
            return searchInFilteredData(filteredData, searchValue.trim(), excludedList, maxSearchDepth);
        },
        [excludedList, maxSearchDepth]
    );

export default useSearchByFilterGroup;
````

````typescript
import { useCallback } from "react";
import { getSortByDefault, getSortByFilteredData, sortFilterExists } from "./FilterGroupHelpers";

type SelectedFilter = {
    filterGroup: string;
    filterName: string;
    id: string;
};

const useSortByFilterGroup = (defaultSortGroup: string | undefined, defaultSortByDesc: boolean | undefined) =>
    useCallback(
        (arrayFilters: SelectedFilter[], filteredData: Record<string, unknown>[]) => {
            if (arrayFilters?.length > 0 && sortFilterExists(arrayFilters)) {
                getSortByFilteredData(arrayFilters, filteredData);
            } else {
                getSortByDefault(filteredData, defaultSortGroup, defaultSortByDesc);

        },

    );
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import { setFilteredCards, useGridDispatch, useGridState } from "../GridContext";
import useStickyPosition from "@hooks/useStickyPosition";
import { FilterGroupPanelWrapper } from "../Grid.styles";
import FilterGroup from "@organisms/FilterGroup/FilterGroup";

export type FilterGroupPanelProps = {
    filterGroupProps: Record<string, unknown>;
    topBarHeight: number;
};

const FilterGroupPanel: React.FC<FilterGroupPanelProps> = ({ filterGroupProps, topBarHeight }) => {
    const { allCards, hasFilterGroup, hasTopBar, topOffset, dataTestId } = useGridState();
    const dispatch = useGridDispatch();

    const { stickyTopFilterGroup } = useStickyPosition({ hasTopBar, topBarHeight, topOffset });

    const displayFilterGroup = useMemo(
        () => hasFilterGroup && !!filterGroupProps && Object.keys(filterGroupProps).length > 0,
        [filterGroupProps, hasFilterGroup]
    );

    const handleFilteredData = useCallback(
        (filteredCards: unknown[]) => {
            dispatch(setFilteredCards(filteredCards));
            const onChangeData = filterGroupProps?.onChangeData as ((data: unknown[]) => void) | undefined;
            onChangeData && onChangeData(filteredCards);
        },
        [dispatch, filterGroupProps]
    );

    return (
        <>
            {displayFilterGroup && (
                <FilterGroupPanelWrapper
                    $topOffset={`${stickyTopFilterGroup}px`}
                    data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-list-filter-group-panel-wrapper`}
                >
                    <FilterGroup
                        {...filterGroupProps}
                        data={allCards as Record<string, unknown>[]}
                        onChangeData={handleFilteredData}
                        hasResultCount
                        displayTokens
                        data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-list-filter-group`}
                    />
                </FilterGroupPanelWrapper>
            )}
        </>
    );
};

export default FilterGroupPanel;
````

````typescript
import React, { createContext, useContext, useMemo, useReducer } from "react";
import { DEFAULT_CARD_WIDTH } from "@components/molecules/Card/CardConstant";

export type TopBarOptions = {
    topBar?: unknown;
    buttons?: Record<string, unknown>;
    customButtons?: unknown;
};

export type GridState = {
    cards: unknown[];
    accessorKey: string;
    hasFilterGroup: boolean;
    hasPagination: boolean;
    selectedId: unknown;
    itemsPerPage: number;
    pageSelection: number;
    allCards: unknown[];
    filteredCards: unknown[];
    currentCards: unknown[];
    hasTopBar: boolean;
    topOffset: string;
    cardWidth: number;
    dataTestId?: string;
};

type SetCardsAction = {
    type: "SET_CARDS";
    cards: unknown[];
};

type SetFilteredCardsAction = {
    type: "SET_FILTERED_CARDS";
    filteredCards: unknown[];
};

type SetCardsPerPageAction = {
    type: "SET_CARDS_PER_PAGE";
    itemsPerPage: number;
};

type SetPageSelectionAction = {
    type: "SET_PAGE_SELECTION";
    pageSelection: number;
};

export type GridAction = SetCardsAction | SetFilteredCardsAction | SetCardsPerPageAction | SetPageSelectionAction;

export type GridContextValue = {
    state: GridState;
    dispatch: React.Dispatch<GridAction>;
};

export type GridProviderProps = {
    cards: unknown[];
    accessorKey: string;
    hasFilterGroup: boolean;
    hasPagination: boolean;
    topBarOptions: TopBarOptions;
    topOffset: string;
    children: React.ReactNode;
    dataTestId?: string;
};

export const GridContext = createContext<GridContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

// initial state
const initialState = (
    cards: unknown[],
    accessorKey: string,
    hasFilterGroup: boolean,
    hasPagination: boolean,
    topBarOptions: TopBarOptions,
    topOffset: string,
    dataTestId?: string
): GridState => {
    return {
        cards,
        accessorKey,
        hasFilterGroup,
        hasPagination,
        selectedId: null,
        itemsPerPage: 10,
        pageSelection: 1,
        allCards: [],
        filteredCards: [],
        currentCards: [],
        hasTopBar: hasTopBar(topBarOptions),
        topOffset,
        cardWidth: getCardWidth(cards?.[0]),
        dataTestId
    };
};

const hasTopBar = (topBarOptions: TopBarOptions) =>
    !!(
        topBarOptions?.topBar ||
        (topBarOptions?.buttons && Object.keys(topBarOptions.buttons).length > 0) ||
        topBarOptions?.customButtons
    );

const getCardWidth = (card: unknown) => {
    if (card) {
        const width = (card as Record<string, unknown>)?.width || DEFAULT_CARD_WIDTH;
        return typeof width === "number" ? width : DEFAULT_CARD_WIDTH;
    }
    return DEFAULT_CARD_WIDTH;
};

// Action types
const SET_CARDS = "SET_CARDS";
const SET_FILTERED_CARDS = "SET_FILTERED_CARDS";
const SET_CARDS_PER_PAGE = "SET_CARDS_PER_PAGE";
const SET_PAGE_SELECTION = "SET_PAGE_SELECTION";

export const gridReducer: React.Reducer<GridState, GridAction> = (state, action) => {
    switch (action.type) {
        case SET_CARDS: {
            const fullCards = state.hasPagination
                ? calculateCurrentCards(action.cards, state.pageSelection, state.itemsPerPage)
                : action.cards;
            return {
                ...state,
                allCards: action.cards,
                filteredCards: action.cards,
                currentCards: fullCards
            };
        }
        case SET_FILTERED_CARDS: {
            const filteredCards = state.hasPagination
                ? calculateCurrentCards(action.filteredCards, state.pageSelection, state.itemsPerPage)
                : action.filteredCards;
            return {
                ...state,
                filteredCards: action.filteredCards,
                currentCards: filteredCards
            };
        }
        case SET_CARDS_PER_PAGE: {
            return {
                ...state,
                itemsPerPage: action.itemsPerPage,
                currentCards: calculateCurrentCards(state.filteredCards, state.pageSelection, action.itemsPerPage)
            };
        }
        case SET_PAGE_SELECTION: {
            return {
                ...state,
                pageSelection: action.pageSelection,
                currentCards: calculateCurrentCards(state.filteredCards, action.pageSelection, state.itemsPerPage)
            };
        }
        default:
            return state;
    }
};

const calculateCurrentCards = (cards: unknown[], pageSelection: number, itemsPerPage: number) => {
    const startIndex = (pageSelection - 1) * itemsPerPage;
    const endIndex = startIndex + itemsPerPage;
    return cards.slice(startIndex, endIndex);
};

export const GridProvider: React.FC<GridProviderProps> = ({
    cards,
    accessorKey,
    hasFilterGroup,
    hasPagination,
    topBarOptions,
    topOffset,
    children,
    dataTestId
}) => {
    const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(
        gridReducer,
        initialState(cards, accessorKey, hasFilterGroup, hasPagination, topBarOptions, topOffset, dataTestId)
    );
    const values = useMemo(() => ({ state, dispatch }), [state, dispatch]);

    return <GridContext.Provider value={values}>{children}</GridContext.Provider>;
};

// Custom hooks to use the context
export const useGridState = () => {
    const context = useContext(GridContext);
    if (!context) {
        throw new Error("useGridState must be used within a GridProvider");
    }
    return context.state;
};

export const useGridDispatch = () => {
    const context = useContext(GridContext);
    if (!context) {
        throw new Error("useGridDispatch must be used within a GridProvider");
    }
    return context.dispatch;
};

//Action creators
export const setCards = (cards: unknown[]): SetCardsAction => ({ type: SET_CARDS, cards });

export const setFilteredCards = (filteredCards: unknown[]): SetFilteredCardsAction => ({
    type: SET_FILTERED_CARDS,
    filteredCards
});

export const setItemsPerPage = (itemsPerPage: number): SetCardsPerPageAction => ({
    type: SET_CARDS_PER_PAGE,
    itemsPerPage
});

export const setPageSelection = (pageSelection: number): SetPageSelectionAction => ({
    type: SET_PAGE_SELECTION,
    pageSelection
});
````

````typescript
import TopBar from "@organisms/DataTable/DataTablePanels/TopBarPanel";
import { useListState } from "../ListContext";

export type TopBarPanelProps = {
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    topBarOptions?: any;
    topOffset?: string;
    setTopBarHeight: (height: number) => void;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const TopBarPanel = ({ topBarOptions, topOffset, setTopBarHeight, "data-testid": dataTestId }: TopBarPanelProps) => {
    const { hasTopBar, dataTestId: contextDataTestId } = useListState();
    const testId = dataTestId || contextDataTestId;
    // Convert topOffset from string to number (remove unit)
    const topOffsetNum = topOffset ? parseInt(topOffset) || 0 : 0;
    return (
        <TopBar
            hasTopBar={hasTopBar}
            toolbarOptions={topBarOptions}
            topOffset={topOffsetNum}
            setTopBarHeight={setTopBarHeight}
            data-testid={testId ? `${testId}-list` : undefined}
        />
    );
};

export default TopBarPanel;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { ListProvider } from "./ListContext";
import ListPanel from "./ListPanels/ListPanel";

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
type ListItemType = Record<string, any>;

type ErrorMessage = {
    line1?: string;
    line2?: string;
};

export type ListProps = {
    /**
     * Display a list of ListItem components
     */
    items: ListItemType[];
    /**
     * A unique key found in the "Items" array that allow for tracking selected rows.
     * NOTE: If no accessorKey is provided, it will default to "id".
     * **GOOD PRACTICE:** To provide an unique identifier field in the Items
     * in order to identify individual rows
     */
    accessorKey?: string;
    /**
     * Default to false. If set to true, it will display FilterGroup component.
     */
    hasFilterGroup?: boolean;
    /**
     * Default to false. If set to true, it will display pagination component
     */
    hasPagination?: boolean;
    /**
     * Provide access to populate the filterGroup's Props.
     */
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    filterGroupProps?: any;
    /**
     * Provide access to populate the Pagination's Props.
     */
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    paginationProps?: any;
    /**
     * overwrite default error messages with a locale one
     * Note:
     * "notFound": Display error message when "hasFilterGroup" is set to true.
     * "noItems": Display error messages when "hasFilterGroup" is set to false.
     */
    errorMessages?: {
        noItems?: ErrorMessage;
        notFound?: ErrorMessage;
    };
    /**
     * Display title and/or primary/seconday buttons on the Top Bar
     */
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    topBarOptions?: any;
    /**
     * Enables responsive support text behavior
     */
    hasResponsiveSupportText?: boolean;
    /**
     * sets the top offset for the top bar to be sticky
     * use case: sticky toolbar/header for scroll on a non-fixed height table
     */
    topOffset?: string;
    /**
     * Used for testing
     */
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const List = ({
    items,
    accessorKey = "id",
    hasFilterGroup = false,
    hasPagination = false,
    filterGroupProps = {},
    paginationProps = {},
    errorMessages = {},
    topBarOptions = {},
    hasResponsiveSupportText = false,
    topOffset = "0px",
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: ListProps) => {
    return (
        <ListProvider
            items={items}
            accessorKey={accessorKey}
            hasFilterGroup={hasFilterGroup}
            hasPagination={hasPagination}
            topBarOptions={topBarOptions}
            topOffset={topOffset}
            dataTestId={dataTestId}
        >
            <ListPanel
                items={items}
                topBarOptions={topBarOptions}
                filterGroupProps={filterGroupProps}
                paginationProps={paginationProps}
                hasResponsiveSupportText={hasResponsiveSupportText}
                errorMessages={errorMessages}
                topOffset={topOffset}
            />
        </ListProvider>
    );
};

export default List;
````

````typescript
import type { ReactNode } from "react";
import React from "react";
import Button from "@atoms/button/Button";
import type { ModalButtons } from "./ModalButtonShape";
import { useModalButtons } from "./useModalButtons";
import type { ModalType } from "./Modal.styles";
import { Actions, Content, Header, HeaderPadding, ModalWrapper, StyledBackDrop } from "./Modal.styles";

export type BaseModalProps = {
    buttons?: ModalButtons;
    children?: ReactNode;
    "data-testid"?: string;
    disableContentOverflow?: boolean;
    hasIcon?: boolean;
    header?: ReactNode;
    type?: ModalType;
};

export type ModalProps = BaseModalProps & {
    hideBackdrop?: boolean;
    showModal?: boolean;
    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly?: number;
};

export const BaseModal: React.FC<BaseModalProps> = ({
    buttons,
    children,
    "data-testid": dataTestId,
    disableContentOverflow,
    hasIcon,
    header,
    type
}) => {
    const { primary, secondary } = useModalButtons(buttons);
    return (
        <ModalWrapper data-testid={dataTestId}>
            <Header type={type}>
                <HeaderPadding type={type}>
                    {hasIcon && type === "decorated" && (
                        <i className="fas fa-info-circle" style={{ fontSize: "1.5rem", paddingRight: "1rem" }} />
                    )}
                    {header}
                </HeaderPadding>
            </Header>
            <Content $disableContentOverflow={disableContentOverflow} type={type}>
                {(hasIcon && type === "confirmation" && (
                    <i
                        className="fas fa-exclamation-triangle"
                        style={{ color: "#FAA52D", fontSize: "1.5rem", paddingRight: "1rem" }}
                    />
                )) ||
                    (hasIcon && type === "destructive" && (
                        <i
                            className="fas fa-exclamation-circle"
                            style={{ color: "#DB5560", fontSize: "1.5rem", paddingRight: "1rem" }}
                        />
                    )) ||
                    (type === "error" && (
                        <i
                            className="fas fa-exclamation-circle"
                            style={{ color: "#DB5560", fontSize: "1.5rem", paddingRight: "1rem" }}
                        />
                    ))}
                {children}
            </Content>
            <Actions type={type}>
                {secondary?.children && (
                    <Button {...secondary} data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-secondary-button`} type="border">
                        {secondary.children}
                    </Button>
                )}
                {primary?.children && (
                    <Button
                        {...primary}
                        data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-primary-button`}
                        type={type === "destructive" ? "destructive" : "primary"}
                    >
                        {primary.children}
                    </Button>
                )}
            </Actions>
        </ModalWrapper>
    );
};

export const Modal: React.FC<ModalProps> = ({
    buttons = {},
    children,
    "data-testid": dataTestId,
    disableContentOverflow = false,
    hasIcon,
    header,
    hideBackdrop = false,
    showModal = false,
    type = "confirmation",
    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly
}) => {
    return (
        <StyledBackDrop
            invisible={hideBackdrop}
            mountOnEnter={true}
            open={showModal}
            unmountOnExit={true}
            zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly={zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly}
        >
            <BaseModal
                buttons={buttons}
                data-testid={dataTestId}
                disableContentOverflow={disableContentOverflow}
                hasIcon={hasIcon}
                header={header}
                type={type}
            >
                {children}
            </BaseModal>
        </StyledBackDrop>
    );
};
````

````typescript
import { useMemo } from "react";
import type { ModalButtonProps, ModalButtons } from "./ModalButtonShape";

export type UseModalButtonsReturn = {
    primary: ModalButtonProps;
    secondary: ModalButtonProps;
};

export const useModalButtons = (buttons?: ModalButtons): UseModalButtonsReturn => {
    const primary = useMemo(() => {
        return {
            attrType: buttons?.primary?.attrType ?? "submit",
            children: buttons?.primary?.children ?? buttons?.primaryText,
            dataTrackAction: buttons?.primary?.dataTrackAction,
            disabled: buttons?.primary?.disabled ?? buttons?.primaryDisabled,
            loading: buttons?.primary?.loading ?? buttons?.primaryLoading,
            onClick: buttons?.primary?.onClick ?? buttons?.primaryOnClick
        };
    }, [
        buttons?.primary?.attrType,
        buttons?.primary?.children,
        buttons?.primary?.dataTrackAction,
        buttons?.primary?.disabled,
        buttons?.primary?.loading,
        buttons?.primary?.onClick,
        buttons?.primaryDisabled,
        buttons?.primaryLoading,
        buttons?.primaryOnClick,
        buttons?.primaryText
    ]);

    const secondary = useMemo(() => {
        return {
            attrType: buttons?.secondary?.attrType ?? "submit",
            children: buttons?.secondary?.children ?? buttons?.secondaryText,
            dataTrackAction: buttons?.secondary?.dataTrackAction,
            disabled: buttons?.secondary?.disabled ?? buttons?.secondaryDisabled,
            onClick: buttons?.secondary?.onClick ?? buttons?.secondaryOnClick
        };
    }, [
        buttons?.secondary?.attrType,
        buttons?.secondary?.children,
        buttons?.secondary?.dataTrackAction,
        buttons?.secondary?.disabled,
        buttons?.secondary?.onClick,
        buttons?.secondaryDisabled,
        buttons?.secondaryOnClick,
        buttons?.secondaryText
    ]);

    return { primary, secondary };
};

export default useModalButtons;
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useContext } from "react";
import { RuleBuilderContext } from "../RuleBuilderContext";
import { Condition, FieldValue } from "../shared/propTypes";
import { FIELD_TYPE_CONFIG } from "../shared/constants";

export type LeftOperandFieldProps = {
    blockId: string;
    condition: Condition;
};

const LeftOperandField: React.FC<LeftOperandFieldProps> = ({ blockId, condition }) => {
    const context = useContext(RuleBuilderContext);

    if (!context) return null;

    const {
        conditionConfig: { leftOperandConfig },
        updateCondition
    } = context;

    const { id, leftOperandValue } = condition;

    const handleChange = useCallback(
        (value: FieldValue) =>
            updateCondition({
                blockId,
                conditionId: id,
                fieldName: "leftOperand",
                value
            }),
        [blockId, id, updateCondition]
    );

    const { type, ...restConfig } = leftOperandConfig;
    const { Component } = FIELD_TYPE_CONFIG[type as keyof typeof FIELD_TYPE_CONFIG];

    return (
        <Component {...restConfig} value={leftOperandValue} onChange={handleChange} data-testid="left_operand_field" />
    );
};

export default LeftOperandField;
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useContext, useMemo } from "react";
import { RuleBuilderContext } from "../RuleBuilderContext";
import Select from "@molecules/Select/Select";
import { Condition, FieldValue } from "../shared/propTypes";

export type OperatorFieldProps = {
    blockId: string;
    condition: Condition;
};

const OperatorField: React.FC<OperatorFieldProps> = ({ blockId, condition }) => {
    const context = useContext(RuleBuilderContext);

    if (!context) return null;

    const {
        conditionConfig: { operatorConfig },

    } = context;

    const { id, leftOperandValue, operatorValue } = condition;

    const options = useMemo(
        () =>
            Array.isArray(operatorConfig.options)
                ? operatorConfig.options
                : operatorConfig.getOptions?.(leftOperandValue) ?? [],
        [leftOperandValue, operatorConfig]
    );

    const handleChange = useCallback(
        (value: FieldValue) =>
            updateCondition({
                blockId,
                conditionId: id,
                fieldName: "operator",
                value
            }),
        [blockId, id, updateCondition]
    );

    return (
        <Select
            options={options}
            optionValueAsSelectValue
            value={operatorValue}
            onChange={handleChange}
            data-testid="operator_field"
        />
    );
};

export default OperatorField;
````

````typescript
import React, { useContext, useMemo } from "react";
import { RuleBuilderContext } from "../RuleBuilderContext";
import RightOperandField from "./RightOperandField";
import { Condition, FieldValue } from "../shared/propTypes";

export type RightOperandSectionProps = {
    blockId: string;
    condition: Condition;
};

const RightOperandSection: React.FC<RightOperandSectionProps> = ({ blockId, condition }) => {
    const context = useContext(RuleBuilderContext);

    if (!context) return null;

    const {
        conditionConfig: { rightOperandConfig }
    } = context;

    const { id, leftOperandValue, operatorValue, rightOperandValues } = condition;
    const fields = useMemo(
        () =>
            rightOperandConfig
                ? Array.isArray(rightOperandConfig.fields)
                    ? rightOperandConfig.fields
                    : rightOperandConfig.getFields?.(leftOperandValue, operatorValue) ?? []
                : [],
        [leftOperandValue, operatorValue, rightOperandConfig]
    );

    return fields.map(fieldConfig => (
        <RightOperandField
            key={fieldConfig.name}
            blockId={blockId}
            conditionId={id}
            config={fieldConfig}
            value={rightOperandValues[fieldConfig.name] as FieldValue}
        />
    ));
};

export default RightOperandSection;
````
