````typescript
import React, { forwardRef, useContext } from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import Button from "@atoms/button/Button";
import { RuleBuilderContext, RuleBuilderContextProvider, type Block, type ConditionConfig } from "./RuleBuilderContext";
import ConditionBlock from "./components/ConditionBlock";
import { ButtonPlusIcon } from "./components/StyledComponents";

export type RuleBuilderProps = {
    blocksSeparator: string;
    conditionsSeparator: string;
    emptyConditionIsDisplayedByDefault?: boolean;
    conditionConfig: ConditionConfig;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const RuleBuilder = forwardRef<Block[], RuleBuilderProps>(({ "data-testid": dataTestId, ...props }, ref) => {
    return (
        <RuleBuilderContextProvider ref={ref} {...props}>
            <RuleBuilderContent dataTestId={dataTestId} />
        </RuleBuilderContextProvider>
    );
});

type RuleBuilderContentProps = {
    dataTestId?: string;
};

const RuleBuilderContent: React.FC<RuleBuilderContentProps> = ({ dataTestId }) => {
    const context = useContext(RuleBuilderContext);
    if (!context) return null;

    const { blocks, addNewBlock, blocksSeparator } = context;

    return (
        <ConditionBlockListContainer data-testid={dataTestId}>
            {blocks.map((block: Block, blockIndex: number) => (
                <React.Fragment key={block.id}>
                    {blockIndex !== 0 && <div>{blocksSeparator}</div>}
                    <ConditionBlock block={block} />
                </React.Fragment>
            ))}

            <Button type="border" onClick={addNewBlock}>
                <ButtonPlusIcon /> Add Block
            </Button>
        </ConditionBlockListContainer>
    );
};

const ConditionBlockListContainer = styled("div")`
    > :not(:last-child) {
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
````

## File: src/components/organisms/SankeyChart/SankeyHelpers.ts
````typescript
import {
    NODE_LABEL_CHAR_LIMIT,
    NODE_TOOLTIP_EDGE_MARGIN,
    NODE_TOOLTIP_HEIGHT,
    NODE_TOOLTIP_WIDTH,
    NODE_VARIANTS,
    type SankeyData,
    type NodeVariant
} from "./SankeyConstants";

export type SankeyNodePayload = {
    name: string;
    icon?: string;
    variant: NodeVariant;
    value: number;
    sourceLinks: number[];
};

export const formatValues = (value?: number): string => (value ? value.toLocaleString("en-US") : "");

export const truncateNodeLabel = (name: string): string =>
    name.length > NODE_LABEL_CHAR_LIMIT ? `${name.substring(0, NODE_LABEL_CHAR_LIMIT - 3)}...` : name;

export const calculateTooltipLeft = (nodeX: number, nodeWidth: number, containerWidth: number): number => {
    const xOffset = nodeWidth / 1.2;
    const leftPos = nodeX + xOffset;
    return leftPos + NODE_TOOLTIP_WIDTH > containerWidth
        ? nodeX - NODE_TOOLTIP_EDGE_MARGIN - NODE_TOOLTIP_WIDTH
        : leftPos;
};

export const calculateTooltipTop = (nodeY: number, nodeHeight: number, containerHeight: number): number => {
    const yOffset = nodeHeight / 2.5;
    const topPos = nodeY + yOffset;
    return topPos + NODE_TOOLTIP_HEIGHT > containerHeight
        ? containerHeight - NODE_TOOLTIP_EDGE_MARGIN - NODE_TOOLTIP_HEIGHT
        : topPos;
};

export const calculateCarryoverTotal = (payload: SankeyNodePayload, data: SankeyData): number =>
    payload.sourceLinks.reduce((total, sourceLinkIndex) => {
        const sourceLink = data.links[sourceLinkIndex];
        const sourceNode = data.nodes[sourceLink.source];
        if (sourceNode && sourceNode.variant === NODE_VARIANTS.DROP_OFF)
            return total + data.links[sourceLinkIndex].value;
        else return total;
    }, 0);

export const countEndNodes = (data: SankeyData): number => {
    const allNodeIndices = new Set(data.nodes.map((_, index) => index));
    const sourceIndices = new Set(data.links.map(link => link.source));

    // End nodes are those that never appear as a source
    const endNodeIndices = [...allNodeIndices].filter(index => !sourceIndices.has(index));

    return endNodeIndices.length;
};
````

````typescript
import React, { useContext } from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import { SideNavigationContext } from "../SideNavigationContext";

type StyledSubTabProps = {
    $bgHover: string;
    $isSelected: boolean;
    $isSelectedBgColor: string;
    $lockedSelected?: boolean;
};

const StyledSubTab = styled("div", {
    shouldForwardProp: prop =>
        !["$bgHover", "$isSelected", "$isSelectedBgColor", "$lockedSelected"].includes(prop as string)
})<StyledSubTabProps>`
    color: ${({ $isSelected }) => ($isSelected ? "#fff" : "#F5F5F5")};
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 0.875rem;
    font-weight: ${({ $lockedSelected }) => ($lockedSelected ? "600" : "400")};
    width: 100%;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    height: 2.5rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    background-color: ${({ $isSelected, $lockedSelected, $isSelectedBgColor }) =>
        $isSelected ? $isSelectedBgColor : $lockedSelected ? "#007CC2" : "#1A3A5D"};
    padding: 0.5rem 0.5rem 0.5rem 3.25rem;

    :hover {
        background-color: ${({ $bgHover }) => $bgHover && $bgHover};
        color: #fff;
    }
`;

export type SideNavSubTabProps = {
    title?: string;
    id?: string;
    lockedSelected?: boolean;
    parentId?: string;
    onClick?: (id?: string) => void;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const SideNavSubTab: React.FC<SideNavSubTabProps> = ({
    title,
    id,
    lockedSelected,
    parentId,
    onClick,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}) => {
    const { subTabSelected, dispatch, isNavCollapsed } = useContext(SideNavigationContext);
    const isSelected = !!(id && subTabSelected === id);
    const isSelectedBgColor = isNavCollapsed ? "#1362A2" : "#007CC2";
    const bgHover = isSelected ? isSelectedBgColor : lockedSelected ? "#007CC2" : "#194E80";

    const handleClick = () => {
        if (!lockedSelected) {
            dispatch({ type: "UpdateMainAndSubSelected", mainValue: parentId, subValue: id });
        }

        if (onClick) {
            onClick(id);
        }
    };

    return (
        <StyledSubTab
            data-testid={dataTestId}
            $bgHover={bgHover}
            role="button"
            aria-pressed={isSelected}
            $isSelected={isSelected}
            $isSelectedBgColor={isSelectedBgColor}
            $lockedSelected={lockedSelected}
            onClick={handleClick}
        >
            {title}
        </StyledSubTab>
    );
};

export default SideNavSubTab;
````

````typescript
import React, { useContext, useState, useRef } from "react";
import { Popper, Fade } from "@mui/material";
import { SideNavigationContext } from "../SideNavigationContext";
// @ts-ignore - SideNavCollapsedTab is still a JSX file
import SideNavCollapsedTab from "./SideNavCollapsedTab";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";

export type SideNavTabProps = {
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    "data-testid"?: string;
    defaultSubItemId?: string;
    icon?: React.ReactNode;
    id?: string;
    isExpandable?: boolean;
    isExpanded?: boolean;
    onClick?: (id?: string) => void;
    title?: string;
};

type StyledTitleWrapperProps = {
    isSelected: boolean;
    isSelectedBgColor: string;
};

type StyledTabIconProps = {
    isNavCollapsed?: boolean;
};

const StyledNavPopupWrapper: React.ComponentType<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> = styled("div")`
    width: 14rem;
    cursor: pointer;
`;

const StyledTitleWrapper = styled("div")<StyledTitleWrapperProps>`
    display: flex;
    line-height: 1rem;
    font-weight: 600;
    align-items: center;
    height: 2.5rem;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    justify-content: center;
    background-color: ${({ isSelected, isSelectedBgColor }) => (isSelected ? isSelectedBgColor : "#15263B")};

    :hover {
        background-color: ${({ isSelected, isSelectedBgColor }) => (isSelected ? isSelectedBgColor : "#303B4C")};
    }
`;

const StyledTab = styled("div")`
    cursor: pointer;
    color: #ddd;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
`;

const StyledTabIcon = styled("div")<StyledTabIconProps>`
    display: flex;
    padding: ${({ isNavCollapsed }) => !isNavCollapsed && "0 1rem"};
    width: 1.25rem;
`;

const StyledChevronWrap: React.ComponentType<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> = styled("div")`
    color: #828a94;
    margin-left: auto;
    margin-right: 0.875rem;
    font-size: 0.5rem;
`;

export const SideNavTab: React.FC<SideNavTabProps> = ({
    children,
    "data-testid": dataTestId,
    defaultSubItemId,
    icon,
    id,
    isExpandable,
    isExpanded,
    onClick,
    title
}) => {
    const { isNavCollapsed, mainTabSelected, isMainTabCollapsed, dispatch } = useContext(SideNavigationContext);
    const [subMenu, setSubMenu] = useState(false);
    const anchorEl = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const isSelected = id && mainTabSelected === id;
    const isSelectedBgColor = isNavCollapsed || isMainTabCollapsed ? "#007CC2" : "#1A3A5D";

    const handleClick = () => {
        if (isSelected) {
            dispatch({ type: "ToggleMainTabExpanded" });
        } else {
            isExpandable && dispatch({ type: "UpdateMainAndSubSelected", mainValue: id, subValue: defaultSubItemId });
            onClick && onClick(id);
        }
    };
    const triggerMenuOn = () => {
        setSubMenu(true);
    };
    const triggerMenuOff = () => {
        setSubMenu(false);
    };

    return (
        <>
            <StyledTab
                role="button"
                ref={anchorEl}
                onMouseEnter={triggerMenuOn}
                onMouseLeave={triggerMenuOff}
                data-testid={dataTestId}
            >
                <StyledTitleWrapper
                    isSelectedBgColor={isSelectedBgColor}
                    onClick={handleClick}
                    isSelected={!!isSelected}
                >
                    <StyledTabIcon isNavCollapsed={isNavCollapsed}>{icon}</StyledTabIcon>
                    {!isNavCollapsed && (
                        <>
                            {title}
                            {isExpandable && (
                                <StyledChevronWrap>
                                    <span className={`fas fa-chevron-${isExpanded ? "down" : "right"}`} />
                                </StyledChevronWrap>
                            )}
                        </>
                    )}
                </StyledTitleWrapper>
                {isSelected && !isNavCollapsed && !isMainTabCollapsed && children}
            </StyledTab>
            {isNavCollapsed && (
                <Popper open={subMenu} placement="right-start" anchorEl={anchorEl.current} transition disablePortal>
                    {({ TransitionProps }) => (
                        <Fade {...TransitionProps} timeout={225}>
                            <StyledNavPopupWrapper onMouseEnter={triggerMenuOn} onMouseLeave={triggerMenuOff}>
                                <SideNavCollapsedTab isSelected={!!isSelected} title={title} parentId={id}>
                                    {children}
                                </SideNavCollapsedTab>
                            </StyledNavPopupWrapper>
                        </Fade>
                    )}
                </Popper>
            )}
        </>
    );
};
````

````typescript
import React, { useMemo, useReducer } from "react";

export type SideNavigationState = {
    mainTabSelected?: string;
    subTabSelected?: string;
    isMainTabCollapsed: boolean;
    isNavCollapsed?: boolean;
};

export type SideNavigationAction =
    | { type: "UpdateMainTabSelected"; value?: string }
    | { type: "UpdateSubTabSelected"; value?: string }
    | { type: "UpdateMainAndSubSelected"; mainValue?: string; subValue?: string }
    | { type: "ToggleMainTabExpanded" }
    | { type: "ToggleNavCollapsed" };

export type SideNavigationContextValue = SideNavigationState & {
    dispatch: React.Dispatch<SideNavigationAction>;
};

export type SideNavigationContextProviderProps = {
    initialMainTabSelected?: string;
    initialSubTabSelected?: string;
    initialIsCollapsed?: boolean;
    children?: React.ReactNode;
};

export const SideNavigationContext = React.createContext<SideNavigationContextValue>(
    undefined as unknown as SideNavigationContextValue
);

const initialState = (
    mainTabSelected?: string,
    subTabSelected?: string,
    initialIsCollapsed?: boolean
): SideNavigationState => {
    return {
        mainTabSelected,
        subTabSelected,
        isMainTabCollapsed: false,
        isNavCollapsed: initialIsCollapsed
    };
};

const reducer: React.Reducer<SideNavigationState, SideNavigationAction> = (state, action) => {
    switch (action.type) {
        case "UpdateMainTabSelected":
            return { ...state, mainTabSelected: action.value, isMainTabCollapsed: false };
        case "UpdateSubTabSelected":
            return { ...state, subTabSelected: action.value };
        case "UpdateMainAndSubSelected":
            return {
                ...state,
                subTabSelected: action.subValue,
                mainTabSelected: action.mainValue,
                isMainTabCollapsed: false
            };
        case "ToggleMainTabExpanded":
            return { ...state, isMainTabCollapsed: !state.isMainTabCollapsed };
        case "ToggleNavCollapsed":
            return { ...state, isNavCollapsed: !state.isNavCollapsed };
        default:
            return state;
    }
};

export const SideNavigationContextProvider: React.FC<SideNavigationContextProviderProps> = ({
    initialMainTabSelected,
    initialSubTabSelected,
    initialIsCollapsed,
    children
}) => {
    const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(
        reducer,
        initialState(initialMainTabSelected, initialSubTabSelected, initialIsCollapsed)
    );

    const values: SideNavigationContextValue = useMemo(() => {
        return {
            ...state,
            dispatch
        };
    }, [state]);

    return <SideNavigationContext.Provider value={values}>{children}</SideNavigationContext.Provider>;
};
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { useSlideoutCounter } from "./SlideoutPanelContext";
import SlideoutPanelRoot from "./SlideoutPanelRoot";
import SlidePanelWrapper from "./SlidePanelWrapper";

export type SlideoutPanelProps = {
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    closeOnKeyEscape?: boolean;
    "data-testid"?: string;
    isOpen?: boolean;
    muiColumnsOverride?: number;
    onExited?: () => void;
    onOutsideClick?: () => void;
    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly?: number;
};

const SlideoutPanel: React.FC<SlideoutPanelProps> = ({
    isOpen,
    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly,
    onOutsideClick,
    muiColumnsOverride,
    onExited,
    children,
    closeOnKeyEscape,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}) => {
    const { isInitialized } = useSlideoutCounter();

    return (
        <>
            {!isInitialized ? (
                <SlideoutPanelRoot
                    data-testid={dataTestId}
                    onOutsideClick={onOutsideClick}
                    muiColumnsOverride={muiColumnsOverride}
                    onExited={onExited}
                    isOpen={isOpen}
                    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly={zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly}
                    closeOnKeyEscape={closeOnKeyEscape}
                >
                    {children}
                </SlideoutPanelRoot>
            ) : (
                <SlidePanelWrapper
                    data-testid={dataTestId}
                    onOutsideClick={onOutsideClick}
                    closeOnKeyEscape={closeOnKeyEscape}
                    isOpen={isOpen}
                    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly={zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly}
                    muiColumnsOverride={muiColumnsOverride}
                >
                    {children}
                </SlidePanelWrapper>
            )}
        </>
    );
};

export default SlideoutPanel;
````

````typescript
import React, { useEffect, useRef, useCallback } from "react";
import { useSlideoutPanel } from "./SlideoutPanelContext";
import useOnClickOutside from "@hooks/useOnClickOutside";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";

export type SlideoutPanelChildProps = {
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    onOutsideClick?: () => void;
    triggerMarginUpdate?: (margin: number) => void;
    closeOnKeyEscape?: boolean;
    isOpen?: boolean;
    isMain?: boolean;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const SlideoutPanelChild: React.FC<SlideoutPanelChildProps> = ({
    children,
    onOutsideClick,
    triggerMarginUpdate,
    closeOnKeyEscape,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}) => {
    const { panelCount, dispatch } = useSlideoutPanel();
    const panelIdRef = useRef(panelCount + 1);
    const slideoutRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

    useEffect(() => {
        dispatch({ type: "AddPanelCount" });
        return () => {
            dispatch({ type: "DelPanelCount" });
        };
    }, [dispatch]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (triggerMarginUpdate) {
            triggerMarginUpdate(panelCount === 1 && panelIdRef.current === 1 ? 0 : -16 * (panelCount - 1));
        }
    }, [panelCount, triggerMarginUpdate]);

    const _onOutsideClick = useCallback(
        (e: Event | React.KeyboardEvent) => {
            const target = e.target as HTMLElement;
            const key = "key" in e ? e.key : undefined;
            // we only care about a backdrop click or the little slideoutpanel page tab
            if (
                onOutsideClick &&
                (target.classList.contains("MuiBackdrop-root") ||
                    target.classList.contains("tlium-slideout-slide-panel-stacked-page") ||
                    (closeOnKeyEscape && key === "Escape"))
            ) {
                onOutsideClick();
            }
        },
        [closeOnKeyEscape, onOutsideClick]
    );

    useOnClickOutside(
        slideoutRef as React.RefObject<HTMLElement>,
        panelIdRef.current === panelCount ? _onOutsideClick : undefined,
        closeOnKeyEscape
    );

    return (
        <StyledPanel data-testid={dataTestId} $panelCount={panelIdRef.current} ref={slideoutRef}>
            {children}
        </StyledPanel>
    );
};

type StyledPanelProps = {
    $panelCount: number;
};

const StyledPanel = styled("div")<StyledPanelProps>`
    height: 100vh;
    background: white;
    width: 100%;
    margin-left: ${props => (props.$panelCount !== 1 ? 16 : 0)}px;
    top: 0;
    position: absolute;
    background-color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.001);
    box-shadow: 0 4px 4px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.4);
`;

export default SlideoutPanelChild;
````

## File: src/components/organisms/SlideoutPanel/SlideoutPanelContext.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useContext, useMemo, useReducer } from "react";

export type SlideoutPanelState = {
    panelCount: number;
};

export type SlideoutPanelAction = { type: "AddPanelCount" } | { type: "DelPanelCount" };

export type SlideoutPanelContextValue = {
    panelCount: number;
    dispatch: React.Dispatch<SlideoutPanelAction>;
};

export type SlideoutPanelContextProviderProps = {
    initialCount?: number;
    children?: React.ReactNode;
};

export const SlideoutPanelContext = React.createContext<SlideoutPanelContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

export const useSlideoutPanel = () => {
    const context = useContext(SlideoutPanelContext);
    if (!context) {
        throw new Error("useSlideoutPanel must be used within SlideoutPanelContextProvider");
    }
    return context;
};

export const useSlideoutCounter = () => {
    const value = useContext(SlideoutPanelContext);
    if (!value) {
        return {
            isInitialized: false as const
        };
    }
    return {
        isInitialized: true as const,
        dispatch: value.dispatch
    };
};

const initialState = (initialCount?: number): SlideoutPanelState => {
    return { panelCount: initialCount ?? 0 };
};

const reducer: React.Reducer<SlideoutPanelState, SlideoutPanelAction> = (state, action) => {
    switch (action.type) {
        case "AddPanelCount":
            return { ...state, panelCount: state.panelCount + 1 };
        case "DelPanelCount":
            return { ...state, panelCount: state.panelCount - 1 };
        default:
            return state;
    }
};

export const SlideoutPanelContextProvider: React.FC<SlideoutPanelContextProviderProps> = ({
    initialCount,
    children
}) => {
    const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, initialState(initialCount));

    const values = useMemo(() => {
        return {
            panelCount: state.panelCount,
            dispatch
        };
    }, [state, dispatch]);
    return <SlideoutPanelContext.Provider value={values}>{children}</SlideoutPanelContext.Provider>;
};
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import SlidePanelWrapper from "./SlidePanelWrapper";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { SlideoutPanelContextProvider } from "./SlideoutPanelContext";

const RandomComponent = (props: any) => {
    const { "data-testid": dataTestId } = props;
    React.useEffect(() => {
        if (props.in) {
            props.onEntering();
            props.onEntered();
        } else {
            props.onExiting();
            props.onExited();
        }
    }, [props]);

    return (
        <div data-testid={`${dataTestId}`}>
            <span>{props.in ? "Visible!" : "Not!"}</span>
            <div>{props.children}</div>
        </div>
````

````typescript
import React, { useState, useRef, useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import ActionMenu from "@atoms/ActionMenu/ActionMenu";
import useOnClickOutside from "@hooks/useOnClickOutside";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import type { ActionListItem } from "@atoms/ActionMenu/ActionMenu";

type TriggerRowSelectedFn = (val: boolean, isDelRow?: boolean) => void;

type MenuAction = ActionListItem & {
    onClick?: (rowIndex: number, triggerRowSelected: TriggerRowSelectedFn) => void;
    clearSelectionAfterClick?: boolean;
};

type MenuCellValue = MenuAction[] | { hide: true };

export type MenuCellProps = {
    value?: MenuCellValue;
    toggleRowSelected: (rowIndex: number, val: boolean, isDelRow?: boolean) => void;
    rowIndex: number;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

export const MenuCell = ({
    value: menuList,
    toggleRowSelected,
    rowIndex,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: MenuCellProps) => {
    const menuRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const [menuOpen, setMenuOpen] = useState(false);

    const closeMenu = useCallback(() => {
        setMenuOpen(false);
    }, []);

    const openMenu = useCallback(() => {
        setMenuOpen(true);
    }, []);

    const stopPropagation = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
    };

    const handleActionClick = useCallback(
        (action: MenuAction, rowIndex: number) => {
            //used for if you need to manually trigger it based off another flow action
            //don't use with clearSelectionAfterClick at same time (it's not needed)
            const triggerRowSelected: TriggerRowSelectedFn = (val, isDelRow) => {
                toggleRowSelected(rowIndex, val, isDelRow);
            };
            action.onClick && action.onClick(rowIndex, triggerRowSelected);
            closeMenu();

            action.clearSelectionAfterClick && toggleRowSelected(rowIndex, false);
        },
        [closeMenu, toggleRowSelected]
    );

    const rowMenuList = useMemo(() => {
        if (!menuList || (menuList as { hide?: boolean }).hide) {
            return;
        }

        return (menuList as MenuAction[]).map(action => {
            let onClick;
            if (action.onClick) {
                onClick = () => handleActionClick(action, rowIndex);
            }
            return {
                ...action,
                onClick: onClick
            } as ActionListItem;
        });
    }, [menuList, rowIndex, handleActionClick]);

    useOnClickOutside(menuRef as React.RefObject<HTMLElement>, closeMenu);

    if ((menuList as { hide?: boolean })?.hide) return null;

    return (
        <MenuCellWrapper onClick={stopPropagation}>
            <EllipsisIcon
                className="fa fa-ellipsis-v"
                onClick={openMenu}
                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-menu-cell-ellipsis-row-${rowIndex}`}
            />
            {menuOpen && (
                <ActionMenuWrap
                    ref={menuRef}
                    data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-menu-cell-action-wrap-row-${rowIndex}`}
                >
                    <ActionMenu
                        actionList={rowMenuList}
                        data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-menu-cell-row-${rowIndex}`}
                    />
                </ActionMenuWrap>
            )}
        </MenuCellWrapper>
    );
};

const MenuCellWrapper = styled("div")`
    position: relative;
    right: -0.6625em;
`;

const ActionMenuWrap = styled("div")`
    position: absolute;
    right: 1rem;
    z-index: 1;

    &:hover {
        color: green;
    }
`;

const EllipsisIcon = styled("i")`
    width: 24px;
    height: 20px;
    z-index: 3;

    &:hover {
        color: #48a9e6;
    }
`;

export default MenuCell;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import LabelsCell, { type LabelsCellProps as LabelsComponentProps } from "./LabelsCell";
import MenuCell, { type MenuCellProps } from "./MenuCell";
import SwitchCell, { type SwitchCellProps } from "./SwitchCell";

type LabelItem = {
    text?: string;
    color?: number;
    children?: string;
};

type LabelsValue =
    | LabelItem[]
    | {
          labelsData: LabelItem[];
          popUpTitle?: string;
          popUpSize?: "xs" | "sm" | "md" | "lg";
      }
    | LabelItem;

type LabelsCellProps = {
    value?: unknown;
    rowIndex: number;
    dataTestId?: string;
};

/** Type guard to narrow unknown to LabelsValue */
const isLabelsValue = (value: unknown): value is LabelsValue => {
    if (!value) return false;

    // Check if it's a LabelItem[] or LabelItem
    if (Array.isArray(value)) {
        return value.every(
            item =>
                typeof item === "object" &&
                item !== null &&
                (typeof (item as any).text === "string" ||
                    typeof (item as any).color === "number" ||
                    typeof (item as any).children === "string")
        );
    }

    // Check if it's a LabelItem (single object with text, color, or children)
    if (typeof value === "object" && value !== null) {
        const obj = value as any;
        // Could be LabelItem
        if ("text" in obj || "color" in obj || "children" in obj) return true;
        // Could be object with labelsData
        if ("labelsData" in obj && Array.isArray(obj.labelsData)) return true;
    }

    return false;
};

type PrebuiltCellProps =
    | ({ type: "status" } & SwitchCellProps)
    | ({ type: "menu" } & MenuCellProps)
    | ({ type: "labels" } & LabelsCellProps)
    | { type: string };

export const PrebuiltCell = ({ type, ...props }: PrebuiltCellProps) => {
    switch (type) {
        case "status":
            return <SwitchCell {...(props as SwitchCellProps)} />;
        case "menu":
            return <MenuCell {...(props as MenuCellProps)} />;
        case "labels": {
            const labelProps = props as LabelsCellProps;
            return isLabelsValue(labelProps.value) ? (
                <LabelsCell {...(labelProps as LabelsComponentProps)} value={labelProps.value} />
            ) : null;
        }
        default:
            return null;
    }
};

type OptimizedStatusProps = {
    onChange?: (e: React.SyntheticEvent, rowIndex: number) => void;
    on?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    hide?: boolean;
};

export const optimizedProps = (
    props: unknown,
    type: string
): OptimizedStatusProps | { value: unknown } | Record<string, never> => {
    switch (type) {
        case "status":
            if (props) {
                const p = props as SwitchCellProps;
                return {
                    onChange: p.onChange,
                    on: p.on,
                    disabled: p.disabled,
                    hide: p.hide
                };
            }
            return {};
        default:
            return { value: props };
    }
};

export const containsPrebuilt = (type: string): boolean => {
    switch (type) {
        case "status":
        case "menu":
        case "labels":
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
    }
};
````

````typescript
import { useCallback } from "react";

export type UseGlobalFilterUpdateParams = {
    toolbarOptions?: {
        onSearchCallback?: (searchValue: string) => void;
        onGlobalSearchCallback?: (searchValue: string) => void;
    };
    setGlobalFilter: (value: string) => void;
};

export const useGlobalFilterUpdate = ({ toolbarOptions, setGlobalFilter }: UseGlobalFilterUpdateParams) =>
    useCallback(
        (val: string) => {
            if (toolbarOptions?.onSearchCallback) {
                toolbarOptions.onSearchCallback(val);
            } else if (toolbarOptions?.onGlobalSearchCallback) {
                toolbarOptions.onGlobalSearchCallback(val);
            }

            if (!toolbarOptions?.onSearchCallback) setGlobalFilter(val);
        },
        [toolbarOptions, setGlobalFilter]
    );

export default useGlobalFilterUpdate;
````

````typescript
import { useCallback, useState, useEffect } from "react";
import type { Row, Cell, ColumnInstance } from "react-table";
import type { CellInfo } from "./useLazyLoadBlur";

type ExtendedColumnInstance = ColumnInstance<Record<string, unknown>> & {
    cellWidth?: string;
    type?: string;
};

type ExtendedCell = Cell<Record<string, unknown>> & {
    column: ExtendedColumnInstance;
};

type ExtendedRow = Row<Record<string, unknown>> & {
    cells: ExtendedCell[];
};

export type UseLazyBodyParams = {
    rows: ExtendedRow[];
    preGlobalFilteredRowsLength: number;
};

export type UseLazyBodyReturn = {
    lazyRows: number;
    getCellInfo: (rowInfo?: unknown) => CellInfo;
    increaseRowsLoaded: () => void;
};

const useLazyBody = ({ rows, preGlobalFilteredRowsLength }: UseLazyBodyParams): UseLazyBodyReturn => {
    // TODO:  Lazy load only rows on a certain distance from visible, instead of cells as well
    const [lazyRows, setLazyRows] = useState(100);

    const [previousRowLength, setPreviousRowLength] = useState(rows.length);
    const [rowNumberChanged, setRowNumberChanged] = useState(false);

    // These two row effects are to ensure that if rows are dynamically added after render, they are lazy loaded in
    useEffect(() => {
        if (!rowNumberChanged && rows.length !== previousRowLength) {
            setRowNumberChanged(true);
        }
        setPreviousRowLength(rows.length);
    }, [rows.length, previousRowLength, rowNumberChanged]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (lazyRows < rows.length && rows.length > 100 && rowNumberChanged) {
            setLazyRows(rows.length);
        }
        // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
    }, [rows.length, rowNumberChanged]);

    const getCellInfo = useCallback(
        (rowInfo?: unknown): CellInfo => {
            const rowIndex = rowInfo as number;
            const dataTypes: string[] = [];
            const cellWidths: string[] = [];

            for (const cell of rows[rowIndex].cells) {
                dataTypes.push(cell.column.type || "");
                cellWidths.push(cell.column.cellWidth || "");
            }

            return { dataTypes, cellWidths };
        },
        [rows]
    );

    const increaseRowsLoaded = useCallback(() => {
        setLazyRows(prev => {
            //uncontrolled filter was hit, reset the lazyload amount
            if (preGlobalFilteredRowsLength !== rows.length) {
                return 100;
            }
            if (rows.length <= prev) {
                return rows.length;
            }

            return prev + 100;
        });
    }, [preGlobalFilteredRowsLength, rows.length]);

    return {
        lazyRows,
        getCellInfo,
        increaseRowsLoaded
    };
};

export default useLazyBody;
````

## File: src/components/organisms/table/TableHooks/useLazyLoadBlur.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useMemo, ReactElement } from "react";
import TableCell from "@atoms/TableCell/TableCell";

export type CellInfo = {
    dataTypes: string[];
    cellWidths: string[];
};

export type UseLazyLoadBlurParams = {
    id: string | number;
    getCellInfo: (rowInfo?: unknown) => CellInfo;
    rowInfo?: unknown;
    hasSelections?: boolean;
    isSubHeader?: boolean;
};

export const useLazyLoadBlur = ({ id, getCellInfo, rowInfo, hasSelections, isSubHeader }: UseLazyLoadBlurParams) =>
    useMemo((): ReactElement[] => {
        const childrenStuff: ReactElement[] = [];
        const cellInfo = getCellInfo(rowInfo);
        for (const [i, dataType] of cellInfo.dataTypes.entries()) {
            if (i === 0 && hasSelections) {
                childrenStuff.push(
                    <div style={{ padding: "8px", backgroundColor: "#fafafa" }} key={`lazy-load-cell-${id}-${i}`}></div>
                );
            } else {
                childrenStuff.push(
                    <TableCell
                        componentType="div"
                        key={`lazy-load-cell-${id}-${i}`}
                        cellType={isSubHeader ? "subHeader" : "body"}
                        cellWidth={cellInfo.cellWidths[i]}
                        dataType={dataType}
                    >
                        <div style={{ padding: "10px 0px", width: "100%", backgroundColor: "#fafafa" }}></div>
                    </TableCell>
                );
            }
        }
        return childrenStuff;
    }, [id, hasSelections, rowInfo, getCellInfo, isSubHeader]);

export default useLazyLoadBlur;
````

````typescript
import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import type { Column } from "react-table";
import type { ColumnsShapeArray } from "@components/shared/shapes/ColumnsShape";
import { SelectionCell, SelectionHeader } from "../TableModules/Selection";

export type UseProcessColumnsParams = {
    hasSelections?: boolean;
    columns: ColumnsShapeArray;
    dataTestId?: string;
    triggerAllRowsSelect: (value: boolean) => void;
    triggerRowSelect: (rowIndex: number, val: boolean, isDelRow?: boolean) => void;
};

const useProcessColumns = ({
    hasSelections,
    columns,
    dataTestId,
    triggerAllRowsSelect,
    triggerRowSelect
}: UseProcessColumnsParams) =>
    useMemo(() => {
        const sortableColumns = columns.map(col => ({
            disableSortBy: !(col as any).sortable,
            sortType: (col as any).sortCallback ?? "alphanumeric",
            ...col
        }));
        if (hasSelections) {
            return [
                {
                    id: "selection",
                    type: "checkmark",
                    Header: (props: any) => (
                        <SelectionHeader
                            getToggleAllRowsSelectedProps={props.getToggleAllRowsSelectedProps}
                            triggerAllRowsSelect={triggerAllRowsSelect}
                            data-testid={dataTestId}
                        />
                    ),
                    Cell: (props: any) => (
                        <SelectionCell {...props} triggerRowSelect={triggerRowSelect} data-testid={dataTestId} />
                    )
                } as Column<Record<string, unknown>>,
                ...sortableColumns
            ];
        }
        return sortableColumns;
    }, [columns, hasSelections, dataTestId, triggerAllRowsSelect, triggerRowSelect]);

export { useProcessColumns };
export default useProcessColumns;
````

````typescript
import { useCallback } from "react";

export type UseSelectRowTriggerParams = {
    onToggleRowSelection: (rowIndex: number, val: boolean) => void;
    onDeleteRow: (rowIndex: number) => void;
};

export type UseSelectRowTriggerReturn = (rowIndex: number, val: boolean, isDelRow?: boolean) => void;

const useSelectRowTrigger = ({
    onDeleteRow,
    onToggleRowSelection
}: UseSelectRowTriggerParams): UseSelectRowTriggerReturn =>
    useCallback(
        (id: number, val: boolean, isDelete?: boolean) => {
            if (isDelete) onDeleteRow(id);
            else onToggleRowSelection(id, val);
        },
        [onDeleteRow, onToggleRowSelection]
    );

export default useSelectRowTrigger;
````

````typescript
import { useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import { useExpanded, useGlobalFilter, useRowSelect, useSortBy } from "react-table";

type UseTableUtilsParams = {
    data: unknown[];
    hasSubHeaders: boolean;
    defaultSortBy: string | undefined;
    sortByDesc: boolean;
    overwriteSelection: Record<string, boolean>;
};

const useTableUtils = ({ data, hasSubHeaders, defaultSortBy, sortByDesc, overwriteSelection }: UseTableUtilsParams) => {
    const expandedRows = useMemo(() => {
        if (!hasSubHeaders) {
            return {};
        }
        const expandedRows: Record<number, boolean> = {};
        for (const [index] of data.entries()) {
            expandedRows[index] = true;
        }
        return expandedRows;
    }, [data, hasSubHeaders]);

    const tableHooks = useMemo(() => {
        return [useGlobalFilter, useSortBy, hasSubHeaders && useExpanded, useRowSelect].filter(p => p);
    }, [hasSubHeaders]);

    const sortBy = useMemo(() => {
        return defaultSortBy ? [{ id: defaultSortBy, desc: sortByDesc }] : [];
    }, [defaultSortBy, sortByDesc]);

    const controlledStateCallback = useCallback(
        (state: Record<string, any>) => {
            return {
                ...state,
                selectedRowIds: overwriteSelection
            };
        },
        [overwriteSelection]
    );

    return {
        expandedRows,
        tableHooks,
        sortBy,
        controlledStateCallback,
        overwriteSelection
    };
};

export { useTableUtils };
export default useTableUtils;
````

````typescript
import { useCallback } from "react";

export const useToggleRowSelection = (
    overwriteSelection: Record<string, boolean>,
    setOverwriteSelection: (value: Record<string, boolean>) => void
) =>
    useCallback(
        (id: string, val: boolean) => {
            const newSelect = { ...overwriteSelection };
            if (!val) {
                delete newSelect[id];
            } else {
                newSelect[id] = true;
            }

            setOverwriteSelection(newSelect);
        },
        [overwriteSelection, setOverwriteSelection]
    );

export default useToggleRowSelection;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import useTypeCheckedOnClickRow from "./useTypeCheckedOnClickRow";

describe("useTypeCheckedOnClickRow hook test,", () => {
    type TestRow = { hasBeenOnClicked: boolean };

    const row: TestRow = { hasBeenOnClicked: false };
    const presentOnClick = () => (row.hasBeenOnClicked = true);
    const absentOnClick = null;

    type WrapperComponentProps = {
        onClick: (() => void) | null;
    };

    const WrapperComponent = ({ onClick }: WrapperComponentProps) => {
        useTypeCheckedOnClickRow({
            row: row,
            onClick: onClick || undefined
        });

        return <button onClick={onClick || undefined}></button>;
    };

    it("should trigger the onClick function on the row if the onClick function is present", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        row.hasBeenOnClicked = false;

        render(<WrapperComponent onClick={presentOnClick} />);
        await user.click(screen.getByRole("button"));

        expect(row.hasBeenOnClicked).toBeTruthy();
    });

    it("should do nothing if the onClick function is not present", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        row.hasBeenOnClicked = false;

        render(<WrapperComponent onClick={absentOnClick} />);
        await user.click(screen.getByRole("button"));

        expect(row.hasBeenOnClicked).toBeFalsy();
    });
});
````

````typescript
import { useCallback } from "react";

type UseTypeCheckedOnClickRowParams = {
    onClick: ((row: unknown) => void) | undefined;
    row: unknown;
};

const useTypeCheckedOnClickRow = ({ onClick, row }: UseTypeCheckedOnClickRowParams) => {
    const noopCallback = useCallback(() => {}, []);

    return useCallback(
        () => (typeof onClick === "function" ? onClick(row) : noopCallback()),
        [onClick, row, noopCallback]
    );
};

export { useTypeCheckedOnClickRow };
export default useTypeCheckedOnClickRow;
````

````typescript
import { useMemo } from "react";

const useUnselectableRows = (data: unknown[]): number[] =>
    useMemo(() => {
        const rowsIndex: number[] = [];
        data.forEach((row, index) => {
            if (
                (row as { checkbox?: { hide?: boolean; disabled?: boolean } })?.checkbox?.hide ||
                (row as { checkbox?: { hide?: boolean; disabled?: boolean } })?.checkbox?.disabled
            ) {
                rowsIndex.push(index);
            }
        });
        return rowsIndex;
    }, [data]);

export default useUnselectableRows;
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import { Row } from "react-table";
import TableBody from "@atoms/TableBody/TableBody";
import TableCell from "@atoms/TableCell/TableCell";
import { PrebuiltCell, containsPrebuilt, optimizedProps } from "../PrebuiltCells/PrebuiltCell";
import LazyLoadTableRow from "./LazyLoadTableRow";
import useLazyBody, { UseLazyBodyParams } from "../TableHooks/useLazyBody";
import "../react-table.d";

/** Extract ExtendedRow type from useLazyBody */
type ExtendedRow = UseLazyBodyParams["rows"][number];

const MemoRow = React.memo(LazyLoadTableRow);
const MemoCell = React.memo(TableCell);

export type BodyProps = {
    /** Table rows to render */
    rows: ExtendedRow[];
    /** Function to prepare row for rendering */
    prepareRow: (row: ExtendedRow) => void;
    /** Currently selected row index */
    selectedRowIndex?: number;
    /** Callback when row is clicked */
    onRowClick?: (
        rowIndex: number,
        row: ExtendedRow & { toggleRowSelected?: (rowId?: string, set?: boolean) => void }
    ) => void;
    /** Pre-filtered rows before global filter applied */
    preGlobalFilteredRows?: ExtendedRow[];
    /** Whether table has row selections */
    hasSelections?: boolean;
    /** Function to toggle row selection */
    toggleRowSelected?: (rowId?: string, set?: boolean) => void;
    /** Data track action for analytics */
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    /** Test ID for debugging */
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const Body = ({
    rows,
    prepareRow,
    selectedRowIndex,
    onRowClick,
    preGlobalFilteredRows,
    hasSelections,
    toggleRowSelected,
    dataTrackAction,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: BodyProps) => {
    const preGlobalFilteredRowsLength = (preGlobalFilteredRows && preGlobalFilteredRows.length) || 0;
    const { lazyRows, getCellInfo, increaseRowsLoaded } = useLazyBody({ rows, preGlobalFilteredRowsLength });

    const _onRowClick = useCallback(
        (row?: unknown) => {
            if (typeof onRowClick === "function" && preGlobalFilteredRows) {
                const typedRow = row as ExtendedRow;
                onRowClick(preGlobalFilteredRows.indexOf(typedRow), {
                    ...typedRow,
                    toggleRowSelected: toggleRowSelected
                });
            }
        },
        [onRowClick, preGlobalFilteredRows, toggleRowSelected]
    );
    return (
        <TableBody componentType="div" data-testid={dataTestId}>
            {rows.slice(0, lazyRows).map((row, index) => {
                prepareRow(row);
                const rowProps = row.getRowProps();
                return (
                    <MemoRow
                        triggerLazyAdd={index % 99 === 0 && index !== 0 ? increaseRowsLoaded : undefined}
                        isSelected={rows[index].isSelected || selectedRowIndex === index}
                        rowInfo={index}
                        key={rowProps.key}
                        id={String(rowProps.key)}
                        onClick={_onRowClick}
                        hasSelections={hasSelections}
                        getCellInfo={getCellInfo}
                        row={row as any}
                        data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-row-${index}`}
                    >
                        {row.cells.map(cell => {
                            const cellProps = cell.getCellProps();

                            return (
                                <MemoCell
                                    key={cellProps.key}
                                    cellType={row.canExpand ? "subHeader" : "body"}
                                    componentType="div"
                                    dataType={cell.column.type || "text"}
                                    cellWidth={cell.column.cellWidth ? String(cell.column.cellWidth) : undefined}
                                >
                                    {containsPrebuilt(cell.column.type || "") ? (
                                        <PrebuiltCell
                                            {...(optimizedProps(cell.value, cell.column.type || "") as any)}
                                            toggleRowSelected={
                                                hasSelections && toggleRowSelected
                                                    ? (rowIdx: number, val: boolean) =>
                                                          toggleRowSelected(String(rowIdx), val)
                                                    : undefined
                                            }
                                            data-testid={dataTestId}
                                            dataTrackAction={
                                                (cell.row?.original?.dataTrackAction as string) || dataTrackAction
                                            }
                                            type={cell.column.type || "text"}
                                            rowIndex={row.index}
                                            row={row}
                                        />
                                    ) : (
                                        // TODO: see if passing the top makes more sense, and doesn't break anyone
                                        // : cell.render("Cell", { value: cell.value, rowIndex: row.index })}
                                        cell.render("Cell")
                                    )}
                                </MemoCell>
                            );
                        })}
                    </MemoRow>
                );
            })}
        </TableBody>
    );
};

export default Body;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import LazyLoadTableRow from "./LazyLoadTableRow";

import { mockAllIsIntersecting } from "react-intersection-observer/test-utils";

describe("lazy load table wrapper", () => {
    it("should lazyload the row cells", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const getCellInfo = jest.fn().mockImplementation(() => {
            return {
                dataTypes: ["text"],
                cellWidths: ["100px"]
            };
        });
        mockAllIsIntersecting(false);
        render(
            <LazyLoadTableRow data-testid="test" getCellInfo={getCellInfo} id="1">
                <div>Hi!</div>
            </LazyLoadTableRow>
        );

        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("test"));

        expect(screen.queryByText("Hi!")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
        mockAllIsIntersecting(true);
        expect(screen.queryByText("Hi!")).toBeInTheDocument();
````

````typescript
import React, { useState, ReactNode } from "react";
import { useTable } from "react-table";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import useTableUtils from "./TableHooks/useTableUtils";
import useSelectedRows from "./TableHooks/useSelectedRows";
import useEnrichedErrors from "./TableHooks/useEnrichedErrors";
import useGlobalFilterUpdate from "./TableHooks/useGlobalFilterUpdate";
import useDeleteRow from "./TableHooks/useDeleteRow";
import TableBase from "@atoms/TableBase/TableBase";
import TableContainer from "@atoms/TableContainer/TableContainer";
import Header from "./TableModules/Header";
import Body from "./TableModules/Body";
import CustomizableToolbar from "./TableModules/CutomizableToolbar";
import type { ButtonGroupConfig, BulkActionMenuItem } from "@molecules/TableToolbar/TableToolbar";
import useProcessColumns from "./TableHooks/useProcessColumns";
import useUnselectableRows from "./TableHooks/useUnselectableRows";
import useToggleRowSelection from "./TableHooks/useToggleRowSelection";
import useSelectAllRowsTrigger from "./TableHooks/useSelectAllRowsTrigger";
import useSelectRowTrigger from "./TableHooks/useSelectRowTrigger";
import type { ColumnsShapeArray } from "@components/shared/shapes/ColumnsShape";

type LocaleTexts = {
    SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER?: string;
    BULK_ACTIONS?: string;
    SELECTED?: string;
};

type CustomToolbarFunction = (params: {
    toggleRowSelected: (id: string) => void;
    toggleAllRowsSelected: (value: boolean) => void;
    selectedRows: Record<string, unknown>;
}) => React.ReactElement;

type ToolbarOptions = {
    autoFocus?: boolean;
    tableType?: string;
    buttons?: ButtonGroupConfig;
    customButtons?: () => React.ReactElement;
    customToolbar?: CustomToolbarFunction;
    hasSearch?: boolean;
    onSearchCallback?: (searchValue: string) => void;
    onGlobalSearchCallback?: (searchValue: string) => void;
    hideToolbar?: boolean;
    preFilterItemCount?: number;
    bulkActionMenu?: BulkActionMenuItem[];
    leftComponents?: React.ReactElement;
    rightComponents?: React.ReactElement;
    defaultSearchVal?: string;
};

type ErrorMessages = {
    noItems?: ReactNode;
    notFound?: ReactNode;
};

export type TableProps = {
    hasSelections?: boolean;
    onSelectedRowChanged?: (selectedRowIds: string[]) => void;
    onRowClick?: (row: unknown) => void;
    selectedRowIndex?: number;
    columns?: ColumnsShapeArray;
    data?: unknown[];
    localeTexts?: LocaleTexts;
    toolbarOptions?: ToolbarOptions;
    topOffset?: string;
    errorMessages?: ErrorMessages;
    hasSubHeaders?: boolean;
    defaultSortBy?: string;
    sortByDesc?: boolean;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const Table: React.FC<TableProps> = ({
    onRowClick,
    selectedRowIndex,
    hasSelections,
    onSelectedRowChanged,
    columns = [],
    data = [],
    localeTexts = {},
    toolbarOptions,
    errorMessages,
    hasSubHeaders,
    topOffset = "0px",
    defaultSortBy,
    sortByDesc,
    dataTrackAction,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}) => {
    const [overwriteSelection, setOverwriteSelection] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({});
    const unselectableRows = useUnselectableRows(data);
    const onDeleteRow = useDeleteRow(overwriteSelection, setOverwriteSelection);
    const onToggleRowSelection = useToggleRowSelection(overwriteSelection, setOverwriteSelection);
    const triggerRowSelect = useSelectRowTrigger({
        onToggleRowSelection: (rowIndex: number, val: boolean) => {
            onToggleRowSelection(String(rowIndex), val);
        },
        onDeleteRow: onDeleteRow
    });
    const triggerAllRowsSelect = useSelectAllRowsTrigger({
        overwriteSelection: overwriteSelection,
        setOverwriteSelection: setOverwriteSelection,
        unselectableRows: unselectableRows,
        data: data
    });

    const { expandedRows, tableHooks, sortBy, controlledStateCallback } = useTableUtils({
        data: data,
        hasSubHeaders: hasSubHeaders ?? false,
        defaultSortBy: defaultSortBy,
        sortByDesc: sortByDesc ?? false,
        overwriteSelection: overwriteSelection
    });

    const postProcessColumns = useProcessColumns({
        hasSelections: hasSelections,
        columns: columns,
        dataTestId: dataTestId,
        triggerAllRowsSelect: triggerAllRowsSelect,
        triggerRowSelect: triggerRowSelect
    });

    const {
        headerGroups,
        rows,
        prepareRow,
        preGlobalFilteredRows,
        setGlobalFilter,
        toggleRowSelected,
        getTableBodyProps
    } = useTable(
        {
            useControlledState: controlledStateCallback,
            autoResetSelectedRows: false,
            columns: postProcessColumns,
            data: data,
            autoResetGlobalFilter: false,
            disableSortRemove: true,
            disableMultiSort: true,
            initialState: {
                expanded: expandedRows,
                sortBy
            }
        } as any,
        ...(tableHooks as any)
    ) as any;

    const triggerGlobalFilterUpdate = useGlobalFilterUpdate({
        toolbarOptions: toolbarOptions,
        setGlobalFilter: setGlobalFilter
    });

    const selectedRows = useSelectedRows({
        overwriteSelection: overwriteSelection,
        onSelectedRowChanged: onSelectedRowChanged,
        preGlobalFilteredRows: preGlobalFilteredRows
    });

    const defaultErrorMessages = useEnrichedErrors(errorMessages);

    const hideToolbar = toolbarOptions?.hideToolbar;

    return (
        <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" }}>
            {!hideToolbar && (
                <CustomizableToolbar
                    topOffset={topOffset}
                    toolbarOptions={toolbarOptions}
                    toggleRowSelected={toggleRowSelected}
                    triggerAllRowsSelect={triggerAllRowsSelect}
                    rows={rows}
                    localeTexts={localeTexts}
                    overwriteSelection={overwriteSelection}
                    preGlobalFilteredRows={preGlobalFilteredRows}
                    selectedRows={selectedRows}
                    triggerGlobalFilterUpdate={triggerGlobalFilterUpdate}
                    parentDataTestId={dataTestId}
                />
            )}
            <TableContainer>
                <TableBase componentType="div" data-testid={dataTestId} stickyHeader={true}>
                    <Header headerGroups={headerGroups} topOffset={topOffset} hideToolbar={!!hideToolbar} />
                    <Body
                        rows={rows}
                        prepareRow={prepareRow}
                        selectedRowIndex={selectedRowIndex}
                        onRowClick={onRowClick}
                        hasSelections={hasSelections}
                        data-testid={`${dataTestId}_body`}
                        preGlobalFilteredRows={preGlobalFilteredRows}
                        toggleRowSelected={triggerRowSelect as any}
                        dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction}
                    />
                </TableBase>
            </TableContainer>
            {rows.length === 0 && (
                <ErrorMessagesWrap>
                    {toolbarOptions?.preFilterItemCount || preGlobalFilteredRows.length
                        ? defaultErrorMessages.notFound
                        : defaultErrorMessages.noItems}
                </ErrorMessagesWrap>
            )}
        </div>
    );
};

const ErrorMessagesWrap = styled("div")`
    padding-top: 48px;
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 20px;
    line-height: 28px;
    display: flex;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    color: #a2a8b0;
    flex-direction: column;
`;

export default Table;
````

## File: src/components/organisms/Wizard/WizardContext.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useState, createContext, useContext, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from "react";

export type WizardStep = {
    details?: unknown;
    id: string | number;
    title: string | number;
};

export type ValidationFunction = () => boolean | Promise<boolean>;

export type ValidationRef = Record<string | number, ValidationFunction>;

export type UseWizardParams = {
    onSave?: () => void | Promise<void>;
    steps: WizardStep[];
};

export type WizardContextValue = {
    currentStep: WizardStep;
    currentStepIndex: number;
    goToNextStep: () => Promise<boolean>;
    goToPreviousStep: () => void;
    isFirstStep: boolean;
    isLastStep: boolean;
    isNextDisabled: boolean;
    setCurrentStepIndex: (index: number) => void;
    steps: WizardStep[];
    validation: React.MutableRefObject<ValidationRef>;
};

export type WizardContextProviderProps = {
    children: React.ReactNode;
    onSave?: () => void | Promise<void>;
    steps: WizardStep[];
};

export type UseWizardStepParams = {
    id: string | number;
};

export const WizardContext = createContext<WizardContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

export const useWizard = ({ steps, onSave }: UseWizardParams) => {
    const [currentStepIndex, setCurrentStepIndex] = useState(0);
    const [isNextDisabled, setIsNextDisabled] = useState(false);
    const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
    const validation = useRef<ValidationRef>({});
    const currentStep = steps[currentStepIndex];
    const id = currentStep.id;

    const goToNextStep = useCallback(async () => {
        // onValidation should return true/false depending on of the step is valid to continue
        if (validation.current[id]) {
            setIsNextDisabled(true);
            const validationResult = await validation.current[id]();
            setIsNextDisabled(false);
            if (!validationResult) {
                return false;
            }
        }

        const maxNumOfSteps = steps.length - 1;
        const nextStepIndex = currentStepIndex + 1;

        if (nextStepIndex <= maxNumOfSteps) {
            setCurrentStepIndex(nextStepIndex);
        } else {
            // onSave is called as a side effect so that any state updates
            // made in validation are reflected when it is called
            onSave && setIsSaving(true);
        }
        return true;
    }, [currentStepIndex, validation, onSave, steps.length, id]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (isSaving) {
            const handleSave = async () => {
                setIsNextDisabled(true);
                await onSave?.();
                setIsNextDisabled(false);
            };
            setIsSaving(false);
            handleSave();
        }
    }, [isSaving, onSave]);

    const goToPreviousStep = useCallback(() => {
        const previousStepIndex = currentStepIndex - 1;
        setCurrentStepIndex(previousStepIndex);
    }, [currentStepIndex]);

    const isFirstStep = currentStepIndex === 0;
    const isLastStep = currentStepIndex === steps.length - 1;

    return {
        currentStepIndex,
        setCurrentStepIndex,
        currentStep,
        goToNextStep,
        goToPreviousStep,
        steps,
        isFirstStep,
        isLastStep,
        validation,
        isNextDisabled
    };
};

export const useWizardStep = ({ id }: UseWizardStepParams) => {
    const context = useContext(WizardContext);

    if (!context) {
        throw new Error("useWizardStep must be used within WizardContextProvider");
    }

    const { currentStep } = context;
    const isActive = currentStep && currentStep.id === id;

    return { isActive };
};

export const useWizardValidation = (id: string | number, onValidation?: ValidationFunction) => {
    const context = useContext(WizardContext);

    if (!context) {
        throw new Error("useWizardValidation must be used within WizardContextProvider");
    }

    const { validation } = context;

    useEffect(() => {
        if (onValidation) {
            validation.current[id] = onValidation;
        }
    }, [validation, onValidation, id]);
};

export const WizardContextProvider = ({ steps, onSave, children }: WizardContextProviderProps) => {
    const value = useWizard({ steps, onSave });

    return <WizardContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</WizardContext.Provider>;
};
````

````typescript
import React, { useContext } from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import { WizardContext, WizardStep } from "./WizardContext";

export type WizardNavigationListProps = Record<string, never>;

const WizardNavigationList: React.FC<WizardNavigationListProps> = () => {
    const context = useContext(WizardContext);

    if (!context) {
        throw new Error("WizardNavigationList must be used within WizardContextProvider");
    }

    const { steps, currentStepIndex } = context;

    return (
        <StyledListWrap>
            <StyledListGroup>
                {steps.map((item, index) => {
                    const isActive = currentStepIndex === index;
                    const isComplete = currentStepIndex > index;
                    const isFirst = index === 0;
                    const isLast = index === steps.length - 1;
                    return (
                        <ListItem
                            key={item.id}
                            isActive={isActive}
                            isComplete={isComplete}
                            isFirst={isFirst}
                            isLast={isLast}
                            item={item}
                            index={index}
                        />
                    );
                })}
            </StyledListGroup>
        </StyledListWrap>
    );
};

    );
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { useWizardStep } from "./WizardContext";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";

export type WizardStepProps = {
    /**
     * id of the wizard step
     */
    id: string | number;
    /**
     * true to remove from DOM when not active
     */
    renderActiveOnly?: boolean;
    children: React.ReactNode;
};

export const WizardStep = ({ id, renderActiveOnly, children }: WizardStepProps) => {
    const { isActive } = useWizardStep({ id });

    return (
        <>{(!renderActiveOnly || isActive) && <StyledWizardStep $isActive={isActive}>{children}</StyledWizardStep>}</>
    );
};

type StyledWizardStepProps = {
    $isActive: boolean;
};

const StyledWizardStep = styled("div", {
    shouldForwardProp: prop => !prop.toString().startsWith("$")
})<StyledWizardStepProps>`
    display: ${props => (props.$isActive ? null : "none")};
    overflow: auto;
    width: 100%;
`;

export default WizardStep;
````

````typescript
    font-size: 18px;
    font-weight: normal;
    line-height: 24px;
    margin-left: 16px;
`;

type SummaryItemProps = {
    label: string;
    value: number | string;
    color: string;
    maxWidth?: number;
    maxHeight?: number;
};

const SummaryItem = ({ label, value, color, maxWidth, maxHeight }: SummaryItemProps) => (
    <SummaryItemContainer maxWidth={maxWidth} maxHeight={maxHeight} data-testid="summary-item">
        <SummaryLabel>
            <i className="fas fa-xs fa-circle" style={{ color, marginRight: "4px", fontSize: "12px" }} />
            {label}
        </SummaryLabel>
        <SummaryValue>{value}</SummaryValue>
    </SummaryItemContainer>
);

export type ChartSummaryProps = {
    data?: Array<{
        name: string;
        value: number;
        color: string;
    }>;
    options?: SummaryOptions;
    vertical?: boolean;
};

export const ChartSummary = ({ data = [], options = {}, vertical = false }: ChartSummaryProps) => {
    const valuesTotal = data.reduce((acc, item) => acc + item.value, 0);

    return (
        <SummaryContainer vertical={vertical} data-testid="summary">
            {data.map(item => {
                const [value, label] = options.formatter?.(item.value, item.name, { valuesTotal }) ?? [
                    item.value,
                    item.name
                ];
                return (
                    <SummaryItem
                        key={label}
                        label={label}
                        value={value}
                        color={item.color}
                        maxWidth={options.maxItemWidth}
                        maxHeight={options.maxItemHeight}
                    />
                );
            })}
        </SummaryContainer>
    );
};
````

````typescript
import React, { forwardRef } from "react";
import { CustomToolTipContainer, CustomToolTipHeader, CustomToolTipItem } from "./StyledComponents";

type PayloadItem = {
    name?: string;
    value: string | number;
    color?: string;
};

export type CustomTooltipProps = {
    active?: boolean;
    prefix?: string;
    payload?: PayloadItem[] | Record<string, unknown>;
    label?: string | number;
    dateFormat?: boolean;
    customToolTipStyles?: { height?: string; width?: string; padding?: string };
    customFormat?: (label: string | number) => string;
};

export const CustomTooltip = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, CustomTooltipProps>((props, ref) => {
    const { active, prefix, payload, label, dateFormat, customToolTipStyles, customFormat } = props;
    const displayLabel = dateFormat
        ? new Date(label ?? 0).toLocaleDateString()
        : customFormat
        ? customFormat(label ?? "")
        : label;

    if (active && payload && Array.isArray(payload) && payload.length) {
        return (
            <CustomToolTipContainer $dimensions={customToolTipStyles} ref={ref}>
                <CustomToolTipHeader>
                    {prefix && `${prefix} `}
                    {displayLabel}
                </CustomToolTipHeader>
                {payload.map(item => {
                    return (
                        <div key={item?.name}>
                            <span style={{ color: item?.color, marginRight: "10px" }} className="fas fa-xs fa-circle" />
                            <CustomToolTipItem>
                                {item.name}: {item.value}
                            </CustomToolTipItem>
                        </div>
                    );
                })}
            </CustomToolTipContainer>
        );
    }

    return null;
});

CustomTooltip.displayName = "CustomTooltip";
````

````typescript
import "@testing-library/jest-dom";
import React, { useEffect } from "react";
import useRechartsHooks from "./RechartsHooks";
import { DEFAULT_DATA, SINGLENUMBER_NEGATIVE_DATA } from "./ChartData";
import { render } from "@testing-library/react";

describe("Recharts Hooks Tests", () => {
    it("should trigger every hook function", () => {
        const newMap = new Map();
        newMap.set("test", true);
        const TestComponent = () => {
            const { state, dispatch, zoom, zoomOut } = useRechartsHooks({
                activeMap: newMap,
                data: DEFAULT_DATA,
                left: "dataMin",
                right: "dataMax",
                refAreaLeft: 2,
                refAreaRight: 1,
                bottom: 0,
                top: 80
            });
            useEffect(() => {
                dispatch({
                    type: "UpdateZoom",
                    value: {
                        left: 1,
                        right: 10,
                        refAreaLeft: undefined,
                        refAreaRight: undefined,
                        bottom: 0,
                        top: 80,
                        stateData: state.stateData.slice()
                    }
                });
                dispatch({ type: "UpdateMap", id: "test", value: false });
                zoom();
                zoomOut();
                dispatch({ type: "WrongOne", value: 1 } as any);
                dispatch({ type: "UpdateRefAreaLeft", value: 1 });
                dispatch({ type: "UpdateRefAreaRight", value: 2 });
                // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
            }, []);
            const { zoom: zoom2 } = useRechartsHooks({
                refAreaLeft: 1,
                refAreaRight: 2,
                hasNegativeValue: true
            });
            useEffect(() => {
                zoom2();
                // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
            }, []);
            const { zoom: zoom3, zoomOut: zoomOut3 } = useRechartsHooks({
                activeMap: newMap,
                data: SINGLENUMBER_NEGATIVE_DATA,
                left: "dataMin",
                right: "dataMax",
                refAreaLeft: 2,
                refAreaRight: 1,
                top: 80,
                bottom: -100,
                hasNegativeValue: true
            });
            useEffect(() => {
                zoom3();
                zoomOut3();
                // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
            }, []);
            // when user clicks without dragging
            const { zoom: zoom4 } = useRechartsHooks({
                refAreaLeft: 1,
                refAreaRight: undefined
            });
            useEffect(() => {
                zoom4();
                // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
            }, []);
            // when user selects a single data point
            const { zoom: zoom5 } = useRechartsHooks({
                refAreaLeft: 1,
                refAreaRight: 1
            });
            useEffect(() => {
                zoom5();
                // eslint-disable-next-line react-hooks/exhaustive-deps
            }, []);
            return <div>Test</div>;
        };
        render(<TestComponent />);
    });
    it("should build a reducer without data", () => {
        const TestComponent = () => {
            useRechartsHooks();
            return <div>Test</div>;
        };
        render(<TestComponent />);
    });
});
````

````typescript
type TickFormatter = (value: unknown, ...args: unknown[]) => string;

type AxisOptionsWithFormatter = {
    tickFormatter?: TickFormatter;
};

export const defaultDateFormatter = (unixTime: unknown, ...args: unknown[]): string =>
    new Date(<number>unixTime).toLocaleDateString();

export const getTickFormatter = (
    axisOptions: AxisOptionsWithFormatter | undefined,
    formatToDate: boolean | undefined
): TickFormatter | undefined => {
    return axisOptions?.tickFormatter ? axisOptions.tickFormatter : formatToDate ? defaultDateFormatter : undefined;
};
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useEffect } from "react";
import { getChartsColorPalette } from "./getChartsColorPalette";
import { useLegendSegments } from "./useLegendSegments";
import {
    ButtonContainer,
    CustomLegendContainer,
    GraphContainer,
    GraphHeader,
    HeaderText,
    HeaderTextContainer,
    SubHeaderText,
    XAxisLabel,
    XAxisLabelContainer,
    YAxisLabel
} from "./StyledComponents";
import PopUp from "@molecules/PopUp/PopUp";
import Button from "@atoms/button/Button";
import Toggle from "@molecules/toggle/Toggle";
import useRechartsHooks from "./RechartsHooks";
import { ChartSummary } from "./ChartSummary";
import type { AccessoryOptions, ContainerDimensions, DataKeys, PopUpOptions, SummaryOptions } from "./PropTypes";

type RechartsState = {
    activeMap: Map<string | number, boolean>;
    stateData: Record<string, unknown>[];
};

type LegendSegment = {
    id: string;
    content: string;
    iconColor: string;
};

type SummaryData = {
    name: string;
    value: number;
    color: string;
};

const buildSummaryData = (
    { stateData, activeMap }: RechartsState,
    dataKeys: DataKeys,
    segments: LegendSegment[]
): SummaryData[] => {
    const summaryColors = segments.reduce<Record<string, string>>((colorsMap, { id, iconColor }) => {
        colorsMap[id] = iconColor;
        return colorsMap;
    }, {});

    return dataKeys
        .filter(({ dataKey }) => !!activeMap.get(typeof dataKey === "function" ? "" : dataKey))
        .map(({ displayName, dataKey }) => {
            const key = typeof dataKey === "function" ? "" : String(dataKey);
            return {
                name: displayName!,
                value: stateData.reduce((acc, item) => acc + (item[key] as number), 0),
                color: summaryColors[key]
            };
        });
};

type HeaderProps = {
    header?: string;
    subHeader?: string;
    shouldRenderPopup: boolean;
    popUpOptions: PopUpOptions;
};

const Header = ({ header, subHeader, shouldRenderPopup, popUpOptions }: HeaderProps) => {
    const { popUpButtonText, popUpButtonIcon, popUpText, popUpStyles, customPopUp, emergencyZIndex } = popUpOptions;
    return (
        <GraphHeader>
            <HeaderTextContainer>
                <HeaderText>{header}</HeaderText>
                <SubHeaderText>{subHeader}</SubHeaderText>
            </HeaderTextContainer>
            {shouldRenderPopup && (
                <PopUp
                    buttonType="border"
                    buttonText={popUpButtonText}
                    buttonIcon={popUpButtonIcon}
                    popUpText={popUpText}
                    popUpStyles={popUpStyles}
                    customPopUp={customPopUp}
                    emergencyZIndex={emergencyZIndex}
                    placement="bottom-end"
                />
            )}
        </GraphHeader>
    );
};

type ZoomOutButtonProps = {
    zoomOut: () => void;
    zoomOutText?: string;
};

const ZoomOutButton = ({ zoomOut, zoomOutText }: ZoomOutButtonProps) => (
    <div data-testid="zoom-out-button">
        <Button type={"border"} onClick={zoomOut}>
            <ButtonContainer>
                <span className="fas fa-search fa-s" style={{ marginRight: "5px" }} />
                <span>{zoomOutText}</span>
            </ButtonContainer>
        </Button>
    </div>
);

type LegendProps = {
    segments: LegendSegment[];
    selectedSegmentMap: Map<string | number, boolean>;
    handleSegmentToggle: (key: string | number) => void;
};

const Legend = ({ segments, selectedSegmentMap, handleSegmentToggle }: LegendProps) => (
    <CustomLegendContainer>
        <Toggle
            isMulti={true}
            isLegend={true}
            segments={segments}
            selectedSegmentMap={selectedSegmentMap}
            onClick={handleSegmentToggle}
            data-testid="legend-toggle"
        />
    </CustomLegendContainer>
);

type YAxisLabelComponentProps = {
    yAxisLabel: string;
};

const YAxisLabelComponent = ({ yAxisLabel }: YAxisLabelComponentProps) => (
    <React.Fragment>
        <YAxisLabel data-testid="y-axis-label"> {yAxisLabel} </YAxisLabel>
        <div style={{ height: "10px" }}> </div>
    </React.Fragment>
);

type XAxisLabelComponentProps = {
    xAxisLabel: string;
};

const XAxisLabelComponent = ({ xAxisLabel }: XAxisLabelComponentProps) => (
    <XAxisLabelContainer>
        <XAxisLabel data-testid="x-axis-label">{xAxisLabel}</XAxisLabel>
    </XAxisLabelContainer>
);

type WithAccessoriesOptions = {
    hasSummary?: boolean;
};

type HocProps = {
    state: RechartsState;
    palette: string[];
    zoom: () => void;
    updateRefAreaLeft: (e?: { activeLabel?: number }) => void;
    updateRefAreaRight: (e?: { activeLabel?: number }) => void;
};

type WithAccessoriesBaseProps = {
    dataKeys?: DataKeys;
    type?: "default" | "secondary" | "dualHeat" | "heat";
    isSimple?: boolean;
    header?: string;
    subHeader?: string;
    yAxisLabel?: string;
    xAxisLabel?: string;
    accessoryOptions?: AccessoryOptions;
    containerDimensions?: ContainerDimensions;
    popUpOptions?: PopUpOptions;
    summaryOptions?: SummaryOptions;
    hasNegativeValue?: boolean;
    customPalette?: string[];
    data?: unknown;
};

/**
 * HOC for charts with X and Y axes:
 * AreaGraph, BarChart, LineGraph
 */
function withAccessories(options: WithAccessoriesOptions = {}) {
    return <P extends WithAccessoriesBaseProps>(ChartComponent: React.ComponentType<P & { hocProps: HocProps }>) =>
        (props: P) => {
            const {
                data,
                dataKeys,
                type,
                isSimple = false,
                header,
                subHeader,
                yAxisLabel,
                xAxisLabel,
                accessoryOptions = {},
                containerDimensions = {},
                popUpOptions = {},
                summaryOptions = {},
                hasNegativeValue,
                customPalette
            } = props;
            const { state, dispatch, zoom, zoomOut } = useRechartsHooks({
                data: data as Record<string, unknown>[] | undefined,
                hasNegativeValue
            });
            const { zoomOutText, hasZoom, hideToggle, hideSummary } = accessoryOptions;
            const shouldRenderPopup = !!(popUpOptions.popUpButtonText || popUpOptions.popUpButtonIcon);

            const palette = customPalette ?? getChartsColorPalette(type);
            const legendDataKeys = dataKeys
                ? dataKeys.map(dk => ({
                      dataKey: typeof dk.dataKey === "function" ? "" : String(dk.dataKey),
                      displayName: dk.displayName || ""
                  }))
                : [];
            const segments = useLegendSegments(legendDataKeys, palette);
            const selectedSegmentMap = state.activeMap;
            const handleSegmentToggle = useCallback(
                (k: string | number) => {
                    const currVal = selectedSegmentMap.get(k);
                    dispatch({ type: "UpdateMap", id: String(k), value: !currVal });
                },
                [dispatch, selectedSegmentMap]
            );

            const updateRefAreaLeft = useCallback(
                (e?: { activeLabel?: number }) => dispatch({ type: "UpdateRefAreaLeft", value: e?.activeLabel! }),
                [dispatch]
            );
            /* istanbul ignore next */
            const updateRefAreaRight = useCallback(
                (e?: { activeLabel?: number }) => dispatch({ type: "UpdateRefAreaRight", value: e?.activeLabel! }),
                [dispatch]
            );

            useEffect(() => {
                dataKeys?.forEach(item => {
                    const { dataKey } = item;
                    const key = typeof dataKey === "function" ? "" : String(dataKey);
                    dispatch({ type: "UpdateMap", id: key, value: true });
                });
            }, [dataKeys, dispatch]);

            const hocProps = { state, palette, zoom, updateRefAreaLeft, updateRefAreaRight };
            const chartProps = { ...props, hocProps } as P & { hocProps: HocProps };

            if (isSimple) {
                return <ChartComponent {...chartProps} />;
            }

            return (
                <GraphContainer $dimensions={containerDimensions} data-testid="graph-container">
                    {
                        /* istanbul ignore next */ (header || subHeader || shouldRenderPopup) && (
                            <Header {...{ header, subHeader, shouldRenderPopup, popUpOptions }} />
                        )
                    }

                    {hasZoom && <ZoomOutButton {...{ zoomOut, zoomOutText }} />}

                    {!hideToggle && <Legend {...{ segments, selectedSegmentMap, handleSegmentToggle }} />}

                    {yAxisLabel && <YAxisLabelComponent yAxisLabel={yAxisLabel} />}

                    <ChartComponent {...chartProps} />

                    {xAxisLabel && <XAxisLabelComponent xAxisLabel={xAxisLabel} />}

                    {options.hasSummary && !hideSummary && dataKeys && (
                        <ChartSummary data={buildSummaryData(state, dataKeys, segments)} options={summaryOptions} />
                    )}
                </GraphContainer>
            );
        };
}

export default withAccessories;
````
