````typescript
import { useEffect } from "react";

export type UseCalculateResizeCallback = (height: number) => void;

export function useCalculateResize(ref: React.RefObject<HTMLElement>, callback: UseCalculateResizeCallback) {
    useEffect(() => {
        const calculateHeight = () => {
            if (ref?.current) {
                const height = ref.current.offsetHeight;
                callback(height);
            }
        };

        const observer = new ResizeObserver(() => {
            calculateHeight();
        });

        if (ref.current) {
            observer.observe(ref.current);
        }

        window.addEventListener("resize", calculateHeight);
        calculateHeight();

        const currentRef = ref.current;
        return () => {
            if (currentRef) {
                observer.unobserve(currentRef);
            }
            window.removeEventListener("resize", calculateHeight);
        };
    }, [ref, callback]);
}

export default useCalculateResize;
````

````typescript
/* istanbul ignore file */
import { useEffect, useRef } from "react";

export type UseEventListenerHandler<E extends Event = Event> = (event: E) => void;

export function useEventListener<E extends Event = Event>(
    eventName: string,
    handler: UseEventListenerHandler<E>,
    element: EventTarget | null = window
) {
    const savedHandler = useRef<UseEventListenerHandler<E> | undefined>(undefined);

    useEffect(() => {
        savedHandler.current = handler;
    }, [handler]);

    useEffect(() => {
        const isSupported = element && "addEventListener" in element;
        if (!isSupported) return;

        const eventListener = (event: Event) => savedHandler.current?.(event as E);

        element.addEventListener(eventName, eventListener);

        return () => {
            element.removeEventListener(eventName, eventListener);
        };
    }, [eventName, element]);
}

export default useEventListener;
````

````typescript
import { useRef, useLayoutEffect, useCallback, RefObject } from "react";
import { createTextMaskInputElement, Mask, PipeFn, TextMaskInputElement } from "text-mask-core";

export type UseInputMaskParams = {
    guide?: boolean;
    input?: RefObject<HTMLInputElement>;
    keepCharPositions?: boolean;
    mask: Mask | ((value: string) => Mask);
    onChange?: (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
    pipe?: PipeFn;
    placeholderChar?: string;
    showMask?: boolean;
    value?: string;
};

export function useInputMask({
    guide,
    input,
    keepCharPositions,
    mask,
    onChange,
    pipe,
    placeholderChar,
    showMask,
    value = ""
}: UseInputMaskParams) {
    const textMask = useRef<TextMaskInputElement | undefined>(undefined);

    const init = useCallback(() => {
        if (!input?.current) return;

        const inputElement = input.current;

        textMask.current = createTextMaskInputElement({
            guide,
            inputElement,
            keepCharPositions,
            mask,
            pipe,
            placeholderChar,
            showMask
        });

        textMask.current.update(value);
    }, [input, value, guide, keepCharPositions, mask, pipe, placeholderChar, showMask]);

    useLayoutEffect(() => {
        init();
    }, [init, guide, keepCharPositions, mask, pipe, placeholderChar, showMask, input, value]);

    useLayoutEffect(() => {
        if (input && input.current && value === input.current.value) return;

        init();
    }, [value, input, init]);

    return (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
        if (textMask && textMask.current) {
            textMask.current.update();
        }

        if (typeof onChange === "function") {
            onChange(event);
        }
    };
}

export default useInputMask;
````

````typescript
        jest.clearAllMocks();
        jest.clearAllTimers();
    });

        jest.runOnlyPendingTimers();

        const mockRef = { current: null } as unknown as React.RefObject<HTMLElement>;

        renderHook(() => useInsideBasicSlideout(mockRef, mockCallback));
````

## File: src/hooks/useInsideBasicSlideout.tsx
````typescript
import { type RefObject, useCallback, useEffect } from "react";

const useInsideBasicSlideout = (ref: RefObject<HTMLElement>, callback: (isInside: boolean) => void) => {
    // Memoize the callback to prevent infinite re-renders
    const stableCallback = useCallback(callback, [callback]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (ref.current) {
            const checkSlideout = () => {
                const hasMuiBackdrop = ref.current?.closest(".MuiBackdrop-root");
                const slideoutSelectors = [
                    "[class*='SlideoutPanelRoot']",
                    "[class*='SlideoutPanelRoot__SlideLeftTransition']",
                    "[class*='BasicSlideout']"
                ];
                const hasSlideoutPanelRoot = slideoutSelectors.some(selector => ref.current?.closest(selector));
                stableCallback(!!(hasMuiBackdrop && hasSlideoutPanelRoot));
            };

            // Use setTimeout for better Jest compatibility
            const timeoutId = setTimeout(checkSlideout, 0);

            return () => clearTimeout(timeoutId);
        }
    }, [ref, stableCallback]);
};

export default useInsideBasicSlideout;
````

````typescript
import React, { useRef } from "react";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import useOnClickOutside, { type UseOnClickOutsideCallback } from "./useOnClickOutside";

describe("useOnClickOutside Hook test", () => {
    const RandomComponent = ({ onClick }: { onClick?: UseOnClickOutsideCallback }) => {
        const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
        useOnClickOutside(ref as React.RefObject<HTMLElement>, onClick);
        return (
            <div data-testid="main-div">
                <div>
                    <div data-testid="do-not-click" ref={ref}>
                        Do not click me!
                    </div>
                </div>
                <div data-testid="click-me">Click Me!</div>
            </div>
        );
    };

    const TestComponent = ({
        isAutoClose,
        disablePortal,
        callback
    }: {
        isAutoClose?: boolean;
        disablePortal?: boolean;
        callback?: UseOnClickOutsideCallback;
    }) => {
        const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
        const popperRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);

        useOnClickOutside(ref as React.RefObject<HTMLElement>, callback, false, {
            isAutoClose,
            popperRef: popperRef as React.RefObject<HTMLElement>,
            disablePortal
        });

        return (
            <div>
                <div ref={ref} data-testid="inside-ref">
                    Inside Ref
                </div>
                <div ref={popperRef} data-testid="inside-popper">
                    Inside Popper
                </div>
                <div data-testid="outside">Outside</div>
            </div>
        );
    };

    it("should trigger the callback if clicked outside", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const onClick = jest.fn();
        render(<RandomComponent onClick={onClick} />);

        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("click-me"));

        expect(onClick).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should do nothing if no callback is passed", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        render(<RandomComponent />);

        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("click-me"));

        expect(screen.getByTestId("main-div")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should trigger the callback if clicked outside", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const onClick = jest.fn();
        render(<RandomComponent onClick={onClick} />);

        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("do-not-click"));

        expect(onClick).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should not call callback when clicking inside ref or popper with isAutoClose set to false", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const callback = jest.fn();
        render(<TestComponent isAutoClose={false} disablePortal={false} callback={callback} />);

        // Click inside the reference element
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("inside-ref"));
        // Click inside the popper element
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("inside-popper"));

        // Ensure the callback is not called
        expect(callback).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
});
````

````typescript
/*istanbul ignore file*/
import { useRef, useEffect } from "react";

// Hook
function useWhyDidYouUpdate<T extends Record<string, unknown>>(name: string, props: T) {
    // Get a mutable ref object where we can store props ...
    // ... for comparison next time this hook runs.
    const previousProps = useRef<T | undefined>(undefined);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (previousProps.current) {
            // Get all keys from previous and current props
            const allKeys = Object.keys({ ...previousProps.current, ...props });
            // Use this object to keep track of changed props
            const changesObj: Record<string, { from: unknown; to: unknown }> = {};
            // Iterate through keys
            allKeys.forEach(key => {
                // If previous is different from current
                if (previousProps.current && previousProps.current[key] !== props[key]) {
                    // Add to changesObj
                    changesObj[key] = {
                        from: previousProps.current[key],
                        to: props[key]
                    };
                }
            });

            // If changesObj not empty then output to console
            if (Object.keys(changesObj).length) {
                console.log("[why-did-you-update]", name, changesObj);
            }
        }

        // Finally update previousProps with current props for next hook call
        previousProps.current = props;
    });
}

export { useWhyDidYouUpdate };
export default useWhyDidYouUpdate;
````

````typescript
// Helper function to apply global search filter
const applySearchFilter = (data: MockDataItem[], searchTerm?: string): MockDataItem[] => {
    if (!searchTerm) return data;
    const keyword = searchTerm.toLowerCase();
    return data.filter(item => Object.values(item).some(val => String(val).toLowerCase().includes(keyword)));
};

// Helper function to apply selected filters
const applySelectedFilters = (
    data: MockDataItem[],
    selectedFilters?: Array<{ filterGroup: string; filterName: string }>
): MockDataItem[] => {
    if (!selectedFilters?.length) return data;

    const groupedFilters = selectedFilters.reduce<Record<string, Set<string>>>((acc, { filterGroup, filterName }) => {
        if (!acc[filterGroup]) acc[filterGroup] = new Set();
        acc[filterGroup].add(String(filterName)); // normalize to string
        return acc;
    }, {});

    return data.filter(item =>
        Object.entries(groupedFilters).every(([group, values]) => values.has(String(item[group as keyof MockDataItem])))
    );
};

// Helper function to apply sorting
const applySorting = (data: MockDataItem[], sortBy?: string, sortOrder?: "asc" | "desc"): MockDataItem[] => {
    if (!sortBy) return data;

    return [...data].sort((a, b) => {
        const aValue = a[sortBy as keyof MockDataItem];
        const bValue = b[sortBy as keyof MockDataItem];
        return sortOrder === "desc"
            ? String(aValue).localeCompare(String(bValue), undefined, { numeric: true })
            : String(bValue).localeCompare(String(aValue), undefined, { numeric: true });
    });
};

// Helper function to apply pagination
const applyPagination = (data: MockDataItem[], pageIndex: number, pageSize: number | "all"): MockDataItem[] => {
    const pageSizeInt = pageSize?.toString().toLowerCase() === "all" ? data.length : Number(pageSize);
    const start = pageIndex * pageSizeInt;
    return data.slice(start, start + pageSizeInt);
};

// Main function to simulate a fetch call
export const fetchMockData = async (params: FetchParams): Promise<FetchResponse> => {
    try {
        const { filters, pageIndex, pageSize, sortBy, sortOrder } = params;
        const allData = mockDataState.data;

        // Apply filters, sorting, and pagination
        let filteredData = applySearchFilter(allData, filters?.searchTerm);
        filteredData = applySelectedFilters(filteredData, filters?.selectedFilters);
        filteredData = applySorting(filteredData, sortBy, sortOrder);
        const paginatedData = applyPagination(filteredData, pageIndex, pageSize);

        // Simulate API latency
        return new Promise(resolve => {
            setTimeout(() => {
                resolve({
                    success: true,
                    rows: paginatedData,
                    totalCount: allData.length,
                    totalFilteredCount: filteredData.length || 0
                });
            }, 300); // 300ms delay
        });
    } catch (err) {
        const error = new Error("Mock API error occurred") as Error & { code?: number };
        error.code = (err as Error & { code?: number }).code || 500;
        throw error;
    }
};
// This function simulates a fetch call to an API that returns paginated data

// Named exports for types
export type { Label, MockDataItem, MockDataState, MockDataAction, FetchParams, FetchResponse, ApiResponse };
````

````typescript
// src/utils/accessibleAttrFilter.ts

/**
 * Filters an object to only include allowed accessible attributes.
 */
export function filterAccessibleAttributes(attrProps?: Record<string, unknown> | null): Record<string, unknown> {
    if (attrProps == null) attrProps = {};
    const allowed = [
        "aria-label",
        "aria-labelledby",
        "aria-describedby",
        "aria-controls",
        "aria-checked",
        "aria-expanded",
        "aria-haspopup",
        "aria-hidden",
        "aria-live",
        "aria-modal",
        "aria-pressed",
        "aria-readonly",
        "aria-required",
        "aria-selected",
        "aria-disabled",
        "role"
    ];
    return Object.keys(attrProps).reduce((acc, key) => {
        if (allowed.includes(key)) {
            acc[key] = attrProps[key];
        }
        return acc;
    }, {} as Record<string, unknown>);
}
````

````typescript
type AriaLabelValidation = (props: Record<string, unknown>, propName: string, componentName: string) => Error | null;

const AriaLabelValidation: AriaLabelValidation = (props, propName, componentName) => {
    const attrProps = (props[propName] as Record<string, unknown>) || {};
    const hasAriaLabel = "aria-label" in attrProps;
    const hasAriaLabelledby = "aria-labelledby" in attrProps;

    if (!hasAriaLabel && !hasAriaLabelledby) {
        return new Error(`Invalid prop in <${componentName}>: Provide either "aria-label" or "aria-labelledby".`);
    }

    if (hasAriaLabel && hasAriaLabelledby) {
        return new Error(
            `Invalid prop in <${componentName}>: Provide only one of "aria-label" or "aria-labelledby", not both.`
        );
    }

    return null;
};

export { AriaLabelValidation };
export type { AriaLabelValidation as AriaLabelValidationType };
````

````typescript
import addMinutes from "date-fns/addMinutes";
import addHours from "date-fns/addHours";
import addDays from "date-fns/addDays";
import addWeeks from "date-fns/addWeeks";
import addMonths from "date-fns/addMonths";
import addYears from "date-fns/addYears";
import subMinutes from "date-fns/subMinutes";
import subHours from "date-fns/subHours";
import subDays from "date-fns/subDays";
import subWeeks from "date-fns/subWeeks";
import subMonths from "date-fns/subMonths";
import subYears from "date-fns/subYears";
import dfIsEqual from "date-fns/isEqual";
import isAfter from "date-fns/isAfter";
import isBefore from "date-fns/isBefore";
import isValidDate from "date-fns/isValid";
import dfIsSameDay from "date-fns/isSameDay";
import differenceInCalendarDays from "date-fns/differenceInCalendarDays";
import parseISO from "date-fns/parseISO";
import toDate from "date-fns/toDate";

/**
 * Date Utils
 * source: https://github.com/Hacker0x01/react-datepicker/blob/master/src/date_utils.js
 */

// ** Date Math **

// *** Addition ***

export { addMinutes, addDays, addWeeks, addMonths, addYears };

// *** Subtraction ***

export { addHours, subMinutes, subHours, subDays, subWeeks, subMonths, subYears };

// ** Date Comparison **

export { isBefore, isAfter };

export type DateValue = string | string | Date | number;

export type DateBoundsOptions = {
    minDate?: Date | null;
    maxDate?: Date | null;
};

export type DayDisabledOptions = DateBoundsOptions & {
    excludeDates?: Date[];
    includeDates?: Date[];
    filterDate?: (date: Date | null) => boolean;
};

// ** Date Constructors **
export function newDate(value?: DateValue) {
    const d = value
        ? typeof value === "string" || value instanceof String
            ? parseISO(String(value))
            : toDate(value)
        : new Date();
    return isValid(d) ? d : null;
}

/*istanbul ignore next */
export function isValid(date: Date, minDate?: Date | null) {
    minDate = minDate ? minDate : new Date("1/1/1000");
    return isValidDate(date) && isAfter(date, minDate);
}

export function isSameDay(date1: Date | null | undefined, date2: Date | null | undefined) {
    /*istanbul ignore next */
    if (date1 && date2) {
        return dfIsSameDay(date1, date2);
    } else {
        return !date1 && !date2;
    }
}

export function isEqual(date1: Date | null | undefined, date2: Date | null | undefined) {
    /*istanbul ignore next */
    if (date1 && date2) {
        return dfIsEqual(date1, date2);
    } else {
        return !date1 && !date2;
    }
}

export function isDayDisabled(day: Date, options: DayDisabledOptions = {}) {
    const { minDate, maxDate, excludeDates, includeDates, filterDate } = options;
    return (
        isOutOfBounds(day, { minDate, maxDate }) ||
        (excludeDates && excludeDates.some(excludeDate => isSameDay(day, excludeDate))) ||
        (includeDates && !includeDates.some(includeDate => isSameDay(day, includeDate))) ||
        (filterDate && !filterDate(newDate(day))) ||
        false
    );
}

export function isOutOfBounds(day: Date, options: DateBoundsOptions = {}) {
    const { minDate, maxDate } = options;
    return (
        (minDate && differenceInCalendarDays(day, minDate) < 0) ||
        (maxDate && differenceInCalendarDays(day, maxDate) > 0)
    );
}
````

````typescript
// Declare process for NODE_ENV access

type PropTypeValidator = (
    props: Record<string, unknown>,
    propName: string,
    componentName: string,
    location: string,
    propFullName: string
) => Error | null;

function deprecated(validator: PropTypeValidator, reason: string) {
    return function deprecated(props: Record<string, unknown>, propName: string, ...rest: [string, string, string]) {
        if (props[propName] != null && process.env.NODE_ENV === "development") {
            console.warn(`${propName} is deprecated.  Reason:  ${reason}`);
````

## File: README.md
````markdown
# Tealium UI Kit

## Standards

**File Structure**
This repo utilizes [Atomic Design](https://bradfrost.com/blog/post/atomic-web-design/), thus components are categorized by atoms, molecules, organisms, templates and pages. Underneath that folder, component folders and files are named in PascalCase.

Example: **\<TableToolbar/>** component is classified as a molecule, and thus it's path would be **_src/components/molecules/TableToolbar/TableToolbar.jsx_**

The top level src has a components folder for components, and folders for shared common types used throughout the repository (hooks, css, utils, etc).

**Makeup of a component**
Each component shall have at least 3 files, contained in their own folder:

1.  Source file (*.js)
2.  Storybook stories file (*.stories.jsx)
3.  Unit test file (*.test.jsx)
4.  (optional) Styles file (*.styles.jsx) -- This allows us to separate CSS from the inline business logic.

**Code Coverage**
The repository enforces a 98% overall code coverage. Pre-commit hooks and a Jenkins pipeline tests these, along with pre-release checks.

**Other standards tools used**
Also utilized are standards tools Prettier and ESLint. Checks are done on pre-push as well as in Jenkins pipelines ensure standards are met.

**Component Generator**
A [component generator](https://tealium.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENGSD/pages/1278869850/Component+Generator) was created for both VSCode and Intellij. This takes the guess work out of creating the new files and folders manually.

## How to Contribute

### --> Reference the [Contribution Guide](https://tealium.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENGSD/pages/2927101149/UI+Kit+Contribution+Process+Chromatic) ###

### Commit Message

Before pushing your commit, make note that this repository uses a convention that allows us to do semantic versioning automatically. It's loosely based on the [angular commit messages convention](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/en/v1.0.0/).

**Convention**

    <type>(<scope>): <subject>
    <blank line>
    <body>
    <blank line>
    <footer>

**Accepted Commit [Type Enums](https://github.com/conventional-changelog/commitlint/tree/master/%40commitlint/config-conventional#type-enum)**

-   build
-   chore
-   ci
-   docs
-   feat (increments the minor version)
-   fix (increments the patch version)
-   perf
-   refactor
-   revert
-   style
-   test

**Patch Release Example (i.e. v1.0.0 -> v1.0.1)**
Use type _fix_ to release a patch version. Common use cases are for fixing existing code, or updating styles or prop-types.

    fix(radio): updated radiobutton styles

**Minor/Feature Release Example (i.e. v1.0.0 -> v1.1.0)**
Use types _feat_, _perf_ for a minor/feature release. This is mainly used for new features, or to update performance on existing code.

    feat(toggle): add triple state option to component

**Major/Breaking Release Example (i.e. v1.0.0 -> v2.0.0)**

> **IF YOU NEED TO DO A BREAKING CHANGE, YOU MUST CONSULT THE CORE UI/UX TEAM**

You can use any type for this, but as your footer, you need to add _BREAKING CHANGE: \<reason>_. Only use this if interfaces on a component will drastically change, thus making consumers refactor their code in order for it to work. The general format should be _WHY_ the change was made and _WHAT_ the change does. Extra information can be included as well, if needed.

    fix(table): updated table to accept different type of data object for cells

    BREAKING CHANGE: The original interface was too complicated, and added a lot of complexity in running.
    This change allows for more readability and better performance.  Existing consumers need to update
    existing code to reflect changes.

### IMPORTANT!!! index.js for named exports

In order for a newly made component to be importable, be sure to add the named export into src/index.js. **This is very important to allow your component to be consumed, please do not forget this step.**

### Code Reviews/Pull Requests

Merging to the main branch is managed by approved reviewers, see the `CODEOWNERS` file. After the code is reviewed, they will approve and merge the request.

### Symbolic Links

> THIS IS OUT OF DATE, NPM 6 BREAKS THIS METHOD.  UNTIL WE CAN MOVE FORWARD TO NPM 8, THE INSTRUCTIONS ARE DIFFERENT.

To test your changes as the consumer of the repository in UTUI for example, use [symbolic links](https://tealium.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENGSD/pages/1270481958/Symbolic+links+with+UTUI) to accomplish this.

## Jenkins Pipeline

Please refer to the [confluence page](https://tealium.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/ENGSD/pages/1430192495/Jenkins+Pipeline) for information on how the pipeline currently is implemented.
````

## File: scripts/generate-component-catalog.ts
````typescript
import fs from 'fs';
import path from 'path';

type ComponentMetadata = {
  name: string;
  category: 'atoms' | 'molecules' | 'organisms';
  path: string;
  hasStories: boolean;
  hasTests: boolean;
  hasStyles: boolean;
  types: string[];
  submodules: string[];
};

// Read package.json for version
const packageJsonPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'package.json');
if (!fs.existsSync(packageJsonPath)) {
  throw new Error(`package.json not found at ${packageJsonPath}`);
}
const packageJson = JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(packageJsonPath, 'utf-8'));
const version = packageJson.version;

const categories = ['atoms', 'molecules', 'organisms'] as const;
const componentsPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'src', 'components');
const allComponents: ComponentMetadata[] = [];

// Scan each category
for (const category of categories) {
  console.log(`Scanning ${category}...`);
  const categoryPath = path.join(componentsPath, category);

  if (!fs.existsSync(categoryPath)) {
    throw new Error(`Directory not found: ${categoryPath}`);
  }

  const entries = fs.readdirSync(categoryPath, { withFileTypes: true });
  const componentDirs = entries.filter(entry => entry.isDirectory());

  console.log(`Found ${componentDirs.length} ${category}`);

  for (const dir of componentDirs) {
    const dirName = dir.name;
    const componentPath = path.join(categoryPath, dirName);
    const files = fs.readdirSync(componentPath);

    // Detect main .tsx file (handle both PascalCase and lowercase dirs)
    const mainTsx = files.find(f => {
      const nameWithoutExt = f.replace('.tsx', '');
      return nameWithoutExt.toLowerCase() === dirName.toLowerCase() && f.endsWith('.tsx');
    });
    if (!mainTsx) continue; // Skip if no main component file

    // Use PascalCase name from the actual file
    const componentName = mainTsx.replace('.tsx', '');

    // Check for supporting files
    const hasStories = files.some(f => f.endsWith('.stories.tsx'));
    const hasTests = files.some(f => f.endsWith('.test.tsx'));
    const hasStyles = files.some(f => f.includes('Style') && f.endsWith('.tsx'));

    // Parse index.ts for types
    let types: string[] = [];
    const indexPath = path.join(componentPath, 'index.ts');
    if (fs.existsSync(indexPath)) {
      const indexContent = fs.readFileSync(indexPath, 'utf-8');
      const typeMatch = indexContent.match(/export type \{([^}]+)\}/);
      types = typeMatch ? typeMatch[1].split(',').map(t => t.trim()) : [];
    }

    // Detect submodules for organisms
    let submodules: string[] = [];
    if (category === 'organisms') {
      const subdirs = fs.readdirSync(componentPath, { withFileTypes: true })
        .filter(entry => entry.isDirectory())
        .map(entry => entry.name);
      submodules = subdirs;
    }

    allComponents.push({
      name: componentName,
      category,
      path: `src/components/${category}/${dirName}`,
      hasStories,
      hasTests,
      hasStyles,
      types,
      submodules,
    });
  }
}

console.log(`Total components: ${allComponents.length}`);

// Generate markdown
const markdown = `# Component Catalog

> Auto-generated component documentation for Tealium UI Kit v${version}

## Table of Contents

- [Quick Stats](#quick-stats)
- [Component Catalog](#component-catalog)
  - [Atoms](#atoms)
  - [Molecules](#molecules)
  - [Organisms](#organisms)
- [Architecture](#architecture)
- [Theme](#theme)
- [Development](#development)
- [Appendix](#appendix)

## Quick Stats

- **Version**: ${version}
- **Total Components**: ${allComponents.length}
- **Atoms**: ${allComponents.filter(c => c.category === 'atoms').length}
- **Molecules**: ${allComponents.filter(c => c.category === 'molecules').length}
- **Organisms**: ${allComponents.filter(c => c.category === 'organisms').length}
- **Components with Stories**: ${allComponents.filter(c => c.hasStories).length}
- **Components with Tests**: ${allComponents.filter(c => c.hasTests).length}

## Component Catalog

### Atoms

Basic building blocks of the UI.

${generateComponentTable(allComponents.filter(c => c.category === 'atoms'))}

### Molecules

Combinations of atoms working together.

${generateComponentTable(allComponents.filter(c => c.category === 'molecules'))}

### Organisms

Complex components made of molecules and atoms.

${generateComponentTable(allComponents.filter(c => c.category === 'organisms'))}

## Architecture

Key architectural files:

- **Build Config**: \`tsconfig.json\`, \`tsconfig.build.json\`, \`rollup.config.js\`
- **Entry Point**: \`src/index.ts\`
- **Exports**: Package exports defined in \`package.json\`
  - \`./atoms\`, \`./atoms/*\`
  - \`./molecules\`, \`./molecules/*\`
  - \`./organisms\`, \`./organisms/*\`
  - \`./hooks\`, \`./utils\`, \`./providers\`, \`./theme\`
  - \`./styles\` (CSS tokens)

## Theme

Theme system files:

- **Provider**: \`src/providers/ThemeProvider.tsx\`
- **MUI Theme**: \`src/theme/muiTheme.ts\`
- **Tokens**: \`src/theme/tokens.css\`
- **Colors**: \`src/theme/colors.ts\`, \`src/theme/colorMappings.ts\`
- **Utils**: \`src/theme/themeUtils.ts\`, \`src/theme/migrationHelper.ts\`

## Development

### Hooks

Available custom hooks in \`src/hooks/\`:

${generateHooksList()}

### Utils

Available utilities in \`src/utils/\`:

${generateUtilsList()}

### File Structure Example

\`\`\`
src/components/atoms/Button/
├── Button.tsx              # Main component
├── Button.test.tsx         # Tests
├── Button.stories.tsx      # Storybook stories
├── ButtonStyles.ts         # Styles
├── ButtonUtils.ts          # Utils
├── index.ts                # Exports
└── ...
\`\`\`

## Appendix

### All Components (A-Z)

${generateAlphabeticalList()}
`;

// Write output
const outputPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'COMPONENTS.md');
try {
  fs.writeFileSync(outputPath, markdown, 'utf-8');
  console.log(`Generated: ${outputPath}`);
} catch (error) {
  throw new Error(`Failed to write ${outputPath}: ${error}`);
}

// Helper functions
function generateComponentTable(components: ComponentMetadata[]): string {
  if (components.length === 0) return '_No components_';

  const rows = components.map(c => {
    const badges: string[] = [];
    if (c.hasStories) badges.push('📖 Stories');
    if (c.hasTests) badges.push('✅ Tests');
    if (c.submodules.length > 0) badges.push(`📦 ${c.submodules.length} submodules`);

    const typesStr = c.types.length > 0 ? c.types.join(', ') : '_none_';
    const badgesStr = badges.length > 0 ? badges.join(' · ') : '_none_';

    return `| **${c.name}** | \`${c.path}\` | ${typesStr} | ${badgesStr} |`;
  });

  return `| Component | Path | Exported Types | Features |
|-----------|------|----------------|----------|
${rows.join('\n')}`;
}

function generateHooksList(): string {
  const hooksPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'src', 'hooks');
  if (!fs.existsSync(hooksPath)) return '_No hooks_';

  const files = fs.readdirSync(hooksPath)
    .filter(f => f.endsWith('.tsx') && !f.endsWith('.test.tsx') && !f.endsWith('.stories.tsx'))
    .map(f => `- \`${f.replace('.tsx', '')}\``)
    .sort();

  return files.join('\n');
}

function generateUtilsList(): string {
  const utilsPath = path.join(process.cwd(), 'src', 'utils');
  if (!fs.existsSync(utilsPath)) return '_No utils_';

  const files = fs.readdirSync(utilsPath)
    .filter(f => f.endsWith('.ts') && !f.endsWith('.test.ts') && !f.endsWith('.d.ts'))
    .map(f => `- \`${f.replace('.ts', '')}\``)
    .sort();

  return files.join('\n');
}

function generateAlphabeticalList(): string {
  const sorted = [...allComponents].sort((a, b) => a.name.localeCompare(b.name));
  return sorted.map(c => `- **${c.name}** (${c.category}) - \`${c.path}\``).join('\n');
}
````

````typescript
        while (document.activeElement !== button && maxTabs > 0) {

        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(button);

        // Keyboard activation (Enter)

        expect(actionCallback).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);

        await user.keyboard("{Space}");
````

````typescript
import {
    BLUE_100,
    BLUE_700,
    GRAY_200,
    GRAY_800,
    GREEN_200,
    GREEN_800,
    ORANGE_200,
    ORANGE_800,
    PINK_100,
    PINK_800,
    PURPLE_100,
    PURPLE_800,
    RED_100,
    RED_600,
    SKY_100,
    SKY_800,
    YELLOW_200,
    YELLOW_800
} from "@css/constants";

// Shape constants
export const AvatarShape = {
    CIRCLE: "circle",
    SQUARE: "square"
} as const;

export const CIRCLE = AvatarShape.CIRCLE;
export const SQUARE = AvatarShape.SQUARE;
export type AvatarShape = (typeof AvatarShape)[keyof typeof AvatarShape];

// Size constants
export const AvatarSize = {
    SMALL: "small",
    MEDIUM: "medium",
    LARGE: "large"
} as const;

export const SMALL = AvatarSize.SMALL;
export const MEDIUM = AvatarSize.MEDIUM;
export const LARGE = AvatarSize.LARGE;
export type AvatarSize = (typeof AvatarSize)[keyof typeof AvatarSize];

// Color Constants
export const AvatarColor = {
    GRAY: "gray",
    RED: "red",
    ORANGE: "orange",
    YELLOW: "yellow",
    GREEN: "green",
    SKY: "sky",
    BLUE: "blue",
    PURPLE: "purple",
    PINK: "pink"
} as const;

export const GRAY = AvatarColor.GRAY;
export type AvatarColor = (typeof AvatarColor)[keyof typeof AvatarColor];

export const getBackgroundColor = {
    red: RED_100,
    orange: ORANGE_200,
    yellow: YELLOW_200,
    green: GREEN_200,
    sky: SKY_100,
    blue: BLUE_100,
    purple: PURPLE_100,
    pink: PINK_100,
    gray: GRAY_200
} as const;

export const getColor = {
    red: RED_600,
    orange: ORANGE_800,
    yellow: YELLOW_800,
    green: GREEN_800,
    sky: SKY_800,
    blue: BLUE_700,
    purple: PURPLE_800,
    pink: PINK_800,
    gray: GRAY_800
} as const;

// Height and width constants
export const SIZES = {
    small: "32px",
    medium: "40px",
    large: "48px"
} as const;

// Font size constants
export const FONT_SIZES = {
    small: "16px",
    medium: "20px",
    large: "24px"
} as const;

// Function returns border radius based on size and shape. Squares always have a border-radius: 4px, while circles depends on height and width.
export const getBorderRadius = ({ size, shape }: { size: AvatarSize; shape: AvatarShape }) => {
    if (shape === SQUARE) {
        return "4px";
    }

    return SIZES[size];
};
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { Badge } from "./Badge";

const linkProps = { href: "https://tealium.com/", target: "_blank" };
describe("Badge", () => {
    it("displays badge with high attention", () => {
        const label = "Test label";
        render(<Badge type="neutral" label={label} data-testid="badge-high-attention" />);

        // Label is rendered

        // Accessibility: aria-live and aria-atomic
        const badge = screen.getByTestId("badge-high-attention");
        expect(badge).toHaveAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
        expect(badge).toHaveAttribute("aria-atomic", "true");

        // Visual cues: correct class or style for high attention
        expect(badge).toHaveStyle({
            border: "1px solid #e4e5e6"
        });
        expect(badge).not.toHaveStyle({ border: "none" });

        // Icon should be present and hidden from screen readers
        const icon = badge.querySelector('[aria-hidden="true"]');
        expect(icon).toBeInTheDocument();

        // Label should be in the correct label span
        const labelSpan = screen.getByTestId("badge-high-attention-badge-label");
        expect(labelSpan).toHaveTextContent(label);
    });

        expect(screen.getByText(label)).toBeInTheDocument();

        // Accessibility: aria-live and aria-atomic
        const badge = screen.getByTestId("badge-low-attention");
        expect(badge).toHaveAttribute("aria-live", "polite");
        expect(badge).toHaveAttribute("aria-atomic", "true");

        // Visual cues: should NOT have border or background
        expect(badge).toHaveStyle({ border: "none" });
````

````typescript
import useUniqueId from "@hooks/useUniqueId";
import { hasTextContent } from "./ButtonTextImageValidation";
import { processAriaLabel } from "./ButtonUtils";

// Type definitions
export type ButtonType = "primary" | "secondary" | "border" | "borderless" | "serverCTA" | "segmented" | "destructive";
type BorderRadiusType = "left" | "right" | "both" | "none";
export type AttrType = "button" | "submit" | "reset";

type AriaAttributes = {
    "aria-label"?: string;
    "aria-labelledby"?: string;
    "aria-describedby"?: string;
    "aria-hidden"?: boolean;
    role?: string;
    tabIndex?: number;
    title?: string;
};

export type ButtonProps = Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<"button">, "type"> & {
    /** HTML button type attribute */
    attrType?: AttrType;
    /** Which sides should have radius borders */
    borderRadiusType?: BorderRadiusType;
    /** Disable text-transform capitalize. Can also set custom transform with child wrapper. */
    disableCapitalize?: boolean;
    /** Render small button variant */
    small?: boolean;
    /** Medium-small button variant (internal use) */
    mediumSmall?: boolean;
    /** Selected/highlighted state style */
    isHighlighted?: boolean;
    /** Button visual style type */
    type?: ButtonType;
    /** Set min-width to zero. Used for appended joint buttons. */
    isMinWidthZero?: boolean;
    /** Show loading indicator and disable button */
    loading?: boolean;
    /** Icon-only mode. Requires aria-label in attrProps for accessibility. */
    isIconOnly?: boolean;
    /** Pendo tracking attribute for data-track-action */
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    /** Testing identifier */
    "data-testid"?: string;
    /** @deprecated Use native HTML attributes instead. Accessibility attributes object. When isIconOnly=true, aria-label or aria-labelledby required. */
    attrProps?: AriaAttributes;
    /** Disable auto-fix for accessibility (internal use) */
    disableAutoFix?: boolean;
    /** @deprecated Use children instead. Legacy text prop */
    text?: string;
};

const Button = forwardRef<HTMLButtonElement, ButtonProps>(
    (
        {
            id,
            borderRadiusType = "both",
            type,
            attrType,
            small,
            mediumSmall,
            isHighlighted,
            isMinWidthZero,
            disableCapitalize,
            loading = false,
            isIconOnly = false,
            dataTrackAction,
            attrProps,
            disableAutoFix,
            text,
            // Extract native HTML props
            onClick,
            onMouseDown,
            disabled,
            children,
            className,
            "data-testid": dataTestId,
            "aria-label": nativeAriaLabel,
            "aria-labelledby": nativeAriaLabelledby,
            "aria-describedby": nativeAriaDescribedby,
            "aria-hidden": nativeAriaHidden,
            "aria-busy": nativeAriaBusy,
            role,
            tabIndex: nativeTabIndex,
            title,
            // Native button attributes
            form,
            name,
            value,
            autoFocus,
            formAction,
            formMethod,
            formNoValidate,
            formTarget,
            formEncType,
            ...nativeProps
        },
        ref
    ) => {
        const hasAriaLabel = "aria-label" in (attrProps || {});
        const hasAriaLabelledby = "aria-labelledby" in (attrProps || {});

        // Runtime validation for development (maintain PropTypes compatibility)
        React.useEffect(() => {
            if (hasAriaLabel && hasAriaLabelledby) {
                console.error(
                    "Warning: Failed %s type: %s%s",
                    "prop",
                    'Invalid prop in <Button>: Provide only one of "aria-label" or "aria-labelledby", not both.',
                    "\n    in Button (at src/components/atoms/button/Button.tsx)"
                );
            }
        }, [hasAriaLabel, hasAriaLabelledby]);

        const uniqueId = useUniqueId(); // generates unique id
        const buttonId = id || uniqueId;
        const isDisabled = disabled || loading;

        const handleOnMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
            if (onMouseDown) {
                onMouseDown(e);
            }
        };

        // Check if children contain readable text (including nested elements)
        const containsText = React.Children.toArray(children).some(hasTextContent);

        // Merge aria-label: attrProps takes precedence for backward compat
        const mergedAriaLabel = attrProps?.["aria-label"] ?? nativeAriaLabel;
        const mergedAriaLabelledby = attrProps?.["aria-labelledby"] ?? nativeAriaLabelledby;
        const mergedAriaDescribedby = attrProps?.["aria-describedby"] ?? nativeAriaDescribedby;
        const mergedAriaHidden = attrProps?.["aria-hidden"] ?? nativeAriaHidden;
        const mergedRole = attrProps?.["role"] ?? role;
        const mergedTitle = attrProps?.["title"] ?? title;
        const mergedTabIndex =
            attrProps?.["tabIndex"] !== undefined
                ? attrProps["tabIndex"]
                : nativeTabIndex !== undefined
                ? nativeTabIndex
                : isDisabled
                ? -1
                : 0;

        // Compute final aria-label:
        // 1. If explicit aria-label provided (attrProps or native), use it (attrProps takes precedence)
        // 2. Otherwise, if no text content, use processAriaLabel for icon-only buttons
        // 3. Otherwise, undefined (button has visible text)
        const computedAriaLabel = mergedAriaLabel
            ? mergedAriaLabel
            : containsText
            ? undefined
            : processAriaLabel(attrProps, isIconOnly, hasAriaLabel, hasAriaLabelledby);

        return (
            <MultiButton
                ref={ref}
                aria-label={computedAriaLabel}
                aria-labelledby={mergedAriaLabelledby}
                aria-describedby={mergedAriaDescribedby}
                aria-hidden={mergedAriaHidden}
                aria-busy={loading || nativeAriaBusy || undefined}
                role={mergedRole}
                title={mergedTitle}
                id={buttonId}
                small={small}
                btnType={type}
                type={attrType}
                disabled={isDisabled}
                onClick={onClick}
                mediumSmall={mediumSmall}
                data-testid={dataTestId}
                isIconOnly={isIconOnly}
                onMouseDown={handleOnMouseDown}
                tabIndex={mergedTabIndex}
                data-track-action={dataTrackAction ? dataTrackAction : undefined}
                className={className}
                // Native button form attributes
                form={form}
                name={name}
                value={value}
                autoFocus={autoFocus}
                formAction={formAction}
                formMethod={formMethod}
                formNoValidate={formNoValidate}
                formTarget={formTarget}
                formEncType={formEncType}
                {...nativeProps}
            >
                <ButtonContent
                    btnType={type}
                    disabled={isDisabled}
                    mediumSmall={mediumSmall}
                    small={small}
                    borderRadiusType={borderRadiusType}
                    isHighlighted={isHighlighted}
                    isMinWidthZero={isMinWidthZero}
                    tabIndex={-1}
                    disableCapitalize={disableCapitalize}
                    isIconOnly={isIconOnly}
                >
                    {loading && (
                        <ProgressIndicatorContainer>
                            <ProgressIndicator
                                size={small ? 14 : 16}
                                thickness={6}
                                shouldInheritColor
                                attrProps={{ "aria-hidden": true }}
                                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-loading-progress-button-${buttonId}`}
                            />
                        </ProgressIndicatorContainer>
                    )}
                    {text || children}
                </ButtonContent>
            </MultiButton>
        );
    }
);

Button.displayName = "Button";

// TODO: add media queries
const handleBorderRadius = (borderRadius: BorderRadiusType) => {
    switch (borderRadius) {
        case "left":
            return "5px 0px 0px 5px";
        case "right":
            return "0px 5px 5px 0px";
        case "none":
            return "0px";
        default:
            return "5px";
    }
};

const handleToggleBorderRadius = (borderRadius: BorderRadiusType) => {
    switch (borderRadius) {
        case "left":
            return "4px 0px 0px 4px";
        case "right":
            return "0px 4px 4px 0px";
        case "none":
            return "0px";
        default:
            return "4px";
    }
};

const baseButton = ({
    borderRadiusType,
    btnType,
    small
}: {
    borderRadiusType: BorderRadiusType;
    btnType?: ButtonType;
    small?: boolean;
}) => `
    font-family: proxima-nova, Proxima, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    border-radius: ${
        btnType === "segmented" ? handleToggleBorderRadius(borderRadiusType) : handleBorderRadius(borderRadiusType)
    };
    text-align: center;
    font-weight: 600;
    user-select: none;
    font-size: ${!small ? "1rem" : "0.875rem"};
    height: 100%;
`;

type MultiButtonProps = React.RefAttributes<HTMLButtonElement> & {
    small?: boolean;
    mediumSmall?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    btnType?: ButtonType;
    isIconOnly?: boolean;
};

const MultiButton = styled("button")<MultiButtonProps>`
    height: ${(props: MultiButtonProps) => (props.small ? "1.5rem" : props.mediumSmall ? "1.75rem" : "2rem")};
    display: inline-block;
    user-select: none;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    padding: 0;
    border: none;
    background: transparent;

    :hover > div {
        ${({ disabled, btnType, isIconOnly }: MultiButtonProps) =>
            !disabled && getButtonTypeHover({ type: btnType, isIconOnly })};
    }

    :focus > div {
        ${({ btnType, isIconOnly }: MultiButtonProps) => getButtonTypeFocus({ type: btnType, isIconOnly })}
    }

    :active > div {
        ${({ disabled, btnType, isIconOnly }: MultiButtonProps) =>
            !disabled && getButtonTypeToggle({ type: btnType, isIconOnly })}
    }

    :focus {
        outline: none;
    }

    /* Maximum specificity + !important + CSS custom properties */
    &&&&:hover i,
    &&&&:hover i.fas,
    &&&&:hover i.fa,
    &&&&:hover i.fa::before {
        /* Force override with CSS custom properties */
        color: var(--icon-hover-color, inherit) !important;
        fill: var(--icon-hover-fill, inherit) !important;
    }

    /* Set the custom properties on the button */
    &&& {
        --icon-hover-color: inherit;
        --icon-hover-fill: inherit;
    }
`;

type ButtonContentProps = {
    small?: boolean;
    mediumSmall?: boolean;
    disableCapitalize?: boolean;
    isMinWidthZero?: boolean;
    borderRadiusType: BorderRadiusType;
    btnType?: ButtonType;
    disabled?: boolean;
    isHighlighted?: boolean;
    isIconOnly?: boolean;
};

const ButtonContent = styled("div")<ButtonContentProps>`
    width: fit-content;
    display: flex;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    justify-content: center;
    align-items: center;
    padding: ${(props: ButtonContentProps) => (props.small ? "4px 8px" : props.mediumSmall ? "8px 6px" : "8px")};
    gap: 8px;
    cursor: pointer;
    text-transform: ${(props: ButtonContentProps) => (props.disableCapitalize ? "none" : "capitalize")};
    position: relative;
    min-width: ${(props: ButtonContentProps) => (props.isMinWidthZero ? "0" : "80px")};
    ${(props: ButtonContentProps) => baseButton(props)}
    ${({ disabled, btnType, isHighlighted, isIconOnly }: ButtonContentProps) => {
        if (disabled) return getButtonTypeDisabled({ type: btnType, isIconOnly: isIconOnly });
        if (isHighlighted) return getButtonTypeFocus({ type: btnType, isIconOnly: isIconOnly });
        return getButtonTypeBase({ type: btnType, isIconOnly: isIconOnly });
    }}

    &:focus {
        outline: none;
    }
`;

const ProgressIndicatorContainer = styled("div")`
    display: flex;
    margin-right: 0.5rem;
`;

export default Button;
````

````typescript
        await user.click(checkbox);
        expect(screen.getByTestId("checked-value").textContent).toEqual("false");
        expect(screen.getByTestId("id-value").textContent).toEqual("test_id");
    });
    it('should set data-track-action to "myAction-unchecked" when unchecked', () => {
        const { container } = render(
            <Checkbox
                checked={false}
                dataTrackAction="myAction"
                label="Test"
                onChange={() => {}}
                data-testid="track-action-checkbox"
            />
        );
        const trackActionEl = container.querySelector("[data-track-action]");
        expect(trackActionEl).toHaveAttribute("data-track-action", "myAction-unchecked");
    });

    it("should not set data-track-action when dataTrackAction is not provided", () => {
        render(<Checkbox checked={false} label="Test" onChange={() => {}} data-testid="track-action-checkbox" />);
        expect(screen.getByTestId("track-action-checkbox")).not.toHaveAttribute("data-track-action");
    });

    // TDD RED PHASE: Tests for bd-ts2.7.4.1 refactoring
    describe("forwardRef and ComponentPropsWithRef support", () => {
        it("should forward ref to the underlying input element", () => {
            const ref = React.createRef<HTMLInputElement>();
            render(<Checkbox label="Ref Test" ref={ref} />);

            expect(ref.current).toBeInstanceOf(HTMLInputElement);
            expect(ref.current?.type).toBe("checkbox");
        });

        it("should allow access to input element methods via ref", () => {
            const ref = React.createRef<HTMLInputElement>();
            render(<Checkbox label="Ref Methods" ref={ref} />);

            // Should be able to call focus on the ref
            expect(() => ref.current?.focus()).not.toThrow();
            expect(ref.current?.tagName).toBe("INPUT");
        });

        it("should pass custom onChange with CheckboxState and event", async () => {
            const user = userEvent.setup();
            const onChange = jest.fn();

            render(<Checkbox id="custom-onChange-id" label="Custom onChange" checked={false} onChange={onChange} />);

            const checkbox = screen.getByRole("checkbox");
            await user.click(checkbox);

            // Verify onChange receives CheckboxState object as first param and event as second
            expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
                expect.objectContaining({
                    id: "custom-onChange-id",
                    checked: true,
                    indeterminate: false
                }),
                expect.objectContaining({
                    target: expect.any(Object),
                    type: "change"
                })
            );
        });

        it("should forward inputProps correctly", () => {
            render(
                <Checkbox
                    label="Input Props"
                    inputProps={{
                        "data-custom": "custom-value",
                        "aria-describedby": "description-id"
                    }}
                    data-testid="input-props-checkbox"
                />
            );

            const checkbox = screen.getByTestId("input-props-checkbox");
            expect(checkbox).toHaveAttribute("data-custom", "custom-value");
            expect(checkbox).toHaveAttribute("aria-describedby", "description-id");
        });

        it("should spread native HTML attributes properly", () => {
            render(
                <Checkbox label="Native Attrs" data-testid="native-attrs-checkbox" aria-required="true" tabIndex={0} />
            );

            const checkbox = screen.getByTestId("native-attrs-checkbox");
            expect(checkbox).toHaveAttribute("aria-required", "true");
            expect(checkbox).toHaveAttribute("tabindex", "0");
        });

        it("should maintain ref stability across re-renders", () => {
            const ref = React.createRef<HTMLInputElement>();

            function Wrapper() {
                const [checked, setChecked] = React.useState(false);
                return (
                    <>
                        <Checkbox
                            ref={ref}
                            label="Stable Ref"
                            checked={checked}
                            onChange={v => setChecked(v.checked)}
                        />
                        <button onClick={() => setChecked(!checked)}>Toggle</button>
                    </>
                );
            }

            render(<Wrapper />);
            const firstRef = ref.current;

            fireEvent.click(screen.getByText("Toggle"));

            // Ref should point to the same element after re-render
            expect(ref.current).toBe(firstRef);
        });
    });
});
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import Card from "@molecules/Card/Card";
import { BLUE_500, GRAY_600 } from "@css/constants";
import { filterAccessibleAttributes } from "@utils/accessibleAttrFilter";

export type FileCardProps = {
    /**
     * File name to display
     */
    fileName: string;
    /**
     * Is FileCard has error?
     */
    hasError?: boolean;
    /**
     * Callback to call when remove icon is clicked
     */
    onRemove?: (fileName: string) => void;
    /**
     * Test id for testing
     */
    "data-testid"?: string;
    /**
     * Accessibility attributes for remove icon
     */
    attrProps?: Record<string, unknown>;
};

const FileCard: React.FC<FileCardProps> = ({
    fileName,
    hasError = false,
    onRemove,
    "data-testid": dataTestId,
    attrProps = {}
}) => {
    const onRemoveClick = useCallback(() => {
        onRemove && onRemove(fileName);
    }, [fileName, onRemove]);

    const onRemoveKeyDown = useCallback(
        (e: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
            if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
                e.preventDefault();
                onRemoveClick();
            }
        },
        [onRemoveClick]
    );

    const allowedAttrProps = filterAccessibleAttributes(attrProps);

    // Ensure tabIndex and role are set for accessibility if not provided
    const removeIconProps = {
        tabIndex: (allowedAttrProps.tabIndex as number) ?? 0,
        role: (allowedAttrProps.role as string) ?? "button",
        "aria-label": (allowedAttrProps["aria-label"] as string) ?? "Remove file",
        ...allowedAttrProps,
        onKeyDown: onRemoveKeyDown
    };

    return (
        <Card hasError={hasError} data-testid={dataTestId}>
            <Content>
                <FileNameContainer>
                    <FileIcon className="fas fa-file-alt" />
                    <FileName>{fileName}</FileName>
                </FileNameContainer>
                <RemoveIcon
                    className="fas fa-trash"
                    data-testid={`${dataTestId}_remove_icon`}
                    onClick={onRemoveClick}
                    {...removeIconProps}
                />
            </Content>
        </Card>
    );
};

const Content: React.ComponentType<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> = styled("div")`
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
    align-items: center;
` as any;

const FileIcon: React.ComponentType<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>> = styled("span")`
    margin-right: 1.625rem;
    font-size: 1.25rem;
    color: ${BLUE_500};
` as any;

const FileName: React.ComponentType<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>> = styled("span")`
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 143%;
    color: #0a1b36;
    white-space: nowrap;
    overflow: hidden;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
` as any;

const FileNameContainer: React.ComponentType<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> = styled("div")`
    min-width: 0;
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    margin-right: 1.25rem;
` as any;

const RemoveIcon: React.ComponentType<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>> = styled("span")`
    font-size: 0.75rem;
    color: ${GRAY_600};

    :hover {
        cursor: pointer;
    }
` as any;

export default FileCard;
````

````typescript
// COLORS FOR BACKGROUND LABELS
const RED_BG = RED_50;
const ORANGE_BG = ORANGE_50;
const YELLOW_BG = YELLOW_100;
const GREEN_BG = GREEN_50;
const MINT_BG = MINT_50;
const AQUA_BFG = AQUA_50;
const SKY_BG = SKY_50;
const BLUE_BG = BLUE_50;
const INDINGO_BG = INDINGO_50;

const VIOLET_BG = VIOLET_50;
const PINK_BG = PINK_50;
const CORAL_BG = CORAL_50;
const GREY_BG = GRAY_200;

// TODO: extract into token base system
const LABEL_COLORS = [RED, ORANGE, YELLOW, GREEN, MINT, AQUA, SKY, BLUE, INDINGO, PURPLE, VIOLET, PINK, CORAL, GREY];

const LABEL_FONT_COLORS = [
    RED_FONT,
    ORANGE_FONT,
    YELLOW_FONT,
    GREEN_FONT,
    MINT_FONT,
    AQUA_FONT,
    SKY_FONT,
    BLUE_FONT,
    INDINGO_FONT,
    PURPLE_FONT,
    VIOLET_FONT,
    PINK_FONT,
    CORAL_FONT,
    GREY_FONT
];

const LABEL_BACKGROUND_COLORS = [
    RED_BG,
    ORANGE_BG,
    YELLOW_BG,
    GREEN_BG,
    MINT_BG,
    AQUA_BFG,
    SKY_BG,
    BLUE_BG,
    INDINGO_BG,
    PURPLE_BF,
    VIOLET_BG,
    PINK_BG,
    CORAL_BG,
    GREY_BG
];

export const getLabelColor = (type: string, colorNumber?: number): string => {
    const index = (colorNumber ?? 1) - 1;
    switch (type) {
        case LABELS_ICON:
            return LABEL_COLORS[index] || LABEL_COLORS[0];
        case LABELS_BG:
            return LABEL_BACKGROUND_COLORS[index] || LABEL_BACKGROUND_COLORS[0];
        case LABELS_FONT:
            return LABEL_FONT_COLORS[index] || LABEL_FONT_COLORS[0];
        default:
            return LABEL_COLORS[index] || LABEL_COLORS[0];
    }
};

export type LabelColorType = (typeof LABELS_COLOR_TYPES)[keyof typeof LABELS_COLOR_TYPES];
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import Labels from "./Labels";
import { render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";

const LABELS_DATA: Array<{ color: number; text: string }> = [
    { color: 1, text: "Red" },
    { color: 2, text: "Orange" },
    { color: 3, text: "Yellow" },
    { color: 4, text: "Green" },
    { color: 5, text: "Mint" }
];

describe("Labels Tests", () => {
    it("should render a label", () => {
        render(
            <Labels color={1} data-testid="label-test">
                Label Text
            </Labels>
        );
        const label = screen.getByTestId("label-test");
        expect(label).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(label).toHaveTextContent("Label Text");
        // Check for style or class related to color (styled-components injects style)
        expect(label).toHaveStyle({ backgroundColor: expect.any(String) });
    });

    it("should render a label with accessible role if provided", () => {
        render(
            <Labels color={2} data-testid="label-accessible" attrProps={{ role: "status" }}>
                Accessible Label
            </Labels>
        );
        const label = screen.getByTestId("label-accessible");
        expect(label).toHaveTextContent("Accessible Label");
        expect(label).toHaveAttribute("role", "status");
    });

    it("should render a label with missing color prop (fallback to default)", () => {
        render(<Labels data-testid="label-default">Default Color</Labels>);
        const label = screen.getByTestId("label-default");
        expect(label).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(label).toHaveTextContent("Default Color");
    });

    it("should render a label with invalid color prop (fallback to default)", () => {
        render(
            <Labels color={99} data-testid="label-invalid">
                Invalid Color
            </Labels>
        );
        const label = screen.getByTestId("label-invalid");
        expect(label).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(label).toHaveTextContent("Invalid Color");
    });

    it("should render a label with default label's color", () => {
        render(
            <Labels color={0} data-testid="label-default-color">
                Default Color Label
            </Labels>
        );
        const label = screen.getByTestId("label-default-color");
        expect(label).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(label).toHaveTextContent("Default Color Label");
        // Check that a background color is applied (styled-components injects style)
        expect(label).toHaveStyle({ backgroundColor: expect.any(String) });
    });

    it("should render a label with undefined color (fallback to default)", () => {
        render(<Labels data-testid="label-undefined-color">Undefined Color Label</Labels>);
        const label = screen.getByTestId("label-undefined-color");
        expect(label).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(label).toHaveTextContent("Undefined Color Label");
        expect(label).toHaveStyle({ backgroundColor: expect.any(String) });
    });

    it("should render a label with default color and accessibility attribute", () => {
        render(
            <Labels color={0} data-testid="label-default-accessible" attrProps={{ "aria-label": "default label" }}>
                Accessible Default
            </Labels>
        );
        const label = screen.getByTestId("label-default-accessible");
        expect(label).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(label).toHaveTextContent("Accessible Default");
        expect(label).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "default label");
        expect(label).toHaveStyle({ backgroundColor: expect.any(String) });
    });

    it("should render a labels data", () => {
        render(
            <Labels
                labelsData={LABELS_DATA.slice(0, 3)}
                data-testid="label-test"
                attrProps={{ "aria-label": "label-group" }}
            />
        );
        // Wrapper present
        const wrapper = screen.getByTestId("label-test-labels-wrapper");
        expect(wrapper).toBeInTheDocument();
        // Each label present with correct text and style
        LABELS_DATA.slice(0, 3).forEach(labelData => {
            const label = screen.getByTestId(`label-test-${labelData.text}`);
            expect(label).toBeInTheDocument();
            expect(label).toHaveTextContent(labelData.text);
            expect(label).toHaveStyle({ backgroundColor: expect.any(String) });
            // Should inherit group accessibility attribute if passed
            // (attrProps only applies to each label, not the wrapper)
            expect(label).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "label-group");
        });
        // Number of labels rendered matches data length (up to visible limit)
        expect(wrapper.querySelectorAll('[data-testid^="label-test-"]').length).toBe(3);
    });

    it("should render nothing if labelsData is empty", () => {
        const { container } = render(<Labels labelsData={[]} data-testid="label-test" />);
        expect(container).toBeEmptyDOMElement();
    });

    it("should filter out labels with missing text", () => {
        const data: Array<{ color: number; text?: string }> = [
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import ProgressIndicator from "./ProgressIndicator";
import { render } from "@testing-library/react";

describe("ProgressIndicator Tests", () => {
    it("should render circular progress indicator", () => {
        // assemble/act
        const { getByRole, rerender } = render(
            <ProgressIndicator data-testid="circular-progress" attrProps={{ "aria-label": "Loading indicator" }} />
        );
        const progress = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(progress).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(progress).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "Loading indicator");
        // Should not have aria-valuenow for indeterminate
        expect(progress).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow");
        // Should be visible
        expect(progress).toBeVisible();

        // Custom props: size, thickness, shouldInheritColor, className
        rerender(
            <ProgressIndicator
                size={80}
                thickness={8}
                shouldInheritColor={true}
                className="custom-class"
                data-testid="circular-progress"
                attrProps={{ "aria-label": "Custom loading" }}
            />
        );
        const customProgress = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(customProgress).toHaveClass("custom-class");
        expect(customProgress).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "Custom loading");

        // Edge case: determinate mode with value=0
        rerender(<ProgressIndicator value={0} data-testid="circular-progress" />);
        const zeroProgress = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(zeroProgress).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", "0");
        // MUI does not set aria-valuemin or aria-valuemax by default
        expect(zeroProgress).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemin");
        expect(zeroProgress).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemax");

        // Edge case: determinate mode with value=100
        rerender(<ProgressIndicator value={100} data-testid="circular-progress" />);
        const maxProgress = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(maxProgress).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", "100");
    });

    it("should render linear progress indicator", () => {
        // Renders indeterminate linear progress
        const { getByRole, rerender } = render(
            <ProgressIndicator
                type="linear"
                data-testid="linear-progress"
                attrProps={{ "aria-label": "Linear loading" }}
            />
        );
        const progress = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(progress).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(progress).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "Linear loading");
        expect(progress).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow"); // indeterminate
        expect(progress).toBeVisible();

        // Custom className
        rerender(<ProgressIndicator type="linear" className="custom-linear" data-testid="linear-progress" />);
        const customProgress = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(customProgress).toHaveClass("custom-linear");

        // Edge case: determinate mode with value=0
        rerender(<ProgressIndicator type="linear" value={0} data-testid="linear-progress" />);
        const zeroProgress = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(zeroProgress).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", "0");
        expect(zeroProgress).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemin", "0");
        expect(zeroProgress).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemax", "100");

        // Edge case: determinate mode with value=100
        rerender(<ProgressIndicator type="linear" value={100} data-testid="linear-progress" />);
        const maxProgress = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(maxProgress).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", "100");
        expect(maxProgress).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemin", "0");
        expect(maxProgress).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemax", "100");
    });

    it("should render circular determinate indicator", () => {
        const { getByRole, rerender } = render(<ProgressIndicator value={50} data-testid="circular-determinate" />);
        const progress = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(progress).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(progress).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", "50");
        // MUI CircularProgress does not set aria-valuemin or aria-valuemax by default
        expect(progress).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemin");
        expect(progress).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemax");
        expect(progress).toBeVisible();
        // Edge case: value at 0
        rerender(<ProgressIndicator value={0} data-testid="circular-determinate" />);
        const progressZero = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(progressZero).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", "0");
        // Edge case: value at 100
        rerender(<ProgressIndicator value={100} data-testid="circular-determinate" />);
        const progressFull = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(progressFull).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", "100");
    });

    it("should render linear determinate indicator", () => {
        const { getByRole } = render(<ProgressIndicator type="linear" value={50} data-testid="linear-determinate" />);
        const progress = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(progress).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(progress).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", "50");
        expect(progress).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemin", "0");
        expect(progress).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemax", "100");
        expect(progress).toBeVisible();
    });

    it("should render linear progress indicator (accessibility, custom props, edge cases)", () => {
        const { getByRole, rerender } = render(
            <ProgressIndicator type="linear" value={60} data-testid="linear-progress" aria-label="Loading progress" />
        );
        const progress = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(progress).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(progress).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "Loading progress");
        // MUI LinearProgress (determinate) sets aria-valuenow, aria-valuemin, aria-valuemax
        expect(progress).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", "60");
        expect(progress).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemin", "0");
        expect(progress).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemax", "100");
        expect(progress).toHaveAttribute("data-testid", "linear-progress");
        // Note: custom color prop is not supported in this implementation
        // Edge case: value at 0
        rerender(<ProgressIndicator type="linear" value={0} />);
        const progressZero = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(progressZero).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", "0");
        expect(progressZero).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemin", "0");
        expect(progressZero).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemax", "100");
        // Edge case: value at 100
        rerender(<ProgressIndicator type="linear" value={100} />);
        const progressFull = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(progressFull).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", "100");
        expect(progressFull).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemin", "0");
        expect(progressFull).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemax", "100");
    });

    it("should not be focusable by keyboard by default (circular)", () => {
        const { getByRole } = render(<ProgressIndicator />);
        const progress = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(progress.tabIndex).toBe(-1);
    });

    it("should not be focusable by keyboard by default (linear)", () => {
        const { getByRole } = render(<ProgressIndicator type="linear" />);
        const progress = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(progress.tabIndex).toBe(-1);
    });

    it("should be focusable by keyboard if tabIndex=0 is set (circular)", () => {
        const { getByRole } = render(<ProgressIndicator tabIndex={0} />);
        const progress = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(progress.tabIndex).toBe(0);
    });

    it("should be focusable by keyboard if tabIndex=0 is set (linear)", () => {
        const { getByRole } = render(<ProgressIndicator type="linear" tabIndex={0} />);
        const progress = getByRole("progressbar");
        expect(progress.tabIndex).toBe(0);
    });
});
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { StyledCircularProgress, StyledLinearIndicator } from "./ProgressIndicator.styles";

export type ProgressIndicatorProps = {
    /**
     * Type of progress indicator to display
     */
    type?: "circular" | "linear";
    /**
     * Value of the progress indicator, from 1 - 100.
     * If not set, the indicator will be indeterminate
     */
    value?: number;
    /**
     * Size of an indicator.
     * CircularIndicator only!
     */
    size?: number | string;
    /**
     * Thickness of an indicator
     * CircularIndicator only!
     */
    thickness?: number;
    /**
     * should an indicator inherit outer color?
     * CircularIndicator only!
     */
    shouldInheritColor?: boolean;
    /**
     * Additional accessible attributes to pass to the component
     * e.g. aria-hidden
     */
    attrProps?: Record<string, unknown>;
    /**
     * Used for testing
     */
    "data-testid"?: string;
    /**
     * CSS class name
     */
    className?: string;
    /**
     * Tab index for keyboard navigation
     */
    tabIndex?: number;
};

type CircularIndicatorProps = {
    size?: number | string;
    thickness?: number;
    shouldInheritColor?: boolean;
    value?: number;
    variant: "determinate" | "indeterminate";
    "data-testid"?: string;
    "aria-label"?: string;
    "aria-hidden"?: boolean;
} & React.ComponentProps<typeof StyledCircularProgress>;

type LinearIndicatorProps = {
    value?: number;
    variant: "determinate" | "indeterminate";
    "data-testid"?: string;
    "aria-label"?: string;
    "aria-hidden"?: boolean;
} & React.ComponentProps<typeof StyledLinearIndicator>;

const ProgressIndicator = ({
    type = "circular",
    value,
    "data-testid": dataTestId,
    attrProps,
    ...props
}: ProgressIndicatorProps) => {
    const hasValue = !isNaN(value as number);
    const Indicator = type === "circular" ? CircularIndicator : LinearIndicator;
    const ariaLabel = type === "circular" ? "Loading" : "Loading progress";

    let variant: "determinate" | "indeterminate" = "indeterminate";
    if (hasValue) {
        variant = "determinate";
    }

    return (
        <Indicator
            value={value}
            variant={variant}
            data-testid={dataTestId}
            aria-label={(attrProps?.["aria-label"] as string) || ariaLabel}
            aria-hidden={(attrProps?.["aria-hidden"] as boolean) ?? undefined}
            {...props}
        />
    );
};

const CircularIndicator = ({ size, thickness, shouldInheritColor = false, ...props }: CircularIndicatorProps) => (
    <StyledCircularProgress
        size={size ?? 50}
        thickness={thickness ?? 6}
        $shouldInheritColor={shouldInheritColor}
        {...props}
    />
);

const LinearIndicator = (props: LinearIndicatorProps) => <StyledLinearIndicator {...props} />;

export default ProgressIndicator;
````

````typescript
        const input = radioWrapper.querySelector("input[type='radio']");
        expect(input).toBeInTheDocument();

        expect(input).toBeChecked();

        render(<RadioButton data-testid="radio-test" />);

    });

    it("should generate a default aria-label if not provided and isStandAlone is true", () => {
        render(<RadioButton data-testid="radio-test" value="foo" isStandAlone={true} />);
        const input = screen.getByTestId("radio-test").querySelector("input");
        expect(input).toHaveAttribute("aria-label");
        if (input) {
            expect(input.getAttribute("aria-label")).toMatch(/Radio button option|foo/);
        }
    });

    it("should not set aria-label if not standalone and no aria-label provided", () => {
        render(<RadioButton data-testid="radio-test" value="foo" isStandAlone={false} />);
        const input = screen.getByTestId("radio-test").querySelector("input");
        // Should not have aria-label attribute
        if (input) {
            expect(input.hasAttribute("aria-label")).toBe(false);
        }
    });

    it("should respect custom aria-labelledby if provided", () => {
        render(
            <>
                <span id="label-id">Custom Label</span>
                <RadioButton data-testid="radio-test" inputProps={{ "aria-labelledby": "label-id" }} />
            </>
        );
        const input = screen.getByTestId("radio-test").querySelector("input");
        expect(input).toHaveAttribute("aria-labelledby", "label-id");
    });
});
````
