````typescript
import React from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import { GREEN_500, GRAY_300, GRAY_600, GRAY_700, GRAY_900, BASICS_WHITE, GRAY_500, GREEN_100 } from "@css/constants";
import MuiSwitch, { SwitchProps } from "@mui/material/Switch";
import ReactDOMServer from "react-dom/server";

type SwitchComponentProps = SwitchProps & {
    theme?: any;
    disabled?: boolean;
};

export const Switch: React.ComponentType<SwitchComponentProps> = styled((props: SwitchComponentProps) => (
    <MuiSwitch focusVisibleClassName=".Mui-focusVisible" {...props} />
))(({ theme, disabled }) => ({
    padding: 0,
    "&:active, &:focus-within": {
        boxSizing: "border-box",
        boxShadow: disabled ? "none" : "0 0 0 2px transparent, 0 0 0 3px rgba(19, 98, 162, 1)",
        outline: disabled ? "none" : "1px solid #fff",
        borderRadius: 32 / 2
    },

    "& .MuiSwitch-switchBase": {
        padding: 1,
        transitionDuration: "300ms",
        "&.Mui-checked": {
            backgroundColor: "unset",
            transform: "translateX(15px)",
            color: "#fff",
            "& + .MuiSwitch-track": {
                backgroundColor: GREEN_500,
                opacity: 1,
                border: 0
            },
            "&.Mui-disabled + .MuiSwitch-track": {
                opacity: 1,
                backgroundColor: GREEN_100
            }
        },
        "&.Mui-focusVisible .MuiSwitch-thumb": {
            color: GREEN_500,
            border: "6px solid #fff"
        },
        "&.Mui-disabled .MuiSwitch-thumb": {
            color: BASICS_WHITE
        },
        "&.Mui-disabled + .MuiSwitch-track": {
            opacity: 1,
            backgroundColor: GRAY_300
        }
    },
    "& .MuiSwitch-thumb": {
        boxSizing: "border-box",
        boxShadow: "none",
        "&:before": {
            content: "''",
            position: "absolute",
            backgroundRepeat: "no-repeat",
            backgroundPosition: "center"
        }
    },
    "& .MuiSwitch-track": {
        borderRadius: 32 / 2,
        backgroundColor: GRAY_600,
        opacity: 1,
        transition: theme.transitions.create(["background-color"], {
            duration: 500
        })
    }
})) as any;

type CheckedIconProps = {
    fillColor: string;
};

const CheckedIcon: React.FC<CheckedIconProps> = ({ fillColor }) => (
    <svg
        xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
        height="6px"
        width="6px"
        viewBox="0 0 6 6"
        focusable="false"
        aria-hidden="true"
    >
        <path
            d="M5.595 1.895c0 0.084-0.033 0.167-0.094 0.228l-2.879 2.879c-0.060 0.060-0.144 0.094-0.228 0.094s-0.167-0.033-0.228-0.094l-1.667-1.667c-0.060-0.060-0.094-0.144-0.094-0.228s0.033-0.167 0.094-0.228l0.455-0.455c0.060-0.060 0.144-0.094 0.228-0.094s0.167 0.033 0.228 0.094l0.984 0.988 2.196-2.2c0.060-0.060 0.144-0.094 0.228-0.094s0.167 0.033 0.228 0.094l0.455 0.455c0.060 0.060 0.094 0.144 0.094 0.228z"
            fill={fillColor}
        />
    </svg>
);

type StyledSwitchProps = {
    $isStandAlone?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
};

export const StyledSwitch: React.ComponentType<StyledSwitchProps & SwitchComponentProps> = styled(Switch, {
    shouldForwardProp: prop => prop !== "$isStandAlone"
})<StyledSwitchProps>`
    &.MuiSwitch-root {
        block-size: ${({ $isStandAlone }) => ($isStandAlone ? "1rem" : "1.5rem")};
        inline-size: ${({ $isStandAlone }) => ($isStandAlone ? "2rem" : "3rem")};

        & .MuiSwitch-switchBase {
            &.Mui-checked {
                transform: ${({ $isStandAlone }) => ($isStandAlone ? "translateX(1rem)" : "translateX(1.5rem)")};
            }
        }

        & .MuiSwitch-thumb {
            width: ${({ $isStandAlone }) => ($isStandAlone ? "0.75rem" : "1.125rem")} !important;
            height: ${({ $isStandAlone }) => ($isStandAlone ? "0.75rem" : "1.125rem")} !important;
        }

        & .MuiSwitch-track {
            height: ${({ $isStandAlone }) => ($isStandAlone ? "1rem" : "1.5rem")};
        }
    }

    & .Mui-checked {
        & .MuiSwitch-thumb {
            &::before {
                content: "";
                background-image: ${({ $isStandAlone, disabled }) => {
                    if ($isStandAlone) {
                        const fillColor = $isStandAlone && disabled ? GRAY_300 : GREEN_500;
                        const svgUri = `url("data:image/svg+xml;utf8, ${encodeURIComponent(
                            ReactDOMServer.renderToStaticMarkup(<CheckedIcon fillColor={fillColor} />)
                        )}")`;
                        return svgUri;
                    }
                    return null;
                }};
            }
        }
    }

    & .MuiSwitch-switchBase {
        & .MuiSwitch-thumb {
            background-color: unset;
            box-shadow: none;

            &::before {
                background-color: ${BASICS_WHITE};
                border-radius: 50%;
                block-size: ${({ $isStandAlone }) => ($isStandAlone ? "0.75rem" : "1.125rem")};
                inline-size: ${({ $isStandAlone }) => ($isStandAlone ? "0.75rem" : "1.125rem")};
                inset-block-start: ${({ $isStandAlone }) => ($isStandAlone ? "0.125rem" : "0.1875rem")};
                inset-inline-start: ${({ $isStandAlone }) => ($isStandAlone ? "0.125rem" : "0.1875rem")};
            }
        }
    }
` as any;

type StyledSwitchContainerProps = {
    $isStandAlone?: boolean;
};

export const StyledSwitchContainer: React.ComponentType<
    StyledSwitchContainerProps & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
> = styled("div")<StyledSwitchContainerProps>`
    font-family: proxima-nova, Proxima, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif !important;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    width: fit-content;
    justify-content: center;

` as any;

    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 16px;
    color: ${GRAY_700};
` as any;

type StyledSwitchBoxProps = {
    $hasActionGap?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
};

export const StyledSwitchBox: React.ComponentType<StyledSwitchBoxProps & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> = styled(
    "div"
)<StyledSwitchBoxProps>`
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    gap: ${({ $hasActionGap }) => ($hasActionGap ? "8px" : "0px")};

    &:hover {
        cursor: ${({ disabled }) => (disabled ? "default" : "pointer")};
    }
` as any;

type StyledActionLabelProps = {

};

export const StyledActionLabel: React.ComponentType<StyledActionLabelProps & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> =
    styled("div")<StyledActionLabelProps>`
        div {
            color: ${({ $disabled }) => ($disabled ? GRAY_500 : GRAY_900)};
            font-weight: 400;
            font-size: 14px;
            line-height: 20px;
        }
    ` as any;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import Tab from "./Tab";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";

describe("Tab Tests", () => {
    it("it should render a tab", () => {
        // arrange
        const label = "Tab";
        const dataTestId = "tab-element-id";
        // act
        render(<Tab label={label} data-testid={dataTestId} selected />);
        // assert
        expect(screen.getByTestId(dataTestId)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
    it("should render a tab with an icon and no text", () => {
        // arrange
        const icon = <i className="fas fa-info-circle" />;
        const dataTestId = "tab-element-id";
        const iconDataTest = `${dataTestId}-icon`;
        // act
        render(<Tab icon={icon} data-testid={dataTestId} disabled attrProps={{ role: "tab" }} />);
        // assert
        const tab = screen.getByTestId(dataTestId);
        const iconEl = screen.getByTestId(iconDataTest).querySelector(".fas.fa-info-circle");
        // Tab and icon are rendered
        expect(tab).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(screen.getByTestId(iconDataTest)).toBeInTheDocument();
        // Tab should not have any text content
        expect(tab).toHaveTextContent(/^[\s\u200B]*$/);
        // Icon should have aria-hidden and focusable attributes
        expect(iconEl).toHaveAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        expect(iconEl).toHaveAttribute("focusable", "false");
        // Tab should be focusable and have correct role
        expect(tab).toHaveAttribute("role", "tab");
        // Tab should be disabled (MUI adds disabled attribute and Mui-disabled class)
        expect(tab).toHaveClass("Mui-disabled");
        expect(tab).toHaveAttribute("tabindex", "-1");
    });
    it("it should render a disabled tab", async () => {
        // arrange
        const label = "Tab";
        const dataTestId = "tab-element-id";
        const onChange = jest.fn();
        // act
        render(<Tab label={label} data-testid={dataTestId} disabled onChange={onChange} attrProps={{ role: "tab" }} />);
        const tab = screen.getByTestId(dataTestId);
        // assert
        // Tab is rendered
        expect(tab).toBeInTheDocument();
        // Tab has disabled class
        expect(tab).toHaveClass("Mui-disabled");
        // Tab label is present
        expect(tab).toHaveTextContent(label);
        // Tab cannot be focused (tabIndex should be -1 or not focusable)
        expect(tab.tabIndex === -1 || tab.tabIndex === undefined).toBe(true);
        // Tab does not call onChange when clicked
        tab.click();
        expect(onChange).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        // Tab does not receive focus when tabbed to
        await userEvent.tab();
        expect(tab).not.toHaveFocus();
    });

    it("it should display a disabled icon with the icon param", () => {
        // arrange
        const label = "Tab";
        const icon = <i className="fas fa-info-circle" />;
        const dataTestId = "tab-element-id";
        const iconDataTest = `${dataTestId}-icon`;

        render(<Tab label={label} icon={icon} data-testid={dataTestId} disabled attrProps={{ role: "tab" }} />);
        const tab = screen.getByTestId(dataTestId);
        const iconEl = screen.getByTestId(iconDataTest).querySelector(".fas.fa-info-circle") as HTMLElement;
        // assert
        // Tab and icon are rendered
        expect(tab).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(screen.getByTestId(iconDataTest)).toBeInTheDocument();
        // Tab has disabled class
        expect(tab).toHaveClass("Mui-disabled");
        // Icon should have aria-hidden and focusable attributes
        expect(iconEl).toHaveAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        expect(iconEl).toHaveAttribute("focusable", "false");
        // Icon should not be focusable
        expect(iconEl?.tabIndex === -1 || iconEl?.tabIndex === undefined).toBe(true);
        // Tab label is present
        expect(tab).toHaveTextContent(label);
    });

    it("it should display an icon with the icon param", () => {
        // arrange

        const icon = <i className="fas fa-info-circle" />;
        const dataTestId = "tab-element-id";

        // Icon should have aria-hidden and focusable attributes

        // Tab label is present
````

````typescript
import React, { useEffect } from "react";
import MuiTableCell from "@mui/material/TableCell";
import { getCellMinWith, getCellMaxWidth, getCellWidth } from "@utils/TableUtils";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import { css } from "@emotion/css";
import { BLUE_600, GRAY_100, GRAY_200, GRAY_600, GRAY_800, WHITE_200 } from "@css/constants";

export type TableCellProps = {
    topOffset?: string;
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    cellType?: "body" | "header" | "subHeader";
    colSpan?: number;
    dataType?: string;
    cellWidth?: string;
    resizable?: boolean;
    componentType?: React.ElementType;
    onClick?: (event: React.MouseEvent) => void;
    canSort?: boolean;
    isSorted?: boolean;
    isSortedDesc?: boolean;
    onSorted?: (isSortedDesc: boolean) => void;
    cellColor?: string;
    cellLineHeight?: string;
    cellPadding?: string;
    hasScrollX?: boolean;
    isInsideSlideout?: boolean;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const TableCell = ({
    topOffset,
    children,
    cellType = "body",
    colSpan,
    dataType = "text",
    cellWidth,
    resizable,
    componentType,
    onClick,
    canSort,
    isSorted,
    isSortedDesc,
    onSorted,
    cellColor,
    cellLineHeight,
    cellPadding,
    hasScrollX = false,
    isInsideSlideout = false,
    dataTrackAction,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: TableCellProps) => {
    const sortIcon = isSorted ? (isSortedDesc ? "fa-sort-down" : "fa-sort-up") : "fa-sort";

    useEffect(() => {
        if (isSortedDesc !== undefined && onSorted) {
            onSorted(isSortedDesc);
        }
    }, [isSortedDesc, onSorted]);

    const handleClick = (event: React.MouseEvent) => {
        onClick && onClick(event);
    };

    const handleKeyDown = (event: React.KeyboardEvent) => {
        if (event.key === "Enter" || event.key === " ") {
            event.preventDefault();
            onClick && onClick(event as unknown as React.MouseEvent);
        }
    };

    return (
        <StyledCell
            $cellColor={cellColor}
            $cellLineHeight={cellLineHeight}
            $cellPadding={cellPadding}
            $cellType={cellType}
            $cellWidth={cellWidth}
            $dataType={dataType}
            $topOffset={topOffset}
            colSpan={colSpan}
            data-testid={dataTestId}
            component={componentType as any}
            onClick={handleClick}
            data-resizable={resizable}
            $hasScrollX={hasScrollX}
            $isInsideSlideout={isInsideSlideout}
            data-track-action={dataTrackAction}
            role={cellType === "header" ? "columnheader" : "cell"}
            aria-sort={canSort ? (isSorted ? (isSortedDesc ? "descending" : "ascending") : "none") : undefined}
        >
            {canSort ? (
                <FlexRow role="button" tabIndex={0} onKeyDown={handleKeyDown} aria-label="Sortable column">
                    {children}
                    <StyledSortIcon className={`fas ${sortIcon}`} $isSorted={isSorted} aria-hidden="true" />
                </FlexRow>
            ) : (
                children
            )}
        </StyledCell>
    );
};

type StyledCellProps = {
    $cellColor?: string;
    $cellLineHeight?: string;
    $cellPadding?: string;
    $cellType: "body" | "header" | "subHeader";
    $cellWidth?: string;
    $dataType: string;
    $topOffset?: string;
    $hasScrollX: boolean;
    $isInsideSlideout: boolean;
};

const StyledCell = styled(MuiTableCell, {
    shouldForwardProp: (prop: PropertyKey) =>
        ![
            "$cellColor",
            "$cellLineHeight",
            "$cellPadding",
            "$cellType",
            "$cellWidth",
            "$dataType",
            "$topOffset",
            "$hasScrollX",
            "$isInsideSlideout"
        ].includes(prop as string)
})<StyledCellProps>`
    font-family: proxima-nova, Proxima, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif !important;
    border-bottom: ${props => (props.$cellType === "body" ? `1px solid ${GRAY_200} !important` : "0px !important")};
    padding: ${props => (props.$cellType === "body" ? "0px 8px !important" : "8px !important")};
    font-size: 0.875rem !important;
    line-height: ${props => (props.$cellLineHeight ? props.$cellLineHeight : "1rem")} !important;
    font-weight: ${props =>
        props.$cellType === "header" || props.$cellType === "subHeader" ? "600 !important" : "normal !important"};
    color: ${props => (props.$cellColor ? props.$cellColor : GRAY_800)} !important;
    min-width: ${props => (props.$cellWidth ? props.$cellWidth : getCellMinWith(props.$dataType) + " !important")};
    max-width: ${props => (props.$cellWidth ? props.$cellWidth : getCellMaxWidth(props.$dataType) + " !important")};
    text-align: ${props =>
        props.$dataType === "menu"
            ? "center !important"
            : props.$cellType === "subHeader"
            ? "left !important"
            : "inherit"};
    width: ${props => (props.$cellWidth ? props.$cellWidth : getCellWidth(props.$dataType))};
    position: ${props => props.$dataType === "menu" && "relative"};
    height: ${props => (props.$cellType === "header" ? "40px !important" : "48px !important")};
    box-sizing: border-box !important;
    top: ${props => (props.$hasScrollX && !props.$isInsideSlideout ? "0px" : props.$topOffset)};
    background-color: ${props =>
        props.$cellType === "header" ? `${WHITE_200} !important` : props.$cellType === "subHeader" ? GRAY_100 : null};
    ${props =>
        props.$cellPadding &&
        css`
            padding: ${props.$cellPadding} !important;
        `}

    ${props =>
        props.$cellPadding &&
        props.$cellType === "header" &&
        css`
            border-bottom: 1px solid ${GRAY_200} !important;
        `}

    &.MuiTableCell-stickyHeader {
        top: ${props => (props.$hasScrollX && !props.$isInsideSlideout ? "0px" : props.$topOffset)} !important;
        z-index: 2;
    }
`;

type StyledSortIconProps = {
    $isSorted?: boolean;
};

const StyledSortIcon = styled("i")<StyledSortIconProps>`
    color: ${(props: StyledSortIconProps) => (props.$isSorted ? BLUE_600 : GRAY_600)};
    padding-left: 0.625rem;
    vertical-align: middle;
`;

const FlexRow = styled("div")`
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
`;

export default TableCell;
````

````typescript
import React, { useEffect, useState, ComponentProps } from "react";
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react";
import Textbox from "./Textbox";

export default {
    title: "Atoms/Textbox",
    component: Textbox,
    argTypes: {}
} satisfies Meta<typeof Textbox>;

const ClearButton = ({ onClick }: { onClick: () => void }) => {
    return (
        <span
            style={{ display: "flex", cursor: "pointer", color: "red", alignItems: "center", justifyContent: "center" }}
        >
            <i className="fas fa-times-circle" onClick={onClick} />
        </span>
    );
};

const Template = (args: ComponentProps<typeof Textbox>) => {
    const [value, setValue] = useState("");

    // allow value to be changed from storybook controls
    useEffect(() => {
        if (args.value !== undefined) {
            setValue(String(args.value));
        }
    }, [args.value]);

    return <Textbox {...args} value={value} onChange={setValue} />;
};

const FullWidthTemplate = (args: ComponentProps<typeof Textbox>) => {
    const [value, setValue] = useState("");

    // allow value to be changed from storybook controls
    useEffect(() => {
        if (args.value !== undefined) {
            setValue(String(args.value));
        }
    }, [args.value]);

    return (
        <div style={{ width: "300px" }}>
            <Textbox {...args} value={value} onChange={setValue} />
        </div>
    );
};

const ClearButtonTemplate = (args: ComponentProps<typeof Textbox>) => {
    const [value, setValue] = useState("");

    // allow value to be changed from storybook controls
    useEffect(() => {
        if (args.value !== undefined) {
            setValue(String(args.value));
        }
    }, [args.value]);

    return (
        <Textbox
            {...args}
            value={value}
            onChange={setValue}
            endAdornment={value ? <ClearButton onClick={() => setValue("")} /> : null}
        />
    );
};

export const Default: StoryObj<typeof Textbox> = {
    render: Template,
    args: {}
};

export const Disabled: StoryObj<typeof Textbox> = {
    render: Template,
    args: {
        disabled: true
    }
};

export const SearchIcon: StoryObj<typeof Textbox> = {
    render: Template,
    args: {
        startAdornment: <i className="fas fa-search" />
    }
};

export const WithClearButton: StoryObj<typeof Textbox> = {
    render: ClearButtonTemplate,
    args: {}
};

export const WithClearButtonAndSearchIcon: StoryObj<typeof Textbox> = {
````

````typescript
import React, { forwardRef, useMemo } from "react";
import TextField, { TextFieldProps } from "@mui/material/TextField";
import InputAdornment from "@mui/material/InputAdornment";

import { css } from "@emotion/css";
import FormFieldHelper from "@atoms/FormFieldHelper/FormFieldHelper";

declare const process: { env: { NODE_ENV?: string } };
import {
    BASICS_WHITE,
    BLUE_700,
    GRAY_100,
    GRAY_200,
    GRAY_300,
    GRAY_400,
    GRAY_600,
    GRAY_700,
    RED_400,
    YELLOW_50
} from "@css/constants";
import useUniqueId from "@hooks/useUniqueId";

const FILTER_GROUP_BORDER_COLOR = "rgba(212, 214, 217, 1)";
const TRANSPARENT_BG = "#0000";
const BORDER_WIDTH = "1px solid";

export type TextboxProps = Omit<TextFieldProps, "onChange" | "variant" | "multiline" | "error" | "inputProps"> & {
    /** @deprecated Use startAdornment/endAdornment instead */
    adornment?: {
        position: "start" | "end";
        value: string | React.ReactElement;
    };
    /** Icon/element at start of textbox */
    startAdornment?: React.ReactNode;
    /** Icon/element at end of textbox */
    endAdornment?: React.ReactNode;
    /** Show error state */
    error?: boolean;
    /** Error helper text with error icon */
    errorHelperText?: string;
    /** Helper text below textbox */
    helperText?: string | React.ReactElement;
    /** Allow textbox to grow to parent container */
    isFullWidth?: boolean;
    /** Text change callback. Receives the new value as string. */
    onChange?: (value: string) => void;
    /** Key up callback */
    onKeyUp?: (event: React.KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
    /** Focus callback */
    onFocus?: (event: React.FocusEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
    /** Blur callback */
    onBlur?: (event: React.FocusEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
    /** Mouse down callback */
    onMouseDown?: (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
    /** Ref for the input element */
    inputRef?: React.Ref<HTMLInputElement>;
    /** Highlighted state */
    isHighlighted?: boolean;
    /** Max length of input */
    maxLength?: number;
    /** Internal: used in filter groups */
    _isInFilterGroup?: boolean;
    /** Internal: filter group search mode */
    isFilterGroupSearch?: boolean;
    /** Internal: autocomplete on blur mode */
    isAutocompleteOnBlur?: boolean;
    /** Testing identifier */
    "data-testid"?: string;
    /** Aria label for accessibility. Default: "Input field" */
    ariaLabel?: string;
    /** Read-only state */
    readOnly?: boolean;
    /** Additional input props */
    inputProps?: {
        id?: string;
        "aria-label"?: string;
        readOnly?: boolean;
        maxLength?: number;
        [key: string]: unknown;
    };
    /** Pendo tracking attribute */
    dataTrackAction?: string;
};

// Helper: Determine accessible aria-label
const determineAccessibleLabel = ({
    id,
    ariaLabel,
    deprecatedAriaLabel,
    inputPropsAriaLabel
}: {
    id?: string;
    ariaLabel?: string;
    deprecatedAriaLabel?: string;
    inputPropsAriaLabel?: string;
}) => {
    if (id) return undefined;
    const finalAriaLabel = ariaLabel || deprecatedAriaLabel;
    return finalAriaLabel || inputPropsAriaLabel || "Input field";
};

const Textbox = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, TextboxProps>(
    (
        {
            id,
            adornment,
            autoComplete,
            autoFocus,
            name,
            startAdornment: propStartAdornment,
            endAdornment: propEndAdornment,
            disabled,
            error,
            errorHelperText,
            helperText,
            isFullWidth,
            onChange,
            onKeyUp,
            onFocus,
            onBlur,
            onMouseDown,
            inputRef,
            placeholder,
            isHighlighted,
            type = "text",
            value,
            maxLength,
            _isInFilterGroup = false,
            isFilterGroupSearch = false,
            isAutocompleteOnBlur = false,
            "data-testid": dataTestId,
            "aria-label": ariaLabel,
            ariaLabel: deprecatedAriaLabel,
            readOnly,
            inputProps,
            dataTrackAction,
            className,
            ...nativeProps
        },
        ref
    ) => {
        const uniqueId = useUniqueId(); // generates unique id
        const inputValue = useMemo(
            () => (_isInFilterGroup && isAutocompleteOnBlur && !isFilterGroupSearch ? "" : value),
            [_isInFilterGroup, isAutocompleteOnBlur, isFilterGroupSearch, value]
        );

        // Deprecation warning for old adornment interface
        React.useEffect(() => {
            if (adornment && adornment.position === "start" && process.env.NODE_ENV === "development") {
                console.warn(
                    "Warning: Failed prop type: The prop `adornment` is deprecated. Please use startAdornment or endAdornment instead."
                );
            }
        }, [adornment]);

        const handleOnChange = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
            if (readOnly || inputProps?.readOnly) return; // Prevent onChange if readOnly
            onChange && onChange(event.target.value);
        };

        let startAdornment = propStartAdornment;
        let endAdornment = propEndAdornment;

        if (adornment) {
            if (adornment.position === "start") {
                startAdornment = adornment.value;
            } else {
                endAdornment = adornment.value;
            }
        }

        const textboxId = id || inputProps?.id || uniqueId;
        const accessibleLabel = determineAccessibleLabel({
            id,
            ariaLabel,
            deprecatedAriaLabel,
            inputPropsAriaLabel: inputProps?.["aria-label"] as string | undefined
        });

        return (
            <>
                <StyledTextbox
                    ref={ref}
                    id={textboxId}
                    autoFocus={autoFocus}
                    $isHighlighted={isHighlighted}
                    error={error}
                    disabled={disabled || readOnly}
                    className={className}
                    data-testid={dataTestId}
                    InputProps={{
                        startAdornment: startAdornment && (
                            <StyledAdornment position="start">{startAdornment}</StyledAdornment>
                        ),
                        endAdornment: endAdornment && <StyledAdornment position="end">{endAdornment}</StyledAdornment>,
                        readOnly: readOnly
                    }}
                    inputProps={{
                        ...inputProps,
                        readOnly: readOnly || inputProps?.readOnly,
                        onFocus,
                        onKeyUp,
                        onBlur,
                        onMouseDown,
                        maxLength: maxLength ?? inputProps?.maxLength,
                        "aria-label": accessibleLabel,
                        "data-track-action": dataTrackAction
                    }}
                    inputRef={inputRef}
                    variant="outlined"
                    placeholder={placeholder}
                    onChange={handleOnChange}
                    autoComplete={autoComplete}
                    name={name}
                    value={inputValue}
                    fullWidth={isFullWidth}
                    type={type}
                    $_isInFilterGroup={_isInFilterGroup}
                    {...nativeProps}
                />
                <FormFieldHelper
                    error={error}
                    errorHelperText={errorHelperText}
                    helperText={helperText}
                    data-testid={`${dataTestId}_helper`}
                />
            </>
        );
    }
);

Textbox.displayName = "Textbox";

type StyledTextboxProps = {
    $isHighlighted?: boolean;
    $_isInFilterGroup?: boolean;
    fullWidth?: boolean;
    error?: boolean;
    InputProps?: {
        startAdornment?: React.ReactNode;
    };
};

// isHighlighted and _isInFilterGroup warning of not being used, except it is in the styled css
// eslint-disable-next-line no-unused-vars
const StyledTextbox = styled(TextField, {
    shouldForwardProp: prop => !["$isHighlighted", "$_isInFilterGroup"].includes(prop as string)
})<StyledTextboxProps>`
    min-width: ${props => (props.fullWidth ? "0px" : "200px")};
    height: 2rem;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 1rem;

    input::placeholder {
        opacity: 1 !important;
        font-weight: 400;
        color: ${props => (props.$_isInFilterGroup ? GRAY_700 : GRAY_400)};
    }

    & .MuiOutlinedInput-root {
        background: ${props => (props.$isHighlighted ? YELLOW_50 : BASICS_WHITE)};
        border-radius: 4px;

        & input {
            background-color: ${TRANSPARENT_BG};
        }

        & fieldset {
            border-color: ${props =>
                props.$_isInFilterGroup
                    ? `${FILTER_GROUP_BORDER_COLOR} !important`
                    : `${BORDER_WIDTH} ${GRAY_200} !important`};
        }

        &:hover fieldset {
            border: ${props =>
                props.$_isInFilterGroup ? `${BORDER_WIDTH} ${GRAY_300} !important` : `${BORDER_WIDTH} ${BLUE_700}`};
        }

        &.Mui-focused fieldset {
            border: ${BORDER_WIDTH} ${BLUE_700} !important;
        }
    }

    & .MuiOutlinedInput-root.Mui-error {
        & fieldset {
            border: ${BORDER_WIDTH} ${RED_400} !important;
        }
    }

    & .MuiInputBase-root.Mui-disabled {
        background: ${GRAY_100};
        border-radius: 4px;
        border-color: ${GRAY_100};
        color: ${GRAY_600};

        & fieldset {
            border: ${props => (props.error ? `${BORDER_WIDTH} ${RED_400} !important` : `${BORDER_WIDTH} ${GRAY_100}`)};
        }

        &:hover fieldset {
            border: ${props => (props.error ? `${BORDER_WIDTH} ${RED_400} !important` : `${BORDER_WIDTH} ${GRAY_100}`)};
        }
    }

    & .MuiInputBase-input {
````

````typescript
export const TOAST_TYPE = {
    ERROR: "error",
    INFORMATIONAL: "informational",
    SUCCESS: "success",
    WARNING: "warning"
} as const;

export const TOAST_CONFIG = {
    [TOAST_TYPE.SUCCESS]: {
        BACKGROUND_COLOR: "#ECF8E7",
        ICON: "fa-check-circle",
        ICON_COLOR: "#45A931",
        DEFAULT_TITLE: "Success!",
        DEFAULT_DESCRIPTION: "Your changes have been saved.",
        DEFAULT_ACTION_LABEL: "Action",
        BORDER_COLOR: "#b6e8a2"
    },
    [TOAST_TYPE.WARNING]: {
        BACKGROUND_COLOR: "#FFF5E5",
        ICON: "fa-exclamation-triangle",
        ICON_COLOR: "#F29100",
        DEFAULT_TITLE: "Warning!",
        DEFAULT_DESCRIPTION: "Please check your settings.",
        DEFAULT_ACTION_LABEL: "Action",
        BORDER_COLOR: "#FFDA9E"
    },
    [TOAST_TYPE.ERROR]: {
        BACKGROUND_COLOR: "#FCE6E5",
        ICON: "fa-exclamation-circle",
        ICON_COLOR: "#CE3845",
        DEFAULT_TITLE: "Error!",
        DEFAULT_DESCRIPTION: "Something went wrong.",
        DEFAULT_ACTION_LABEL: "Action",
        BORDER_COLOR: "#FCAAA9"
    },
    [TOAST_TYPE.INFORMATIONAL]: {
        BACKGROUND_COLOR: "#EBF7FC",
        ICON: "fa-info-circle",

        DEFAULT_TITLE: "Informational!",
        DEFAULT_DESCRIPTION: "Information here.",
        DEFAULT_ACTION_LABEL: "Action",
        BORDER_COLOR: "#97D2F7"
    }
} as const;

export type ToastType = (typeof TOAST_TYPE)[keyof typeof TOAST_TYPE];
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import Snackbar, { SnackbarProps } from "@mui/material/Snackbar";
import { TOAST_CONFIG, ToastType } from "./ToastConfig";
import { BLACK_600, GRAY_600 } from "@css/constants";

type StyledToastProps = SnackbarProps & {
    type: ToastType;
    $topOffset?: number;
};

type StyledToastContentProps = {
    hasDescription?: boolean;
};

type StyledToastBoxProps = {
    hasDescription?: boolean;
};

type StyledIconProps = {
    type: ToastType;
};

export const StyledToast: React.ComponentType<StyledToastProps> = styled(Snackbar as any)`
    background-color: ${({ type }: StyledToastProps) => TOAST_CONFIG[type].BACKGROUND_COLOR};
    color: ${BLACK_600};
    padding: var(--spacing-4);
    width: 320px;
    min-height: 18px;
    border-radius: var(--radius-base);
    display: flex;
    justify-content: flex-start !important;
    border: 1px solid ${({ type }: StyledToastProps) => TOAST_CONFIG[type].BORDER_COLOR};
    box-sizing: content-box;

    &.MuiSnackbar-anchorOriginTopRight,
    &.MuiSnackbar-anchorOriginTopCenter,
    &.MuiSnackbar-anchorOriginTopLeft {
        top: ${({ $topOffset }: StyledToastProps) => $topOffset}px;
    }
`;

export const StyledToastContent: React.ComponentType<
    StyledToastContentProps & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>
> = styled("div")`
    display: flex;
    align-items: ${({ hasDescription }: StyledToastContentProps) => (hasDescription ? "baseline" : "center")};
    width: 100%;
`;

export const StyledToastBox: React.ComponentType<StyledToastBoxProps & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> = styled(
    "div"
)`
    display: flex;
    flex-grow: 1;
    flex-direction: ${({ hasDescription }: StyledToastBoxProps) => (hasDescription ? "column" : "row")};
    justify-content: ${({ hasDescription }: StyledToastBoxProps) => (hasDescription ? "flex-start" : "space-between")};
    align-items: baseline;
`;

export const StyledIcon: React.ComponentType<StyledIconProps & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>> = styled("span")`
    padding: 0 var(--spacing-2) 0 0;
    width: 16px;
    height: 16px;
    box-sizing: content-box;
    color: ${({ type }: StyledIconProps) => TOAST_CONFIG[type].ICON_COLOR};
`;

export const StyledCloseIcon: React.ComponentType<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLElement>> = styled("i")`
    cursor: pointer;
    font-size: 20px;
    color: ${GRAY_600};
    margin-left: var(--spacing-2);
` as any;

(StyledCloseIcon as any).defaultProps = {
    role: "button",
    "aria-label": "close"
};

export const StyledTitle: React.ComponentType<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> = styled("div")`
    padding: 0 var(--spacing-2);
    line-height: 20px;
    font-weight: var(--font-semibold);
    font-style: semibold;
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
`;

export const StyledDescription: React.ComponentType<React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>> = styled("div")`
    padding: 0 var(--spacing-2);
    font-size: var(--text-sm);
    line-height: 20px;
    font-weight: var(--font-normal);
    margin-bottom: var(--spacing-2);
    overflow-wrap: break-word;
    word-break: break-word;
`;
````

````typescript
import { renderHook } from "@testing-library/react";
import useFooterButtonGroupWithWrappedOnClick, {
    type FooterButtonWithClose
} from "./useFooterButtonGroupWithWrappedOnClick";

describe("FooterButtonGroup Tests", () => {
    it("should wrap action onclick functions and call close menu when closeMenuAfterOnClick is true", async () => {
        const onClick = jest.fn();
        const closeMenu = jest.fn();
        const mockActions: FooterButtonWithClose[] = [
            {
                onClick: onClick,
                closeMenuAfterOnClick: true
            }
        ];
        const { result } = renderHook(() => useFooterButtonGroupWithWrappedOnClick(mockActions, closeMenu));
        result.current?.[0].onClick?.(new MouseEvent("click") as any);

        expect(onClick).toHaveBeenCalled();
        expect(closeMenu).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should not call close menu even if there is no onclick provided", async () => {
        const closeMenu = jest.fn();
        const mockActions: FooterButtonWithClose[] = [{} as FooterButtonWithClose];
        renderHook(() => useFooterButtonGroupWithWrappedOnClick(mockActions, closeMenu));

        expect(closeMenu).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should not call close menu even if there is no closeMenuAfterOnClick provided", async () => {
        const onClick = jest.fn();
        const closeMenu = jest.fn();
        const mockActions: FooterButtonWithClose[] = [
            {
                onClick: onClick
            }
        ];
        const { result } = renderHook(() => useFooterButtonGroupWithWrappedOnClick(mockActions, closeMenu));
        result.current?.[0].onClick?.(new MouseEvent("click") as any);

        expect(onClick).toHaveBeenCalled();
        expect(closeMenu).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
});
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import type { BadgeProps } from "@atoms/Badge/Badge";
import type { ButtonProps } from "@atoms/button/Button";
import type { ActionIconItem } from "./ActionIcons";
import type { ActionSwitchAction } from "./ActionSwitch";
import type { ActionWithActionMenuButtonAction } from "./ActionWithActionMenuButton";
import { ACTION_TYPE } from "../CardConstant";

type BadgeAction = {
    type: typeof ACTION_TYPE.BADGE;
    action: BadgeProps;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

type ButtonsAction = {
    type: typeof ACTION_TYPE.BUTTONS;
    actions: ButtonProps[];
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

type IconsAction = {
    type: typeof ACTION_TYPE.ICONS;
    actions: ActionIconItem[];
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

type SwitchAction = {
    type: typeof ACTION_TYPE.SWITCH;
    action: ActionSwitchAction;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

type ActionMenuButtonAction = {
    type: typeof ACTION_TYPE.ACTION_MENU_BUTTON;
    action: ActionWithActionMenuButtonAction;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

type CustomAction = {
    type: typeof ACTION_TYPE.CUSTOM;
    action: {
        custom?: React.ReactNode;
    };
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

type TextAction = {
    type: typeof ACTION_TYPE.TEXT;
    action: {
        text: string;
    } & React.HTMLAttributes<HTMLDivElement>;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

export type ActionComponentProps =
    | BadgeAction
    | ButtonsAction
    | IconsAction
    | SwitchAction
    | ActionMenuButtonAction
    | CustomAction
    | TextAction;

export type CardAction = ActionComponentProps;
````

## File: src/components/molecules/Card/Actions/ActionWithActionMenuButton.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useMemo } from "react";
import ActionMenuButton from "@molecules/ActionMenuButton/ActionMenuButton";

export type ActionItem = {
    id?: string | number;
    onClick?: (event: React.MouseEvent | React.KeyboardEvent, action: ActionItem) => void;
    text?: string;
    icon?: React.ReactNode;
    separator?: boolean;
    component?: React.ReactNode;
    childComponent?: React.ReactNode;
    disabled?: boolean;
};

export type ActionWithActionMenuButtonAction = {
    actionList?: ActionItem[];
    label?: string;
    [key: string]: unknown;
};

export type ActionWithActionMenuButtonProps = {
    action?: ActionWithActionMenuButtonAction;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

export const ActionWithActionMenuButton = ({ action, "data-testid": dataTestId }: ActionWithActionMenuButtonProps) => {
    const { actionList } = action || {};

    const stopPropagation = (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
    };

    const handleActionOnClick = useCallback((event: React.MouseEvent | React.KeyboardEvent, action: ActionItem) => {
        action?.onClick && action.onClick(event, action);
    }, []);

    const actions = useMemo(() => {
        if (!actionList) return;
        return actionList
            ?.filter((action): action is ActionItem & { id: string | number } => action.id !== undefined)
            .map(action => {
                let onClick;
                if (action?.onClick) {
                    onClick = (event: React.MouseEvent | React.KeyboardEvent) => handleActionOnClick(event, action);
                }
                return {
                    id: action.id,
                    text: action.text,
                    separator: action.separator,
                    disabled: action.disabled,
                    onClick: onClick,
                    icon: action.icon && React.isValidElement(action.icon) ? action.icon : undefined,
                    component:
                        action.component && React.isValidElement(action.component) ? action.component : undefined,
                    childComponent:
                        action.childComponent &&
                        (typeof action.childComponent === "function" || React.isValidElement(action.childComponent))
                            ? action.childComponent
                            : undefined
                };
            });
    }, [actionList, handleActionOnClick]);

    return (
        <div
            onClick={stopPropagation}
            data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-action-with-action-menu-button-wrapper`}
        >
            <ActionMenuButton {...action} actionList={actions} data-testid={dataTestId}>
                <span>{action?.label}</span>
            </ActionMenuButton>
        </div>
    );
};

export default ActionWithActionMenuButton;
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import { ActionPanelWrapper, ActionsWrapper, RightActionsWrapper, Divider, LeftActionWrapper } from "../Card.styles";
import ActionComponent from "../Actions/ActionComponent";
import type { CardAction, ActionComponentProps } from "../Actions/ActionTypes";

export type { CardAction };

export type CardActionsPanelProps = {
    actions: {
        left?: CardAction;
        right?: CardAction;
    };
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

function withDataTestId(action: CardAction, dataTestId?: string): ActionComponentProps {
    return { ...action, "data-testid": dataTestId } as ActionComponentProps;
}

const CardActionsPanel: React.FC<CardActionsPanelProps> = ({ actions, "data-testid": dataTestId }) => {
    const { left, right } = actions;
    const stopPropagation = useCallback((event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
        event.stopPropagation();
    }, []);
    return (
        <ActionPanelWrapper data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-actions-panel`}>
            <Divider />
            <ActionsWrapper data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-actions-wrapper`}>
                <LeftActionWrapper
                    onClick={stopPropagation}
                    data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-left-wrapper-footer`}
                >
                    {left && (
                        <ActionComponent
                            {...withDataTestId(left, dataTestId ? `${dataTestId}-left-action` : undefined)}
                        />
                    )}
                </LeftActionWrapper>
                <RightActionsWrapper
                    onClick={stopPropagation}
                    data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-right-wrapper-footer`}
                >
                    {right && (
                        <ActionComponent
                            {...withDataTestId(right, dataTestId ? `${dataTestId}-right-actions` : undefined)}
                        />
                    )}
                </RightActionsWrapper>
            </ActionsWrapper>
        </ActionPanelWrapper>
    );
};

export default CardActionsPanel;
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useMemo, forwardRef } from "react";
import type { ComponentPropsWithRef } from "react";
import { CustomCard, StyledCard, StyledCardDirection } from "./Card.styles";
import CardHeaderPanel, { CardMedia } from "./CardPanels/CardHeaderPanel";
import CardContentPanel from "./CardPanels/CardContentPanel";
import CardActionsPanel from "./CardPanels/CardActionsPanel";
import type { CardAction } from "./Actions/ActionTypes";
import { DEFAULT_CARD_WIDTH } from "./CardConstant";

export type CardContent = {
    title?: string | React.ReactNode;
    subtitle?: string | React.ReactNode;
};

export type CardFooter = {
    left?: CardAction;
    right?: CardAction;
};

export type CardProps = Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<"div">, "onClick" | "children" | "content" | "id"> & {
    /**
     * id of card
     */
    id?: string | number;
    /**
     * data-testid attribute for testing
     */
    "data-testid"?: string;
    /**
     * height of card - Only applicable if hasCardMediaFooter is set to true
     */
    height?: number;
    /**
     * is card disabled
     */
    disabled?: boolean;
    /**
     * is card has error?
     */
    hasError?: boolean;
    /**
     * children of card
     * NOTE: if hasCardMediaFooter is set to true,
     * it will display inside the content panel of the card
     */
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * If set to true, it will display Media and Footer.
     * If set to false, will only display children of the card
     */
    hasCardMediaFooter?: boolean;
    /**
     * Display subtitle on top placement above the title
     */
    hasSubtitleTopPlacement?: boolean;
    /**
     * If set to true, Card can be hovered and selected
     */
    isInteractive?: boolean;
    /**
     * If set to true, Card will be selected
     * NOTE: This is only applicable if isInteractive is set to true
     */
    isSelected?: boolean;
    /**
     * Callback function get trigger when card is clicked
     * Signature: function(event: object, id: string | number) => void
     */
    onClick?: (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>, id?: string | number) => void;
    /**
     * Display on the top panel of the card
     */
    media?: CardMedia;
    /**
     * Display on the content panel of the card
     */
    content?: CardContent;
    /**
     * Display on the bottom panel of the card
     */
    footer?: CardFooter;
    /**
     * width of card
     */
    width?: string | number;
};

const Card = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, CardProps>(
    (
        {
            id,
            disabled,
            hasError,
            media,
            content,
            footer,
            hasCardMediaFooter = false,
            hasSubtitleTopPlacement = false,
            children,
            isInteractive = false,
            onClick,
            isSelected = false,
            height,
            width,
            // Extract native HTML props
            className,
            "data-testid": dataTestId,
            role,
            tabIndex,
            "aria-label": ariaLabel,
            "aria-labelledby": ariaLabelledby,
            "aria-describedby": ariaDescribedby,
            ...nativeProps
        },
        ref
    ) => {
        const handleClick = useCallback(
            (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
                onClick && onClick(event, id);
            },
            [id, onClick]
        );

        const hasActionMenuButton = useMemo(
            () => footer?.right?.type?.toLowerCase() === "actionmenubutton",
            [footer?.right?.type]
        );

        const cardWidth = useMemo(() => {
            if (typeof width === "number") {
                return width;
            }
            if (typeof width === "string") {
                return parseInt(width, 10) || DEFAULT_CARD_WIDTH;
            }
            return DEFAULT_CARD_WIDTH;
        }, [width]);

        // Extract data-* attributes from remaining native props
        const dataAttrs: Record<string, unknown> = {};
        Object.keys(nativeProps).forEach(key => {
            if (key.startsWith("data-")) {
                dataAttrs[key] = nativeProps[key as keyof typeof nativeProps];
            }
        });

        // Build native HTML props object
        const nativeHTMLProps = {
            className,
            "data-testid": dataTestId,
            role,
            tabIndex,
            "aria-label": ariaLabel,
            "aria-labelledby": ariaLabelledby,
            "aria-describedby": ariaDescribedby,
            ...dataAttrs
        };

        return (
            <>
                {hasCardMediaFooter ? (
                    <CustomCard
                        ref={ref}
                        disabled={disabled}
                        $isSelected={isSelected && isInteractive}
                        onClick={handleClick}
                        $isInteractive={isInteractive}
                        $isFullWidth={media?.isFullWidthImage}
                        $hasActionMenuButton={hasActionMenuButton}
                        $width={cardWidth}
                        {...nativeHTMLProps}
                    >
                        <div data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-card-action-wrapper`}>
                            <StyledCardDirection $height={height}>
                                {media != undefined && Object.values(media).length > 0 && (
                                    <CardHeaderPanel
                                        media={media}
                                        data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-card-media`}
                                    />
                                )}
                                <CardContentPanel
                                    content={content}
                                    height={height}
                                    hasSubtitleTopPlacement={hasSubtitleTopPlacement}
                                    data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-card-content`}
                                >
                                    {children}
                                </CardContentPanel>
                                {footer != undefined && Object.values(footer).length > 0 && (
                                    <CardActionsPanel
                                        actions={footer}
                                        data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-card-footer`}
                                    />
                                )}
                            </StyledCardDirection>
                        </div>
                    </CustomCard>
                ) : (
                    <StyledCard ref={ref} disabled={disabled} $hasError={hasError} {...nativeHTMLProps}>
                        {children}
                    </StyledCard>
                )}
            </>
        );
    }
);

Card.displayName = "Card";

export default Card;
````

## File: src/components/molecules/DateRangePicker/DateRangePickerTextbox.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useEffect, useCallback, useState, useMemo, forwardRef, useContext } from "react";
import format from "date-fns/format";
import Textbox from "@atoms/textbox/Textbox";
import { DateRangePickerContext } from "./DateRangePickerContext";
import { localeSelector, getLocaleTime } from "@molecules/DatePicker/DatePickerHelper";
import type { DateRangePickerContextValue } from "./DateRangePickerContext";

type LocaleTexts = {
    INVALID_DATE: string;
    INVALID_TIME: string;
    APPLY: string;
    START_DATE_TIME: string;
    END_DATE_TIME: string;
    START_DATE: string;
    END_DATE: string;
    SELECT_DATE: string;
    SELECT_DATE_TIME: string;
};

export type DateRangePickerTextboxProps = {
    /** initial date passed in. Will reset to this if closed without hitting apply */
    initialStart?: Date;
    /** initial end date passed in. Will reset to this if closed without hitting apply */
    initialEnd?: Date;
    /** function to set the open status */
    setIsOpen?: (isOpen: boolean) => void;
    /** is the calendar open? */
    isOpen?: boolean;
    /** width of the initial range textbox */
    width?: string;
    /** locale text overwrites for defaults */
    localeTexts: LocaleTexts;
    /** data-testid attribute */
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const DateRangePickerTextbox = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, DateRangePickerTextboxProps>(
    ({ initialStart, initialEnd, setIsOpen, isOpen, width, localeTexts, "data-testid": dataTestId }, ref) => {
        const { locale, hasTime } = useContext(DateRangePickerContext) as DateRangePickerContextValue;
        const [isDisabled, setDisabled] = useState(false);
        const onClick = useCallback(() => {
            setIsOpen?.(true);
        }, [setIsOpen]);

        useEffect(() => {
            setDisabled(isOpen || false);
        }, [isOpen]);

        const value = useMemo(() => {
            if (!initialStart && !initialEnd) {
                return hasTime ? localeTexts.SELECT_DATE_TIME : localeTexts.SELECT_DATE;
            }
            const timeLocale = getLocaleTime(locale);

            // output template: [start locale date/Time] -> [end locale date/time]
            return `${format(initialStart!, `P${hasTime ? ", " + timeLocale : ""}`, {
                locale: localeSelector(locale)
            })} → ${format(initialEnd!, `P${hasTime ? ", " + timeLocale : ""}`, {
                locale: localeSelector(locale)
            })}`;
        }, [initialStart, initialEnd, hasTime, localeTexts, locale]);

        return (
            <Textbox
                isFullWidth={width || hasTime ? true : false}
                inputRef={ref}
                startAdornment={<i className="fa fa-calendar-alt" onClick={onClick} />}
                endAdornment={<i className="fas fa-chevron-down" onClick={onClick} />}
                disabled={isDisabled}
                value={value}
                onFocus={onClick}
                inputProps={{
                    "data-testid": dataTestId ? `${dataTestId}-daterange-textbox` : undefined
                }}
            />
        );
    }
);

DateRangePickerTextbox.displayName = "DateRangePickerTextbox";

export default DateRangePickerTextbox;
````

````typescript
import { FileUploader } from "./FileUploader";

const COMMON_PROPS = {

        title: "Upload file accessory",

    },
    uploadHelperProps: {
        helperText: "Max file size is 500kb."
    }
};

        jest.resetModules();
        process.env = { ...ORIGINAL_ENV };
    });

        process.env = ORIGINAL_ENV;
    });

        expect(screen.getByText(COMMON_PROPS.formFieldAccessoryProps.title)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
````

````typescript
import React, { createRef } from "react";
import ListItem from "./ListItem";
import { render, fireEvent } from "@testing-library/react";

const content = {
    title: "Test Item",
    subtitle: "Test Subtitle"
};

describe("ListItem forwardRef + ComponentPropsWithRef Tests", () => {
    it("should forward ref to the outer container element", () => {
        const ref = createRef<HTMLDivElement>();
        render(<ListItem ref={ref} content={content} data-testid="list-item" />);

        expect(ref.current).toBeInstanceOf(HTMLDivElement);
        expect(ref.current).toHaveAttribute("data-testid", "list-item-list-item");
    });

    it("should support native HTML className prop", () => {
        const ref = createRef<HTMLDivElement>();
        render(<ListItem ref={ref} content={content} className="custom-class" data-testid="list-item" />);

        expect(ref.current).toHaveClass("custom-class");
    });

    it("should support native HTML data-* attributes", () => {
        const ref = createRef<HTMLDivElement>();
        render(<ListItem ref={ref} content={content} data-custom="test-value" data-testid="list-item" />);

        expect(ref.current).toHaveAttribute("data-custom", "test-value");
    });

    it("should support native HTML aria-* attributes", () => {
        const ref = createRef<HTMLDivElement>();
        render(
            <ListItem
                ref={ref}
                content={content}
                aria-label="Custom List Item"
                aria-selected="true"
                data-testid="list-item"
            />
        );

        expect(ref.current).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "Custom List Item");
        expect(ref.current).toHaveAttribute("aria-selected", "true");
    });

    it("should preserve custom onClick signature with isSelected and selection params", () => {
        const handleClick = jest.fn();
        const selection = {
            type: "checkbox" as const,
            props: { checked: false, onChange: jest.fn() }
        };
        const ref = createRef<HTMLDivElement>();

        render(
            <ListItem
                ref={ref}
                content={content}
                onClick={handleClick}
                selection={selection}
                isInteractive
                data-testid="list-item"
            />
        );

        fireEvent.click(ref.current!);

        expect(handleClick).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        expect(handleClick).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
            expect.any(Object), // event
            expect.any(Boolean), // isSelected
            selection // selection object
        );
    });

    it("should work with isInteractive and custom onClick without selection", () => {
        const handleClick = jest.fn();
        const ref = createRef<HTMLDivElement>();

        render(<ListItem ref={ref} content={content} onClick={handleClick} isInteractive data-testid="list-item" />);

        fireEvent.click(ref.current!);

        expect(handleClick).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        expect(handleClick).toHaveBeenCalledWith(
            expect.any(Object), // event
            expect.any(Boolean), // isSelected
            undefined // selection is undefined
        );
    });

    it("should merge className with internal styling", () => {
        const ref = createRef<HTMLDivElement>();
        render(
            <ListItem ref={ref} content={content} className="external-class" isInteractive data-testid="list-item" />
        );

        // Should have both external class and internal styled-components class
        expect(ref.current?.className).toContain("external-class");
        expect(ref.current?.className.length).toBeGreaterThan("external-class".length);
    });
});
````

````typescript
import React, {
    forwardRef,
    useCallback,
    useEffect,
    useMemo,
    useRef,
    useState,
    type ComponentPropsWithRef
} from "react";
import { LeftPanel, ListItemContainer } from "./ListItem.styles";
import SelectionControlPanel from "./ListItemPanels/SelectionControlPanel";
import MediaPanel from "./ListItemPanels/MediaPanel";
import ContentPanel from "./ListItemPanels/ContentPanel";
import TrailingPanel, { type TrailingItem } from "./ListItemPanels/TrailingPanel";
import { SELECTION_TYPE } from "./ListItemConstant";
import { type CheckboxProps } from "@atoms/checkbox/Checkbox";
import { type RadioButtonProps } from "@atoms/RadioButton/RadioButton";

type SelectionItem = {
    type: "checkbox" | "radio";
    props: CheckboxProps | RadioButtonProps;
};

type MediaItem = {
    type: "avatar" | "icon";
    props: Record<string, unknown>;
};

type ContentData = {
    title: string;
    subtitle?: string;
};

export type ListItemProps = Omit<ComponentPropsWithRef<"div">, "onClick" | "content"> & {
    /**
     * Display the selection control (single or multiple)
     * It can be an Checkbox or Radio component
     */
    selection?: SelectionItem;
    /**
     * Display the media
     * It can be an avatar or icon
     */
    media?: MediaItem;
    /**
     * Display the trailing
     * It can be a button or icon group, badge,
     * switch, text, or action menu button
     */
    trailing?: TrailingItem;
    /**
     * Display the content
     */
    content: ContentData;
    /**
     * Display only divider border on the bottom of each list item
     * Set default to false
     */
    hasDivider?: boolean;
    /**
     * Display the body's content
     */
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Display subtitle on top placement above the title
     */
    hasSubtitleTopPlacement?: boolean;
    /**
     * If set to true, ListItem can be hovered and selected
     */
    isInteractive?: boolean;
    /**
     * Callback function gets trigger when
     * isInteractive is set to true.
     * This callback function returns the event,
     * state of the selection(true/false), selection object
     * Signature: function(event: object, isSelected: boolean, selection: object) => void
     */
    onClick?: (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>, isSelected: boolean, selection?: SelectionItem) => void;
    /**
     * Display the responsive supporting text
     * Set default to false
     * If set to true, it will display the
     * supporting text on it's own column
     * NOTE: This is a private prop
     * only accessible through the List component
     */
    _hasResponsiveSupportText?: boolean;
    /**
     * If set to true, the ListItem will be selected and highlighted
     * This is a controlled prop meaning the state is managed by the parent component
     */
    isSelected?: boolean;
    /**
     * If set to true, the ListItem will be selected and highlighted
     * This is an uncontrolled prop meaing the state is managed by the ListItem component itself
     */
    defaultIsSelected?: boolean;
    /**
     * Callback function to support keyboard navigation, focus event, etc
     */
    onSelectionChange?: (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => void;
    /**
     * used for testing
     */
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const ListItem = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, ListItemProps>(
    (
        {
            selection,
            media,
            content,
            children,
            trailing,
            hasDivider = false,
            isInteractive = false,
            onClick,
            hasSubtitleTopPlacement = false,
            _hasResponsiveSupportText = false,
            isSelected,
            defaultIsSelected = false,
            onSelectionChange,
            "data-testid": dataTestId,
            className,
            ...nativeProps
        },
        ref
    ) => {
        // Check if the selection is controlled or uncontrolled
        // If the selection is controlled, we don't need to manage the state of the selection
        // Controlled - the state of the selection is managed by the parent component
        // Uncontrolled - the state of the selection is managed by the ListItem component itself
        const isControlled = isSelected !== undefined;
        const contentRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null!);
        const [numberOfLines, setNumberOfLines] = useState(0);
        const [isInternalSelected, setIsInternalSelected] = useState(() => defaultIsSelected);
        const resolvedIsSelected = useMemo(
            () => (isControlled ? isSelected : isInternalSelected),
            [isControlled, isSelected, isInternalSelected]
        );

        useEffect(() => {
            // Determine if the selected item is controlled or uncontrolled state
            if (!isControlled) {
                if (isInteractive && (selection?.props?.checked || isInternalSelected)) {
                    setIsInternalSelected(true);
                } else {
                    setIsInternalSelected(false);
                }
            }
        }, [defaultIsSelected, isControlled, isInteractive, isInternalSelected, selection]);

        const validateProps = useCallback(
            (
                objectItem?: SelectionItem | MediaItem | TrailingItem
            ): objectItem is SelectionItem | MediaItem | TrailingItem => {
                return (
                    objectItem != undefined &&
                    objectItem?.props != undefined &&
                    Object.values(objectItem?.props).length > 0
                );
            },
            []
        );

        const toggleSelect = useCallback(
            (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>) => {
                if (isInteractive) {
                    // Verify selection control
                    if (
                        validateProps(selection) &&
                        (selection?.type === SELECTION_TYPE.CHECKBOX || selection?.type === SELECTION_TYPE.RADIO)
                    ) {
                        if (selection?.type === SELECTION_TYPE.CHECKBOX) {
                            if (!isControlled) setIsInternalSelected(!isInternalSelected);
                            onClick && onClick(event, !isInternalSelected, selection);
                        } else {
                            if (!isControlled) setIsInternalSelected(true);
                            onClick && onClick(event, true, selection);
                        }
                    } else {
                        if (!isControlled) setIsInternalSelected(!isInternalSelected);
                        onClick && onClick(event, !isInternalSelected, selection);
                    }
                }
                // Trigger the onSelectionChange callback
                // This is to support keyboard navigation, focus event, etc
                onSelectionChange && onSelectionChange(event);
            },
            [isControlled, isInteractive, isInternalSelected, onClick, onSelectionChange, selection, validateProps]
        );

        const displayTopPosition = useMemo(() => numberOfLines > 2, [numberOfLines]);
        return (
            <ListItemContainer
                ref={ref}
                $hasDivider={hasDivider}
                $isSelected={resolvedIsSelected && isInteractive}
                $isInteractive={isInteractive}
                onClick={toggleSelect}
                data-testid={dataTestId ? `${dataTestId}-list-item` : undefined}
                className={className}
                {...nativeProps}
            >
                <LeftPanel
                    $hasTopPosition={displayTopPosition}
                    data-testid={dataTestId ? `${dataTestId}-left-panel` : undefined}
                >
                    {validateProps(selection) && (
                        <SelectionControlPanel
                            selection={selection}
                            displayTopPosition={displayTopPosition}
                            data-testid={dataTestId}
                        />
                    )}
                    {validateProps(media) && (
                        <MediaPanel media={media} displayTopPosition={displayTopPosition} data-testid={dataTestId} />
                    )}
                    <ContentPanel
                        content={content}
                        contentRef={contentRef}
                        setNumberOfLines={setNumberOfLines}
                        hasSubtitleTopPlacement={hasSubtitleTopPlacement}
                        hasResponsiveSupportText={_hasResponsiveSupportText}
                        data-testid={dataTestId}
                    >
                        {children}
                    </ContentPanel>
                </LeftPanel>
                {validateProps(trailing) && (
                    <TrailingPanel
                        trailing={trailing}
                        displayTopPosition={displayTopPosition}
                        data-testid={dataTestId}
                    />
                )}
            </ListItemContainer>
        );
    }
);

ListItem.displayName = "ListItem";

export default ListItem;
````

````typescript
        const value = [{ ...OPTIONS[0], disabled: true }]; // Disabled option is already selected

        render(
            <MultiSelect
                data-testid="multiselect-test"
                options={options}
                value={value}
                withCheckboxes
                onChange={onChange}
            />
        );

        const multiSelect = screen.getByTestId("multiselect-test-input");
        await user.click(multiSelect);
        await user.click(screen.getByText("Select all"));

        // Should preserve the disabled selected option and add enabled options
        const expectedValue = [
            { ...OPTIONS[0], disabled: true }, // Preserved disabled option
            { ...OPTIONS[1], disabled: false } // Added enabled option
        ];
        expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith(expectedValue);
    });
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import Pagination from "./Pagination";
import { render, screen, within, cleanup, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";

describe("Pagination Tests", () => {
    afterEach(() => {
        cleanup();
    });

    it("should render a pagination", () => {
        const onDataChange = jest.fn();
        render(
            <Pagination totalItems={400} onPaginationChange={onDataChange} itemsPerPage={"sm"} data-testid="test" />
        );

        const pagination = screen.getByTestId("test-pagination");
        expect(pagination).toBeInTheDocument();

        // Accessibility: role and label
        expect(pagination.getAttribute("role")).toBe("navigation");
        expect(pagination.getAttribute("aria-label")).toBe("Pagination");

        // Buttons: accessible names
        const nextButton = screen.getByRole("button", { name: /next/i });
        const prevButton = screen.getByRole("button", { name: /previous/i });
        expect(nextButton).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(prevButton).toBeInTheDocument();

        // Keyboard navigation
        nextButton.focus();
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(nextButton);
        prevButton.focus();
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(prevButton);
    });

    it("should render pagination with fallback aria-labels when localizations are empty", () => {
        const onDataChange = jest.fn();
        render(<Pagination totalItems={20} onPaginationChange={onDataChange} localizations={{}} data-testid="test" />);

        const pagination = screen.getByTestId("test-pagination");

        // When localizations is empty object, aria-label should be "Pagination" (default fallback)
        expect(pagination.getAttribute("aria-label")).toBe("Pagination");

        // Test that Select components are rendered with proper aria-labels
        const itemsPerPageSelect = screen.getByTestId("test-pagination-select");
        const pageSelect = screen.getByTestId("test-pagination-select-page");

        expect(itemsPerPageSelect).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(pageSelect).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should render pagination with fallback aria-labels when localization values are falsy", () => {
        const onDataChange = jest.fn();
        render(
            <Pagination
                totalItems={20}
                onPaginationChange={onDataChange}
                localizations={{
                    itemsPerPageText: undefined,
                    pageText: undefined,
                    itemsText: "items",
                    ofText: "of"
                }}
                data-testid="test"
            />
        );

        const pagination = screen.getByTestId("test-pagination");

        // Test fallback aria-label when itemsPerPageText is null
        expect(pagination.getAttribute("aria-label")).toBe("Pagination");

        // Test that Select components are rendered with fallback aria-labels
        const itemsPerPageSelect = screen.getByTestId("test-pagination-select");
        const pageSelect = screen.getByTestId("test-pagination-select-page");

        expect(itemsPerPageSelect).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(pageSelect).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should allow custom aria-label via attrProps", () => {
        const onDataChange = jest.fn();
        render(
            <Pagination
                totalItems={20}
                onPaginationChange={onDataChange}
                attrProps={{ "aria-label": "Custom pagination navigation" }}
                data-testid="test"
            />
        );

        const pagination = screen.getByTestId("test-pagination");

        // Test that custom aria-label from attrProps overrides the default
        expect(pagination.getAttribute("aria-label")).toBe("Custom pagination navigation");
    });

    it("should render pagination without data-testid", () => {
        const onDataChange = jest.fn();
        render(<Pagination totalItems={20} onPaginationChange={onDataChange} />);

        // Should render without data-testid attributes
        const pagination = screen.getByRole("navigation");
        expect(pagination).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(pagination.getAttribute("aria-label")).toBe("Pagination");

        // Should not have aria-describedby when no dataTestId
        expect(pagination.getAttribute("aria-describedby")).toBeNull();

        // Should not have id on the info span when no dataTestId
        const infoSpan = pagination.querySelector('span[aria-live="polite"]');
        expect(infoSpan).toBeInTheDocument();
        if (infoSpan) {
            expect(infoSpan.getAttribute("id")).toBeNull();
        }
    });

    it("should render pagination with display show all", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const onDataChange = jest.fn();
        render(<Pagination totalItems={20} onPaginationChange={onDataChange} data-testid="test" />);

        const select = screen.getByTestId("test-pagination-select-combobox");

        // Keyboard navigation: focus and select Show All using arrow keys
        select.focus();
        await user.click(select);
        await user.keyboard("{ArrowDown}"); // Navigate to "Show All"
        await user.keyboard("{Enter}");

        expect((select as HTMLInputElement).value).toEqual("Show All");
        expect(select).toBeTruthy();

        // Option should be present in the dropdown
        await user.click(select);
        expect(screen.getByRole("option", { name: "Show All" })).toBeInTheDocument();

        // Callback should be called
        expect(onDataChange).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should render pagination with onDataChange function been called", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const onDataChange = jest.fn();
        render(<Pagination totalItems={10} onPaginationChange={onDataChange} data-testid="test" />);

        // Accessibility: select should be focusable and have correct aria-label
        const select = screen.getByTestId("test-pagination-select");
        const input = within(select).getByTestId("test-pagination-select-combobox");

        // Open dropdown and robustly wait for 'Show All' option
        await user.click(input);
        const showAllOption = await screen.findByRole("option", { name: "Show All" });
        expect(showAllOption).toBeInTheDocument();
        await user.click(showAllOption);

        // Option should be present and selected
        expect((input as HTMLInputElement).value).toEqual("Show All");

        // Callback should be called with correct value
        expect(onDataChange).toHaveBeenCalled();
        const found = onDataChange.mock.calls.some(
            call => call[0]?.pageSize === "Show All" && call[0]?.pageIndex === 1
        );
        expect(found).toBe(true);
    });

    it("should render pagination with option set to 10", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const onDataChange = jest.fn();
        render(<Pagination totalItems={50} onPaginationChange={onDataChange} data-testid="test" />);

        const select = screen.getByTestId("test-pagination-select");
        const input = within(select).getByTestId("test-pagination-select-combobox");

        // Mouse interaction: open dropdown and select '10'
        await user.click(input);
        const option10 = await screen.findByRole("option", { name: "10" });
        expect(option10).toBeInTheDocument();
        await user.click(option10);

        // Callback: should be called with correct value
        expect(onDataChange).toHaveBeenCalled();
        const found = onDataChange.mock.calls.some(call => call[0]?.pageSize === "10" && call[0]?.pageIndex === 1);
        expect(found).toBe(true);

    it("should render pagination with next page button and previous page button", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup({ delay: null }); // Remove delays for faster testing
        const onDataChange = jest.fn();
        render(<Pagination totalItems={4000} itemsPerPage="20" onPaginationChange={onDataChange} data-testid="test" />);

        // Accessibility: get buttons by role and name
        const btnNext = screen.getByRole("button", { name: /next/i });
        const btnPrev = screen.getByRole("button", { name: /previous/i });
        expect(btnNext).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(btnPrev).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect((btnNext as HTMLButtonElement).disabled).toBe(false);
        expect((btnPrev as HTMLButtonElement).disabled).toBe(true); // On first page, previous should be disabled

        // Test basic navigation without excessive interactions
        const initialCalls = onDataChange.mock.calls.length;

        // Click next button
        await user.click(btnNext);
        const delta = onDataChange.mock.calls.length - initialCalls;
        // React 18 StrictMode intentionally double-invokes effects in tests, so a single click can yield two
        // `onPaginationChange` calls (see https://react.dev/reference/react/StrictMode). In production we only
        // see one, so we assert the delta stays within the 1-2 range to cover both environments and still flag
        // any regressions that fire zero or more than twice.
        expect(delta).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
        expect(delta).toBeLessThanOrEqual(2);
        expect(onDataChange).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith({ pageSize: "20", pageIndex: 2 });

        // Output: page selection should update (query after click to ensure DOM is updated)
        let select: HTMLElement | undefined = undefined;
        await waitFor(() => {
            select = screen.getByTestId("test-pagination-select-page-combobox");
            expect((select as HTMLInputElement).value).toEqual("2");
        });
        expect(screen.getByText("21-40 of 4000 items")).toBeInTheDocument();

        // Click previous button
        await user.click(btnPrev);
        expect(onDataChange.mock.calls.length).toBe(initialCalls + 2);
        await waitFor(() => {
            if (select) {
                expect((select as HTMLInputElement).value).toEqual("1");
            }
        });
        expect(screen.getByText("1-20 of 4000 items")).toBeInTheDocument();

        // Edge case: try to go before first page
        expect((btnPrev as HTMLButtonElement).disabled).toBe(true); // Should be disabled on first page
        await user.click(btnPrev); // should stay at 1
        if (select) {
            expect((select as HTMLInputElement).value).toEqual("1");
        }

        // Test keyboard navigation on next button
        btnNext.focus();
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(btnNext);
        await user.keyboard("{Enter}");
        await waitFor(() => {
            if (select) {
                expect((select as HTMLInputElement).value).toEqual("2");
            }
        });

        // Go to last page (use page selector instead of clicking 199 times)
        const pageSelect = screen.getByTestId("test-pagination-select-page");
        const pageInput = within(pageSelect).getByTestId("test-pagination-select-page-combobox");

        await user.click(pageInput);
        const lastPageOption = await screen.findByRole("option", { name: "200" });
        await user.click(lastPageOption);

        expect((pageInput as HTMLInputElement).value).toEqual("200");
        expect((btnNext as HTMLButtonElement).disabled).toBe(true);
        // Try to go beyond last page
        await user.click(btnNext);
        expect((pageInput as HTMLInputElement).value).toEqual("200");
    });

    it("should render pagination with items per page set to 2 (accessibility, output, navigation, callback, keyboard, edge)", async () => {

        // Callback: should be called with correct value
        expect(onDataChange).toHaveBeenCalled();
        const found = onDataChange.mock.calls.some(call => call[0]?.pageSize === "20" && call[0]?.pageIndex === 1);
        expect(found).toBe(true);

        // Navigation: next/previous buttons

        const btnPrev = screen.getByRole("button", { name: /previous/i });
````
