````typescript
import React, { useMemo } from "react";
import { Row } from "react-table";
// @ts-ignore - Selection module not yet converted to TS
import { SelectionCell, SelectionHeader } from "../TableModules/Selection";
import { ColumnShape } from "../../../shared/shapes/ColumnsShape";

const isAlphanumeric = (type: unknown) => {
    if (
        type?.toString() === "text" ||
        type?.toString() === "string" ||
        type?.toString() === "numeric" ||
        !type ||
        type === ""
    ) {
        return true;
    }
    return false;
};

type ExtendedColumnShape = ColumnShape & {
    id?: string;
    isBuildIn?: boolean;
    isSwitchStatus?: boolean;
    manageable?: boolean;
    minWidth?: string | number;
    maxWidth?: string | number;
};

type UseProcessColumnsParams = {
    hasSelections?: boolean;
    columns: ExtendedColumnShape[];
    dataTestId?: string;
    sortByInsensitiveCase: (
        rowA: Row<Record<string, unknown>>,
        rowB: Row<Record<string, unknown>>,
        id: string,
        desc?: boolean
    ) => number;
    hasAsyncData?: boolean;
    setSortOrder?: (sortOrder: string) => void;
    setSortBy?: (sortBy: string) => void;
};

const useProcessColumns = ({
    hasSelections,
    columns,
    dataTestId,
    sortByInsensitiveCase,
    hasAsyncData,
    setSortOrder,
    setSortBy
}: UseProcessColumnsParams) =>
    useMemo(() => {
        let sortableColumns: any[] = [];
        if (columns?.length > 0) {
            sortableColumns = columns?.map((col, index) => {
                return {
                    Cell: ({ cell: { value } }: any) => value ?? "–", //set empty cells to dashed line
                    ...col,
                    id: col.id || col.accessor || `col-${index}`,
                    disableSortBy: !col.sortable,
                    reorderable: col.reorderable !== false || col.accessor === "switchStatus",
                    isBuildIn: col.isBuildIn || false,
                    isSwitchStatus: col.isSwitchStatus || col.accessor === "switchStatus" || false,
                    manageable: col.manageable !== false, // Default to true if not specified
                    columnOrder: index, // Add the column's position in the table
                    isLocked: col.reorderable === false || col.accessor === "switchStatus", // Mark if the column is locked (non-reorderable)
                    sortType: col.sortCallback ?? (isAlphanumeric(col.type) ? sortByInsensitiveCase : "alphanumeric"),
                    minWidth: col.minWidth,
                    maxWidth: col.maxWidth || col.minWidth || "auto",
                    onSorted: (desc: boolean) => {
                        if (hasAsyncData) {
                            setSortBy?.(col.accessor!);
                            setSortOrder?.(desc ? "desc" : "asc");
                        }
                        return col.onSorted && col.onSorted(desc);
                    }
                };
            });

            if (hasSelections) {
                return [
                    {
                        id: "selection",
                        type: "checkmark",
                        cellWidth: "50px",
                        accessor: "selection",
                        isBuildIn: true,
                        reorderable: false,
                        columnOrder: 0, // Selection column is always at position 0
                        isLocked: true, // Selection column is always locked
                        disableSortBy: true,
                        Header: (props: any) => (
                            <SelectionHeader
                                {...props}
                                getToggleAllRowsSelectedProps={props.getToggleAllPageRowsSelectedProps}
                                triggerAllRowsSelect={props.toggleAllPageRowsSelected}
                                data-testid={dataTestId}
                            />
                        ),
                        Cell: (props: any) => <SelectionCell {...props} row={props.row} data-testid={dataTestId} />
                    },
                    ...sortableColumns
                ];
            }
        }

        return sortableColumns;
    }, [columns, hasSelections, sortByInsensitiveCase, hasAsyncData, setSortBy, setSortOrder, dataTestId]);

export { useProcessColumns };
export default useProcessColumns;
````

## File: src/components/organisms/DataTable/TableHooks/useSelectedRows.tsx
````typescript
import { useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import type { Row } from "react-table";
import usePrevious from "@hooks/usePrevious";

export type UseSelectedRowsParams = {
    selectedRowIds: Record<string, boolean>;
    onSelectedRowChanged: ((ids: string[], rows: Row<Record<string, unknown>>[]) => void) | undefined;
    selectedFlatRows: Row<Record<string, unknown>>[];
    toggleRowSelected: (rowId: string, value: boolean) => void;
};

const useSelectedRows = ({
    selectedRowIds,
    onSelectedRowChanged,
    selectedFlatRows,
    toggleRowSelected
}: UseSelectedRowsParams) => {
    // Memoize selectedRows to prevent recalculation unless selectedFlatRows or toggleRowSelected changes
    const selectedRows = useMemo(() => {
        return selectedFlatRows.reduce((acc, row) => {
            const original = row.original as Record<string, unknown>;
            if ((original.checkbox as Record<string, unknown>)?.hide) {
                toggleRowSelected(row.id, false);
                return acc; // Skip hidden rows
            }
            acc.push(row.original);
            return acc;
        }, [] as unknown[]);
    }, [selectedFlatRows, toggleRowSelected]);

    // Track previous selectedRowIds to detect changes
    const previousSelectedRowIds = usePrevious(selectedRowIds);

    // Trigger onSelectedRowChanged only when selectedRowIds change
    useEffect(() => {
        // first render, skip trigger of callback
        if (
            previousSelectedRowIds &&
            previousSelectedRowIds !== selectedRowIds &&
            typeof onSelectedRowChanged === "function"
        ) {
            const selectedRowKeys = Object.keys(selectedRowIds);
            onSelectedRowChanged(selectedRowKeys, selectedFlatRows);
        }
    }, [onSelectedRowChanged, selectedRowIds, previousSelectedRowIds, selectedFlatRows]);

    return selectedRows;
};

export { useSelectedRows };
export default useSelectedRows;
````

## File: src/components/organisms/DataTable/TableModules/DataTableToolbar/TableToolbarHooks/useBulkActionsMenuList.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useMemo, ReactElement } from "react";
import type { BulkAction } from "./renderActionButton";
import type { FooterButtonWithClose } from "@molecules/ActionMenuButton/useFooterButtonGroupWithWrappedOnClick";

type FooterButtonGroup = Omit<FooterButtonWithClose, "onClick"> & {
    onClick?: (selectedRows: unknown, refetchData?: () => void) => void;
    clearSelectionsAfterClick?: boolean;
};

type BulkActionWithClick = Omit<BulkAction, "onClick" | "footerButtonGroup"> & {
    onClick?: (selectedRows: unknown, onSelectedRemove: () => void, refetchData?: () => void) => void;
    clearSelectionsAfterClick?: boolean;
    icon?: ReactElement | ((selectedRows: unknown, refetchData?: () => void) => ReactElement);
    footerButtonGroup?: FooterButtonGroup[];
};

export type UseBulkActionsMenuListProps = {
    bulkActionMenu?: BulkActionWithClick[];
    performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove: (functionToPerform: () => void) => void;
    onSelectedRemove: () => void;
    selectedRows?: unknown;
    refetchData?: () => void;
};

const overrideOnClicks = (
    actions: any[],
    performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove: (functionToPerform: () => void) => void,
    selectedRows: unknown,
    onSelectedRemove: () => void,
    refetchData?: () => void
): any[] => {
    return actions.map(action => {
        if (action.actionList) {
            // update actionList
            return {
                ...action,
                actionList: overrideOnClicks(
                    action.actionList,
                    performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove,
                    selectedRows,
                    onSelectedRemove,
                    refetchData
                ),
                // update button group actions
                footerButtonGroup: action?.footerButtonGroup
                    ? overrideButtonGroupOnClicks(
                          action?.footerButtonGroup,
                          selectedRows,
                          performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove,
                          refetchData
                      )
                    : undefined
            };
        } else {
            // no actionList exists, update onClick
            return {
                ...action,
                onClick:
                    action.onClick && action.clearSelectionsAfterClick
                        ? () =>
                              performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove(() =>
                                  action.onClick?.(selectedRows, onSelectedRemove, refetchData)
                              )
                        : action.onClick && (() => action.onClick?.(selectedRows, onSelectedRemove, refetchData)),
                icon:
                    action?.icon && typeof action?.icon === "function"
                        ? React.cloneElement(action.icon(selectedRows, refetchData))
                        : action.icon
            };
        }
    });
};

const overrideButtonGroupOnClicks = (
    footerButtonGroup: any[],
    selectedRows: unknown,
    performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove: (functionToPerform: () => void) => void,
    refetchData?: () => void
): any[] => {
    return footerButtonGroup?.map(actionButton => {
        return {
            ...actionButton,
            onClick:
                actionButton?.onClick && actionButton?.clearSelectionsAfterClick
                    ? () => performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove(() => actionButton.onClick?.(selectedRows, refetchData))
                    : actionButton?.onClick && (() => actionButton.onClick?.(selectedRows, refetchData))
        };
    });
};

const useBulkActionsMenuList = ({
    bulkActionMenu,
    performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove,
    onSelectedRemove,
    selectedRows,
    refetchData
}: UseBulkActionsMenuListProps): any =>
    useMemo(() => {
        if (!bulkActionMenu) return;
        return overrideOnClicks(
            bulkActionMenu as any,
            performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove,
            selectedRows,
            onSelectedRemove,
            refetchData
        );
    }, [bulkActionMenu, performFunctionThenOnSelectedRemove, selectedRows, onSelectedRemove, refetchData]);

export default useBulkActionsMenuList;
````

````typescript
import { SelectedLabel, SelectedWrapperStyle, StyledCloseIcon } from "./TableToolbarStyle";
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import Button from "@atoms/button/Button";
import BulkActionMenu from "./TableToolbarHooks/renderBulkActionMenu";
import type { BulkAction } from "./TableToolbarHooks/renderActionButton";
import type { LocaleTexts } from "./TableToolbarConstants";

export type TableToolbarSelectedWrapperProps = {
    numSelectedRows?: number;
    localeTextOverwrites: LocaleTexts;
    onSelectedRemove: () => void;
    bulkActionMenu?: unknown;
    bulkActionsMenuList?: any;
    parentDataTestId?: string;
    selectedRows?: unknown;
};

const TableToolbarSelectedWrapper: React.FC<TableToolbarSelectedWrapperProps> = ({
    numSelectedRows,
    localeTextOverwrites,
    onSelectedRemove,
    bulkActionMenu,
    bulkActionsMenuList,
    parentDataTestId,
    selectedRows
}) => {
    const handleOnClick = useCallback((onClick?: () => void) => (onClick ? () => onClick() : undefined), []);
    return (
        <SelectedWrapperStyle data-testid={parentDataTestId && `${parentDataTestId}-selected-wrapper`}>
            {numSelectedRows && numSelectedRows > 0 && (
                <>
                    <SelectedLabel data-testid="selected_label_test">
                        {numSelectedRows} {localeTextOverwrites.SELECTED}
                    </SelectedLabel>
                    {bulkActionMenu && (
                        <BulkActionMenu
                            bulkActionsMenuList={bulkActionsMenuList}
                            handleOnClick={handleOnClick}
                            parentDataTestId={parentDataTestId}
                        />
                    )}
                    <Button
                        type="primary"
                        isIconOnly
                        attrProps={{ "aria-label": "Deselect All Rows" }}
                        isMinWidthZero={true}
                        onClick={onSelectedRemove}
                        data-testid="selected_label_remove_icon"
                    >
                        <StyledCloseIcon className="fal fa-times" />
                    </Button>
                </>
            )}
        </SelectedWrapperStyle>
    );
};

export default TableToolbarSelectedWrapper;
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import TableBody from "@atoms/TableBody/TableBody";
import PropTypes from "prop-types";
import useLazyBody from "../TableHooks/useLazyBody";
// @ts-ignore - Rows.jsx doesn't have type definitions
import Rows from "./Rows";

type BodyProps = {
    rows: any[];
    prepareRow: (row: any) => void;
    onRowClick?: (row: any, refetchData?: any) => void;
    hasSelections?: boolean;
    preGlobalFilteredRows?: any[];
    accessorKey: string;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    hasAsyncData?: boolean;
    refetchData?: any;
    disableTrackPostfix?: boolean;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const Body = ({
    rows,
    prepareRow,
    onRowClick,
    hasSelections,
    preGlobalFilteredRows,
    accessorKey,
    dataTrackAction,
    hasAsyncData,
    refetchData,
    disableTrackPostfix,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: BodyProps) => {
    const preGlobalFilteredRowsLength = preGlobalFilteredRows && preGlobalFilteredRows.length;
    const { lazyRows, getCellInfo, increaseRowsLoaded } = useLazyBody(rows, preGlobalFilteredRowsLength || 0);

    const _onRowClick = useCallback(
        (row: any) => {
            if (typeof onRowClick === "function") {
                onRowClick({ ...row }, refetchData);
            }
        },
        [refetchData, onRowClick]
    );

    return (
        <TableBody componentType="div" data-testid={dataTestId}>
            <Rows
                rows={rows}
                prepareRow={prepareRow}
                lazyRows={lazyRows}
                accessorKey={accessorKey}
                dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction}
                hasSelections={hasSelections}
                getCellInfo={getCellInfo}
                increaseRowsLoaded={increaseRowsLoaded}
                hasAsyncData={hasAsyncData}
                refetchData={refetchData}
                dataTestId={dataTestId}
                onRowClick={_onRowClick}
                disableTrackPostfix={disableTrackPostfix}
            />
        </TableBody>
    );
};

Body.propTypes = {
    rows: PropTypes.array.isRequired,
    prepareRow: PropTypes.func.isRequired,
    onRowClick: PropTypes.func,
    hasSelections: PropTypes.bool,
    preGlobalFilteredRows: PropTypes.array,
    accessorKey: PropTypes.string.isRequired,
    dataTrackAction: PropTypes.string,
    hasAsyncData: PropTypes.bool,
    refetchData: PropTypes.func,
    "data-testid": PropTypes.string
};

export default Body;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { useCallback } from "react";
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { StyledErrorMessageContainer } from "../DataTableStyles";
import Button from "@components/atoms/button/Button";

const NO_ITEMS_LINE_1 = "Start by adding a new tag";
const NOT_FOUND_LINE_1 = "No results found";
const NOT_FOUND_LINE_2 = "Try adjusting your search or filter to find what you're looking for";
const NO_ITEMS = "noItems";
const NOT_FOUND = "notFound";
const API_ERROR = "apiError";
const API_ERROR_LINE_1 = "An error occurred while fetching data";
const API_ERROR_LINE_2 = "Please try again later";

export const ERROR_MESSAGES = {
    NOT_FOUND_LINE_1,
    NOT_FOUND_LINE_2,
    NO_ITEMS_LINE_1,
    API_ERROR_LINE_1,
    API_ERROR_LINE_2
};

export const ERROR_TYPES = {
    NOT_FOUND,
    NO_ITEMS,
    API_ERROR
};

const ErrorMessages = ({
    errorMessages,
    hasFilterGroup,
    filteredDataSize,
    preGlobalFilteredRows,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: {
    errorMessages: any;
    hasFilterGroup: any;
    filteredDataSize: any;
    preGlobalFilteredRows: any;
    "data-testid"?: any;
}) => {
    const type = (hasFilterGroup && filteredDataSize === 0) || preGlobalFilteredRows?.length ? NOT_FOUND : NO_ITEMS;

    const getDefaultErrorMessageLine2 = useCallback((type: any) => {
        return type === NOT_FOUND ? ERROR_MESSAGES.NOT_FOUND_LINE_2 : "";
    }, []);

    const errorMessageLine1 = useMemo(() => {
        if (typeof errorMessages[type]?.line1 != "undefined" && errorMessages[type]?.line1.length > 0) {
            return errorMessages[type].line1;
        }
        return type === NOT_FOUND ? ERROR_MESSAGES.NOT_FOUND_LINE_1 : ERROR_MESSAGES.NO_ITEMS_LINE_1;
    }, [errorMessages, type]);

    const errorMessageLine2 = useMemo(() => {
        return typeof errorMessages[type]?.line2 != "undefined" && errorMessages[type]?.line2.length > 0
            ? errorMessages[type].line2
            : getDefaultErrorMessageLine2(type);
    }, [errorMessages, getDefaultErrorMessageLine2, type]);

    return (
        <StyledErrorMessageContainer data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-error-messages`}>
            {errorMessages?.[API_ERROR] != undefined ? (
                <>
                    {Object.values(errorMessages?.[API_ERROR].line1).length > 0 && (
                        <span className="line-1" data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-api-error-message-line1`}>
                            {errorMessages[API_ERROR].line1}
                        </span>
                    )}
                    {Object.values(errorMessages?.[API_ERROR].code).length > 0 && (
                        <span className="line-2" data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-api-error-message-code`}>
                            {errorMessages[API_ERROR].code}
                        </span>
                    )}
                    {Object.values(errorMessages?.[API_ERROR]).length > 0 && (
                        <span className="line-2" data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-api-error-message-line2`}>
                            {errorMessages[API_ERROR].line2}
                        </span>
                    )}
                </>
            ) : (
                <>
                    <span className="line-1" data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-error-message-line1`}>
                        {errorMessageLine1}
                    </span>
                    {errorMessageLine2.length > 0 && (
                        <span className="line-2" data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-error-message-line2`}>
                            {errorMessageLine2}
                        </span>
                    )}
                    {errorMessages[type]?.buttonProps && (
                        <Button
                            {...errorMessages[type].buttonProps}
                            data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-error-message-button`}
                        />
                    )}
                </>
            )}
        </StyledErrorMessageContainer>
    );
};

export default ErrorMessages;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import TableHead from "@atoms/TableHead/TableHead";
import TableRow from "@atoms/TableRow/TableRow";
import TableCell from "@atoms/TableCell/TableCell";

const MemoHead = React.memo(TableHead);
const MemoRow = React.memo(TableRow);
const MemoCell = React.memo(TableCell);

const Header = ({
    headerGroups,
    stickyTopHeader,
    isInsideSlideout,
    hasScrollX,
    dataTrackAction,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: {
    headerGroups: any;
    stickyTopHeader: any;
    isInsideSlideout: any;
    hasScrollX: any;
    dataTrackAction: any;
    "data-testid"?: any;
}) => {
    return (
        <MemoHead componentType="div" data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}_header`}>
            {headerGroups.map((headerGroup: any) => {
                const headerGroupProps = headerGroup.getHeaderGroupProps();
                return (
                    <MemoRow
                        key={headerGroupProps.key}
                        {...headerGroupProps}
                        componentType="div"
                        data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}_header_row`}
                    >
                        {headerGroup.headers.map((column: any) => {
                            const cellDataTrackAction =
                                dataTrackAction && column?.id ? `${dataTrackAction}-header-${column.id}` : undefined;
                            const sortProps = column.getSortByToggleProps();
                            const headerProps = column.getHeaderProps(sortProps);
                            return (
                                <MemoCell
                                    key={headerProps.key}
                                    cellType="header"
                                    componentType="div"
                                    dataType={column.type}
                                    topOffset={`${stickyTopHeader}px`}
                                    cellWidth={column.cellWidth}
                                    canSort={column.canSort}
                                    isSorted={column.isSorted}
                                    isSortedDesc={column.isSortedDesc}
                                    onSorted={column.onSorted}
                                    cellColor="#0a1b36"
                                    cellLineHeight={"20px"}
                                    cellPadding="8px 16px !important;"
                                    isInsideSlideout={isInsideSlideout}
                                    hasScrollX={hasScrollX}
                                    data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}_${headerProps.key}`}
                                    dataTrackAction={cellDataTrackAction}
                                    {...headerProps}
                                >
                                    {column.render("Header")}
                                </MemoCell>
                            );
                        })}
                    </MemoRow>
                );
            })}
        </MemoHead>
    );
};

export default Header;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { SelectionHeader, SelectionCell } from "./Selection";
import { render, screen, fireEvent } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";

describe("Table selection tests", () => {
    it("should render a selection header", () => {
        const onChange = jest.fn();
        const getToggleAllRowsSelectedProps = () => {
            return {
                onChange: jest.fn()
            };
        };
        render(
            <SelectionHeader
                getToggleAllRowsSelectedProps={getToggleAllRowsSelectedProps}
                triggerAllRowsSelect={onChange}
                isAllPageRowsSelected={false}
                data-testid="test"
            />
        );
        fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId("test-select-header-check"));
        expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should handle remove selected rows on indeterminate", () => {
        const onChange = jest.fn();
        const getToggleAllRowsSelectedProps = () => {
            return {
                onChange: jest.fn(),
                indeterminate: true
            };
        };
        render(
            <SelectionHeader
                getToggleAllRowsSelectedProps={getToggleAllRowsSelectedProps}
                triggerAllRowsSelect={onChange}
                isAllPageRowsSelected={false}
                data-testid="test"
            />
        );
        fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId("test-select-header-check"));
        expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should render a selection cell", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const onChange = jest.fn();
        const row = {
            getToggleRowSelectedProps: () => {
                return {
                    onChange: jest.fn()
                };
            },
            toggleRowSelected: jest.fn(),
            id: "1",
            index: 0,
            original: { id: "1" }
        } as any;
        render(<SelectionCell row={row} triggerRowSelect={onChange} accessorKey="id" data-testid="test" />);
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("test-select-cell-check-0"));
        expect(row.toggleRowSelected).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should hide a selection cell", () => {
        const onChange = jest.fn();
        const row = {
            getToggleRowSelectedProps: () => {
                return {
                    onChange: onChange
                };
            },
            toggleRowSelected: jest.fn(),
            original: {
                id: "1",
                checkbox: {
                    hide: true
                }
            },
            id: 1,
            index: 0
        } as any;
        const { queryByTestId } = render(<SelectionCell row={row} accessorKey="id" data-testid="test" />);
        expect(queryByTestId("test")).toBeNull();
    });

    it("should disable a selection cell", () => {
        const onChange = jest.fn();
        const row = {
            getToggleRowSelectedProps: () => {
                return {
                    onChange: onChange
                };
            },
            toggleRowSelected: jest.fn(),
            original: {
                id: "1",
                checkbox: {
                    disabled: true
                }
            },
            id: 1,
            index: 0
        } as any;
        render(<SelectionCell row={row} data-testid="test" />);
        expect(screen.getByTestId("test-select-cell-check-0")).toHaveAttribute("disabled");
    });
});
````

````typescript
import "react-table";

declare module "react-table" {
    export interface TableOptions<D extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>> {
        autoResetSelectedRows?: boolean;
        autoResetSortBy?: boolean;
        autoResetPage?: boolean;
        autoResetHiddenColumns?: boolean;
        autoResetGlobalFilter?: boolean;
        disableSortRemove?: boolean;
        disableMultiSort?: boolean;
        manualPagination?: boolean;
        manualSortBy?: boolean;
        getRowId?: (originalRow: D, relativeIndex: number, parent?: Row<D>) => string;
    }

    export interface TableInstance<D extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>> {
        page: Array<Row<D>>;
        preGlobalFilteredRows: Array<Row<D>>;
        gotoPage: (updater: number | ((pageIndex: number) => number)) => void;
        setPageSize: (pageSize: number) => void;
        selectedFlatRows: Array<Row<D>>;
        toggleRowSelected: (rowId: string | number, set?: boolean) => void;
        toggleAllPageRowsSelected: (set?: boolean) => void;
        toggleAllRowsSelected: (set?: boolean) => void;
    }

    export interface TableState<D extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>> {
        selectedRowIds: Record<string, boolean>;
        sortBy: Array<{ id: string; desc: boolean }>;
        pageIndex: number;
        pageSize: number;
    }

    export interface Row<D extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>> {
        /** The original data for this row */
        original: D;
        /** The index of this row */
        index: number;
        /** The unique identifier for this row */
        id: string;
        /** The row's values object */
        values: Record<string, unknown>;
        /** The row's cells array */
        cells: Cell<D>[];
        /** Get props for the row element */
        getRowProps: () => { key: string | number; [key: string]: unknown };
        /** Whether row is selected */
        isSelected?: boolean;
        /** Whether row can be expanded */
        canExpand?: boolean;
        /** Toggle row selection - added by useRowSelect plugin */
        toggleRowSelected?: (rowId?: string, set?: boolean) => void;
    }

    export interface Cell<D extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>> {
        /** The column for this cell */
        column: ColumnInstance<D>;
        /** The row for this cell */
        row: Row<D>;
        /** The value of this cell */
        value: unknown;
        /** Get props for the cell element */
        getCellProps: () => { key: string | number; [key: string]: unknown };
        /** Render the cell */
        render: (type: string, userProps?: Record<string, unknown>) => React.ReactNode;
    }

    export interface ColumnInstance<D extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>> {
        /** Cell data type (e.g. "text", "badge", "avatar") */
        type?: string;
        /** Cell width value */
        cellWidth?: string | number;
    }
}
````

````typescript
                accessor: "name",
                sortable: true
            },
            {
                id: "age",
                accessor: "age",
                sortable: true

        const { result } = renderHook(() =>
            useProcessColumns({
                hasSelections: false,
                columns,
                dataTestId: "test",
                sortByInsensitiveCase: jest.fn(),
                hasAsyncData: true,
                setSortOrder: mockSetSortOrder,
                setSortBy: mockSetSortBy
            })
        );

        // Simulate sorting on the "name" column in descending order
        const nameColumn = result.current.find(col => col.id === "name");
        nameColumn.onSorted(true);

        // Assert that setSortBy and setSortOrder were called with the correct values
        expect(mockSetSortBy).toHaveBeenCalledWith("name");
        expect(mockSetSortOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith("desc");

        // Simulate sorting on the "age" column in ascending order
        const ageColumn = result.current.find(col => col.id === "age");
        ageColumn.onSorted(false);

        // Assert that setSortBy and setSortOrder were called with the correct values
        expect(mockSetSortBy).toHaveBeenCalledWith("age");
        expect(mockSetSortOrder).toHaveBeenCalledWith("asc");
    });

        });

        await waitFor(() => {
            expect(screen.getByText("User 1")).toBeInTheDocument();
            expect(screen.getByText("User 2")).toBeInTheDocument();
        });
    });
````

````typescript
import "@testing-library/jest-dom";
import React from "react";
import DonutChart from "./DonutChart";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { DONUT_DATA_TEST } from "@components/shared/Recharts/ChartData";

const renderComponent = (props?: any) => {
    return render(
        <div style={{ height: "200px", width: "200px" }}>
            <DonutChart width={200} height={200} data={DONUT_DATA_TEST} isAnimationActive={false} {...props} />
        </div>
    );
};

describe("DonutChart Tests", () => {
    beforeEach(() => {
        // IMPORTANT!!! Recharts generally has issues with RTL and finding a container height so this method
        // sets the "height" of the container so svg elements can render otherwise you can find elements
        jest.spyOn(HTMLElement.prototype, "clientHeight", "get").mockReturnValue(100);
        jest.spyOn(HTMLElement.prototype, "clientWidth", "get").mockReturnValue(100);
    });

    afterAll(() => {
        jest.restoreAllMocks();
    });

    it("should render a chart with correct number of sectors and summary items", () => {
        const { container } = renderComponent();
        const sectors = container.querySelectorAll(".recharts-pie-sector");
        expect(sectors.length).toBe(2);
        expect(screen.getAllByTestId("summary-item").length).toBe(2);
    });

    it("should render a chart with custom palette", () => {
        const { container } = renderComponent({ customPalette: ["#ff00ff", "#00ff00"] });
        expect(container.querySelector('path[fill="#ff00ff"]')).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(container.querySelector('path[fill="#00ff00"]')).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should hide tooltip", () => {
        const { container } = renderComponent({ accessoryOptions: { hideToolTip: true } });
        expect(container.querySelectorAll(".recharts-tooltip-wrapper").length).toBe(0);
    });

    it("should render with horizontal align to left", () => {
        renderComponent({ horizontalAlign: "left", width: 300, height: 200 });
    });

    it("should render with horizontal align to right", () => {
        renderComponent({ horizontalAlign: "right", width: 300, height: 200 });
    });

    it("should render with invalid horizontal align", () => {
        renderComponent({ horizontalAlign: "hohoho", width: 300, height: 200 });
    });

    it("should render with vertical align to top", () => {
        renderComponent({ verticalAlign: "top", width: 200, height: 300 });
    });

    it("should render with vertical align to bottom", () => {
        renderComponent({ verticalAlign: "bottom", width: 200, height: 300 });
    });

    it("should render with invalid vertical align", () => {
        renderComponent({ verticalAlign: "ohohoh", width: 200, height: 300 });
    });

    it("should render with empty data", () => {
        renderComponent({ data: [] });
        expect(screen.getByTestId("graph-container")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
});
````

````typescript
import React, { ReactNode } from "react";
import { FilterGroupContextProvider } from "./FilterGroupContext";
import FilterGroupPanel from "./FilterGroupPanel";

export type FilterOption = {
    label?: string;
    value?: unknown;
};

export type FilterGroupItem = {
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    filterGroup: string;
    id?: string;
    isMultiselect?: boolean;
    isSortable?: boolean;
    optionLabel?: string;
    optionValue?: string;
    options?: FilterOption[];
    placeholder: string;
    sortDataType?: string;
};

export type SortByDataItem = {
    filterGroup: string;
    id?: string;
    isSortable?: boolean;
    placeholder: string;
    sortDataType?: string;
};

export type SortGroups = {
    defaultSortGroup?: string;
    sortByDesc?: boolean;
    sortDataType?: string;
};

export type FilterChangeEvent =
    | {
          filterGroup: string;
          filterName: string;
          isSelected: boolean;
      }
    | {
          searchTerm: unknown;
          selectedFilters: unknown[];
      };

export type FilterGroupProps = {
    data: Record<string, unknown>[];
    filterGroups?: FilterGroupItem[];
    sortGroups?: SortGroups;
    sortByData?: SortByDataItem[];
    hasSort?: boolean;
    hasSearch?: boolean;
    defaultSortGroup?: string;
    defaultSortByDesc?: boolean;
    displayTokens?: boolean;
    onChangeData?: (data: Record<string, unknown>[]) => void;
    hasResultCount?: boolean;
    isSortByData?: boolean;
    excludedFieldsOnSearch?: string[];
    maxSearchDepth?: number;
    hasAsyncData?: boolean;
    onFilterChange?: (filter: FilterChangeEvent) => void;
    totalCount?: number;
    debounceTime?: number;
    totalFilteredCount?: number;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

export const FilterGroup = (props: FilterGroupProps) => {
    const {
        sortGroups,
        filterGroups = [],
        data,
        hasSort = false,
        hasSearch = false,
        defaultSortGroup,
        defaultSortByDesc = false,
        displayTokens = false,
        onChangeData,
        hasResultCount = false,
        sortByData = [],
        isSortByData = false,
        excludedFieldsOnSearch = [],
        maxSearchDepth = 4,
        hasAsyncData = false,
        onFilterChange,
        totalCount,
        debounceTime = 300,
        totalFilteredCount,
        dataTrackAction,
        "data-testid": dataTestId
    } = props;
    {
        return (
            <FilterGroupContextProvider
                sortGroups={sortGroups}
                filterGroups={filterGroups}
                data={data}
                hasSort={hasSort}
                hasSearch={hasSearch}
                defaultSortGroup={defaultSortGroup}
                defaultSortByDesc={defaultSortByDesc}
                displayTokens={displayTokens}
                onChangeData={onChangeData}
                sortByData={sortByData}
                isSortByData={isSortByData}
                excludedFieldsOnSearch={excludedFieldsOnSearch}
                maxSearchDepth={maxSearchDepth}
                hasAsyncData={hasAsyncData}
                onFilterChange={onFilterChange}
                debounceTime={debounceTime}
                dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction}
            >
                <FilterGroupPanel
                    data-testid={dataTestId}
                    hasResultCount={hasResultCount}
                    hasSearch={hasSearch}
                    hasSort={hasSort}
                    displayTokens={displayTokens}
                    data={data}
                    isSortByData={isSortByData}
                    totalCount={totalCount}
                    totalFilteredCount={totalFilteredCount}
                />
            </FilterGroupContextProvider>
        );
    }
};

export default FilterGroup;
````

````typescript
import React, { useState, useCallback, useMemo, useEffect } from "react";
import ContentGrid from "@atoms/ContentGrid/ContentGrid";
import { StyledFilterGroupBox, StyledMultiSelect, StyledSelect } from "./FilterGroup.styles";
import FilterGroupColumnsGenerator from "./FilterGroupColumnsGenerator";

type Option = {
    key?: string;
    label: string;
    value: string;
};

type FilterGroupColumnProps = {
    dataTestId?: string;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    filterGroup: string;
    hasOptions: boolean;
    hasSort?: boolean;
    id: string;
    isMultiselect?: boolean;
    onChange?: (
        selectedItem: Option | Option[] | null | undefined,
        filterGroup: string,
        isMultiselect: boolean,
        id: string,
        placeholder: string | undefined,
        setValue: (value: unknown) => void,
        getOptionsValues?: (value: unknown) => unknown
    ) => void;
    options: unknown[];
    placeholder?: string;
};

type FilterGroupSelectProps = {
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    filterGroup: string;
    id: string;
    isMultiselect: boolean;
    onChange?: (
        selectedItem: Option | null | undefined,
        filterGroup: string,
        isMultiselect: boolean,
        id: string,
        placeholder: string | undefined,
        setValue: (value: unknown) => void
    ) => void;
    options: Option[];
    placeholder?: string;
};

type FilterGroupMultiSelectProps = {
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    filterGroup: string;
    id: string;
    isMultiselect: boolean;
    onChange?: (
        selectedItems: Option[] | null | undefined,
        filterGroup: string,
        isMultiselect: boolean,
        id: string,
        placeholder: string | undefined,
        setValue: (value: unknown) => void,
        getOptionsValues?: (value: unknown) => unknown
    ) => void;
    options: Option[];
    placeholder?: string;
};

const FilterGroupColumn: React.FC<FilterGroupColumnProps> = ({
    id,
    placeholder,
    filterGroup,
    hasOptions,
    options,
    onChange,
    hasSort = false,
    isMultiselect = false,
    dataTestId,
    dataTrackAction
}) => {
    const { getSortableFilterGroup, getFilterGroupsOptions } = FilterGroupColumnsGenerator(
        options as any,
        filterGroup,
        hasOptions
    );

    const optionLabels = useMemo(() => {
        if (hasSort) {
            return getSortableFilterGroup();
        } else {
            return getFilterGroupsOptions();
        }
    }, [getFilterGroupsOptions, getSortableFilterGroup, hasSort]);

    const filteredOptions = useMemo(() => {
        return optionLabels.reduce((acc: Option[], current: Option) => {
            const x = acc.find(item => item.value === current.value);
            if (!x) {
                return acc.concat([current]);
            } else {
                return acc;
            }
        }, []);
    }, [optionLabels]);

    return (
        <div data-testid={dataTestId}>
            <ContentGrid columnSize={2}>
                <StyledFilterGroupBox>
                    {isMultiselect ? (
                        <FilterGroupMultiSelect
                            id={id}
                            options={filteredOptions}
                            placeholder={placeholder}
                            filterGroup={filterGroup}
                            onChange={onChange}
                            isMultiselect
                            dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction}
                        />
                    ) : (
                        <FilterGroupSelect
                            id={id}
                            options={filteredOptions}
                            placeholder={hasSort ? "Sort By" : placeholder}
                            filterGroup={hasSort ? "Sort By" : filterGroup}
                            onChange={onChange}
                            isMultiselect={false}
                            dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction}
                        />
                    )}
                </StyledFilterGroupBox>
            </ContentGrid>
        </div>
    );
};

const FilterGroupSelect: React.FC<FilterGroupSelectProps> = ({
    id,
    options,
    placeholder,
    filterGroup,
    onChange,
    isMultiselect,
    dataTrackAction
}) => {
    const [value, setValue] = useState<Option | null>(null);

    const handleOnChange = useCallback(
        (selectedItem: Option | string | null | undefined) => {
            // Only accept valid options from the list, not arbitrary text input
            // Check if selectedItem is a valid option by seeing if it exists in options array
            if (!selectedItem) {
                // Allow clearing/resetting
                onChange &&
                    onChange(
                        selectedItem as Option | null | undefined,
                        filterGroup,
                        isMultiselect,
                        id,
                        placeholder,
                        (val: unknown) => setValue(val as Option | null)
                    );
                setValue(null);
                return;
            }

            // If it's a string (typed text), try to find exact match
            if (typeof selectedItem === "string") {
                const matchedOption = options.find(opt => opt.label.toLowerCase() === selectedItem.toLowerCase());
                if (matchedOption) {
                    onChange &&
                        onChange(matchedOption, filterGroup, isMultiselect, id, placeholder, (val: unknown) =>
                            setValue(val as Option | null)
                        );
                    setValue(matchedOption);
                }
                // If no match, don't update - effectively ignoring partial input
                return;
            }

            // If it's an object, verify it's in our options list
            const isValidOption = options.some(
                opt => opt.value === selectedItem.value && opt.label === selectedItem.label
            );

            if (isValidOption) {
                onChange &&
                    onChange(selectedItem, filterGroup, isMultiselect, id, placeholder, (val: unknown) =>
                        setValue(val as Option | null)
                    );
                setValue(selectedItem);
            }
            // If not valid, ignore it
        },
        [onChange, filterGroup, isMultiselect, id, placeholder, options]
    );
    return (
        <StyledSelect
            options={options}
            value={(options.find(option => option.value === value?.value) ?? null) as any}
            placeholder={placeholder}
            onChange={handleOnChange as any}
            _isInFilterGroup
            allowCustomInput
            autoHighlight
            data-testid={placeholder === "Sort By" ? "filtergroup-sort-select" : "filtergroup-select-test"}
            dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction}
        />
    );
};

const FilterGroupMultiSelect: React.FC<FilterGroupMultiSelectProps> = ({
    id,
    options,
    placeholder,
    filterGroup,
    onChange,
    isMultiselect,
    dataTrackAction
}) => {
    const [selectedValues, setSelectedValues] = useState<Option[]>([]);

    useEffect(() => {}, [selectedValues]);

    const getOptionsValues = useMemo(() => {
        const opts = selectedValues;
        return opts;
    }, [selectedValues]);

    const onMultiSelectChange = useCallback(
        (values: Option[] | string[] | null | undefined) => {
            // Filter out any invalid values (text that doesn't match valid options)
            const validValues = Array.isArray(values)
                ? values.filter((val: Option | string) => {
                      // If it's a string, check for exact match
                      if (typeof val === "string") {
                          return options.some(opt => opt.label.toLowerCase() === val.toLowerCase());
                      }
                      // If it's an object, verify it exists in options
                      return options.some(opt => opt.value === val.value && opt.label === val.label);
                  })
                : values;

            onChange &&
                onChange(
                    validValues as Option[],
                    filterGroup,
                    isMultiselect,
                    id,
                    placeholder,
                    (val: unknown) => setSelectedValues(val as Option[]),
                    getOptionsValues as any
                );
            setSelectedValues(validValues as Option[]);
        },
        [onChange, filterGroup, getOptionsValues, id, isMultiselect, placeholder, options]
    );
    return (
        <StyledMultiSelect
            options={options as any}
            value={selectedValues as any}
            placeholder={placeholder}
            data-testid="filtergroup-multiselect-test"
            onChange={onMultiSelectChange as any}
            withCheckboxes
            _isInFilterGroup
            isFullWidth
            dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction}
        />
    );
};

export default FilterGroupColumn;
````

## File: src/components/organisms/FilterGroup/FilterGroupColumnsGenerator.tsx
````typescript
import { useCallback } from "react";
import { DATATYPES } from "./FilterGroupConstants";
import { getValueByPath } from "./FilterGroupHelpers";

type SortLabel = {
    label: string;
    value: string;
};

type GeneratedOption = {
    key: string;
    label: string;
    value: string;
};

type FilterGroupOption = {
    dataType?: string;
    filterGroup?: string;
    isSortable?: boolean;
    label?: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    value?: unknown;
};

type HasLabelValue = {
    label?: unknown;
    value?: unknown;
};

type HasText = {
    text: string;
};

const getSortLabels = (option: FilterGroupOption, sortAsc: string, sortDesc: string): SortLabel[] => {
    const labels: SortLabel[] = [];
    labels.push({
        label: (option.placeholder || "") + sortAsc,
        value: (option.filterGroup || "") + "_asc"
    });
    labels.push({
        label: (option.placeholder || "") + sortDesc,
        value: (option.filterGroup || "") + "_desc"
    });
    return labels;
};

const generateOption = (hasOptions: boolean, filterGroup: string, option: unknown, index: number): GeneratedOption => {
    const hasLabelValue = option as HasLabelValue;
    const optionLabel = hasOptions ? hasLabelValue.label : option;
    const optionValue = hasOptions ? hasLabelValue.value : option;
    return {
        key: filterGroup + "_" + index,
        label: optionLabel?.toString() ?? "-",
        value: optionValue?.toString() ?? "-"
    };
};

const getOptionText = (option: unknown): string | string[] | undefined => {
    if (Array.isArray(option)) {
        return option
            .filter((f: unknown) => {
                return typeof f === "object" && f !== null && "text" in f;
            })
            .map((item: unknown) => (item as HasText).text);
    } else {
        const hasText = option as HasText;
        return typeof option === "object" && option !== null && "text" in option ? hasText.text : undefined;
    }
};

const addItemsToArray = (items: unknown, optionArray: unknown[]) => {
    if (Array.isArray(items)) {
        for (const i of items) {
            optionArray.push(i);
        }
    } else {
        optionArray.push(items);
    }
};

const FilterGroupColumnsGenerator = (
    options: FilterGroupOption[] | Record<string, unknown>[],
    filterGroup: string,
    hasOptions: boolean
) => {
    const getSortableFilterGroup = useCallback(() => {
        const labels: SortLabel[] = [];
        const sortableOptions = (options as FilterGroupOption[]).filter(option => option.isSortable);
        for (const option of sortableOptions) {
            switch (option.dataType) {
                case "string": {
                    labels.push(...getSortLabels(option, DATATYPES.STRING_ASC, DATATYPES.STRING_DESC));
                    break;
                }
                case "numeric": {
                    labels.push(...getSortLabels(option, DATATYPES.NUMERIC_ASC, DATATYPES.NUMERIC_DESC));
                    break;
                }
                case "date": {
                    labels.push(...getSortLabels(option, DATATYPES.DATE_ASC, DATATYPES.DATE_DESC));
                    break;
                }
                default:
                    labels.push(...getSortLabels(option, DATATYPES.STRING_ASC, DATATYPES.STRING_DESC));
                    break;
            }
        }
        return labels;
    }, [options]);

    const getFilterGroupsOptions = useCallback(() => {
        if (hasOptions) {
            return (options as FilterGroupOption[]).map((option, index) => {
                return generateOption(true, filterGroup, option, index);
            });
        } else {
            const optionsByFilterGroup = (options as Record<string, unknown>[]).map(item =>
                getValueByPath(item, filterGroup)
            );

            const optionArray: unknown[] = [];
            for (const option of optionsByFilterGroup) {
                if (typeof option === "object") {
                    const items = getOptionText(option);
                    addItemsToArray(items, optionArray);
                } else {
                    optionArray.push(option);
                }
            }

            const uniqueItems = Array.from(new Set(optionArray));

            return uniqueItems.map((option, index) => {
                return generateOption(false, filterGroup, option, index);
            });
        }
    }, [filterGroup, hasOptions, options]);

    return {
        getFilterGroupsOptions,
        getSortableFilterGroup
    };
};

export default FilterGroupColumnsGenerator;
````

````typescript
export const DEFAULT_DATA = [
````

````typescript
export type FilterGroupContextProviderProps = InitialStateParams & {

const initialState = ({
    data,
    sortGroups,
    filterGroups,
    hasSort,
    hasSearch,
    defaultSortGroup,
    defaultSortByDesc,
    displayTokens,
    onChangeData,
    isSortByData,
    sortByData,
    excludedFieldsOnSearch,
    maxSearchDepth,
    hasAsyncData,
    onFilterChange,
    debounceTime,
    dataTrackAction
}: InitialStateParams): FilterGroupState => {
    return {
        data: data,
        dataTrackAction,
        debounceTime,
        defaultSortByDesc: defaultSortByDesc,
        defaultSortGroup: getDefaultSortGroup(
            defaultSortGroup,
            sortGroups?.defaultSortGroup,
            isSortByData,
            sortByData?.[0]?.filterGroup,
            filterGroups[0]?.filterGroup
        ) as string | undefined,
        displayTokens: displayTokens,
        excludedFieldsOnSearch: excludedFieldsOnSearch,
        filterGroups: filterGroups as FilterGroupItemExternal[],
        filterGroupTypes: filterGroupTypes(filterGroups),
        hasAsyncData,
        hasSearch: hasSearch,
        hasSort: hasSort,
        maxSearchDepth: maxSearchDepth && maxSearchDepth < 6 ? maxSearchDepth : 5,
        onChangeData,
        onFilterChange,
        optionsByGroup: [],
        searchTerm: null,
        selectedFilters: [],
        sortByData: filterGroupTypes(sortByData),
        sortGroups: hasSort ? sortGroups || {} : {},
        tokens: []
    };
};

const getDefaultSortGroup = (
    defaultSortGroup?: string,
    defaultBySortGroups?: unknown,
    isSortByData?: boolean,
    firstBySortData?: unknown,
    firstByFilterGroup?: unknown
) => {
    return defaultSortGroup || defaultBySortGroups || (isSortByData ? firstBySortData : firstByFilterGroup);
};

const filterGroupTypes = (filterGroups?: Record<string, unknown>[]): FilterGroupItemInternal[] => {
    if (!filterGroups) return [];
    const groups: FilterGroupItemInternal[] = [];
    for (const filter of filterGroups) {
        if (filter && filter.filterGroup !== "") {
            groups.push({
                dataType: filter.sortDataType as string,
                filterGroup: filter.filterGroup as string,
                id: filter.id as string,
                isMultiSelect: filter.isMultiselect as boolean,
                isSortable: filter.isSortable as boolean,
                placeholder: filter.placeholder as string
            });
        }
    }
    return groups;
};

const reducer: React.Reducer<FilterGroupState, FilterGroupAction> = (state, action) => {
    switch (action.type) {
        case ADD_FILTER: {
            const selectedFilters = [
                ...state.selectedFilters,
                { id: action.id, filterName: action.filterName, filterGroup: action.filterGroup }
            ];
            return { ...state, selectedFilters };
        }
        case REMOVE_FILTER: {
            const selectedFilters = state.selectedFilters.filter(
                currentFilter =>
                    !(
                        currentFilter.filterName === action.filterName &&
                        currentFilter.filterGroup === action.filterGroup
                    )
            );
            return { ...state, selectedFilters };
        }
        case REMOVE_FILTER_GROUP: {
            const selectedFilters = state.selectedFilters.filter(f => !(f.filterGroup === action.filterGroup));
            return { ...state, selectedFilters };
        }
        case ADD_TOKEN: {
            const tokens = [
                ...state.tokens,
                {
                    id: action.id,
                    label: action.label,
                    value: action.value,
                    filterGroup: action.filterGroup,
                    placeholder: action.placeholder,
                    isMultiselect: action.isMultiselect,
                    onTokenDelete: (value: unknown) => {
                        action.setValue(value);
                    },
                    getOptionsValues: action.getOptionsValues
                }
            ];
            return { ...state, tokens };
        }
        case REMOVE_TOKEN: {
            const tokens = state.tokens.filter(
                f => !(f.id === action.id && f.value === action.value && f.filterGroup === action.filterGroup)
            );
            return { ...state, tokens };
        }
        case REMOVE_TOKEN_GROUP: {
            const tokens = state.tokens.filter(f => !(f.id === action.id && f.filterGroup === action.filterGroup));
            return { ...state, tokens };
        }
        case ADD_OPTIONS_GROUP: {
            const optionsByGroup = [
                ...state.optionsByGroup,
                { id: action.id, label: action.label, value: action.value, filterGroup: action.filterGroup }
            ];
            return { ...state, optionsByGroup };
        }
        case REMOVE_OPTIONS_GROUP: {
            const optionsByGroup = state.optionsByGroup.filter(
                f => !(f.id === action.id && f.value === action.value && f.filterGroup === action.filterGroup)
            );
            return { ...state, optionsByGroup };
        }
        case REMOVE_ALL_OPTIONS_GROUP: {
            const optionsByGroup = state.optionsByGroup.filter(
                f => !(f.id === action.id && f.filterGroup === action.filterGroup)
            );
            return { ...state, optionsByGroup };
        }
        case ADD_SEARCH: {
            const searchTerm = action.searchTerm;
            return { ...state, searchTerm };
        }
        default:
            return state;
    }
};
export const FilterGroupContextProvider = ({
    data,
    sortGroups,
    filterGroups,
    hasSort,
    hasSearch,
    defaultSortGroup,
    defaultSortByDesc,
    displayTokens,
    onChangeData,
    isSortByData,
    sortByData,
    excludedFieldsOnSearch,
    maxSearchDepth,
    hasAsyncData,
    onFilterChange,
    debounceTime,
    dataTrackAction,
    children
}: FilterGroupContextProviderProps) => {
    const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(
        reducer,
        initialState({
            data,
            sortGroups,
            filterGroups,
            hasSort,
            hasSearch,
            defaultSortGroup,
            defaultSortByDesc,
            displayTokens,
            onChangeData,
            isSortByData,
            sortByData,
            excludedFieldsOnSearch,
            maxSearchDepth,
            hasAsyncData,
            onFilterChange,
            debounceTime,
            dataTrackAction
        })
    );

    const addFilter = useCallback(
        (id: string, filterName: string, filterGroup: string) => {
            dispatch({ type: ACTIONS.ADD_FILTER, id, filterName, filterGroup });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );

    const removeFilter = useCallback(
        (filterName: string, filterGroup: string) => {
            dispatch({ type: ACTIONS.REMOVE_FILTER, filterName, filterGroup });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );

    const removeFilterByGroup = useCallback(
        (id: string, filterGroup: string) => {
            dispatch({ type: ACTIONS.REMOVE_FILTER_GROUP, id, filterGroup });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );

    const addToken = useCallback(
        (
            id: string,
            label: string,
            value: unknown,
            filterGroup: string,
            placeholder?: string,
            isMultiselect?: boolean,
            setValue?: (value: unknown) => void,
            getOptionsValues?: (value: unknown) => unknown
        ) => {
            dispatch({
                type: ACTIONS.ADD_TOKEN,
                id,
                label,
                value,
                filterGroup,
                placeholder,
                isMultiselect,
                setValue: setValue || (() => {}),
                getOptionsValues
            });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );

    const removeToken = useCallback(
        (id: string, value: unknown, filterGroup: string) => {
            dispatch({ type: ACTIONS.REMOVE_TOKEN, id, value, filterGroup });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );

    const removeTokenByGroup = useCallback(
        (id: string, filterGroup: string) => {
            dispatch({ type: ACTIONS.REMOVE_TOKEN_GROUP, id, filterGroup });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );

    const addOptionByGroup = useCallback(
        (id: string, label: string, value: unknown, filterGroup: string) => {
            dispatch({ type: ACTIONS.ADD_OPTIONS_GROUP, id, label, value, filterGroup });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );
    const removeOptionByGroup = useCallback(
        (id: string, value: unknown, filterGroup: string) => {
            dispatch({ type: ACTIONS.REMOVE_OPTIONS_GROUP, id, value, filterGroup });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );
    const removeAllOptionByGroup = useCallback(
        (id: string, filterGroup: string) => {
            dispatch({ type: ACTIONS.REMOVE_ALL_OPTIONS_GROUP, id, filterGroup });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );
    const addSearchTerm = useCallback(
        (searchTerm: string) => {
            dispatch({ type: ACTIONS.ADD_SEARCH, searchTerm });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );

    const values = useMemo((): FilterGroupContextValue => {
        return {
            ...state,
            addFilter,
            addOptionByGroup,
            addSearchTerm,
            addToken,
            dispatch,
            removeAllOptionByGroup,
            removeFilter,
            removeFilterByGroup,
            removeOptionByGroup,
            removeToken,
            removeTokenByGroup
        };
    }, [
        state,
        addFilter,
        removeFilter,
        removeFilterByGroup,
        addToken,
        removeToken,
        removeTokenByGroup,
        addOptionByGroup,
        removeOptionByGroup,
        removeAllOptionByGroup,
        addSearchTerm
    ]);

    return <FilterGroupContext.Provider value={values}>{children}</FilterGroupContext.Provider>;
};

const useFilterGroup = () => {
    const context = useContext(FilterGroupContext);
    if (!context) {
        throw new Error("useFilterGroup must be used within FilterGroupContextProvider");
    }
    return context;
};

export default useFilterGroup;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { StyledTokenChip } from "./FilterGroup.styles";
import { DEFAULT_PLURAL_RESULT_COUNT_LABEL, DEFAULT_SINGULAR_RESULT_COUNT_LABEL } from "./FilterGroupConstants";
import { StyledIcon } from "@molecules/MultiSelect/MultiSelect.styles";

type LabelItem = {
    text: string;
};

type SelectedFilter = {
    filterGroup: string;
    filterName: string;
    id: string;
};

type FilterGroupType = {
    filterGroup?: string;
};

type SelectedItem = {
    label: string;
    value: unknown;
};

type Token = {
    filterGroup: string;
    getOptionsValues?: (value: unknown) => unknown;
    id: string;
    label: string;
    placeholder?: string;
    value: unknown;
};

const handleFilteredItemsByText = (itemFilterGroup: unknown, filterName: string) => {
    if (Array.isArray(itemFilterGroup)) {
        return itemFilterGroup.some((label: LabelItem) => {
            return label.text === filterName;
        });
    } else {
        return (itemFilterGroup as LabelItem).text === filterName;
    }
};

const handleFilteredItem = (item: Record<string, unknown>, filterGroup: string, filterName: string) => {
    const itemFilterGroup = getValueByPath(item, filterGroup) ?? "-";
    if (typeof itemFilterGroup === "object") {
        return handleFilteredItemsByText(itemFilterGroup, filterName);
    } else {
        return itemFilterGroup?.toString() === filterName;
    }
};

const isShownByFilterGroupName = (
    item: Record<string, unknown>,
    filterGroup: string,
    arrayFilters: SelectedFilter[]
) => {
    const selectedFiltersByGroup = arrayFilters.filter(item => item.filterGroup === filterGroup);
    if (!selectedFiltersByGroup.length) return true;
    return selectedFiltersByGroup.some(filter => handleFilteredItem(item, filterGroup, filter.filterName));
};

const getSortByOrder = (a: unknown, b: unknown, sortOrderMod: number) => {
    return (a as any) > (b as any) ? 1 * sortOrderMod : -1 * sortOrderMod;
};

const renderDeleteIcon = <StyledIcon data-testid="filtergroup-delete-icon" className="far fa-times" />;

export const addFilterToken = (
    selectedItem: SelectedItem,
    id: string,
    filterGroup: string,
    placeholder: string | undefined,
    setValue: (value: unknown) => void,
    getOptionsValues: ((value: unknown) => unknown) | undefined,
    isMultiselect: boolean | undefined,
    addToken: (
        id: string,
        label: string,
        value: unknown,
        filterGroup: string,
        placeholder?: string,
        isMultiselect?: boolean,
        setValue?: (value: unknown) => void,
        getOptionsValues?: (value: unknown) => unknown
    ) => void
) => {
    const label = selectedItem.label;
    const value = selectedItem.value;
    addToken(id, label, value, filterGroup, placeholder, isMultiselect, setValue, getOptionsValues);
};

export const getFilteredData = (
    data: Record<string, unknown>[],
    filterGroupTypes: FilterGroupType[],
    arrayFilters: SelectedFilter[],
    hasSort: boolean | undefined,
    searchValue: string | null,
    sortByFilteredData: (arrayFilters: SelectedFilter[], filteredData: Record<string, unknown>[]) => void,
    searchByFilteredData: (searchValue: string, filteredData: Record<string, unknown>[]) => Record<string, unknown>[]
) => {
    const filteredData = data.filter(item => {
        const groups: boolean[] = [];
        for (const filter of filterGroupTypes) {
            groups.push(isShownByFilterGroupName(item, filter?.filterGroup || "", arrayFilters));
        }
        return groups.every(filter => filter);
    });

    if (hasSort) {
        sortByFilteredData(arrayFilters, filteredData);
    }

    if (searchValue?.length) {
        return searchByFilteredData(searchValue, filteredData);
    }
    return filteredData;
};

export const sortFilterExists = (arrayFilters: SelectedFilter[]) => {
    return arrayFilters.find(f => f.id === "0") !== undefined;
};

export const getSortByFilteredData = (arrayFilters: SelectedFilter[], filteredData: Record<string, unknown>[]) => {
    const sortSelected = arrayFilters.filter(item => item.id === "0");
    const sortItems = sortSelected[0].filterName.split("_");
    const sortLabel = sortItems[0];
    const sortOrder = sortItems[1];
    filteredData.sort((a, b) => {
        const sortOrderMod = sortOrder === "asc" ? 1 : -1;
        const aValue = getValueByPath(a, sortLabel);
        const bValue = getValueByPath(b, sortLabel);
        return aValue === bValue ? 0 : getSortByOrder(aValue, bValue, sortOrderMod);
    });
};

export const getSortByDefault = (
    filteredData: Record<string, unknown>[],
    defaultSortGroup: string | undefined,
    defaultSortByDesc: boolean | undefined
) => {
    filteredData.sort((a, b) => {
        const sortOrderMod = defaultSortByDesc ? -1 : 1;
        const aValue = getValueByPath(a, defaultSortGroup || "");
        const bValue = getValueByPath(b, defaultSortGroup || "");
        return aValue === bValue ? 0 : getSortByOrder(aValue, bValue, sortOrderMod);
    });
};

export const getFilterGroupResultsLabel = (filteredDataCount: number, dataCount: number) => {
    const resultCountPluralization =
        filteredDataCount === 1 ? DEFAULT_SINGULAR_RESULT_COUNT_LABEL : DEFAULT_PLURAL_RESULT_COUNT_LABEL;
    const filteredResultCount = `${filteredDataCount} of ${dataCount} results`;
    const unfilteredResultCount = `${dataCount} ${resultCountPluralization}`;
    return filteredDataCount === dataCount ? unfilteredResultCount : filteredResultCount;
};

export const renderTokens = (token: Token, handleDelete: (token: Token) => void, dataTestId?: string) => (
    <StyledTokenChip
        key={token.label}
        label={`${token.placeholder}: ${token.label}`}
        deleteIcon={renderDeleteIcon}
        onDelete={() => handleDelete(token)}
        data-testid={dataTestId}
    />
);

export const getValueByPath = (obj: Record<string, unknown>, path: string) => {
    return path?.split(".").reduce((acc, part) => acc && (acc as Record<string, unknown>)[part], obj as unknown);
};
````

````typescript
const FilterGroupPanel: React.FC<FilterGroupPanelProps> = ({

    const {

        filterGroupTypes,

        searchTerm,

        removeFilter,

        hasAsyncData,
        onFilterChange,
        debounceTime
    } = useFilterGroup();
    const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);
    const [filteredDataCount, setFilteredDataCount] = useState(0);
    const { applyFilters, removeSelectedGroup, addSelectedFilter, maxFilterGroups } = FilterGroupUtils(data, hasSort);
    const isExceedingMax = useMemo(() => filterGroups.length > maxFilterGroups, [filterGroups.length, maxFilterGroups]);
    const hasFilterGroups = useMemo(() => filterGroups.length > 0, [filterGroups.length]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (hasAsyncData) return;
    }, [data, hasAsyncData]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (hasAsyncData) return;

        let dataFiltered: Record<string, unknown>[] = [];
        dataFiltered = applyFilters(selectedFilters, searchTerm);
        if (onChangeData) {
            onChangeData(dataFiltered);
            setFilteredDataCount(dataFiltered?.length);
        }
    }, [applyFilters, onChangeData, searchTerm, selectedFilters, data, hasAsyncData]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!hasAsyncData) return;

        const filters = { selectedFilters, searchTerm };
        onFilterChange && onFilterChange(filters as FilterChangeEvent);
        setFilteredDataCount(totalFilteredCount || 0);
    }, [onFilterChange, selectedFilters, searchTerm, totalFilteredCount, filterGroupTypes, hasAsyncData]);

    useEffect(() => {
        setVisible(selectedFilters.length > 0 ? true : false);
    }, [selectedFilters]);

    const handleSelect = useCallback(
        (
            selectedItem: SelectedItem | SelectedItem[] | null | undefined,
            filterGroup: string,
            isMultiselect: boolean,
            id: string,
            placeholder: string | undefined,
            setValue: (value: unknown) => void,
            getOptionsValues: ((value: unknown) => unknown) | undefined = undefined
        ) => {
            removeSelectedGroup(id, filterGroup, isMultiselect);

            if (isMultiselect && Array.isArray(selectedItem)) {
                for (const item of selectedItem) {
                    addSelectedFilter(item, id, filterGroup, placeholder, setValue, getOptionsValues, isMultiselect);
                }
            } else if (selectedItem && !Array.isArray(selectedItem)) {
                addSelectedFilter(
                    selectedItem,
                    id,
                    filterGroup,
                    placeholder,
                    setValue,
                    getOptionsValues,
                    isMultiselect
                );
            }
        },
        [addSelectedFilter, removeSelectedGroup]
    );

    // Debounce function to delay the search input when using async data
    // This is to prevent too many API calls when the user types quickly
    // The debounce time default is set to 300ms
    const debounceOnSearch = useMemo(
        () =>
            debounce((searchValue: string | null) => {
                addSearchTerm(searchValue || "");

            if (selectedItem.isMultiselect) {
                const currentOptionsByGroup = optionsByGroup.filter(
                    f => f.id === selectedItem.id && f.filterGroup === filterGroup && !(f.value === value)
                );
                removeFilter(String(value), filterGroup);
                removeToken(selectedItem.id, selectedItem.value, filterGroup);
                selectedItem.onTokenDelete(currentOptionsByGroup);
                removeOptionByGroup(selectedItem.id, selectedItem.value, filterGroup);
            } else {
                removeFilterByGroup(selectedItem.id, filterGroup);
                removeTokenByGroup(selectedItem.id, filterGroup);
                selectedItem.onTokenDelete({});

        },
        [optionsByGroup, removeFilter, removeFilterByGroup, removeOptionByGroup, removeToken, removeTokenByGroup]
    );

    }, [removeSelectedGroup, tokens]);

    const dataCount = useMemo(

        [data?.length, hasAsyncData, totalCount]
    );

    const resultCountLabel = useMemo(

        [dataCount, filteredDataCount]
    );

    const sortyByColumn: unknown[] = useMemo(
        () => (isSortByData ? sortByData : filterGroupTypes) as unknown[],
        [filterGroupTypes, isSortByData, sortByData]
    );

    return (
        <div>
            <StyledFlexContainer>
                <Grid container sx={{ width: "100%" }}>
                    <StyledFilterGroupsContainer $hasFilterGroups={hasFilterGroups} data-testid="filtergroup-dropdowns">
                        <StyledSection>
                            {hasResultCount && (
                                <>
                                    <StyledResultCountLabelSpan data-testid="result-count-label-span">
                                        {resultCountLabel}
                                    </StyledResultCountLabelSpan>
                                    {hasFilterGroups && (
                                        <StyledVerticalBarSpan
                                            data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-filter-group-vertical-bar`}
                                        />
                                    )}
                                </>
                            )}
                            {hasFilterGroups && (
                                <Grid
                                    container
                                    alignContent="flex-start"
                                    alignItems="flex-start"
                                    direction="row"
                                    justifyContent="flex-start"
                                    wrap="wrap"
                                    data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-filter-group-filter-by-label`}
                                >
                                    Filter by
                                </Grid>
                            )}
                        </StyledSection>
                        <StyledFilterGroupsSection data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-filter-group-section`}>
                            <Grid
                                container
                                alignContent="space-between"
                                alignItems="flex-start"
                                direction="row"
                                justifyContent="flex-start"
                                wrap="wrap"
                            >
                                {hasSort && (
                                    <FilterGroupColumn
                                        key="0"
                                        id="0"
                                        filterGroup={"Sort By"}
                                        hasOptions={false}
                                        options={sortyByColumn}
                                        onChange={handleSelect}
                                        hasSort={hasSort}
                                        dataTestId={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-sort-by`}
                                    />
                                )}
                                {filterGroups &&
                                    filterGroups
                                        .filter((f, index) => f.filterGroup && index < maxFilterGroups)
                                        .map(group => (
                                            <FilterGroupColumn
                                                key={group.id}
                                                id={group.id || ""}
                                                placeholder={group.placeholder}
                                                filterGroup={group.filterGroup}
                                                hasOptions={(group.options?.length ?? 0) > 0}
                                                options={
                                                    (group.options?.length ?? 0) > 0
                                                        ? ((group.options || []) as unknown[])
                                                        : data
                                                }
                                                onChange={handleSelect}
                                                isMultiselect={group.isMultiselect}
                                                dataTestId={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-${group.filterGroup}`}
                                                dataTrackAction={group.dataTrackAction}
                                            />
                                        ))}
                                <div>
                                    <ContentGrid columnSize={2}>
                                        {visible && (
                                            <StyledFilterGroupBox data-testid="filtergroup-reset-filters">
                                                <Button
                                                    id="resetButton"
                                                    data-testid="filtergroup-reset-filters-button"
                                                    type="borderless"
                                                    onClick={onResetFilters}
                                                >
                                                    Reset Filters
````
