````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { GridContainer, GridPanelWrapper, GridWrapper, StyledCard } from "../Grid.styles";
import { setCards, useGridDispatch, useGridState } from "../GridContext";
import TopBarPanel from "./TopBarPanel";
import FilterGroupPanel from "./FilterGroupPanel";
import PaginationPanel from "./PaginationPanel";
import useGrid from "../useGrid";
import ErrorPanel from "./ErrorPanel";
import { DEFAULT_CARD_COLUMNS, DEFAULT_GAP } from "../GridConstant";

export type GridPanelProps = {
    cards: unknown[];
    filterGroupProps: Record<string, unknown>;
    paginationProps: Record<string, unknown>;
    errorMessages: Record<string, unknown>;
    topBarOptions: Record<string, unknown>;
    topOffset: string;
    columns?: number;
    columnGap?: string;
};

const GridPanel: React.FC<GridPanelProps> = ({
    cards,
    filterGroupProps,
    paginationProps,
    errorMessages,
    topBarOptions,
    topOffset,
    columns,
    columnGap
}) => {
    const [topBarHeight, setTopBarHeight] = useState(0);
    const gridWrapperRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    const { accessorKey, hasPagination, hasTopBar, hasFilterGroup, cardWidth, dataTestId } = useGridState();
    const dispatch = useGridDispatch();
    const { cardList } = useGrid();

    const cardColumns = useMemo(() => {
        if (columns && typeof columns === "number" && columns > 2) {
            return columns;
        }
        return DEFAULT_CARD_COLUMNS;
    }, [columns]);

    const currentColumnGap = useMemo(() => {
        if (columnGap) {
            return columnGap;
        }
        return cardColumns === DEFAULT_CARD_COLUMNS ? DEFAULT_GAP.AUTO_FIT : DEFAULT_GAP.FIXED;
    }, [cardColumns, columnGap]);

    useEffect(() => {
        dispatch(setCards(cards));
    }, [dispatch, cards]);

    const handleOnClick = useCallback((event: React.MouseEvent, id: unknown, onClick?: unknown) => {
        onClick && (onClick as (event: React.MouseEvent, id: unknown) => void)(event, id);
    }, []);

    const hasFixedColumns = useMemo(() => {
        const fixedColumns = cardColumns && typeof cardColumns === "number" && cardColumns > 0;
        if (fixedColumns) {
            return true;
        }
        return false;
    }, [cardColumns]);

    return (
        <GridPanelWrapper
            $hasPagination={hasPagination}
            $hasTopPadding={hasTopBar || hasFilterGroup}
            data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-grid-panel-wrapper`}
        >
            {hasTopBar && (
                <TopBarPanel topBarOptions={topBarOptions} topOffset={topOffset} setTopBarHeight={setTopBarHeight} />
            )}
            <FilterGroupPanel filterGroupProps={filterGroupProps} topBarHeight={topBarHeight} />
            <GridContainer data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-grid-panel`}>
                <GridWrapper
                    ref={gridWrapperRef}
                    $columns={cardColumns}
                    $width={cardWidth}
                    $columnGap={currentColumnGap}
                    $hasFixedColumns={hasFixedColumns}
                    $hasFixedGap={columnGap !== undefined ? true : false}
                    data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-grid-wrapper`}
                >
                    {cardList.map((card, index) => {
                        const cardObj = card as Record<string, unknown>;
                        const id = cardObj[accessorKey] || index;
                        return (
                            <StyledCard
                                key={id as React.Key}
                                {...cardObj}
                                isSelected={cardObj.isSelected as boolean | undefined}
                                onClick={(event: React.MouseEvent) => handleOnClick(event, id, cardObj?.onClick)}
                                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-grid-card-${id}`}
                            />
                        );
                    })}
                </GridWrapper>
                <ErrorPanel errorMessages={errorMessages} />
            </GridContainer>

            {hasPagination && <PaginationPanel paginationProps={paginationProps} />}
        </GridPanelWrapper>
    );
};

export default GridPanel;
````

````typescript
import { PaginationPanelWrapper } from "../Grid.styles";
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import Pagination from "@molecules/Pagination/Pagination";
import { setItemsPerPage, setPageSelection, useGridDispatch, useGridState } from "../GridContext";

export type PaginationPanelProps = {
    paginationProps: Record<string, unknown>;
};

const PaginationPanel: React.FC<PaginationPanelProps> = ({ paginationProps }) => {
    const { filteredCards, dataTestId } = useGridState();
    const dispatch = useGridDispatch();

    const onPageChange = useCallback(
        (data: { pageIndex: string | number; pageSize: string | number }) => {
            const pageSelection = parseInt(String(data.pageIndex));
            const itemsPerPage =
                data.pageSize === "Show All" || data.pageSize === ""
                    ? filteredCards.length
                    : parseInt(String(data?.pageSize));
            if (itemsPerPage > 0) {
                dispatch(setItemsPerPage(itemsPerPage));
            }
            dispatch(setPageSelection(pageSelection));
        },
        [dispatch, filteredCards.length]
    );
    return (
        <PaginationPanelWrapper
            $displayBorders={filteredCards.length > 0}
            data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-list-pagination-panel-wrapper`}
        >
            <Pagination
                totalItems={filteredCards.length}
                onPaginationChange={onPageChange}
                itemsPerPage={paginationProps?.itemsPerPage as string | number | undefined}
                customItemsPerPage={paginationProps?.customItemsPerPage as any}
                pageSelection={paginationProps?.pageSelection as number | undefined}
                localizations={paginationProps?.localizations as Record<string, unknown> | undefined}
                data-testid={dataTestId}
            />
        </PaginationPanelWrapper>
    );
};

export default PaginationPanel;
````

````typescript
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { useGridState } from "./GridContext";
import { ACTION_TYPE } from "@components/molecules/Card/CardConstant";

const handleOnClick = (event: React.MouseEvent, id: unknown, item: Record<string, unknown>, action: unknown) => {
    item?.onClick &&
        (item.onClick as (arg: { id: unknown; action: unknown }, event: React.MouseEvent) => void)(
            { id, action },
            event
        );
};

const handleOnChange = (value: unknown, id: unknown, onChange: unknown, actions: unknown) => {
    onChange && (onChange as (value: unknown, arg: { id: unknown; actions: unknown }) => void)(value, { id, actions });
};

const handlePropsOnClickOrOnChange = (right: Record<string, unknown>, id: unknown) => {
    const { type, props } = right;
    if (Array.isArray(props)) {
        return props.map(prop => {
            return {
                ...prop,
                onClick: (event: React.MouseEvent, action: unknown) => handleOnClick(event, id, prop, action)
            };
        });
    } else {
        if (type === ACTION_TYPE.ACTION_MENU_BUTTON) {
            const actionList = (props as Record<string, unknown>)?.actionList;
            const mappedActionList = Array.isArray(actionList)
                ? actionList.map(item => {
                      return {
                          ...item,
                          onClick: (event: React.MouseEvent, action: unknown) =>
                              handleOnClick(event, id, item as Record<string, unknown>, action)
                      };
                  })
                : undefined;
            return {
                ...(props as Record<string, unknown>),
                actionList: mappedActionList
            };
        } else if (type === ACTION_TYPE.SWITCH) {
            return {
                ...(props as Record<string, unknown>),
                onChange: (value: unknown, event: unknown, actions: unknown) =>
                    handleOnChange(value, id, (props as Record<string, unknown>)?.onChange, actions)
            };
        } else {
            return {
                ...(props as Record<string, unknown>)
            };
        }
    }
};

const useGrid = () => {
    const { currentCards, accessorKey } = useGridState();

    const cardList = useMemo(() => {
        return currentCards.map((card, index) => {
            const cardObj = card as Record<string, unknown>;
            const id = cardObj[accessorKey] || index;
            const footer = cardObj?.footer as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
            const right = footer?.right as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;
            const rightProps = right?.props as Record<string, unknown> | undefined;

            return {
                key: id,
                id: cardObj.id,
                disabled: cardObj?.disabled,
                hasError: cardObj?.hasError,
                media: cardObj?.media,
                content: cardObj?.content,
                hasCardMediaFooter: cardObj?.hasCardMediaFooter,
                hasSubtitleTopPlacement: cardObj?.hasSubtitleTopPlacement,
                children: cardObj?.children,
                isInteractive: cardObj?.isInteractive,
                onClick: cardObj?.onClick,
                isSelected: cardObj?.isSelected,
                width: cardObj?.width,
                height: cardObj?.height,
                "data-testid": cardObj?.["data-testid"],
                footer: {
                    ...footer,
                    right: {
                        ...right,
                        props:
                            rightProps != undefined && right && Object.values(rightProps).length > 0
                                ? handlePropsOnClickOrOnChange(right, id)
                                : undefined
                    }
                }
            };
        });
    }, [accessorKey, currentCards]);
    return { cardList };
};

export default useGrid;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import {
    LineChart,
    Line,
    XAxis,
    YAxis,
    CartesianGrid,
    Tooltip,
    ResponsiveContainer,
    ReferenceArea,
    Brush,
    ReferenceLine
} from "recharts";
import { CustomTooltip as CustomToolTip } from "@components/shared/Recharts/CustomTooltip";
import type {
    DataKeys,
    DataKey,
    AccessoryOptions,
    ContainerDimensions,
    LegendOptions,
    XAxisOptions,
    YAxisOptions,
    TooltipOptions,
    PopUpOptions
} from "@components/shared/Recharts/PropTypes";
import withAccessories from "@components/shared/Recharts/withAccessories";
import { useBrush } from "@components/shared/Recharts/useBrush";
import { getTickFormatter } from "@components/shared/Recharts/tickFormatters";

type RechartsState = {
    activeMap: Map<string | number, boolean>;
    stateData: Record<string, unknown>[];
    left?: number;
    right?: number;
    refAreaLeft?: number;
    refAreaRight?: number;
    bottom?: number;
    top?: number;
    hasNegativeValue?: boolean;
};

type HocProps = {
    state: RechartsState;
    palette: string[];
    zoom: () => void;
    updateRefAreaLeft: (e?: { activeLabel?: number }) => void;
    updateRefAreaRight: (e?: { activeLabel?: number }) => void;
};

export type LineGraphProps = {
    data: Record<string, unknown>[];
    dataKeys?: DataKeys;
    type?: "default" | "secondary" | "dualHeat" | "heat";
    isSimple?: boolean;
    hasNegativeValue?: boolean;
    dateFormat?: boolean;
    referenceLines?: Record<string, unknown>[];
    header?: string;
    subHeader?: string;
    yAxisLabel?: string;
    xAxisLabel?: string;
    accessoryOptions?: AccessoryOptions;
    containerDimensions?: ContainerDimensions;
    legendOptions?: LegendOptions;
    xAxisOptions?: XAxisOptions;
    yAxisOptions?: YAxisOptions;
    tooltipOptions?: TooltipOptions;
    popUpOptions?: PopUpOptions;
    enableGrid?: boolean;
    syncId?: string;
    layout?: "horizontal" | "vertical";
    width?: number;
    height?: number;
    margin?: Record<string, unknown>;
    customPalette?: string[];
    hocProps?: HocProps;
};

type BaseLineGraphProps = LineGraphProps & {
    state: RechartsState;
    palette: string[];
    zoom: () => void;
    updateRefAreaLeft: (e?: { activeLabel?: number }) => void;
    updateRefAreaRight: (e?: { activeLabel?: number }) => void;
};

const LineGraph = ({ hocProps, ...props }: LineGraphProps & { hocProps: HocProps }) => {
    const { state, palette, zoom, updateRefAreaLeft, updateRefAreaRight } = hocProps;

    return (
        <BaseLineGraph
            state={state}
            palette={palette}
            zoom={zoom}
            updateRefAreaLeft={updateRefAreaLeft}
            updateRefAreaRight={updateRefAreaRight}
            {...props}
        />
    );
};

const renderLines = (dataKeys: DataKeys, activeMap: Map<string | number, boolean>, palette: string[]) =>
    dataKeys.map((props, index) => {
        if (activeMap.get(props?.dataKey as string | number)) {
            return (
                <Line
                    key={/* istanbul ignore next */ (props?.dataKey as string | number) ?? index}
                    type={(props?.types ?? "monotone") as any}
                    stroke={props?.stroke ?? palette[index]}
                    dot={props?.dot ?? false}
                    name={props?.displayName}
                    {...(props as any)}
                />
            );
        }
    });

const getXAxisDomain = (hasZoom?: boolean, left?: number, right?: number): [string | number, string | number] =>
    hasZoom ? [left!, right!] : ["auto", "auto"];

const getYAxisDomain = (hasZoom?: boolean, bottom?: number, top?: number, hasNegativeValue?: boolean) =>
    /* istanbul ignore next */ hasZoom ? [bottom!, top!] : [hasNegativeValue ? "dataMin" : 0, "auto"];

export const BaseLineGraph: React.FC<BaseLineGraphProps> = props => {
    const {
        state,
        dataKeys = [],
        palette,
        dateFormat,
        referenceLines = [],
        xAxisOptions = {},
        yAxisOptions = {},
        tooltipOptions = {},
        accessoryOptions = {},
        syncId,
        layout,
        width,
        height,
        margin = {},
        enableGrid,
        updateRefAreaLeft,
        updateRefAreaRight,
        zoom
    } = props;

    const { stateData, activeMap, left, right, refAreaLeft, refAreaRight, bottom, top, hasNegativeValue } = state;
    const { hasZoom, hasBrush, hideToolTip } = accessoryOptions;
    const xAxisKey = xAxisOptions.dataKey ?? "name";
    const tickFormatter = getTickFormatter(xAxisOptions, dateFormat);
    const { leftBrush, rightBrush, handleBrushChange } = useBrush([0, stateData.length - 1]);

    return (
        <ResponsiveContainer width="100%" height="100%" minWidth="50px" minHeight="50px">
            <LineChart
                width={width}
                height={height}
                data={stateData}
                syncId={syncId}
                layout={layout}
                margin={margin}
                onMouseDown={e => {
                    /* istanbul ignore next */
                    if (hasZoom) updateRefAreaLeft(e as { activeLabel?: number });
                }}
                onMouseMove={
                    /* istanbul ignore next */ e => {
                        /* istanbul ignore next */
                        if (refAreaLeft !== undefined && hasZoom) updateRefAreaRight(e as { activeLabel?: number });
                    }
                }
                onMouseUp={zoom}
            >
                {enableGrid && <CartesianGrid strokeDasharray="3 3" />}
                <XAxis
                    allowDataOverflow
                    dataKey="name"
                    domain={getXAxisDomain(hasZoom, left, right) as any}
                    tickFormatter={tickFormatter}
                    {...xAxisOptions}
                />
                <YAxis
                    allowDataOverflow
                    domain={getYAxisDomain(hasZoom, bottom, top, hasNegativeValue) as any}
                    type="number"
                    {...yAxisOptions}
                />
                {!hideToolTip && (
                    <Tooltip
                        content={<CustomToolTip />}
                        dateFormat={dateFormat}
                        customToolTipStyles={tooltipOptions?.customToolTipStyles}
                        {...(tooltipOptions as any)}
                    />
                )}
                {renderLines(dataKeys, activeMap, palette)}
                {referenceLines.map((props, index) => (
                    <ReferenceLine key={/* istanbul ignore next */ index} {...props} />
                ))}
                {hasZoom && refAreaLeft !== undefined && refAreaRight !== undefined && (
                    <ReferenceArea x1={refAreaLeft} x2={refAreaRight} strokeOpacity={0.3} />
                )}
                {hasBrush && (
                    <Brush
                        data={stateData}
                        startIndex={leftBrush}
                        endIndex={rightBrush}
                        onChange={handleBrushChange}
                        tickFormatter={tickFormatter}
                        dataKey={xAxisKey}
                    />
                )}
            </LineChart>
        </ResponsiveContainer>
    );
};

export default withAccessories()(LineGraph);
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import ListItem from "@molecules/ListItem/ListItem";
import { setItems, setSelectedId, toggleSelection, useListDispatch, useListState } from "../ListContext";
import { ListContainer, ListPanelWrapper } from "../List.styles";
import ErrorPanel from "./ErrorPanel";
import FilterGroupPanel from "./FilterGroupPanel";
import PaginationPanel from "./PaginationPanel";
import useList from "../useList";
import TopBarPanel from "./TopBarPanel";
import { SELECTION_TYPE } from "@components/molecules/ListItem/ListItemConstant";

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
type ListItemType = Record<string, any>;

type Selection = {
    type: string;
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    props?: any;
};

type ErrorMessage = {
    line1?: string;
    line2?: string;
};

export type ListPanelProps = {
    items: ListItemType[];
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    filterGroupProps?: any;
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    paginationProps?: any;
    errorMessages?: {
        noItems?: ErrorMessage;
        notFound?: ErrorMessage;
    };
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    topBarOptions?: any;
    hasResponsiveSupportText?: boolean;
    topOffset?: string;
};

const ListPanel = ({
    items,
    filterGroupProps,
    paginationProps,
    errorMessages,
    topBarOptions,
    hasResponsiveSupportText,
    topOffset
}: ListPanelProps) => {
    const [topBarHeight, setTopBarHeight] = useState<number>(0);
    const { accessorKey, hasFilterGroup, hasPagination, selectedIds, hasTopBar, dataTestId, isControlled } =
        useListState();
    const dispatch = useListDispatch();

    const { itemList } = useList();

    useEffect(() => {
        dispatch(setItems(items));
    }, [dispatch, items]);

    const handleOnClick = useCallback(
        (
            event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>,
            isSelected: boolean,
            // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
            selection: any,
            id: string | number,
            // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
            onClick?: (...args: any[]) => void
        ) => {
            let newSelectedIds = new Set<string | number>();
            if (selection?.type === SELECTION_TYPE.CHECKBOX) {
                if (!isControlled) {
                    dispatch(toggleSelection(id));
                    newSelectedIds = new Set(selectedIds);
                    if (newSelectedIds.has(id)) {
                        newSelectedIds.delete(id);
                    } else {
                        newSelectedIds.add(id);
                    }
                }
                onClick &&
                    onClick(
                        {
                            id,
                            type: selection.type,
                            isSelected,
                            ...(!isControlled && { selectedItemIds: [...newSelectedIds] })
                        },
                        event
                    );
            } else {
                if (!isControlled) dispatch(setSelectedId(id));
                onClick && onClick({ id, type: selection?.type, isSelected: true, checked: true }, event);
            }
        },
        [dispatch, isControlled, selectedIds]
    );

    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    const handleOnChange = useCallback((event: any, item: ListItemType) => {
        item?.onSelectionChange && item.onSelectionChange(event, item);
    }, []);

    return (
        <ListPanelWrapper data-testid={dataTestId ? `${dataTestId}-list-panel-wrapper` : undefined}>
            {hasTopBar && (
                <TopBarPanel
                    topBarOptions={topBarOptions}
                    topOffset={topOffset}
                    setTopBarHeight={setTopBarHeight}
                    data-testid={dataTestId}
                />
            )}
            {hasFilterGroup && <FilterGroupPanel filterGroupProps={filterGroupProps} topBarHeight={topBarHeight} />}
            <ListContainer
                $hasDivider={true}
                $hasFilterGroup={hasFilterGroup}
                $hasPagination={hasPagination}
                data-testid={dataTestId ? `${dataTestId}-list-panel` : undefined}
            >
                {itemList?.length &&
                    itemList.length > 0 &&
                    itemList.map(item => {
                        const id = item[accessorKey];
                        return (
                            <ListItem
                                key={id}
                                // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
                                {...(item as any)}
                                onClick={(
                                    event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLDivElement>,
                                    isSelected: boolean,
                                    selection?: unknown
                                ) => handleOnClick(event, isSelected, selection, id, item?.onClick)}
                                onSelectionChange={(event: unknown) => handleOnChange(event, item)}
                                hasDivider
                                _hasResponsiveSupportText={hasResponsiveSupportText}
                                data-testid={dataTestId ? `${dataTestId}-list-item-${id}` : undefined}
                            >
                                {item.children}
                            </ListItem>
                        );
                    })}
                <ErrorPanel errorMessages={errorMessages} data-testid={dataTestId} />
            </ListContainer>
            {hasPagination && <PaginationPanel paginationProps={paginationProps} />}
        </ListPanelWrapper>
    );
};

export default ListPanel;
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import Pagination, { SelectOption } from "@molecules/Pagination/Pagination";
import { setItemsPerPage, setPageSelection, useListDispatch, useListState } from "../ListContext";
import { PaginationPanelWrapper } from "../List.styles";

type PaginationData = {
    pageIndex: string | number;
    pageSize: string | number;
};

export type PaginationPanelProps = {
    paginationProps?: {
        itemsPerPage?: number;
        customItemsPerPage?: SelectOption[];
        pageSelection?: number;
        // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
        localizations?: any;
    };
};

const PaginationPanel = ({ paginationProps }: PaginationPanelProps) => {
    const { filteredItems, dataTestId } = useListState();
    const dispatch = useListDispatch();

    const onPageChange = useCallback(
        (data: PaginationData) => {
            const pageSelection = parseInt(data.pageIndex.toString());
            const itemsPerPage =
                data.pageSize === "Show All" || data.pageSize === ""
                    ? filteredItems.length
                    : parseInt(data?.pageSize.toString());
            if (itemsPerPage > 0) {
                dispatch(setItemsPerPage(itemsPerPage));
            }
            dispatch(setPageSelection(pageSelection));
        },
        [dispatch, filteredItems.length]
    );
    return (
        <PaginationPanelWrapper
            $displayBorders={filteredItems.length > 0}
            data-testid={dataTestId ? `${dataTestId}-list-pagination-panel-wrapper` : undefined}
        >
            <Pagination
                totalItems={filteredItems.length}
                onPaginationChange={onPageChange}
                itemsPerPage={paginationProps?.itemsPerPage}
                customItemsPerPage={paginationProps?.customItemsPerPage}
                pageSelection={paginationProps?.pageSelection}
                localizations={paginationProps?.localizations}
                data-testid={dataTestId}
            />
        </PaginationPanelWrapper>
    );
};

export default PaginationPanel;
````

## File: src/components/organisms/List/ListContext.tsx
````typescript
import React, { createContext, useContext, useMemo, useReducer } from "react";
import { SELECTION_TYPE } from "@components/molecules/ListItem/ListItemConstant";

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
type ListItem = Record<string, any>;

type TopBarOptions = {
    topBar?: boolean;
    buttons?: Record<string, unknown>;
    customButtons?: unknown;
};

type ListState = {
    items: ListItem[];
    accessorKey: string;
    hasFilterGroup: boolean;
    hasPagination: boolean;
    selectedIds: Set<string | number>;
    selectedId: string | number | null;
    itemsPerPage: number;
    pageSelection: number;
    allItems: ListItem[];
    filteredItems: ListItem[];
    currentItems: ListItem[];
    hasTopBar: boolean;
    topOffset: string;
    isControlled: boolean;
    dataTestId?: string;
};

// Action types
const SET_ITEMS = "SET_ITEMS";
const TOGGLE_SELECTION = "TOGGLE_SELECTION";
const SET_SELECTED_ID = "SET_SELECTED_ID";
const SELECT_ALL = "SELECT_ALL";
const CLEAR_SELECTION = "CLEAR_SELECTION";
const SET_FILTERED_ITEMS = "SET_FILTERED_ITEMS";
const SET_ITEMS_PER_PAGE = "SET_ITEMS_PER_PAGE";
const SET_PAGE_SELECTION = "SET_PAGE_SELECTION";

type ListAction =
    | { type: typeof SET_ITEMS; items: ListItem[] }
    | { type: typeof SET_SELECTED_ID; id: string | number }
    | { type: typeof TOGGLE_SELECTION; id: string | number }
    | { type: typeof SELECT_ALL; ids: (string | number)[] }
    | { type: typeof CLEAR_SELECTION }
    | { type: typeof SET_FILTERED_ITEMS; filteredItems: ListItem[] }
    | { type: typeof SET_ITEMS_PER_PAGE; itemsPerPage: number }
    | { type: typeof SET_PAGE_SELECTION; pageSelection: number };

type ListContextValue = {
    state: ListState;
    dispatch: React.Dispatch<ListAction>;
};

// initial state
const initialState = (
    items: ListItem[],
    accessorKey: string,
    hasFilterGroup: boolean,
    hasPagination: boolean,
    topBarOptions?: TopBarOptions,
    topOffset?: string,
    dataTestId?: string
): ListState => {
    return {
        items,
        accessorKey,
        hasFilterGroup,
        hasPagination,
        selectedIds: new Set(),
        selectedId: null,
        itemsPerPage: 10,
        pageSelection: 1,
        allItems: [],
        filteredItems: [],
        currentItems: [],
        hasTopBar: hasTopBar(topBarOptions),
        topOffset: topOffset || "0px",
        isControlled: verifySelectionControl(items),
        dataTestId
    };
};

const hasTopBar = (topBarOptions?: TopBarOptions): boolean =>
    topBarOptions?.topBar ||
    (topBarOptions?.buttons && Object.keys(topBarOptions.buttons).length > 0) ||
    !!topBarOptions?.customButtons;

const verifySelectionControl = (items?: ListItem[]): boolean =>
    items?.some(item => item?.isSelected !== undefined) ?? false;

// listReducer function
export const listReducer = (state: ListState, action: ListAction): ListState => {
    switch (action.type) {
        case SET_ITEMS: {
            const initialSelectedIds = new Set<string | number>();
            let initialSelectedId: string | number | null = null;
            // Initialize selected checkboxes or radio in the list
            action?.items?.forEach(item => {
                const id = item[state.accessorKey];
                if (item?.selection?.type === SELECTION_TYPE.CHECKBOX && item?.selection?.props?.checked) {
                    initialSelectedIds.add(id);
                } else if (item?.selection?.type === SELECTION_TYPE.RADIO && item?.selection?.props?.checked) {
                    initialSelectedId = id;
                }
            });
            const fullItems = state.hasPagination
                ? calculateCurrentItems(action.items, state.pageSelection, state.itemsPerPage)
                : action.items;
            return {
                ...state,
                allItems: action.items,
                filteredItems: action.items,
                currentItems: fullItems,
                selectedIds: initialSelectedIds,
                selectedId: initialSelectedId
            };
        }
        case SET_SELECTED_ID: {
            // This action is specifically for radio button logic
            return {
                ...state,
                selectedId: action.id
            };
        }
        case TOGGLE_SELECTION: {
            const newSelectedIds = new Set(state.selectedIds);
            if (newSelectedIds.has(action.id)) {
                newSelectedIds.delete(action.id);
            } else {
                newSelectedIds.add(action.id);
            }
            return {
                ...state,
                selectedIds: newSelectedIds
            };
        }
        // These two actions will be for next bulk actions' task
        // case SELECT_ALL: {
        //     const allIds = new Set(action.ids);
        //     return { ...state, selectedIds: allIds };
        // }
        // case CLEAR_SELECTION:
        //     return { ...state, selectedIds: new Set() };
        case SET_FILTERED_ITEMS: {
            const filteredItems = state.hasPagination
                ? calculateCurrentItems(action.filteredItems, state.pageSelection, state.itemsPerPage)
                : action.filteredItems;
            return {
                ...state,
                filteredItems: action.filteredItems,
                currentItems: filteredItems
            };
        }
        case SET_ITEMS_PER_PAGE: {
            return {
                ...state,
                itemsPerPage: action.itemsPerPage,
                currentItems: calculateCurrentItems(state.filteredItems, state.pageSelection, action.itemsPerPage)
            };
        }
        case SET_PAGE_SELECTION: {
            return {
                ...state,
                pageSelection: action.pageSelection,
                currentItems: calculateCurrentItems(state.filteredItems, action.pageSelection, state.itemsPerPage)
            };
        }
        default:
            return state;
    }
};

const calculateCurrentItems = (items: ListItem[], pageSelection: number, itemsPerPage: number): ListItem[] => {
    const startIndex = (pageSelection - 1) * itemsPerPage;
    const endIndex = startIndex + itemsPerPage;
    return items.slice(startIndex, endIndex);
};

// ListContext
export const ListContext = createContext<ListContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

export type ListProviderProps = {
    items: ListItem[];
    accessorKey: string;
    hasFilterGroup: boolean;
    hasPagination: boolean;
    topBarOptions?: TopBarOptions;
    topOffset?: string;
    children: React.ReactNode;
    dataTestId?: string;
};

// ListContext Provider component
export const ListProvider = ({
    items,
    accessorKey,
    hasFilterGroup,
    hasPagination,
    topBarOptions,
    topOffset,
    children,
    dataTestId
}: ListProviderProps) => {
    const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(
        listReducer,
        initialState(items, accessorKey, hasFilterGroup, hasPagination, topBarOptions, topOffset, dataTestId)
    );
    const values = useMemo(() => ({ state, dispatch }), [state, dispatch]);

    return <ListContext.Provider value={values}>{children}</ListContext.Provider>;
};

// Custom hooks to use the context
export const useListState = (): ListState => {
    const context = useContext(ListContext);
    if (!context) {
        throw new Error("useListState must be used within a ListProvider");
    }
    return context.state;
};

export const useListDispatch = (): React.Dispatch<ListAction> => {
    const context = useContext(ListContext);
    if (!context) {
        throw new Error("useListDispatch must be used within a ListProvider");
    }
    return context.dispatch;
};

// Action creators
export const setItems = (items: ListItem[]): ListAction => ({
    type: SET_ITEMS,
    items
});

export const setSelectedId = (id: string | number): ListAction => ({
    type: SET_SELECTED_ID,
    id
});

export const toggleSelection = (id: string | number): ListAction => ({
    type: TOGGLE_SELECTION,
    id
});

// export const selectAll = (ids: (string | number)[]): ListAction => ({
//     type: SELECT_ALL,
//     ids
// });

// export const clearSelection = (): ListAction => ({
//     type: CLEAR_SELECTION
// });

export const setFilteredItems = (filteredItems: ListItem[]): ListAction => ({
    type: SET_FILTERED_ITEMS,
    filteredItems
});

export const setItemsPerPage = (itemsPerPage: number): ListAction => ({
    type: SET_ITEMS_PER_PAGE,
    itemsPerPage
});

export const setPageSelection = (pageSelection: number): ListAction => ({
    type: SET_PAGE_SELECTION,
    pageSelection
});
````

````typescript
import { useMemo } from "react";
import { setSelectedId, toggleSelection, useListDispatch, useListState } from "./ListContext";
import { SELECTION_TYPE, TRAILING_TYPE } from "@molecules/ListItem/ListItemConstant";

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
type ListItem = Record<string, any>;

type Selection = {
    type: string;
    props: {
        checked?: boolean;
        // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
        onChange?: (...args: any[]) => void;
    };
};

type Trailing = {
    type?: string;
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    props?: any;
};

const hangleToggleSelection = (
    value: unknown,
    id: string | number,
    event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>,
    selection: Selection,
    selectedIds: Set<string | number>,
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    dispatch: React.Dispatch<any>,
    isControlled: boolean
) => {
    const { type, props } = selection;
    const { onChange } = props;

    if (type === SELECTION_TYPE.CHECKBOX) {
        let newSelectedIds = new Set<string | number>();
        if (!isControlled) {
            dispatch(toggleSelection(id));
            newSelectedIds = new Set(selectedIds);
            if (newSelectedIds.has(id)) {
                newSelectedIds.delete(id);
            } else {
                newSelectedIds.add(id);
            }
        }
        onChange &&
            onChange(
                {
                    id,
                    type,
                    value,
                    ...(!isControlled && { selectedItemIds: [...newSelectedIds] }) // send selectedItemIds only if not controlled
                },
                event
            );
    } else {
        if (!isControlled) dispatch(setSelectedId(id));
        onChange && onChange({ id, type, value, ...(!isControlled && { selectedItemId: id }) }, event);
    }
};

// eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
const handleOnClickOrOnChange = (
    id: string | number,
    accesorKey: string,
    trailing: Trailing,
    selectedIds: Set<string | number>,
    selectedId: string | number | null,
    isControlled: boolean
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
): any => {
    if (Array.isArray(trailing?.props)) {
        // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
        const props = trailing?.props?.map((prop: any) => {
            return {
                ...prop,
                // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
                onClick: (event: any, action: any) => {
                    prop?.onClick &&
                        prop.onClick(
                            {
                                [accesorKey]: id,
                                action,
                                ...(!isControlled && { selectedItemIds: [...selectedIds], selectedItemId: selectedId })
                            },
                            event
                        );
                }
            };
        });
        return [...props];
    } else {
        if (trailing?.type === TRAILING_TYPE.ACTION_MENU_BUTTON) {
            // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
            const actionList = trailing?.props?.actionList?.map((item: any) => {
                return {
                    ...item,
                    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
                    onClick: (event: any, action: any) => {
                        item?.onClick &&
                            item.onClick(
                                {
                                    [accesorKey]: id,
                                    action,
                                    ...(!isControlled && {
                                        selectedItemIds: [...selectedIds],
                                        selectedItemId: selectedId
                                    })
                                },
                                event
                            );
                    }
                };
            });
            return {
                ...trailing?.props,
                actionList: actionList
            };
        } else if (trailing?.type === TRAILING_TYPE.SWITCH) {
            return {
                ...trailing?.props,
                // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
                onChange: (value: any, event: any, action: any) => {
                    trailing?.props?.onChange &&
                        trailing.props.onChange(
                            value,
                            {
                                [accesorKey]: id,
                                action,
                                ...(!isControlled && {
                                    selectedItemIds: [...selectedIds],
                                    selectedItemId: selectedId
                                })
                            },
                            event
                        );
                }
            };
        } else {
            return {
                ...trailing?.props,
                // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
                onClick: (event: any, action: any) => {
                    trailing?.props?.onClick &&
                        trailing.props.onClick(
                            {
                                [accesorKey]: id,
                                action,
                                ...(!isControlled && {
                                    selectedItemIds: [...selectedIds],
                                    selectedItemId: selectedId
                                })
                            },
                            event
                        );
                }
            };
        }
    }
};

const getSelectionCheckedValue = (
    isControlled: boolean,
    id: string | number,
    selection: Selection,
    selectedIds: Set<string | number>,
    selectedId: string | number | null
): boolean => {
    if (isControlled) {
        return selection?.props?.checked ?? false;
    }
    return selection?.type === SELECTION_TYPE.CHECKBOX ? selectedIds.has(id) : selectedId === id;
};

type UseListReturn = {
    itemList?: ListItem[];
};

const useList = (): UseListReturn => {
    const { currentItems, accessorKey, selectedId, selectedIds, isControlled } = useListState();
    const dispatch = useListDispatch();

    const itemList = useMemo(() => {
        if (!currentItems.length) {
            return;
        }
        return currentItems.map(item => {
            const id = item[accessorKey];
            return {
                ...item,
                selection:
                    item?.selection?.props != undefined && Object.values(item?.selection?.props.length > 0)
                        ? {
                              ...item?.selection,
                              props: {
                                  ...item?.selection?.props,
                                  checked: getSelectionCheckedValue(
                                      isControlled,
                                      id,
                                      item?.selection,
                                      selectedIds,
                                      selectedId
                                  ),
                                  onChange:
                                      item?.selection?.type === SELECTION_TYPE.CHECKBOX
                                          ? item?.selection?.props?.onChange &&
                                            ((value: unknown, event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) =>
                                                hangleToggleSelection(
                                                    value,
                                                    id,
                                                    event,
                                                    item.selection,
                                                    selectedIds,
                                                    dispatch,
                                                    isControlled
                                                ))
                                          : item?.selection?.props?.onChange &&
                                            ((event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) =>
                                                hangleToggleSelection(
                                                    event.target.value,
                                                    id,
                                                    event,
                                                    item.selection,
                                                    selectedIds,
                                                    dispatch,
                                                    isControlled
                                                ))
                              }
                          }
                        : undefined,
                trailing: {
                    ...item?.trailing,
                    props:
                        item?.trailing?.props != undefined && Object.values(item?.trailing?.props.length > 0)
                            ? handleOnClickOrOnChange(
                                  id,
                                  accessorKey,
                                  item?.trailing,
                                  selectedIds,
                                  selectedId,
                                  isControlled
                              )
                            : undefined
                }
            };
        });
    }, [currentItems, accessorKey, isControlled, selectedIds, selectedId, dispatch]);
    return { itemList };
};

export default useList;
````

````typescript
import React, { useMemo, useContext, useEffect } from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import BasicSlideout from "@organisms/BasicSlideout/BasicSlideout";
import { MultistepWizardContextProvider, MultistepWizardContext, MultistepWizardStep } from "./MultistepWizardContext";
import MultistepWizardTabs from "./MultistepWizardTabs";
import MultistepWizardNavigationList from "./MultistepWizardNavigationList";
import MultistepWizardStepComponent from "./MultistepWizardStep";
import { MultiWizardButtonShape } from "./MultistepWizardButtonShapes";
import usePrevious from "@hooks/usePrevious";
import AlertBar from "@atoms/AlertBar/AlertBar";

type LocaleTexts = {
    NEXT?: string;
    SAVE?: string;
    BACK?: string;
    CANCEL?: string;
    DONE?: string;
};

const DEFAULT_LOCALE_TEXTS: Required<LocaleTexts> = {
    NEXT: "Next",
    SAVE: "Save",
    BACK: "Back",
    CANCEL: "Cancel",
    DONE: "Done"
};

export type MultistepWizardProps = {
    /**
     * title of the wizard
     */
    title?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Action element to display on the right side of the header
     */
    headerAction?: React.ReactElement;
    /**
     * control's whether or not slideout is open
     */
    isOpen?: boolean;
    /**
     * action to perform when the cancel/close buttons are clicked
     * or the wizard is clicked outside of
     * Signature: function() => void
     * */
    onClose?: () => void;
    /**
     * action to perform when the save button is clicked on the last step
     * Signature: function() => void
     * */
    onSave?: () => void | Promise<void>;
    /**
     * Callback to be triggered when root (first shown) slideout is exited
     * Signature: function() => void
     */
    onExited?: () => void;
    /**
     * switches the wizard to edit mode, displaying tabs in place of the navigation list
     * and a save button on all steps
     */
    isEditMode?: boolean;
    /**
     * array of wizard steps, should have at least 2 steps, and a maximum of 10 steps.
     */
    steps: MultistepWizardStep[];
    /**
     * Index of the step to which you'd like the wizard to initially open (edit mode only)
     */
    initialStepIndex?: number;
    /**
     * children to render within the wizard body
     * each child should have an id matching one of the items in the step array
     */
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * locale text overwrites for defaults
     */
    localeTexts?: LocaleTexts;
    /**
     * By default, inactive wizard steps are always rendered the DOM & hidden to allow back/forth navigation while maintaining state.
     * Set this to true to disable this behavior and only render the currently active step. This prop is ignored for edit mode wizards.
     * Rendering each step is required for the edit mode validation to function.
     */
    renderActiveOnly?: boolean;
    /**
     * Don't use this unless you really really have to, and even then rethink it!
     */
    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly?: number;
    /**
     * By default, set to false.
     * Set to true only if Table component is rending inside the MultistepWizard component. This prevents sticky position to overflow.
     */
    preventStickyOverflow?: boolean;
    /**
     * This allows "limited" accesibility to the Button's "props": ex: [dataTrackAction, attrType and disabled].
     * NOTE: It will create a suffix value for each data-tract-action value, to reflect the current wizard step in the multiStepWizard.
     * Ex: primaryButton_[Current_Wizard_Step]
     */
    stepsButtonsProps?: MultiWizardButtonShape;
    /**
     * Array of AlertBar props. These will be rendered sequentially between the slideout header and wizard steps.
     */
    alerts?: React.ComponentProps<typeof AlertBar>[];
    /**
     * used for testing
     */
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const MultistepWizard = ({ steps, onSave, children, ...props }: MultistepWizardProps) => (
    <MultistepWizardContextProvider steps={steps} onSave={onSave}>
        <MultistepWizardSlideout {...props}>{children}</MultistepWizardSlideout>
    </MultistepWizardContextProvider>
);

type MultistepWizardSlideoutProps = Omit<MultistepWizardProps, "steps" | "onSave">;

const MultistepWizardSlideout = ({
    title,
    headerAction,
    onClose,
    localeTexts,
    children,
    onExited,
    isOpen,
    isEditMode,
    renderActiveOnly,
    preventStickyOverflow = false,
    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly,
    stepsButtonsProps,
    initialStepIndex,
    alerts,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: MultistepWizardSlideoutProps) => {
    const localeTextOverwrites: Required<LocaleTexts> = { ...DEFAULT_LOCALE_TEXTS, ...localeTexts };

    const context = useContext(MultistepWizardContext);

    if (!context) {
        throw new Error("MultistepWizardSlideout must be used within MultistepWizardContextProvider");
    }

    const {
        isFirstStep,
        isLastStep,
        goToNextStep,
        goToPreviousStep,
        steps,
        currentStepIndex,
        setCurrentStepIndex,
        isNextLoading,
        saveWizard
    } = context;

    const previousIsOpen = usePrevious(isOpen);

    useEffect(() => {
        // reset the wizard index on close
        if (previousIsOpen && !isOpen && currentStepIndex !== 0) {
            setCurrentStepIndex(0);
        } else if (
            // in edit mode, reset to the initial step index
            !previousIsOpen &&
            isOpen &&
            isEditMode &&
            initialStepIndex &&
            currentStepIndex !== initialStepIndex
        ) {
            setCurrentStepIndex(initialStepIndex);
        }
    }, [isOpen, currentStepIndex, setCurrentStepIndex, isEditMode, initialStepIndex, previousIsOpen]);

    const buttons = useMemo(() => {
        const onPrimaryButtonClick = () => {
            const primaryAction = isEditMode ? saveWizard : goToNextStep;
            primaryAction();
            stepsButtonsProps?.primary?.onClick && stepsButtonsProps.primary.onClick();
        };
        const onSecondaryButtonClick = () => {
            goToPreviousStep();
            stepsButtonsProps?.secondary?.onClick && stepsButtonsProps.secondary.onClick();
        };
        const currentStepIndexId = `_${steps[currentStepIndex].id}`;
        return {
            cancel: {
                ...stepsButtonsProps?.cancel,
                text: localeTextOverwrites.CANCEL,
                type: "border" as const,
                onClick: onClose,
                dataTrackAction:
                    stepsButtonsProps?.cancel?.dataTrackAction && stepsButtonsProps.cancel.dataTrackAction.length > 0
                        ? stepsButtonsProps.cancel.dataTrackAction + currentStepIndexId
                        : undefined
            },
            primary: {
                ...stepsButtonsProps?.primary,
                text: isEditMode
                    ? localeTextOverwrites.DONE
                    : isLastStep
                    ? localeTextOverwrites.SAVE
                    : localeTextOverwrites.NEXT,
                onClick: onPrimaryButtonClick,
                loading: isNextLoading,
                dataTrackAction:
                    stepsButtonsProps?.primary?.dataTrackAction && stepsButtonsProps.primary.dataTrackAction.length > 0
                        ? stepsButtonsProps.primary.dataTrackAction + currentStepIndexId
                        : undefined
            },
            secondary:
                isFirstStep || isEditMode
                    ? undefined
                    : {
                          ...stepsButtonsProps?.secondary,
                          text: localeTextOverwrites.BACK,
                          type: "border" as const,
                          onClick: onSecondaryButtonClick,
                          dataTrackAction:
                              stepsButtonsProps?.secondary?.dataTrackAction &&
                              stepsButtonsProps.secondary.dataTrackAction.length > 0
                                  ? stepsButtonsProps.secondary.dataTrackAction + currentStepIndexId
                                  : undefined
                      }
        };
    }, [
        steps,
        currentStepIndex,
        stepsButtonsProps?.cancel,
        stepsButtonsProps?.primary,
        stepsButtonsProps?.secondary,
        localeTextOverwrites.CANCEL,
        localeTextOverwrites.DONE,
        localeTextOverwrites.SAVE,
        localeTextOverwrites.NEXT,
        localeTextOverwrites.BACK,
        onClose,
        isEditMode,
        isLastStep,
        saveWizard,
        goToNextStep,
        isNextLoading,
        isFirstStep,
        goToPreviousStep
    ]);

    const wizardChildren = useMemo(
        () =>
            React.Children.toArray(children)
                .filter(c => c)
                .map(
                    (child, index) =>
                        child && (
                            <MultistepWizardStepComponent
                                key={steps[index].id}
                                id={steps[index].id}
                                renderActiveOnly={isEditMode ? false : renderActiveOnly}
                                preventStickyOverflow={preventStickyOverflow}
                            >
                                {child}
                            </MultistepWizardStepComponent>
                        )
                ),
        [children, steps, renderActiveOnly, preventStickyOverflow, isEditMode]
    );

    return (
        <BasicSlideout
            title={title}
            headerAction={headerAction}
            isOpen={isOpen}
            onCloseClick={onClose}
            buttons={buttons}
            onExited={onExited}
            zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly={zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly}
            alerts={alerts}
            data-testid={dataTestId}
        >
            <StyledWizardBody>
                {isOpen && (
                    <>
                        {isEditMode ? <MultistepWizardTabs /> : <MultistepWizardNavigationList />}
                        {wizardChildren}
                    </>
                )}
            </StyledWizardBody>
        </BasicSlideout>
    );
};

const StyledWizardBody = styled("div")`
    height: 100%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    flex: 1;
`;

export default MultistepWizard;
````

````typescript
import React, { useState, createContext, useContext, useCallback, useEffect, useRef } from "react";

export type MultistepWizardStep = {
    id: string | number;
    title: string | number;
    tabIcon?: React.ReactElement;
};

export type ValidationFunction = () => boolean | Promise<boolean>;

export type StepSuccessFunction = () => void | Promise<void>;

export type ValidationRef = Record<string | number, ValidationFunction>;

export type StepSuccessRef = Record<string | number, StepSuccessFunction>;

export type UseMultistepWizardParams = {
    onSave?: () => void | Promise<void>;
    steps: MultistepWizardStep[];
};

export type MultistepWizardContextValue = {
    currentStep: MultistepWizardStep;
    currentStepIndex: number;
    goToNextStep: (stepIndex?: number) => Promise<boolean>;
    goToPreviousStep: () => void;
    isFirstStep: boolean;
    isLastStep: boolean;
    isNextLoading: boolean;
    saveWizard: () => Promise<boolean>;
    setCurrentStepIndex: (index: number) => void;
    stepSuccess: React.MutableRefObject<StepSuccessRef>;
    steps: MultistepWizardStep[];
    validation: React.MutableRefObject<ValidationRef>;
};

export type MultistepWizardContextProviderProps = {
    children: React.ReactNode;
    onSave?: () => void | Promise<void>;
    steps: MultistepWizardStep[];
};

export type UseMultistepWizardStepParams = {
    id: string | number;
};

export const MultistepWizardContext = createContext<MultistepWizardContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

const validateStep = async (stepId: string | number, validation: React.MutableRefObject<ValidationRef>) => {
    if (validation.current[stepId]) {
        return await validation.current[stepId]();
    }
    return true;
};

export const useMultistepWizard = ({ steps, onSave }: UseMultistepWizardParams) => {
    const [currentStepIndex, setCurrentStepIndex] = useState(0);
    const [isNextLoading, setIsNextLoading] = useState(false);
    const [isSaving, setIsSaving] = useState(false);
    const validation = useRef<ValidationRef>({});
    const stepSuccess = useRef<StepSuccessRef>({});
    const currentStep = steps[currentStepIndex];
    const id = currentStep.id;

    const validate = useCallback(
        async (allSteps = false) => {
            let validationResult = false;
            setIsNextLoading(true);
            if (allSteps) {
                for (const stepId in validation.current) {
                    validationResult = await validateStep(stepId, validation);
                    if (!validationResult) {
                        break;
                    }
                }
            } else {
                validationResult = await validateStep(id, validation);
            }
            setIsNextLoading(false);
            return validationResult;
        },
        [validation, id]
    );

    const onStepSuccess = useCallback(async () => {
        if (stepSuccess.current[id]) {
            await stepSuccess.current[id]();
        }
    }, [stepSuccess, id]);

    const saveWizard = useCallback(async () => {
        const validationResult = await validate(true);
        if (!validationResult) {
            return false;
        }
        await onStepSuccess();

        onSave && setIsSaving(true);
        return true;
    }, [validate, onStepSuccess, onSave]);

    const goToNextStep = useCallback(
        async (stepIndex?: number) => {
            const validationResult = await validate();
            if (!validationResult) {
                return false;
            }
            await onStepSuccess();

            if (typeof stepIndex === "number") {
                setCurrentStepIndex(stepIndex);
                return true;
            }

            const maxNumOfSteps = steps.length - 1;
            const nextStepIndex = currentStepIndex + 1;

            if (nextStepIndex <= maxNumOfSteps) {
                setCurrentStepIndex(nextStepIndex);
            } else {
                // onSave is called as a side effect so that any state updates
                // made in validation are reflected when it is called
                onSave && setIsSaving(true);
            }
            return true;
        },
        [currentStepIndex, validate, onSave, onStepSuccess, steps.length]
    );

    useEffect(() => {
        if (isSaving) {
            const handleSave = async () => {
                setIsNextLoading(true);
                await onSave?.();
                setIsNextLoading(false);
            };
            setIsSaving(false);
            handleSave();
        }
    }, [isSaving, onSave]);

    const goToPreviousStep = useCallback(() => {
        const previousStepIndex = currentStepIndex - 1;
        setCurrentStepIndex(previousStepIndex);
    }, [currentStepIndex]);

    const isFirstStep = currentStepIndex === 0;
    const isLastStep = currentStepIndex === steps.length - 1;

    return {
        currentStepIndex,
        setCurrentStepIndex,
        currentStep,
        goToNextStep,
        goToPreviousStep,
        steps,
        isFirstStep,
        isLastStep,
        validation,
        stepSuccess,
        isNextLoading,
        saveWizard
    };
};

export const useMultistepWizardStep = ({ id }: UseMultistepWizardStepParams) => {
    const context = useContext(MultistepWizardContext);

    if (!context) {
        throw new Error("useMultistepWizardStep must be used within MultistepWizardContextProvider");
    }

    const { currentStep } = context;
    const isActive = currentStep && currentStep.id === id;

    return { isActive };
};

export const useMultistepWizardValidation = (id: string | number, onValidation?: ValidationFunction) => {
    const context = useContext(MultistepWizardContext);

    if (!context) {
        throw new Error("useMultistepWizardValidation must be used within MultistepWizardContextProvider");
    }

    const { validation } = context;

    useEffect(() => {
        if (onValidation) {
            validation.current[id] = onValidation;
        }
    }, [validation, onValidation, id]);
};

export const useStepSuccess = (id: string | number, onStepSuccess?: StepSuccessFunction) => {
    const context = useContext(MultistepWizardContext);

    if (!context) {
        throw new Error("useStepSuccess must be used within MultistepWizardContextProvider");
    }

    const { stepSuccess } = context;

    useEffect(() => {
        if (onStepSuccess) {
            stepSuccess.current[id] = onStepSuccess;
        }
    }, [stepSuccess, onStepSuccess, id]);
};

export const MultistepWizardContextProvider = ({ steps, onSave, children }: MultistepWizardContextProviderProps) => {
    const value = useMultistepWizard({ steps, onSave });

    return <MultistepWizardContext.Provider value={value}>{children}</MultistepWizardContext.Provider>;
};
````

````typescript
import React, { Fragment, useCallback, useContext, useState, forwardRef } from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import { MultistepWizardContext, MultistepWizardStep } from "./MultistepWizardContext";
import Tooltip from "@atoms/Tooltip/Tooltip";

const MultistepWizardNavigationList = () => {
    const context = useContext(MultistepWizardContext);

    if (!context) {
        throw new Error("MultistepWizardNavigationList must be used within MultistepWizardContextProvider");
    }

    const { steps, currentStepIndex } = context;
    const [haveEnoughSpace, setHaveEnoughSpace] = useState(true);

    const navigationListRefCallback = useCallback((node: HTMLDivElement | null) => {
        if (node !== null) {
            setHaveEnoughSpace(node.scrollWidth <= node.clientWidth);
        }
    }, []);

    return (
        <StyledNavigationListContainer>
            <StyledListContainer ref={navigationListRefCallback}>
                {steps.map((item, index) => {
                    const isActive = currentStepIndex === index;
                    const isComplete = currentStepIndex > index;
                    const isFirst = index === 0;
                    const isLast = index === steps.length - 1;

                    return (
                        <Fragment key={`fragment-${item.title}-${index}`}>
                            <NavigationListItem
                                isActive={isActive}
                                isComplete={isComplete}
                                isFirst={isFirst}
                                isLast={isLast}
                                item={item}
                                index={index}
                                haveEnoughSpace={haveEnoughSpace}
                            />
                            {!isLast && <StyledSeparatorLine />}
                        </Fragment>
                    );
                })}
            </StyledListContainer>
        </StyledNavigationListContainer>
    );
};

type NavigationListItemProps = {
    isActive: boolean;
    isComplete: boolean;
    isFirst: boolean;
    isLast: boolean;
    index: number;
    item: MultistepWizardStep;
    haveEnoughSpace: boolean;
};

const NavigationListItem = ({
    isActive,
    isComplete,
    isFirst,
    isLast,
    index,
    item,
    haveEnoughSpace
}: NavigationListItemProps) => {
    const styleProps = { isActive, isComplete, isFirst, isLast, haveEnoughSpace };
    const stepNumber = index + 1;
    const { title } = item;

    return (
        <StyledListItemContainer data-testid={`step-item_${index}`}>
            <>
                <StyledCircleContainer>
                    <StyledBeforeListItemSeparator $isFirst={isFirst} />
                    {haveEnoughSpace ? (
                        <NavigationListItemCircle
                            isComplete={isComplete}
                            stepNumber={stepNumber}
                            styleProps={styleProps}
                        />
                    ) : (
                        <Tooltip title={`Step ${stepNumber}: ${title}`}>
                            <NavigationListItemCircle
                                isComplete={isComplete}
                                stepNumber={stepNumber}
                                styleProps={styleProps}
                            />
                        </Tooltip>
                    )}
                    <StyledAfterListItemSeparator $isLast={isLast} />
                </StyledCircleContainer>
                {haveEnoughSpace && <StyledTitle>{title}</StyledTitle>}
            </>
        </StyledListItemContainer>
    );
};

type NavigationListItemCircleProps = {
    isComplete: boolean;
    stepNumber: number;
    styleProps: {
        isActive: boolean;
        isComplete: boolean;
        isFirst: boolean;
        isLast: boolean;
        haveEnoughSpace: boolean;
    };
};

const NavigationListItemCircle = forwardRef<HTMLDivElement, NavigationListItemCircleProps>((props, ref) => {
    const { isComplete, stepNumber, styleProps, ...otherProps } = props;
    return (
        <StyledCircle ref={ref} {...styleProps} {...otherProps} data-testid={`step-${stepNumber}-circle-icon`}>
            {isComplete ? <i className="fa fa-check" /> : stepNumber}
        </StyledCircle>
    );
});

const StyledNavigationListContainer = styled("div")`
    padding: 1rem 3rem;
    background-color: #f5f5f5;
`;

const StyledListContainer = styled("div")`
    display: flex;
    justify-content: space-between;
`;

const StyledListItemContainer = styled("div")`

`;

const StyledCircleContainer = styled("div")`

`;

`;

type StyledBeforeListItemSeparatorProps = {

};

const StyledBeforeListItemSeparator = styled(StyledListItemSeparator, {
    shouldForwardProp: prop => !prop.toString().startsWith("$")
})<StyledBeforeListItemSeparatorProps>`
    visibility: ${({ $isFirst }) => ($isFirst ? "hidden" : "visible")};
    margin-right: 0.5rem;
`;

type StyledAfterListItemSeparatorProps = {

};

const StyledAfterListItemSeparator = styled(StyledListItemSeparator, {
    shouldForwardProp: prop => !prop.toString().startsWith("$")
})<StyledAfterListItemSeparatorProps>`
    visibility: ${({ $isLast }) => ($isLast ? "hidden" : "visible")};

`;

const StyledSeparatorLine = styled("div")`

};

const StyledCircle = styled("div")<StyledCircleProps>`
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { useMultistepWizardStep } from "./MultistepWizardContext";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";

export type MultistepWizardStepProps = {
    /**
     * id of the wizard step
     */
    id: string | number;
    /**
     * true to remove from DOM when not active
     */
    renderActiveOnly?: boolean;
    /**
     * Set to true only if Table component is rending inside the MultistepWizard component. This prevents sticky position to overflow.
     */
    preventStickyOverflow?: boolean;
    children: React.ReactNode;
};

const MultistepWizardStep = ({ id, renderActiveOnly, preventStickyOverflow, children }: MultistepWizardStepProps) => {
    const { isActive } = useMultistepWizardStep({ id });

    return (
        <>
            {(!renderActiveOnly || isActive) && (
                <StyledWizardStep $isActive={isActive} $preventStickyOverflow={preventStickyOverflow}>
                    {children}
                </StyledWizardStep>
            )}
        </>
    );
};

type StyledWizardStepProps = {
    $isActive: boolean;
    $preventStickyOverflow?: boolean;
};

const StyledWizardStep = styled("div", {
    shouldForwardProp: prop => !prop.toString().startsWith("$")
})<StyledWizardStepProps>`
    display: ${props => (props.$isActive ? null : "none")};
    overflow: auto;
    padding: ${props => (props.$preventStickyOverflow ? "0 1rem" : "1rem")};
    flex: 1;
`;

export default MultistepWizardStep;
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useContext } from "react";
import { createTheme } from "@mui/material/styles";
import { ThemeProvider } from "@mui/material";
import Tabs from "@molecules/Tabs/Tabs";
import Tab from "@atoms/Tab/Tab";
import { MultistepWizardContext } from "./MultistepWizardContext";

const MultistepWizardTabs = () => {
    const context = useContext(MultistepWizardContext);

    if (!context) {
        throw new Error("MultistepWizardTabs must be used within MultistepWizardContextProvider");
    }

    const { steps, currentStepIndex, goToNextStep } = context;

    const handleTabChange = useCallback(
        (_: React.SyntheticEvent, value: unknown) => {
            goToNextStep(steps.findIndex(step => String(step.id) === value));
        },
        [goToNextStep, steps]
    );

    return (
        <ThemeProvider theme={TabTheme}>
            <Tabs onChange={handleTabChange} selectedTabValue={String(steps[currentStepIndex].id)}>
                {steps.map(({ id, title, tabIcon }) => (
                    <Tab
                        key={id}
                        value={String(id)}
                        label={String(title)}
                        icon={tabIcon}
                        data-testid={`wizard-tab-${id}`}
                    />
                ))}
            </Tabs>
        </ThemeProvider>
    );
};

const TabTheme = createTheme({
    components: {
        MuiTab: {
            styleOverrides: {
                root: {
                    maxWidth: "100%"
                }
            }
        }
    }
});

export default MultistepWizardTabs;
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useContext } from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import Button from "@atoms/button/Button";
import { RuleBuilderContext } from "../RuleBuilderContext";
import ConditionBlockHeader from "./ConditionBlockHeader";
import ConditionRow from "./ConditionRow";
import { Block } from "../shared/propTypes";
import { ButtonPlusIcon } from "../components/StyledComponents";

export type ConditionBlockProps = {
    block: Block;
};

const ConditionBlock: React.FC<ConditionBlockProps> = ({ block }) => {
    const context = useContext(RuleBuilderContext);
    if (!context) return null;
    const { addNewCondition } = context;
    const { id: blockId, conditions } = block;
    const handleAddNewCondition = useCallback(() => addNewCondition(blockId), [addNewCondition, blockId]);

    return (
        <ConditionBlockContainer data-testid="condition_block">
            <ConditionBlockHeader blockId={blockId} />

            {conditions.map((condition, conditionIndex) => (
                <ConditionRow
                    key={condition.id}
                    blockId={blockId}
                    condition={condition}
                    isFirstCondition={conditionIndex === 0}
                />
            ))}

            <Button type="borderless" onClick={handleAddNewCondition}>
                <ButtonPlusIcon /> Add Condition
            </Button>
        </ConditionBlockContainer>
    );
};

const ConditionBlockContainer = styled("div")`
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    align-items: flex-start;
    padding: 1rem;
    background: #fff;
    border: 1px solid #e4e5e6;
    border-left: 4px solid #218bd1;
    border-radius: 4px;

    > :not(:last-child) {
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }
`;

export default ConditionBlock;
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useContext } from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import { RuleBuilderContext } from "../RuleBuilderContext";
import LeftOperandField from "./LeftOperandField";
import OperatorField from "./OperatorField";
import RightOperandSection from "./RightOperandSection";
import { Condition } from "../shared/propTypes";
import { DuplicateActionIcon, DeleteActionIcon } from "./StyledComponents";

export type ConditionRowProps = {
    blockId: string;
    condition: Condition;
    isFirstCondition: boolean;
};

const ConditionRow: React.FC<ConditionRowProps> = ({ blockId, condition, isFirstCondition }) => {
    const context = useContext(RuleBuilderContext);
    if (!context) return null;
    const { duplicateCondition, deleteCondition, conditionsSeparator } = context;
    const { id: conditionId, leftOperandValue, operatorValue } = condition;

    const handleDuplicate = useCallback(
        () => duplicateCondition(blockId, conditionId),
        [blockId, conditionId, duplicateCondition]
    );

    const handleDelete = useCallback(
        () => deleteCondition(blockId, conditionId),
        [blockId, conditionId, deleteCondition]
    );

    return (
        <ConditionRowContainer data-testid="condition_row">
            <ConditionPrefix>{isFirstCondition ? "Where" : conditionsSeparator}</ConditionPrefix>

            <ConditionRowFieldsAndActionsContainer>
                <LeftOperandField blockId={blockId} condition={condition} />
                {leftOperandValue !== null && leftOperandValue !== "" && (
                    <OperatorField blockId={blockId} condition={condition} />
                )}
                {operatorValue !== null && <RightOperandSection blockId={blockId} condition={condition} />}

                <ConditionRowActions>
                    <DuplicateActionIcon onClick={handleDuplicate} data-testid="condition_row_duplicate_button" />
                    <DeleteActionIcon onClick={handleDelete} data-testid="condition_row_delete_button" />
                </ConditionRowActions>
            </ConditionRowFieldsAndActionsContainer>
        </ConditionRowContainer>
    );
};

const ConditionRowContainer = styled("div")`
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    font-size: 0.875rem;
    line-height: 143%;
    color: #0a1b36;
`;

const ConditionPrefix = styled("div")`
    width: 2.675rem;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    margin-right: 1rem;
    text-align: end;
`;

const ConditionRowFieldsAndActionsContainer = styled("div")`
    display: flex;
    gap: 0.5rem;
`;

const ConditionRowActions = styled("div")`
    display: flex;
`;

export default ConditionRow;
````
