````typescript
import React, { createContext, forwardRef, useCallback, useImperativeHandle, useReducer } from "react";
// @ts-ignore - uuid types not available for this version
import { v4 as uuidv4 } from "uuid";
import structuredClone from "@ungap/structured-clone";
import { FIELD_TYPE_CONFIG } from "./shared/constants";

// Types
export type FieldValue = string | { label: string; value: string };

type FieldType = keyof typeof FIELD_TYPE_CONFIG;

type Option = {
    label: string;
    value: string | number;
};

type FieldConfig = {
    name: string;
    type: FieldType;
    [key: string]: any;
};

type LeftOperandConfig = {
    type: FieldType;
    [key: string]: any;
};

type OperatorConfig = {
    options?: Option[];
    getOptions?: (leftOperandValue: any) => Option[];
};

type RightOperandConfig = {
    fields?: FieldConfig[];
    getFields?: (leftOperandValue: any, operatorValue: any) => FieldConfig[];
};

export type ConditionConfig = {
    leftOperandConfig: LeftOperandConfig;
    operatorConfig: OperatorConfig;
    rightOperandConfig?: RightOperandConfig;
};

export type Condition = {
    id: string;
    leftOperandValue?: FieldValue;
    operatorValue?: FieldValue;
    rightOperandValues: Record<string, unknown>;
};

export type Block = {
    id: string;
    conditions: Condition[];
};

type UpdateConditionPayload = {
    blockId: string;
    conditionId: string;
    fieldName: string;
    value: any;
};

type DuplicateConditionPayload = {
    blockId: string;
    conditionId: string;
};

type DeleteConditionPayload = {
    blockId: string;
    conditionId: string;
};

// Discriminated union for actions
type RuleBuilderAction =
    | { type: "ADD_NEW_BLOCK" }
    | { type: "DUPLICATE_BLOCK"; value: string }
    | { type: "DELETE_BLOCK"; value: string }
    | { type: "UPDATE_CONDITION"; value: UpdateConditionPayload }
    | { type: "ADD_NEW_CONDITION"; value: string }
    | { type: "DUPLICATE_CONDITION"; value: DuplicateConditionPayload }
    | { type: "DELETE_CONDITION"; value: DeleteConditionPayload };

type RuleBuilderContextValue = {
    blocksSeparator: string;
    conditionsSeparator: string;
    conditionConfig: ConditionConfig;
    blocks: Block[];
    addNewBlock: () => void;
    duplicateBlock: (blockId: string) => void;
    deleteBlock: (blockId: string) => void;
    updateCondition: (payload: UpdateConditionPayload) => void;
    addNewCondition: (blockId: string) => void;
    duplicateCondition: (blockId: string, conditionId: string) => void;
    deleteCondition: (blockId: string, conditionId: string) => void;
};

type RuleBuilderContextProviderProps = {
    blocksSeparator: string;
    conditionsSeparator: string;
    emptyConditionIsDisplayedByDefault?: boolean;
    conditionConfig: ConditionConfig;
    children: React.ReactNode;
};

const RuleBuilderContext = createContext<RuleBuilderContextValue | undefined>(undefined);

const RuleBuilderContextProvider = forwardRef<Block[], RuleBuilderContextProviderProps>((props, ref) => {
    const {
        blocksSeparator,
        conditionsSeparator,
        emptyConditionIsDisplayedByDefault = true,
        conditionConfig,
        children
    } = props;

    const getDefaultCondition = useCallback((): Condition => {
        const {
            leftOperandConfig: { type }
        } = conditionConfig;

        const { defaultValue: leftOperandValue } = FIELD_TYPE_CONFIG[type];

        return {
            id: uuidv4(),
            leftOperandValue: leftOperandValue || undefined,
            operatorValue: undefined,
            rightOperandValues: {}
        };
    }, [conditionConfig]);

    const getDefaultBlock = useCallback((): Block => {
        const block: Block = { id: uuidv4(), conditions: [] };

        if (emptyConditionIsDisplayedByDefault) {
            block.conditions = [getDefaultCondition()];
        }

        return block;
    }, [emptyConditionIsDisplayedByDefault, getDefaultCondition]);

    const getInitialBlocks = useCallback((): Block[] => [getDefaultBlock()], [getDefaultBlock]);

    const reducer: React.Reducer<Block[], RuleBuilderAction> = (state, action) => {
        switch (action.type) {
            case "ADD_NEW_BLOCK": {
                return [...state, getDefaultBlock()];
            }

            case "DUPLICATE_BLOCK": {
                const newState = [...state];
                const blockIndex = newState.findIndex(({ id }) => id === action.value);
                const duplicatedBlock: Block = { ...structuredClone(newState[blockIndex]), id: uuidv4() };
                duplicatedBlock.conditions = duplicatedBlock.conditions.map(condition => ({
                    ...condition,
                    id: uuidv4()
                }));

                newState.splice(blockIndex, 0, duplicatedBlock);

                return newState;
            }

            case "DELETE_BLOCK": {
                return state.length === 1 ? getInitialBlocks() : state.filter(({ id }) => id !== action.value);
            }

            case "UPDATE_CONDITION": {
                const { blockId, conditionId, fieldName, value } = action.value;

                return state.map(block => {
                    if (block.id === blockId) {
                        const conditions = structuredClone(block.conditions);
                        const conditionToUpdate = conditions.find((c: Condition) => c.id === conditionId);

                        if (!conditionToUpdate) return block;

                        switch (fieldName) {
                            case "leftOperand": {
                                conditionToUpdate.leftOperandValue = value;
                                conditionToUpdate.operatorValue = undefined;
                                conditionToUpdate.rightOperandValues = {};
                                break;
                            }

                            case "operator": {
                                conditionToUpdate.operatorValue = value;
                                conditionToUpdate.rightOperandValues = {};
                                break;
                            }

                            default: {
                                conditionToUpdate.rightOperandValues[fieldName] = value;
                            }
                        }

                        return { ...block, conditions };
                    }

                    return block;
                });
            }

            case "ADD_NEW_CONDITION": {
                return state.map(block => {
                    if (block.id === action.value) {
                        return { ...block, conditions: [...block.conditions, getDefaultCondition()] };
                    }

                    return block;
                });
            }

            case "DUPLICATE_CONDITION": {
                const { blockId, conditionId } = action.value;

                return state.map(block => {
                    if (block.id === blockId) {
                        const conditions = structuredClone(block.conditions);
                        const conditionIndex = conditions.findIndex((c: Condition) => c.id === conditionId);
                        const duplicatedCondition: Condition = {
                            ...structuredClone(conditions[conditionIndex]),
                            id: uuidv4()
                        };

                        conditions.splice(conditionIndex, 0, duplicatedCondition);

                        return { ...block, conditions };
                    }

                    return block;
                });
            }

            case "DELETE_CONDITION": {
                const { blockId, conditionId } = action.value;

                return state.map(block => {
                    if (block.id === blockId) {
                        let conditions: Condition[];

                        if (block.conditions.length === 1) {
                            conditions = emptyConditionIsDisplayedByDefault ? [getDefaultCondition()] : [];
                        } else {
                            conditions = block.conditions.filter(({ id }) => id !== conditionId);
                        }

                        return { ...block, conditions };
                    }

                    return block;
                });
            }
        }
    };

    const [blocks, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, undefined, getInitialBlocks);

    const addNewBlock = useCallback(() => dispatch({ type: "ADD_NEW_BLOCK" }), []);
    const duplicateBlock = useCallback((blockId: string) => dispatch({ type: "DUPLICATE_BLOCK", value: blockId }), []);
    const deleteBlock = useCallback((blockId: string) => dispatch({ type: "DELETE_BLOCK", value: blockId }), []);
    const updateCondition = useCallback(
        ({ blockId, conditionId, fieldName, value }: UpdateConditionPayload) =>
            dispatch({ type: "UPDATE_CONDITION", value: { blockId, conditionId, fieldName, value } }),
        []
    );
    const addNewCondition = useCallback((blockId: string) => {
        dispatch({ type: "ADD_NEW_CONDITION", value: blockId });
    }, []);
    const duplicateCondition = useCallback(
        (blockId: string, conditionId: string) =>
            dispatch({ type: "DUPLICATE_CONDITION", value: { blockId, conditionId } }),
        []
    );
    const deleteCondition = useCallback(
        (blockId: string, conditionId: string) =>
            dispatch({ type: "DELETE_CONDITION", value: { blockId, conditionId } }),
        []
    );

    useImperativeHandle(ref, () => blocks, [blocks]);

    return (
        <RuleBuilderContext.Provider
            value={{
                blocksSeparator,
                conditionsSeparator,
                conditionConfig,
                blocks,
                addNewBlock,
                duplicateBlock,
                deleteBlock,
                updateCondition,
                addNewCondition,
                duplicateCondition,
                deleteCondition
            }}
        >
            {children}
        </RuleBuilderContext.Provider>
    );
});

export { RuleBuilderContext, RuleBuilderContextProvider };
export type { RuleBuilderContextValue };
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useEffect, useState } from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import Tooltip from "@atoms/Tooltip/Tooltip";
import { NODE_TOOLTIP_APPEARANCE_DELAY, NODE_TOOLTIP_HEIGHT, NODE_TOOLTIP_WIDTH } from "./SankeyConstants";
import { calculateTooltipLeft, calculateTooltipTop, formatValues, type SankeyNodePayload } from "./SankeyHelpers";
import type { SankeyNodeProps } from "./SankeyNode";

const StyledTooltipContainer = styled("div")`
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 19px;
    color: #1362a2;
    background-color: white;
    border-radius: 10px;
    border: 1px solid #d4d6d9;
    box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.2);
    width: ${NODE_TOOLTIP_WIDTH}px;
    height: ${NODE_TOOLTIP_HEIGHT}px;
    padding: 16px;
    position: absolute;
    animation: fadein 0.5s;

    @keyframes fadein {
        from {
            opacity: 0;
        }

        to {
            opacity: 1;
        }
    }
`;

const StyledTooltipTitle = styled("div")`
    font-size: 16px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 19px;
    margin-bottom: 4px;
`;

const StyledTooltipIcon = styled("i")`
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 700;
    line-height: 19px;
    margin-right: 8px;
`;

const StyledCreateIcon = styled("i")`
    font-weight: 400;
    float: right;
    cursor: pointer;
`;

type ActionProps = {
    showTooltipAction?: boolean;
    tooltipActionName?: string;
    onActionClick: () => void;
};

const Action = ({ showTooltipAction, tooltipActionName, onActionClick }: ActionProps) => {
    if (!showTooltipAction) return null;
    const createIcon = (
        <StyledCreateIcon className="fas fa-external-link" onClick={onActionClick} data-testid="action-btn" />
    );
    return tooltipActionName ? (
        <Tooltip title={tooltipActionName} placement="top">
            {createIcon}
        </Tooltip>
    ) : (
        createIcon
    );
};

export type NodeTooltipProps = {
    containerDimensions: { w: number; h: number };
    showTooltipAction?: boolean;
    handleTooltipActionClick?: (payload: SankeyNodePayload) => void;
    tooltipActionName?: string;
} & SankeyNodeProps;

const NodeTooltip = ({
    setNodeTooltipData,
    containerDimensions,
    showTooltipAction,
    handleTooltipActionClick = () => {},
    tooltipActionName,
    ...props
}: NodeTooltipProps) => {
    const handleMouseEnter = useCallback(
        () =>
            setNodeTooltipData({
                containerDimensions,
                showTooltipAction,
                handleTooltipActionClick,
                tooltipActionName,
                ...props
            }),
        [setNodeTooltipData, props, containerDimensions, showTooltipAction, handleTooltipActionClick, tooltipActionName]
    );
    const handleMouseLeave = useCallback(() => setNodeTooltipData(null), [setNodeTooltipData]);

    const [visible, setVisible] = useState(false);

    useEffect(() => {
        const interval = setTimeout(() => {
            setVisible(true);
        }, NODE_TOOLTIP_APPEARANCE_DELAY);
        return () => clearTimeout(interval);
    }, []);

    const onActionClick = useCallback(() => {
        handleTooltipActionClick(props.payload);
    }, [props.payload, handleTooltipActionClick]);

    return (
        <StyledTooltipContainer
            style={{
                left: calculateTooltipLeft(props.x, props.width, containerDimensions.w),
                top: calculateTooltipTop(props.y, props.height, containerDimensions.h),
                display: visible ? "block" : "none",
                opacity: visible ? 1 : 0
            }}
            onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter}
            onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
            data-testid="node-tooltip"
        >
            <StyledTooltipTitle data-testid="tooltip-title">
                {props.payload.icon && <StyledTooltipIcon className={`fas fa-${props.payload.icon}`} />}
                {props.payload.name}
                <Action
                    tooltipActionName={tooltipActionName}
                    showTooltipAction={showTooltipAction}
                    onActionClick={onActionClick}
                />
            </StyledTooltipTitle>
            <span data-testid="tooltip-value">{formatValues(props.payload.value)}</span>
        </StyledTooltipContainer>
    );
};

export default NodeTooltip;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import SankeyChart from "./SankeyChart";
import * as constants from "./SankeyConstants";
import { fireEvent, render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { act } from "react-dom/test-utils";

const renderChart = (props: Record<string, any> = {}) => {
    return render(<SankeyChart data={constants.DEFAULT_MOCK_DATA} {...props} width={1000} height={500} />);
};

describe("Sankey Chart Tests", () => {
    const resizeObserver = global.ResizeObserver;

    const renderChartAndHoverFirstNode = (props?: Record<string, any>) => {
        renderChart(props);
        const node = screen.getAllByTestId("node")[0];
        fireEvent.mouseEnter(node);
        expect(screen.getByTestId("node-tooltip")).toBeInTheDocument();
        return { node };
    };

    beforeAll(() => {
        global.ResizeObserver = require("resize-observer-polyfill");
        jest.useFakeTimers();
    });

    afterAll(() => {
        global.ResizeObserver = resizeObserver;
        jest.useRealTimers();
    });

    it("should render a sankey chart", () => {
        const { container } = renderChart();
        expect(screen.getByTestId("sankey-wrapper")).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(container.querySelectorAll(".recharts-responsive-container")).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(container.querySelectorAll(".recharts-wrapper")).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(container.querySelectorAll(".recharts-sankey-links")).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(container.querySelectorAll(".recharts-sankey-nodes")).toHaveLength(1);
    });

    it("should render correct number of nodes", () => {
        renderChart();
        expect(screen.getAllByTestId("node-container")).toHaveLength(constants.DEFAULT_MOCK_DATA.nodes.length);
    });

    it("should render correct number of node labels", () => {
        renderChart();
        expect(screen.getAllByTestId("node-label")).toHaveLength(constants.DEFAULT_MOCK_DATA.nodes.length);
    });

    it("should render correct carry nodes over when prop is true", () => {
        renderChart({ showDropoffCarryoverNodes: true });
        expect(screen.getAllByTestId("node-carry-over")).toHaveLength(3);
    });

    it("should render no carry nodes over when prop is false", () => {
        renderChart({ showDropoffCarryoverNodes: false });
        expect(screen.queryByTestId("node-carry-over")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should render correct number of links", () => {
        renderChart({ showDropoffCarryoverLinks: true });
        expect(screen.getAllByTestId("link")).toHaveLength(constants.DEFAULT_MOCK_DATA.links.length);
    });

    it("should not render render carry over links when prop is false", () => {
        renderChart({ showDropoffCarryoverLinks: false });
        expect(screen.getAllByTestId("link")).toHaveLength(constants.DEFAULT_MOCK_DATA.links.length - 3);
    });

    it("should not render tooltip when not hovering", () => {
        renderChart();
        expect(screen.queryByTestId("node-tooltip")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should render tooltip when hovering node", () => {
        renderChartAndHoverFirstNode();
        expect(screen.getByTestId("tooltip-title")).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(screen.getByTestId("tooltip-value")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should render tooltip action button", () => {
        renderChartAndHoverFirstNode({ showTooltipAction: true });
        expect(screen.getByTestId("action-btn")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should not render tooltip action button when false", () => {
        renderChartAndHoverFirstNode({ showTooltipAction: false });
        expect(screen.queryByTestId("action-btn")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should render tooltip action name", async () => {
        const text = "Test Name";
        renderChartAndHoverFirstNode({ showTooltipAction: true, tooltipActionName: text });
        expect(screen.getByTestId("action-btn")).toBeInTheDocument();
        fireEvent.mouseEnter(screen.getByTestId("node-tooltip"));
        fireEvent.mouseEnter(screen.getByTestId("action-btn"));
        expect(await screen.findByText(text)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should call handleTooltipActionClick when provided", () => {
        const handler = jest.fn();
        renderChartAndHoverFirstNode({
            showTooltipAction: true,
            handleTooltipActionClick: handler
        });
        expect(screen.getByTestId("action-btn")).toBeInTheDocument();
        fireEvent.click(screen.getByTestId("action-btn"));
        expect(handler).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });

    it("should call handleNodeClick when provided", () => {
        const handler = jest.fn();
        renderChart({ handleNodeClick: handler });
        fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByTestId("node")[0]);
        expect(handler).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });

    it("should call handleLinkClick when provided", () => {
        const handler = jest.fn();
        renderChart({ handleLinkClick: handler });
        fireEvent.click(screen.getAllByTestId("link")[0]);
        expect(handler).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });

    it("noop test", () => {
        const noop = jest.spyOn(constants, "NOOP");
        const result = constants.NOOP();
        expect(noop).toHaveBeenCalled();
        expect(result).toBeFalsy();
    });

    it("should hide tooltip after mouse leave", () => {
        const { node } = renderChartAndHoverFirstNode();
        fireEvent.mouseLeave(node);
        expect(screen.queryByTestId("node-tooltip")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should not hide tooltip when hovering in tooltip", () => {
        renderChartAndHoverFirstNode();
        fireEvent.mouseEnter(screen.getByTestId("node-tooltip"));
        expect(screen.getByTestId("node-tooltip")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should hide tooltip when mouse leaves tooltip and node", () => {
        const { node } = renderChartAndHoverFirstNode();
        const tooltip = screen.getByTestId("node-tooltip");
        fireEvent.mouseEnter(tooltip);
        fireEvent.mouseLeave(tooltip);
        fireEvent.mouseLeave(node);
        expect(screen.queryByTestId("node-tooltip")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should delay tooltip appearance", async () => {
        renderChartAndHoverFirstNode();
        expect(screen.getByTestId("node-tooltip")).toHaveStyle("opacity: 0");
        // Advance timers within act to flush updates
        await act(async () => {
            jest.advanceTimersByTime(constants.NODE_TOOLTIP_APPEARANCE_DELAY);
        });
        expect(screen.getByTestId("node-tooltip")).toHaveStyle("opacity: 1");
    });

    it("should render a sankey chart with node value override and dynamic height", () => {
        const { container } = renderChart({ nodeValueOverride: true, dynamicHeight: true });
        expect(screen.getByTestId("sankey-wrapper")).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(container.querySelectorAll(".recharts-responsive-container")).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(container.querySelectorAll(".recharts-wrapper")).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(container.querySelectorAll(".recharts-sankey-links")).toHaveLength(1);
        expect(container.querySelectorAll(".recharts-sankey-nodes")).toHaveLength(1);
    });
});
````

````typescript
import React, { useMemo, useRef, useState } from "react";
import { ResponsiveContainer, Sankey } from "recharts";
import SankeyNode, { type SankeyNodeProps } from "./SankeyNode";
import SankeyLink from "./SankeyLink";
import NodeTooltip from "./NodeTooltip";
import {
    CHART_DEFAULT_HEIGHT,
    CHART_DEFAULT_MIN_HEIGHT,
    CHART_DEFAULT_MIN_WIDTH,
    CHART_DEFAULT_WIDTH,
    CHART_MARGINS,
    ITERATIONS,
    LINK_CURVATURE,
    NODE_VERTICAL_PADDING,
    NODE_WIDTH,
    NOOP,
    type SankeyData
} from "./SankeyConstants";
import { useElementSize } from "./SankeyHooks";
import { countEndNodes } from "./SankeyHelpers";
import type { SankeyNodePayload } from "./SankeyHelpers";
import type { SankeyLinkPayload } from "./SankeyLink";

export type SankeyChartProps = {
    data: SankeyData;
    linkCurvature?: number;
    iterations?: number;
    /**
     * Callback when a node is clicked
     * Signature: function(node: object) => void
     */
    handleNodeClick?: (node: SankeyNodePayload) => void;
    /**
     * Callback when a link is clicked
     * Signature: function(link: object) => void
     */
    handleLinkClick?: (link: SankeyLinkPayload) => void;
    showDropoffCarryoverNodes?: boolean;
    showDropoffCarryoverLinks?: boolean;
    showTooltipAction?: boolean;
    /**
     * Hides tooltip when hovering over a node
     * default is false
     */
    hideTooltip?: boolean;
    /**
     * Callback when tooltip action is clicked
     * Signature: function(node: object) => void
     */
    handleTooltipActionClick?: (node: SankeyNodePayload) => void;
    tooltipActionName?: string;
    width?: string | number;
    height?: string | number;
    /**
     * Overrides the height prop and dynamically calculates the
     * height based on the number of end nodes
     */
    dynamicHeight?: boolean;
    minWidth?: string | number;
    minHeight?: string | number;
    /**
     * The value and height of a given node is typically calculated based on
     * the sum of the nodes linked on its right (when this prop is false).
     * When this is set to true, the node value/height calculations will be overridden
     * and instead use the values provided in the link portion of the data prop.
     * Also overrides dropoff calculations.
     * default is false
     */
    nodeValueOverride?: boolean;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const SankeyChart = ({
    data,
    handleNodeClick = NOOP,
    handleLinkClick = NOOP,
    showDropoffCarryoverNodes = true,
    showDropoffCarryoverLinks = false,
    showTooltipAction,
    hideTooltip,
    handleTooltipActionClick = NOOP,
    tooltipActionName,
    linkCurvature = LINK_CURVATURE,
    iterations = ITERATIONS,
    width = CHART_DEFAULT_WIDTH,
    height = CHART_DEFAULT_HEIGHT,
    minWidth = CHART_DEFAULT_MIN_WIDTH,
    minHeight = CHART_DEFAULT_MIN_HEIGHT,
    dynamicHeight,
    "data-testid": dataTestId = "",
    nodeValueOverride = false
}: SankeyChartProps) => {
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    const ref = useRef<any>(null);
    const containerDimensions = useElementSize(ref.current?.containerRef ?? null);

    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    const [nodeTooltipData, setNodeTooltipData] = useState<any>(null);

    const calculatedHeight = useMemo(() => {
        if (!dynamicHeight)
            return typeof height === "number"
                ? Math.max(height, typeof minHeight === "number" ? minHeight : 0)
                : height;
        const endNodes = countEndNodes(data);
        return endNodes * (NODE_VERTICAL_PADDING + 25);
    }, [data, dynamicHeight, height, minHeight]);

    return (
        <div
            style={{ width, height: calculatedHeight, minWidth, minHeight, position: "relative" }}
            data-testid={`sankey-wrapper ${dataTestId}`}
        >
            <ResponsiveContainer width={width} height={height} minWidth={minWidth} minHeight={minHeight} ref={ref}>
                <Sankey
                    data={data}
                    linkCurvature={linkCurvature}
                    iterations={iterations}
                    margin={CHART_MARGINS}
                    nodePadding={NODE_VERTICAL_PADDING}
                    nodeWidth={NODE_WIDTH}
                    node={
                        // @ts-expect-error Recharts will add missing props at runtime
                        <SankeyNode
                            data={data}
                            handleNodeClick={handleNodeClick}
                            containerHeight={containerDimensions.w}
                            showDropoffCarryoverNodes={showDropoffCarryoverNodes}
                            setNodeTooltipData={setNodeTooltipData}
                            nodeValueOverride={nodeValueOverride}
                        />
                    }
                    link={
                        // @ts-expect-error Recharts will add missing props at runtime
                        <SankeyLink
                            data={data}
                            handleLinkClick={handleLinkClick}
                            showDropoffCarryoverLinks={showDropoffCarryoverLinks}
                            nodeValueOverride={nodeValueOverride}
                        />
                    }
                />
            </ResponsiveContainer>

            {nodeTooltipData && !hideTooltip && (
                <NodeTooltip
                    {...nodeTooltipData}
                    setNodeTooltipData={setNodeTooltipData}
                    containerDimensions={containerDimensions}
                    showTooltipAction={showTooltipAction}
                    handleTooltipActionClick={handleTooltipActionClick}
                    tooltipActionName={tooltipActionName}
                />
            )}
        </div>
    );
};

export default SankeyChart;
````

````typescript
export const NOOP = () => {};
````

````typescript
import {
    calculateCarryoverTotal,
    calculateTooltipLeft,
    calculateTooltipTop,
    formatValues,
    truncateNodeLabel
} from "./SankeyHelpers";
import { DEFAULT_MOCK_DATA } from "./SankeyConstants";

describe("Sankey Chart Helpers", () => {
    it("formatValues should correctly format", () => {
        expect(formatValues(100)).toBe("100");
        expect(formatValues(1000)).toBe("1,000");
        expect(formatValues(100000)).toBe("100,000");
        expect(formatValues(1000000)).toBe("1,000,000");
        expect(formatValues(undefined)).toBe("");
    });
    it("truncateNodeLabel should truncate correctly", () => {
        expect(truncateNodeLabel("this is short")).toBe("this is short");
        expect(truncateNodeLabel("this is really really really really long")).toBe("this is really really reall...");
    });
    it("calculateTooltipLeft should calculate correctly", () => {
        expect(calculateTooltipLeft(50, 25, 500)).toBe(70.83333333333334);
        expect(calculateTooltipLeft(450, 25, 500)).toBe(205);
    });
    it("calculateTooltipTop should calculate correctly", () => {
        expect(calculateTooltipTop(50, 100, 500)).toBe(90);
        expect(calculateTooltipTop(450, 100, 500)).toBe(450);
    });
    it("calculateCarryoverTotal should calculate correctly", () => {
        const payload = {
            sourceLinks: [10, 13, 14]
        } as any;
        expect(calculateCarryoverTotal(payload, DEFAULT_MOCK_DATA)).toBe(73);
        const payload2 = {
            sourceLinks: [17, 18]
        } as any;
        expect(calculateCarryoverTotal(payload2, DEFAULT_MOCK_DATA)).toBe(114);
        const payload3 = {
            sourceLinks: [1]
        } as any;
        expect(calculateCarryoverTotal(payload3, DEFAULT_MOCK_DATA)).toBe(0);
    });
});
````

## File: src/components/organisms/SankeyChart/SankeyLink.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import { useNodeState } from "./SankeyHooks";
import {
    NODE_COLORS,
    NODE_LABEL_HEIGHT,
    NODE_VALUE_MARGIN_TOP,
    NODE_VARIANTS,
    type SankeyData,
    type NodeVariant
} from "./SankeyConstants";

export type SankeyLinkPayload = {
    source: {
        value: number;
        variant: NodeVariant;
        y: number;
        dy: number;
    };
    target: {
        variant: NodeVariant;
    };
};

export type SankeyLinkProps = {
    data: SankeyData;
    handleLinkClick?: (payload: SankeyLinkPayload) => void;
    showDropoffCarryoverLinks?: boolean;
    nodeValueOverride?: boolean;
    payload: SankeyLinkPayload;
    sourceX: number;
    sourceY: number;
    targetX: number;
    targetY: number;
    sourceControlX: number;
    targetControlX: number;
    linkWidth: number;
    index: number;
};

const SankeyLink = ({
    data,
    handleLinkClick = () => {},
    showDropoffCarryoverLinks,
    nodeValueOverride,
    ...props
}: SankeyLinkProps) => {
    const [state, handleMouseEnter, handleMouseLeave] = useNodeState();
    const colors = NODE_COLORS[props.payload.target.variant][state];

    const onLinkClick = useCallback(() => {
        handleLinkClick(props.payload);
    }, [props.payload, handleLinkClick]);

    if (
        !showDropoffCarryoverLinks &&
        props.payload.target.variant === NODE_VARIANTS.DROP_OFF &&
        props.payload.source.variant === NODE_VARIANTS.DROP_OFF
    ) {
        return null;
    }

    let sourceY = props.sourceY;
    const centerOfLink = props.linkWidth / 2;
    const nodeTopY = props.payload.source.y + NODE_LABEL_HEIGHT + NODE_VALUE_MARGIN_TOP;
    // Adjust link position when overriding node value (which changes node height)
    if (props.payload.source && nodeValueOverride) {
        const link = data.links[props.index];
        const sourceLink = data.links.find(l => l.target === link.source);
        if (sourceLink) {
            const labelValue = sourceLink?.value;
            const nodeHeight = (labelValue / props.payload.source.value) * props.payload.source.dy;
            const heightDiff = props.payload.source.dy - nodeHeight;
            if (heightDiff) {
                sourceY = Math.max(nodeTopY + centerOfLink, sourceY - heightDiff);
            }
        }
    }

    return (
        <g
            data-testid="link"
            className="recharts-layer"
            onClick={onLinkClick}
            onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnter}
            onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeave}
            cursor="pointer"
        >
            <path
                style={{ filter: "drop-shadow( 0px 1px 1px rgba(0, 0, 0, .1))" }}
                fill={colors.linkFill}
                strokeWidth={0}
                opacity="0.6"
                d={`
                  M${props.sourceX},${sourceY + centerOfLink}
                  C${props.sourceControlX},${sourceY + centerOfLink}
                    ${props.targetControlX},${props.targetY + centerOfLink}
                    ${props.targetX},${props.targetY + centerOfLink}
                  L${props.targetX},${props.targetY - centerOfLink}
                  C${props.targetControlX},${props.targetY - centerOfLink}
                    ${props.sourceControlX},${sourceY - centerOfLink}
                    ${props.sourceX},${sourceY - centerOfLink}
                  Z
                `}
            />
        </g>
    );
};

export default SankeyLink;
````

## File: src/components/organisms/SankeyChart/SankeyNode.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import {
    NODE_COLORS,
    NODE_LABEL_HEIGHT,
    NODE_LABEL_WIDTH,
    NODE_VALUE_MARGIN_TOP,
    type SankeyData
} from "./SankeyConstants";
import { Rectangle } from "recharts";
import { formatValues, truncateNodeLabel, type SankeyNodePayload } from "./SankeyHelpers";
import { useDropoffCarryoverValues, useNodeState } from "./SankeyHooks";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";

const StyledNodeLabelContainer = styled("div")<{ color: string }>`
    font-size: 13.5px;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 16px;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    justify-content: flex-end;
    align-items: flex-start;
    color: ${(props: { color: string }) => props.color};
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
`;

const StyledNodeValue = styled("div")`
    font-weight: 700;
    margin-top: ${NODE_VALUE_MARGIN_TOP}px;
`;

const StyledNodeIcon = styled("i")`
    margin-right: 4px;
    font-size: 12px;
`;

export type SankeyNodeProps = {
    data: SankeyData;
    handleNodeClick?: (payload: SankeyNodePayload) => void;
    // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/no-explicit-any
    setNodeTooltipData: (data: any) => void;
    containerHeight: number;
    showDropoffCarryoverNodes?: boolean;
    nodeValueOverride?: boolean;
    x: number;
    y: number;
    width: number;
    height: number;
    index: number;
    payload: SankeyNodePayload;
};

const SankeyNode = ({
    data,
    handleNodeClick = () => {},
    setNodeTooltipData,
    containerHeight,
    showDropoffCarryoverNodes,
    nodeValueOverride,
    ...props
}: SankeyNodeProps) => {
    const [state, handleMouseEnter, handleMouseLeave] = useNodeState();

    const handleMouseEnterWrapped = useCallback(
        (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
            handleMouseEnter(e);
            setNodeTooltipData({
                data,
                handleNodeClick,
                setNodeTooltipData,
                containerHeight,
                showDropoffCarryoverNodes,
                nodeValueOverride,
                ...props
            });
        },
        [
            props,
            handleMouseEnter,
            setNodeTooltipData,
            data,
            handleNodeClick,
            containerHeight,
            showDropoffCarryoverNodes,
            nodeValueOverride
        ]
    );

    const handleMouseLeaveWrapped = useCallback(
        (e: React.MouseEvent) => {
            handleMouseLeave(e);
            setNodeTooltipData(null);
        },
        [setNodeTooltipData, handleMouseLeave]
    );

    const colors = NODE_COLORS[props.payload.variant][state];

    const { newDropoffTotal, carryoverTotal } = useDropoffCarryoverValues(props.payload, data);
    const newDropoffPercentage = (newDropoffTotal / props.payload.value) * 100;
    let heightOfNewDropoffRect = (newDropoffPercentage / 100) * props.height;

    let labelValue = props.payload.value;
    if (nodeValueOverride) {
        const link = data.links.find(l => l.target === props.index);
        if (link) {
            labelValue = link?.value;
            heightOfNewDropoffRect = (labelValue / props.payload.value) * props.height;
        }
    }

    const onNodeClick = useCallback(() => {
        handleNodeClick(props.payload);
    }, [props.payload, handleNodeClick]);

    return (
        <g className="recharts-layer" data-testid="node-container">
            <line
                x1={props.x}
                y1={props.y}
                x2={props.x}
                y2={containerHeight}
                stroke="#D6D6D6"
                strokeWidth={1}
                shapeRendering="crispEdges"
            />
            <foreignObject
                width={NODE_LABEL_WIDTH}
                height={NODE_LABEL_HEIGHT}
                x={props.x + 8}
                y={props.y - NODE_LABEL_HEIGHT - 5}
                pointerEvents="none"
                data-testid="node-label"
            >
                <StyledNodeLabelContainer color={colors.nodeFill}>
                    <div>
                        {props.payload.icon && <StyledNodeIcon className={`fas fa-${props.payload.icon}`} />}
                        {truncateNodeLabel(props.payload.name)}
                    </div>
                    <StyledNodeValue>{formatValues(labelValue)}</StyledNodeValue>
                </StyledNodeLabelContainer>
            </foreignObject>
            <g
                data-testid="node"
                className="recharts-layer"
                onClick={onNodeClick}
                onMouseEnter={handleMouseEnterWrapped}
                onMouseLeave={handleMouseLeaveWrapped}
                cursor="pointer"
            >
                <Rectangle
                    x={props.x}
                    y={props.y}
                    width={props.width}
                    height={heightOfNewDropoffRect}
                    fill={colors.nodeFill}
                    fillOpacity="1"
                />
                {showDropoffCarryoverNodes && carryoverTotal > 0 && (
                    <rect
                        data-testid="node-carry-over"
                        x={props.x}
                        y={props.y + heightOfNewDropoffRect}
                        width={props.width}
                        height={props.height - heightOfNewDropoffRect}
                        fill={colors.carryoverFill}
                        fillOpacity="1"
                    />
                )}
            </g>
        </g>
    );
};

export default SankeyNode;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { screen, render } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { SideNavTab } from "./SideNavTab";
import { SideNavigationContextProvider } from "../SideNavigationContext";

jest.mock("@mui/material", () => {
    return {
        ...jest.requireActual("@mui/material"),
        // mock out fade animation/transition time
        Fade: (props: any) => <div>{props.children}</div>
    };
});

describe("Side Nav Tab Tests", () => {
    it("should click a tab and expand it", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const onClick = jest.fn();
        render(
            <SideNavigationContextProvider>
                <SideNavTab title="TestTab" isExpandable onClick={onClick} data-testid="nav-tab" />
            </SideNavigationContextProvider>
        );

        await user.click(screen.getByText("TestTab"));

        expect(onClick).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should render a tab and collapse it", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const onClick = jest.fn();
        render(
            <SideNavigationContextProvider initialMainTabSelected="TestTab">
                <SideNavTab title="TestTab" id="TestTab" isExpandable onClick={onClick} data-testid="nav-tab" />
            </SideNavigationContextProvider>
        );

        await user.click(screen.getByText("TestTab"));

        expect(onClick).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should render a non collapsed tab", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const onClick = jest.fn();
        render(
            <SideNavigationContextProvider>
                <SideNavTab title="TestTab" isExpandable isExpanded />
            </SideNavigationContextProvider>
        );

        await user.click(screen.getByText("TestTab"));

        expect(onClick).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should show a hover over tab list and hide", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        render(
            <SideNavigationContextProvider initialMainTabSelected="TestTab" initialIsCollapsed>
                <SideNavTab id="TestTab" title="TestTab" data-testid="tab" isExpandable isExpanded>
                    Popper!
                </SideNavTab>
            </SideNavigationContextProvider>
        );

        await user.hover(screen.getByTestId("tab"));

        expect(screen.queryByText(/Popper!/)).toBeInTheDocument();

        await user.unhover(screen.getByTestId("tab"));

        expect(screen.queryByText(/Popper!/)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should show a locked selected tab list", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        render(
            <SideNavigationContextProvider initialMainTabSelected="TestTab" initialIsCollapsed>
                <SideNavTab
                    {...({ lockedSelected: true } as any)}
                    title="TestTab"
                    data-testid="tab"
                    isExpandable
                    isExpanded
                >
                    Popper!
                </SideNavTab>
            </SideNavigationContextProvider>
        );

        await user.hover(screen.getByTestId("tab"));

        expect(screen.queryByText(/Popper!/)).toBeInTheDocument();

        await user.unhover(screen.getByTestId("tab"));

        expect(screen.queryByText(/Popper!/)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should show a non selected hover tab list", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        render(
            <SideNavigationContextProvider initialIsCollapsed>
                <SideNavTab
                    {...({ lockedSelected: true } as any)}
                    title="TestTab"
                    data-testid="tab"
                    isExpandable
                    isExpanded
                >
                    Popper!
                </SideNavTab>
            </SideNavigationContextProvider>
        );

        await user.hover(screen.getByTestId("tab"));

        expect(screen.queryByText(/Popper!/)).toBeInTheDocument();

        await user.unhover(screen.getByTestId("tab"));

        expect(screen.queryByText(/Popper!/)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });
});
````

````typescript
import React, { useState } from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import PageGrid from "@atoms/PageGrid/PageGrid";
import SectionalGrid from "@atoms/SectionalGrid/SectionalGrid";
import { Backdrop, type BackdropProps } from "@mui/material";
import { SlideoutPanelContextProvider } from "./SlideoutPanelContext";
import SlidePanelWrapper from "./SlidePanelWrapper";

export type SlideoutPanelRootProps = {
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly?: number;
    onOutsideClick?: () => void;
    onExited?: () => void;
    muiColumnsOverride?: number;
    isOpen?: boolean;
    closeOnKeyEscape?: boolean;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const SlideoutPanelRoot: React.FC<SlideoutPanelRootProps> = ({
    children,
    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly,
    onOutsideClick,
    onExited,
    muiColumnsOverride,
    isOpen,
    closeOnKeyEscape,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}) => {
    const [slideoutMargin, setSlideoutMargin] = useState(0);

    return (
        <StyledBackdrop
            data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-backdrop`}
            onExited={onExited}
            mountOnEnter
            unmountOnExit
            open={isOpen ?? false}
            $zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly={zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly}
            $muiColumnsOverride={muiColumnsOverride}
        >
            <SlideoutPanelContextProvider>
                <PageGrid>
                    {/* Left spacer: takes remaining columns to push slideout to the right */}
                    <SectionalGrid
                        gutterSpacing={2}
                        columnSize={(muiColumnsOverride ? ((12 - muiColumnsOverride) as number) : 2) as any}
                    />
                    {/* Slideout container: takes the specified number of columns */}
                    <StyledSectionalGrid
                        gutterSpacing={2}
                        columnSize={(muiColumnsOverride ?? 10) as any}
                        $muiColumnsOverride={muiColumnsOverride}
                    >
                        <SlideLeftTransition $margin={slideoutMargin} $muiColumnsOverride={muiColumnsOverride}>
                            <SlidePanelWrapper
                                data-testid={dataTestId}
                                zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly={zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly}
                                triggerMarginUpdate={setSlideoutMargin}
                                onOutsideClick={onOutsideClick}
                                isMain
                                isOpen={isOpen}
                                closeOnKeyEscape={closeOnKeyEscape}
                            >
                                {children}
                            </SlidePanelWrapper>
                        </SlideLeftTransition>
                    </StyledSectionalGrid>
                </PageGrid>
            </SlideoutPanelContextProvider>
        </StyledBackdrop>
    );
};

type StyledBackdropHOCProps = BackdropProps & {
    $zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly?: number;
};

const StyledBackdropHOC = React.memo<StyledBackdropHOCProps>(({ $zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly, ...props }) => (
    <Backdrop {...props} />
));

type SlideLeftTransitionProps = {
    $margin: number;
    $muiColumnsOverride?: number;
};

const SlideLeftTransition = styled("div")<SlideLeftTransitionProps>`
    margin-left: ${props => props.$margin}px;
    transition: margin-left 225ms;
    /* Use viewport units for consistent sizing - Grid v2 doesn't constrain parent width like Grid Legacy */
    width: ${props => (props.$muiColumnsOverride ? `${(props.$muiColumnsOverride / 12) * 100}vw` : "83.3333vw")};

`;
````

````typescript
import React, { useState, useCallback } from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import Slide, { type SlideProps } from "@mui/material/Slide";
import SlideoutPanelChild from "./SlideoutPanelChild";
import { GRAY_100, GRAY_300 } from "@css/constants";

export type SlidePanelWrapperProps = {
    children?: React.ReactNode;
    onOutsideClick?: () => void;
    isOpen?: boolean;
    isMain?: boolean;
    triggerMarginUpdate?: (margin: number) => void;
    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly?: number;
    closeOnKeyEscape?: boolean;
    muiColumnsOverride?: number;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const SlidePanelWrapper: React.FC<SlidePanelWrapperProps> = ({
    children,
    onOutsideClick,
    isOpen,
    isMain,
    triggerMarginUpdate,
    zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly,
    closeOnKeyEscape,
    muiColumnsOverride,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}) => {
    const [showTabBorder, setShowTabBorder] = useState(false);
    const [isEntering, setIsEntering] = useState(false);

    const onEntering = useCallback(() => {
        setIsEntering(true);
    }, []);

    const onEntered = useCallback(() => {
        setShowTabBorder(true);
    }, []);

    const onExiting = useCallback(() => {
        setShowTabBorder(false);
    }, []);

    const onExited = useCallback(() => {
        setIsEntering(false);
    }, []);

    return (
        <StyledSlide
            //unique-ish* class name to tie for outside click event handling
            className="tlium-slideout-slide-panel-stacked-page"
            data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-slide-page`}
            $showTab={showTabBorder}
            in={isOpen}
            direction="left"
            $zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly={zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly}
            onEntering={onEntering}
            onExiting={onExiting}
            onExited={onExited}
            onEntered={onEntered}
            mountOnEnter
            unmountOnExit
        >
            <PanelWrap $showBorder={showTabBorder} $isMain={isMain} $muiColumnsOverride={muiColumnsOverride}>
                {isEntering && (
                    <SlideoutPanelChild
                        onOutsideClick={onOutsideClick}
                        isOpen={isOpen}
                        isMain={isMain}
                        data-testid={dataTestId}
                        triggerMarginUpdate={isMain && triggerMarginUpdate ? triggerMarginUpdate : undefined}
                        closeOnKeyEscape={closeOnKeyEscape}
                    >
                        {children}
                    </SlideoutPanelChild>
                )}
            </PanelWrap>
        </StyledSlide>
    );
};

type StyledSlideProps = SlideProps & {
    $zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly?: number;
    $showTab?: boolean;
};

const StyledSlide = styled(Slide, {
    shouldForwardProp: prop => !["$zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly", "$showTab"].includes(prop as string)
})<StyledSlideProps>`
    z-index: ${({ $zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly }) => ($zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly ? $zIndexUseAsLastResortOnly : 1000)};
    background: ${props => (props.$showTab ? GRAY_100 : "transparent")};
    box-sizing: border-box;
`;

type PanelWrapProps = {
    $showBorder?: boolean;
    $isMain?: boolean;
    $muiColumnsOverride?: number;
};

const PanelWrap = styled("div")<PanelWrapProps>`
    width: ${({ $isMain, $muiColumnsOverride }) => {
        if ($isMain && !$muiColumnsOverride) return "inherit";
        if ($muiColumnsOverride && !$isMain) return `${($muiColumnsOverride / 12) * 100}vw`;
        return "100%";
    }};
    height: 100vh;
    position: ${props => (props.$muiColumnsOverride ? "fixed" : "absolute")}; /* Use fixed for nested slideouts */
    top: 0;
    right: ${props => !props.$isMain && props.$muiColumnsOverride && 0}; /* Position nested slideouts to the right */
    left: ${props => (props.$isMain || props.$muiColumnsOverride ? "auto" : "0")}; /* Reset left positioning */
    border-left: ${props => (props.$showBorder ? `1px solid ${GRAY_300}` : 0)};
    max-width: ${props => props.$muiColumnsOverride && `${(props.$muiColumnsOverride / 12) * 100}vw`};
    box-sizing: border-box;
    z-index: ${props => props.$muiColumnsOverride && 1001}; /* Ensure nested slideouts appear above */
`;

export default SlidePanelWrapper;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import useLazyBody, { type UseLazyBodyParams } from "./useLazyBody";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";

describe("useLazyBody hook test", () => {
    const createRows = (number: number): UseLazyBodyParams["rows"] => {
        const rows: UseLazyBodyParams["rows"] = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < number; i++) {
            rows.push({
                cells: [
                    {
                        column: {
                            type: i % 2 ? "text" : "status",
                            cellWidth: "100px"
                        },
                        getCellProps: () => {
                            return {
                                key: i
                            };
                        },
                        render: () => {
                            return <div>Stuff</div>;
                        }
                    }
                ],
                getRowProps: () => {
                    return {
                        key: i
                    };
                }
            } as unknown as UseLazyBodyParams["rows"][number]);
        }
        return rows;
    };

    type RandomComponentProps = {
        numberOfRows: number;
        prefilterAmount: number;
    };

    const RandomComponent = ({ numberOfRows, prefilterAmount }: RandomComponentProps) => {
        const rows = createRows(numberOfRows);

        const { getCellInfo, increaseRowsLoaded, lazyRows } = useLazyBody({
            rows,
            preGlobalFilteredRowsLength: prefilterAmount
        });

        return (
            <div onClick={() => increaseRowsLoaded()} data-testid="test">
                <span>{getCellInfo(0).dataTypes[0]}</span>
                <span>{getCellInfo(0).cellWidths[0]}</span>
                <span>{lazyRows}</span>
            </div>
        );
    };

    it("should handle prefilteramount differs of rows", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const { rerender } = render(<RandomComponent numberOfRows={300} prefilterAmount={300} />);

        rerender(<RandomComponent numberOfRows={200} prefilterAmount={300} />);

        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("test"));

        expect(screen.getByText("100")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should get cell information ", () => {
        render(<RandomComponent numberOfRows={100} prefilterAmount={100} />);

        expect(screen.getByText("100")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should get number of rows needed to load", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        render(<RandomComponent numberOfRows={100} prefilterAmount={100} />);

        //clicks div to see if there is more rows to increase by
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("test"));

        expect(screen.getByText("100")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should increase the number of rows needed to load", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        render(<RandomComponent numberOfRows={200} prefilterAmount={200} />);

        //clicks div to see if there is more rows to increase by
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("test"));

        expect(screen.getByText("200")).toBeInTheDocument();

        //we are at the limit, it should still be 200
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("test"));

        expect(screen.getByText("200")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should increase the number of rows needed to load", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        render(<RandomComponent numberOfRows={300} prefilterAmount={300} />);

        //clicks div to see if there is more rows to increase by
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("test"));

        expect(screen.getByText("200")).toBeInTheDocument();

        //clicks div to see if there is more rows to increase by
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("test"));

        expect(screen.getByText("300")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
});
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import useLazyRowTriggerInView, { type UseLazyRowTriggerInViewParams } from "./useLazyRowTriggerInView";
import { render } from "@testing-library/react";

describe("useLazyRowTriggerInView hook test,", () => {
    let lazyAddTriggered: boolean;
    const setLazyAddTriggered = (newValue: boolean) => (lazyAddTriggered = newValue);
    let triggerLazyAdd: (() => void) | null = () => setLazyAddTriggered(true);

    let trigger: boolean;
    const setTrigger = (newValue: boolean) => (trigger = newValue);

    let inView: boolean;
    const setInView = (newValue: boolean) => (inView = newValue);

    type WrapperComponentProps = UseLazyRowTriggerInViewParams;

    const WrapperComponent = ({ triggerLazyAdd, inView, setTrigger, trigger }: WrapperComponentProps) => {
        useLazyRowTriggerInView({
            triggerLazyAdd: triggerLazyAdd,
            inView: inView,
            setTrigger: setTrigger,
            trigger: trigger
        });

        return <></>;
    };

    it("should call triggerLazyAdd function and set trigger to true when conditions are met", () => {
        setLazyAddTriggered(false);
        setInView(true);
        setTrigger(false);

        render(
            <WrapperComponent
                setTrigger={setTrigger}
                trigger={trigger}
                inView={inView}
                triggerLazyAdd={triggerLazyAdd ?? undefined}
            />
        );

        expect(lazyAddTriggered).toBeTruthy();
        expect(trigger).toBeTruthy();
    });

    it("should not call triggerLazyAdd function or set trigger to true when conditions are not met", () => {
        setLazyAddTriggered(false);
        setInView(false);
        setTrigger(false);

        render(
            <WrapperComponent
                setTrigger={setTrigger}
                trigger={trigger}
                inView={inView}
                triggerLazyAdd={triggerLazyAdd ?? undefined}
            />
        );
        expect(lazyAddTriggered).toBeFalsy();
        expect(trigger).toBeFalsy();

        setInView(false);
        setTrigger(true);

        render(
            <WrapperComponent
                setTrigger={setTrigger}
                trigger={trigger}
                inView={inView}
                triggerLazyAdd={triggerLazyAdd ?? undefined}
            />
        );
        expect(lazyAddTriggered).toBeFalsy();
    });

    it("should not call triggerLazyAdd when triggerLazyAdd is falsy", () => {
        setLazyAddTriggered(false);
        setInView(true);
        setTrigger(false);
        triggerLazyAdd = null;

        render(
            <WrapperComponent
                setTrigger={setTrigger}
                trigger={trigger}
                inView={inView}
                triggerLazyAdd={triggerLazyAdd ?? undefined}
            />
        );
        expect(lazyAddTriggered).toBeFalsy();
        expect(trigger).toBeFalsy();
    });
});
````

## File: src/components/organisms/table/TableHooks/useSelectedRows.tsx
````typescript
import { useEffect, useMemo } from "react";
import type { Row } from "react-table";
import usePrevious from "@hooks/usePrevious";

type UseSelectedRowsParams = {
    overwriteSelection: Record<string, boolean>;
    preGlobalFilteredRows: Row[];
    onSelectedRowChanged: ((ids: string[]) => void) | undefined;
};

const useSelectedRows = ({
    overwriteSelection,
    preGlobalFilteredRows,
    onSelectedRowChanged
}: UseSelectedRowsParams) => {
    const selectedRows = useMemo(() => {
        const filteredSelectedRowIds = Object.keys(overwriteSelection).filter(
            row => preGlobalFilteredRows[Number(row)]
        );
        return filteredSelectedRowIds.map(row => {
            const rowInfo = { ...preGlobalFilteredRows[Number(row)].original } as Record<string, unknown>;
            rowInfo["_dataRowIndex"] = row;
            return rowInfo;
        });
    }, [overwriteSelection, preGlobalFilteredRows]);

    const previousSelectedRowIds = usePrevious(overwriteSelection);

    useEffect(() => {
        // first render, skip trigger of callback
        if (
            typeof previousSelectedRowIds !== "undefined" &&
            previousSelectedRowIds !== overwriteSelection &&
            !!onSelectedRowChanged
        ) {
            onSelectedRowChanged(Object.keys(overwriteSelection));
        }
    }, [overwriteSelection, previousSelectedRowIds, onSelectedRowChanged]);

    return selectedRows;
};

export { useSelectedRows };
export default useSelectedRows;
````

````typescript
import React, { useState } from "react";
import Wizard from "./Wizard";
import { useWizardValidation } from "./WizardContext";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";

const WIZARD_STEPS = [
    { id: 1, title: "Step 1" },
    { id: 2, title: "Step 2" },
    { id: 3, title: "Step 3" }
];

const WizardStep = ({
    id,
    onValidation,
    children
}: {
    id: number;
    onValidation?: () => boolean;
    children: React.ReactNode;
}) => {
    useWizardValidation(id, onValidation);

    return children;
};

const CloseWizardTest = () => {
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(true);

    return (
        <Wizard steps={WIZARD_STEPS} isOpen={isOpen} onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)} data-testid="wizard-test">
            <WizardStep id={1}>step1</WizardStep>
            <WizardStep id={2}>step2</WizardStep>
            <WizardStep id={3}>step3</WizardStep>
        </Wizard>
    );
};

describe("Wizard Tests", () => {
    const ORIGINAL_ENV = process.env;
    beforeEach(() => {
        jest.resetModules();
        process.env = { ...ORIGINAL_ENV };
    });

    afterAll(() => {
        process.env = ORIGINAL_ENV;
    });

    it("should render wizard", () => {
        render(
            <Wizard steps={WIZARD_STEPS} isOpen={true} data-testid="wizard-test">
                <div>step1</div>
                <div>step2</div>
                <div>step3</div>
            </Wizard>
        );

        expect(screen.getByTestId("wizard-test")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should render save button on last step", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const onSave = jest.fn();
        render(
            <Wizard steps={WIZARD_STEPS} isOpen={true} onSave={onSave} data-testid="wizard-test">
                <div>step1</div>
                <div>step2</div>
                <div>step3</div>
            </Wizard>
        );

        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("wizard-test-primary-button"));
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("wizard-test-primary-button"));
        await user.click(screen.getByText("Save"));

        expect(onSave).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should handle going to next/previous step", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        render(
            <Wizard steps={WIZARD_STEPS} isOpen={true} data-testid="wizard-test">
                <div>step1</div>
                <div>step2</div>
                <div>step3</div>
            </Wizard>
        );

        expect(screen.getByTestId("wizard-test-primary-button")).toBeInTheDocument();
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("wizard-test-primary-button"));

        expect(screen.getByTestId("wizard-test-secondary-button")).toBeInTheDocument();
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("wizard-test-secondary-button"));
    });

    it("should call validation functions only when set for the active step", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const onValidation = jest.fn(() => true);

        render(
            <Wizard steps={WIZARD_STEPS} isOpen={true} renderActiveOnly data-testid="wizard-test">
                <WizardStep id={1} onValidation={onValidation}>
                    step1
                </WizardStep>
                <WizardStep id={2}>step2</WizardStep>
                <WizardStep id={3}>step3</WizardStep>
            </Wizard>
        );

        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("wizard-test-primary-button"));
        await screen.findByText("step2");
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("wizard-test-primary-button"));
        await screen.findByText("step3");
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("wizard-test-primary-button"));

        expect(onValidation).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
    });

    it("should not go to next step when validation returns false", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const onValidation = jest.fn(() => false);
        render(
            <Wizard steps={WIZARD_STEPS} isOpen={true} data-testid="wizard-test">
                <WizardStep id={1} onValidation={onValidation}>
                    step1
                </WizardStep>
                <WizardStep id={2}>step2</WizardStep>
                <WizardStep id={3}>step3</WizardStep>
            </Wizard>
        );

        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("wizard-test-primary-button"));

        expect(screen.queryByTestId("wizard-test-secondary-button")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should unmount children on close", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        render(<CloseWizardTest />);

        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("wizard-test-primary-button"));
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("wizard-test-cancel-button"));

        expect(screen.queryByText("step2")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should render only the active step when renderActiveOnly is set", () => {
        render(
            <Wizard steps={WIZARD_STEPS} isOpen={true} renderActiveOnly>
                <div>step1</div>
                <div>step2</div>
            </Wizard>
        );

        expect(screen.queryByText("step1")).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(screen.queryByText("step2")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should render wizard with console warn", () => {
        process.env = { NODE_ENV: "development" };
        console.warn = jest.fn();
        render(
            <Wizard steps={WIZARD_STEPS} isOpen={true} data-testid="wizard-test">
                <div>step1</div>
                <div>step2</div>
                <div>step3</div>
            </Wizard>
        );

        expect(console.warn).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should render wizard with no console warn", () => {
        process.env = { NODE_ENV: "production" };
        console.warn = jest.fn();
        render(
            <Wizard steps={WIZARD_STEPS} isOpen={true} data-testid="wizard-test">
                <div>step1</div>
                <div>step2</div>
                <div>step3</div>
            </Wizard>
        );

        expect(console.warn).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });
});
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import { StyledButtonActions, StyledButtonActionsContainer, StyledLineSepartor } from "@css/buttonGroupAction";
import Button, { type ButtonProps } from "../atoms/button/Button";

export type FooterButton = Omit<ButtonProps, "onClick"> & {
    onClick?: (event: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, onClose?: () => void) => void;
    ariaLabel?: string;
};

export type ButtonGroupActionsProps = {
    footerButtonGroup?: FooterButton[];
    "data-testid"?: string;
    onClose?: () => void;
};

const ButtonGroupActions: React.FC<ButtonGroupActionsProps> = ({
    footerButtonGroup,
    "data-testid": dataTestId,
    onClose
}) => {
    const handleOnClick = useCallback(
        (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>, button: FooterButton) => {
            button?.onClick && button.onClick(e, onClose);
        },
        [onClose]
    );
    const handleOnMouseDown = (e: React.MouseEvent<HTMLButtonElement>) => {
        // Prevent input blur event which triggers closing the Popper
        e.preventDefault();
    };
    return (
        <section aria-labelledby="button-group-actions">
            <StyledLineSepartor />
            <StyledButtonActionsContainer data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}`}>
                <StyledButtonActions>
                    {footerButtonGroup?.map((button, index) => {
                        return (
                            <Button
                                {...button}
                                key={index}
                                onMouseDown={handleOnMouseDown}
                                onClick={e => handleOnClick(e, button)}
                                type="borderless"
                                attrProps={{ "aria-label": button?.ariaLabel || `${button?.children}-${index}` }}
                                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-button-${index}`}
                            >
                                {button?.children}
                            </Button>
                        );
                    })}
                </StyledButtonActions>
            </StyledButtonActionsContainer>
        </section>
    );
};

export { ButtonGroupActions };
export default ButtonGroupActions;
````

````typescript
    "TEALIUM_BLUE_LIGHT": "#E8F4F8",
    "TEALIUM_BLUE_VIVID": "#0EA5E9",
    "TEALIUM_BLUE_DEEP": "#075985",

    // Teal color scale (from CSS tokens)
    "TEAL_50": "#e6fbfa",
    "TEAL_100": "#b3f3f0",
    "TEAL_200": "#80ebe6",
    "TEAL_300": "#4de3dc",
    "TEAL_400": "#26ddd4",
    "TEAL_500": "#0C87B8",
    "TEAL_600": "#0A6E96",
    "TEAL_700": "#085A7A",
    "TEAL_800": "#064760",
    "TEAL_900": "#043346",
    "TEAL_950": "#022433",

    // Accent colors (from CSS tokens)
    "ACCENT_SUCCESS": "#10b981",
    "ACCENT_SUCCESS_DARK": "#059669",
    "ACCENT_WARNING": "#f59e0b",
    "ACCENT_WARNING_DARK": "#d97706",
    "ACCENT_DANGER": "#ef4444",
    "ACCENT_DANGER_DARK": "#dc2626",
    "ACCENT_INFO": "#3b82f6",
    "ACCENT_INFO_DARK": "#2563eb"
} as const;

export type ColorMappingKey = keyof typeof COLOR_MAPPINGS;

/**
 * Get a color by its original constant name
 */
export const getColor = (colorName: string) => {
    return COLOR_MAPPINGS[<ColorMappingKey>colorName] || colorName;
};

/**
 * Create a simple import replacement for migration
 */
export const createImport = (colorNames: string[]) => {
    const validColors: string[] = [];
    for (const name of colorNames) {
        if (COLOR_MAPPINGS[<ColorMappingKey>name]) {
            validColors.push(name);
        }
    }
    return `import { ${validColors.join(", ")} } from "@theme/colorMappings";`;
};

// Export individual colors for direct import
export const {
````

## File: src/theme/MIGRATION_PLAN.md
````markdown
# Theme Migration Plan

## Overview

This document outlines the plan to migrate all components from hardcoded colors to the centralized theme system.

## Migration Strategy

### Phase 1: Core Theme Setup ✅

-   [x] Create comprehensive `tealiumTheme` with all color mappings
-   [x] Create `themeUtils.js` for easy color access
-   [x] Create `colors.js` with centralized color definitions
-   [x] Create `migrationHelper.js` for migration assistance
-   [x] Update Jest configuration for theme imports
-   [x] Migrate Checkbox component as proof of concept
-   [x] Migrate Badge component as second example

### Phase 2: High-Impact Components

Priority order based on usage and complexity:

1. **Badge Component** - Simple, well-defined color usage
2. **Button Component** - Core UI element with multiple variants
3. **AlertBar Component** - Status-based colors
4. **Labels Component** - Color-coded labels
5. **Icon Component** - Icon colors and states

### Phase 3: Form Components

6. **Textbox/TextArea** - Form input styling
7. **Select Components** - Dropdown and selection styling
8. **RadioButton/Checkbox** - Form control styling
9. **Switch Component** - Toggle styling
10. **Slider Component** - Range input styling

### Phase 4: Complex Components

11. **DataTable Components** - Table styling and states
12. **Modal/Slideout Components** - Overlay styling
13. **Navigation Components** - Menu and navigation styling
14. **Chart Components** - Data visualization colors

### Phase 5: Organism Components

15. **FilterGroup** - Complex form component
16. **List/Grid Components** - Layout components
17. **Wizard Components** - Multi-step process styling

## Migration Pattern

### Before (Hardcoded Colors)

```javascript
import { BLUE_400, GRAY_600, RED_400 } from "@css/constants";

const StyledComponent = styled.div`
    color: ${BLUE_400};
    background: ${GRAY_600};
    border: 1px solid ${RED_400};
`;
```

### After (Theme Colors)

```javascript
import { colors } from "@theme/themeUtils";

const StyledComponent = styled.div`
    color: ${colors.primary};
    background: ${colors.secondary};
    border: 1px solid ${colors.error};
`;
```

### Migration Helper Usage

```javascript
import { getMigrationSuggestion, analyzeFileForMigration } from "@theme/migrationHelper";

// Get migration suggestion for a specific color
const suggestion = getMigrationSuggestion("BLUE_400"); // Returns 'colors.primary'

// Analyze a file for migration opportunities
const suggestions = analyzeFileForMigration(fileContent);
```

### Alternative (Theme Access)

```javascript
import { useTheme } from "@mui/material/styles";

const StyledComponent = styled.div`
    color: ${props => props.theme.palette.primary.main};
    background: ${props => props.theme.palette.secondary.main};
    border: 1px solid ${props => props.theme.palette.error.main};
`;
```

## Benefits

1. **Consistency** - All components use the same color definitions
2. **Maintainability** - Color changes in one place affect all components
3. **Theme Support** - Easy to implement dark mode or other themes
4. **Type Safety** - Better IDE support and error checking
5. **Performance** - Reduced bundle size by eliminating duplicate color definitions

## Testing Strategy

1. **Visual Regression Testing** - Use Chromatic to catch visual changes
2. **Unit Tests** - Update color assertions to use theme values
3. **Storybook** - Verify all stories still render correctly
4. **Cross-browser Testing** - Ensure colors render consistently

## Rollback Plan

If issues arise:

1. Keep original color constants as fallbacks
2. Use feature flags to toggle between old/new color systems
3. Gradual migration allows for easy rollback of individual components
````

````typescript
    "INDINGO_700": "colors.chart.indigo",

    "AQUA_50": "colors.chart.aqua",
    "AQUA_300": "colors.chart.aqua",
    "AQUA_500": "colors.chart.aqua",
    "AQUA_700": "colors.chart.aqua",

    "YELLOW_50": "colors.chart.yellow",
    "YELLOW_100": "colors.chart.yellow",
    "YELLOW_200": "colors.chart.yellow",
    "YELLOW_300": "colors.chart.yellow",
    "YELLOW_500": "colors.chart.yellow",
    "YELLOW_800": "colors.chart.yellow",

    "WHITE_200": "colors.gray100"
} as const;

export type MigrationMapKey = keyof typeof MIGRATION_MAP;

export type MigrationSuggestion = {
    oldName: string;
    newPath: string;
    usage: "used" | "unused";
};

/**
 * Get the migration suggestion for a color constant
 */
export const getMigrationSuggestion = (oldColorName: string) => {
    return MIGRATION_MAP[oldColorName as MigrationMapKey] || `colors.${oldColorName.toLowerCase()}`;
};

/**
 * Generate migration suggestions for a file
 */
export const analyzeFileForMigration = (fileContent: string) => {
    const suggestions: MigrationSuggestion[] = [];
    const importMatch = fileContent.match(/import\s*{([^}]+)}\s*from\s*["']@css\/constants["']/);

    if (importMatch) {
        const importedColors = importMatch[1]
            .split(",")
            .map(color => color.trim())
            .filter(color => color);

        for (const colorName of importedColors) {
            const suggestion = getMigrationSuggestion(colorName);
            suggestions.push({
                oldName: colorName,
                newPath: suggestion,
                usage: fileContent.includes(colorName) ? "used" : "unused"
            });
        }
    }

    return suggestions;
};

/**
 * Generate migration code for a component
 */
export const generateNewImport = (oldImport: string, usedColors: string[]) => {
    const newImports = usedColors.map(colorName => {
        const suggestion = getMigrationSuggestion(colorName);
        return suggestion.replace("colors.", "");
    });

    return `import { ${newImports.join(", ")} } from "@theme/themeUtils";`;
};

export default {
    MIGRATION_MAP,
    getMigrationSuggestion,
    analyzeFileForMigration,
    generateNewImport
};
````

````typescript
/**
 * Theme utility functions for easy access to colors and theme values
 *
 * This file provides convenient functions to access theme colors without
 * having to use the useTheme hook in every component.
 */

import { tealiumTheme } from "./muiTheme";
import { LEGACY_COLORS } from "./colors";

/**
 * Get a color from the theme palette
 */
export const getThemeColor = (colorPath: string): string => {
    const keys = colorPath.split(".");
    let value: any = tealiumTheme.palette;

    for (const key of keys) {
        value = value?.[key];
    }

    return value || colorPath; // Fallback to the original path if not found
};

type ChartColors = {
    primary: string;
    secondary: string;
    success: string;
    warning: string;
    error: string;
    info: string;
    purple: string;
    pink: string;
    mint: string;
    violet: string;
    coral: string;
    yellow: string;
    indigo: string;
    aqua: string;
};

    primaryLight: string;

    secondary: string;
    secondaryLight: string;
    secondaryDark: string;
    error: string;
    errorLight: string;
    errorDark: string;

    gray100: string;
    gray200: string;
    gray300: string;
    gray400: string;
    gray500: string;
    gray600: string;
    gray700: string;
    gray800: string;
    gray850: string;
    gray900: string;
    chart: ChartColors;
    [key: string]: string | ChartColors;
};

/**
 * Common color shortcuts for easy access
 */
export const colors: Colors = {
    // Primary colors
    primary: tealiumTheme.palette.primary.main,
    primaryLight: tealiumTheme.palette.primary.light,
    primaryDark: tealiumTheme.palette.primary.dark,

    // Secondary colors
    secondary: tealiumTheme.palette.secondary.main,
    secondaryLight: tealiumTheme.palette.secondary.light,
    secondaryDark: tealiumTheme.palette.secondary.dark,

    // Status colors

    // Background colors
    background: tealiumTheme.palette.background.default,

    // Gray scale
    gray50: tealiumTheme.palette.grey[50],
    gray100: tealiumTheme.palette.grey[100],
    gray200: tealiumTheme.palette.grey[200],
    gray300: tealiumTheme.palette.grey[300],
    gray400: tealiumTheme.palette.grey[400],
    gray500: tealiumTheme.palette.grey[500],
    gray600: tealiumTheme.palette.grey[600],
    gray700: tealiumTheme.palette.grey[700],
    gray800: tealiumTheme.palette.grey[800],
    gray850: tealiumTheme.palette.grey[850],
    gray900: tealiumTheme.palette.grey[900],

    // Custom colors (excluding chart which is handled separately and warning which conflicts with MUI warning above)
    tealiumBlue: tealiumTheme.palette.custom.tealiumBlue,
    tealiumBlueLight: tealiumTheme.palette.custom.tealiumBlueLight,
    tealiumBlueDark: tealiumTheme.palette.custom.tealiumBlueDark,
    positive: tealiumTheme.palette.custom.positive,
    negative: tealiumTheme.palette.custom.negative,
    neutral: tealiumTheme.palette.custom.neutral,
    border: tealiumTheme.palette.custom.border,

    hover: tealiumTheme.palette.custom.hover,
    active: tealiumTheme.palette.custom.active,
    disabled: tealiumTheme.palette.custom.disabled,

    // Chart colors
    chart: tealiumTheme.palette.custom.chart
};

/**
 * Get chart colors as an array for easy iteration
 */
export const chartColors: string[] = Object.values(tealiumTheme.palette.custom.chart);

/**
 * Get a chart color by index (useful for data visualization)
 */
export const getChartColor = (index: number): string => {
    return chartColors[index % chartColors.length];
};

type StateColors = {
    button: {
        primary: string;
        primaryHover: string;
        secondary: string;
        secondaryHover: string;
        disabled: string;
    };
    form: {

        background: string;
        backgroundDisabled: string;
    };
    status: {
        success: string;
        warning: string;
        error: string;
        info: string;
        neutral: string;
    };
};

/**
 * Common color combinations for UI states
 */
export const stateColors: StateColors = {
    // Button states
    button: {
        primary: tealiumTheme.palette.primary.main,
        primaryHover: tealiumTheme.palette.primary.dark,
        secondary: tealiumTheme.palette.secondary.main,
````
