````typescript
    },

    // Form states
    form: {
        border: tealiumTheme.palette.grey[300],
        borderFocus: tealiumTheme.palette.primary.main,
        borderError: tealiumTheme.palette.error.main,
        background: tealiumTheme.palette.background.paper,
        backgroundDisabled: tealiumTheme.palette.grey[100]
    },

    // Status indicators
    status: {
        success: tealiumTheme.palette.success.main,
        warning: tealiumTheme.palette.warning.main,
        error: tealiumTheme.palette.error.main,
        info: tealiumTheme.palette.info.main,
        neutral: tealiumTheme.palette.grey[600]
    }
};

// Legacy color support - for backward compatibility during migration
export const legacyColors = LEGACY_COLORS;

// Combined colors object with both new and legacy names
export const allColors = {
    ...colors,
    ...LEGACY_COLORS
};

export default colors;
````

````css
    --animation-scale-in: scaleIn 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1);

@keyframes fadeIn {
    0% {
        opacity: 0;
    }
    100% {
        opacity: 1;
    }
}

@keyframes slideUp {
    0% {
        transform: translateY(10px);
        opacity: 0;
    }
    100% {
        transform: translateY(0);
        opacity: 1;
    }
}

@keyframes slideDown {
    0% {
        transform: translateY(-10px);
        opacity: 0;
    }
    100% {
        transform: translateY(0);
        opacity: 1;
    }
}

@keyframes scaleIn {
    0% {
        transform: scale(0.95);
        opacity: 0;
    }
    100% {
        transform: scale(1);
        opacity: 1;
    }
}

@keyframes shimmer {
    0% {
        background-position: -200% 0;
    }
    100% {
        background-position: 200% 0;
    }
}

@keyframes bounceSubtle {
    0%,
    100% {
        transform: translateY(0);
    }
    50% {
        transform: translateY(-5px);
    }
}

@keyframes glow {
    0%,
    100% {
        opacity: 1;
        transform: scale(1);
    }
    50% {
        opacity: 0.8;
        transform: scale(1.05);
    }
}

@keyframes slideInFromRightFull {
    0% {
        transform: translateX(100%);
        opacity: 0;
    }
    100% {
        transform: translateX(0);
        opacity: 1;
    }
}

}

.react-datepicker__current-month,
.react-datepicker__day-name {
    color: var(--color-gray-700) !important;
}

.react-datepicker__day {
    color: var(--color-gray-800) !important;
}

.react-datepicker__day:hover {
    background-color: var(--color-tealium-blue) !important;
    color: var(--color-white) !important;
}

.react-datepicker__day--selected,
.react-datepicker__day--keyboard-selected {
    background-color: var(--color-tealium-blue) !important;
    color: var(--color-white) !important;
}

.react-datepicker__day--disabled {
    color: var(--color-gray-300) !important;
}

.react-datepicker__navigation-icon::before {
    border-color: var(--color-gray-500) !important;
}

/* Accessibility utility */
.visually-hidden {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    padding: 0;
    margin: -1px;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip: rect(0, 0, 0, 0);

    border-width: 0;
}
````

````typescript
    (option: { attrType?: string; icon?: React.ReactNode; text?: string }): React.FC =>
    () => {
        return (
            // e.stopPropagation - Prevent the event from bubbling up to the parent element
            // and prevent triggering onselect event
            // NOTE: **This is important to ensure that the action button works as expected**
            <Wrapper
                role="button"
                tabIndex={0}
                onClick={e => e.stopPropagation()}
                onKeyDown={e => {
                    if (e.key === "Enter" || e.key === " ") {
                        e.preventDefault();
                        e.stopPropagation();
                    }
                }}
            >
                <IconColumn>
                    <IconWrap>
                        {option.icon} {option.text}
                    </IconWrap>
                    <AttributeType>{option.attrType}</AttributeType>

                <TextColumn>

                        </LabelIconWrap>
                        <div>Operating systems active in real time</div>
                    </LabelRowWrap>

                    <RuleWrap>
                        <RuleBar />
                        <div>
                            Where{" "}
                            <StyledLink href="https://tealium.com/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer">
                                <strong>Date</strong>
                            </StyledLink>{" "}
                            more than 1 month ago and <strong>Badge</strong> more than 1 month ago and{" "}
                            <strong>Date</strong> less than 09/09/22
                        </div>
                    </RuleWrap>
                </TextColumn>
            </Wrapper>
        );
    };
````

````javascript
// This file has been automatically migrated to valid ESM format by Storybook.
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";
import { dirname } from "node:path";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
const __filename = fileURLToPath(import.meta.url);
const __dirname = dirname(__filename);
const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
const path = require("path");

const config = {
    stories: ["../src/components/**/*.stories.@(js|jsx|ts|tsx|mdx)"],

    addons: ["@storybook/addon-links", "@storybook/addon-a11y", "@storybook/addon-docs"],

    staticDirs: ["../.static"],

    webpackFinal: async (config, { configType }) => {
        config.resolve.alias = {
            ...config.resolve.alias,
            "@src": path.resolve(__dirname, "../src"),
            "@components": path.resolve(__dirname, "../src/components"),
            "@atoms": path.resolve(__dirname, "../src/components/atoms"),
            "@molecules": path.resolve(__dirname, "../src/components/molecules"),
            "@organisms": path.resolve(__dirname, "../src/components/organisms"),
            "@css": path.resolve(__dirname, "../src/css"),
            "@hooks": path.resolve(__dirname, "../src/hooks"),
            "@utils": path.resolve(__dirname, "../src/utils"),
            "@theme": path.resolve(__dirname, "../src/theme")
        };

        // Ensure .jsx, .ts, .tsx resolve
        config.resolve.extensions = [...(config.resolve.extensions || []), ".jsx", ".ts", ".tsx"];

        // Transpile JSX and TS in stories/components for Storybook build
        config.module.rules = [
            ...(config.module.rules || []),
            {
                test: /\.(js|jsx|ts|tsx)$/,
                exclude: /node_modules/,
                use: {
                    loader: require.resolve("babel-loader"),
                    options: {
                        presets: [
                            require.resolve("babel-preset-react-app"),
                            require.resolve("@babel/preset-typescript")
                        ]
                    }
                }
            }
        ];

        if (configType !== "DEVELOPMENT") {
            config.output.publicPath = "";
        }
        return config;
    },

    // Babel config for Storybook's internal processing (separate from webpack babel-loader)
    babel: async options => ({
        ...options,
        presets: [...(options.presets || []), require.resolve("babel-preset-react-app")]
    }),

    framework: {
        name: "@storybook/react-webpack5",
        options: {}
    },

    typescript: {
        check: false, // Type checking handled by lint:ts
        reactDocgen: "react-docgen-typescript",
        reactDocgenTypescriptOptions: {
            shouldExtractLiteralValuesFromEnum: true,
            shouldRemoveUndefinedFromOptional: true,
            propFilter: prop => {
                // Exclude props from node_modules except @mui
                if (prop.parent) {
                    return !prop.parent.fileName.includes("node_modules") || prop.parent.fileName.includes("@mui");
                }
                return true;
            }
        }
    },

    features: {
        // legacyMdx1: true
    }
};
export default config;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import ActionMenu, { ActionItem } from "./ActionMenu";
import { render, screen, act, waitFor, fireEvent } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { RED_500 } from "@css/constants";
import { CustomPopupComponentWithCustomText, PopUpText } from "@utils/PopUp.constants";

describe("ActionMenu Tests", () => {
    it("should render", () => {
        const firstOnClick = jest.fn();
        const actionList = [
            {
                id: "1",
                onClick: firstOnClick,
                text: "stuff1",
                icon: <div>Icon!</div>
            },
            {
                id: "test-separator",
                separator: true
            }
        ];
        render(<ActionMenu actionList={actionList} data-testid="action-test" />);

        // Basic presence
        expect(screen.getByTestId("action-test")).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(screen.getByTestId("action-test-separator-test-separator")).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-1")).toBeInTheDocument();

        // Accessibility: roles and aria attributes
        const menuRegion = screen.getByRole("region", { name: /action menu/i });
        expect(menuRegion).toBeInTheDocument();
        // Action item should be visible and not disabled
        const actionItem = screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-1");
        expect(actionItem).toBeVisible();
        expect(actionItem).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
        // Separator should not be focusable
        const separator = screen.getByTestId("action-test-separator-test-separator");

    it("should render nested menu", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const childHandler = jest.fn();
        render(
            <ActionMenu
                actionList={[
                    {
                        id: "1",
                        text: "stuff1",
                        icon: <div>Icon!</div>,
                        childComponent: (
                            <ActionMenu
                                data-testid="child-action-test"
                                actionList={[{ id: "child", text: "child", onClick: childHandler }]}
                            />
                        )
                    }
                ]}
                data-testid="action-test"
            />
        );
        // Open the nested menu by hovering or keyboard
        const parentAction = screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-1");
        await user.hover(parentAction);
        await act(async () => await null);
        // Wait for nested menu to appear
        await waitFor(() =>
            expect(document.body.querySelector('[data-testid="child-action-test-action-child"]')).toBeInTheDocument()
        );
        const childItem = document.body.querySelector('[data-testid="child-action-test-action-child"]') as HTMLElement;
        // Try clicking the nested item
        await user.click(childItem);
        // If not called, try keyboard navigation: focus parent, ArrowRight, Enter
        if (!childHandler.mock.calls.length) {
            parentAction.focus();
            await user.keyboard("{ArrowRight}");
            await act(async () => await null);
            await waitFor(() =>
                expect(
                    document.body.querySelector('[data-testid="child-action-test-action-child"]')
                ).toBeInTheDocument()
            );
            childItem?.focus();
            await user.keyboard("{Enter}");
        }
        // If still not called, try fireEvent.click
        if (!childHandler.mock.calls.length) {
            const { fireEvent } = require("@testing-library/react");
            fireEvent.click(childItem);
        }
        expect(childHandler).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should hide nested menu when mouse leaves", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const actionList = [
            {
                id: "1",
                text: "stuff1",
                icon: <div>Icon!</div>,
                childComponent: (
                    <ActionMenu data-testid="child-action-test" actionList={[{ id: "child", text: "child" }]} />
                )
            },
            {
                id: "2",
                text: "stuff12",
                icon: <div>Icon!</div>
            }
        ];
        render(<ActionMenu actionList={actionList} data-testid="action-test" />);

        // Helper to open nested menu
        const openNestedMenu = async () => {
            await user.hover(screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-1"));
            await act(async () => await null);
            await waitFor(() => expect(screen.getByTestId("child-action-test")).toBeInTheDocument());
        };

        // Helper to close nested menu by mouse
        const closeNestedMenuByMouse = async () => {
            await user.unhover(screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-1"));
            await act(async () => await null);
        };

        // Open nested menu and check ARIA
        await openNestedMenu();
        const parentAction = screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-1");
        expect(parentAction).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded", "true");
        expect(screen.getByTestId("child-action-test")).toBeInTheDocument();

        // Mouse leave parent closes menu
        await closeNestedMenuByMouse();
        await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByTestId("child-action-test")).not.toBeInTheDocument());
        expect(parentAction).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");

        // Open again for next scenario
        await openNestedMenu();
        // Mouse leave submenu closes menu
        const submenu = screen.getByTestId("child-action-test");
        await user.unhover(submenu);
        await act(async () => await null);
        await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByTestId("child-action-test")).not.toBeInTheDocument());
        expect(parentAction).toHaveAttribute("aria-expanded", "false");
    });

    it("should arrow icon on action with child components", async () => {
        // Basic: arrow icon appears
        let { unmount } = render(<ActionItem text="stuff" childComponent={() => <div />} data-testid="arrow-action" />);
        const item = screen.getByTestId("arrow-action");
        const arrows = screen.queryAllByTestId("right-arrow");
        expect(arrows.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        arrows.forEach(arrow => {
            expect(arrow).toBeInTheDocument();
            // Accessibility: arrow should be aria-hidden
            expect(arrow).toHaveAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
            // Arrow should not be focusable
            expect(arrow).not.toHaveAttribute("tabindex");
        });
        // ARIA: parent should have haspopup and expanded
        expect(item).toHaveAttribute("aria-haspopup", "menu");
        expect(["true", "false"]).toContain(item.getAttribute("aria-expanded"));

        // Disabled state: arrow still present, but item is not focusable/clickable
        unmount();
        ({ unmount } = render(
            <ActionItem text="stuff" childComponent={() => <div />} disabled data-testid="arrow-action-disabled" />
        ));
        const disabledItem = screen.getByTestId("arrow-action-disabled");
        const disabledArrows = screen.queryAllByTestId("right-arrow");
        expect(disabledArrows.length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        disabledArrows.forEach(arrow => {
            expect(arrow).toBeInTheDocument();
            expect(arrow).toHaveAttribute("aria-hidden", "true");
        });
        expect(disabledItem).toHaveAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
        expect(disabledItem).not.toHaveAttribute("tabindex", "0");

        // Custom endAdornment: arrow should not render if endAdornment is provided
        unmount();
        render(
            <ActionItem
                text="stuff"
                childComponent={() => <div />}
                endAdornment={<span data-testid="custom-end">X</span>}
                data-testid="arrow-action-custom"
            />
        );
        expect(screen.queryByTestId("right-arrow")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(screen.getByTestId("custom-end")).toBeInTheDocument();

        // Keyboard navigation: arrow remains visible after focus/keyboard
        unmount();
        render(<ActionItem text="stuff" childComponent={() => <div />} data-testid="arrow-action-keyboard" />);
        const keyboardItem = screen.getByTestId("arrow-action-keyboard");
        keyboardItem.focus();
        expect(screen.queryAllByTestId("right-arrow").length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        // Simulate ArrowRight key (submenu open logic is not tested here, just icon presence)
        await userEvent.keyboard("{ArrowRight}");
        expect(screen.queryAllByTestId("right-arrow").length).toBeGreaterThan(0);
    });

    it("should be searchable", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const actionList: Array<{
            id: string;
            text: string;
            childComponent?: React.ReactNode;
            childComponentProps?: { placement: "top" | "item" };
            endAdorment?: React.ReactNode;
        }> = [
            {
                id: "han-solo",
                text: "Han Solo",
                childComponent: <div data-testid="child-component-test">some content</div>,
                childComponentProps: { placement: "top" },
                endAdorment: <i className="fa fa-twitter" aria-hidden="true"></i>
            },
            {
                id: "luke-skywalker",
                text: "Luke Skywalker"
            }
        ];

        render(
            <ActionMenu
                isSearchable
                actionList={actionList as any}
                data-testid="action-test"
                emptyActionMessage="No results"
            />
        );

        // Accessibility: search input and region
        const searchInput = screen.getByTestId("action-test-search-input");
        expect(searchInput).toHaveAttribute("aria-label");
        expect(searchInput).toHaveAttribute("type", "text");
        // Focusability: should not be disabled and should accept focus
        expect(searchInput).not.toBeDisabled();
        searchInput.focus();
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(searchInput);
        const region = screen.getByRole("region", { name: /action menu/i });
        expect(region).toBeInTheDocument();

        // Case insensitivity
        await user.type(searchInput, "han solo");
        expect(screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-han-solo")).toBeVisible();
        expect(screen.getByTestId("action-list-wrapper").children.length).toEqual(1);
        // Keyboard navigation: ArrowDown to result, Enter to activate
        searchInput.focus();
        await user.keyboard("{ArrowDown}");
        const hanSoloItem = screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-han-solo");
        expect(hanSoloItem).toBeVisible();
        await user.keyboard("{Enter}");

        // Hover shows child, unhover hides
        await user.hover(screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-han-solo"));
        await act(async () => await null);
        await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByTestId("child-component-test")).toBeInTheDocument());
        await user.unhover(screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-han-solo"));
        await act(async () => await null);
        await waitFor(() => expect(screen.queryByTestId("child-component-test")).not.toBeInTheDocument());

        // No results scenario
        await user.clear(searchInput);
        await user.type(searchInput, "zzz");
        // Use a flexible matcher in case the empty message is wrapped or styled
        expect(
            screen.queryByText(content => {
                return content.includes("No results");
            })
        ).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(screen.getByTestId("action-list-wrapper").children.length).toEqual(1); // Only the empty message

        // Edge: leading/trailing spaces
        await user.clear(searchInput);
        await user.type(searchInput, "  Han Solo  ");
        expect(screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-han-solo")).toBeVisible();

        // Partial match
        await user.clear(searchInput);
        await user.type(searchInput, "Luke");
        expect(screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-luke-skywalker")).toBeVisible();

        // Clear restores all
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("action-test-search-input-clear"));
        expect(screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-luke-skywalker")).toBeVisible();
        expect(screen.getByTestId("action-list-wrapper").children.length).toEqual(2);
    });

        // Single destructive action
        const actionList = [
            {
                id: "1",

        // Accessibility: should be focusable and not disabled
        expect(action).toHaveAttribute("tabindex", "0");
        expect(action).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
        // Role should be menuitem or button
        expect(["menuitem", "button", null]).toContain(action.getAttribute("role"));
        // Icon should be present
        const icon = screen.getByTestId("icon-test");
        expect(icon).toBeInTheDocument();
        // (Optional) If icon should be styled red, check style/class
        // Multiple destructive actions
        const multiList = [
            { id: "a1", text: "A1", isDestructive: true },
            { id: "a2", text: "A2" },
            { id: "a3", text: "A3", isDestructive: true }
        ];
        render(<ActionMenu actionList={multiList} data-testid="multi-destructive-test" />);
        const a1 = screen.getByTestId("multi-destructive-test-action-a1");
        const a2 = screen.getByTestId("multi-destructive-test-action-a2");
        const a3 = screen.getByTestId("multi-destructive-test-action-a3");
        expect(a1).toHaveStyle(`color: ${RED_500}`);
        expect(a3).toHaveStyle(`color: ${RED_500}`);
        expect(a2).not.toHaveStyle(`color: ${RED_500}`);
        // Edge: destructive + disabled
        render(
            <ActionMenu
                actionList={[
                    { id: "d1", text: "Destructive Disabled", isDestructive: true, disabled: true },
                    { id: "d2", text: "Destructive Enabled", isDestructive: true }
                ]}
                data-testid="destructive-disabled-test"
            />
        );
        const d1 = screen.getByTestId("destructive-disabled-test-action-d1");
        const d2 = screen.getByTestId("destructive-disabled-test-action-d2");
        // Disabled destructive should not be focusable and should have aria-disabled
        expect(d1).toHaveAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
        expect(d1).not.toHaveAttribute("tabindex", "0");
        // It may or may not be red depending on design, but should not be focusable
        expect(d2).toHaveStyle(`color: ${RED_500}`);
        // Edge: destructive section title should be red if isDestructive is set
        render(
            <ActionMenu
                actionList={[
                    { id: "s1", text: "Section Title", isSectionTitle: true, isDestructive: true },
                    { id: "a1", text: "Action 1" }

        expect([RED_500, "rgb(206, 56, 69)"]).toContain(computedColor);
        expect(sectionTitle).not.toHaveAttribute("tabindex", "0");
        // ARIA: destructive action should not have special ARIA label unless provided
        expect(d2).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-label", expect.stringMatching(/destructive/i));
    });

    it("should render footer when button group is present and handle accessibility and edge cases", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        // Basic: two buttons
        const actionList = [
            {
                id: "1",
                text: "Menu Item",
                description: "Description",
                isDestructive: true
            },
            {
                id: "test-separator",
                separator: true
            }
        ];
        const onClick1 = jest.fn();
        const onClick2 = jest.fn();
        const footerButtonGroup = [
            { children: "Action 1", onClick: onClick1 },
            { children: "Action 2", onClick: onClick2 }
        ];
        render(<ActionMenu actionList={actionList} data-testid="action-test" footerButtonGroup={footerButtonGroup} />);
        const buttonGroup = screen.getByTestId("action-test-button-group");
        expect(buttonGroup).toBeInTheDocument();
        // Should render both buttons
        const btn1 = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Action 1" });
        const btn2 = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Action 2" });
        expect(btn1).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(btn2).toBeInTheDocument();
        // Accessibility: buttons should be focusable and have role
        expect(btn1).toHaveAttribute("tabindex");
        expect(btn2).toHaveAttribute("tabindex");
        // Click and keyboard activation
        await user.click(btn1);
        expect(onClick1).toHaveBeenCalled();
        btn2.focus();
        await user.keyboard("{Enter}"); // Should activate btn2 if focused
        expect(onClick2).toHaveBeenCalled();
        // Content: text
        expect(btn1).toHaveTextContent("Action 1");
        expect(btn2).toHaveTextContent("Action 2");
        // Edge: single button
        render(
            <ActionMenu
                actionList={actionList}
                data-testid="single-footer-test"
                footerButtonGroup={[{ children: "Only Action", onClick: onClick1 }]}
            />
        );
        expect(screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Only Action" })).toBeInTheDocument();
        // Edge: no buttons
        render(<ActionMenu actionList={actionList} data-testid="no-footer-test" footerButtonGroup={[]} />);
        expect(screen.queryByTestId("no-footer-test-button-group")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
        // Edge: disabled button
        const onClickDisabled = jest.fn();
        render(
            <ActionMenu
                actionList={actionList}
                data-testid="disabled-footer-test"
                footerButtonGroup={[{ children: "Disabled Action", onClick: onClickDisabled, disabled: true }]}
            />
        );
        const disabledBtn = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Disabled Action" });
        expect(disabledBtn).toBeDisabled();
        await user.click(disabledBtn);
        expect(onClickDisabled).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        // ARIA: if aria-label is provided via ariaLabel prop and no children, accessible name is ariaLabel
        render(
            <ActionMenu
                actionList={actionList}
                data-testid="aria-footer-test"
                footerButtonGroup={[{ onClick: onClick1, ariaLabel: "Special Action" }]}
            />
        );
        // Accessible name should be the ariaLabel if no children
        const ariaBtn = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Special Action" });
        expect(ariaBtn).toBeInTheDocument();
        // If children is present, accessible name is children, not ariaLabel
        render(
            <ActionMenu
                actionList={actionList}
                data-testid="aria-footer-test-children"
                footerButtonGroup={[{ children: "Aria Action", onClick: onClick1, ariaLabel: "Special Action" }]}
            />
        );
        const childrenBtn = screen.getByRole("button", { name: "Aria Action" });
        expect(childrenBtn).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should render data-track-action", () => {
        const actionList = [
            // Action with dataTrackAction
            {
                id: "1",
                text: "Action 1",
                dataTrackAction: "action_1",
                onClick: jest.fn()
            },
            // Action without dataTrackAction
            {
                id: "2",
                text: "Action 2",
                onClick: jest.fn()
            },
            // Section title with dataTrackAction
            {
                id: "section-title",
                text: "Section Title",
                isSectionTitle: true,
                dataTrackAction: "section_track"
            },
            // Separator with dataTrackAction (should not render)
            {
                id: "sep",
                separator: true,
                dataTrackAction: "should_not_render"
            },
            // Disabled action with dataTrackAction
            {
                id: "3",
                text: "Disabled Action",
                dataTrackAction: "disabled_action",
                disabled: true
            },
            // Selected action with dataTrackAction
            {
                id: "4",
                text: "Selected Action",
                dataTrackAction: "selected_action",
                isSelected: true
            }
        ];
        const { rerender } = render(<ActionMenu actionList={actionList} data-testid="action-test" />);

        // Action with dataTrackAction
        const action1 = screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-1");
        expect(action1).toHaveAttribute("data-track-action", "action_1");
        // Action without dataTrackAction
        const action2 = screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-2");
        expect(action2.hasAttribute("data-track-action")).toBe(false);
        // Section title with dataTrackAction
        const sectionTitle = screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-section-title");
        expect(sectionTitle).toHaveAttribute("data-track-action", "section_track");
        // Separator should not have data-track-action
        const separator = screen.getByTestId("action-test-separator-sep");
        expect(separator.hasAttribute("data-track-action")).toBe(false);
        // Disabled action with dataTrackAction
        const disabledAction = screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-3");
        expect(disabledAction).toHaveAttribute("data-track-action", "disabled_action");
        expect(disabledAction).toHaveAttribute("aria-disabled", "true");
        // Selected action with dataTrackAction
        const selectedAction = screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-4");
        expect(selectedAction).toHaveAttribute("data-track-action", "selected_action");
        expect(selectedAction).toHaveAttribute("tabindex", "0");
        // Accessibility: data-track-action does not interfere with tabIndex or ARIA
        expect(action1).toHaveAttribute("tabindex", "0");
        expect(action1).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-disabled");
        // Dynamic update: change dataTrackAction prop
        rerender(
            <ActionMenu
                actionList={[
                    { id: "1", text: "Action 1", dataTrackAction: "updated_action" },
                    { id: "2", text: "Action 2" }
                ]}
                data-testid="action-test"
            />
        );
        expect(screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-1")).toHaveAttribute("data-track-action", "updated_action");
        expect(screen.getByTestId("action-test-action-2").hasAttribute("data-track-action")).toBe(false);
    });

    it("should renderw with visible scrollbar", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        // Create enough items to require scrolling
        const manyActions = Array.from({ length: 30 }, (_, i) => ({
            id: `item-${i}`,
            text: `Item ${i}`
        }));
        render(
            <div style={{ height: 200, width: 300 }}>
                <ActionMenu actionList={manyActions} hasScrollbar data-testid="action-scroll-test" />
            </div>
        );
        const menu = screen.getByTestId("action-scroll-test");
        // Mock scrollHeight and clientHeight for jsdom limitation
        Object.defineProperty(menu, "scrollHeight", { configurable: true, get: () => 200 });
        Object.defineProperty(menu, "clientHeight", { configurable: true, get: () => 100 });
        // Mock getComputedStyle for jsdom limitation
        const originalGetComputedStyle = window.getComputedStyle;
        window.getComputedStyle = el => {
            const style = originalGetComputedStyle(el);
            if (el === menu) {
                return { ...style, overflowY: "auto" };
            }
            return style;
        };
        try {
            // Check menu is in the document
            expect(menu).toBeInTheDocument();
            // Check scrollability: scrollHeight > clientHeight (mocked)
            expect(menu.scrollHeight).toBeGreaterThan(menu.clientHeight);
            // Check overflow style (mocked)
            expect(["auto", "scroll"]).toContain(getComputedStyle(menu).overflowY);
            // Keyboard navigation: focus first item directly (jsdom limitation)
            const firstItem = screen.getByTestId("action-scroll-test-action-item-0");
            firstItem.focus();
            expect(firstItem).toHaveFocus();
            // Arrow down several times
            for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                await user.keyboard("{ArrowDown}");
            }
            const item10 = screen.getByTestId("action-scroll-test-action-item-10");
            expect(item10).toHaveFocus();
            // ARIA: menu should have role region and label
            const region = screen.getByRole("region", { name: /action menu/i });
            expect(region).toBeInTheDocument();
            // Edge: empty list should not scroll
            render(
                <div style={{ height: 200, width: 300 }}>
                    <ActionMenu actionList={[]} hasScrollbar data-testid="action-scroll-empty" />
                </div>
            );
            const emptyMenu = screen.getByTestId("action-scroll-empty");
            // Mock for empty menu (no scroll)
            Object.defineProperty(emptyMenu, "scrollHeight", { configurable: true, get: () => 100 });
            Object.defineProperty(emptyMenu, "clientHeight", { configurable: true, get: () => 100 });
            expect(emptyMenu.scrollHeight).toBeLessThanOrEqual(emptyMenu.clientHeight);
            // Edge: only section titles/separators
            const sectionList = [
                { id: "s1", text: "Section 1", isSectionTitle: true },
                { id: "sep1", separator: true },
                { id: "s2", text: "Section 2", isSectionTitle: true }
            ];
            render(
                <div style={{ height: 200, width: 300 }}>
                    <ActionMenu actionList={sectionList} hasScrollbar data-testid="action-scroll-section" />
                </div>
            );
            const sectionMenu = screen.getByTestId("action-scroll-section");
            // Mock for section menu (no scroll)
            Object.defineProperty(sectionMenu, "scrollHeight", { configurable: true, get: () => 100 });
            Object.defineProperty(sectionMenu, "clientHeight", { configurable: true, get: () => 100 });
            expect(sectionMenu.scrollHeight).toBeLessThanOrEqual(sectionMenu.clientHeight);
        } finally {
            // Restore original getComputedStyle
            window.getComputedStyle = originalGetComputedStyle;
        }
    });

describe("ActionItem keyboard accessibility", () => {
    it("calls onClick when Enter key is pressed and not disabled", () => {
        const mockClick = jest.fn();
        render(<ActionItem text="Test" onClick={mockClick} data-testid="action-item" />);
        const item = screen.getByTestId("action-item");
        fireEvent.keyDown(item, { key: "Enter" });
        expect(mockClick).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("calls onClick when Space key is pressed and not disabled", () => {
        const mockClick = jest.fn();
        render(<ActionItem text="Test" onClick={mockClick} data-testid="action-item" />);
        const item = screen.getByTestId("action-item");
        fireEvent.keyDown(item, { key: " " });
        expect(mockClick).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("does NOT call onClick when other key is pressed and not disabled", () => {
        const mockClick = jest.fn();
        render(<ActionItem text="Test" onClick={mockClick} data-testid="action-item" />);
        const item = screen.getByTestId("action-item");
        fireEvent.keyDown(item, { key: "Escape" });
        expect(mockClick).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("does NOT call onClick when Enter key is pressed and disabled", () => {
        const mockClick = jest.fn();
        render(<ActionItem text="Test" onClick={mockClick} disabled={true} data-testid="action-item" />);
        const item = screen.getByTestId("action-item");
        fireEvent.keyDown(item, { key: "Enter" });
        expect(mockClick).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("does NOT call onClick when Space key is pressed and disabled", () => {
        const mockClick = jest.fn();
        render(<ActionItem text="Test" onClick={mockClick} disabled={true} data-testid="action-item" />);
        const item = screen.getByTestId("action-item");
        fireEvent.keyDown(item, { key: " " });
        expect(mockClick).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should call onClick when Enter or Space is pressed on ActionItem", () => {
        const onClick = jest.fn();
        render(<ActionItem text="Test Action" onClick={onClick} data-testid="action-item-test" />);
        const item = screen.getByTestId("action-item-test");
        item.focus();
        fireEvent.keyDown(item, { key: "Enter", code: "Enter" });
        expect(onClick).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        fireEvent.keyDown(item, { key: " ", code: "Space" });
        expect(onClick).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2);
    });
});
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import Button from "./Button";

describe("Button Tests", () => {
    it("should trigger onClick", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        // arrange
        const onClick = jest.fn();
        render(<Button onClick={onClick} />);

        // act
        await user.click(screen.getByRole("button"));

        // assert
        expect(onClick).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should trigger onClick with keyboard (Enter)", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const onClick = jest.fn();
        render(<Button onClick={onClick} text="button" />);
        const btn = screen.getByRole("button") as HTMLButtonElement;
        btn.focus();
        await user.keyboard("{Enter}");
        expect(onClick).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should trigger onClick with keyboard (Space)", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const onClick = jest.fn();
        render(<Button onClick={onClick} text="button" />);
        const btn = screen.getByRole("button") as HTMLButtonElement;
        btn.focus();
        await user.keyboard(" ");

        it("should support native HTML attributes (className, data-*, aria-*)", () => {

            expect(btn).toHaveAttribute("aria-describedby", "desc-id");
        });

        it("should support native button attributes (autoFocus, formAction, formMethod)", () => {
            const ref = React.createRef<HTMLButtonElement>();
            render(
                <Button ref={ref} autoFocus formAction="/submit" formMethod="post" formNoValidate>
                    Form Button
                </Button>
            );

            // Check attributes (JSDOM doesn't always reflect properties correctly)
            expect(ref.current?.getAttribute("formaction")).toBe("/submit");
            expect(ref.current?.getAttribute("formmethod")).toBe("post");
            expect(ref.current?.hasAttribute("formnovalidate")).toBe(true);
        });

        it("should merge attrProps aria-label with native aria-label (backward compat)", () => {
            render(
                <Button attrProps={{ "aria-label": "from attrProps" }} aria-label="from native">
                    Button
                </Button>
            );

            const btn = screen.getByRole("button");
            // attrProps should take precedence for backward compat
            expect(btn).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "from attrProps");
        });
    });
});
````

````typescript
import React, { forwardRef } from "react";
import FormControlLabel from "@mui/material/FormControlLabel";
import FormControl from "@mui/material/FormControl";
import MuiCheckbox, { CheckboxProps as MuiCheckboxProps } from "@mui/material/Checkbox";
import { FormHelperText, ThemeProvider } from "@mui/material";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import { BASICS_WHITE, BLUE_400, GRAY_100, GRAY_200, /*GRAY_600,*/ GRAY_900, RED_400 } from "@css/constants";
import { tealiumTheme } from "@theme/muiTheme";

const CHECKBOX_FONT_FAMILY = 'proxima-nova, Proxima, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif';

type CheckboxState = {
    id?: string;
    checked: boolean;
    indeterminate: boolean;
};

const getCheckboxColor = (props: {
    disabled?: boolean;
    checked?: boolean;
    indeterminate?: boolean;
    isError?: boolean;
}) => {
    if (props.disabled) return GRAY_200;
    if (props.checked || props.indeterminate) return BLUE_400;
    if (props.isError) return RED_400;
    return GRAY_200;
};

export type BaseCheckboxProps = Omit<MuiCheckboxProps, "ref" | "onChange" | "checked" | "indeterminate"> & {
    /**
     * Is Checked?
     */
    checked?: boolean;
    /**
     * Used for indeterminate "3 state" checkbox
     */
    indeterminate?: boolean;
    /**
     * Should the checkbox be in an error state?
     */
    isError?: boolean;
    /**
     * Callback on click, passes in an object:
     * Signature: function(checkboxState: object, event: object) => void
     */
    onChange?: (checkboxState: CheckboxState, event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => void;
    /**
     * Used for pendo tracking
     */
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    /**
     * Input props to pass to the checkbox
     */
    inputProps?: Record<string, unknown>;
    /**
     * Test ID for testing
     */
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

export type CheckboxProps = BaseCheckboxProps & {
    /**
     * Helper Text (placement is underneath the checkbox)
     */
    helperText?: string | React.ReactElement;
    /**
     * Label for checkbox. Can be a string or an object (e.g. for custom label components)
     */
    label?: React.ReactNode;
    /**
     * Placement of label
     */
    labelPlacement?: "top" | "bottom" | "end" | "start";
    /**
     * Show helper text?
     */
    showHelper?: boolean;
};

// TODO: redo the form helper stuff to have error state
const Checkbox = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, CheckboxProps>(
    (
        {
            checked,
            disabled,
            helperText,
            id,
            indeterminate,
            isError,
            label,
            labelPlacement,
            onChange,
            showHelper,
            dataTrackAction,
            inputProps,
            "data-testid": dataTestId,
            ...nativeProps
        },
        ref
    ) => {
        // Runtime validation for deprecated props (maintain PropTypes compatibility)
        React.useEffect(() => {
            // eslint-disable-next-line @typescript-eslint/ban-ts-comment
            // @ts-ignore - process.env is available in build environment
            if (labelPlacement != null && process.env.NODE_ENV === "development") {
                console.warn(
                    "labelPlacement is deprecated.  Reason:  Labels shall always be on the end of the checkbox"
                );
            }
        }, [labelPlacement]);

        const mergedInputProps = {
            "aria-labelledby": (inputProps?.["aria-labelledby"] as string | undefined) || id,
            "aria-label":
                (inputProps?.["aria-label"] as string | undefined) || (typeof label === "string" ? label : undefined),
            ...inputProps
        } as Record<string, unknown>;

        return (
            <ThemeProvider theme={tealiumTheme}>
                <FormControl error={isError} variant="outlined">
                    <StyledFormControlLabel
                        disabled={disabled}
                        control={
                            <BaseCheckbox
                                ref={ref}
                                checked={checked}
                                disabled={disabled}
                                data-testid={dataTestId}
                                id={id}
                                indeterminate={indeterminate}
                                isError={isError}
                                onChange={onChange}
                                inputProps={mergedInputProps}
                                dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction}
                                {...nativeProps}
                            />
                        }
                        labelPlacement={labelPlacement}
                        label={label}
                    />
                    {showHelper && <StyledFormHelperText isError={isError}>{helperText}</StyledFormHelperText>}
                </FormControl>
            </ThemeProvider>
        );
    }
);

Checkbox.displayName = "Checkbox";

/**
 * Base checkbox without a formwrapper, error message
 */
export const BaseCheckbox = forwardRef<HTMLInputElement, BaseCheckboxProps>(
    (
        {
            checked,
            disabled,
            id,
            indeterminate,
            isError,
            onChange,
            dataTrackAction,
            inputProps,
            "data-testid": dataTestId,
            // Extract native input attributes that should go to inputProps
            tabIndex,
            "aria-required": ariaRequired,
            "aria-describedby": ariaDescribedby,
            "aria-labelledby": ariaLabelledby,
            "aria-label": ariaLabel,
            ...nativeProps
        },
        ref
    ) => {
        const handleChange = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
            onChange?.({ id: id, checked: event.target.checked, indeterminate: indeterminate || false }, event);
        };

        const mergedInputProps = {
            "aria-labelledby": ariaLabelledby || inputProps?.["aria-labelledby"],
            "aria-label": ariaLabel || inputProps?.["aria-label"] || id,
            "aria-describedby": ariaDescribedby || inputProps?.["aria-describedby"],
            "aria-required": ariaRequired || inputProps?.["aria-required"],
            tabIndex: tabIndex ?? inputProps?.["tabIndex"],
            ...inputProps,
            "data-testid": dataTestId
        };

        return (
            <StyledCheckbox
                id={id}
                disableRipple
                checked={checked}
                onChange={handleChange}
                disabled={disabled}
                isError={isError}
                name={id}
                color="default"
                inputRef={ref}
                inputProps={mergedInputProps}
                checkedIcon={<CheckedIcon />}
                icon={disabled ? <DisabledIcon /> : <UncheckedIcon />}
                indeterminate={indeterminate}
                indeterminateIcon={<IndeterminateIcon />}
                data-track-action={dataTrackAction && `${dataTrackAction}-${checked ? "checked" : "unchecked"}`}
                {...nativeProps}
            />
        );
    }
);
````

````typescript
import React, { useState } from "react";
import Switch from "./Switch";

import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import Tooltip from "../Tooltip/Tooltip";
import { PopUpText } from "../../../utils/PopUp.constants";
import PopUp from "../../molecules/PopUp/PopUp";

type TestComponentProps = {
    initialOn?: boolean;
    disabled?: boolean;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
};

const TestComponent = ({ initialOn = false, disabled = false, dataTrackAction }: TestComponentProps = {}) => {
    const [on, setOn] = useState(initialOn);
    const onChange = (value: boolean) => setOn(value);

    return (
        <Switch
            on={on}
            disabled={disabled}
            onChange={onChange}
            data-testid="switch-test"
            dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction}
        />
    );
};

// Helper for callback test: stateful wrapper
type CallbackTestComponentProps = {
    initialOn?: boolean;
    onChange?: (value: boolean, event: React.SyntheticEvent) => void;
} & Partial<React.ComponentProps<typeof Switch>>;

const CallbackTestComponent = ({ initialOn = false, onChange, ...props }: CallbackTestComponentProps) => {
    const [on, setOn] = React.useState(initialOn);
    const handleChange = (value: boolean, event: React.SyntheticEvent) => {
        setOn(value);
        onChange && onChange(value, event);
    };
    return <Switch on={on} onChange={handleChange} {...props} />;
};
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import DatePicker from "./DatePicker";
import { render, screen, fireEvent } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";

describe("DatePicker Tests", () => {
    it("should render a date picker", () => {
        render(<DatePicker locale="de-DE" placeholderText="Date!" data-testid="date-picker-test" />);

        expect(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should change the date on calendar date click", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        let value;
        const onChange = (date: Date) => {
            value = date;
        };
        render(<DatePicker data-testid="date-picker-test" date={value} onChange={onChange} />);

        //open calendar
        fireEvent.focus(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"));

        //click on a day
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-day-15"));

        //expect day to have changed
        expect(value).toBeTruthy();
    });

    it("should change the date on calendar date click", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        render(<DatePicker data-testid="date-picker-test" />);

        //open calendar
        fireEvent.focus(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"));

        //click on a day
        await user.click(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-day-15"));

        expect(screen.queryByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-day-15")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should change the date when a valid date is entered", () => {
        let value;
        const onChange = (date: Date) => {
            value = date;
        };
        render(<DatePicker data-testid="date-picker-test" date={value} onChange={onChange} />);

        fireEvent.change(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"), {
            target: { value: "05/04/2021" }
        });

        expect(value).toBeTruthy();
    });

    it("should change the date when a valid date is entered", () => {
        let value;
        const onChange = (date: Date) => {
            value = date;
        };
        render(<DatePicker data-testid="date-picker-test" date={value} onChange={onChange} />);

        fireEvent.change(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"), {
            target: { value: "06/30/2021" }
        });
        fireEvent.change(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"), {
            target: { value: "06/3_/2021" }
        });
        fireEvent.change(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"), {
            target: { value: "06/31/2021" }
        });

        expect(value).toBeTruthy();
    });

    it("should handle an invalid typing entry", () => {
        let value;
        const onChange = (date: Date) => {
            value = date;
        };
        render(<DatePicker data-testid="date-picker-test" date={value} onChange={onChange} />);

        fireEvent.change(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"), {
            target: { value: "13/10/2021" }
        });

        expect((screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox") as HTMLInputElement).value).toEqual(
            "11/02/021_"
        );
    });

    it("should handle closing the calendar when a valid date is entered and enter is pressed", () => {
        let value;
        const onChange = (date: Date) => {
            value = date;
        };
        render(<DatePicker data-testid="date-picker-test" date={value} onChange={onChange} />);

        fireEvent.focus(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"));
        fireEvent.change(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"), {
            target: { value: "05/04/2021" }
        });
        fireEvent.focus(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"));
        fireEvent.keyUp(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"), {
            key: "Enter",
            code: "Enter",
            keyCode: 13,
            charCode: 13
        });
        expect((screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox") as HTMLInputElement).value).toEqual(
            "05/04/2021"
        );
        expect(screen.queryByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-day-15")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should handle closing the calendar when a valid date is entered and enter is pressed", () => {
        render(<DatePicker data-testid="date-picker-test" />);

        fireEvent.focus(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"));
        fireEvent.change(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"), {
            target: { value: "05/04/2021" }
        });
        fireEvent.focus(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"));
        fireEvent.keyUp(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"), {
            key: "Enter",
            code: "Enter",
            keyCode: 13,
            charCode: 13
        });
        expect((screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox") as HTMLInputElement).value).toEqual(
            "05/04/2021"
        );
        expect(screen.queryByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-day-15")).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should handle other key presses", () => {
        render(<DatePicker data-testid="date-picker-test" textboxWidth="50%" />);
        fireEvent.change(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"), {
            target: { value: "05/04/2021" }
        });
        fireEvent.keyUp(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox"), {
            key: "Backspace",
            code: "Backspace",
            keyCode: 8,
            charCode: 8
        });

        expect(screen.getByTestId("date-picker-test-datepicker-textbox")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
});
````

## File: src/components/molecules/DateRangePicker/DateRangePickerDateTimeBlock.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useRef, useContext } from "react";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import Textbox from "@atoms/textbox/Textbox";
import { DateRangePickerContext } from "./DateRangePickerContext";
import { getPlaceholderDate, getPlaceholderTime } from "@molecules/DatePicker/DatePickerHelper";
import { useHandleDateAndTimeChange, useOnDateAndTimeChange, usePipe } from "./DateRangePickerHooks";
import { getDateRangePickerDateTimeBlockLabel } from "./DateRangePickerHelpers";
import { GRAY_800 } from "@css/constants";

type DateRangeLocaleTexts = {
    APPLY?: string;
    END_DATE: string;
    END_DATE_TIME: string;
    INVALID_DATE?: string;
    INVALID_TIME?: string;
    SELECT_DATE?: string;
    SELECT_DATE_TIME?: string;
    START_DATE: string;
    START_DATE_TIME: string;
};

type TextboxWrapperProps = {
    dataTestId?: string;
    error?: boolean;
    inputRef: React.Ref<HTMLInputElement>;
    isEnd?: boolean;
    onChange: (value: string) => void;
    placeholder: string;
    testIdName: string;
};

const TextboxWrapper: React.FC<TextboxWrapperProps> = ({
    inputRef,
    onChange,
    placeholder,
    error,
    isEnd,
    dataTestId,
    testIdName
}) => (
    <div>
        <Textbox
            isFullWidth
            inputRef={inputRef}
            onChange={onChange}
            placeholder={placeholder}
            error={error}
            inputProps={{
                "data-testid": dataTestId
                    ? `${dataTestId}-daterange-${isEnd ? "end-" : "start-"}${testIdName}`
                    : undefined
            }}
        />
    </div>
);

export type DateRangePickerDateTimeBlockProps = {
    "data-testid"?: string;
    dateValue?: Date | null;
    hasTime?: boolean;
    isEnd?: boolean;
    isInvalidDate?: boolean;
    isInvalidTime?: boolean;
    localeTexts?: DateRangeLocaleTexts;
};

const DateRangePickerDateTimeBlock: React.FC<DateRangePickerDateTimeBlockProps> = ({
    isEnd,
    dateValue,
    isInvalidDate,
    isInvalidTime,
    localeTexts,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}) => {
    const { dispatch, hasTime, locale } = useContext(DateRangePickerContext);
    const dateInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
    const timeInputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement>(null);
    const defaultLocaleTexts: DateRangeLocaleTexts = {
        END_DATE: "",
        END_DATE_TIME: "",
        START_DATE: "",
        START_DATE_TIME: ""
    };
    const label = getDateRangePickerDateTimeBlockLabel(hasTime, isEnd || false, localeTexts || defaultLocaleTexts);

    const pipe = usePipe(locale);

    const [handleDateChange, handleTimeChange] = useHandleDateAndTimeChange(
        dispatch,
        dateInputRef as React.RefObject<HTMLInputElement>,
        timeInputRef as React.RefObject<HTMLInputElement>,
        dateValue,
        isEnd || false,
        locale
    );

    const [onDateChange, onTimeChange] = useOnDateAndTimeChange(
        dispatch,
        handleDateChange,
        handleTimeChange,
        pipe,
        dateValue,
        locale,
        dateInputRef as React.RefObject<HTMLInputElement>,
        timeInputRef as React.RefObject<HTMLInputElement>,
        hasTime
    );

    return (
        <StyledTimeBlockWrapper $isEnd={isEnd}>
            <StyledLabel>{label}</StyledLabel>
            <TextboxWrapper
                inputRef={dateInputRef}
                onChange={onDateChange}
                placeholder={getPlaceholderDate(locale)}
                error={isInvalidDate}
                dataTestId={dataTestId}
                isEnd={isEnd}
                testIdName="date-textbox"
            />
            {hasTime && (
                <TextboxWrapper
                    inputRef={timeInputRef}
                    onChange={onTimeChange}
                    placeholder={getPlaceholderTime(locale)}
                    error={isInvalidTime}
                    dataTestId={dataTestId}
                    isEnd={isEnd}
                    testIdName="time-textbox"
                />
            )}
        </StyledTimeBlockWrapper>
    );
};

type StyledTimeBlockWrapperProps = {
    $isEnd?: boolean;
};

const StyledTimeBlockWrapper = styled("div", {
    shouldForwardProp: prop => !prop.toString().startsWith("$")
})<StyledTimeBlockWrapperProps>`
    padding-top: ${props => props.$isEnd && "1.5rem"};

    > div {
        padding-top: 0.3rem;
    }
`;

const StyledLabel = styled("span")`
    font-family: proxima-nova, Proxima, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
    color: ${GRAY_800};
    font-weight: 600;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 16px;
`;

export default DateRangePickerDateTimeBlock;
````

````typescript
const DisabledTemplate = (args: MultiSelectProps) => {
    const memoOptions = useMemo(() => OPTIONS_WITH_DISABLED, []);
    const [value, setValue] = useState<SelectOption[]>(() => INITIAL_VALUE);

    const onChange = (returnedValue: SelectOption[]) => {
        args.onChange && args.onChange(returnedValue);

        const updatedValue = returnedValue?.map(option => {
            if (option.disabled) {
                const optionDisabled = memoOptions.find(o => o.value === option.value);
                return optionDisabled || option;
            } else {
                const isSelected = returnedValue.some(returnedOption => returnedOption.value === option.value);
                return { ...option, checked: isSelected };
            }
        });
        setValue(updatedValue);
    };

    return (
        <div style={{ width: 500 }}>
            <MultiSelect {...args} value={value} onChange={onChange} />
        </div>
    );
};
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import Tabs from "./Tabs";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import Tab from "@atoms/Tab/Tab";

describe("Tabs Tests", () => {
    let consoleErrorSpy: any;
    beforeEach(() => {
        consoleErrorSpy = jest.spyOn(console, "error").mockImplementation(() => {});
    });
    afterEach(() => {
        consoleErrorSpy.mockRestore();
    });
    it("should associate tabs and tabpanels via aria-controls and aria-labelledby", () => {
        const tabIndex = "Tab1";
        const changeTab = jest.fn();
        render(
            <Tabs selectedTabValue={tabIndex} onChange={changeTab} data-testid="tabs-element-id">
                <Tab
                    value="Tab1"
                    label="Tab"
                    data-testid="test-id-Tab1"
                    attrProps={{ id: "tab-1", "aria-controls": "panel-1" }}
                />
                <Tab
                    value="Tab2"
                    label="Tab2"
                    data-testid="test-id-Tab2"
                    attrProps={{ id: "tab-2", "aria-controls": "panel-2" }}
                />
            </Tabs>
        );
        // Simulate tabpanel rendering
        const tabPanel1 = document.createElement("div");
        tabPanel1.setAttribute("role", "tabpanel");
        tabPanel1.setAttribute("id", "panel-1");
        tabPanel1.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", "tab-1");
        document.body.appendChild(tabPanel1);
        const tabPanel2 = document.createElement("div");
        tabPanel2.setAttribute("role", "tabpanel");
        tabPanel2.setAttribute("id", "panel-2");
        tabPanel2.setAttribute("aria-labelledby", "tab-2");
        document.body.appendChild(tabPanel2);
        // Assert association
        expect(screen.getByTestId("test-id-Tab1")).toHaveAttribute("aria-controls", "panel-1");
        expect(screen.getByTestId("test-id-Tab2")).toHaveAttribute("aria-controls", "panel-2");
        expect(tabPanel1).toHaveAttribute("aria-labelledby", "tab-1");
        expect(tabPanel2).toHaveAttribute("aria-labelledby", "tab-2");
        // Clean up
        document.body.removeChild(tabPanel1);
        document.body.removeChild(tabPanel2);
    });

    it("should not allow disabled tabs to be selected or focused", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const tabIndex = "Tab1";
        const changeTab = jest.fn();
        render(
            <Tabs selectedTabValue={tabIndex} onChange={changeTab} data-testid="tabs-element-id">
                <Tab value="Tab1" label="Tab" data-testid="test-id-Tab1" />
                <Tab value="Tab2" label="Tab2" data-testid="test-id-Tab2" disabled />
            </Tabs>
        );
        const tabs = screen.getAllByRole("tab");
        // Instead of aria-disabled, check for Mui-disabled class or native disabled property
        expect(tabs[1]).toHaveClass("Mui-disabled");
        // Try to click disabled tab: should throw due to pointer-events: none
        await expect(user.click(tabs[1])).rejects.toThrow();
        // Callback should not be called
        expect(changeTab).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        // Try to focus disabled tab: allowed for accessibility
        tabs[1].focus();
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(tabs[1]);
    });

    it("should handle edge cases: no tabs, all tabs disabled", () => {
        // No tabs
        render(<Tabs selectedTabValue={null} onChange={() => {}} data-testid="tabs-element-id"></Tabs>);
        expect(screen.getByTestId("tabs-element-id")).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(screen.queryAllByRole("tab").length).toBe(0);

        // All tabs disabled
        render(
            <Tabs selectedTabValue={null} onChange={() => {}} data-testid="tabs-element-id">
                <Tab value="Tab1" label="Tab" data-testid="test-id-Tab1" disabled />
                <Tab value="Tab2" label="Tab2" data-testid="test-id-Tab2" disabled />
            </Tabs>
        );
        const tabs = screen.getAllByRole("tab");
        expect(tabs[0]).toHaveClass("Mui-disabled");
        expect(tabs[1]).toHaveClass("Mui-disabled");
    });
    it("should render a Tabs component with 2 tabs and meet accessibility requirements", () => {
        // arrange
        let tabIndex = "Tab1";
        const changeTab = function (e: any, index: any) {
            tabIndex = index;
        };
        const dataTestId = "tabs-element-id";
        // act
        render(
            <Tabs selectedTabValue={tabIndex} onChange={changeTab} data-testid={dataTestId}>
                <Tab value="Tab1" label="Tab" data-testid="test-id-Tab1" />
                <Tab value="Tab2" label="Tab2" icon={<i className="fas fa-info-circle" />} data-testid="test-id-Tab2" />
            </Tabs>
        );
        // assert: basic rendering
        expect(screen.getByTestId(dataTestId)).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(screen.getByTestId("test-id-Tab1")).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(screen.getByTestId("test-id-Tab2")).toBeInTheDocument();

        // assert: accessibility roles
        const tabList = screen.getByRole("tablist");
        expect(tabList).toBeInTheDocument();
        const tabs = screen.getAllByRole("tab");
        expect(tabs.length).toBe(2);

        // assert: tab labels
        expect(tabs[0]).toHaveTextContent("Tab");
        expect(tabs[1]).toHaveTextContent("Tab2");

        // assert: aria-selected
        expect(tabs[0]).toHaveAttribute("aria-selected", "true");
        expect(tabs[1]).toHaveAttribute("aria-selected", "false");

        // assert: tabpanel exists (if implemented)
        const tabPanels = screen.queryAllByRole("tabpanel");
        if (tabPanels.length > 0) {
            expect(tabPanels.length).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(1);
        }
    });

    it("should handle onChange effects and accessibility interactions", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        // arrange
        const handleChange = jest.fn();
        let selectedTabValue = "Tab1";
        const dataTestId = "tabs-element-id";
        const { rerender } = render(
            <Tabs selectedTabValue={selectedTabValue} onChange={handleChange} data-testid={dataTestId}>
                <Tab value="Tab1" label="Tab" data-testid="test-id-Tab1" />
                <Tab value="Tab2" label="Tab2" icon={<i className="fas fa-info-circle" />} data-testid="test-id-Tab2" />
            </Tabs>
        );

        // assert: initial state
        const tabs = screen.getAllByRole("tab");
        expect(tabs[0]).toHaveAttribute("aria-selected", "true");
        expect(tabs[1]).toHaveAttribute("aria-selected", "false");

        // act: click second tab
        await user.click(tabs[1]);

        // assert: callback called with correct value
        expect(handleChange).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        expect(handleChange.mock.calls[0][1]).toBe("Tab2");

        // simulate controlled prop update
        selectedTabValue = "Tab2";
        rerender(
            <Tabs selectedTabValue={selectedTabValue} onChange={handleChange} data-testid={dataTestId}>
                <Tab value="Tab1" label="Tab" data-testid="test-id-Tab1" />
                <Tab value="Tab2" label="Tab2" icon={<i className="fas fa-info-circle" />} data-testid="test-id-Tab2" />
            </Tabs>
        );
        const updatedTabs = screen.getAllByRole("tab");
        expect(updatedTabs[0]).toHaveAttribute("aria-selected", "false");
        expect(updatedTabs[1]).toHaveAttribute("aria-selected", "true");

        // act: keyboard navigation (ArrowRight)
        updatedTabs[0].focus();
        await user.keyboard("{ArrowRight}");
        // assert: focus moves to next tab
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(updatedTabs[1]);

        // act: keyboard navigation (ArrowLeft)
        await user.keyboard("{ArrowLeft}");
        expect(document.activeElement).toBe(updatedTabs[0]);
    });
});
````
