## File: src/components/organisms/DataTable/DataTablePanels/ColumnReorderPanel.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useState, useCallback, useImperativeHandle, useEffect, useMemo, useReducer } from "react";
import {
    DndContext,
    closestCenter,
    KeyboardSensor,
    PointerSensor,
    useSensor,
    useSensors,
    DragEndEvent,
    DragStartEvent
} from "@dnd-kit/core";
import { SortableContext, verticalListSortingStrategy } from "@dnd-kit/sortable";
import SortableListItem from "./SortableListItem";
import { ColumnReorderPanelWrapper, DndContextWrapper, SortableListItemContainer } from "../DataTableStyles";
import { columnVisibilityReducer, initializeVisibleColumns } from "./columnVisibilityReducer";

type Column = {
    accessor?: string;
    id?: string;
    reorderable?: boolean;
    isLocked?: boolean;
    isBuildIn?: boolean;
    manageable?: boolean;
    columnOrder?: number;
    [key: string]: unknown;
};

export type ColumnReorderPanelHandle = {
    handleApplyChanges: () => void;
    resetToInitial: () => void;
};

export type ColumnReorderPanelProps = {
    columns: Column[];
    onReorder: (columns: Column[]) => void;
    hiddenColumns?: string[];
    onVisibilityChange: (hiddenColumns: string[]) => void;
    onDone?: () => void;
    initialColumns: Column[];
    initialHiddenColumns?: string[];
    dataTestId?: string;
};

type DragEndResult = {
    success: boolean;
    reason?: string;
    column?: Column;
    activeId?: string | number;
    oldIndex?: number;
    newIndex?: number;
    draggedColumn?: Column;
    targetColumn?: Column;
};

// Pure function for testing handleDragEnd logic
export const handleDragEndLogic = (event: DragEndEvent, columns: Column[]): DragEndResult => {
    const { active, over } = event;

    if (over && active.id !== over.id) {
        const oldIndex = columns.findIndex(col => col.accessor === active.id);
        const newIndex = columns.findIndex(col => col.accessor === over.id);

        // Check if the dragged column is reorderable
        const draggedColumn = columns[oldIndex];
        if (draggedColumn && draggedColumn.reorderable === false) {
            return {
                success: false,
                reason: "dragged-column-not-reorderable",
                column: draggedColumn
            };
        }

        // Check if trying to drop into a non-reorderable column position
        const targetColumn = columns[newIndex];
        if (targetColumn && targetColumn.reorderable === false) {
            return {
                success: false,
                reason: "target-position-not-reorderable",
                column: targetColumn
            };
        }

        // Successful reordering
        return {
            success: true,
            oldIndex,
            newIndex,
            draggedColumn,
            targetColumn
        };
    }

    // Same position - no reordering
    return {
        success: false,
        reason: "same-position",
        activeId: active.id
    };
};

const ColumnReorderPanel = React.forwardRef<ColumnReorderPanelHandle, ColumnReorderPanelProps>(
    (
        {
            columns,
            onReorder,
            hiddenColumns,
            onVisibilityChange,
            onDone,
            initialColumns,
            initialHiddenColumns,
            dataTestId
        },
        ref
    ) => {
        const [localColumns, setLocalColumns] = useState<Column[]>(columns);
        const [columnState, dispatchVisibleColumns] = useReducer(columnVisibilityReducer, {
            visibleColumns: new Set<string>(),
            numberOfNonDisplayColumns: 0
        });
        const [windowHeight, setWindowHeight] = useState(window.innerHeight);

        // Initialize visible columns state
        useEffect(() => {
            dispatchVisibleColumns(initializeVisibleColumns(columns, hiddenColumns || []));
        }, [columns, hiddenColumns]);

        // Show all columns (including locked ones) but handle drag and drop logic internally
        const displayColumns = useMemo(() => {
            return localColumns;
        }, [localColumns]);

        // Calculate total manageable columns (including locked ones for display)
        // This is used for validation in SortableListItem
        const totalDisplayColumns = displayColumns.length;

        // Calculate dynamic height based on viewport
        const scrollableHeight = useMemo(() => {
            // Reserve space for header, padding, and footer
            const headerHeight = 80; // Title + description + margins
            const padding = 16; // Top and bottom padding
            const footerHeight = 16; // BasicSlideout footer + extra buffer
            const listItemHeight = 60; // Approximate height of each ListItem
            const minHeight = 200; // Minimum scrollable height
            const maxHeight = Math.max(400, windowHeight * 0.8); // 80% of viewport height, minimum 400px

            const availableHeight = windowHeight - headerHeight - padding - footerHeight - listItemHeight;
            return Math.max(minHeight, Math.min(availableHeight, maxHeight));
        }, [windowHeight]);

        // Sync local state with props when they change
        useEffect(() => {
            setLocalColumns(columns);
        }, [columns]);

        // Listen for window resize events
        useEffect(() => {
            const handleResize = () => {
                setWindowHeight(window.innerHeight);
            };

            window.addEventListener("resize", handleResize);
            return () => window.removeEventListener("resize", handleResize);
        }, []);

        const sensors = useSensors(useSensor(PointerSensor), useSensor(KeyboardSensor));

        const handleDragEnd = useCallback(
            (event: DragEndEvent) => {
                const { active, over } = event;

                if (over && active.id !== over.id) {
                    const oldIndex = displayColumns.findIndex(col => col.accessor === active.id);
                    const newIndex = displayColumns.findIndex(col => col.accessor === over.id);

                    // Validate indices
                    if (oldIndex === -1 || newIndex === -1) {
                        return;
                    }

                    // Check if dragged column is reorderable
                    const draggedColumn = displayColumns[oldIndex];
                    if (draggedColumn.isLocked) {
                        return;
                    }

                    // Check if target position is locked
                    const targetColumn = displayColumns[newIndex];
                    if (targetColumn.isLocked) {
                        return;
                    }

                    setLocalColumns(prev => {
                        // Create a map of fixed positions (locked columns) - ADAPTED FROM SCAFFOLD
                        const fixedPositions = new Map<string, number>();
                        for (const [index, col] of prev.entries()) {
                            if ((col.isLocked || col.reorderable === false) && col.accessor) {
                                fixedPositions.set(col.accessor, index);
                            }
                        }

                        const newState = [...prev];

                        // Find the actual indices in the full column array
                        const actualOldIndex = newState.findIndex(col => col.accessor === active.id);
                        const actualNewIndex = newState.findIndex(col => col.accessor === over.id);

                        // TODO: Commented out for future hook refactoring - this condition prevents drag/drop
                        // when column accessors are invalid, but current implementation ensures valid accessors
                        // if (actualOldIndex === -1 || actualNewIndex === -1) {
                        //     return prev;
                        // }

                        // Calculate insert index (ADAPTED FROM SCAFFOLD)
                        let insertIndex;
                        const targetIndex = newState.findIndex(col => col.accessor === over.id);

                        if (actualOldIndex < actualNewIndex) {
                            insertIndex = targetIndex + 1; // Moving down: insert after target
                        } else {
                            insertIndex = targetIndex; // Moving up: insert at target position
                        }

                        // Remove dragged item first
                        const withoutDragged = newState.filter(col => col.accessor !== active.id);

                        // Adjust insert index after removal (ADAPTED FROM SCAFFOLD)
                        const draggedOriginalIndex = newState.findIndex(col => col.accessor === active.id);
                        if (draggedOriginalIndex < insertIndex) {
                            insertIndex = insertIndex - 1;
                        }

                        insertIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(insertIndex, withoutDragged.length));

                        // Insert dragged item at calculated position
                        const result = [...withoutDragged];
                        const draggedItem = newState.find(col => col.accessor === active.id);
                        if (draggedItem) {
                            result.splice(insertIndex, 0, draggedItem);
                        }

                        // Now restore fixed positions - this creates the "push down" effect (ADAPTED FROM SCAFFOLD)
                        const finalResult = [...result];

                        for (const [accessor, originalIndex] of fixedPositions.entries()) {
                            const currentIndex = finalResult.findIndex(col => col.accessor === accessor);
                            if (currentIndex !== -1 && currentIndex !== originalIndex) {
                                const fixedColumn = finalResult.splice(currentIndex, 1)[0];
                                finalResult.splice(originalIndex, 0, fixedColumn);
                            }
                        }
                        return finalResult;
                    });
                }
            },
            [displayColumns]
        );

        const handleDragStart = useCallback((_event: DragStartEvent) => {
            // const { active } = event;
            // Optional: Add any drag start logic here
        }, []);

        // Apply changes when Done is clicked
        const handleApplyChanges = useCallback(() => {
            // Clean the columns before sending back to parent (remove isLocked, columnOrder properties)
            const cleanColumns = localColumns.map(col => {
                const { isLocked, columnOrder, ...cleanCol } = col;
                return cleanCol;
            });

            const filteredColumns = cleanColumns.filter(col => !col.isBuildIn);
            onReorder(filteredColumns);

            // Convert visible columns Set to hidden columns array
            const allColumnAccessors = localColumns
                .map(col => col.accessor)
                .filter((accessor): accessor is string => !!accessor);
            const hiddenColumns = allColumnAccessors.filter(accessor => !columnState.visibleColumns.has(accessor));

            onVisibilityChange(hiddenColumns);
            onDone && onDone();
        }, [localColumns, columnState.visibleColumns, onReorder, onVisibilityChange, onDone]);

        // Reset to initial values
        const resetToInitial = useCallback(() => {
            setLocalColumns(initialColumns);

            // Include manageable: false columns in the reset hidden columns
            const manageableFalseColumns = initialColumns
                .filter(col => col.manageable === false)
                .map(col => col.accessor)
                .filter((accessor): accessor is string => !!accessor);
            const resetHiddenColumns = [...new Set([...(initialHiddenColumns || []), ...manageableFalseColumns])];

            dispatchVisibleColumns(initializeVisibleColumns(initialColumns, resetHiddenColumns));
        }, [initialColumns, initialHiddenColumns]);

        // Expose functions to parent via ref
        useImperativeHandle(
            ref,
            () => ({
                handleApplyChanges,
                resetToInitial
            }),
            [handleApplyChanges, resetToInitial]
        );

        return (
            <ColumnReorderPanelWrapper data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-column-reorder-panel-wrapper`}>
                <DndContextWrapper
                    $scrollableHeight={scrollableHeight}
                    data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-context-wrapper`}
                >
                    <DndContext
                        sensors={sensors}
                        collisionDetection={closestCenter}
                        onDragStart={handleDragStart}
                        onDragEnd={handleDragEnd}
                    >
                        <SortableContext
                            items={displayColumns.filter(col => col.accessor).map(col => col.accessor || "")}
                            strategy={verticalListSortingStrategy}
                        >
                            <SortableListItemContainer
                                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-sortable-list-container`}
                            >
                                {displayColumns.map((column, index) => {
                                    const isVisible = columnState.visibleColumns.has(column.accessor || "");
                                    const hasAccessor = !!column.accessor;
                                    const isDraggable = hasAccessor && !column.isLocked; // Only non-locked columns are draggable

                                    if (column.isBuildIn || column.id === "switchStatus") {
                                        return null;
                                    }

                                    return (
                                        <SortableListItem
                                            key={column.id || column.accessor || `col-${index}`}
                                            id={column.accessor || index}
                                            column={column}
                                            index={index}
                                            isVisible={isVisible}
                                            dispatchVisibleColumns={dispatchVisibleColumns}
                                            dataTestId={dataTestId}
                                            visibleColumns={columnState.visibleColumns}
                                            isDraggable={isDraggable}
                                            totalManageableColumns={totalDisplayColumns}
                                            numberOfNonDisplayColumns={columnState.numberOfNonDisplayColumns}
                                        />
                                    );
                                })}
                            </SortableListItemContainer>
                        </SortableContext>
                    </DndContext>
                </DndContextWrapper>
            </ColumnReorderPanelWrapper>
        );
    }
);

export default ColumnReorderPanel;
````

````typescript
import React, { useMemo, useRef } from "react";
import { StyledCustomToolbar, StyledTopBarTitle, TopBarButtonGroup } from "../DataTableStyles";
import TableToolbarButtonGroup from "../TableModules/DataTableToolbar/TableToolbarButtonGroup";
import useCalculateResize from "@hooks/useCalculateResize";
import Button from "@atoms/button/Button";

export type TopBarPanelProps = {
    toolbarOptions?: {
        topBar?: () => React.ReactNode;
        buttons?: {
            primaryText?: Record<string, unknown>;
            secondaryText?: Record<string, unknown>;
        };
        customButtons?: unknown;
        [key: string]: unknown;
    };
    hasTopBar?: boolean;
    topOffset: number;
    setTopBarHeight: (height: number) => void;
    "data-testid"?: string;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    hasColumnReorder?: boolean;
    onOpenColumnReorder?: () => void;
};

const TopBarPanel = ({
    toolbarOptions,
    hasTopBar,
    topOffset,
    setTopBarHeight,
    "data-testid": dataTestId,
    dataTrackAction,
    hasColumnReorder,
    onOpenColumnReorder
}: TopBarPanelProps) => {
    const topBarRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
    useCalculateResize(topBarRef as React.RefObject<HTMLElement>, setTopBarHeight);

    const includeButtons = useMemo(
        () =>
            (toolbarOptions?.buttons &&
                ((toolbarOptions.buttons?.primaryText != undefined &&
                    Object.values(toolbarOptions.buttons?.primaryText).length > 0) ||
                    (toolbarOptions.buttons?.secondaryText != undefined &&
                        Object.values(toolbarOptions.buttons?.secondaryText).length > 0))) ||
            toolbarOptions?.customButtons,
        [toolbarOptions]
    );

    const StyledCustomToolbarAny = StyledCustomToolbar as any;

    return (
        <>
            {hasTopBar && (
                <StyledCustomToolbarAny
                    ref={topBarRef}
                    $topOffset={topOffset}
                    data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-topbar`}
                >
                    {toolbarOptions?.topBar && (
                        <StyledTopBarTitle data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-topbar-title`}>
                            {toolbarOptions.topBar() as React.ReactNode}
                        </StyledTopBarTitle>
                    )}
                    <TopBarButtonGroup>
                        {hasColumnReorder && (
                            <Button
                                type="borderless"
                                onClick={onOpenColumnReorder}
                                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-column-reorder-button`}
                            >
                                <i className="fas fa-columns" style={{ marginRight: "8px" }} aria-hidden="true" />
                                Manage Columns
                            </Button>
                        )}
                        {
                            (includeButtons && (
                                <TableToolbarButtonGroup
                                    buttons={toolbarOptions?.buttons as any}
                                    customButtons={toolbarOptions?.customButtons as any}
                                    dataTestId={dataTestId}
                                    dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction}
                                />
                            )) as React.ReactNode
                        }
                    </TopBarButtonGroup>
                </StyledCustomToolbarAny>
            )}
        </>
    );
};

export default TopBarPanel;
````

## File: src/components/organisms/DataTable/PrebuiltCells/LabelsCell.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useState, useEffect } from "react";
import Labels from "@atoms/Labels/Labels";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";

type LabelsCellProps = {
    value: any;
    rowIndex?: number;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const renderLabelData = (labels: any, rowIndex: any) => {
    if (labels?.length === 0) return [];
    return labels.map((label: any) => {
        return {
            key: `row-${rowIndex}-${label?.text || label?.children}`,
            color: label?.color,
            text: label?.text || label?.children
        };
    });
};

const LabelsCell = ({ value: labels, rowIndex, "data-testid": dataTestId }: LabelsCellProps) => {
    const [labelsData, setLabelsData] = useState<any[]>([]);
    useEffect(() => {
        if (labels?.labelsData) {
            setLabelsData(labels.labelsData);
            return;
        } else {
            const data = Array.isArray(labels)
                ? renderLabelData(labels, rowIndex)
                : renderLabelData([{ ...labels }], rowIndex);
            setLabelsData(data);
        }
    }, [labels, rowIndex]);

    const stopPropagation = (e: any) => {
        e.stopPropagation();
    };

    return (
        <LabelsWrapper
            onClick={stopPropagation}
            data-chromatic="ignore"
            data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-labels-cell-wrap-row-${rowIndex}`}
        >
            <Labels
                labelsData={labelsData}
                popUpTitle={labels?.popUpTitle || labels[0]?.popUpTitle || ""}
                popUpSize={labels?.popUpSize || labels[0]?.popUpSize || "xs"}
                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-labels-cell-row-${rowIndex}`}
            />
        </LabelsWrapper>
    );
};

const LabelsWrapper = styled("div")`
    display: flex;
    flex-flow: row wrap;
    width: fit-content;
`;

export default React.memo(LabelsCell);
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import LabelsCell from "./LabelsCell";
import SwitchCell from "./SwitchCell";

export const PrebuiltCell = ({
    type,
    hasAsyncData,
    refetchData,
    onToggleCallback,
    ...props
}: {
    type: any;
    hasAsyncData: any;
    refetchData: any;
    onToggleCallback: any;
    [key: string]: any;
}) => {
    switch (type) {
        case "status":
            return (
                <SwitchCell
                    {...props}
                    on={props.on}
                    onChange={props.onChange}
                    disabled={props.disabled}
                    row={props.row}
                    hide={props.hide}
                    hasAsyncData={hasAsyncData}
                    refetchData={refetchData}
                    onToggleCallback={onToggleCallback}
                    dataTrackAction={props?.dataTrackAction}
                />
            );
        case "labels":
            return props.value ? <LabelsCell {...(props as any)} /> : null;
        default:
            return null;
    }
};

// deconstruct object/arrays into primatives for optimized performance if possible
// TODO: optimize menu and labels cells
export const optimizedProps = (props: any, type: any) => {
    switch (type) {
        case "status":
            if (props) {
                return {
                    ...props,
                    onChange: props?.onChange,
                    on: props?.on,
                    disabled: props?.disabled,
                    hide: props?.hide
                };
            }
            return {};
        default:
            return { value: props };
    }
};
export const containsPrebuilt = (type: any) => {
    switch (type) {
        case "status":
        case "labels":
            return true;
        default:
            return false;
    }
};
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import Switch from "@atoms/switch/Switch";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";

type SwitchCellProps = {
    on?: boolean;
    onChange?: (e: any, id: string, refetchData?: any) => void;
    disabled?: boolean;
    row?: any;
    "data-testid"?: string;
    hide?: boolean;
    hasAsyncData?: boolean;
    refetchData?: any;
    onToggleCallback?: (e: any, id: string, refetchData?: any) => void;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    rowIndex?: number;
    [key: string]: any;
};

const SwitchCell = React.memo(
    ({
        on,
        onChange,
        disabled,
        row,
        "data-testid": dataTestId,
        hide,
        hasAsyncData,
        refetchData,
        onToggleCallback,
        dataTrackAction,
        ...props
    }: SwitchCellProps) => {
        const _onChange = useCallback(
            (e: any) => {
                if (hasAsyncData) {
                    onToggleCallback && onToggleCallback(e, row.id, refetchData);
                } else onChange && onChange(e, row.id, refetchData);
            },
            [hasAsyncData, refetchData, onChange, onToggleCallback, row.id]
        );

        const stopPropagation = (e: any) => {
            e.stopPropagation();
        };

        if (hide) return null;

        return (
            <SwitchWrapper onClick={stopPropagation}>
                <StyledSwitchCell>
                    <Switch
                        {...props}
                        data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-switch-cell-${props.rowIndex}`}
                        on={on}
                        onChange={_onChange}
                        disabled={disabled}
                        isStandAlone
                        dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction && `${dataTrackAction}-switch-cell-${props.rowIndex}`}
                    />
                </StyledSwitchCell>
            </SwitchWrapper>
        );
    }
);
export default React.memo(SwitchCell);

const SwitchWrapper = styled("div")`
    display: flex;
    align-items: center;
    justify-content: center;
    width: 45px;
    min-width: 45px;
    max-width: 45px;
    height: 100%;
    position: relative;
    flex-shrink: 0;
    flex-grow: 0;
`;

const StyledSwitchCell = styled("div")`
    margin: 0;
    position: absolute;
    top: 50%;
    transform: translateY(-50%);
`;
````

````typescript
    getCellInfo?: any;
    row?: any;
    dataTrackAction?: string;
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const LazyLoadTableRow = ({
    id,
    onClick,
    triggerLazyAdd,
    isHeader,
    isSelected,
    hasSelections,
    children,
    rowInfo,
    getCellInfo,
    row,
    dataTrackAction,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}: LazyLoadTableRowProps) => {
    const { ref, inView } = useInView({ threshold: 0 });
    const [trigger, setTrigger] = useState(false);
    const isSubHeader = !!row?.canExpand;

    const typeCheckedOnClick = useTypeCheckedOnClickRow({ onClick: onClick, row: row });
    useLazyRowTriggerInView({
        trigger: trigger,
        setTrigger: setTrigger,
        triggerLazyAdd: triggerLazyAdd,
        inView: inView
    });
    const blur = useLazyLoadBlur({
        id: id,
        hasSelections: !!hasSelections,
        rowInfo: rowInfo,
        getCellInfo: getCellInfo,
        isSubHeader: isSubHeader
    });

    const rowChildren = isHeader || inView ? children : blur;
    const refWithHeaderUndefined = isHeader ? undefined : ref;

    return isSubHeader ? (
        <TableSubHeader ref={ref} componentType="div">
            {rowChildren}
        </TableSubHeader>
    ) : (
        <TableRow
            {...({
                sx: { height: "48px" },
                ref: refWithHeaderUndefined,
                isSelected: !!isSelected,
                onClick: typeCheckedOnClick,
                componentType: "div",
                borderBottom: "none !important",
                "data-testid": dataTestId,
                dataTrackAction: dataTrackAction
            } as any)}
        >
            {rowChildren}
        </TableRow>
    );
};

export default LazyLoadTableRow;
````

## File: src/components/organisms/DataTable/TableModules/Selection.tsx
````typescript
import React, { useCallback } from "react";
import { BaseCheckbox } from "@atoms/checkbox/Checkbox";
import { CheckboxWrapper } from "../DataTableStyles";

const MemoCheckbox = React.memo(BaseCheckbox);

export const SelectionHeader = React.memo(
    ({
        getToggleAllRowsSelectedProps,
        triggerAllRowsSelect,
        isAllPageRowsSelected,
        "data-testid": dataTestId
    }: {
        getToggleAllRowsSelectedProps: any;
        triggerAllRowsSelect: any;
        isAllPageRowsSelected: any;
        "data-testid"?: string;
    }) => {
        const allRowsSelectedProps = getToggleAllRowsSelectedProps();

        const _handleOnChange = useCallback(() => {
            if (allRowsSelectedProps.indeterminate) {
                triggerAllRowsSelect(false);
                return;
            }
            triggerAllRowsSelect(isAllPageRowsSelected ? false : true);
        }, [allRowsSelectedProps.indeterminate, isAllPageRowsSelected, triggerAllRowsSelect]);

        const stopPropagation = useCallback((event: any) => {
            event.stopPropagation();
        }, []);

        return (
            <CheckboxWrapper data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-select-header-wrap`} onClick={stopPropagation}>
                <MemoCheckbox
                    inputProps={{ "aria-label": `Select/Deselect All` }}
                    data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-select-header-check`}
                    checked={allRowsSelectedProps.checked}
                    indeterminate={allRowsSelectedProps.indeterminate}
                    onChange={_handleOnChange}
                />
            </CheckboxWrapper>
        );
    }
);

export const SelectionCell = React.memo(
    ({ row, "data-testid": dataTestId, ...props }: { row: any; "data-testid"?: string; [key: string]: any }) => {
        const rowSelectedProps = row.getToggleRowSelectedProps();

        // trigger change for row to be selected
        const onChangeHandler = useCallback(
            (e: any) => {
                row.toggleRowSelected(e.checked);
            },
            [row]
        );

        // cancelling row click when checkbox is clicked
        const stopPropagation = useCallback((event: any) => {
            event.stopPropagation();
        }, []);

        if (row.original?.checkbox?.hide) return null;

        return (
            <CheckboxWrapper
                data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-select-cell-wrap-${row.index}`}
                onClick={stopPropagation}
            >
                <MemoCheckbox
                    {...props}
                    inputProps={{ "aria-label": `Select row ${row.id}` }}
                    data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-select-cell-check-${row.index}`}
                    checked={row.original?.checkbox?.disabled ? false : rowSelectedProps.checked}
                    indeterminate={rowSelectedProps.indeterminate}
                    onChange={onChangeHandler}
                    disabled={row.original?.checkbox?.disabled}
                />
            </CheckboxWrapper>
        );
    }
);
````

````typescript
    it("should clear the search input when Enter or Space is pressed on the ClearButton", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const mockOnSearch = jest.fn();

        render(<FilterGroupSearch onSearch={mockOnSearch} />);

        const searchInput = screen.getByTestId("filtergroup-search-textbox");

        // Simulate typing in the search field
        await user.type(searchInput, "test");
        expect(searchInput).toHaveValue("test");

        // Simulate tabbing to the ClearButton
        await user.tab();

        // Simulate pressing Enter on the ClearButton
        await user.keyboard("{Enter}");
        expect(searchInput).toHaveValue(""); // Assert that the input is cleared
        expect(mockOnSearch).toHaveBeenCalledWith(null);

        // Simulate typing again
        await user.type(searchInput, "test");
        expect(searchInput).toHaveValue("test");

        // Simulate tabbing to the ClearButton again
        await user.tab();

        // Simulate pressing Space on the ClearButton
        await user.tab();
        expect(searchInput).toHaveValue("test"); // Assert that the input is cleared again
        expect(mockOnSearch).toHaveBeenCalledWith(null);
    });

        it("should reset column order and visibility when reset button is clicked after drag and reorder", async () => {
            const user = userEvent.setup();

            // Test data with all columns set to reorderable: true
            const reorderableColumns = [
                { Header: "First Name", accessor: "firstName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
                { Header: "Last Name", accessor: "lastName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
                { Header: "Email", accessor: "email", type: "text", reorderable: true },
                { Header: "Tags", accessor: "tags", type: "text", reorderable: false }
            ];

            render(
                <DataTable
                    data={columnReorderData}
                    columns={reorderableColumns}
                    hasColumnReorder={true}
                    data-testid="datatable-test"
                />
            );

            const manageColumnsButton = screen.getByText("Manage Columns");
            await user.click(manageColumnsButton);

            // Verify initial state - tags column is should not have a drag handler
            const tagsDragHandler = screen.queryByTestId("datatable-test-list-item-tags-action-button-group-button-0");
            expect(tagsDragHandler).not.toBeInTheDocument(); // Drag handle should not be present

            // Simulate drag and reorder by changing the order in the component
            // We'll need to mock the drag end event to simulate reordering
            const { useSortable } = require("@dnd-kit/sortable");

            // Mock a successful drag operation that changes column order
            useSortable.mockReturnValue({
                attributes: {},
                listeners: {},
                setNodeRef: jest.fn(),
                transform: null,
                transition: null,
                isDragging: false
            });

            // Simulate hiding another column to test reset functionality
            const emailCheckbox = screen.getByTestId("datatable-test-list-item-email-list-item-checkbox");
            await user.click(emailCheckbox);

            // Verify email column is now hidden
            expect(emailCheckbox).not.toBeChecked();

            // Click reset button
            const resetButton = screen.getByText("Reset");
            await user.click(resetButton);

            // Verify that the state is reset to initial values
            // Tags column should still be checked (initial state)
            const tagsCheckbox = screen.getByTestId("datatable-test-list-item-tags-list-item-checkbox");
            expect(tagsCheckbox).toBeChecked();
            // Email column should be visible again (reset to initial state)
            expect(emailCheckbox).toBeChecked();

            // Close the slideout
            const cancelButton = screen.getByText("Cancel");
            await user.click(cancelButton);
        });
````

````typescript
import "@testing-library/jest-dom";
import React from "react";
import { renderHook } from "@testing-library/react";
import { act } from "react-dom/test-utils";
import { DataTableAsyncContextProvider, reducer } from "./DataTableAsyncContext";

import useDataTableAsync from "./DataTableAsyncContext";

describe("DataTableAsyncContext", () => {
    it("should return the default state when action type is unknown", () => {
        const initialState = {
            data: [],
            totalCount: 0,
            loading: false,
            filters: { search: "", selected: [] },
            pageIndex: 0,
            pageSize: "10",
            sortBy: "",
            sortOrder: "asc",
            apiError: null,
            refetchTrigger: 0
        };

        const action = { type: "UNKNOWN_ACTION", payload: "test" };

        const newState = reducer(initialState as any, action as any);

        expect(newState).toEqual(initialState);
    });

    it("should update pageSize to 'Show All'", () => {
        const wrapper = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => (
            <DataTableAsyncContextProvider>{children}</DataTableAsyncContextProvider>
        );
        const { result } = renderHook(() => useDataTableAsync(), { wrapper });

        act(() => {
            result.current.setPageSize("Show All");
        });

        expect(result.current.pageSize).toBe("All");
    });

    it("should update pageSize to '10'", () => {
        const wrapper = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => (
            <DataTableAsyncContextProvider>{children}</DataTableAsyncContextProvider>
        );
        const { result } = renderHook(() => useDataTableAsync(), { wrapper });

        act(() => {
            result.current.setPageSize("10");
        });

        expect(result.current.pageSize).toBe("10");
    });

    it("should have default values", () => {
        const wrapper = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => (
            <DataTableAsyncContextProvider>{children}</DataTableAsyncContextProvider>
        );
        const { result } = renderHook(() => useDataTableAsync(), { wrapper });

        expect(result.current.pageSize).toBe("10");
        expect(result.current.pageIndex).toBe(0);
        expect(result.current.sortBy).toBe("");
        expect(result.current.sortOrder).toBe("asc");
    });

    it("should update pageIndex", () => {
        const wrapper = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => (
            <DataTableAsyncContextProvider>{children}</DataTableAsyncContextProvider>
        );
        const { result } = renderHook(() => useDataTableAsync(), { wrapper });

        act(() => {
            result.current.setPageIndex(2);
        });

        expect(result.current.pageIndex).toBe(1); // Page index is 0-based
    });

    it("should update sortBy", () => {
        const wrapper = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => (
            <DataTableAsyncContextProvider>{children}</DataTableAsyncContextProvider>
        );
        const { result } = renderHook(() => useDataTableAsync(), { wrapper });

        act(() => {
            result.current.setSortBy("name");
        });

        expect(result.current.sortBy).toBe("name");
    });

    it("should update sortOrder", () => {
        const wrapper = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => (
            <DataTableAsyncContextProvider>{children}</DataTableAsyncContextProvider>
        );
        const { result } = renderHook(() => useDataTableAsync(), { wrapper });

        act(() => {
            result.current.setSortOrder("desc");
        });

        expect(result.current.sortOrder).toBe("desc");
    });

    it("should resolve pageSize correctly in the reducer", () => {
        const initialState = { pageSize: "10" };
        const action = { type: "SetPageSize", payload: "Show All" };
        const newState = reducer(initialState as any, action as any);
        expect(newState.pageSize).toBe("All");
    });

    it("should resolve pageIndex correctly in the reducer", () => {
        const initialState = { pageIndex: 0 };
        const action = { type: "SetPageIndex", payload: -1 };
        const newState = reducer(initialState as any, action as any);
        expect(newState.pageIndex).toBe(0); // Ensure pageIndex is non-negative
    });

    it("should increment refetchTrigger when REFETCH_TRIGGER is dispatched", () => {
        const wrapper = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => (
            <DataTableAsyncContextProvider>{children}</DataTableAsyncContextProvider>
        );
        const { result } = renderHook(() => useDataTableAsync(), { wrapper });

        act(() => {
            result.current.setRefetchTrigger();
        });

        expect(result.current.refetchTrigger).toBe(1);
    });

    it("should update toolbar options", () => {
        const wrapper = ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => (
            <DataTableAsyncContextProvider>{children}</DataTableAsyncContextProvider>
        );
        const { result } = renderHook(() => useDataTableAsync(), { wrapper });

        const newToolbarOptions = {
            tableType: "Users",
            topBar: jest.fn()
        };

        act(() => {
            result.current.setToolbarOptions(newToolbarOptions);
        });

        expect(result.current.toolbarOptions).toEqual(newToolbarOptions);
    });
});

describe("useDataTableAsync Hook", () => {
    it("should throw an error when used outside of DataTableAsyncContextProvider", () => {
        expect(() => renderHook(() => useDataTableAsync())).toThrow(
            new Error("useDataTableAsync must be used within a DataTableAsyncContextProvider")
        );
    });
});
````

## File: src/components/organisms/Grid/GridPanels/ErrorPanel.tsx
````typescript
import React from "react";
import { useGridState } from "../GridContext";
import { ErrorMessagesWrap } from "@organisms/DataTable/DataTableStyles";
import ErrorMessages from "@organisms/DataTable/TableModules/ErrorMessages";

export type ErrorPanelProps = {
    errorMessages: Record<string, unknown>;
};

const ErrorPanel: React.FC<ErrorPanelProps> = ({ errorMessages }) => {
    const { hasFilterGroup, hasPagination, currentCards, dataTestId } = useGridState();
    return (
        <>
            {(currentCards?.length === 0 || (hasPagination && currentCards?.length === 0)) && (
                <ErrorMessagesWrap data-testid={dataTestId && `${dataTestId}-list-error-messages-wrapper`}>
                    <ErrorMessages
                        errorMessages={errorMessages}
                        hasFilterGroup={hasFilterGroup}
                        filteredDataSize={currentCards?.length}
                        data-testid={dataTestId}
                        {...({ preGlobalFilteredRows: [] } as any)}
                    ></ErrorMessages>
                </ErrorMessagesWrap>
            )}
        </>
    );
};

export default ErrorPanel;
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { useListState } from "../ListContext";
import { ErrorMessagesWrap } from "@organisms/DataTable/DataTableStyles";
import ErrorMessages from "@organisms/DataTable/TableModules/ErrorMessages";

type ErrorMessage = {
    line1?: string;
    line2?: string;
};

export type ErrorPanelProps = {
    errorMessages?: {
        noItems?: ErrorMessage;
        notFound?: ErrorMessage;
    };
    "data-testid"?: string;
};

const ErrorPanel = ({ errorMessages, "data-testid": dataTestId }: ErrorPanelProps) => {
    const { hasFilterGroup, hasPagination, currentItems, dataTestId: contextDataTestId } = useListState();
    const testId = dataTestId || contextDataTestId;
    return (
        <>
            {(currentItems?.length === 0 || (hasPagination && currentItems?.length === 0)) && (
                <ErrorMessagesWrap data-testid={testId ? `${testId}-list-error-messages-wrapper` : undefined}>
                    <ErrorMessages
                        errorMessages={errorMessages}
                        hasFilterGroup={hasFilterGroup}
                        filteredDataSize={currentItems?.length}
                        data-testid={testId}
                        {...({ preGlobalFilteredRows: [] } as any)}
                    ></ErrorMessages>
                </ErrorMessagesWrap>
            )}
        </>
    );
};

export default ErrorPanel;
````

````typescript
import React, { useCallback, useMemo, useReducer } from "react";
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react";
import List, { type ListProps } from "./List";
import { MEDIA_LIST, SELECTION_LIST, SELECTION_TYPE, TRAILING_LIST } from "@molecules/ListItem/ListItemConstant";
import { ICONS } from "@css/Icons";
import { MEDIUM, SQUARE } from "@components/atoms/Avatar/constants";
import { Items } from "./ListConstant";

export default {
    title: "Organisms/List",
    component: List,
    argTypes: {}
} satisfies Meta<typeof List>;

// Action types
const TOGGLE_CHECKBOX_SELECTION = "TOGGLE_CHECKBOX_SELECTION";
const TOGGLE_SELECTION = "TOGGLE_SELECTION";
const SET_SELECTED_ID = "SET_SELECTED_ID";
const CLEAR_SELECTION = "CLEAR_SELECTION";

type SelectionState = {
    items: unknown[];
    accessorKey: string;
    selectedItemIds: Set<unknown>;
    selectedCheckedItems: Set<unknown>;
    selectedId: unknown;
};

type SelectionAction = {
    type: string;
    id: unknown;
    value?: unknown;
};

/* BEGIN: REDUCER */
const selectionReducer = (state: SelectionState, action: SelectionAction) => {
    let updatedState = [];
    const accessorKey = state.accessorKey;
    switch (action.type) {
        case TOGGLE_CHECKBOX_SELECTION: {
            updatedState = state.items;
            let isSelected = false;
            const newSelectedCheckedItems = new Set(state.selectedCheckedItems);
            if (newSelectedCheckedItems.has(action.id)) {
                newSelectedCheckedItems.delete(action.id);
                isSelected = false;
            } else {
                newSelectedCheckedItems.add(action.id);
                isSelected = true;
            }

            const newItems = updatedState.map((item: any) => {
                if (item[accessorKey]?.toString() === String(action.id)) {
                    return {
                        ...item,
                        selection: {
                            ...item.selection,
                            props: { ...item.selection.props, checked: isSelected }
                        }
                    };
                }
                return item;
            });
            return {
                ...state,
                items: newItems,
                selectedCheckedItems: newSelectedCheckedItems
            };
        }
        case SET_SELECTED_ID: {
            // This action is specifically for radio button logic
            updatedState = state.items;
            const items = updatedState.map((item: any) => {
                if (item[accessorKey]?.toString() === String(action.id)) {
                    return {
                        ...item,
                        selection: {
                            ...item.selection,
                            props: { ...item?.selection?.props, checked: true }
                        }
                    };
                } else {
                    return {
                        ...item,
                        selection: {
                            ...item.selection,
                            props: { ...item?.selection?.props, checked: false }
                        }
                    };
                }
            });
            return { ...state, items, selectedId: action.id };
        }
        case TOGGLE_SELECTION: {
            updatedState = state.items;
            let isSelected = false;
            const newSelectedIds = new Set(state.selectedItemIds);
            if (newSelectedIds.has(action.id)) {
                newSelectedIds.delete(action.id);
                isSelected = false;
            } else {
                newSelectedIds.add(action.id);
                isSelected = true;
            }
            return {
                ...state,
                items: updateItems(state.items, accessorKey, action.id, isSelected),
                selectedItemIds: newSelectedIds
            };
        }
        case CLEAR_SELECTION: {
            const newSelectedIds = new Set(state.selectedItemIds);
            if (newSelectedIds.has(action.id)) {
                newSelectedIds.delete(action.id);
            }
            return {
                ...state,
                items: updateItems(state.items, accessorKey, action.id, false),
                selectedItemIds: newSelectedIds
            };
        }
        default:
            return state;
    }
};
/* END: REDUCER */

const updateItems = (items: unknown[], accessorKey: string, id: unknown, isSelected: boolean) => {
    const updatedItems = items.map((item: any) => {
        if (item[accessorKey]?.toString() === String(id)) {
            return {
                ...item,
                isSelected: isSelected
            };
        }
        return item;
    });
    console.log("this is the updated item: ", updatedItems);
    return updatedItems;
};

const initialState = (items: unknown[], accessorKey: string) => {
    return {
        items,
        accessorKey: accessorKey || "id",
        selectedItemIds: new Set(),
        selectedCheckedItems: new Set(),
        selectedId: null
    };
};

/* BEGIN: CUSTOM HOOK */
const useToggleSelection = ({ items, accessorKey }: { items: unknown[]; accessorKey: string }) => {
    const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(selectionReducer, initialState(items, accessorKey));

    const toggleCheckboxSelection = useCallback(
        (id: unknown, value?: unknown) => {
            dispatch({
                type: TOGGLE_CHECKBOX_SELECTION,
                id,
                value
            });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );

    const setSelectedId = useCallback(
        (id: unknown) =>
            dispatch({
                type: SET_SELECTED_ID,
                id
            }),
        [dispatch]
    );

    const toggleSelection = useCallback(
        (id: unknown) =>
            dispatch({
                type: TOGGLE_SELECTION,
                id
            }),
        [dispatch]
    );

    const clearSelection = useCallback(
        (id: unknown) => {
            dispatch({ type: CLEAR_SELECTION, id });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );

    const values = useMemo(
        () => ({ state, toggleCheckboxSelection, setSelectedId, toggleSelection, clearSelection }),
        [state, clearSelection, setSelectedId, toggleCheckboxSelection, toggleSelection]
    );
    return values;
};
/* END: CUSTOM HOOK */

/////////////////
const Template = (args: ListProps) => {
    const { state } = useToggleSelection({ items: args.items, accessorKey: args?.accessorKey || "id" });
    const { items } = state;

    const itemList = useMemo(() => items, [items]);

    return <List {...args} items={itemList} data-testid="test" />;
};

/////////////////
const SelectionTemplate = (args: ListProps) => {
    const { state, toggleCheckboxSelection, setSelectedId } = useToggleSelection({
        items: args.items,
        accessorKey: args?.accessorKey || "id"
    });
    const { items } = state;

    const itemList = useMemo(() => {
        // If checkbox, props returns {event, type, id, value, selectedItemIds }
        // If radio, props returns {event, type, id, value, checked }
        const onChange = (props: any /*, event*/) => {
            console.log("this is the props: ", props);
            const { id, type, value /*, selectedItemIds*/ } = props;
            if (type === SELECTION_TYPE.CHECKBOX) {
                toggleCheckboxSelection(id, value.checked);
            } else {
                setSelectedId(id);
            }
        };

        return items.map((item: any) => {
            return {
                ...item,
                selection: {
                    ...item?.selection,
                    props: {
                        ...item?.selection?.props,
                        onChange: onChange
                    }
                }
            };
        });
    }, [items, setSelectedId, toggleCheckboxSelection]);

    return <List {...args} items={itemList} data-testid="test" />;
};

const InteractiveTemplate = (args: ListProps) => {

                //action: The action menu props
                //selectedItemIds: Apply only for Checkbox selection control - Selected Items Ids
                //selectedItemId: Apply only for Radio selection control  - Seletected Item's Id
                onClick: (props: any, event: React.MouseEvent) => console.log("action menu on click: ", props, event)
            };

        return i;
    });

    const itemList = useMemo(() => {
        // If checkbox, props returns {id, type, value, selectedItemIds }

        const onChange = (props: any, event: React.SyntheticEvent) => {
            const { id, type, value, selectedItemIds } = props;
            if (type === SELECTION_TYPE.CHECKBOX) {
                toggleCheckboxSelection(id, value.checked);
                console.log("this is the selectedItemIds: ", selectedItemIds);
            } else {

            }
            // If isInteractive is set to true, let's update the isSelected state, too!

        };

        const handleOnClick = (props: any, event: React.MouseEvent) => {

                        }

const ControlledTemplate = (args: ListProps) => {
    const { state, toggleCheckboxSelection, setSelectedId, toggleSelection /*, clearSelection*/ } = useToggleSelection({
````

````typescript
import Button from "@atoms/button/Button";
import { Modal, BaseModal, type ModalProps } from "./Modal";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import Select from "@molecules/Select/Select";
import FormFieldAccessory from "@atoms/FormFieldAccessory/FormFieldAccessory";

export default {
    title: "Organisms/Modal",
    component: Modal,
    argTypes: {}
} satisfies Meta<typeof Modal>;

const ContentWrapper = styled("div")`
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    position: relative;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    width: auto;
    font-family: proxima-nova, Proxima, "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif;
`;

const Body = styled("div")`
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: row;
    position: relative;
    flex: 1 1 auto;
    width: auto;
`;

const Section = styled("div")`
    flex-grow: 1;
    width: 49%;
    display: flex;
    flex-direction: column;
    gap: 4px;
`;

const StyledSubHeader = styled("div")`
    font-weight: 700;
    font-size: 14px;
    line-height: 20px;
    color: #303b4c;
    margin-bottom: 8px;
`;

const StyledText = styled("div")`
    font-size: 14px;
    font-weight: 400;
    line-height: 20px;
    letter-spacing: 0;
    text-align: left;

    & ul li {
        margin-left: -16px;
    }
`;

const VerticalSeperator = styled("div")`
    border: 1px solid #b3b3b3;
    height: 100%;
    margin-left: 16px;
    margin-right: 16px;
`;

const DivWithMargins = styled("div")`
    margin: 16px 0;
`;

const OPTIONS = Array.from({ length: 14 }).map((_, index) => {
    return {
        label: `Label ${index + 1}`,
        value: `${index}`
    };
});

const Template = (args: ModalProps) => {
    const [showModal, setShowModal] = useState(false);

    const onClick = () => {
        setShowModal(prevState => !prevState);
    };
    const closeModal = () => {
        setShowModal(false);
    };
    const buttons = useMemo(() => {
        return {
            ...args.buttons,
            secondaryOnClick: closeModal
        };
    }, [args]);

    //allow storybook to control modal display
    useEffect(() => {
        if (args.showModal || args.showModal === false) {
            setShowModal(args.showModal);
        }
    }, [args.showModal]);
    return (
        <>
            <Button type="primary" onClick={onClick}>
                Show Modal
            </Button>
            <Modal {...args} showModal={showModal} buttons={buttons} />
        </>
    );
};

            <Button type="primary" onClick={onClick}>
                Show Modal
            </Button>
            <Modal {...args} showModal={showModal} buttons={buttons}>
                <ContentWrapper>
                    <Body>
                        <Section>
                            <FormFieldAccessory htmlFor="select-account" title="Select Account" isRequired>
                                <Select
                                    id="select-account"
                                    options={OPTIONS}
                                    onChange={value => console.log(value)}
                                    maxHeight="md"
                                    {...({ disablePortal: false, disableFlip: true } as any)}
                                />
                            </FormFieldAccessory>
                            <br />
                            <FormFieldAccessory htmlFor="select-profile" title="Select Profile" isRequired>
                                <Select
                                    id="select-profile"
                                    options={OPTIONS}
                                    onChange={value => console.log(value)}
                                    maxHeight="sm"
                                    {...({ disablePortal: false, disableFlip: true } as any)}
                                />
                            </FormFieldAccessory>
                        </Section>
                        <VerticalSeperator />
                        <Section>
                            <StyledSubHeader>Go to Client-Side</StyledSubHeader>
                            <StyledText>
                                You do not have access to Server-Side for this profile. Got to Client-Side instead
                            </StyledText>
                            <DivWithMargins>
                                <Button disabled onClick={() => console.log("Go to Client-Side")}>
                                    Go To Client-Side
                                </Button>
                            </DivWithMargins>
                        </Section>
                    </Body>
                </ContentWrapper>
            </Modal>
        </>
    );
};

            }
````
````typescript
        ]

const DataContext = React.createContext<{ data: any; setData: any }>({ data: {}, setData: () => {} });

const ValidationTemplate = (args: MultistepWizardProps) => {
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
    const defaultData = useMemo(
        () => (args.isEditMode ? { 1: "Step 1", 2: "Step 2", 3: "Step 3" } : {}),
        [args.isEditMode]
    );
    const [data, setData] = useState(defaultData);
    const [wizardResult, setWizardResult] = useState(data);

    const toggleOpen = useCallback(() => {
        setIsOpen(true);
    }, [setIsOpen]);

    const toggleClose = useCallback(() => {
        setIsOpen(false);
        setData(defaultData);
    }, [setIsOpen, setData, defaultData]);

    const onSave = useCallback(() => {
        toggleClose();
        console.log("save clicked");
        setWizardResult(data);
    }, [toggleClose, data]);

    return (
        <DataContext.Provider value={{ data, setData }}>
            <button onClick={toggleOpen}>click to open</button>
            <div>{"Result: " + JSON.stringify(wizardResult)}</div>
            <MultistepWizard {...args} isOpen={isOpen} onClose={toggleClose} onSave={onSave}>
                <MyWizardStep async={(args as any).async} id={1}>
                    step 1:
                </MyWizardStep>
                <MyWizardStep async={(args as any).async} id={2}>
                    step 2:
                </MyWizardStep>
                <MyWizardStep async={(args as any).async} id={3}>
                    step 3
                </MyWizardStep>
            </MultistepWizard>
        </DataContext.Provider>
    );
};

const MyWizardStep = ({ id, children, async }: { id: any; children: any; async?: boolean }) => {
    const [hasError, setHasError] = useState(false);

    const { data, setData } = useContext(DataContext);
    const [value, setValue] = useState(data[id]);

    const onValidation = useCallback(async () => {
        if (async) {
            await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 2000));
        }
        const newHasError = !value;
        if (newHasError) {
            setHasError(newHasError);
        }

        const newData = { ...data };
        newData[id] = value;
        setData(newData);

        return !newHasError;
    }, [value, async, data, setData, id]);

    const onStepSuccess = useCallback(() => console.log("Step changed"), []);

    useMultistepWizardValidation(id, onValidation);

    useStepSuccess(id, onStepSuccess);

    return (
        <div style={{ margin: "1em" }}>
            <div>{children}</div>
            <Textbox
                type="text"
                value={value}
                onChange={setValue}
                error={hasError}
                errorHelperText="field is required"
            />
        </div>
    );
};
````

````typescript
import React, { useState } from "react";
import MultistepWizard from "./MultistepWizard";
import { useMultistepWizardValidation, useStepSuccess } from "./MultistepWizardContext";
import { render, screen, waitFor } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import { ALERT_BAR_TYPE } from "@atoms/AlertBar/AlertBarConstants";

const WIZARD_STEPS = [
    { id: 1, title: "Step 1 label" },
    { id: 2, title: "Step 2 label" },
    { id: 3, title: "Step 3 label" }
];

const DATA_TRACT_ACTION_BUTTONS = {
    primary: {
        dataTrackAction: "primary_btn"
    },
    secondary: {
        dataTrackAction: "secondary_btn"
    },
    cancel: {
        dataTrackAction: "cancel_btn"
    }
};

const DATA_TRACK_ACTION = "data-track-action";

const Step = ({
    id,
    onValidation,
    onStepSuccess,
    children
}: {
    id: number;
    onValidation?: () => boolean | Promise<boolean>;
    onStepSuccess?: () => void;
    children: React.ReactNode;
}) => {
    useMultistepWizardValidation(id, onValidation);

    useStepSuccess(id, onStepSuccess);

    return children;
};

const CloseMultistepWizardTest = () => {
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(true);

    return (
        <MultistepWizard
            steps={WIZARD_STEPS}
            isOpen={isOpen}
            onClose={() => setIsOpen(false)}
            data-testid="multistep-wizard-test"
        >
            <Step id={1}>step1</Step>
            <Step id={2}>step2</Step>
            <Step id={3}>step3</Step>
        </MultistepWizard>
    );
};

describe("MultistepWizard", () => {
    it("renders multistep wizard", () => {
        render(
            <MultistepWizard steps={WIZARD_STEPS} isOpen={true} data-testid="multistep-wizard-test">
                <div>step1</div>
                <div>step2</div>
                <div>step3</div>
            </MultistepWizard>
        );

        expect(screen.getByTestId("multistep-wizard-test")).toBeInTheDocument();
````

````typescript
import { useDropoffCarryoverValues, useElementSize, useNodeState } from "./SankeyHooks";
import { renderHook } from "@testing-library/react";
import { DEFAULT_MOCK_DATA, NODE_STATES } from "./SankeyConstants";
import React, { useRef } from "react";
import { mockElementBoundingClientRect, mockResizeObserver } from "jsdom-testing-mocks";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import { act } from "react-dom/test-utils";

// Initialize a shared mock ResizeObserver before tests run
const ro = mockResizeObserver();

describe("Sankey Chart Hook Tests", () => {
    it("useNodeState should return correctly", () => {
        const { result } = renderHook(() => useNodeState());
        expect(result.current[0]).toBe(NODE_STATES.NEUTRAL);
        expect(typeof result.current[1]).toBe("function");
        expect(typeof result.current[2]).toBe("function");
    });

    it("useNodeState handles hovering correctly", () => {
        const handleHover = jest.fn(() => {});
        const { result } = renderHook(() => useNodeState(handleHover));
        act(() => {
            result.current[1]();
        });
        expect(result.current[0]).toBe(NODE_STATES.HOVER);
        expect(handleHover).toHaveBeenCalledWith(true);
        act(() => {
            result.current[2]();
        });
        expect(result.current[0]).toBe(NODE_STATES.NEUTRAL);
        expect(handleHover).toHaveBeenCalledWith(false);
    });

    it("useDropoffCarryoverValues should return correctly", () => {
        const payload = {
            sourceLinks: [10, 13, 14],
            value: 114
        } as any;
        const { result } = renderHook(() => useDropoffCarryoverValues(payload, DEFAULT_MOCK_DATA));
        expect(result.current.newDropoffTotal).toBe(41);
        expect(result.current.carryoverTotal).toBe(73);
    });

    it("useElementSize should return the size correctly", async () => {
        const MockComponent = () => {
            const ref = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
            const size = useElementSize(ref);
            return (
                <div ref={ref} data-testid="test">
                    {size.w} x {size.h}
                </div>
            );
        };
        render(<MockComponent />);
        const div = screen.getByTestId("test");

        expect(screen.getByText("0 x 0")).toBeInTheDocument();

        mockElementBoundingClientRect(div, { width: 300, height: 200 });
        await act(async () => {
            ro.resize(div);
        });

        expect(screen.getByText("300 x 200")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
});
````

## File: src/components/organisms/SankeyChart/SankeyHooks.tsx
````typescript
import { useCallback, useEffect, useMemo, useState } from "react";
import { NODE_STATES, type NodeState, type SankeyData } from "./SankeyConstants";
import { calculateCarryoverTotal, type SankeyNodePayload } from "./SankeyHelpers";

export const useNodeState = (
    handleHover: (isHovering: boolean) => void = () => {}
): [NodeState, (e?: React.MouseEvent) => void, (e?: React.MouseEvent) => void] => {
    const [state, setState] = useState<NodeState>(NODE_STATES.NEUTRAL);

    const handleMouseEnter = useCallback(
        (e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
            setState(NODE_STATES.HOVER);
            handleHover(true);
        },
        [setState, handleHover]
    );

    const handleMouseLeave = useCallback(
        (e?: React.MouseEvent) => {
            setState(NODE_STATES.NEUTRAL);
            handleHover(false);
        },
        [setState, handleHover]
    );

    return [state, handleMouseEnter, handleMouseLeave];
};

export const useDropoffCarryoverValues = (
    payload: SankeyNodePayload,
    data: SankeyData
): { newDropoffTotal: number; carryoverTotal: number } => {
    const carryoverTotal = useMemo(() => calculateCarryoverTotal(payload, data), [payload, data]);
    const newDropoffTotal = payload.value - carryoverTotal;
    return { newDropoffTotal, carryoverTotal };
};

export const useElementSize = (
    ref: React.RefObject<HTMLElement | null> | HTMLElement | null
): { w: number; h: number } => {
    const [containerDimensions, setContainerDimensions] = useState({ w: 0, h: 0 });

    useEffect(() => {
        let resizeObserver: ResizeObserver | null = null;
        const element = ref && "current" in ref ? ref.current : ref;
        if (element) {
            resizeObserver = new ResizeObserver(entries => {
                setContainerDimensions({
                    w: entries[0].contentRect.width,
                    h: entries[0].contentRect.height
                });
            });
            resizeObserver.observe(element);
        }
        return () => {
            if (resizeObserver) resizeObserver.disconnect();
        };
    }, [ref]);

    return containerDimensions;
};
````

````typescript
import "react-table";

declare module "react-table" {
    export interface Row<D extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>> {
        /** The original data for this row */
        original: D;
        /** The index of this row */
        index: number;
        /** The unique identifier for this row */
        id: string;
        /** The row's values object */
        values: Record<string, unknown>;
        /** The row's cells array */
        cells: Cell<D>[];
        /** Get props for the row element */
        getRowProps: () => { key: string | number; [key: string]: unknown };
        /** Whether row is selected */
        isSelected?: boolean;
        /** Whether row can be expanded */
        canExpand?: boolean;
        /** Toggle row selection - added by useRowSelect plugin */
        toggleRowSelected?: (rowId?: string, set?: boolean) => void;
    }

    export interface Cell<D extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>> {
        /** The column for this cell */
        column: ColumnInstance<D>;
        /** The row for this cell */
        row: Row<D>;
        /** The value of this cell */
        value: unknown;
        /** Get props for the cell element */
        getCellProps: () => { key: string | number; [key: string]: unknown };
        /** Render the cell */
        render: (type: string, userProps?: Record<string, unknown>) => React.ReactNode;
    }

    export interface ColumnInstance<D extends Record<string, unknown> = Record<string, unknown>> {
        /** Cell data type (e.g. "text", "badge", "avatar") */
        type?: string;
        /** Cell width value */
        cellWidth?: string | number;
    }
}
````

````javascript
import React, { useState } from "react";
import PropTypes from "prop-types";
import { useTable } from "react-table";
import { styled } from "@mui/material/styles";
import useTableUtils from "./TableHooks/useTableUtils";
import useSelectedRows from "./TableHooks/useSelectedRows";
import useEnrichedErrors from "./TableHooks/useEnrichedErrors";
import useGlobalFilterUpdate from "./TableHooks/useGlobalFilterUpdate";
import useDeleteRow from "./TableHooks/useDeleteRow";
import TableBase from "@atoms/TableBase/TableBase";
import TableContainer from "@atoms/TableContainer/TableContainer";
import Header from "./TableModules/Header";
import Body from "./TableModules/Body";
import CustomizableToolbar from "./TableModules/CutomizableToolbar";
import useProcessColumns from "./TableHooks/useProcessColumns";
import useUnselectableRows from "./TableHooks/useUnselectableRows";
import useToggleRowSelection from "./TableHooks/useToggleRowSelection";
import useSelectAllRowsTrigger from "./TableHooks/useSelectAllRowsTrigger";
import useSelectRowTrigger from "./TableHooks/useSelectRowTrigger";
import { ColumnsShape } from "@components/shared/shapes/ColumnsShape";
import { ToolbarButtonShape } from "@components/shared/shapes/ToolbarButtonShape";

const Table = ({
    onRowClick,
    selectedRowIndex,
    hasSelections,
    onSelectedRowChanged,
    columns = [],
    data = [],
    localeTexts = {},
    toolbarOptions,
    errorMessages,
    hasSubHeaders,
    topOffset = "0px",
    defaultSortBy,
    sortByDesc,
    dataTrackAction,
    "data-testid": dataTestId
}) => {
    const [overwriteSelection, setOverwriteSelection] = useState({});
    const unselectableRows = useUnselectableRows(data);
    const onDeleteRow = useDeleteRow(overwriteSelection, setOverwriteSelection);
    const onToggleRowSelection = useToggleRowSelection(overwriteSelection, setOverwriteSelection);
    const triggerRowSelect = useSelectRowTrigger({
        onToggleRowSelection: onToggleRowSelection,
        onDeleteRow: onDeleteRow
    });
    const triggerAllRowsSelect = useSelectAllRowsTrigger({
        overwriteSelection: overwriteSelection,
        setOverwriteSelection: setOverwriteSelection,
        unselectableRows: unselectableRows,
        data: data
    });

    const { expandedRows, tableHooks, sortBy, controlledStateCallback } = useTableUtils({
        data: data,
        hasSubHeaders: hasSubHeaders,
        defaultSortBy: defaultSortBy,
        sortByDesc: sortByDesc,
        overwriteSelection: overwriteSelection,
        setOverwriteSelection: setOverwriteSelection,
        unselectableRows: unselectableRows,
        onDeleteRow: onDeleteRow,
        onToggleRowSelection: onToggleRowSelection
    });

    const postProcessColumns = useProcessColumns({
        hasSelections: hasSelections,
        columns: columns,
        dataTestId: dataTestId,
        triggerAllRowsSelect: triggerAllRowsSelect,
        triggerRowSelect: triggerRowSelect
    });

    const {
        headerGroups,
        rows,
        prepareRow,
        preGlobalFilteredRows,
        setGlobalFilter,
        toggleRowSelected,
        getTableBodyProps
    } = useTable(
        {
            useControlledState: controlledStateCallback,
            autoResetSelectedRows: false,
            columns: postProcessColumns,
            data,
            autoResetGlobalFilter: false,
            disableSortRemove: true,
            disableMultiSort: true,
            initialState: {
                expanded: expandedRows,
                sortBy
            }
        },
        ...tableHooks
    );

    const triggerGlobalFilterUpdate = useGlobalFilterUpdate({
        toolbarOptions: toolbarOptions,
        setGlobalFilter: setGlobalFilter
    });

    const selectedRows = useSelectedRows({
        toolbarOptions: toolbarOptions,
        overwriteSelection: overwriteSelection,
        setGlobalFilter: setGlobalFilter,
        errorMessages: errorMessages,
        onSelectedRowChanged: onSelectedRowChanged,
        preGlobalFilteredRows: preGlobalFilteredRows
    });

    const defaultErrorMessages = useEnrichedErrors(errorMessages);

    const hideToolbar = toolbarOptions?.hideToolbar;

    return (
        <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" }}>
            {!hideToolbar && (
                <CustomizableToolbar
                    topOffset={topOffset}
                    toolbarOptions={toolbarOptions}
                    toggleRowSelected={toggleRowSelected}
                    triggerAllRowsSelect={triggerAllRowsSelect}
                    rows={rows}
                    localeTexts={localeTexts}
                    overwriteSelection={overwriteSelection}
                    preGlobalFilteredRows={preGlobalFilteredRows}
                    selectedRows={selectedRows}
                    triggerGlobalFilterUpdate={triggerGlobalFilterUpdate}
                    parentDataTestId={dataTestId}
                />
            )}
            <TableContainer>
                <TableBase componentType="div" data-testid={dataTestId} stickyHeader={true}>
                    <Header headerGroups={headerGroups} topOffset={topOffset} hideToolbar={hideToolbar} />
                    <Body
                        rows={rows}
                        prepareRow={prepareRow}
                        selectedRowIndex={selectedRowIndex}
                        onRowClick={onRowClick}
                        hasSelections={hasSelections}
                        data-testid={`${dataTestId}_body`}
                        preGlobalFilteredRows={preGlobalFilteredRows}
                        toggleRowSelected={triggerRowSelect}
                        getTableBodyProps={getTableBodyProps}
                        dataTrackAction={dataTrackAction}
                    />
                </TableBase>
            </TableContainer>
            {rows.length === 0 && (
                <ErrorMessagesWrap>
                    {toolbarOptions?.preFilterItemCount || preGlobalFilteredRows.length
                        ? defaultErrorMessages.notFound
                        : defaultErrorMessages.noItems}
                </ErrorMessagesWrap>
            )}
        </div>
    );
};

Table.propTypes = {
    /**
     * Used for checkbox/selections for bulk actions
     * @param {Boolean} hasSelections -  enable or disable feature
     */
    hasSelections: PropTypes.bool,
    /**
     * Used for a callback when checkbox selections change,
     * returns array of selected row ids
     * Signature: function(selectedRowIds: string[]) => void
     */
    onSelectedRowChanged: PropTypes.func,
    /**
     * used for row click changes
     * Signature: function(row: object) => void
     */
    onRowClick: PropTypes.func,
    /**
     * which row is selected?
     */
    selectedRowIndex: PropTypes.number,
    /**
     * columns of table
     * @param {String[]}
     * please memoize your columns with useMemo
     */
    columns: ColumnsShape.isRequired,
    /**
     * data of table, the accessor of the headers are your key entries into their columns for data
     * i.e., a column accessor = "firstName", your data object would be [{firstName: "Name"}]
     * Please memoize your data with useMemo
     */
    data: PropTypes.array,
    /**
     * locale text overwrites for defaults
     */
    localeTexts: PropTypes.shape({
        SEARCH_PLACEHOLDER: PropTypes.string,
        BULK_ACTIONS: PropTypes.string,
        SELECTED: PropTypes.string
    }),
    /**
     * options for the toolbar
     */
    toolbarOptions: PropTypes.shape({
        /**
         * autofocus for textbox
         * default: false
         */
        autoFocus: PropTypes.bool,
        /**
         * this is used to tie a type to the number of data listed
         * i.e. tableType = "Users", "6 Users" or "2 of 6 Users" will display
         */
        tableType: PropTypes.string,
        /**
         * use this for default buttons in toolbar component if you don't need to have different ones
         */
        buttons: ToolbarButtonShape,
        /**
         * use this if you want to have custom buttons for the toolbar
         * be sure to pass in a useCallBack functional component
         */
        customButtons: PropTypes.func,
        /**
         * use this if you want to overwrite the default toolbar with your own
         * be sure to pass in a useCallBack functional component
         */
        customToolbar: PropTypes.func,
        /**
         * enable search/filtering
         */
        hasSearch: PropTypes.bool,
        /**
         * pass in a custom search callback or leave blank to use the uncontrolled search/filter
         */
        onSearchCallback: PropTypes.func,
        /**
         * hides the toolbar entirely
         */
        hideToolbar: PropTypes.bool
    }),
    /**
     * sets the top offset for the toolbar and header
     * use case: sticky toolbar/header for scroll on a non-fixed height table
     */
    topOffset: PropTypes.string,
    /**
     * overwrite default error messages with a locale one
     */
    errorMessages: PropTypes.shape({
        noItems: PropTypes.any,
        notFound: PropTypes.any
    }),
    /**
     * set to enable subheaders
     * subheaders should have a "subRows" prop containing the array of child rows
     */
    hasSubHeaders: PropTypes.bool,
    /**
     * accessor of the column to sort by default
     */
    defaultSortBy: PropTypes.string,
    /**
     * sort descending by default when defaultSortBy is set
     */
    sortByDesc: PropTypes.bool,
    /**
     * Used for testing
     */
    "data-testid": PropTypes.string
};

const ErrorMessagesWrap = styled.div`padding-top: 48px;
font-weight: 600;
font-size: 20px;
line-height: 28px;
display: flex;
justify-content: center;
align-items: center;
color: #a2a8b0;
flex-direction: column;
`;

export default Table;
````

````typescript
const generateLabels = () => {

};

const addLabels = (data: Record<string, unknown>) => {
    data["labels"] = [];
    const randomLabels = generateLabels().sort((a, b) => a - b);
    if (randomLabels.length === 0) {
        data["labels"] = {
````
