````typescript
            });
        });
    }

    return data;
};

type ReducerState = Record<string, unknown>[];
type ReducerAction =
    | { type: "addSwitch"; on: boolean; onChange: (status: boolean, rowIndex: number) => void }
    | { type: "updateSwitch"; status: boolean; _dataRowIndex: number }
    | { type: "deleteRow"; rows: { _dataRowIndex: number }[] }
    | { type: "enableSelected"; selectedRows: { _dataRowIndex: number }[] }
    | { type: "disableSelected"; selectedRows: { _dataRowIndex: number }[] }
    | { type: "addMenu"; func: (row: { _dataRowIndex: number }) => void }
    | { type: "addLabels" }
    | { type: "hideSwitchAndMenu" };

const reducer = (state: ReducerState, action: ReducerAction): ReducerState => {
    let updatedState: ReducerState;
    switch (action.type) {
        case "addSwitch":
            return state.map((data: Record<string, unknown>) => {
                data["switchStatus"] = {
                    on: action.on,
                    onChange: action.onChange
                };
                return data;
            });
        case "updateSwitch":
            updatedState = [...state];
            (updatedState[action._dataRowIndex] as Record<string, { on: boolean }>).switchStatus.on = action.status;

            return updatedState;
        case "deleteRow":
            updatedState = [...state];
            for (let i = action.rows.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
                updatedState.splice(action.rows[i]._dataRowIndex, 1);
            }

            return updatedState;
        case "enableSelected":
            updatedState = [...state];
            action.selectedRows.forEach((row: { _dataRowIndex: number }) => {
                (
                    updatedState[row._dataRowIndex] as Record<string, { on: boolean; disabled: boolean }>
                ).switchStatus.on = true;
                (
                    updatedState[row._dataRowIndex] as Record<string, { on: boolean; disabled: boolean }>
                ).switchStatus.disabled = false;
            });

            return updatedState;
        case "disableSelected":
            updatedState = [...state];
            action.selectedRows.forEach((row: { _dataRowIndex: number }) => {
                (
                    updatedState[row._dataRowIndex] as Record<string, { on: boolean; disabled: boolean }>
                ).switchStatus.on = false;
                (
                    updatedState[row._dataRowIndex] as Record<string, { on: boolean; disabled: boolean }>
                ).switchStatus.disabled = true;
            });
            return updatedState;

        case "addMenu":
            return state.map((data: Record<string, unknown>) => {
                data["menu"] = [
                    {
                        id: "1",
                        onClick: (rowIndex: number) => {
                            console.log("Action 1", rowIndex);
                        },
                        icon: <i className="fas fa-toggle-on" />,
                        text: "Action 1",
                        disabled: true,
                        dataTrackAction: "row_action_item_1"
                    },
                    {
                        id: "2",
                        onClick: (rowIndex: number) => {
                            console.log("Action 2", rowIndex);
                        },
                        icon: <i className="fas fa-toggle-off" />,
                        text: "Action 2",
                        clearSelectionAfterClick: true,
                        dataTrackAction: "row_action_item_2"
                    },
                    {
                        id: "3",
                        onClick: (rowIndex: number, toggleRowSelected: (val1: boolean, val2: boolean) => void) => {
                            console.log("Action 3", rowIndex);
                            toggleRowSelected(false, true);
                            action.func({ _dataRowIndex: rowIndex });
                        },
                        icon: <i className="fas fa-toggle-off" />,
                        text: "Action 3",
                        dataTrackAction: "row_action_item_3"
                    }
                ];
                return data;
            });
        case "addLabels":
            return state.map((data: Record<string, unknown>) => {
                if (data.subRows) {
                    (data.subRows as Record<string, unknown>[]).map((row: Record<string, unknown>) => {
                        addLabels(row);
                    });
                } else {
                    addLabels(data);
                }
                return data;
            });
        case "hideSwitchAndMenu":
            return state.map((data: Record<string, unknown>) => {
                if (data.hideStatus) {
                    data["switchStatus"] = {
                        hide: true
                    };
                }
                if (data.hideMenu) {
                    data["menu"] = {
                        hide: true
                    };
                }
                return data;
            });
        default:
            throw new Error();
    }
};

const useEditData = (
    data: ReducerState,
    addSwitch: boolean,
    addMenu: boolean,
    addLabels: boolean,
    hideSwitchAndMenu = false
) => {
    const [state, dispatch] = useReducer(reducer, data);
    const handleSwitchChange = useCallback(
        (status: boolean, rowIndex: number) => {
            dispatch({ type: "updateSwitch", status: status, _dataRowIndex: rowIndex });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );

    const enableSelectedAction = useCallback(
        (rows: { _dataRowIndex: number }[]) => {
            dispatch({ type: "enableSelected", selectedRows: rows });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );
    const disableSelectedAction = useCallback(
        (rows: { _dataRowIndex: number }[]) => {
            dispatch({ type: "disableSelected", selectedRows: rows });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );
    const deleteRow = useCallback(
        (rows: { _dataRowIndex: number }[]) => {
            dispatch({ type: "deleteRow", rows: rows });
        },
        [dispatch]
    );
    useEffect(() => {
        if (addSwitch) {
            dispatch({ type: "addSwitch", on: false, onChange: handleSwitchChange });
        }
    }, [dispatch, addSwitch, handleSwitchChange]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (addMenu) {
            dispatch({
                type: "addMenu",
                func: (row: { _dataRowIndex: number }) => dispatch({ type: "deleteRow", rows: [row] })
            });
        }
    }, [dispatch, addMenu]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (addLabels) {
            dispatch({ type: "addLabels" });
        }
    }, [dispatch, addLabels]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (hideSwitchAndMenu) {
            dispatch({ type: "hideSwitchAndMenu" });
        }
    }, [dispatch, hideSwitchAndMenu]);

    const val = useMemo(() => {
        return {
            memoData: state,
            deleteRow: deleteRow,
            enableSelectedAction: enableSelectedAction,
            disableSelectedAction: disableSelectedAction
        };
    }, [state, deleteRow, enableSelectedAction, disableSelectedAction]);
    return val;
};
const generateData = () => {
    const returnVal = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 300; i++) {
        const dataLength = DEFAULT_DATA.length - 1;
        returnVal.push({ ...DEFAULT_DATA[i + dataLength * Math.floor(i / 300)], index: i });
    }
    return returnVal;
};

const CheckboxCell = ({ value }: { value: { checked: boolean; onChange: () => void } | null }) => {
    if (!value) {
        return null;
    }

    const { checked, onChange } = value;

    return <Checkbox checked={checked} onChange={onChange} />;
};

const CheckboxTemplate = (args: TableProps) => {
    const [masterMap, setMasterMap] = useState<Record<string, boolean>>({
        obiWan: true,
        mace: true,
        yoda: true,
        anakin: false,
        vader: false,
        dooku: false,
        maul: false,
        palpatine: true
    });

    const onCheckboxUpdated = useCallback((value: { checked: boolean }, id: string) => {
        setMasterMap(prevMap => {
            const newMap = { ...prevMap };
            newMap[id] = value.checked;
            return newMap;
        });
    }, []);

    const data = [
        {
            firstName: "Jedi",
            subRows: [
                {
                    firstName: "Obi-Wan",
                    lastName: "Kenobi",
                    master: {
                        checked: masterMap.obiWan,
                        onChange: (val: { checked: boolean }) => onCheckboxUpdated(val, "obiWan")
                    }
                },
                {
                    firstName: "Mace",
                    lastName: "Windu",
                    master: {
                        checked: masterMap.mace,
                        onChange: (val: { checked: boolean }) => onCheckboxUpdated(val, "mace")
                    }
                },
                {
                    firstName: "Yoda",
                    master: {
                        checked: masterMap.yoda,
                        onChange: (val: { checked: boolean }) => onCheckboxUpdated(val, "yoda")
                    }
                },
                {
                    firstName: "Anakin",
                    lastName: "Skywalker",
                    master: {
                        checked: masterMap.anakin,
                        onChange: (val: { checked: boolean }) => onCheckboxUpdated(val, "obiWan")
                    }
                }
            ]
        },
        {
            firstName: "Sith",
            subRows: [
                {
                    firstName: "Darth",
                    lastName: "Vader",
                    master: {
                        checked: masterMap.vader,
                        onChange: (val: { checked: boolean }) => onCheckboxUpdated(val, "vader")
                    }
                },
                {
                    firstName: "Count",
                    lastName: "Dooku",
                    master: {
                        checked: masterMap.dooku,
                        onChange: (val: { checked: boolean }) => onCheckboxUpdated(val, "dooku")
                    }
                },
                {
                    firstName: "Darth",
                    lastName: "Maul",
                    master: {
                        checked: masterMap.maul,
                        onChange: (val: { checked: boolean }) => onCheckboxUpdated(val, "maul")
                    }
                },
                {
                    firstName: "Emperor",
                    lastName: "Palpatine",
                    master: {
                        checked: masterMap.palpatine,
                        onChange: (val: { checked: boolean }) => onCheckboxUpdated(val, "palpatine")
                    }
                }
            ]
        }
    ];

    return <Table {...args} data={data} />;
};
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { render, screen } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";
import VideoLightbox from "./VideoLightbox";

const COMPONENT_TEST_ID = "video_lightbox";
const CLOSE_BUTTON_TEST_ID = `${COMPONENT_TEST_ID}_close_button`;
const YOUTUBE_IFRAME_TEST_ID = `${COMPONENT_TEST_ID}_youtube_iframe`;

describe("VideoLoghtbox", () => {
    it("isn't displayed when is not opened", () => {
        render(<VideoLightbox opened={false} data-testid={COMPONENT_TEST_ID} {...({} as any)} />);

        expect(screen.queryByTestId(COMPONENT_TEST_ID)).not.toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("is displayed when is opened", () => {
        render(<VideoLightbox opened={true} data-testid={COMPONENT_TEST_ID} {...({} as any)} />);

        expect(screen.queryByTestId(COMPONENT_TEST_ID)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("calls onClose when close button is clicked", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        const mockOnClose = jest.fn();
        render(<VideoLightbox opened={true} onClose={mockOnClose} data-testid={COMPONENT_TEST_ID} {...({} as any)} />);

        screen.getByTestId(COMPONENT_TEST_ID);

        await user.click(screen.getByTestId(CLOSE_BUTTON_TEST_ID));

        expect(mockOnClose).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("displays youtube iframe", () => {
        render(
            <VideoLightbox opened={true} youtubeVideoId="testId" data-testid={COMPONENT_TEST_ID} {...({} as any)} />
        );

        expect(screen.getByTestId(YOUTUBE_IFRAME_TEST_ID)).toBeInTheDocument();
    });
});
````

````typescript
import React, { useState, useCallback, useContext } from "react";
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react";
import Wizard, { type WizardProps } from "./Wizard";
import { useWizardValidation } from "./WizardContext";
import Textbox from "@atoms/textbox/Textbox";

export default {
    title: "Organisms/Wizard",
    component: Wizard
} satisfies Meta<typeof Wizard>;

const Template = (args: WizardProps) => {
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);

    const toggleOpen = useCallback(() => {
        setIsOpen(true);
    }, [setIsOpen]);
    const toggleClose = useCallback(() => {
        setIsOpen(false);
    }, [setIsOpen]);

    const onSave = useCallback(() => {
        toggleClose();
        console.log("save clicked");
    }, [toggleClose]);

    return (
        <>
            <button onClick={toggleOpen}>click to open</button>
            <Wizard {...args} isOpen={isOpen} onClose={toggleClose} onSave={onSave}>
                <div>step1</div>
                <div>step2</div>
                <div>step3</div>
            </Wizard>
        </>
    );
};

export const Default: StoryObj<typeof Wizard> = {
    render: Template,
    args: {
        title: "Wizard",
        steps: [
            { id: 1, title: "Step 1" },
            { id: 2, title: "Application and Feature Permissions" },
            { id: 3, title: "Add Profiles" }
        ]
    }
};

const DataContext = React.createContext<{ data: any; setData: any }>({ data: {}, setData: () => {} });

const ValidationTemplate = (args: WizardProps) => {
    const [isOpen, setIsOpen] = useState(false);
    const [data, setData] = useState({});
    const [wizardResult, setWizardResult] = useState({});

    const toggleOpen = useCallback(() => {
        setIsOpen(true);
    }, [setIsOpen]);

    const toggleClose = useCallback(() => {
        setIsOpen(false);
    }, [setIsOpen]);

    const onSave = useCallback(() => {
        toggleClose();
        console.log("save clicked");
        setWizardResult(data);
    }, [toggleClose, data]);

    return (
        <DataContext.Provider value={{ data, setData }}>
            <button onClick={toggleOpen}>click to open</button>
            <div>{"Result: " + JSON.stringify(wizardResult)}</div>
            <Wizard {...args} isOpen={isOpen} onClose={toggleClose} onSave={onSave}>
                <MyWizardStep async={(args as any).async} id={1}>
                    step 1:
                </MyWizardStep>
                <MyWizardStep async={(args as any).async} id={2}>
                    step 2:
                </MyWizardStep>
                <MyWizardStep async={(args as any).async} id={3}>
                    step 3
                </MyWizardStep>
            </Wizard>
        </DataContext.Provider>
    );
};

const MyWizardStep = ({ id, children, async }: { id: any; children: any; async?: boolean }) => {
    const [value, setValue] = useState("");
    const [hasError, setHasError] = useState(false);

    const { data, setData } = useContext(DataContext);

    const onValidation = useCallback(async () => {
        if (async) {
            await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 1000));
        }
        const newHasError = value === "";
        if (newHasError) {
            setHasError(newHasError);
        }

        const newData = { ...data };
        newData[id] = value;
        setData(newData);

        return !newHasError;
    }, [value, async, data, setData, id]);

    useWizardValidation(id, onValidation);

    return (
        <div style={{ margin: "1em" }}>
            <div>{children}</div>
            <Textbox
                type="text"
                value={value}
                onChange={setValue}
                error={hasError}
                errorHelperText="field is required"
            />
        </div>
    );
};

export const Validation: StoryObj<typeof Wizard> = {
    render: ValidationTemplate,
    args: {
        title: "Wizard",
        isOpen: true,
        steps: [
            {
                id: 1,
                title: "Group Type",
                details: (
                    <div>
                        step 1 details
                        <ul>
                            <li>abc</li>
                            <li>123</li>
                        </ul>
                    </div>
                )
            },
            { id: 2, title: "Application and Feature Permissions" },
            { id: 3, title: "Add Profiles" }
        ]
    }
};

export const AsyncValidation: any = {
    render: ValidationTemplate,
    args: {
        ...Validation.args,
        async: true
    },
    parameters: { controls: { exclude: ["async"] } }
};
````

````typescript
// wrapped component for storybook compatibility
const SelectionsTemplateWrapper = (args: ComponentProps<typeof ActionMenu>) => {
    const [selectedActions, setSelectedActions] = useState(["2"]); // set default selections

    const handleOnClick = useCallback(
        (id: string) =>
            setSelectedActions(selectedActions => {
                console.log("Menu Item", id);
                if (selectedActions.includes(id)) {
                    return selectedActions.filter(action => action !== id);
                } else {
                    return [...selectedActions, id];
                }
            }),
        [setSelectedActions]
    );

    const SelectionCheckboxTemplate = (args: any) => {
        const isChecked = selectedActions.includes(args.parentId);
        const onCheckboxUpdated = () => {
            handleOnClick(args.parentId);
        };
        return <Checkbox {...args} checked={isChecked} onChange={() => onCheckboxUpdated()} />;
    };

    const SelectableActions = [
        {
            id: "1",
            text: "Section Title",
            isSectionTitle: true
        },
        {
            id: "2",
            text: "Menu Item",
            onClick: () => {
                handleOnClick("2");
            },
            isSelected: selectedActions.includes("2")
        },
        {
            id: "3",
            text: "Menu Item",
            onClick: () => {
                handleOnClick("3");
            },
            isSelected: selectedActions.includes("3")
        },
        {
            id: "4",
            icon: <SelectionCheckboxTemplate id="4-1" label="Menu Item 4" value={false} parentId={"4"} />,
            isSelected: selectedActions.includes("4")
        },
        {
            id: "5",
            text: "Menu Item",
            onClick: () => {
                handleOnClick("5");
            },
            isSelected: selectedActions.includes("5")
        },
        {
            id: "6",
            text: "Sub Menu",
            childComponent: (
                <ActionMenu
                    actionList={[
                        {
                            id: "child1",
                            text: "Nested Action 1",
                            onClick: () => {
                                handleOnClick("child1");
                            },
                            isSelected: selectedActions.includes("child1")
                        },
                        {
                            id: "child2",
                            text: "Nested Action 2",
                            onClick: () => {
                                handleOnClick("child2");
                            },
                            isSelected: selectedActions.includes("child2")
                        }
                    ]}
                />
            )
        }
    ];
    return <ActionMenu {...args} actionList={SelectableActions} />;
};

const WithSelectionsTemplate = (args: ComponentProps<typeof ActionMenu>) => {
    return <SelectionsTemplateWrapper {...args} />;
};

export const WithSelections: StoryObj<typeof ActionMenu> = {
    render: WithSelectionsTemplate
};
````

````typescript
import React, { createRef } from "react";
import Icon from "./Icon";
import { render } from "@testing-library/react";
import { BLUE_500 } from "@css/constants";

describe("Card Tests", () => {
    it("should render an icon with color and size props", () => {
        //arrange/act
        const { getByTestId, container } = render(
            <Icon icon="fas fa-file-alt" color={BLUE_500} size="20px" data-testid="test" />
        );
        const wrapper = getByTestId("test-icon-wrapper");
        expect(wrapper).toBeInTheDocument();
        // Check that the icon element exists and has the correct class
        const iconEl = container.querySelector(".fas.fa-file-alt");
        expect(iconEl).toBeInTheDocument();
        // Check that the color style is applied
        expect(iconEl).toHaveStyle(`color: ${BLUE_500}`);
        // Check that the font-size style is applied
        expect(iconEl).toHaveStyle(`font-size: 20px`);
        // Check that the wrapper has correct width and height
        expect(wrapper).toHaveStyle(`width: 20px`);
        expect(wrapper).toHaveStyle(`height: 20px`);
    });

    it("should render an icon with color and custom style props", () => {
        //arrange/act
        const customStyle = { width: "15px", height: "15px" };
        const { getByTestId, container } = render(
            <Icon icon="fas fa-file-alt" color={BLUE_500} style={customStyle} data-testid="test" />
        );
        const wrapper = getByTestId("test-icon-wrapper");
        expect(wrapper).toBeInTheDocument();
        // Check that the icon element exists and has the correct class
        const iconEl = container.querySelector(".fas.fa-file-alt");
        expect(iconEl).toBeInTheDocument();
        // Check that the color style is applied
        expect(iconEl).toHaveStyle(`color: ${BLUE_500}`);
        // Check that the custom width and height are applied to the wrapper
        expect(wrapper).toHaveStyle(`width: 15px`);
        expect(wrapper).toHaveStyle(`height: 15px`);
    });

    it("should render an icon with minimal props", () => {
        const { container } = render(<Icon icon="fas fa-file-alt" />);
        const iconEl = container.querySelector(".fas.fa-file-alt");
        expect(iconEl).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should handle missing icon prop gracefully", () => {
        const { container } = render(<Icon />);
        // Should not throw, and should render an empty <i> element
        const iconEl = container.querySelector("i");
        expect(iconEl).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("should support aria-label for accessibility", () => {
        const { container } = render(
            <Icon icon="fas fa-file-alt" attrProps={{ "aria-label": "Document icon" }} data-testid="icon-accessible" />
        );
        const iconEl = container.querySelector(".fas.fa-file-alt");
        expect(iconEl).toBeInTheDocument();
        if (iconEl) {
            expect(iconEl.getAttribute("aria-label")).toBe("Document icon");
        }
    });

    it("should support aria-hidden for decorative icons", () => {
        const { container } = render(
            <Icon icon="fas fa-file-alt" attrProps={{ "aria-hidden": "true" }} data-testid="icon-decorative" />
        );
        const iconEl = container.querySelector(".fas.fa-file-alt");
        expect(iconEl).toBeInTheDocument();
        if (iconEl) {
            expect(iconEl.getAttribute("aria-hidden")).toBe("true");
        }
    });

    it("should forward ref to the icon element", () => {
        const ref = createRef<HTMLElement>();
        const { container } = render(<Icon ref={ref} icon="fas fa-check" />);

        expect(ref.current).toBeTruthy();
        expect(ref.current).toBeInstanceOf(HTMLElement);
        expect(ref.current?.tagName.toLowerCase()).toBe("i");
        expect(ref.current?.className).toContain("fas");
        expect(ref.current?.className).toContain("fa-check");
    });

    it("should support native HTML attributes via ComponentPropsWithRef", () => {
        const ref = createRef<HTMLElement>();
        const { container } = render(
            <Icon ref={ref} icon="fas fa-star" className="custom-class" data-custom="test-value" id="icon-id" />
        );

        const iconEl = ref.current;
        expect(iconEl).toBeTruthy();
        expect(iconEl?.className).toContain("custom-class");
        expect(iconEl?.getAttribute("data-custom")).toBe("test-value");
        expect(iconEl?.id).toBe("icon-id");
    });
});
````

````typescript
import React, { createRef } from "react";
import Slider, { getAriaLabel } from "./Slider";
import { render, screen, waitFor, fireEvent } from "@testing-library/react";
import userEvent from "@testing-library/user-event";

// --- getAriaLabel unit tests ---
describe("getAriaLabel", () => {
    it("returns step marks label when lockToMarks is true and markLabels is a non-empty array", () => {
        expect(
            getAriaLabel({
                lockToMarks: true,
                markLabels: [
                    { value: 0, label: "zero" },
                    { value: 1, label: "one" }
                ],
                step: 5,
                hasMarks: true
            })
        ).toBe("continue-slider with step marks for zero, one");
    });
    it("returns fallback label for various non-array or empty markLabels", () => {
        expect(
            getAriaLabel({
                lockToMarks: true,
                markLabels: null as unknown as Array<{ value: number; label: string }>,
                step: 5,
                hasMarks: true
            })
        ).toMatch(/continuous-slider/);
        expect(
            getAriaLabel({
                lockToMarks: true,
                markLabels: 42 as unknown as Array<{ value: number; label: string }>,
                step: 5,
                hasMarks: true
            })
        ).toMatch(/continuous-slider/);
        expect(getAriaLabel({ lockToMarks: true, markLabels: [], step: 5, hasMarks: true })).toMatch(
            /continuous-slider/
        );
    });
    it("returns fallback label when lockToMarks is false", () => {
        expect(
            getAriaLabel({ lockToMarks: false, markLabels: [{ value: 0, label: "zero" }], step: 5, hasMarks: true })
        ).toMatch(/continuous-slider/);
    });
});

describe("Slider accessibility and aria props", () => {
    it("should use aria-labelledby when provided and not set aria-label", () => {
        render(<Slider value={0} attrProps={{ "aria-labelledby": "some-label-id" }} />);
        const slider = screen.getByRole("slider");
        expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-labelledby", "some-label-id");
        expect(slider).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-label");
    });
    it("should use aria-label when aria-labelledby is not provided", () => {
        render(<Slider value={0} attrProps={{ "aria-label": "custom-slider-label" }} />);
        const slider = screen.getByRole("slider");
        expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "custom-slider-label");
        expect(slider).not.toHaveAttribute("aria-labelledby");
    });
    it("should fallback to getAriaLabel output if no aria-label or aria-labelledby", () => {
        render(<Slider value={0} lockToMarks={true} markLabels={[]} step={10} hasMarks={true} attrProps={{}} />);
        const slider = screen.getByRole("slider");
        expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", expect.stringContaining("continuous-slider"));
    });
});

describe("Slider Tests", () => {
    it("render a slider", () => {
        // arrange
        let value = 25;
        const onChange = (val: number) => {
            value = val;
        };

        // act
        render(<Slider onChange={onChange} value={value} min={0} max={100} attrProps={{ "aria-label": "slider" }} />);

        // assert
        const slider = screen.getByRole("slider");
        expect(slider).toBeInTheDocument();
        // Accessibility: ARIA attributes
        expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuenow", "25");
        expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemin", "0");
        expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemax", "100");
        // Initial value
        expect(Number(slider.getAttribute("aria-valuenow"))).toBe(25);
        // Focus
        slider.focus();
        expect(slider).toHaveFocus();
    });

    it("render a disabled slider", () => {
        // arrange
        let value = 0;
        const onChange = (val: number) => {
            value = val;
        };

        // act
        render(<Slider onChange={onChange} value={value} disabled attrProps={{ "aria-label": "slider" }} />);

        // assert
        expect(screen.getByRole("slider")).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("render a slider with mark labels", async () => {
        // arrange
        let value = 0;
        const onChange = jest.fn(val => {
            value = val;
        });

        // act
        render(
            <Slider
                onChange={onChange}
                value={value}
                disabled
                lockToMarks
                min={0}
                max={50}
                markLabels={[
                    { value: 0, label: "zero" },
                    { value: 50, label: "fifty" }
                ]}
                attrProps={{ "aria-label": "slider with marks" }}
            />
        );

        // ARIA attributes

        expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemin", "0");
        expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-valuemax", "50");
        // Disabled (check parent element for Mui-disabled class in MUI v5)
        expect(slider.parentElement).toHaveClass("Mui-disabled");
        // Try to change value via keyboard (should not call onChange)
        slider.focus();

    it("should change the slider value on click", async () => {

            const [value, setValue] = React.useState(0);
            return (
                <Slider
                    onChange={(val: number) => {
                        setValue(val);
                        props.onChange(val);
                    }}
                    value={value}
                    min={0}
                    max={100}
                    attrProps={{ "aria-label": "slider" }}
                />
            );
        }
        const onChange = jest.fn();

        const slider = screen.getByRole("slider");
        // Accessibility: focusable
        slider.focus();
        expect(slider).toHaveFocus();

        await user.pointer({
            target: slider,
            coords: { clientX: 162, clientY: 302 },
            keys: "[MouseLeft]"
        });
        // assert
        // onChange called
        expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalled();
        // Value updated (aria-valuenow should be > 0)
        expect(Number(slider.getAttribute("aria-valuenow"))).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        // onChange receives value in range
        const calledWith = onChange.mock.calls[0][0];
        expect(calledWith).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(0);
        expect(calledWith).toBeLessThanOrEqual(100);
    });

    it("should change the commit value on mouse up", async () => {
        const user = userEvent.setup();
        // arrange
        function SliderWrapper(props: { onChange: (val: number) => void; onChangeCommitted: (val: number) => void }) {
            const [value, setValue] = React.useState(0);
            return (
                <Slider
                    onChange={(val: number) => {
                        setValue(val);
                        props.onChange(val);
                    }}
                    value={value}
                    onChangeCommitted={props.onChangeCommitted}
                    min={0}
                    max={100}
                    attrProps={{ "aria-label": "slider" }}
                />
            );
        }
        const onChange = jest.fn();
        const onChangeCommitted = jest.fn();
        render(<SliderWrapper onChange={onChange} onChangeCommitted={onChangeCommitted} />);
        const slider = screen.getByRole("slider");
        // Pointer down (drag start)
        await user.pointer({ target: slider, coords: { clientX: 162, clientY: 302 }, keys: "[MouseLeft>]" });
        // onChange should be called
        expect(onChange).toHaveBeenCalled();
        // ARIA value should update
        expect(Number(slider.getAttribute("aria-valuenow"))).toBeGreaterThan(0);
        // onChangeCommitted should NOT be called yet
        expect(onChangeCommitted).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
        // Pointer up (commit)
        await user.pointer({ target: slider, coords: { clientX: 162, clientY: 302 }, keys: "[/MouseLeft]" });
        // onChangeCommitted should be called once
        expect(onChangeCommitted).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1);
        // Committed value matches current value
        const committedValue = onChangeCommitted.mock.calls[0][0];
        expect(committedValue).toBe(Number(slider.getAttribute("aria-valuenow")));
    });

            />
        );
        // Do not simulate pointer events on disabled slider (not allowed)
        // Just assert that callbacks are not called after render

            />
        );

        // assert

    });

    it("render a slider with dynamic aria label", async () => {

                </>
            );
        }

    it("render a slider with fallback aria label", () => {

        };
        // act
        // Suppress prop-type warning for this test only
        const originalError = console.error;
        console.error = (msg, ...args) => {

            originalError(msg, ...args);
        };
        render(<Slider onChange={onChange} value={value} />);

        const slider = screen.getByRole("slider");

describe("Slider refactor with forwardRef and ComponentPropsWithRef", () => {
    it("forwards ref to HTMLSpanElement (MUI Slider root element)", () => {
        const ref = createRef<HTMLSpanElement>();
        render(<Slider ref={ref} value={50} attrProps={{ "aria-label": "slider" }} />);
        expect(ref.current).toBeInstanceOf(HTMLSpanElement);
        expect(ref.current?.tagName).toBe("SPAN");
    });

    it("supports custom onChange with value only (not event)", () => {
        const handleChange = jest.fn();
        render(<Slider value={50} onChange={handleChange} min={0} max={100} attrProps={{ "aria-label": "slider" }} />);
        const slider = screen.getByRole("slider");
        // Simulate slider change via fireEvent
        fireEvent.change(slider, { target: { value: "75" } });
        // Should be called with number only, not event
        expect(handleChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith(75);
        expect(handleChange).not.toHaveBeenCalledWith(expect.objectContaining({ target: expect.anything() }));
    });

    it("supports custom onChangeCommitted with value only (not event)", () => {
        const handleChangeCommitted = jest.fn();
        render(
            <Slider
                value={50}
                onChangeCommitted={handleChangeCommitted}
                min={0}
                max={100}
                attrProps={{ "aria-label": "slider" }}
            />
        );
        const slider = screen.getByRole("slider");
        // Simulate mouse up event
        fireEvent.mouseDown(slider);
        fireEvent.mouseUp(slider);
        // Should be called with number only, not event
        expect(handleChangeCommitted).toHaveBeenCalledWith(50);
        expect(handleChangeCommitted).not.toHaveBeenCalledWith(
            expect.anything(),
            expect.objectContaining({ target: expect.anything() })
        );
    });

    it("supports native HTML props passthrough (className)", () => {
        const { container } = render(
            <Slider value={50} className="custom-slider-class" attrProps={{ "aria-label": "slider" }} />
        );
        // MUI Slider root is a span with the className
        const sliderRoot = container.querySelector(".custom-slider-class");
        expect(sliderRoot).toBeInTheDocument();
        expect(sliderRoot?.tagName).toBe("SPAN");
    });

    it("supports native HTML props passthrough (data-* attributes)", () => {
        render(<Slider value={50} data-custom="test-value" attrProps={{ "aria-label": "slider" }} />);
        const slider = screen.getByRole("slider");
        // data-* should be on the slider element or its parent
        const sliderParent = slider.closest('[data-custom="test-value"]');
        expect(sliderParent).toBeInTheDocument();
    });

    it("supports native HTML props passthrough (aria-* attributes)", () => {
        render(<Slider value={50} aria-label="native slider label" min={0} max={100} />);
        const slider = screen.getByRole("slider");
        // aria-label passed as native prop should work
        expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "native slider label");
    });

    it("supports native aria-describedby prop", () => {
        render(
            <div>
                <p id="slider-desc">Slider description</p>
                <Slider value={50} aria-describedby="slider-desc" aria-label="slider" />
            </div>
        );
        const slider = screen.getByRole("slider");
        expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-describedby", "slider-desc");
    });

    it("maintains backward compatibility with attrProps['aria-label'] (deprecated)", () => {
        render(<Slider value={50} attrProps={{ "aria-label": "deprecated label" }} />);
        const slider = screen.getByRole("slider");
        // Should still work for backward compatibility
        expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "deprecated label");
    });

    it("native aria-label takes precedence over attrProps['aria-label']", () => {
        render(
            <Slider
                value={50}
                aria-label="native label"
                attrProps={{ "aria-label": "deprecated label" }}
                min={0}
                max={100}
            />
        );
        const slider = screen.getByRole("slider");
        // Native prop should win
        expect(slider).toHaveAttribute("aria-label", "native label");
    });
});
````

````typescript
import React, { useEffect, useState, ComponentProps } from "react";
import type { Meta, StoryObj } from "@storybook/react";
import TextArea from "./TextArea";
import FormFieldAccessory from "@atoms/FormFieldAccessory/FormFieldAccessory";
import { GRAY_300 } from "@css/constants";

export default {
    title: "Atoms/TextArea",
    component: TextArea,
    argTypes: {
        resize: {
            options: ["none", "vertical", "auto"],
            control: { type: "select" }
        }
    }
} satisfies Meta<typeof TextArea>;

const Template = (args: ComponentProps<typeof TextArea>) => {
    const [value, setValue] = useState("");

    useEffect(() => {
        if (typeof args.value === "string") {
            setValue(args.value);
        }
    }, [args.value]);
    return (
        <div style={{ height: "75px", width: "320px" }}>
            <TextArea {...args} value={value} onChange={setValue} />
        </div>
    );
};

const AccessibilityTemplate = (args: ComponentProps<typeof TextArea>) => {
    const [value, setValue] = useState("");

    useEffect(() => {
        if (typeof args.value === "string") {
            setValue(args.value);
        }
    }, [args.value]);
    return (
        <div style={{ height: "75px", width: "320px" }}>
            <FormFieldAccessory title="Comments" htmlFor="comment-textarea">
                <TextArea {...args} value={value} onChange={setValue} />
            </FormFieldAccessory>
        </div>
    );
};

const ResizableTemplate = (args: ComponentProps<typeof TextArea>) => {
    const [stdValue, setStdValue] = useState("");
    const [divValue, setDivValue] = useState("");
    const [flexValue, setFlexValue] = useState("");
    const [gridValue, setGridValue] = useState("");

    useEffect(() => {
        if (typeof args.value === "string") {
            setStdValue(args.value);
            setFlexValue(args.value);
            setGridValue(args.value);
        }
    }, [args.value]);
    return (
        <div style={{ display: "flex", flexDirection: "column", gap: 32, width: "400px" }}>
            <div style={{ height: "75px", width: "300px" }}>
                <TextArea {...args} value={stdValue} onChange={setStdValue} />
            </div>
            <div>
                <h4>Block Container</h4>
                <div
                    style={{
                        minHeight: "120px",
                        border: "2px solid #333",
                        padding: "16px"
                    }}
                >
                    <TextArea {...args} value={divValue} onChange={setDivValue} height={args.height || "120px"} />
                </div>
            </div>
            <div>
                <h4>Flex Container</h4>
                <div
                    style={{
                        display: "flex",
                        border: "2px solid #333",
                        padding: "16px",
                        minHeight: "150px",
                        alignItems: "stretch",
                        background: "#fafbfc"
                    }}
                >
                    <div style={{ flex: 1, marginRight: 8, display: "flex", flexDirection: "column" }}>
                        <TextArea {...args} value={flexValue} onChange={setFlexValue} />
                    </div>
                    <div
                        style={{
                            background: GRAY_300,
                            padding: "16px",
                            flex: 1,
                            display: "flex",
                            flexDirection: "column"
                        }}
                    >
                        Flex Item
                    </div>
                </div>
            </div>
            <div>
                <h4>Grid Container</h4>
                <div
                    style={{
                        display: "grid",
                        gridTemplateColumns: "1fr 100px",
                        border: "2px solid #333",
                        padding: 16,
                        minHeight: 120,
                        gap: 8
                    }}
                >
                    <div>
                        <TextArea {...args} value={gridValue} onChange={setGridValue} />
                    </div>
                    <div style={{ background: GRAY_300, padding: 8 }}>Grid Item</div>
                </div>
            </div>
        </div>
    );
};

export const Default: StoryObj<typeof TextArea> = {
````

````typescript
import { BLACK_600, GRAY_600, GRAY_800 } from "@css/constants";

export default {
    title: "Molecules/Select",

    argTypes: {
        isOpen: { control: "boolean", default: false },
        hasScrollbar: { control: "boolean", default: false }
    }
} satisfies Meta<typeof Select>;

type Story = StoryObj<typeof Select>;

const OPTIONS: SelectOption[] = [
    {
        label: "Luke Skywalker",
        value: "luke.skywalker@rebellion.com"

    {

    },
    {
        label: "Han Solo",

    },

    },
    {

        value: "obiwan.kenobi@jeditemple.org"
    },
    {
        label: "Yoda",
        value: "yoda@jeditemple.org"
    }
];

const DISABLED_OPTIONS: SelectOption[] = OPTIONS.map((item, index) => {
    return {
        ...item,
        disabled: index % 2 === 0
    };
});

const addIcon = (item: SelectOption): SelectOption => {
    const iconIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * 14);
    const newItem: SelectOption = {
        ...item,
        icon: <StyledIcon className={`${ICONS[iconIndex].icon}`} color={`${ICONS[iconIndex].color}`} />
    };
    return newItem;
};

const addStyleIcon = (item: SelectOption): SelectOption => {
    const iconIndex = Math.floor(Math.random() * 14);
    const newItem: SelectOption = {
        ...item,
        icon: (
            <i
                className={`${ICONS[iconIndex].icon}`}
                style={{ ...StyledIconInline, backgroundColor: `${ICONS[iconIndex].color}` }}
            />
        )
    };
    return newItem;
};

const Template = (args: SelectProps) => {
    const [value, setValue] = useState<string | number | SelectOption | undefined>(args.value || undefined);

    const onChange = (value: any) => {
        args.onChange && args.onChange(value);
        setValue(value);
    };

    return <Select {...args} value={value} onChange={onChange} data-testid="test" />;
};

// Template for FormFieldAccessory stories
type FormFieldAccessoryTemplateProps = SelectProps & { isRequired?: boolean };

const FormFieldAccessoryTemplate = (args: FormFieldAccessoryTemplateProps) => {
    const { isRequired, value: argValue, onChange: argOnChange, ...selectProps } = args;
    const [value, setValue] = useState<string | number | SelectOption | undefined>(argValue || undefined);

    const onChange = (value: any) => {
        argOnChange && argOnChange(value);
        setValue(value);
    };

    const combinedProps: SelectProps = {
        ...(selectProps as SelectProps),
        id: "user-select",
        value,
        onChange,
        "data-testid": "test"
    };

    return (
        <FormFieldAccessory title="Select User" htmlFor="user-select" isRequired={isRequired}>
            <Select {...combinedProps} />
        </FormFieldAccessory>
    );
};
````

````typescript
import React from "react";
import { render, screen, act } from "@testing-library/react";
import type { DragEndEvent, DragStartEvent } from "@dnd-kit/core";
import ColumnReorderPanel, { handleDragEndLogic, type ColumnReorderPanelHandle } from "./ColumnReorderPanel";

type Column = {
    accessor?: string;
    id?: string;
    Header?: string;
    type?: string;
    reorderable?: boolean;
    isLocked?: boolean;
    isBuildIn?: boolean;
    manageable?: boolean;
    [key: string]: unknown;
};

type DndHandlers = {
    onDragStart?: (event: DragStartEvent) => void;
    onDragEnd?: (event: DragEndEvent) => void;
};

declare global {
    // eslint-disable-next-line no-var
    var dndHandlers: DndHandlers;
}

jest.mock("@dnd-kit/core", () => {
    const actual = jest.requireActual("@dnd-kit/core");
    const React = require("react");
    return {
        ...actual,
        DndContext: (props: { onDragStart?: (event: DragStartEvent) => void; onDragEnd?: (event: DragEndEvent) => void; children: React.ReactNode }) => {
            // Use global variable that Jest allows
            global.dndHandlers = {
                onDragStart: props.onDragStart,
                onDragEnd: props.onDragEnd
            };
            return React.createElement("div", { "data-testid": "dnd-context" }, props.children);
        },
        useSensors: () => [],
        useSensor: () => ({})
    };
});

jest.mock("@dnd-kit/sortable", () => ({
    SortableContext: ({ children }: { children: React.ReactNode }) => children,
    verticalListSortingStrategy: "vertical",
    arrayMove: jest.requireActual("@dnd-kit/sortable").arrayMove,
    useSortable: () => ({
        attributes: {},
        listeners: {},
        setNodeRef: jest.fn(),
        transform: null,
        transition: null,
        isDragging: false
    })
}));

// Helper functions to simulate drag events
const dragStart = (id: string | number): DragStartEvent => ({ active: { id } } as DragStartEvent);
const dragEnd = (activeId: string | number, overId: string | number | null): DragEndEvent => ({
    active: { id: activeId },
    over: overId ? { id: overId } : null
} as DragEndEvent);

// Helper to determine if any column is reorderable
function hasColumnReorder(columns: Column[]): boolean {
    return columns.some((col: Column) => col.reorderable !== false);
}

describe("ColumnReorderPanel - hasColumnReorder", () => {
    it("returns true if at least one column is reorderable", () => {
        const columns: Column[] = [
            { accessor: "a", reorderable: false },
            { accessor: "b" }, // reorderable by default
            { accessor: "c", reorderable: false }
        ];
        expect(hasColumnReorder(columns)).toBe(true);
    });

    it("returns false if all columns are not reorderable", () => {
        const columns: Column[] = [
            { accessor: "a", reorderable: false },
            { accessor: "b", reorderable: false }
        ];
        expect(hasColumnReorder(columns)).toBe(false);
    });

    it("returns true if reorderable is not set (defaults to true)", () => {
        const columns: Column[] = [{ accessor: "a" }, { accessor: "b" }];
        expect(hasColumnReorder(columns)).toBe(true);
    });

    it("works with empty columns array", () => {
        expect(hasColumnReorder([])).toBe(false);
    });
});

describe("ColumnReorderPanel - handleDragEndLogic pure function", () => {
    const mockColumns: Column[] = [
        { Header: "First Name", accessor: "firstName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
        { Header: "Last Name", accessor: "lastName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
        { Header: "Email", accessor: "email", type: "text", reorderable: true }
    ];

    it("should successfully reorder columns when both are reorderable", () => {
        const mockEvent = {
            active: { id: "firstName" },
            over: { id: "email" }
        } as DragEndEvent;

        const result = handleDragEndLogic(mockEvent, mockColumns);

        expect(result.success).toBe(true);
        expect(result.oldIndex).toBe(0);
        expect(result.newIndex).toBe(2);
        expect(result.draggedColumn?.reorderable).toBe(true);
        expect(result.targetColumn?.reorderable).toBe(true);
    });

    it("should not reorder when dragging to same position (active.id === over.id)", () => {
        const mockEvent = {
            active: { id: "firstName" },
            over: { id: "firstName" }
        } as DragEndEvent;

        const result = handleDragEndLogic(mockEvent, mockColumns);

        expect(result.success).toBe(false);
        expect(result.reason).toBe("same-position");
        expect(result.activeId).toBe("firstName");
    });

    it("should prevent reordering when dragged column is not reorderable", () => {
        const nonReorderableColumns: Column[] = [
            { Header: "First Name", accessor: "firstName", type: "text", reorderable: false },
            { Header: "Last Name", accessor: "lastName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
            { Header: "Email", accessor: "email", type: "text", reorderable: true }
        ];

        const mockEvent = {
            active: { id: "firstName" },
            over: { id: "email" }
        } as DragEndEvent;

        const result = handleDragEndLogic(mockEvent, nonReorderableColumns);

        expect(result.success).toBe(false);
        expect(result.reason).toBe("dragged-column-not-reorderable");
        expect(result.column?.Header).toBe("First Name");
        expect(result.column?.reorderable).toBe(false);
    });

    it("should prevent dropping into non-reorderable column position", () => {
        const mixedColumns: Column[] = [
            { Header: "First Name", accessor: "firstName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
            { Header: "Last Name", accessor: "lastName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
            { Header: "Email", accessor: "email", type: "text", reorderable: false }
        ];

        const mockEvent = {
            active: { id: "firstName" },
            over: { id: "email" }
        } as DragEndEvent;

        const result = handleDragEndLogic(mockEvent, mixedColumns);

        expect(result.success).toBe(false);
        expect(result.reason).toBe("target-position-not-reorderable");
        expect(result.column?.Header).toBe("Email");
        expect(result.column?.reorderable).toBe(false);
    });

    it("should handle edge case with columns without accessor", () => {
        const columnsWithMissingAccessor: Column[] = [
            { Header: "First Name", accessor: "firstName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
            { Header: "Last Name", type: "text", reorderable: true }, // No accessor
            { Header: "Email", accessor: "email", type: "text", reorderable: true }
        ];

        const mockEvent = {
            active: { id: "firstName" },
            over: { id: "email" }
        } as DragEndEvent;

        const result = handleDragEndLogic(mockEvent, columnsWithMissingAccessor);

        // Should still work for columns with accessor
        expect(result.success).toBe(true);
        expect(result.oldIndex).toBe(0);
        expect(result.newIndex).toBe(2);
    });

    it("should handle mixed reorderable and non-reorderable columns", () => {
        const mixedColumns: Column[] = [
            { Header: "First Name", accessor: "firstName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
            { Header: "Last Name", accessor: "lastName", type: "text", reorderable: false }, // Target not reorderable
            { Header: "Email", accessor: "email", type: "text", reorderable: true }
        ];

        const mockEvent = {
            active: { id: "firstName" },
            over: { id: "lastName" }
        } as DragEndEvent;

        const result = handleDragEndLogic(mockEvent, mixedColumns);

        expect(result.success).toBe(false);
        expect(result.reason).toBe("target-position-not-reorderable");
        expect(result.column?.Header).toBe("Last Name");
    });

    it("should handle case where dragged column is not found", () => {
        const mockEvent = {
            active: { id: "nonexistent" },
            over: { id: "email" }
        } as DragEndEvent;

        const result = handleDragEndLogic(mockEvent, mockColumns);

        // Should handle gracefully - oldIndex will be -1
        expect(result.success).toBe(true);
        expect(result.oldIndex).toBe(-1);
        expect(result.newIndex).toBe(2);
    });

    it("should handle case where target column is not found", () => {
        const mockEvent = {
            active: { id: "firstName" },
            over: { id: "nonexistent" }
        } as DragEndEvent;

        const result = handleDragEndLogic(mockEvent, mockColumns);

        // Should handle gracefully - newIndex will be -1
        expect(result.success).toBe(true);
        expect(result.oldIndex).toBe(0);
        expect(result.newIndex).toBe(-1);
    });
});

describe("ColumnReorderPanel - ref functionality", () => {
    const mockColumns: Column[] = [
        { Header: "First Name", accessor: "firstName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
        { Header: "Last Name", accessor: "lastName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
        { Header: "Email", accessor: "email", type: "text", reorderable: true }
    ];

    const mockHiddenColumns: string[] = [];
    const mockOnReorder = jest.fn();
    const mockOnVisibilityChange = jest.fn();
    const mockOnDone = jest.fn();

    it("should expose handleApplyChanges and resetToInitial via ref", () => {
        const ref = React.createRef<ColumnReorderPanelHandle>();

        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                ref={ref}
                columns={mockColumns}
                initialColumns={mockColumns}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
                onDone={mockOnDone}
            />
        );

        expect(ref.current).toBeDefined();
        if (ref.current) {
            expect(typeof ref.current.handleApplyChanges).toBe("function");
            expect(typeof ref.current.resetToInitial).toBe("function");
        }
    });

    it("should call handleApplyChanges when ref method is called", () => {
        const ref = React.createRef<ColumnReorderPanelHandle>();

        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                ref={ref}
                columns={mockColumns}
                initialColumns={mockColumns}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
                onDone={mockOnDone}
            />
        );

        act(() => {
            if (ref.current) {
                ref.current.handleApplyChanges();
            }
        });

        expect(mockOnReorder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockColumns);
        expect(mockOnVisibilityChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockHiddenColumns);
        expect(mockOnDone).toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should call handleApplyChanges when onDone is not provided", () => {
        const ref = React.createRef<ColumnReorderPanelHandle>();

        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                ref={ref}
                columns={mockColumns}
                initialColumns={mockColumns}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
                // onDone not provided
            />
        );

        act(() => {
            if (ref.current) {
                ref.current.handleApplyChanges();
            }
        });

        expect(mockOnReorder).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockColumns);
        expect(mockOnVisibilityChange).toHaveBeenCalledWith(mockHiddenColumns);
        // Should not crash when onDone is undefined
    });

    it("should call resetToInitial when ref method is called", () => {
        const ref = React.createRef<ColumnReorderPanelHandle>();

        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                ref={ref}
                columns={mockColumns}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
                initialColumns={mockColumns}
                initialHiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
            />
        );

        // First, change the local state by dragging
        act(() => {
            global.dndHandlers.onDragEnd?.(dragEnd("firstName", "email"));
        });

        // Then reset to initial
        act(() => {
            if (ref.current) {
                ref.current.resetToInitial();
            }
        });

        // The component should reset to initial state
        // Note: We can't directly test the internal state, but we can verify the function was called
        if (ref.current) {
            expect(ref.current.resetToInitial).toBeDefined();
        }
    });

    it("should handle resetToInitial when hiddenColumns is undefined and fallback to empty array", () => {
        const ref = React.createRef<ColumnReorderPanelHandle>();

        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                ref={ref}
                columns={mockColumns}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={undefined} // Explicitly undefined
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
                initialColumns={mockColumns}
                initialHiddenColumns={undefined}
            />
        );

        // Verify ref is exposed
        expect(ref.current).toBeDefined();
        if (ref.current) {
            expect(typeof ref.current.resetToInitial).toBe("function");
        }

        // Call resetToInitial - should not crash and should handle undefined gracefully
        act(() => {
            if (ref.current) {
                ref.current.resetToInitial();
            }
        });

        // The function should execute without errors
        // The component should internally use [] as fallback for undefined hiddenColumns
        if (ref.current) {
            expect(ref.current.resetToInitial).toBeDefined();
        }
    });
});

describe("ColumnReorderPanel - handleDragEnd integration tests", () => {
    const mockColumns: Column[] = [
        { Header: "First Name", accessor: "firstName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
        { Header: "Last Name", accessor: "lastName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
        { Header: "Email", accessor: "email", type: "text", reorderable: true }
    ];

    const mockHiddenColumns: string[] = [];
    const mockOnReorder = jest.fn();
    const mockOnVisibilityChange = jest.fn();

    beforeEach(() => {
        jest.clearAllMocks();
        // Clear global handlers
        global.dndHandlers = {} as DndHandlers;
    });

    it("should successfully reorder columns when dragging to new position", () => {
        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                columns={mockColumns}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
                initialColumns={mockColumns}
            />
        );

        // Verify the component rendered the DnD context
        expect(screen.getByTestId("dnd-context")).toBeInTheDocument();

        // Verify that handlers were captured
        expect(global.dndHandlers).toBeDefined();
        expect(global.dndHandlers.onDragEnd).toBeDefined();
        expect(global.dndHandlers.onDragStart).toBeDefined();

        // Simulate drag start
        act(() => {
            global.dndHandlers.onDragStart?.(dragStart("firstName"));
        });

        // Simulate drag end - moving firstName to email position
        act(() => {
            global.dndHandlers.onDragEnd?.(dragEnd("firstName", "email"));
        });

        // The drag event should be handled without errors
        // Note: console.log statements were removed when reverting external tracking
    });

    it("should not reorder when dragging to same position", () => {
        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                columns={mockColumns}
                initialColumns={mockColumns}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
            />
        );

        expect(global.dndHandlers).toBeDefined();

        // Simulate drag start
        global.dndHandlers.onDragStart?.(dragStart("firstName"));

        // Simulate drag end - same position
        global.dndHandlers.onDragEnd?.(dragEnd("firstName", "firstName"));

        // The drag event should be handled without errors
        // Note: console.log statements were removed when reverting external tracking
    });

    it("should handle drag end with invalid indices (oldIndex === -1 || newIndex === -1)", () => {
        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                columns={mockColumns}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
                initialColumns={mockColumns}
            />
        );

        expect(global.dndHandlers).toBeDefined();

        // Simulate drag start
        act(() => {
            global.dndHandlers.onDragStart?.(dragStart("firstName"));
        });

        // Simulate drag end with invalid target (non-existent column)
        // This should trigger the oldIndex === -1 || newIndex === -1 condition
        act(() => {
            global.dndHandlers.onDragEnd?.(dragEnd("firstName", "nonExistentColumn"));
        });

        // The drag event should be handled without errors and return early
        // No reordering should occur due to invalid indices
        expect(mockOnReorder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should handle drag end when dragged column is locked (isLocked === true)", () => {
        // Create columns with one locked column
        const columnsWithLocked: Column[] = [
            { accessor: "firstName", Header: "First Name", reorderable: true, isLocked: false },
            { accessor: "lastName", Header: "Last Name", reorderable: true, isLocked: true }, // This column is locked
            { accessor: "email", Header: "Email", reorderable: true, isLocked: false }
        ];

        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                columns={columnsWithLocked}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
                initialColumns={columnsWithLocked}
            />
        );

        expect(global.dndHandlers).toBeDefined();

        // Simulate drag start on locked column
        act(() => {
            global.dndHandlers.onDragStart?.(dragStart("lastName"));
        });

        // Simulate drag end - trying to move locked column
        act(() => {
            global.dndHandlers.onDragEnd?.(dragEnd("lastName", "firstName"));
        });

        // The drag event should be handled without errors and return early
        // No reordering should occur because dragged column is locked
        expect(mockOnReorder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should handle drag end when target position is locked (isLocked === true)", () => {
        // Create columns with one locked column
        const columnsWithLocked: Column[] = [
            { accessor: "firstName", Header: "First Name", reorderable: true, isLocked: false },
            { accessor: "lastName", Header: "Last Name", reorderable: true, isLocked: true }, // This position is locked
            { accessor: "email", Header: "Email", reorderable: true, isLocked: false }
        ];

        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                columns={columnsWithLocked}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
                initialColumns={columnsWithLocked}
            />
        );

        expect(global.dndHandlers).toBeDefined();

        // Simulate drag start on unlocked column
        act(() => {
            global.dndHandlers.onDragStart?.(dragStart("firstName"));
        });

        // Simulate drag end - trying to drop on locked position
        act(() => {
            global.dndHandlers.onDragEnd?.(dragEnd("firstName", "lastName"));
        });

        // The drag event should be handled without errors and return early
        // No reordering should occur because target position is locked
        expect(mockOnReorder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should handle drag end when actual indices are invalid (actualOldIndex === -1 || actualNewIndex === -1)", () => {
        // Create columns with specific accessors
        const columnsWithSpecificAccessors: Column[] = [
            { accessor: "firstName", Header: "First Name", reorderable: true, isLocked: false },
            { accessor: "lastName", Header: "Last Name", reorderable: true, isLocked: false },
            { accessor: "email", Header: "Email", reorderable: true, isLocked: false }
        ];

        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                columns={columnsWithSpecificAccessors}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
                initialColumns={columnsWithSpecificAccessors}
            />
        );

        expect(global.dndHandlers).toBeDefined();

        // Simulate drag start on a valid column
        act(() => {
            global.dndHandlers.onDragStart?.(dragStart("firstName"));
        });

        // Simulate drag end with a non-existent column accessor for the target
        // This will cause actualNewIndex to be -1 when findIndex can't find "nonExistentTarget"
        act(() => {
            global.dndHandlers.onDragEnd?.(dragEnd("firstName", "nonExistentTarget"));
        });

        // The drag event should be handled without errors
        // The condition should return prev state without changes when actualNewIndex === -1
        // This explicitly tests: if (actualOldIndex === -1 || actualNewIndex === -1) { return prev; }
    });

    it("should handle drag end when dragged column accessor is invalid (actualOldIndex === -1)", () => {
        // Create columns with specific accessors
        const columnsWithSpecificAccessors: Column[] = [
            { accessor: "firstName", Header: "First Name", reorderable: true, isLocked: false },
            { accessor: "lastName", Header: "Last Name", reorderable: true, isLocked: false },
            { accessor: "email", Header: "Email", reorderable: true, isLocked: false }
        ];

        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                columns={columnsWithSpecificAccessors}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
                initialColumns={columnsWithSpecificAccessors}
            />
        );

        expect(global.dndHandlers).toBeDefined();

        // Simulate drag start on a non-existent column
        act(() => {
            global.dndHandlers.onDragStart?.(dragStart("nonExistentDragged"));
        });

        // Simulate drag end with a valid target but invalid dragged column
        // This will cause actualOldIndex to be -1 when findIndex can't find "nonExistentDragged"
        act(() => {
            global.dndHandlers.onDragEnd?.(dragEnd("nonExistentDragged", "lastName"));
        });

        // The drag event should be handled without errors
        // The condition should return prev state without changes when actualOldIndex === -1
        // This explicitly tests: if (actualOldIndex === -1 || actualNewIndex === -1) { return prev; }
    });

    it("should handle drag end with no over target (dragging outside)", () => {
        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                columns={mockColumns}
                initialColumns={mockColumns}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
            />
        );

        expect(global.dndHandlers).toBeDefined();

        // Simulate drag end with no target (dragging outside)
        // Component now handles null 'over' gracefully
        act(() => {
            global.dndHandlers.onDragEnd?.(dragEnd("firstName", null));
        });

        // The drag event should be handled without errors
        expect(mockOnReorder).not.toHaveBeenCalled();
    });

    it("should prevent reordering when dragged column is not reorderable", () => {
        const nonReorderableColumns: Column[] = [
            { Header: "First Name", accessor: "firstName", type: "text", reorderable: false },
            { Header: "Last Name", accessor: "lastName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
            { Header: "Email", accessor: "email", type: "text", reorderable: true }
        ];

        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                columns={nonReorderableColumns}
                initialColumns={nonReorderableColumns}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
            />
        );

        expect(global.dndHandlers).toBeDefined();

        // Try to drag non-reorderable column
        global.dndHandlers.onDragStart?.(dragStart("firstName"));
        global.dndHandlers.onDragEnd?.(dragEnd("firstName", "email"));

        // The drag event should be handled without errors
        // Note: console.log statements were removed when reverting external tracking
    });

    it("should prevent dropping into non-reorderable column position", () => {
        const mixedColumns: Column[] = [
            { Header: "First Name", accessor: "firstName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
            { Header: "Last Name", accessor: "lastName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
            { Header: "Email", accessor: "email", type: "text", reorderable: false }
        ];

        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                columns={mixedColumns}
                initialColumns={mixedColumns}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
            />
        );

        expect(global.dndHandlers).toBeDefined();

        // Try to drop into non-reorderable position
        global.dndHandlers.onDragStart?.(dragStart("firstName"));
        global.dndHandlers.onDragEnd?.(dragEnd("firstName", "email"));

        // The drag event should be handled without errors
        // Note: console.log statements were removed when reverting external tracking
    });

    it("should handle columns without accessor values", () => {
        const columnsWithMissingAccessor: Column[] = [
            { Header: "First Name", accessor: "firstName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
            { Header: "Last Name", type: "text", reorderable: true }, // Missing accessor
            { Header: "Email", accessor: "email", type: "text", reorderable: true }
        ];

        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                columns={columnsWithMissingAccessor}
                initialColumns={columnsWithMissingAccessor}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
            />
        );

        expect(global.dndHandlers).toBeDefined();

        // Should still handle drag events
        global.dndHandlers.onDragStart?.(dragStart("firstName") as DragStartEvent);
        global.dndHandlers.onDragEnd?.(dragEnd("firstName", "email") as DragEndEvent);

        // The drag event should be handled without errors
        // Note: console.log statements were removed when reverting external tracking
    });

    it("should handle handleDragStart callback", () => {
        render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                columns={mockColumns}
                initialColumns={mockColumns}
                onReorder={mockOnReorder}
                hiddenColumns={mockHiddenColumns}
                onVisibilityChange={mockOnVisibilityChange}
            />
        );

        expect(global.dndHandlers).toBeDefined();

        // Simulate drag start
        global.dndHandlers.onDragStart?.(dragStart("firstName"));

        // The handleDragStart function exists but doesn't do much currently
        // We're just verifying it doesn't crash
        expect(global.dndHandlers.onDragStart).toBeDefined();
    });
});

describe("ColumnReorderPanel - window resize handling", () => {
    const mockColumns: Column[] = [
        { Header: "First Name", accessor: "firstName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
        { Header: "Last Name", accessor: "lastName", type: "text", reorderable: true },
        { Header: "Email", accessor: "email", type: "text", reorderable: true }
    ];

    let originalInnerHeight: number;

    beforeEach(() => {
        // Store original window.innerHeight
        originalInnerHeight = window.innerHeight;
        // Mock window.innerHeight
        Object.defineProperty(window, "innerHeight", {
            writable: true,
            configurable: true,
            value: 800
        });
    });

    afterEach(() => {
        // Restore original window.innerHeight
        Object.defineProperty(window, "innerHeight", {
            writable: true,
            configurable: true,
            value: originalInnerHeight
        });
    });

    it("should handle window resize events and clean up listeners", async () => {
        const removeEventListenerSpy = jest.spyOn(window, "removeEventListener");

        const { unmount } = render(
            <ColumnReorderPanel
                columns={mockColumns}
                initialColumns={mockColumns}
                onReorder={jest.fn()}
                hiddenColumns={[]}
                onVisibilityChange={jest.fn()}
            />
        );

        // Wait for any initial state updates to complete
        await act(async () => {
            // Change window height
            Object.defineProperty(window, "innerHeight", {
                writable: true,
                configurable: true,
                value: 600
            });

            // Trigger resize event
            window.dispatchEvent(new Event("resize"));
        });

        // The component should handle the resize event without crashing
        expect(screen.getByTestId("dnd-context")).toBeInTheDocument();

        // Unmount the component
        unmount();

        // Should have called removeEventListener for the resize event
        expect(removeEventListenerSpy).toHaveBeenCalledWith("resize", expect.any(Function));

        // Clean up spy
        removeEventListenerSpy.mockRestore();
    });
});
````
